desc_chs: 爽脆可口的酸甜果实，无论生食或是酿酒都很是美味。
desc_en: Crisp and fragrant. Delicious raw or made into wine.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 遍布提瓦特大陆的自然恩惠，如夕阳般靓丽美好的饱满果实。有着奇异的香甜气味，能让人精神百倍。
desc_en: A plump fruit, beautiful like the sunset, that is abundant across all of Teyvat. It has a curious, sweet aroma and is able to energize an individual.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 不知道谁塞给你的
desc_en: You have no idea who slipped it to you.

desc_chs: 蒙德城市民的货物，之前被丘丘人在醉汉峡劫掠了
desc_en: Items belonging to the people of Mondstadt that were previously stolen by hilichurls in Drunkard Gorge.

desc_chs: (test)此道具废弃
desc_en: Made by hilichurl witch doctors. Cures hilichurl poison.

desc_chs: 攀爬比赛终点的标记物
desc_en: Marker indicating the finish line of the Climbing Competition.

desc_chs: 飞行比赛终点的标记物
desc_en: Marker indicating the finish line of the Gliding Competition.

desc_chs: 飞行决赛终点的标记物
desc_en: Marker indicating the finish line of the Gliding Competition finals.

desc_chs: 会被颁发给蒙德城的飞行比赛冠军
desc_en: Awarded to the Mondstadt Gliding Competition Champion.

desc_chs: 生命力旺盛的常见菌类。只要拥有适宜的荫蔽与水分，在何处都能蓬勃生长。
desc_en: Hardy common fungi. Can grow anywhere with the right amount of shade and moisture.

desc_chs: 香气浓郁的植株。即便在黑暗中，也能循着芬芳的气息找到的花朵。
desc_en: Particularly fragrant flowers. They can be found easily, even in the dark. Just follow the scent.

desc_chs: 营养非常丰富的草本植物。易于种植与收获的作物，口感清甜爽脆。
desc_en: A healthy and nutritious vegetable that is crunchy and sweet to the taste. Easy to grow and harvest.

desc_chs: 纤维分明的草本植物。易于种植与收获的作物，富含纤维与营养。
desc_en: Rich in fiber and nutrients. Easy to grow and harvest.

desc_chs: 烹饪后可食用的植株。作为香料能给食材带来奇妙的滋味。
desc_en: Can be eaten once cooked. As a spice, it can bring wonderful flavor to dishes.

desc_chs: 饱含清凉成分的植物叶子。清爽冰凉的滋味能将暑气荡涤一空。
desc_en: A refreshingly cool ingredient. The cool, fresh flavor can cut through the heat of many dishes.

desc_chs: 金灿灿的穗子，让人充满希望。要经过磨砺与水火才能成为终极形态。
desc_en: Golden, sun-kissed tassels. Needs to be ground down to flour for further use.

desc_chs: 层层相裹的蔬菜。据说曾经是观赏植物，如今在锅里的模样也很棒。
desc_en: A layered, leafy vegetable. Said to have originally been an ornamental plant, it certainly looks great in the pot.

desc_chs: 珍贵的植物，生长在陡峭崖壁上的傲骨，在暗夜中发出高洁的光。
desc_en: A rare plant that grows on steep cliffs with nobility. Shines magnificently in the night.

desc_chs: 富含油脂的肥美种子，并不会在松鼠的胃里长成参天大树。
desc_en: Filled with oil-rich seeds. Certainly won't be growing into a tree from inside a squirrel's stomach.

desc_chs: 带着勾刺的莓果，会挂在狼的毛皮上来迁徙。看见它时，仿佛能听见狼的凄嚎在林间回荡…
desc_en: A berry with thorns that often gets attached to a wolf's pelt. When you look at it, you can almost hear the echoing cries of the wolves in the woods.

desc_chs: 饱满透亮的莓果，在口中绽放出清甜的花香。在过去，守望风暴的人仅有的慰藉便是落落莓的甜蜜与对城市安宁的希望。
desc_en: A plump and translucent berry that has a fragrant smell and a sweet, refreshing taste. In the past, the storm watchers' only solace was the sweetness of this fruit and hope for the city's peace.

desc_chs: 名字与外形同等美丽的花朵，只生长在清冷而风急的高处，如同浪子一样真心难以触碰。
desc_en: A beautiful flower with a name that suits its appearance. It only grows where harsh winds blow, and is just as intangible as the true heart of an unbound soul.

desc_chs: 喜好风的植物。对于崇信风、本身也如风一般爽朗自在的蒙德人而言，风车菊便是「看得见的风」。
desc_en: A plant that adores the wind. To the proud children of the wind, or the citizens of Mondstadt, the Windwheel Asters are "the visible winds."

desc_chs: 沐浴着和煦的风而生长的菌类，与风一样生生不息，滋养生命。
desc_en: A fungus that grows in the warm caress of the wind. It is as everlasting as the wind, nourishing life.

desc_chs: 璃月水生的泽芝，花开两株。一株盛放芳香，一株莲蓬清苦。据说能入药。
desc_en: An aquatic plant native to Liyue that grows and blooms in pairs. One is fragrant, and the other bitter. It's said to make a good herbal medicine.

desc_chs: 璃月地方特产的辛辣植物。只要闻到它的味道，身体就会变得炽热，渴求水分。
desc_en: A spicy plant native to Liyue. Merely smelling it makes one hot and thirsty.

desc_chs: 稀有的特质矿石，在静谧的暗夜里会幽幽地发光。据称是天地间奔流的元素在异变中凝聚成的珍奇宝石。
desc_en: A rare mineral that glimmers in the dark. It's said to be a mutated gemstone condensed from the flourishing elements of the world.

desc_chs: 在璃月如霓云般盛放的妖红之花，能制成如水般顺滑的织物。
desc_en: A crimson flower that blooms like the rainbow clouds in Liyue. It can be made into silky-smooth fabric.

desc_chs: 极为古老的花卉。据说曾经遍布璃月大地，能将大地的记忆积攒成花期时的芬芳。
desc_en: An extremely ancient flower that was said to be commonly seen in Liyue. It transforms the memories of the land into its fragrance during florescence.

desc_chs: 只生长在孤高石峰的通透白花。不愿接受平原的温暖与湿润，宁可在清冷的尖峰眺望远方。
desc_en: A translucent white flower that only grows on the highest stone peaks. It eschews the warmth and moisture of the plains to gaze out afar from the solitary mountaintops.

desc_chs: 偶然随荻草生长的紫色植物。比周围的荻草更为挺拔、饱满，如同崇高的人。
desc_en: A purple plant that sometimes grows amidst Silvergrass but grows taller, straighter, and plumper — like an aristocrat among the paupers.

desc_chs: 随着海潮来到沙滩上的螺。将耳朵凑近空壳，能听见海充满思念的呼唤。
desc_en: Empty seashells brought ashore by the tides. Hold one close to your ear, and hear the longing calls of the sea.

desc_chs: 拥有旺盛生命力的小花，传说朝下盛开的花姿是为了守住它的香气。
desc_en: A small flower with strong vitality. It is said that its downward-blooming flower keeps its fragrance from dissipating.

desc_chs: 颜色鲜艳的果实。遍布野外的小小美好，能将路途疲惫一扫而空。
desc_en: Small, brightly-colored fruit. They can be found everywhere, and the taste of them wipes the fatigue of a long journey away.

desc_chs: 封闭在坚冰当中的花芯。即使离开了植株也持续散发着寒气的冰凉植物。
desc_en: A flower bud encased in solid ice. Even after being picked, the flower continues to emit cold.

desc_chs: 火辣辣的花芯。熊熊燃烧的炙热花朵，即使被水浇熄了也隐隐地放出热量。
desc_en: The stamen of a fiercely burning flower. Even after being extinguished, it still emits heat.

desc_chs: 富含电力的晶石，由逸散在大气与大地中的电气积聚而成。摸起来酥酥麻麻的。
desc_en: A power-rich crystal that draws electricity from the air around it. Holding it makes your hand a little numb.

desc_chs: 在夜间会隐隐散发辉光的野花。与其他食材一同烹饪能提升鲜味。
desc_en: A wild grass that emits light at night. Used in cooking to enhance other flavors.

desc_chs: 生长在水边的花。花瓣经过烹制口感爽脆，清甜微苦。
desc_en: A flower that grows near water sources. When cooked, the petals have a chunky texture, yet are sweet and a little bitter.

desc_chs: 随风而行的细小种子。即使拔去了旅行的羽絮，其中也寄宿着远方的希望吧。
desc_en: A tiny seed that rides on the wind. Even without its feathered wings, it still holds the hope from afar within.

desc_chs: 极纯的岩元素凝成的珍稀晶石，常与其他矿物伴生。也被称为「岩之心」。
desc_en: A precious crystal of condensed pure Geo element that usually grows along with other minerals. It's also commonly called "Cor Petrae."

desc_chs: 兽类的新鲜肉块。经过适当处理可以制成让人元气满满的美食。
desc_en: A fresh chunk of meat. Handled properly, it can be used to make delicious food.

desc_chs: 拥有无限可能性的禽类的卵，能带来一整天所需的蛋白质。
desc_en: An incredibly versatile ingredient that can supply all of your daily protein needs.

desc_chs: 与松树伴生的珍稀菌类，散发的淡雅鲜香暴露了它的位置。
desc_en: A rare fungus that generally grows on or near pine trees. Its delicate aroma gives away its location.

desc_chs: 禽类的新鲜肉块。经过适当处理可以制成让人精神一振的佳肴。
desc_en: A fresh chunk of fowl. Handled properly, it can make a hearty meal.

desc_chs: 色彩靓丽的翅膀。散落的鳞粉微微地发着光，或许是让蝴蝶能轻快飞翔的成分。
desc_en: Brightly colored wings. The powder that falls from them shimmers a little. Perhaps this is what allows them to fly?

desc_chs: 生活在近海区的甲壳类动物。细嫩鲜美的肉质，能够很容易地被加工成美味佳肴。
desc_en: A shelled creature that lives near the ocean. Its flaky, delicious meat can easily be made into tasty dishes.

desc_chs: 母蟹体内独有的美味。稀少而又珍贵的蟹黄，聚集了螃蟹的精华。但并非所有人都擅于品尝这种美味。
desc_en: A delicacy specific to female crabs. A rare and prized ingredient that isn't quite to everyone's taste.

desc_chs: 带有咸味的调味剂。只要在料理中准确把握「适量」的程度，就能让菜品产生质的提升。
desc_en: A savory seasoning. A precise but adequate amount will elevate the quality of the cuisine.

desc_chs: 球状的草本植物。为了报复切碎它的人，不管人的心情好坏都会让他落泪。
desc_en: A spherical vegetable. As vengeance for cutting it, it will make you cry, no matter how brave you are.

desc_chs: 带有香辛味的调味剂。能够解腻并激发食材的香味，和肉搭配在一起最佳。
desc_en: Peppery. Cuts through oily flavors and excites the taste buds. Goes best on meat.

desc_chs: 奶牛的乳汁。香香甜甜，嘴角的那滴也不想放过。
desc_en: Sweet and fragrant cow's milk. Don't waste a single drop, not even that one rolling down your chin.

desc_chs: 外皮鲜红的草本植物。色泽艳丽，酸甜多汁。关于它到底属于水果还是蔬菜的争论自古有之。
desc_en: A bright red ingredient that gives a tangy kick. Yes, the "fruit or vegetable" debate is still going...

desc_chs: 块状的草本植物。来自大地的馈赠，是不管怎样加工都永远吃不腻的一味神奇食材。
desc_en: A chunky vegetable. A gift from the earth that you never tire of with its multitude of cooking methods.

desc_chs: 常见的蛙类，生活在潮湿的环境。总是富有活力。身上会分泌出让人充满活力的物质。
desc_en: Common frog found in moist environments. Full of energy, they secrete a substance that will keep you full of vitality.

desc_chs: 萤火虫发出磷光的部位。对它而言是求偶的器官，对人则是能强健力量的良药。
desc_en: The light-emitting part of a firefly. Used for courtship, and in medicine to help recover strength.

desc_chs: 失去生命后微微卷曲的蜥蜴尾巴。含有强烈的药性，能让人皮肤变硬。味道很苦。
desc_en: A lizard tail that curled up after losing its owner. Very bitter, but has skin hardening properties.

desc_chs: 鱼类的新鲜肉块。经过适当处理可以制成让人回味无穷的菜式。
desc_en: A fresh fillet of fish. Handled properly, it can make a rich dish.

desc_chs: 晶蝶的核心。是吸食着大气中逸散的细小元素的晶蝶长出的奇妙器官。
desc_en: The core of a crystal butterfly. It absorbs elemental energy that has escaped into the atmosphere.

desc_chs: 兽类的新鲜肉块。经过适当处理可以制成让人元气满满的美食。
desc_en: A fresh chunk of meat. Handled properly, it can be used to make delicious food.

desc_chs: 禽类的新鲜肉块。经过适当处理可以制成让人精神一振的佳肴。
desc_en: A fresh chunk of fowl. Handled properly, it can make a hearty meal.

desc_chs: 鲜嫩的豆制品。口感如凝乳般细腻。
desc_en: Freshly made bean product that has a silky-smooth tender texture.

desc_chs: 有着奇特香味的种子。能给食物带来全然不同的清新风味。
desc_en: A seed with a peculiar fragrance that gives food a refreshing taste.

desc_chs: 鳅鳅吐出的闪亮珍珠，有神奇的药用效果。\n鳅鳅会将摄入的矿物质和元素凝结成带有微弱魔力的珠子，在紧急情况下，会将这些珠子吐出来迷惑狩猎者，以保全性命。
desc_en: A shiny pearl spat out by a loach that has mystical medicinal properties.\nMinerals and elemental particles ingested by the loach condense into these mildly magical beads. When threatened, the loach spits them out to confuse predators and escape with its life.

desc_chs: 新鲜生长出土的竹子嫩芽。有着奇妙的芳香，是只有竹子生长的地方才会出产的美味食材。
desc_en: A fresh young bamboo shoot, straight out of the ground. It is a delicious cooking ingredient with an exotic aroma, found exclusively in bamboo-growing regions.

desc_chs: 提瓦特常见的禾本作物。无论是什么样的人，都能欣赏这种颗粒分明的饱满口感，正所谓「一样米养百样人」。
desc_en: A grain crop commonly found in Teyvat. People of all walks of life enjoy its distinct grainy texture. As the saying goes, "The same kind of rice can feed one hundred kinds of people."

desc_chs: 饱满的深海虾仁。拥有丰富的营养与压倒性的鲜美风味。
desc_en: A whole piece of deep sea shrimp meat, full of nutrients and bursting with delicious flavor.

desc_chs: 稀有的鲜美肉类。\n据记载在数百年前已经灭绝的走豕品种，因为龙脊雪山的极端天候而被保存了下来。对于提瓦特的老饕们而言，是福音般神圣的极佳食材。
desc_en: Rare, fresh meat.\nThis species of boar is recorded to have gone extinct several hundred years ago and has been preserved by the extreme temperatures on Dragonspine. For the gourmets of Teyvat, this is an ingredient of unspeakable sacrosanctness.

desc_chs: 陆鳗鳗的新鲜肉块。经过适当调理，可以做成极其鲜美的佳肴。
desc_en: The fresh meat of an Unagi/Eel. If handled properly, it can be used to make fresh, lovely food.

desc_chs: 提瓦特常见的豆类作物。带有淡淡的香气，因食用方法多样而被各地民众广泛接受。
desc_en: A common legume in Teyvat with a light aroma. It can be prepared in a variety of ways, and is thus widely accepted by people all over the world.

desc_chs: 散发着神秘气息的新鲜肉块。不知道吃起来会是什么味道呢？
desc_en: A fresh chunk of meat that seems to be radiating an enigmatic aura. Wonder what it'll taste like?

desc_chs: 提瓦特常见的植物果实。带有特殊的香气，碾碎后，可用于制作饮品。
desc_en: A common fruit in Teyvat with a special aroma. It can be used to make beverages after being ground.

desc_chs: 经发酵而制成的果实汁。带有非同寻常的果实香气，常在烹饪肉类时用于调味。
desc_en: A fermented juice with a unique fruity scent. It is often used as a marinade.

desc_chs: 灰褐色的穗子，是大地的馈赠。要经过研磨与烘烤，才能化为醇厚的滋味。
desc_en: The gray-brown ears are a gift from the earth. Their richness can only be brought out by grounding and roasting.

desc_chs: (test)此道具废弃
desc_en: A few normal documents and a copy of Vera's Troubles.

desc_chs: 马斯克的游记。关于马斯克礁，其中写到“只有驾乘清晨的海风，才能从恋人岬滑翔到达…”
desc_en: Musk's Travel Journal. In the notes regarding Musk Reef is a line that reads: "Only on a morning sea breeze can one glide here from Lover's Cape..."

desc_chs: 《Yellow》的上半章乐谱，右下角标记着"S to J"的字样
desc_en: The first half of the sheet music for "Yellow." "S to J" is written in the bottom right corner.

desc_chs: 《Yellow》的下半章乐谱
desc_en: The second half of the sheet music for "Yellow."

name_en: Private Letter from Lisa to Jean
desc_chs: 丽莎拜托主角带给琴，说是《少女薇拉的秘密》下卷有消息了
desc_en: Lisa has asked you to give this to Jean to deliver the news that Vera's Secret is receiving a sequel soon.

desc_chs: 讲宫廷法师和她的王最后结婚了的故事
desc_en: Tells a story in which a court mage and her King get married in the end.

desc_chs: 看上去很好吃，其实是虚弱药剂
desc_en: Looks tasty, but is actually a weakening potion.

desc_chs: 丽莎拜托主角带给芭芭拉
desc_en: Lisa has asked you to give this to Barbara.

desc_chs: 丽莎拜托主角带给芭芭拉
desc_en: Lisa has asked you to give this to Barbara.

desc_chs: 温迪拜托寻找的诗篇，只是断章
desc_en: The poem Venti asked you to look for, though only the first part of it.

desc_chs: 温迪拜托寻找的诗篇，似乎还有下文
desc_en: The poem Venti asked you to look for, though it would seem there is more.

desc_chs: 温迪拜托寻找的诗篇，和前面两页一起构成一首小情诗
desc_en: The poem Venti asked you to look for, piece the three pages together to reveal a love verselet.

desc_chs: 印刻在建筑上的古文字
desc_en: Ancient text engraved on the building.

desc_chs: 可以使被深渊法师变成丘丘人的患者恢复人形
desc_en: Can restore those that have been transformed into hilichurls by Abyss Mages back to their human form.

desc_chs: (test)此道具废弃
desc_en: Can be used for taking down Stormterror.

desc_chs: 没抓到蛐蛐，只捡到蛐蛐腿上一根毛。
desc_en: You didn't catch a cricket, just a hair off its leg.

desc_chs: 随处可见、须端浅淡，没有什么稀奇的蛐蛐。
desc_en: Common cricket. Can be seen everywhere, nothing rare about it at all.

desc_chs: 值得一战的蛐蛐，大颚发蓝，斗争时的咬合力相当可观。
desc_en: A big blue cricket. Seems to have a powerful bite force. Should be good at battle.

desc_chs: 难得一见的珍贵蛐蛐，翅脉间透出七种不同层次的紫红光泽。
desc_en: A rare cricket with seven different red and purple layers to its wings.

desc_chs: 哇！金蛐传说！
desc_en: Oh, wow! The Legendary Golden Cricket!

desc_chs: 温迪给的水琥珀道具，击碎可产生降雨（测试）
desc_en: Hydro Amber given to you by Venti. Can be smashed to create rainfall. (Test)

desc_chs: 温迪给的风琥珀道具，击碎可产生风场（测试）
desc_en: Anemo Amber given to you by Venti. Can be smashed to create air currents. (Test)

desc_chs: 随机路人被抢走的东西，没什么价值，快点换回去吧
desc_en: Items worth little value stolen from some random passer-by. Better return them quickly.

desc_chs: 随机路人被抢走的东西，没什么价值，快点换回去吧
desc_en: Items worth little value stolen from some random passer-by. Better return them quickly.

desc_chs: 随机路人被抢走的东西，没什么价值，快点换回去吧
desc_en: Items worth little value stolen from some random passer-by. Better return them quickly.

desc_chs: 随机路人被抢走的东西，没什么价值，快点换回去吧
desc_en: Items worth little value stolen from some random passer-by. Better return them quickly.

desc_chs: 水滴状的结晶，流动着赤红色的阴郁光芒，可能是那条龙留下的东西…刚才那个与龙交谈的怪人也许知道这是什么吧。但他到哪里去了？
desc_en: A teardrop crystal in which gloomy red gleams flow. Seems to have been left by the dragon. Perhaps the person that was talking with the dragon knows more about it, but where did he go?

desc_chs: 封印线索
desc_en: Seal Clue

desc_chs: 封印线索

desc_chs: 遗落在古代竞技场的泪滴。吸引了许多怪物到来，真是一场大乱斗啊。
desc_en: A curious teardrop left in the ancient arena that attracted hordes of monsters to fight for it.

desc_chs: 被抢夺的泪滴。在丘丘人的圣山「说服」了一些黑日族部落成员，才得到了这枚结晶。
desc_en: A teardrop looted and treasured by some members of the Eclipse hilichurl tribe. Had some trouble "convincing" them to part with it.

desc_chs: 被藏匿在林中废墟的泪滴。还好没有被虫子吃掉。
desc_en: A tear hidden in the forest ruins. Thankfully it hadn't been eaten by the insects.

desc_chs: 曾是风神巴巴托斯的至宝，但如今「风」的力量已然干涸。
desc_en: A treasure that once belonged to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, but its Anemo power has all dried up.

name_en: Partially Repaired Holy Lyre der Himmel
desc_chs: 曾是风神巴巴托斯的至宝，接触泪滴结晶后稍稍恢复了一些力量。
desc_en: A treasure that once belonged to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, with some power restored by a Teardrop Crystal.

name_en: Completely Repaired Holy Lyre der Himmel
desc_chs: 风神巴巴托斯的至宝，如今元素之力满溢，或许可以用来呼唤风龙特瓦林。
desc_en: A treasure that once belonged to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, that has been restored to full power. Even Dvalin may heed its call.

desc_chs: 风龙留下的泪滴，似乎涌动着一股清澈的风元素之力。
desc_en: A teardrop left behind by Dvalin. The pure power of Anemo resonates within it.

desc_chs: 风神巴巴托斯的至宝。它发出的清澈的琴声曾经传上高天，让无羁的风龙特瓦林为之倾心。但现在只能发出暗哑刺耳的噪音了。
desc_en: A prized treasure of Barbatos, the Anemo Archon. Its clear sound that once echoed through the heavens and was beloved by the unruly Dvalin has now been reduced to naught but dull, ear-piercing noise.

desc_chs: 记载着有关宝藏线索的纸，上面是一幅意味不明的画，附带着一句意味不明的话
desc_en: A piece of paper with clues to a treasure. On it, is an unclear map with an unclear message.

desc_chs: 记载着有关宝藏线索的纸，上面是一幅意味不明的画，附带着一句意味不明的话
desc_en: A piece of paper with clues to a treasure. On it, is an unclear map with an unclear message.

desc_chs: 一张潦草的地图，图中某处打上了简单的标记。
desc_en: A scribbled map with a simple marking in a particular area.

desc_chs: 曾经掌握在愚人众手中的钥匙。和所有钥匙一样，一枚钥匙对应一扇门。
desc_en: A key that once belonged to the Fatui. Just like all other keys, each respond to a door.

desc_chs: 可以打开黑色大门
desc_en: Opens the black door.

desc_chs: 我可从来没有觉得世界很无聊。单纯是因为有趣的事情都在很远的地方罢了。\n——向往着未知远方的平凡少女薇拉，宏大的冒险奇谭悄然开幕。
desc_en: I don't ever think the world is monotonous. It's just that interesting things happen in far away galaxies.\nThe great adventure of Vera, an ordinary girl always fascinated by distant lands, secretly begins.

desc_chs: 总是在觉得无聊，这可不是什么忧郁，而是到了十四岁年纪了。\n总之薇拉的冒险，在此开幕！
desc_en: Everything's just boring. Everything, all the time. It's not depression. It's just reaching the age of 14.\nSo begins Vera's adventure.

desc_chs: 仙女座的帝国幅员辽阔，基本占领了本星系群大半江山。每个行星都有自己的恶魔与众神，海龙与怪兽。\n「我对你家闪烁的每一个星星都想象过一个故事呢。」「那不可能，这里看仙女座星云只有月亮五分之一大。」\n少女薇拉的冒险，仍在继续！
desc_en: The Andromeda Empire stretches across half the galaxy group. Every planet within the Empire has its own demons and deities, dragons and monsters.\n"I've come up with a story for every star from your home." "That's not possible. Looking from here, the Andromeda Galaxy is only one fifth the size of your moon."\nSo continues Vera's adventure.

desc_chs: 「你有没有思考过，假如没有了神，我们的生活会怎样？」\n在理智而幽默的叙述中，与作者一同拨开那团名为「神性」的迷雾。
desc_en: "Have you ever thought about what our lives would've been like without the archons?"\nCome and join the author in an exploration of "divinity" with humor and logic.

desc_chs: 自蒙德城重建起，广为传唱的歌谣，讲述了西风骑士团创始者温妮莎早年，在蒙德受到奴役的故事。
desc_en: A popular song since the reconstruction of Mondstadt. It tells the story of Vennessa, the founder of the Knights of Favonius, in her early years as a slave in Mondstadt.

desc_chs: 自蒙德城重建，就广为传唱的歌谣，讲述了西风骑士团创始者温妮莎早年，与风神巴巴托斯相识，战败魔龙，推翻贵族的传奇故事。
desc_en: A popular song since the reconstruction of Mondstadt. It tells the story of Vennessa, the founder of the Knights of Favonius, in her early years when she met Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, as well as how she defeated the drake and overthrew the Aristocrats.

desc_chs: 蒙德百货订货板
desc_en: Mondstadt General Goods Order Board

desc_chs: 猫尾酒馆留言板
desc_en: Cat's Tail Tavern Message Board

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (I)
desc_chs: 蒲公英，蒲公英，跟风一起，到远方去吧——小狐狸念念有词地说。\n令人难忘的蒙德童话，猎人与狐狸的故事，《蒲公英海的狐狸》，总十一卷，就此开始。
desc_en: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nAn unforgettable Mondstadt fairytale about a hunter and a fox. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, an 11-part story, begins here.

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (II)
desc_chs: 「狐狸乖乖，别乱动。」遇到了猎人，被冰雾花困住的狐狸，命运究竟如何？\n猎人、狐狸和蒲公英的童话，第二卷，继续展开。
desc_en: "Be good and stay put." Trapped by a Mist Flower, what does fate have in store by the fox who met a hunter?\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox continues in Part 2.

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (III)
desc_chs: 门外的动静，惊醒了狩猎无果的猎人。在门外的，究竟是谁呢？\n猎人与狐狸的童话仍在延续。《蒲公英海的狐狸》，第三卷。
desc_en: The Hunter of fruitless hunts was awoken by a commotion outside. Who is at his door?\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox continues. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 3.

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (V)
desc_chs: 接受了狐狸的条件，他来到了所有消失不见的猎物最终抵达的，蒲公英飘舞的无边无际的旷野。\n猎人、狐狸，在蒲公英的海洋中的故事，第五卷。
desc_en: Upon accepting the Fox's conditions, he came to the place where all the prey who disappeared had eventually gone to — an endless field of dandelions.\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox in the sea of dandelions. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 5.

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (VI)
desc_chs: 「你为什么要学说人的话呢？」「为了变成人以后，能和人交朋友啊。」\n蒲公英海中，稚嫩的声音不知传到了何方。童话故事《蒲公英海的狐狸》，第六卷。
desc_en: "Why do you want to learn the language of human?" "So I can befriend humans when I become one."\nThe child-like voice says, in the sea of dandelions. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 6.

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (VII)
desc_chs: 「蒲公英，蒲公英，跟风一起，到远方去吧。」小狐狸念念有词地说。\n猎人也能学会魔法，实现自己的愿望吗？童话故事《蒲公英海的狐狸》，第七卷。
desc_en: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nCan the Hunter also learn magic to make his wish come true? The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 7.

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (X)
desc_chs: 令人感慨的别离终于到来，小狐狸向他的母亲、老师和蒲公英海挥手告别。\n是兑现承诺的时候了。童话故事《蒲公英海的狐狸》，第十卷。
desc_en: The somber parting has finally arrived... The Fox bids farewell to its mother, teacher, and the dandelion sea.\nIt's time to live up to the promise. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 10.

name_chs: 蒲公英海的狐狸·卷十一
name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (XI)
desc_chs: 蒲公英，蒲公英，跟风一起，到远方去吧——狐狸念念有词地说。\n令人难忘的蒙德童话，猎人与狐狸的故事，《蒲公英海的狐狸》，完结篇。
desc_en: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nAn unforgettable Mondstadt fairytale about a hunter and a fox. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, the final installment.

desc_chs: 丘丘语桂冠诗人代表作！通过一部诗集，学者泰斗雅各布·马斯克带你进入丘丘人的神秘精神世界！
desc_en: The masterpiece of the Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian! Scholar Jacob Musk will show you the mysterious spiritual world of the hilichurls through this poetry collection!

desc_chs: 丘丘人的生活也有酒和诗吗？丘丘人也会有虔诚的渴望吗？丘丘人专家雅各布·马斯克给你答案！
desc_en: Are wine and poetry a part of the hilichurl lifestyle? Do they have pure and devout desires? Expert on the hilichurls, Jacob Musk, is here to answer!

desc_chs: 星际高速路和高速公路的路边是不能野餐的，就算是众神被高速星际船撞了也是全责。\n看起来只是普通的小村书房，透过门扉却可以到达宇宙与时间的任何一处地方！与众神午餐、与时间捉迷藏。薇拉的冒险，在此继续！
desc_en: You can't have picnics on the sides of a galactic highway! Even the deities will be held fully responsible for road accidents that might occur!\nThe doorway to a study in a simple village connects to anywhere in space and time! Having tea with the deities, playing hide-and-seek across time... Vera's great adventure continues!

desc_chs: 「薇拉她这么漂亮，在宇宙里闪耀，而我……」「这个年纪的男孩子看起来就是会比女孩子矮小。」\n必须得到达青春，必须得告别童年了！事到如今才点题也并不晚，少女薇拉真的开始忧郁！
desc_en: "Vera's so beautiful, like a shining star in the universe, but I..." "Boys at this age are always more petite than girls of a similar age."\nChildhood must be let go of to welcome the coming of the adolescent years. It's not too late to think about it now... Real melancholy finally hits Vera.

desc_chs: 稻妻「社奉行」神里家的大小姐。端庄而文雅，聪慧又坚韧。
desc_en: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

desc_chs: 「已经可以了。我们回家吧……现在距离我最远的地方，就是有你的德尔斐。」\n虽然现在才解释，小镇德尔斐是希腊神话的世界中心。《少女薇拉的忧郁》，圆满完结……吗？
desc_en: "It's enough. Let's go home... The furthest place I've dreamt of, is the Delphi where you are."\nThough the explanation is delayed, you should know that Delphi is the center of Greek mythology. Vera's Melancholy - the perfect ending... or is it?

name_en: Breeze Amidst the Forest - Ballad Selection Excerpt
desc_chs: 数百年前的学者们整理记录了蒙德诸多无名游吟诗人的诗篇，将其编纂结集，命名为《林间风》。
desc_en: A collection of Mondstadt ballads, recorded, compiled and arranged by scholars centuries ago.

desc_chs: 很久、很久以前的森林王国，发生着怎样的传奇故事？\n《野猪公主》，第一卷，为您揭示一个关于友谊，爱与生死的童话。
desc_en: A long, long time ago, in the forest kingdom... What legends occurred there?\nThe Boar Princess, Part 1. A story about friendship, love, and death.

desc_chs: 了无生命的冰原，温柔的风神也不曾光临的土地，竟然也有孤独的住民？ \n《野猪公主》，第二卷，故事在冰川继续。
desc_en: A lifeless ice field, a land even the gentle Anemo Archon has never visited. How is it that it still has its lonely inhabitants?\nThe Boar Princess, Part 2. The story continues on the glacier.

desc_chs: 「你从此以后将了无希望！」面对寒冰的诅咒，小狼将遭遇何种命运？\n《野猪公主》，第三卷。
desc_en: "Now and evermore shall you be bereft of hope." What fate awaits the wolf pup who bears such a cruel curse?\nThe Boar Princess, Part 3.

desc_chs: 幼狼在冰冷的孤独中成长，冰原孤狼的身世秘密就此完全揭开。\n《野猪公主》，第四卷。
desc_en: The wolf pup grew up in the cold loneliness. The secret past of the lone wolf is now revealed.\nThe Boar Princess, Part 4.

desc_chs: 「没有谁应该遭逢这样的命运。」善良的公主流下了悲悯的眼泪——在齐心协力的伙伴面前，寒冰终将被决心融解。\n《野猪公主》，第五卷。
desc_en: "No one deserves this fate." The good princess sheds a tear of compassion. For those who persevere as true companions, even the ice shall melt before their determination.\nThe Boar Princess, Part 5.

desc_chs: 冰封原野中的一切牺牲终于没有白费，友谊、爱与生死的完美终曲！\n催人泪下的童话名作，《野猪公主》，大结局！
desc_en: All the sacrifices made out in the frozen plains were not in vain. The perfect ending of friendship, love, life and death!\nThis is the end to the famous and touching story, The Boar Princess.

desc_chs: 贵族暴政的沉郁时代，异域少女与身负噩兆的孤儿在高塔前的相遇，两人的邂逅是否预示着注定悲剧的结局？\n瑰丽的历史小说，《蒙德高塔》，大幕揭开！
desc_en: In the age of depression and tyranny, the outlander girl met the ominous orphan. Does this fateful encounter foretell a tragic ending?\nThe historic romance novel, The Mondstadt Tower, begins!

desc_chs: 过于整齐的断痕
desc_en: Overly Clean Cut

desc_chs: 看起来已经腐烂很久了
desc_en: Seems it's been rotten for a long time.

desc_chs: 不知是谁遗弃的锋利爪钩
desc_en: Wonder who left it behind?

name_en: Breeze Amidst the Forest Supplement: The Dragon Tome
desc_chs: 对叙事诗集《林间风》的补充说明集，其中资料摘选自各类文献。\n描述了蒙德的龙的故事。
desc_en: A supplement to the "Breeze Amidst the Forest" ballad selection with excerpts from various sources.\nIt tells the story of the Dragon of Mondstadt.

desc_chs: 似乎是深渊教团对「暗夜英雄」下的战书，内容中有很多地方用「暗文」写成，隐藏了关键的情报。
desc_en: Seems to be a declaration of war from the Abyss Order to the "Darknight Hero." Many key phrases have been redacted.

name_chs: 白之公主与六侏儒·卷一
name_en: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (I)
desc_chs: 在提瓦特大陆各地流传已久的童话，这是第一册，讲述了夜之国与月光森林的故事。
desc_en: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This is part one, which tells the story of the Land of Night and the Moonlight Forest.

name_chs: 白之公主与六侏儒·卷二
name_en: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (II)
desc_chs: 在提瓦特大陆各地流传已久的童话，本册讲述了白之公主与光之王子的相遇。
desc_en: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This installment tells of the meeting of the Pale Princess and the Light Prince.

name_chs: 白之公主与六侏儒·卷三
name_en: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (III)
desc_chs: 在提瓦特大陆各地流传已久的童话，这一册讲述了白之公主与光之王子下定决心拯救月光森林的故事。
desc_en: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This installment tells of the Pale Princess and the Light Prince's decision to save the Moonlight Forest.

name_chs: 白之公主与六侏儒·卷四
name_en: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (IV)
desc_chs: 在提瓦特大陆各地流传已久的童话，该册讲述了白之公主与光之王子与六侏儒的相遇。
desc_en: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. Installment four describes the meeting between the Pale Princess, the Light Prince, and the Six Pygmies.

name_chs: 白之公主与六侏儒·卷五
name_en: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (V)
desc_chs: 在提瓦特大陆各地流传已久的童话，在这一册中，六侏儒险恶的阴谋徐徐展开。
desc_en: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. In this installment, the Six Pygmies' sinister scheme starts to unfold.

name_chs: 白之公主与六侏儒·卷六
name_en: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (VI)
desc_chs: 在提瓦特大陆各地流传已久的童话，这一册讲述了六侏儒如何实施他们恶毒的计划。
desc_en: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This installment tells of how the Six Pygmies managed to implement their nefarious plot.

name_chs: 白之公主与六侏儒·卷七
name_en: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (VII)
desc_chs: 提瓦特各地流传的童话，这是最终册，讲述了一切的结局与夜母的预言。
desc_en: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. The final installment brings everything to a conclusion, and includes the Night Mother's prophecy.

desc_chs: 清泉镇猎人奇幻悲剧之旅的开端，究竟何处是不幸的开始？千年孤独之旅的起点与终点为何？《千年孤独》第一部，为你揭开戈德森一生的梦幻迷雾！
desc_en: The beginning of the Springvale Hunter's tragic fantasy journey. Where did misfortune first befall him? What marks the start and finish of the 1000-year journey of loneliness? Let this first volume of 1000 Years of Loneliness be your guide through the fantastical fog that is the life of Gothson.

name_chs: 提瓦特游览指南·蒙德篇
desc_chs: 冒险家协会主办的旅行杂志，每一期都会介绍提瓦特大陆各地值得游览的景色。这一本登载了旅行家艾莉丝在蒙德的简短行记。
desc_en: A magazine by the Adventurers' Guild. Each issue introduces great sceneries across Teyvat. This issue includes a short traveling diary of Alice the Traveler on her experiences in Mondstadt.

desc_chs: 安柏拿错的…寓言书？
desc_en: A book mistakenly taken by Amber... about fables?

desc_chs: 用来捕捉一定体型的野兽。在野外留心搜集的话，还是能做出这样一个陷阱的。布置在地上，小心藏好。
desc_en: Used to trap beasts of a certain size. If you pay attention in the wilds to collect them, you can make one like this. Set one down, and then conceal it carefully.

name_chs: 冒险家罗尔德的日志·轻策山庄
name_en: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Qingce Village
desc_chs: 著名冒险家罗尔德在临时营地留下的日志，看起来还很新，散发着轻策山药草的清香。
desc_en: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald, at a makeshift camp. It stills looks new, and smells like the fragrant herbs of Mt. Qingce.

name_chs: 冒险家罗尔德的日志·渌华池
name_en: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Luhua Pool
desc_chs: 著名冒险家罗尔德在临时营地偶然落下的日志，似乎被水浸过，纸上留下了一只狐狸湿湿的爪印。
desc_en: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald, at a makeshift camp. It seems to have been dipped in water, with the watermark of a fox's footprint.

name_chs: 冒险家罗尔德的日志·瑶光滩
name_en: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Yaoguang Shoal
desc_chs: 著名冒险家罗尔德留下的日志，纸上有海风的味道。
desc_en: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages smell like the sea breeze.

desc_chs: 轻策庄的东东珍藏的信件，似乎是他的父亲寄回来的家书。
desc_en: A letter treasured by Dongdong from Qingce Village. It seems to be a letter from his father.

name_chs: 谁人的日志·其一·瑶光滩
desc_chs: 某人遗落在野外的日志，描述了其人在瑶光滩的不幸遭遇。
desc_en: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's unfortunate encounters at Yaoguang Shoal.

desc_chs: (test)冒险日志书页
desc_en: (TEST) Adventure Journal Page

desc_chs: (test)冒险日志
desc_en: (TEST) Adventure Journal

desc_chs: 生命力旺盛的常见菌类。只要拥有适宜的荫蔽与水分，在何处都能蓬勃生长。
desc_en: Hardy common fungi. Can grow anywhere with the right amount of shade and moisture.

desc_chs: 营养非常丰富的草本植物。易于种植与收获的作物，口感清甜爽脆。
desc_en: A healthy and nutritious vegetable that is crunchy and sweet to the taste. Easy to grow and harvest.

desc_chs: 层层相裹的蔬菜。据说曾经是观赏植物，如今在锅里的模样也很棒。
desc_en: A layered, leafy vegetable. Said to have originally been an ornamental plant, it certainly looks great in the pot.

desc_chs: 为新手风之翼使用者准备的指导手册，也是为取得蒙德城飞行执照必读的读物。本手册为蒙德公民提供了使用风之翼时需要注意的入门事项。
desc_en: A guidebook for the ones new to using wind gliders. It also serves as a mandatory reading material to get a gliding license in Mondstadt. It contains all the necessary info any user must know.

desc_chs: 从蓬蓬果的根系下挖出的浮生石，颜色十分特别，或许这就是望雅所说的「岚生石」…
desc_en: A piece of plaustrite dug up from the roots of a Bloatty Floatty. It has a rather unique color and is, perhaps, the Azurite that Wang'ya spoke of...

desc_chs: 从遗迹猎者处获得的浮生石，颜色十分特别，或许这就是望雅所说的「霞生石」…
desc_en: A piece of plaustrite plucked from a Ruin Hunter. It has a rather unique color and is, perchance, the Vermillionite that Wang'ya mentioned...

name_chs: 谁人的日志·其二·归离原
desc_chs: 某人遗落在野外的日志，描述了其人在归离原的不幸遭遇。
desc_en: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's unfortunate encounters at Guili Plains.

name_chs: 谁人的日志·其三·绝云间
desc_chs: 某人遗落在野外的日志，描述了其人在绝云间的冒险经历。
desc_en: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's adventures at Jueyun Karst.

name_chs: 谁人的日志·其四·璃月港
desc_chs: 某人遗落在璃月港的日志，描述了其人在璃月港的经历。
desc_en: A diary left behind by someone in Liyue that tells of the owner's adventures there.

desc_chs: 某人写给盗宝团的一封信。似乎有什么与海灯节相关的计划…
desc_en: A letter written by someone to the Treasure Hoarders about some plans for the Lantern Rite...

desc_chs: 从史莱姆处获得的玉石戒指，色泽温润，品质上佳。看上去应该是朱老板的失物。
desc_en: A Nephrite Ring obtained from a slime. Gorgeous color and clearly a top-quality item. This must be Mr. Zhu's lost property.

desc_chs: 裹上面粉的螃蟹先用油炸，再跟姜蒜一起炒，盛到盘里的螃蟹就像躺在黄金上。
desc_en: Crab meat that's been rolled in flour, deep fried, and then pan fried together with ginger and garlic. When you finally plate up, the crab appears to be lying on gold.

desc_chs: 古代冒险家莱纳德的笔记，看起来古旧残缺。因为年代久远，大部分内容都已散佚了，只剩只言片语尚存。
desc_en: Notes penned by Leonard, an adventurer from the distant past. Clearly an ancient text, it has suffered much wear and tear. Most of the content has been lost to the ravages of time, with just a few fragments remaining.

name_chs: 《百人一揆～最强武斗大会篇～》样稿
name_en: Draft Manuscript of "Hyakunin Ikki: The Greatest Battle"

name_chs: 菲谢尔辞典·皇女新编版
name_en: Fischl Dictionary: Die Neuauflage der Prinzessin

desc_chs: 正直严谨的蒲公英骑士，蒙德西风骑士团的代理团长。
desc_en: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

desc_chs: 由怀尔德保管的钥匙，用来打开仓库的大门。易丢程度仅次于干瘪的钱包。
desc_en: A key to the warehouse's gates kept by Wyatt. The likeliness of him losing it is next to him losing his slim wallet.

desc_chs: 由怀尔德保管的钥匙，用来打开仓库的大门。易丢程度仅次于干瘪的钱包。
desc_en: A key to the warehouse's gates kept by Wyatt. The likeliness of him losing it is next to him losing his slim wallet.

desc_chs: 装着摩拉的小小袋子。没有多少重量，偶尔会让人忘了它的存在。
desc_en: A small coin pouch of Mora that doesn't weigh much; you'd sometimes forget it's even there.

desc_chs: 装着摩拉的袋子，里面是向猎鹿人餐馆付出的订餐费。你的报酬并不能从此处支取。
desc_en: A small coin pouch of Mora that contains payment for a meal ordered at the Good Hunter. Do not take your cut out of this bag.

name_chs: 美味的蜜酱胡萝卜煎肉
desc_chs: 浇满蜜酱的肉料理。炙热的蜜酱让香嫩多汁的兽肉爆发出惊人的美味，似乎整个身子都沐浴在了橘色的暖阳中。
desc_en: A meat dish in a sweet honey sauce. The warm honey draws out the flavor of the meat, creating a flavor explosion akin to bathing in the warm summer sun.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 十分结实的木板，拿起时能感觉到可靠的沉重感，在各种方面都很易于使用。
desc_en: A sturdy plank. It feels heavy and reliable, and easy to apply to all sorts of scenarios.

desc_chs: 十分脆弱的木板，感觉可以轻松掰断，除了假装自己力气很大之外，没有太多用处。
desc_en: A fragile wooden plank that is easily breakable. It doesn't serve much of a purpose aside from pretending that you're strong.

desc_chs: 一捆结实的绳索。长度足够将某些部位暂时强行捆在一起，但也只能支持一小段时间。
desc_en: A bundle of sturdy ropes long enough to temporarily hold certain things together for a time, however short it may be.

desc_chs: 装着摩拉的袋子，里面是向猎鹿人餐馆付出的订餐费。你的报酬并不能从此处支取。
desc_en: A small coin pouch of Mora that contains payment for a meal ordered at the Good Hunter. Do not take your cut out of this bag.

desc_chs: 装着摩拉的小小袋子。没有多少重量，偶尔会让人忘了它的存在。
desc_en: A small coin pouch of Mora that doesn't weigh much; you'd sometimes forget it's even there.

desc_chs: 装着摩拉的袋子，里面是向猎鹿人餐馆付出的订餐费。你的报酬并不能从此处支取。
desc_en: A small coin pouch of Mora that contains payment for a meal ordered at the Good Hunter. Do not take your cut out of this bag.

desc_chs: 油炸的萝卜丸。美味得让人难以置信原料只是朴素的萝卜，吃过的人都会感慨璃月美食名不虚传！
desc_en: Fried Radish Balls. It's insane that something so delicious comes from plain old radishes! All who eat them will truly understand Liyue's culinary reputation.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高95点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 营养均衡的海鲜羹。蟹肉的鲜美在舌尖跃然绽放，配合上清凉的薄荷和嘟嘟莲，仿佛正赤脚在夏天的池边嬉戏。
desc_en: A balanced combination of seafood. The crab, mint, and Calla Lily come together perfectly to dance on your tongue. It reminds you of playing barefoot by the lake in summer.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高235点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 颇有些重量的袋子。入手后，让人不由自主地想要找另外的人帮忙。
desc_en: A bag that is quite heavy. Once picked up, you can't help but think of asking someone else for a hand.

desc_chs: TEST加工后的夜泊石
desc_en: TEST Processed Noctilucous Jade

desc_chs: 口感偏甜，颇有观赏性的酒品。在透明的酒液中，果汁如同夕阳余晖般缓缓垂落，深得情侣们的喜爱。
desc_en: A pretty and sweet cocktail. The juice slowly sinks in the clear liquor like the sunset. A favorite among couples.

desc_chs: 玛格丽特小姐的特调酒，口感清凉，很受那些只想小酌一杯的酒客欢迎。材料中也采用了「蒲公英」，但与著名的「蒲公英酒」还是有显著区别，最大的区别就是售价差距。
desc_en: Margaret's refreshing signature cocktail, popular among those who only want one drink. It also uses dandelions, but the greatest difference between this and dandelion wine is the price.

desc_chs: 干脆利落，几乎不加任何调制的酒品，忠实呈现了蒸馏酒的本味。喝上一口就能让人浑身发热。
desc_en: A straight liquor shot, giving you the original taste of the distilled liquor itself. One shot is enough to make your body burn.

desc_chs: 刻意制出了许多泡沫，拥有醇厚口感的啤酒。名字来源于大力碰杯时飞溅的泡沫。
desc_en: A mellow beer with thick layer of foam on top. The flying bubbles from making toasts gave it its name.

desc_chs: 这杯酒虽然味道勉强能够接受，但因为调制手法出错而失去了大部分的观赏性。
desc_en: Though the taste is acceptable, but it has lost its aesthetic value due to a mistake in the making.

desc_chs: 外观看起来尚可，但是错误的调制方式让清凉的口感几乎消失了。
desc_en: It looks alright, but a mistake in the making cost it its refreshing taste.

desc_chs: 既没有完全展现出蒸馏酒的本味，也没有其他突出的风味，也许…是调制手法出了什么问题。
desc_en: A shot without the taste of the distilled liquor and pretty much anything else... Something must have gone wrong.

desc_chs: 在错误的调制手法下，虽然味道尚能接受，但这杯啤酒的口感被大大折损了。
desc_en: Though the taste is acceptable, but a mistake in the making cost it its texture.

desc_chs: 有着果味的酒品，但味道似乎与昆恩所描述的「蒙德落日」并不一样…
desc_en: A fruity cocktail, but it somehow tastes different from what Quinn described.

desc_chs: 味道十分杂乱的酒品，似乎并不是玛格丽特所描述的「玛格丽特」…
desc_en: A drink with a messy taste, definitely not what Margaret promised.

desc_chs: 除了蒸馏酒的本味，能尝出许多味道的酒品。杜拉夫想要的似乎并不是这种酒…
desc_en: There are tastes of different liquors aside from the distilled liquor... This is not what Draff wanted.

desc_chs: 虽然这杯啤酒也有着醇厚的泡沫，但味道似乎和杰克所描述的「明珠」不太一样…
desc_en: There are bubbles and foams, sure, but it somehow tastes different from what Jack described.

name_chs: 勉强能称之为酒的物品
desc_chs: 因为加入了一些过于错误的材料，这杯酒似乎发生了一些并不美好的变化…
desc_en: Due to mistakes made while adding ingredients, this wine has undergone some unpleasant changes...

desc_chs: 从未见过的酒，让人很有一尝的冲动。
desc_en: A cocktail never before seen. Kinda makes one wanna try.

desc_chs: 十分平常的酒，随时随地都能喝到。
desc_en: A common alcoholic drink available anywhere.

desc_chs: (test)蒙德调酒新星的最新作品。
desc_en: (TEST) The latest creation of the new bartender in Mondstadt

desc_chs: 古德温给葛罗丽的信。厚厚的一大沓，大部分是让人脸红心跳的奔放示爱，和情侣之间亲昵行为的详细描述，让人不由得一目十行地往下快速阅读，实际上能记住的只有最后一段。
desc_en: A love letter from Godwin to Glory detailing their love and the intimate things they did, which would make any reader blush. However, only the last part is somewhat memorable.

desc_chs: 沉甸甸的漂流瓶，寄托了故友的信物与重聚的希望，随波逐流而来。
desc_en: A hefty bottle that came drifting with the waves, carrying tokens of an old friendship and the hopes of being reunited.

desc_chs: (test)可莉的本子
desc_en: (TEST) Klee's Notebook

desc_chs: 用甜甜花制成的止咳药，能稍微缓解咳嗽。味道清凉微甜，很受蒙德城孩子们的欢迎，甚至有的孩子为了尝到这种药而期待着自己咳嗽。
desc_en: Cough Syrup made from Sweet Flower that can moderately suppress cough. Due to its sweet and refreshing taste, the syrup is very popular among kids in Mondstadt. Some kids even wish they had a cough so they can get the syrup.

desc_chs: 杜拉夫寄给葛瑞丝修女的信。本来封得很紧，但是在丘丘人的暴力下，封装完全被破坏了。
desc_en: A letter from Draff to Sister Grace. It was tightly sealed, but it wasn't enough to withstand the brute force of the hilichurls.

desc_chs: 一些杂类材料，也许能勉强拼凑出一个木桩来…
desc_en: All sorts of materials. These should be just enough to make a training dummy.

desc_chs: 从璃月港寄回，收件人上写着莎拉的厚厚信件。信封上还有几根鸽羽，昭示着运送这封信的鸽子们有多努力，还有它们到底遭受了何等对待。
desc_en: A thick-set letter sent back from Liyue Harbor to Sara. Several feathers are still stuck in the envelope, signifying the effort that carrier pigeon put in and the sort of treatment it received.

desc_chs: 纤维分明的草本植物。易于种植与收获的作物，富含纤维与营养。
desc_en: Rich in fiber and nutrients. Easy to grow and harvest.

desc_chs: 盖伊写给父亲的信，以西风骑士团的方式牢牢封住。封得严严实实，努力保护着内面的信件，不受风雨和迷惘的侵扰。
desc_en: A letter from Guy to his father sealed as per regulation of the Knights of Favonius. It is tightly sealed to deter influence of rain and perplexity.

desc_chs: 昆恩的特调酒所需物品的清单。如果采用其他材料的话，会有出乎意料的效果吗？
desc_en: A list of ingredients Quinn needs for his cocktail. If other ingredients are used, what kind of result could one expect?

desc_chs: 玛格丽特的特调酒所需物品的清单。如果采用其他材料的话，会有出乎意料的效果吗？
desc_en: A list of ingredients Margaret needs for her cocktail. If other ingredients are used, what kind of result could one expect?

desc_chs: 杰克的特调酒所需物品的清单。如果采用其他材料的话，会有出乎意料的效果吗？
desc_en: A list of ingredients Jack needs for his cocktail. If other ingredients are used, what kind of result could one expect?

desc_chs: 杜拉夫的特调酒所需物品的清单。如果采用其他材料的话，会有出乎意料的效果吗？
desc_en: A list of ingredients Draff needs for his cocktail. If other ingredients are used, what kind of result could one expect?

name_chs: 提瓦特游览指南·璃月篇
desc_chs: 冒险家协会主办的旅行杂志，每一期都会介绍提瓦特大陆各地值得游览的景色。这一本登载了旅行家艾莉丝在璃月的简短行记。
desc_en: A magazine by the Adventurers' Guild. Each issue introduces great sceneries across Teyvat. This issue includes a short traveling diary of Alice the Traveler in Liyue.

desc_chs: 行秋写给飞云商会的信件，字迹潦草难以辨认。
desc_en: A letter written by Xingqiu to the Feiyun Commerce Guild. The handwriting is so messy it's barely recognizable.

desc_chs: 沉甸甸的袋子里装满了摩拉，由飞云商会提供，用来收购璃月地区所有流通中的石珀。
desc_en: A heavy bag full of Mora provided by the Feiyun Commerce Guild. Enough to purchase every Cor Lapis available in Liyue.

desc_chs:
弥耳再度念出了遗忘的咒语。少女与他再度相会——「原来真实的你长这样啊。」
「这个世界已经坏掉了，必须得全部烧尽重来。」疯狂的天帝对万物如此判决。
「我说，如果是你的话，是可以理解我的吧？」盗走国宝的无名大盗这么对圣上说道。
「不，不用道歉，因为你就是这样的温柔的存在呢。」
desc_en:
Mir once again chanted the forgotten spell. The maiden was reunited with him again. "So, this is what you truly look like."
"The world is beyond repair. It shall be born anew from the ashes of the last." The mad Celestial Emperor sentenced all living things of the world to a harsh punishment.
"But you, you would understand me, wouldn't you?" The nameless thief who stole the national treasure said to his lord.
"No. No apologies necessary, for you are benevolent."

desc_chs: 十分完好的木桩。牢固可靠，很适合用于训练。
desc_en: An intact training dummy. Very sturdy, perfect for training.

name_en: Legend of the Geo Archon: God of the Stove
desc_chs: 关于岩王爷「炉灶之神」的传说故事。
desc_en: Stories about the Geo Archon as the God of the Stove.

name_en: Legend of the Geo Archon: The Groundbreaker
desc_chs: 关于岩王爷「开拓之神」神职的传说故事。
desc_en: Stories about the Geo Archon and his divine duties as The Groundbreaker.

name_en: Legend of the Geo Archon: God of Wealth
desc_chs: 关于岩王爷「财神」神职的传说故事。
desc_en: Stories about the Geo Archon and his divine duties as the God of Wealth.

name_en: Legend of the Geo Archon: God of History
desc_chs: 关于岩王爷「历史之神」神职的传说故事。
desc_en: Stories about the Geo Archon and his divine duties as the God of History.

desc_chs: 刘苏所说过的《海山履云记》中的部分片段，讲述了南十字船队的故事…
desc_en: Segments from "The Wrath of Haishan," mentioned by Liu Su, that features the story of The Crux...

desc_chs: (test)神州折戟录小天章
(test)神州折戟录小门章

desc_en: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on the legends of stone beasts.

name_en: Records of Jueyun: Palace Beneath the Sea

desc_en: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on ancient fictional stories.

desc_chs: 传说是古代纪念岩王帝君与诸仙人夜叉的咒文，也是古时岩神信仰的文本之一。
desc_en: Legend has that it contains ancient incantations used to pay respects to Rex Lapis and the yaksha adepti. It also serves as a historical record of the ancient belief in the Geo Archon.

name_en: Records of the Gallant: The Hermit
desc_chs: 记录了璃月市井传说中诸多侠客的奇书，其中有些故事年代已远，但依旧十分受市井读者欢迎。
desc_en: A compilation of stories and legends of various knights-errant in Liyue. Some of them have been told for a long time but are still popular among the people.

desc_chs: 记录璃月港本土风俗的专著，最初由旅居璃月的须弥旅行学者法德兰编写，而后经过了诸多璃月本地学者的编校，在璃月广为出版流传。
desc_en: A book on the cultures and customs of Liyue originally compiled by Fadhlan, a scholar from Sumeru residing in Liyue. It was then edited by many local scholars and published. It is one of the bestsellers in Liyue.

desc_chs: 古代史家子苌将璃月古代记录历史的石板铭文加以翻译，编纂而成的史书，收录了许多简短破碎的史事。
desc_en: A history book compiled and translated from ancient stone tablets of Liyue by the historian Zichang. It contains various fragmented historical events.

desc_chs: 古代方士平山居人所作的闲逸打油诗集，其中作品质量参差不齐。但经常被璃月的年轻诗人或自以为诗人的年轻诗歌爱好者传阅参考。
desc_en: A poetry collection by Pingshan, The Mystic. The quality of the poems is all over the place, but it has long been a reference book for young poets or poet-wannabes in Liyue.

desc_chs: 蒙德生态学者，「丘丘语桂冠诗人」雅各布·马斯克关于丘丘人社会习俗的考察，本卷介绍了丘丘人的社会形式与特征。
desc_en: It contains the investigations and observations into the cultural customs of the hilichurls by the "Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian," Jacob Musk, a Mondstadt ecologist. This volume features the social structure and characteristics of the hilichurls.

desc_chs: 蒙德生态学者，「丘丘语桂冠诗人」雅各布·马斯克关于丘丘人社会习俗的考察，本卷探询了丘丘人的信仰与精神世界。

desc_chs: 蒙德生态学者，「丘丘语桂冠诗人」雅各布·马斯克关于丘丘人社会习俗的考察，本卷以蒙德为例，探究了多元化的丘丘人习俗。
desc_en: It contains the investigations and observations into the cultural customs of the hilichurls by the "Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian," Jacob Musk, a Mondstadt ecologist. This volume explores the diverse cultural customs of the hilichurls in relation to Mondstadt's.

name_en: History of Kings and Clans: Prologue
desc_chs: 着力于翔实刻画悠久而跌宕起伏的蒙德历史的学术书籍，由北大陆历史学会联合编著。
desc_en: A comprehensive history of Mondstadt edited and compiled by the Northland History Society.

desc_chs: 近代蒙德史家埃克哈特·古恩希尔德筛选贵族时代的破碎传说，编写而成的历史著作，讲述了家族先祖古恩希尔德的故事。
desc_en: A history book on the life of the apical ancestor of the Gunnhildr Clan compiled by Eckhart Gunnhildr, a modern historian of Mondstadt. It consists of fragmented stories and legends from the aristocratic period.

desc_chs: 自旧贵族时代流传至今的诗歌，据说是「晨曦骑士」莱艮芬德的自述。讲述了他还是骑士侍从时的经历。
desc_en: Ballads that have been passed down since the aristocratic period and are said to come from Ragnvindr the Dawn Knight himself. They tell of Ragnvindr's days as a knight's squire.

desc_chs: 自旧贵族时代流传至今的诗歌，据说是「晨曦骑士」莱艮芬德的自述。讲述了他与一位剑舞者的缘分。
desc_en: Ballads that have been passed down since the aristocratic period and are said to come from Ragnvindr the Dawn Knight himself. They tell of Ragnvindr's friendship with a sword-dancer.

desc_chs: 饮食烹饪是野外生存的重中之重！拥有十年资历的冒险家协会老会员琳，为您深入讲解如何野外紧急情况下吃饱又吃好的烹饪秘诀！
desc_en: Field-cooking skills are paramount to surviving in the wilderness. Lynn, a 10-year Adventurers' Guild veteran, teaches you how to cook delicious and fulfilling food in times of emergency in the wilderness!

须弥学者麦苏迪所著民俗百科全书《琉璃岩间国土纪行》的璃月版本《匣中琉璃云间月》，因文笔佶屈聱牙，内容艰深难读而备受书商与读者冷落。《护法仙众夜叉录》是其中一册，本册介绍了曾与岩之神并肩作战的诸位夜叉之事迹。
desc_en: A volume out of the "Wonders and Folklore of Liyue" collection, which serves as Liyue's own version of "Tour of the Land of Liyue," an encyclopedia of folk beliefs and customs by Masudi, a scholar from Sumeru. Due to the archaic nature of the author's writing style, it was largely dismissed by the public and publishers alike. "Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti" introduces the readers to the various yakshas who fought side-by-side with the Geo Archon.

desc_chs: 望舒客栈大厨言笑的拿手招牌菜，清甜中带着杏仁苦涩的余韵，柔和的清香似乎连仙人也会闻之赞赏。
desc_en: The signature dish of Smiley Yanxiao, the chef of Wangshu Inn. It has a sweet taste but also retains the bitterness of the almonds. Its refreshing taste and mild fragrance shall impress even the adepti.

desc_chs: 遗落在地上的包裹，入手没多少重量。拿起来的时候能听见哗啦的响声，里面似乎装着很多零碎的小东西。
desc_en: A package that has been left on the ground. It's not very heavy; the sound of something clattering inside can be heard when picking it up. It must contain many small objects.

desc_chs: 愚人众执行官「公子」借出的某种信物。璃月民众只在「绝云间」外围供奉仙人，但据说持此信物者，可以安全地接近仙家洞府。
desc_en: A token lent out from "Childe" of the Fatui. Normally, the people of Liyue only hold rituals to worship the adepti in the peripheral areas of Jueyun Karst; however, he who holds this token may safely enter the residence of the adepti.

desc_chs:
太古之时，九洲互具，昆仑尚开。人住之土，名称「中洲」；神在之界，则唤「神霄」。
上一劫劫末之时，曾有神魔交战；最终神王折戟，九界火焚，万象化灰。
如今新世伊始，万类更生。昆仑闭合，诸世界不复相通。
围绕着神王之戟展开的新感觉武侠绘卷，启封！
desc_en: In ancient times when Axis Mundi was unobstructed, there were nine realms, each a world of its own. The realm of humans was known as the Zhongzhou, while the gods reside in Shenxiao.\nAt the end of the last calamity, a war between the gods broke out. The God King fell, setting the nine realms ablaze, obliterating all living things. The realms have now been born anew, life again thrives, but the passageway between the nine realms by Axis Mundi has been sealed off.\nAn all-new graphic novel on the epic journey in search of the God-King's Halberd begins!

desc_chs: 阴差阳错走上了征刀之旅的弥耳，还没踏出半步就遇到了空前危机。金吾、羽林精锐被贼人斩于邪剑之下。危急时刻，弥耳想起父亲传下的光禄寺密咒。传说天帝有一小女，名讳并未流传——此刻她却占据了眼前未央的身体，显现在前。已然化作恶鬼的贼人与邪剑，面对勉强可以缚鸡杀鸡的弥耳，究竟胜负如何？
desc_en: Mir, having stumbled onto the journey to retrieve the swords by accident, encountered a huge crisis before the journey had even begun. Imperial Guard and Imperial Escort elites were slain by enemies holding the Ominous Swords. Amidst grave danger, Mir recalled a spell taught by his father. Legend has that, the Celestial Emperor has a young daughter whose name was not known to the world; she now possessed Weiyang's body and revealed herself. Who would prevail? The wielders of the Ominous Swords who had turned into ferocious demons? Or Mir who could somewhat hold his own in a fight?

desc_chs: 「你还是叫未央吧。毕竟行走人间，这个身份最是方便。还有朝廷的牒文，王土之上，出入无碍。」因为放心不下未央，弥耳还是一同踏上了旅程。所谓遇魔斩魔，见妖诛妖——如今已经收集了邪剑五柄。\n虽然看起来好事过半，但是谁人心里都是清楚的。接下来的路途只会更加凶险——
desc_en: "Just stay with the name 'Weiyang' for convenience's sake on the road. With the official documents from the government in hand, you should be free to go as you wish throughout the kingdom." Still worried about Weiyang, Mir decided to accompany her on her journey and kill any demons they may encounter.\nThough they had already collected five Ominous Swords and all seemed to be well, they knew in their hearts that the way forward would only get more treacherous and perilous.

desc_chs: 「首先你别惊讶，我儿米弥耳，冷静听我说。我不是你亲生父亲。」「不——！」\n曾经的米光禄寺卿原来是山隐界的阿修罗可汗，当初离京也只是伙同太常、首辅演的一出戏。目的就是保护眼前的天帝幺女。\n「神霄天帝生前是我的朋友，现在已经堕为万物之敌。既然她已经被你召请，那我也死而无憾了。」
desc_en:
"Calm down, my son. Listen, Mir. I am not your real father..."
"Noooooo!"
The once Minister of Imperial Banquets was, in truth, Khan the Asura from Jotunheim. Leaving the capital was but an act in collaboration with the Minister of Ceremonies and the Grand Secretary to protect the daughter of the Celestial Emperor.
"The late Celestial Emperor Shenxiao, the now Contra Mundi, was once a dear friend of mine. But now, knowing that you have successfully summoned her, all my wishes have been fulfilled."

desc_chs:
「武官之中，想要重开昆仑的人并不少。让世界陷入混沌，那么武人的地位当然一步通天。」
「他们难道想要重开传说中的阿修罗战争吗？」
「是他想要。」
文官、武官的博弈，已死众神的计划，再度袭来的九洲危机！
desc_en:
"There are many among the military officials who wish to unseal Axis Mundi since the world in chaos would greatly elevate the position and importance of the Martial Artists."
"They want to wage another War of the Asuras?"
"He does."
The tug-of-war between the civil and military officials and the schemes of the past gods once again threatens all of the nine realms!
