desc_en: A clue found in the northern Guili Plains ruins: "To unite in ambition is to be steadfast and immovable for all time."

desc_chs: 在归离原「东面」遗迹中发现的线索：「其智如水，善利万物，为镜自省。」
desc_en: A clue found in the eastern Guili Plains ruins: "Wisdom is like water, it nourishes all those who receive it and in it is a reflection of the truth."

desc_chs: 在归离原「南面」遗迹中发现的线索：「坚其筋骨，适时而动。」
desc_en: A clue found in the southern Guili Plains ruins: "Fortify the bones, that movement be supple when the time comes."

desc_chs: 在归离原「西面」遗迹中发现的线索：「其德如树，荫蔽一间，生生不息。」
desc_en: A clue found in the western Guili Plains ruins: "Virtue grows tall like a tree, though there be shade it will flourish forever."

desc_chs: 进香的香炉。
desc_en: A censer used for burning incense.

desc_chs: 七星灯
desc_en: Seven-Star Lamp

desc_chs: 掇星攫辰天君留下来的信
desc_en: Letter left by Starsnatcher

desc_chs: 在蒙德土豆饼中加入了切丁的慕风蘑菇，比寻常的土豆饼口感更好，也更有营养。\n据说是由某位最爱「蒙德土豆饼」的父亲，为自己未出生的儿子所创造。
desc_en: A Mondstadt Hash Brown stuffed with chopped Philanemo Mushrooms. It's much tastier and more nutritious than the average hash brown.\nThey say a father who truly loved Mondstadt Hash Browns prepared these for his unborn son.

name_chs: 被草史莱姆吞下去过的树莓
desc_chs: 被草史莱姆吞下过肚子的树莓，外表看起来…似乎和平常的树莓没什么区别。用这个入药，真的能治病吗？
desc_en: It's a berry that's been digested by a Dendro Slime. From the outside, it appears the same as any other ordinary berry. Will using it for herbal medicine really have any effect?

desc_chs: 水史莱姆的浓厚凝液。捧在手里时，会不由自主地产生一种奇异的满足感，不知道口感会是怎样…
desc_en: A thick blob of Hydro Slime Condensate. You can't help but get a strange sense of satisfaction while sloshing it in your hands. As for its taste...

name_chs: 被风史莱姆吹拂过的风车菊
desc_chs: 被风史莱姆吹拂过的风车菊。虽然外表没有变化，但握在手中的时候，总感觉有微风从指缝间溜过。
desc_en: A Windwheel Aster that's been through the gentle caress of an Anemo Slime. Although its appearance hasn't changed, faint puffs of air seem to escape between your fingers as you hold it in your hand.

desc_chs: 精美的石制雕刻碎片，似乎在记录着某事，具体的意义，应该只有当地人能看懂…
desc_en: A delicate fragment of carved stone. It seems to have something inscribed on it, perhaps only locals could decipher its exact meaning...

desc_chs: 精美的石制雕刻碎片，似乎在记录着某事，具体的意义，应该只有当地人能看懂…
desc_en: A delicate fragment of carved stone. It seems to have something inscribed on it, perhaps only locals could decipher its exact meaning...

desc_chs: 精美的石制雕刻碎片，似乎在记录着某事，具体的意义，应该只有当地人能看懂…
desc_en: A delicate fragment of carved stone. It seems to have something inscribed on it, perhaps only locals could decipher its exact meaning...

name_chs: 从石碑上抄下来的文字
desc_chs: 「…初，因农而兴，聚之为集…」\n从石碑上抄下来的文字，似乎是在记录着什么事…
desc_en: "...In the beginning, when the people assembled to farm the land..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

name_chs: 从石碑上抄下来的文字
desc_chs: 「…有神临，名『归终』，善扬尘，遮天不知几千里…」\n从石碑上抄下来的文字，似乎是在记录着什么事…
desc_en: "...A god named Guizhong descended, whose dominion was over Dust, and whose reach shrouded the skies for thousands of miles around..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

name_chs: 从石碑上抄下来的文字
desc_chs: 「…引诫四条，告以诸民…」\n从石碑上抄下来的文字，似乎是在记录着什么事…
desc_en: "...The god laid down four commandments for the people..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

name_chs: 从石碑上抄下来的文字
desc_chs: 「…后又有神临，以岩为器，迁璃月族民于集，共护诸民…」\n从石碑上抄下来的文字，似乎是在记录着什么事…
desc_en: "...Then another god descended, whose dominion was over Geo, and who brought the people of Liyue to this place. Jointly they shepherded the people for their protection..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

name_chs: 从石碑上抄下来的文字
desc_chs: 「…取二神之名，号此集为『归离』…」\n从石碑上抄下来的文字，似乎是在记录着什么事…
desc_en: "...And the assembly was named Guili after the names of the two gods..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

name_chs: 从遗迹中抄下来的文字
desc_chs: 「…战于『归离原』，彼时黑尘漫天，千岩俱裂…」\n从石碑上抄下来的文字，似乎是在描述一场惨烈的大战…
desc_en: "...and there they fought upon the Guili Plains, where black dust choked the heavens and a thousand rocks splintered..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of a terrible war...

name_chs: 从遗迹中抄下来的文字
desc_chs: 归终四诫：「教之以智、律之以德、坚其筋骨，众志一心，四者汇之而成『归离集』。」\n「…故土难离。宝藏于归离，引之以『归终四诫』，后世子孙欲图者，当以之问本心…」\n从石碑上抄下的纸条，似乎是某人留下的信…
desc_en: Guizhong's Four Commandments are: "Teach with wisdom, be bound by virtue, fortify the bones, unite in ambition — the convergence of these four shall be known as the 'Guili Assembly.'"\n"...One can bear not to leave one's native land. A treasure lies in Guili, and Guizhong's Four Commandments shall guide those in generations to come who aspire to find it, if they would test themselves against the Four."\nThis transcript seems to be a letter that was left behind by someone...

desc_chs: 轻策山秘宝，含有巨大的能量。
desc_en: The hidden treasure of Mt. Qingce contains enormous Energy.

desc_chs: 写着关于轻策山密藏的情报
desc_en: A report regarding the hidden treasure of Mt. Qingce.

desc_chs: 从艾拉·马斯克那拿到的单句清单，上面记载了许多丘丘人语的单句，后面有着对于内容的简单标注…
desc_en: A list of lines from Ella Musk. On the front are many terms in Hilichurlian, and the back has some simple footnotes regarding the content...

desc_chs: (test)艾拉·马斯克的诗歌翻译
(test)优美的丘丘语抒情诗
封得紧紧的信封。信封里包含着信件、墨水字、蒲公英、爱，还有缥缈的希望。在信封开启之前，这一切都会保持完好。
desc_en: An envelope that has been tightly sealed. Inside is a letter, inked characters, a Dandelion, love, and a wisp of hope. All these will be safely preserved inside until the seal is opened.

desc_chs: 由玛乔丽推荐的「礼物」，入手时感觉没什么重量，不知道装着什么样的「纪念品」。
desc_en: A gift that was recommended by Marjorie. It isn't very heavy; what kind of souvenirs could be packed inside?

desc_chs: 从昆恩那里拿到的礼物。但据他说，这是由贝雅特丽奇小姐帮他准备的…
desc_en: A gift from Quinn. He mentioned that Beatrice helped him prepare it.

desc_chs: 莎拉小姐给吉丽安娜小姐特制的特色餐品。真好奇到底具体是什么餐品，有什么特别之处…
desc_en: A special dish that Sara had specially made for Jilliana. What dish could it be? And what could be so special about it?

desc_chs: 客商送给望舒客栈老板淮安的包裹。里面似乎装着一些礼物，重量没有轻到让人不快，也没有重到让人不安。
desc_en: A package given from a traveling merchant to Huai'an, boss of the Wangshu Inn. There seems to be some gifts inside. It's heavy enough to pique your interest, but not so heavy as to make you worry.

desc_chs: 装着货单的盒子。出于基本的社会常识和避嫌意识，不打开盒子偷看货单，一般来说是最佳选择。
desc_en: A box containing invoices of goods. Common sense says that to avoid raising any suspicion, it's usually best to not open the box and take a peek.

desc_chs: 装着货单的盒子。虽然都是纸质，但入手后依然颇有重量，让人不由得开始同情起每天都要和它们打交道的商人。
desc_en: Although it only contains papers, it's still pretty heavy. You can't help but to start sympathizing the merchants that deal with them daily.

desc_chs: 装着货单的盒子，被人拆开过，又再次严密封好。…到底是一笔怎样的生意，能让无意捡到的人都如此紧张呢？
desc_en: A box containing various invoices. It appears to have been opened once before and then tightly sealed back up. What nature of business could make even one who stumbles upon the box feel at nerve's end?

desc_chs: 清泉镇猎人们口口相传的传说故事，讲述了泉水精灵与不知名少年的相遇。
desc_en: A legendary tale passed down by Springvale hunters that portrays an encounter between an unknown young boy and a spring fairy.

desc_chs: 清泉镇猎人们口口相传的传说故事，讲述了泉水精灵与少年的相识。
desc_en: A legendary tale passed down by Springvale hunters that recounts the acquaintance of a spring fairy and a young boy.

desc_chs: 清泉镇猎人们口口相传的传说故事，讲述了泉水精灵与少年许下诺言的故事。
desc_en: A legendary tale passed down by Springvale hunters that recounts a promise made between a spring fairy and a young boy.

desc_chs: 清泉镇猎人们口口相传的传说故事，不再是少年的少年与不老的精灵终于面对苦涩的缺憾结局。
desc_en: A legendary tale passed down by Springvale hunters that recounts a bitter ending finally faced by a boy who was no longer young and a spring fairy who had not grown old.

desc_chs: 霖铃自费出版的精装诗集，是她的处女作，也是引以为豪的代表作。
desc_en: A collection of poetry that Linling published at her own expense. It is her first publication, and she is very proud of it.

desc_chs: 记载着货物信息的单据。只有简单的几项货物信息，看起来似乎是人为挑选出来的。
desc_en: An invoice with information of goods recorded on it. With only a few simple goods listed on it, someone must have selected these items.

name_chs: 确认了货物数量的货物单
desc_chs: 仅仅是确认过了货物数量的货物单。虽然是看上去很简单的工作，但也需要全身心投入，才能保证不会出错。
desc_en: Some manifests of goods that has only had their numbers checked out. This may seem like a very simple job, but one must still focus in order to ensure that no mistakes are made.

desc_chs: 用于制作「送仙典仪」所需香膏的霓裳花。\n这个品种原本生长在水文复杂之地，枝繁叶茂，花蕊如金屋藏娇，绿叶长存。
desc_en: Silk Flowers from which perfume used in the Rite of Parting is made.\nThis species originally grew under complex hydrological conditions. Its foliage is abundant, its leaves are evergreen, and its stamen is as fair as a Golden House Maiden.

desc_chs: 用于制作「送仙典仪」所需香膏的霓裳花。\n这个品种原本生长在山阴潮湿之地，花瓣大、蕊密，香气扑鼻，堪称花团锦簇。
desc_en: Silk Flowers from which perfume used in the Rite of Parting is made.\nThis variety originally grew in dark, damp locations. It is known for its profusion of petals, densely packed stamens, and powerful scent.

desc_chs: 用于制作「送仙典仪」所需香膏的霓裳花。\n这个品种过去的生长环境在烟岚云岫。孤傲清冷，开花时香气寡淡，却极为持久。
desc_en: Silk Flowers from which perfume used in the Rite of Parting is made.\nIn the past, this strain would grow among cloud-ringed peaks. It is a reclusive species, and has a subtle yet enduring scent.

desc_chs: 霓裳花熬出的精油，进一步提炼后可以制成香膏。散发着甜美的香味。
desc_en: The essence of decocted Silk Flowers. It can be further refined into perfume. Gives off a sweet scent.

desc_chs: 霓裳花熬出的精油，进一步提炼后可以制成香膏。散发着浓烈的芬芳。
desc_en: The essence of decocted Silk Flowers. It can be further refined into perfume. Gives off an intense scent.

desc_chs: 霓裳花熬出的精油，进一步提炼后可以制成香膏。散发着淡雅的香气。
desc_en: The essence of decocted Silk Flowers. It can be further refined into perfume. Gives off an elegant scent.

desc_chs: 空空的盒子，重量很轻。感觉上，这个脆弱的盒子似乎没有多少防护力…
desc_en: A light and empty box. It doesn't seem as though this fragile container has much protective ability...

desc_chs: 装入了「文物」的盒子。沉甸甸的重量，让人感觉这个盒子随时可能坏掉…
desc_en: A box containing cultural relics. Its ponderous weight makes one feel like it could break at any time...

desc_chs: 已经被水浸透的书页，似乎已经在水里泡了很久，上面的字迹被水泡烂，完全看不清了。
desc_en: A page of a book that has been soaked through in water. It must have been in there for a long time, as the words have become so smudged as to be illegible.

desc_chs: 「公子」提供的经费，这种沉甸甸的安心感反而让人不想花掉…\n每枚金币的面值都很庞大，但可以在「北国银行」兑换成零钱。
desc_en: Funds provided by Childe. The sense of stability one gets from its weight also makes one unwilling to part with the money...\nThe face value of each of these gold coins is very large, but they can be redeemed for smaller change at the Northland Bank.

desc_chs: 特殊品种的霓裳花手工熬制成的香膏。\n散发着甜蜜梦幻的香气。或许与清纯的少女最为相配吧。
desc_en: A perfume decocted from a special breed of Silk Flower.\nIt releases a scent that reminds one of sweet dreams. Perhaps it is the best fit for innocent young ladies.

desc_chs: 特殊品种的霓裳花手工熬制成的香膏。\n这种浑厚凌人的芬芳，听说很受富家千金欢迎。
desc_en: A perfume decocted from a special breed of Silk Flower.\nIt releases a thick, oppressive aroma. They say that it is very popular among the daughters of wealthy families.

desc_chs: 特殊品种的霓裳花手工熬制成的香膏。\n淡雅的香味如同山岳中缥缈的烟岚，据说最受成熟女性喜好。
desc_en: A perfume decocted from a special breed of Silk Flower.\nIt releases a fragrance as elegant as the elusive, smoky mountain mist. One hears that it is a favorite of mature women.

desc_chs: 从世界之外漂流而来的旅行者，被神带走血亲，自此踏上寻找七神之路。
desc_en: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

desc_chs: 装着索拉雅给的「小玩意」的盒子。拿在手里时，能感受到些微的重量，应该能暂时满足某些人的贪念。
desc_en: A box that contains the gadgets Soraya gave to you. You can feel its weight in your hand. It should be able to satisfy the greed of certain people.

desc_chs: 据说这是专门为仙人准备的法铃，其音玲珑振振，回荡久长不散，能够涤净凡尘。\n握在手中时，仿佛能感受其中有生命…
desc_en: It is said that this magic bell was prepared specifically for adepti. Its sound rings through the air and does not fade quickly, and can be used to purify the mortal realm.\nIt seems to have a life of its own, even as you hold it in your hand...

desc_chs: 古代保存至今的归终机备用零件。\n虽然看起来只是普通的建材，其实有着特殊的制作工艺与设计规格…
desc_en: Spare parts for the Guizhong Ballista that have been stored away since antiquity.\nWhile they may seem like ordinary components, they have been made with special construction techniques, and to special design specifications.

name_chs: 绮命与志华的对话记录
name_en: A Record of Qiming and Zhihua's Conversation
desc_chs: 绮命与志华的对话记录。看起来只是一些无聊的推搪对话，但总感觉，里面有一些微妙的默契…
desc_en: A record of Qiming and Zhihua's conversation. It seems like banal passing of the buck, but it feels like there is some tacit understanding hidden within...

name_chs: 思思与潮汐的对话记录
name_en: A Record of Sisi and Chaoxi's Conversation
desc_chs: 思思与潮汐的对话记录。粗略看过后，给人印象最深的只有无尽的逃避，还有避重就轻…
desc_en: A record of Sisi and Chaoxi's conversation. At first glance, the impression it makes is one of endless evasion, and of avoiding the brunt of work...

name_chs: 小蒙、阿飞与璐璐的对话记录
name_en: A Record of Little Meng, Little Fei, and Little Lulu's Conversation
desc_chs: 小蒙、阿飞与璐璐的对话记录。看起来只是一些无忌的童言，但从中也能隐约注意到孩子们心中懵懂情感的萌芽。也许，这些情感还会逐渐成长，直到枝蔓蔽天，无论是谁都无法将其忽视…
desc_en: A record of Little Meng, Little Fei and Little Lulu's conversation. It appears to only be the straightforward conversation of children. But one can dimly sense some unnameable emotion sprouting in the hearts of the children. Perhaps this sprout will continue to gradually grow until its branches stretch out across the skies, no longer able to be ignored by anyone...

desc_chs: 诺玛订的餐品。拿在手上时还能感觉到温热。
desc_en: Norma's food order. You can feel its warmth in your hand.

name_chs: 丘丘语诗歌试作·朗诵诗
desc_chs: 艾拉·马斯克创作的丘丘语诗歌。据她说，这首「友好的朗诵诗」中蕴含着许多人的心血。但是，读起来总感觉怪怪的…
desc_en: A Hilichurlian poem created by Ella Musk. According to her, this Recital of Friendship is the work of many hands. Still, you can't help but feel that something sounds a bit off when you read it...

name_chs: 丘丘语诗歌试作·叙事诗
desc_chs: 艾拉·马斯克创作的丘丘语诗歌。据她说，这首「激昂的叙事诗」中蕴含着许多人的心血。但是，读起来总感觉怪怪的…
desc_en: A Hilichurlian poem created by Ella Musk. According to her, this Stirring Narrative is the work of many hands. Still, you can't help but feel that something sounds a bit off when you read it...

name_chs: 丘丘语诗歌试作·抒情诗
desc_chs: 艾拉·马斯克创作的丘丘语诗歌。据她说，这首「优美的抒情诗」中蕴含着许多人的心血。但是，读起来总感觉怪怪的…
desc_en: A Hilichurlian poem created by Ella Musk. According to her, this Elegant Lyric Poem is the work of many hands. Still, you can't help but feel that something sounds a bit off when you read it...

desc_chs: 从薇尔那里拿到的礼物。入手后颇有重量，里面似乎塞着很多东西…
desc_en: A gift acquired from Vile. Given how heavy it is to hold, there must be quite a lot of items inside.

desc_chs: 被盗宝团挖掘出来的文物。被随意包裹在一个盒子里，拿起来的时候，感觉盒子随时都可能散架…
desc_en: Cultural relics dug up by the Treasure Hoarders, and packed willy-nilly into a box. When you lift the box, it feels like it could collapse at any moment.

desc_chs: 被关在琥珀之中，看起来平平无奇的盒子。入手后却能感觉到一股让人吃惊的重量，而且无论用什么方式，都没办法打开它…
desc_en: A seemingly ordinary container that had been trapped in amber. Its weight, once held, is astounding, and no matter what you do, you can't seem to open it...

desc_chs: 似乎是被强行撕下来的书页，已经被水浸透，上面的字迹完全看不清了。
desc_en: A page that seems to have been forcibly torn out of a book. It has been soaked in water, and the words on it have become illegible.

desc_chs: 字迹十分凌乱的书页，上面的字都被粗重的笔迹划去，又被水浸透，什么也看不清了。
desc_en: A page with very messy handwriting. The words have been struck out with crude brushstrokes, and it has also been soaked in water to the point where nothing can be made out.

desc_chs: 切下来的小片样品，用以甄选制作「送仙典仪」所需器物的夜泊石。\n璃月古谚有云，「夜泊烁光须火炼」，意思是优质的夜泊石在高温下会发出明亮清澈的蓝光，用来比喻英杰在逆境中会大放光彩。
desc_en: A small sample that has been sliced off in order to help you select the Noctilucous Jade you will be using to make implements for the Rite of Parting.\nAn ancient Liyue proverb goes: "Noctilucous Jade shines brightest in the flames," meaning that high-quality Noctilucous Jade will shine with a bright and pure azure light when exposed to high temperatures. It has also come to symbolize heroes showing their true mettle in times of crisis.

desc_chs: 「公子」提供的经费。袋子里叮叮当当的响声让人心情愉快。
desc_en: Funds provided by Childe. The clinking of the coins within lifts a person's spirits.

desc_chs: 从丘丘人暴徒身上拿到的战利品，看起来似乎能吹出很响的声音，不过，应该也无法把某些人从傲慢之心中吹醒。
desc_en: A trophy taken from a Mitachurl. It seems to be capable of producing a very loud sound, but that probably won't be enough to shake a certain group of people free of their arrogance.

desc_chs: 从盗宝团身上取得的战利品，盒子很小，入手也没有多少重量，绝对盛不下某些人的傲慢之心，但装下此人的心眼应该绰绰有余。
desc_en: A trophy taken from the Treasure Hoarders. This box is very small and isn't very heavy, and will not be able to contain the arrogance of certain people. But it should be more than enough to keep a lid on their tricks.

desc_chs: 从遗迹守卫身上取得的战利品。虽然外表看起来不怎么具有收藏价值，但足够沉重，如果砸在某位傲慢之徒的脚上，应该会很痛吧。
desc_en: A trophy seized from a Ruin Guard. It does not appear to have much value as a collector's item. But it is heavy enough that it would cause a great deal of pain, were it to be dropped onto a certain arrogant someone's foot.

desc_chs: 切下来的小片样品，用以甄选制作「送仙典仪」所需器物的夜泊石。\n璃月古谚有云，「夜泊烁光须火炼」，意思是优质的夜泊石在高温下会发出明亮清澈的蓝光，用来比喻英杰在逆境中会大放光彩。
desc_en: A small sample that has been sliced off in order to help you select the Noctilucous Jade you will be using to make implements for the Rite of Parting.\nAn ancient Liyue proverb goes: "Noctilucous Jade shines brightest in the flames," meaning that high-quality Noctilucous Jade will shine with a bright and pure azure light when exposed to high temperatures. It has also come to symbolize heroes showing their true mettle in times of crisis.

desc_chs: 切下来的小片样品，用以甄选制作「送仙典仪」所需器物的夜泊石。\n璃月古谚有云，「夜泊烁光须火炼」，意思是优质的夜泊石在高温下会发出明亮清澈的蓝光，用来比喻英杰在逆境中会大放光彩。
desc_en: A small sample that has been sliced off in order to help you select the Noctilucous Jade you will be using to make implements for the Rite of Parting.\nAn ancient Liyue proverb goes: "Noctilucous Jade shines brightest in the flames," meaning that high-quality Noctilucous Jade will shine with a bright and pure azure light when exposed to high temperatures. It has also come to symbolize heroes showing their true mettle in times of crisis.

desc_chs: 价值两百九十九万摩拉的，符合「送仙典仪」正统的线香。\n这世间有些东西的价值，只有了解它的人才明白。恐怕永生香也是其中之一吧…？
desc_en: A traditional incense fit for the Rite of Parting, worth 2,990,000 Mora.\nThere are some things in this world whose value can only be appreciated by those who understand them. Perhaps Everlasting Incense is one such thing...?

desc_chs: 古代保存至今的归终机备用零件。\n虽然看起来只是普通的建材，其实有着特殊的制作工艺与设计规格…
desc_en: Spare parts for the Guizhong Ballista that have been stored away since antiquity.\nWhile they may seem like ordinary components, they have been made with special construction techniques, and to special design specifications.

desc_chs: 很适合用于修理的木板。人们总在需要修理时想起它。
desc_en: A wooden plank well-suited to repair work. When people need repairs done, these things always come to mind.

desc_chs: 装有树叶的盒子。捧在手里的时候有一股不同寻常的感觉，让人不由得担心，这些树叶真的能装在这盒子里吗？
desc_en: A box with some leaves inside. Something feels unusual about it when you hold it in your hand, and you can't help but feel a little uneasy... can this box really contain these leaves?

desc_chs: （test）极为古老的花卉的种子
（test）水史莱姆体中生成的精华液，对植物的生长有奇效
盗宝团所携带着的钥匙，可以用来开启某物。
desc_en: A key carried by a Treasure Hoarder.

desc_chs: 宝藏就埋在灵矩关最中间的那棵<color=#00E1FFFF>金色大树</color>下。
desc_en: The treasure is buried beneath the <color=#00E1FFFF>giant golden tree</color> in the middle of Lingju Pass.

desc_chs: 从青墟浦处得到的无名宝藏，表面有着不明意义的纹饰。或许可以拿给璃月港里懂古玩的人看看…
desc_en: Anonymous treasure acquired at Qingxu Pool. There is a pattern of unknown significance on the outside. Perhaps you could get someone in Liyue Harbor with an interest in antiques to take a look at it.

desc_chs: 从灵矩关处得到的无名宝藏，表面有着不明意义的纹饰。或许可以拿给璃月港里懂古玩的人看看…
desc_en: Anonymous treasure acquired at Lingju Pass. There is a pattern of unknown significance on the outside. Perhaps you could get someone in Liyue Harbor with an interest in antiques to take a look at it.

desc_chs: 从遁玉陵处得到的无名宝藏，表面有着不明意义的纹饰。或许可以拿给璃月港里懂古玩的人看看…
desc_en: Anonymous treasure acquired at Dunyu Ruins. There is a pattern of unknown significance on the outside. Perhaps you could get someone in Liyue Harbor with an interest in antiques to take a look at it.

desc_chs: 可以解除某处封印的异形宝石。\n握在手中的话，可以感受到其中翻涌不止的思绪。在这片大地的某处，埋葬着古老的战争记忆。\n「为了不让杀伐的痛苦再现，为了不再让生命白白流入大地，为了迎接和平的岁月…」
desc_en: An unusual gemstone capable of removing a seal somewhere.\nYou can feel the turbulent thoughts racing relentlessly within when you hold it in your hand. Somewhere in this world are buried the memories of an ancient war.\n"For a future without the pain of savage slaughter, for a future without lives lived in vain, for a future where every day is filled with peace..."

desc_chs: 似乎度过了漫长岁月的戒指，虽然在岁月的侵蚀下变得有些晦暗，但因为存放在箱子里，并没有落上太多尘土。\n戒指内侧刻着一行字，字迹十分清晰。\n「世间纷难，众生皆苦」
desc_en: A ring that seems to have existed for a long time. Though it has become dull due to erosion over time, it is not dirty because it has been stored inside a box.\nThere are words engraved on the inside of the ring, still clearly legible:\n"All beings suffer in war."

desc_chs: 大约五支长短各异，大小不同的画笔，用布包好了放在盒子里，能看得出画家在护理它们时的细心。
desc_en: Around five paintbrushes of different lengths and widths, wrapped in a cloth and stored in a box. The artist clearly takes excellent care of them.

desc_chs: 半盒颜色各异的颜料，其中白色的那瓶看起来更大一些…
desc_en: Half a box of paints of different colors. The bottle of white paint seems bigger than the others.

desc_chs: 画家梵米尔所画的画稿，不知为何，这幅画稿中只使用了黑白两色。据他说，丢失的画材就在他画这幅画稿时所处的<color=#00E1FFFF>取景位</color>上…
desc_en: An unfinished painting by Vermeer the artist. For some reason, black and white are the only colors that he used. Vermeer says that his lost paints and brushes are at the <color=#00E1FFFF>viewing spot</color> where he painted this work.

desc_chs: 画家梵米尔所画的画稿。据他说，丢失的画材就在他画这幅画稿时所处的<color=#00E1FFFF>取景位</color>上…
desc_en: An unfinished painting by Vermeer the artist. He says that his lost paints and brushes are at the <color=#00E1FFFF>viewing spot</color> where he painted this work.

desc_chs: 在旅行者的帮助下，画家梵米尔所完成的画稿。据他说，是目前他的画稿中最优秀的一幅，但远不是最完美的一幅，他还想要不断地画下去…
desc_en: A painting that Vermeer completed with the Traveler's help. He says that it is his finest work to date, but still far from perfect. He is determined to keep painting.

desc_chs: 圆球状的石头，在侧面刻着一行字「石官掩柴门」。看起来，似乎可以镶嵌进什么地方…
desc_en: A circular stone with some text engraved on the side: "The house of stone envelops the timber hut." It seems like it should be fitted inside something...

desc_chs: 十分新鲜的清心，摘下时还能闻到花香。如果想用来泡水喝，应该还需要再做一些处理…
desc_en: The freshest Qingxin you ever saw. Just bursting with scent when you picked it. It probably needs some further processing before it's ready to brew, though.

name_chs: 猎鹿人餐馆的「特产餐品」
desc_chs: 从猎鹿人餐馆处拿到的「特产餐品」。是以「满足沙拉」为原材料制作，便于携带和存储的「礼物类食品」。但据说在长途运输后，味道和口感可能不太好…
desc_en: An extra-special item from the Good Hunter menu. A durable and travel-ready reinvention of their Satisfying Salad, intended as a gift product. Despite this, the original flavor and texture apparently doesn't quite survive long journeys.

desc_chs: 从芙萝拉处得到的书签。将风车菊晒干后做的书签，放在盒子里几乎感受不到重量。
desc_en: A bookmark given to you by Flora. Made from a dried-out Windwheel Aster, even in its box you barely notice the weight of it.

desc_chs: 从「天使的馈赠」酒馆处得到的特色饮料。据说有着无与伦比的清凉口感，喝完之后，能让人格外清晰地感受到「风」…
desc_en: An extra-special beverage obtained from the Angel's Share. Claimed to be the most cool and refreshing beverage ever, one can certainly feel the wind at the back of the throat more keenly after consuming it.

desc_chs: 莺儿为璐璐特别制作的薄荷香膏。据莺儿说，这一种香膏是最适合璐璐的…
desc_en: A mint-scented perfume specially prepared for Little Lulu by Ying'er. It's the perfect scent for Lulu, Ying'er says.

desc_chs: 以薄荷为材料制成的精油，是制作香膏所需的材料。
desc_en: Essential oil extracted from the Mint plant. Used for making perfume.

desc_chs: 晶莹剔透的浓厚凝液，或许是上等的食材…？\n据说，真正愿意品尝史莱姆的人并不多，所以史莱姆制品有时会伪装成琼脂制的美食。只有真正的老饕能分辨出两者间的细微区别。
desc_en: Crystal-clear, thick and gooey, like gelatine... Could this be the stuff of haute-cuisine dreams?\nApparently, very few people are actually willing to try eating slime, so derivative products are typically passed off as agar-based delicacies. Only die-hard food fanatics can taste the subtle difference between the two.

desc_chs: 散发着浓郁香甜气息的植株，是极好的甜味剂。\n据说植物也有感情，受人悉心照料的花卉也会用更加努力地芬芳绽放。有时候也会因此不幸引来「多管闲事」的人。
desc_en: A plant with a rich, sweet fragrance that makes an excellent sweetener.\nSome say plants have feelings too — show them enough care and attention, and they will strive to bloom all the more fragrantly. Sometimes, though, this will then make them the target of people who don't know how to mind their own business.

desc_chs: 从低语森林摘到的甜甜花，看上去十分有活力，靠近闻的话，还能闻到甜甜的气味
desc_en: A Sweet Flower picked in the Whispering Woods. A decidedly healthy-looking specimen with a delightfully sweet aroma if you get close enough.

desc_chs: 从摘星崖摘到的塞西莉亚花。被掘起后，花瓣与枝叶依旧保持着平静的温柔感
desc_en: A Cecilia picked on Starsnatch Cliff. The whole plant still conveys a quiet sense of gentleness even outside of its natural habitat.

desc_chs: 从风起地摘到的风车菊。花瓣还在欢快地随风旋转，似乎风赐予了它无穷的生命力
desc_en: A Windwheel Aster picked at Windrise. The petals are still spinning merrily around. It seems the wind has imbued this plant with a healthy dose of vitality.

desc_chs: 从低语森林摘到的小灯草。小心翼翼地连根掘起，没有伤到任何枝叶。
desc_en: A small lamp grass obtained from the Whispering Woods. It has been unearthed with the utmost care, and neither its stem nor leaf has been bruised.

desc_chs: 从货车里抢救出来的调酒材料。拿在手里的时候，总有种奇怪的感觉…
desc_en: A cocktail ingredient salvaged from a cart. When you hold it in your hand, you can't help but feel that there's something unusual about it.

desc_chs: 托克塞给你的沉甸甸的钱袋，这个来自至冬的孩子究竟出自什么样的家庭呢…\n每枚金币的面值都很庞大，但可以在「北国银行」兑换成零钱。
desc_en: A very hefty bag of cash that Teucer was all too eager to offload onto you... One wonders what sort of family this Snezhnayan kid comes from.\nThe face value of each of these gold coins is very large, but they can be redeemed for smaller change at the Northland Bank.

desc_chs: 「公子」提供的游玩经费，托克之前给过的那些摩拉也都混在了一起…\n每枚金币的面值都很庞大，但可以在「北国银行」兑换成零钱。
desc_en: Funds for Teucer's entertainment, provided by Childe, now mixed in with the stash you received from Teucer earlier...\nThe face value of each of these gold coins is very large, but they can be redeemed for smaller change at the Northland Bank.

desc_chs: 或许是受到特殊的生长环境的影响，这种日落果看上去更加饱满一些，但除此之外并没有发现其他的特殊之处。
desc_en: A Sunsettia, slightly plumper than most, possibly due to unique cultivation conditions. That aside, there doesn't seem to be anything particularly special about it.

desc_chs: 「冒险家协会诚招新人，有意者请与蒙德城冒险家协会会长塞琉斯先生联系。」
desc_en: "The Adventurers' Guild is now recruiting new members! To sign up, speak to Branch Master Cyrus in Mondstadt today."

desc_chs: 「猫尾酒馆酒品上新，迪奥娜本日当班。」
desc_en: "New drinks at the Cat's Tail. Your bartender today is: Diona."

desc_chs: 「猎鹿人餐馆推出套餐服务，同时购买满足沙拉与蜜酱胡萝卜煎肉时，总价可享九折优惠。」
desc_en: "Try the all-new Good Hunter meal deal! Get 10% off when you purchase a Satisfying Salad and a Sticky Honey Roast in a single order."

desc_chs: 嘉义给自己的女儿小六买的礼物，沉甸甸的一大包。也许，嘉义更想自己亲手送给小六…
desc_en: A huge, heavy bag of gifts bought by Jiayi for his daughter, Little Liu. Perhaps Jiayi would prefer to give it to his daughter himself?

name_chs: 盗宝团成员携带的地图
desc_chs: 盗宝团成员所携带的蒙德地区地图。上面用歪歪扭扭的字迹做了标注，标注的地点就在不远处…
desc_en: A map of Mondstadt carried by a Treasure Hoarder. Someone with terrible handwriting has made some notes on a location not too far away.

desc_chs: 某人写就的笔记。上面记载的东西似乎与这个地方有关…
desc_en: Anonymously authored notes. They describe a place seemingly not far from here.

desc_chs: 圆球状的石头，在侧面刻着一行字「欲入需点睛」。看起来，似乎可以镶嵌进什么地方…
desc_en: A circular stone with some text engraved on the side: "To enter, first dot the eyes." It seems like it should be fitted inside something...

name_chs: 骑士团指导手册·第五版
desc_chs: 蒙德西风骑士团的日常言行守则，经过了本届代理团长琴的亲自修订。合格的骑士应当严格依照其规定规范自己的言行。
desc_en: A code of conduct covering language usage and behavioral norms for Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius, personally edited by Acting Grand Master Jean. All knights are expected to strictly abide by these rules and regulate their words and deeds accordingly.

name_en: Tales From the Waves: Rising Tide
desc_chs: 璃月被海兽侵扰的时代，无名船师的传奇故事。
desc_en: The legendary tale of an anonymous seafarer set in a time when Liyue was plagued by sea monsters.

name_en: Tales From the Waves: Wild Storm
desc_chs: 在不息回荡的海歌中，船师与命运的强敌搏斗至最后。
desc_en: To the never-ending tune of the ocean, the seafarer fought against the phenomenal foe of fate, fighting to the bitter end...

name_en: Tales From the Waves: Receding Torrent
desc_chs: 待到一切复归风平浪静，海风轻轻吟唱着归乡的故曲……
desc_en: Finally, when the tempest eased and the ocean surface was tranquil once more, the soft wind played a poignant homecoming tune...

desc_chs: 有些情绪如同夏日的阵雨一般，来得不明原由，又让人措手不及。遥远贵族时代的怀古风夏日物语，自此展开…
desc_en: Sometimes, feelings are like the summer rain, coming out of nowhere and catching you unprepared. A nostalgic summer story set in the age of aristocrats begins right here.

desc_chs: 金钱虽然不能解决一切烦恼，但是真的能解决很多问题！ 以叮当作响的摩拉作为开幕，浪游少女的蒙德夏日物语！
desc_en: Money doesn't solve all your problems, but it can certainly solve a lot of them! A young woman's summer vacation in Mondstadt opens to the melodic tune of a symphonic sum of Mora.

desc_chs: 即使居于安全的城市，也要小心夜间逼近的狼爪…比大型催眠术更难以掌控的东西，在此揭晓。
desc_en: Even when you live in a safe city, you should watch out for the wolves that lurk in the night... Something more impossible to master than mass hypnosis is revealed within these pages.

desc_chs: 就算是犬科动物也能学会的贵族礼仪等二三事——自外而来的淑女教师执鞭教导！
desc_en: Even a dog can learn basic things like upper-class etiquette — or so insists a certain non-nonsense teacher from afar.

desc_chs: 「好好当我的狗吧！虽然做得好可能没有奖励，但是做不好可是有惩罚的！」黛色的魔女如是笑道——
desc_en: "Be a good dog! Yes, there's no reward for getting it right, but there's still a punishment for getting it wrong!" The witch in black makeup smirked.

desc_chs: 来自山庄的少年志在离开一成不变的家乡，却迷失在竹林夕照之间。他将遇到怎样的旧梦？
desc_en: When a small-town boy looking to leave his sleepy hometown behind gets lost in a bamboo forest at sundown, what long-forgotten dreams will he encounter?

desc_chs: 明月渐升时分，出自山庄的少年与来自竹林的女子偶遇。是仙人的神游，或是妖鬼的陷阱？
desc_en: As the moon slowly rises in the night sky, small-town boy meets bamboo-forest girl — but is he voyaging into the realm of the adepti, or setting foot in some monstrous trap?

desc_chs: 皓月高悬的竹林之夜，是旧日之梦与现实交汇的终点。少年在古老的故事中沉入了难以言喻的睡梦。
desc_en: Deep in the bamboo forest, reality has coincided with a story from the distant past. But the crossover ends as the bright moon reaches its peak in the night sky, and small-town boy disappears into an indescribable dream.

desc_chs: 天色渐明，两人的命途分道扬镳，但古老故事的余韵依旧回荡在山林之中，等待着少年再度归来。
desc_en: As dawn gently approaches, the fate of the two youngsters diverges, and they go their separate ways. But the echoes of that ancient story still resound within the forest, waiting for the day that they may welcome small-town boy back into their midst once more.

desc_chs: 蒙德传扬的酒客故事之一，讲述了误入狼林的醉汉与饥饿的孤狼之间的故事。
desc_en: One of many popular tales told of Mondstadt's drinkers. This one is the story of a drunkard who stumbled into wolven territory and the lone, starving wolf he encountered there.

desc_chs: 传扬蒙德的酒客故事之一，讲述了饥饿的孤狼与醉客的相遇。
desc_en: One of many Mondstadt tales told of popular drinkers. This story is the one of the time a lone, starving wolf met a drunken Mondstadt man.

desc_chs: 传扬蒙德的醉汉故事之一，本卷是醉汉为孤狼讲述的久远故事。
desc_en: One of the popular, many tales told by the drinkers of Mondstadt. This drunkard is the one who told the lone wolf of an ancient story.

desc_chs: 传扬蒙德的醉客故事之一，本卷是孤狼为醉汉讲述的，关于酒与狼的故事。
desc_en: One of many drinking tales popularly told in Mondstadt. This wolf told a tale of wine and wolf to a drunken man of Mondstadt.

desc_chs: (test)礼物盒
(test)布娃娃
昔日「留云借风真君」建造「云中仙居」时所画的设计图。
desc_en: The designs for the Dwelling in the Clouds, built long ago by Cloud Retainer.

desc_chs:
击败特瓦林后，回收得到的某种物质。
汇聚着巨龙体内的悠古之风与某种幽邃能量的结晶。

崇高的风之龙曾被禁锢在由三种剧毒交织成的樊笼中：
过去咽下的血、深渊来客的耳语，以及遭受遗忘的哀恸。
循着泪水与诗人的话语，击碎毒血结成的圣钉，撕破囚禁巨龙的纱网…
或许这就是只有随风而来的、自由的异乡人才能做到的事情吧。
desc_en:
Substance acquired from defeating Dvalin.
A crystal imbued with the winds of antiquity as well as another occult power from within the great dragon's body.

The mighty dragon was once a captive of a cage of toxicity, woven of three poisons:
The foul blood he once ingested, the lies whispered from the Abyss, and the anguish of abandonment.
Through tears shed and songs sung, the unholy spikes that had grown on Dvalin's body were smashed to pieces, and the web that had ensnared him was torn away...
Perhaps these feats were achievable only by a free-spirited traveler from a far-away land.

desc_chs:
击败漩涡之魔神后，回收得到的某种碎片。
在遥远的过去，曾被用来镇压漩涡之魔神。

这片土地上的住民曾经面对过高如山岳的怒涛，也曾在床榻上、睡梦中被摇撼地心的海啸惊醒；这些恐惧已经随着和平与岁月消逝了。
但这也无妨。即使长眠海中的古老魔神再度醒转，也无法阻止新的时代来临。
或许当初封印它的那位，期待的也不过是在数千年后的如今，能看见这样的景象吧。
desc_en:
Some kind of fragment recovered after defeating the Overlord of the Vortex in battle.
In the ancient past, it was used to pin the great beast down.

There once was a time when the inhabitants of this land were terrorized by waves as tall as mountains, torn from their dreams in the dead of night by the deafening roar of tidal waves that would shake the world to its core. Fear of such horrors gradually subsided over the years as peace became the norm.
But no matter: though That Which Lies In The Deep awakens once more, it is powerless to prevent the dawning of a new era.
Perhaps this is just what the one who suppressed the Overlord of the Vortex has been hoping to witness in the millennia since.

desc_chs: 璃月的幻想小说，讲述了岩王帝君化为凡形行走人间的旧事。天下珍宝尽来的时代里，或真或假的故事与旧梦在商港汇聚。
desc_en: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. Set in an age when the treasures of the world flocked forth, fact merges with fiction and both blend with old dreams in this charming tale set in the commercial port of Liyue.

desc_chs: 璃月的幻想小说，讲述了岩王帝君化为凡形行走人间的旧事。在蕴玉的山峦间，有形的表象与无形的妄言恍然得以对照。
desc_en: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. Between lofty mountain peaks where bounteous jade lies beneath, substantial ideas and empty lies are suddenly shown up side by side.

desc_chs: 璃月的幻想小说，讲述了岩王帝君化为凡形行走人间的故事。规则与公平的刻板含义，同样会在虚幻的故事中消解。
desc_en: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. Iron-clad concepts of rules or equity fade into nothingness in this fantastical tale.

desc_chs: 璃月的幻想小说，讲述了岩王帝君化为凡形行走人间的故事。天下珍宝明鉴的时代里，一句小小的戏谑之语便能拆穿妄言。
desc_en: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. In an age when scrutiny was laid upon the treasures of the world, one humble witticism was all it took to expose all lies.

desc_chs: 流行璃月港的武侠小说，讲述了一个没有元素力与炼金术的世界中发生的爱恨情仇故事。本册讲述了金七十二郎复仇的开始。
desc_en: A popular martial arts novel in Liyue Harbor. In a world without elemental energy or alchemy, a tale unfolds of love and hate between friends and foes. This volume tells of the origins of Jin the Seventy-Second's revenge.

desc_chs: 流行璃月港的武侠小说，讲述了一个没有元素力量与炼金术的世界中发生的爱恨情仇故事。本册讲述了金七十二郎初到屠毗庄的故事。
desc_en: A popular martial arts novel in Liyue Harbor. In a world without elemental energy or alchemy, a tale unfolds of love and hate between friends and foes. This volume tells of Jin the Seventy-Second's arrival in Tupi Village.

desc_chs: 流行璃月港的武侠小说，讲述了一个没有元素力与炼金术的世界中发生的爱恨情仇故事。本册讲述了金七十二郎与屠毗庄主的对决。
desc_en: A popular martial arts novel in Liyue Harbor. In a world without elemental energy or alchemy, a tale unfolds of love and hate between friends and foes. This volume tells of Jin the Seventy-Second's duel with the chief of Tupi Village.

desc_chs: 流行璃月港的武侠小说，讲述了一个没有元素力与炼金术的世界中发生的爱恨情仇故事。本册讲述了金七十二郎初入荒山的险恶。
desc_en: A popular martial arts novel in Liyue Harbor. In a world without elemental energy or alchemy, a tale unfolds of love and hate between friends and foes. This volume tells of Jin the Seventy-Second's treacherous trek into the mountains.

desc_chs: 小六为自己父亲嘉义搜集的礼物。小小的一包。也许，小六更想自己亲手送给嘉义…
desc_en: A little bag of gifts collected by Little Liu for her father, Jiayi. Perhaps Little Liu would prefer to give it to her father herself?

desc_chs: 潮汐给翠儿的回信。看写信者的态度，这封信里也许不会有什么有意义的内容…
desc_en: A reply from Chaoxi to Cui'er. Judging from the sender's attitude, it's unlikely to be a particularly heartfelt letter.

desc_chs: 小月用星螺做成的小玩具。虽然不知道能不能听见大海的声音，但他的心意应该能听得很清楚吧。
desc_en: A toy made from Starconches by Little Yue. It might not capture the sound of the sea, but it certainly captures the amount of thought he put into it.

desc_chs: 银杏写给博来的信，看上去并不厚，但是封得很紧。
desc_en: A letter from Yinxing to Bolai. Short, but tightly sealed.

desc_chs: 小昭写给江舟的单据。数页纸张上填写着密密麻麻的字，似乎是说江舟的海灯节策划案已经拖了很长时间…
desc_en: An invoice from Clerk Zhao to Jiangzhou. There are several sheets, each with reams of text on. It seems that Jiangzhou has been putting off the planning for Lantern Rite for a very long time...

name_en: Clerk Zhao's Invoice for Nervous An
desc_chs: 小昭写给小安的单据。数页纸张上填写着密密麻麻的字，似乎是说小安的港口船只情况统计表已经拖了很长时间…
desc_en: An invoice from Clerk Zhao to Nervous An. There are several sheets, each with reams of text on. It seems that Nervous An has been putting off collating the statistics on the ships in the harbor for a very long time...

desc_chs: 慵懒而博学的图书管理员，须弥教令院「两百年一见」的天才毕业生。
desc_en: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

desc_chs: 翠儿写给自己的恋人潮先生的信。信件很厚，应该是饱含着翠儿对这位潮先生的思念之情吧…
desc_en: A letter from Cui'er to her lover, Chaoxi. It's a rather long letter — presumably packed with page upon page of poignant prose about how much she longs to see him again.

desc_chs: 亨利莫顿写就的笔记。上面记载的东西似乎与这个地方有关…
desc_en: Notes written by Henry Morton. They describe a place seemingly not far from here.

desc_chs: 杰克的地图。厚厚的一卷地图，细心地装在盒子里。
desc_en: Jack's map. Huge when unfolded, but currently neatly packed into a box.

desc_chs: 杰克的冒险之证。冒险家协会的冒险家们人手一册的冒险之证，被杰克细心地用布包好，装在了盒子里。
desc_en: Jack's Adventurer Handbook. Issued by the Guild to every newly recruited adventurer, Jack has carefully wrapped his in a cloth and packed it into a box.

desc_chs: 用来开启某个木造牢笼的钥匙。\n当然，从牢笼的设计目的而言，或许应该称它为「用来锁上某个木造牢笼的钥匙」…？
desc_en: A key used to open a wooden cage.\nOf course, considering what the cage is meant to do, perhaps one should call it a "key meant to lock a wooden cage" instead?

desc_chs: 依据何者梦中的情景、某人现实中的努力，和「噼咔」的感觉，做出的至尊点心。\n大抵是能配得上尊贵人物的礼品吧。
desc_en: A truly exquisite sweet treat that came to a certain someone in a dream. This dream was made a reality through someone else's hard work and, of course, a healthy dose of boom shaka-laka.\nSurely this is a gift fit for someone who belongs to the upper echelons of society.

desc_chs: 用于「送仙典仪」的野生琉璃百合。\n因为天地异变，琉璃百合失去了自然生长的环境。据说这是通人心的植物，在感情丰沛的歌声中会开放得格外美丽。
desc_en: Wild Glaze Lilies used in the Rite of Parting.\nDue to geological changes, Glaze Lilies have lost their natural habitat. They say that these plants understand human hearts, and will grow to be especially beautiful if serenaded with deep and meaningful songs.

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (IV)
desc_chs: 在蒲公英飘起风雪的夏夜里，几日不见的久别重逢。\n狐狸的引领下，蒲公英的海洋展开在猎人眼前……《蒲公英海的狐狸》，第四卷。
desc_en: After a few days apart, a long-awaited reunion takes place on a midsummer's night amidst a veritable blizzard of dandelion seeds.\nAt the direction of the fox, an ocean of dandelions opens up before the hunter's very eyes...

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (VIII)
desc_chs: 「等他学会了人类的话语——」狐狸的声音被夜风轻轻卷走，携着蒲公英越飘越远了……\n毕竟狐狸是不同于人的走兽，其悲喜与人类也不尽相通……童话故事《蒲公英海的狐狸》，第八卷。
desc_en: "When he has mastered human language..." The fox's voice is gently carried away by the midnight breeze, drifting further and further away together with the dandelion seeds...\nAfter all, the fox is a different kind of creature from the human, and the two do not share all the same sense of mirth and misery...

name_en: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (IX)
desc_chs: 等到我教无可教的时候，还能够再次看见这片蒲公英海吗…？\n在蒲公英的海洋中，猎人开始思索离别。《蒲公英海的狐狸》，第九卷。
desc_en: When I have taught all that there is to teach, will it be possible to see this sea of dandelions again...?\nIn the dandelion sea, the hunter starts to contemplate leaving.

desc_chs: 踏上冰封的荒原，爬上严寒的雪山，公主与两位智者遇到了神秘的住民…\n《野猪公主》，第六卷，雪山上的冒险徐徐展开。\n扉页上，某人以稚嫩的笔迹写着：「爸爸回家后，也一定要给我讲雪山上的故事！」
desc_en: The Boar Princess and her two wise companions brave an icy wasteland and scale a snowy mountain, where they discover a very mysterious inhabitant indeed...\nSee how this high-altitude, low-temperature adventure unfolds in volume six of The Boar Princess.\nThere is some childish handwriting on the title page, which reads: "Daddy, when you get home, you have to read me the one about the snowy mountain too!"

desc_chs: 有句俗话叫，发光的未必是金子，还有可能是因为失恋而破碎的心。\n总之天上的星星并不是金子，大部分人的心也不是玻璃制成的。\n总之就是这样，薇拉的冒险，踏入新的篇章！
desc_en: There is a saying that goes as follows: Not all that glitters is gold, sometimes it is the outpouring of a broken heart.\nEither way, the stars in the sky certainly aren't made of gold, and most people's hearts aren't made of glass.\nIn any case — here is the next chapter of Vera's adventure!

desc_chs: 曾经有一位伟大的学者，想要给帝国的节日写一本著作。\n结果他发现，好像帝国每一天都有过节的传统！如此巨大的工作量之下，他写了六个月人就跑路了。\n作者我啊，是不会辜负大家的！
desc_en: There was once a great scholar who wished to write a book about all the festive days of the empire.\nAfter looking into it more closely, he discovered that every single day had some sort of a festival associated with it... He persevered with this monumental writing task for six months before giving up on it.\nBut don't worry — as far as this book is concerned, I am the author, and I won't let my readers down!

desc_chs: 在宇宙的边陲的一片星团，可居住的行星密度稀疏。因此这是一片属于星海操帆士和海盗的乐土。\n因为是宇宙，所以航行没有左舷、右舷。靠着恒星的那一侧叫做星舷。\n少女薇拉的冒险，在方位感消失的星海继续！
desc_en: In the star clusters at the outer reaches of the universe, habitable planets are few and far between. For this reason, the region is the playground of space captains and pirates alone.\nWith this being the universe, though, there is no port and starboard in the traditional sense — out here, "starboard" means whichever side of your spacecraft is oriented towards the star you are using for navigation...\nLose yourself, and especially your sense of direction, in this next chapter of Vera's starbound voyage!

desc_chs: 女孩子们的睡衣派对环节，男性当然不准参加！可爱的女孩们就像是黄金时代的众神一样，神圣不可方物。\n薇拉、公主、圣王列班宁，还有星际巢虫的雌性主脑乌尔，四人的少女夜话！
desc_en: Of course boys aren't invited to the girl's slumber party! Girls are sacrosanct, like the gods of the golden age.\nVera, the Princess, Saint King Lebannin, and Ur, alpha female of the Galactic Swarm, shall talk deep into the night!

desc_chs: 蒙德生态学者，「丘丘语桂冠诗人」雅各布·马斯克关于丘丘人社会习俗的考察，本卷探询了丘丘人中间的神秘独居者。
desc_en: It contains the investigations and observations into the cultural customs of the hilichurls by the "Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian," Jacob Musk, a Mondstadt ecologist. This volume features mysterious hilichurls who live apart from the others.

desc_chs: （test）阅读物测试
古代冒险家莱纳德的笔记，十分古旧。莫娜通过占星术解读了残缺的内文，还原了书中内容。
desc_en: Notes penned by Leonard, an adventurer from antiquity. Most ancient indeed. Mona has used her astrology to interpret its tattered contents and restore them.

desc_chs: 从雪山上拾得的「牙齿」。也许有人会知道关于它的一些信息…
desc_en: A Dragontooth you picked up in Dragonspine. Perhaps someone would know something more about it...

desc_chs: 汲取了力量的龙牙。无论是光泽还是质感，相较原本都有所不同…
desc_en: A Dragontooth infused with power. Its luster and texture appear to have been somewhat transformed...

desc_chs:
底部有着某种三分之一纹样的宝盒。如果能筹齐另外两个，或许可以打开何处的门。
「壁画恐怕无法完成了。」
「我已经很久没看过晴空与绿地了。不知道应该用什么样的蓝色、什么样的绿色，才能画出父亲想要的，冰雪消融的景象。」
「等他回来，一切都会恢复过去的样子吧。但是，太冷了。我已经不行了。」
「对不起，爸爸。对不起，一直看着我们丑态的乌库。」
「伊蒙洛卡，如果能再见你一面就好了…」
desc_en:
A treasure box with a decorative pattern at the bottom. The ornamentation seems to be a part of a three-piece motif. Once the pattern is completed, a certain door may open.
"I'm afraid I can't finish the fresco."
"It's been a while since I last saw the blue sky and green grass. I don't know which hues to use to capture the landscape of thawing ice and snow that my father so longs for."
"By the time he comes back, everything will be back to how it was. But I can't take this cold anymore."
"Forgive me, Father. Ukko, I'm sorry you had to see us like this."
"Imunlaukr, I wish I could see you again..."

desc_chs:
底部有着某种三分之一纹样的宝盒。如果能筹齐另外两个，或许可以打开何处的门。
「老身本以为后代能如白树一般生生不灭。」
「但白树即将枯死，『他们』的声音不再传来，老身的期待、他们于此身的期待也即将落空。」
「老身将再次登上峰顶，寻求指引。下山时，女儿第二幅画应该已经完成了。」
「第三幅画，若是冰雪消融的图景就好了。」
desc_en:
A treasure box with a decorative pattern at the bottom. The ornamentation seems to be a part of a three-piece motif. Once the pattern is completed, a certain door may open.
"I thought that the young will grow strong and vital like cypresses."
"But these cypresses are about to wither. Their voices won't be carried by the wind anymore. My expectations towards them, as well as the faith they have in me, will all fall through."
"Once again I'll climb this peak looking for guidance. By the time I'm back down, my daughter will have finished the second painting."
"As long as the third one will be of thawing snow and ice, everything will be fine."

desc_chs:
底部有着某种三分之一纹样的宝盒。如果能筹齐另外两个，或许可以打开何处的门。
「愿降下这片冰雪的天空燃烧，直到世界上再也没有一丝生命。」
「愿我们化作灰烬，顺风而行，追上那抛弃了公主再也不返回的异邦人。」
「愿公主梦见的蔽日的黑龙，为可憎的大地涂上赤红的毒。」
「我是最后一个。再也没有留守的必要了。」
「听说何处有人正在建立无神的国度。那么，或许他们也有对抗世界的力量吧。」
desc_en:
A treasure box with a decorative pattern at the bottom. The ornamentation seems to be a part of a three-piece motif. Once the pattern is completed, a certain door may open.
"I yearn for those frosty skies to stand in flames and burn till there's no living soul in the world."
"I yearn for us to turn to dust carried by the wind so that we can find that outsider who abandoned the princess."
"I yearn for the black dragon from the princess' dreams to engulf the land in a cloud of scarlet poison."
"For I am the last one. There's no need to keep watch any longer."
"I've heard of people who are building a new nation without gods. Perhaps they'll have the power to stand against this world."

name_chs: 看起来很普通的甜甜花
desc_chs: 在陨石旁采到的甜甜花。看起来、摸起来和闻起来，都并没有什么特别的。也许只有伊凡诺维奇才知道这株花的价值所在…
desc_en: A Sweet Flower gathered from beside a meteorite. It doesn't look, feel or smell like anything special. Perhaps only Ivanovich knows its true worth...

desc_chs: 记录璃月港本土风俗的专著，最初由旅居璃月的须弥旅行学者法德兰编写，而后经过了诸多璃月本地学者的编校，在璃月广为出版流传。
desc_en: A book on the cultures and customs of Liyue originally compiled by Fadhlan, a scholar from Sumeru residing in Liyue. It was then edited by many local scholars and published. It is one of the bestsellers in Liyue.

desc_chs: 「公子」专门为托克订做的「独眼小宝」玩偶，上面还写有托克的名字。
desc_en: A "Mr. Cyclops" toy that Childe had specially-made for Teucer. It even has the lad's name on it.

desc_chs: 小六写给嘉义的信。信件封得不太紧，但还是别打开看比较好…
desc_en: A letter that Little Liu wrote to Jiayi. The seal isn't all that tight. Best not to open it...

desc_chs: 样式很常见的木桩，除了体积小一点之外，没有明显的特别之处。木桩上有一些使用的痕迹，很可能是从其他地方搬运过来的。
desc_en: A wooden stake of very common design. It doesn't seem special in any way, other than its slightly smaller bulk. It bears some signs of use, and might have been moved here from elsewhere.

desc_chs: 以常见材料制成的布袋，其中装有少量已经受潮的物品。可能是从商船上掉下来的。
desc_en: A cloth bag made of commonly-found materials. It contains some slightly damp objects. It might have fallen from a merchant vessel.

desc_chs: 带有神秘纹饰的石板，无法明确判断其来历，有进行分析的价值。
desc_en: A stone tablet with mysterious markings on it. Its origin cannot be determined, but there is value in analyzing it.

desc_chs: 从薇尔那里拿到的信件，附有盗宝团的特别标记。
desc_en: A letter obtained from Vile. It has the special mark of the Treasure Hoarders on it.

desc_chs: 维克多丢失的盒子。外面的包装皱巴巴的…不过倒没什么破损，不知道里面到底装着什么重要的东西…
desc_en: The box that Viktor lost. The wrapping is all crumpled up... but it doesn't look damaged. What important things could it contain?

desc_chs: 匆忙写就的字条，上面详细记录着申请新版经营许可证所需提交的一系列文件材料。
desc_en: A note written in haste. It lists a number of documents required when applying for a new business license.

desc_chs: 旧版的经营许可证。厚厚一叠，拿在手里时有一种异样的沉重感…
desc_en: An old business license. The thick stack has an unnatural weight to it...

name_chs: 经营场所证明及经营安全许诺书
desc_chs: 经营场所证明及经营安全许诺书。厚厚一叠，拿在手里时有一种异样的沉重感…
desc_en: Proof of one's business premises and the safety of said premises. The thick bundle has an unnatural weight to it...

desc_chs: 一张关于出海申请的批复件。薄薄一张，可千万别弄丢了…
desc_en: Approval documentation for going out to sea. Best you don't lose this thin sheet of paper...

desc_chs: 口感紧致，油脂丰富，无论是煎炸烹煮都味道极佳的肉。\n只有熬过了漫长年月，足够强壮的走豕才会被人们称为「王」。
desc_en: Exquisite flavor, rich in fat. This cut of meat is exceptionally delicious, regardless of preferred cooking technique.\nOnly the most ancient of creatures, the sturdiest of the boars deserves to be called a king.

desc_chs: 璃月流传的诸多志怪传奇故事合集，收录了许多短小精悍，脍炙人口的轶事，大多为民俗题材。本篇记载了无妄坡的来历。
desc_en: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on the origin of Wuwang Hill.

desc_chs: 璃月流传的诸多志怪传奇故事合集，收录了许多短小精悍，脍炙人口的轶事，大多为民俗题材。本篇讲述了神秘的山中仙灵的故事。
desc_en: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment features the stories of Seelie living in the mountains.

desc_chs: 群玉阁中珍藏的孤本图书，本卷似乎是系列中的其中一册。其中记录了有关璃月港经济方针的论述内容。
desc_en: This scroll, which seems to be a part of a larger series, belongs to the Jade Chamber's invaluable collection of written works. This volume is a dissertation on Liyue Harbor's economic policy.

desc_chs: 记录璃月港本土风俗的专著，最初由旅居璃月的须弥旅行学者法德兰编写，而后经过了诸多璃月本地学者的编校，在璃月广为出版流传。
desc_en: A book on the cultures and customs of Liyue originally compiled by Fadhlan, a scholar from Sumeru residing in Liyue. It was then edited by many local scholars and published. It is one of the bestsellers in Liyue.

desc_chs: 记录璃月港本土风俗的专著，最初由旅居璃月的须弥旅行学者法德兰编写，而后经过了诸多璃月本地学者的编校，在璃月广为出版流传。
desc_en: A book on the cultures and customs of Liyue originally compiled by Fadhlan, a scholar from Sumeru residing in Liyue. It was then edited by many local scholars and published. It is one of the bestsellers in Liyue.

desc_chs: 渔女梓心家境清寒，街边贩鱼时不慎丢失了平常佩戴的珠串。但她不知道的是，这珠串即将为她带来一段曲折的姻缘…
desc_en: Zixin is a poor fisherwoman whose family struggles to make ends meet. One day, she is selling fish on the street when she carelessly loses the string of pearls she usually wears. Though what she does not know is that this lost string of pearls will change her fate for good...

desc_chs: 梓心尚未得知归还珠串的青年的姓名，他便已经走远，为了找到他，张婆给梓心出了个主意…
desc_en: The young man who had returned Zixin's string of pearls left without revealing his name. Grandma Zhang comes up with a plan that will allow Zixin to find him...

desc_chs: 青年与佳人就此相遇相知，互生情意的二人本应就此幸福地生活下去，但垂涎佳人美貌的恶霸却叫平地生起波澜…
desc_en: Our heroine meets the young man again. They fall in love and are ready to live together happily ever after. But a despot who covets Zixin's beauty and virtue is putting the skids under their plans...

name_chs: 古老的考察日志·其之一
desc_chs: 在有着圆形大门的遗迹前，发现的考察日志。\n记事者似乎是过去统治蒙德的贵族。
desc_en: An investigation journal found in front of the ruins with a circular entrance.\nIts author seems to have been a member of the aristocracy that once ruled Mondstadt.

desc_chs: 为西瑞先生特制的土豆饼，刚刚出炉，还带着余温。
desc_en: A Hash Brown made specifically for Silio. Fresh out of the oven and still warm.

desc_chs: 刚刚做好的杏仁豆腐。看上去非常不错…
desc_en: A newly-made serving of Almond Tofu. It looks very delicious indeed.

name_chs: 特制的珍珠翡翠白玉汤
desc_chs: 还有温度的珍珠翡翠白玉汤。看起来就是很容易洒出来的样子。
desc_en: Warm Jewelry Soup. It's practically spilling out of the bowl.

desc_chs: 特制的甜甜花酿鸡。这么脆弱又诱人的美食并不常有。
desc_en: A custom-made Sweet Madame. Such a fragile yet tempting dish is not often seen.

desc_chs: 新鲜的松茸酿酒卷。订餐人之后一定有口福了。
desc_en: Freshly-made Matsutake Meat Rolls. The person who ordered this is in for a real treat.

desc_chs: 刚完成的翡玉什锦袋，散发着短暂又梦幻的香味。不快点送到的话…
desc_en: A newly-completed set of Jade Parcels. It exudes a transient, fantastical aroma. If you don't send this out soon...

desc_chs: 刚刚装盘的火火肉酱面。看起来脆弱又美味。
desc_en: A freshly-served plate of Flaming Red Bolognese. It is a thing of fragile beauty.

desc_chs: 刚出锅的水煮黑背鲈。鲜美能保持的时间是很短的。
desc_en: Black-Back Perch Stew, fresh from the oven. It won't maintain its freshness for long.

desc_chs: 一份摩拉肉。冷了可能就既不富贵也不肉了。
desc_en: A serving of Mora Meat. Neither Mora nor Meat will be left if it gets cold.

desc_chs: 刚刚淋上糖浆的庄园烤松饼。应该趁早送给顾客享用。
desc_en: Tea Break Pancake that has just had syrup drizzled over it. Time to serve it to the customers, and fast.

desc_chs: 看起来很好吃的来来菜。其实不论特制不特制，来来菜都特别怕凉了。
desc_en: A Come And Get It that looks delicious. Specially-made or not, Come And Get It always tastes terrible cold.

desc_chs: 格外嫩的香嫩椒椒鸡。当冷菜或许也有自己的风味，不过还是趁热送去吧。
desc_en: Especially tender Jueyun Chili Chicken. Eating it cold has some merit, but it's best to serve it hot.

desc_chs: 为西瑞先生特制的土豆饼，刚刚出炉，依旧带着余温。
desc_en: A Hash Brown made specifically for Silio. Fresh out of the oven and still warm.

desc_chs: 鲜美的一份水煮黑背鲈。水煮菜凉了应该就不能吃了吧。
desc_en: Fresh Black-Back Perch Stew. It will probably be inedible once it gets cold.

desc_chs: 看起来很好吃的来来菜。其实不论特制不特制，来来菜都特别怕凉了。
desc_en: A Come And Get It that looks delicious. Specially-made or not, Come And Get It always tastes terrible cold.

desc_chs: 看起来皮脆肉鲜的蒙德烤鱼。放久了就不好吃了。
desc_en: Mondstadt Grilled Fish with crispy skin and tender meat. It'll taste terrible if left out for too long.

desc_chs: 为铃官准备的爆炒肉片。如果命中注定要放凉，一开始何必爆炒呢？
desc_en: Stir-Fried Filet prepared for Ling'guan. If it was fated to be left to cool, why stir-fry it in the first place?

name_en: Special Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup
desc_chs: 又是莲子又是禽蛋。送到绝云间感觉在嘲讽仙人。
desc_en: Lotus on the one hand, and eggs on the other. It feels like you'd be insulting the adepti if you sent this over to Jueyun Karst.

desc_chs: 明明是方便食品，却还要加急递送。真的太奇怪了。
desc_en: This should be finger food, but it also needs to be sent by speed courier. How odd.

desc_chs: 刚刚做好的杏仁豆腐。看上去非常不错…
desc_en: A newly-made serving of Almond Tofu. It looks very delicious indeed.

name_chs: 特制的珍珠翡翠白玉汤
desc_chs: 还有温度的珍珠翡翠白玉汤。看起来就是很容易洒出来的样子。
desc_en: Warm Jewelry Soup. It's practically spilling out of the bowl.

desc_chs: 霍夫曼先生写的命令书，封得紧紧的。最好还是别自己打开看了…
desc_en: Orders written by Huffman. It's sealed up very tight. Best not to open it yourself...

desc_chs: (test)精美的石制雕刻碎片，似乎在记录着某事，在绝壁藏书馆找到。
(test)精美的石制雕刻碎片，似乎在记录着某事，在王国藏书馆找到。
(test)精美的石制雕刻碎片，似乎在记录着某事，在学者手里找到。

嘉义写给小六的信。信件封得很紧，还是别打开看比较好…
desc_en: A letter that Jiayi wrote to Little Liu. It is sealed very tightly. Don't open it, now...

desc_chs: 小五亲手制作的香嫩椒椒鸡，据他所说完美还原了童年时候的风味，虽然狼哥应该无法享用，但也能由此回忆起当年小小的幸福吧。
desc_en: Jueyun Chili Chicken made personally by Little Wu. According to him, it captures the taste of his youth perfectly, and though Big G will not be able to enjoy it, he may yet remember some of the happiness of his youth.

desc_chs: 从木木那里获得的华丽玩具箱，听说这曾是他们童年时期共同的愿望。希望一切梦想在未来都能实现。
desc_en: A luxurious toybox from Mumu. This was once something they all desired in their childhood. May all wishes come true in the future.

desc_chs: 看起来成色优良的浮生石片，以此等品质的材料制成的霄灯，一定能高高地飞上天空，带着美满的期许一同翱翔。
desc_en: Plaustrite Shards of fine quality. A Xiao Lantern made from such material is sure to carry happy hopes high into the sky.

desc_chs: 从聪子那里获得的霄灯，其中写上了童年时期五位最好的玩伴的名字。愿薪火相传，友谊不灭。
desc_en: Xiao Lantern obtained from Congzi, and it has the names of the five childhood playmates inscribed upon it. May the fire pass on, and may friendship never die.

desc_chs: 饱含着葛罗丽心意的蒲公英籽，看起来能随风飞到很远的地方。
desc_en: Dandelion Seeds that contain Glory's thoughts. The wind can probably carry these far, far away.

desc_chs: 寄给塞琉斯的信。信封上的字迹很是潦草，和写字人的心情颇为相似。
desc_en: A letter to Cyrus. The handwriting on the envelope looks hasty and careless, reflecting the sender's state of mind.

desc_chs: 璃月诗人清昼亲自挥笔写下的签名。据说凭此签名能前往万文集舍兑换清昼的全新诗集。虽然不知道清昼什么时候才能写好那本诗集…但这份签名本身也能算是个纪念。
desc_en: A signature personally penned by the Liyue poet, Qingzhou. He mentioned that you can exchange this signature for a copy of his new anthology at Wanwen Bookhouse. Well, no one knows when he will finish writing that anthology, but at least it makes for a nice memento.

desc_chs: 包裹内装有芙萝拉小姐亲手剪下的几枝鲜花，仿佛隔着盒子也能闻到花朵的芳馨。
desc_en: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

desc_chs: 包裹内装有芙萝拉小姐亲手剪下的几枝鲜花，仿佛隔着盒子也能闻到花朵的芳馨。
desc_en: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

desc_chs: 璃月的幻想小说，讲述了岩王帝君化为凡形行走人间的故事。天下珍宝明鉴的时代里，一句小小的戏谑之语便能拆穿妄言。
desc_en: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. In an age when scrutiny was laid upon the treasures of the world, one humble witticism was all it took to expose all lies.

name_chs: 古老的考察日志·其之二
desc_chs: 在冰封的遗迹地窖下，发现的考察日志。\n记事者似乎是过去统治蒙德的贵族。
desc_en: An investigation journal found in the basement of the ice-covered ruins.\nIts author seems to have been a member of the aristocracy that once ruled Mondstadt.

name_chs: 古老的考察日志·其之三
desc_chs: 在雪山阳面山壁上的营地中，发现的考察日志。\n记事者似乎是过去统治蒙德的贵族。
desc_en: An investigation journal found in the camp on the sunny side of Dragonspine.\nIts author seems to have been a member of the aristocracy that once ruled Mondstadt.

desc_chs: （test）老孟和狼哥的好友们提供的材料购买经费…\n，可以在「北国银行」兑换成零钱。
（test）给戴因的特调酒
（test）深渊教团的残破图卷·上
（test）深渊教团的残破图卷·下
（test）深渊教团的残破图卷·完整
「荣发商铺」向「范木堂」订购高档家具的订单收据，记录了这笔交易的各种详细信息。
desc_en: The invoice for the furniture that Second Life purchased from Fanmu Carpenter's. It features detailed information regarding that transaction.

desc_chs: 从世界之外漂流而来的旅行者，被神带走血亲，自此踏上寻找七神之路。
desc_en: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

desc_chs: 包裹内装有芙萝拉小姐亲手剪下的几枝鲜花，仿佛隔着盒子也能闻到花朵的芳馨。
desc_en: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

desc_chs: 包裹内装有芙萝拉小姐亲手剪下的几枝鲜花，仿佛隔着盒子也能闻到花朵的芳馨。
desc_en: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

desc_chs: 包裹内装有芙萝拉小姐亲手剪下的几枝鲜花，仿佛隔着盒子也能闻到花朵的芳馨。
desc_en: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

desc_chs: 一张被揉皱了的纸条，纸条上的字迹很是潦草，能想象到写这份字条的人当时所处的状态。
desc_en: A crumpled note featuring hastily written characters. One can imagine the state its author was in when they wrote it.

desc_chs: 阿贝多用炼金术调制的药剂，呈现出一种特殊的色彩。既然阿贝多说药剂符合预期，那喝下去应该不会有什么问题吧。
desc_en: A potion that Albedo made using alchemy. Despite its unusual color, Albedo insists that the potion will work just as expected. Drinking it should not cause any adverse side effects.

desc_chs: 稀有的鲜美肉类。\n据记载在数百年前已经灭绝的走豕品种，因为龙脊雪山的极端天候而被保存了下来。对于提瓦特的老饕们而言，是福音般神圣的极佳食材。
desc_en: Rare, fresh meat.\nThis species of boar is recorded to have gone extinct several hundred years ago and has been preserved by the extreme temperatures on Dragonspine. For the gourmets of Teyvat, this is an ingredient of unspeakable sacrosanctness.

name_chs: 冒险家罗尔德的日志·龙脊雪山
name_en: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Dragonspine
desc_chs: 著名冒险家罗尔德遗落的日志，有一些书页已经残破发皱了，些许发亮的冰晶附着其上。
desc_en: A journal left behind by a renowned adventurer Roald. Some of its pages are damaged and crumpled, and a few shimmering ice crystals are attached to them.

desc_chs: 「留影机」所印出的画，画面很清晰。
desc_en: A picture printed out by the Kamera. It's very clear.

desc_chs: 「留影机」所印出的画，画面很清晰。
desc_en: A picture printed out by the Kamera. It's very clear.

desc_chs: 璃月民众只在「绝云间」外围供奉仙人，但据说持此信物者，可以安全地接近仙家洞府。
desc_en: Normally, the people of Liyue only hold rituals to worship the adepti in the peripheral areas of Jueyun Karst; however, he who holds this token may safely enter the residence of the adepti.

name_chs: 哈里斯特制白汁时蔬烩肉
desc_chs: 新鲜奶油炖煮，口感松软，丝丝热气带来家一般的温暖。
desc_en: A dish of delicate texture stewed in fresh cream. So warm and comforting that it makes one feel at home.

desc_chs: 记载着宝藏线索的地图。
desc_en: A map that records the location of treasure.

desc_chs: 奇怪的纸条，上面似乎记载着什么信息…
desc_en: A strange note that seems to contain some sort of message...

desc_chs: 一袋摩拉。虽然不算重，但也不算轻。
desc_en: A bag of Mora. Not the heaviest, but one would not mind finding it on the street.

desc_chs: 被水泡过的盒子。但包裹得很严实，似乎包着什么重要的东西…
desc_en: A water-logged box. It is packed very tightly — its contents seem to be of much importance...

desc_chs: 群玉阁中珍藏的孤本图书，本卷似乎是系列中的其中一册。其中记录了有关璃月港经济方针的论述内容。
desc_en: This scroll, which seems to be a part of a larger series, belongs to the Jade Chamber's invaluable collection of written works. This volume is a dissertation on Liyue Harbor's economic policy.

desc_chs: 沿路收集的星银矿石，看上去和普通的星银矿差别不大，但经阿贝多判断，很适合用作炼金术的触媒。
desc_en: Starsilver ore collected along the way. It looks similar to regular Starsilver, but upon closer inspection by Albedo, it can be used as an alchemical catalyst.

desc_chs: 从<color=#FF5E41FF>愚人众、丘丘人</color>与<color=#FF5E41FF>深渊法师</color>等敌人处获取，也有可能从植物中采集得到。\n随处可见的纤维素。特殊处理后，可以制成霄灯的灯皮，让它承载着良善的愿望飘向远方。\n可在璃月寻找
desc_en: Dropped by <color=#FF5E41FF>the Fatui, hilichurls</color>, and <color=#FF5E41FF>Abyss Mages</color>. Can also be harvested from plants.\nCommon fibrous material that can be processed into lantern wrappings so that the lanterns can float away with their beautiful wishes.\nFound in Liyue.

desc_chs: 从<color=#FF5E41FF>毛茸茸的敌人</color>与<color=#FF5E41FF>小动物</color>身上获得，也有可能从植物中采集得到。\n随处可见的绒材。特殊处理后，可以制成霄灯的灯芯，让它承载着良善的愿望飘向远方。\n可在璃月寻找
desc_en: Dropped by <color=#FF5E41FF>fluffy enemies</color> and <color=#FF5E41FF>small animals</color>. Can also be harvested from plants.\nCommon velvety material that can be processed into lantern wicks so that the lanterns can float away with their beautiful wishes.\nFound in Liyue.

desc_chs: 阿笨所做的霄灯，看起来意外地有些精致…
desc_en: A Xiao Lantern made by Dummy. It looks surprisingly intricate...

desc_chs: 「希望一切顺利…」
desc_en: "I wish for good fortune..."

desc_chs: (test)通用相片道具
从阿桂那里拿到的药，还是快点送去给订药的人吧。
desc_en: Medicine from Herbalist Gui. Best to send it to the one who ordered it.

desc_chs: 沿路收集的星银矿石，看上去和普通的星银矿差别不大，但经阿贝多判断，很适合用作炼金术的触媒。
desc_en: Starsilver ore collected along the way. It looks similar to regular Starsilver, but upon closer inspection by Albedo, it can be used as an alchemical catalyst.

desc_chs: 寄托着弗莱琪姐弟心意的蒲公英籽。希望能随风飞回蒙德城…
desc_en: Dandelion Seeds that contain the wishes of the siblings Freki and Geri. May it go with the wind back to Mondstadt...

desc_chs: 思妤送给王扳子的霄灯。
desc_en: A Xiao Lantern given to Wrench Wang by Siyu as a gift.

desc_chs: 璃月流传的诸多志怪传奇故事合集，收录了许多短小精悍，脍炙人口的轶事，大多为民俗题材。本篇讲述了仙兽「麒麟」与凡人的渊源。
desc_en: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on the shared history of qilins and humans.

desc_chs: 璃月流传的诸多志怪传奇故事合集，收录了许多短小精悍，脍炙人口的轶事，大多为民俗题材。本篇介绍了被称为「遁玉陵」的古老遗迹。
desc_en: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on the Dunyu Ruins.

name_en: Records of the Gallant: Black Raccoons
desc_chs: 记录了璃月市井传说中诸多侠客的奇书，其中有些故事年代已远，但依旧十分受市井读者欢迎。
desc_en: A compilation of stories and legends of various knights-errant in Liyue. Some of them have been told for a long time but are still popular among the people.

desc_chs: 记录了璃月市井传说中诸多侠客的奇书，其中有些故事年代已远，但依旧十分受市井读者欢迎。
desc_en: A compilation of stories and legends of various knights-errant in Liyue. Some of them have been told for a long time but are still popular among the people.

desc_chs: 「编辑寄语：谢谢大家的支持！我们去猫尾酒馆把酒鬼作者给抓出来啦！虽然看起来醉得像沾了水的蒲公英球，但继续写连载完全没有问题！接下来也请各位多多关照！」
desc_en: "Message From the Editor: Thank you for your support, everyone! We've managed to snag our erstwhile author from the bowels of The Cat's Tail! Although they look drunker than a sodden dandelion, continued serialization should pose no problem! We hope for your continued support from here on out as well!"

desc_chs: 「是会一边笑着一边分发狗饼干的好人呢…」在熟悉的树林与陌生的少女再次相逢，其真身究竟是——
desc_en: "A good person, one who smiles as she gives out dog biscuits..." What is the true identity of the strange young woman in the familiar forest?

desc_chs: 「糟了，居然当着魔女的面说了魔女的坏话！」「唉，真是不乖呢。不过，训练狗是主人的义务，所以没办法咯~」魔女大人的残酷秘密，正在拉开帷幕——
desc_en: "Heavens, I spoke ill of a witch to her face!" "Oh, what a bad boy. Still, discipline is a master's duty, so there's nothing for it~" The curtains rise on the witch's cruel secret—

desc_chs: 方整的包裹里装有望舒客栈出品的杏仁豆腐，包装仔细，能感受到厨房的用心。
desc_en: This box contains Almond Tofu made at Wangshu Inn. It is well-packaged, and one can feel the care that the chef took in putting this together.

desc_chs: 方整的包裹里装有望舒客栈出品的金丝虾球，包装仔细，能感受到厨房的用心。
desc_en: This box contains Golden Shrimp Balls made at Wangshu Inn. It is well-packaged, and one can feel the care that the chef took in putting this together.

desc_chs: 虽说是班尼特的得意之作，但这道菜从气氛上就有一股微妙的感觉…是不幸吗？
desc_en: This is supposed to be Bennett's specialty dish, but you can sense that this dish emanates a strange feeling of... misfortune?

desc_chs: 在遗迹中意外捡到的冒险家笔记，似乎记载着破解机关的线索。
desc_en: A set of adventurer's notes that you picked up in the ruins. It seems to contain a clue to unlocking these mechanisms.

desc_chs: 原本是一盏完整的霄灯，承载了某人的心愿。这盏灯不知飞过了多少地方，现在磨损得只剩下了灯罩…
desc_en: This was once a Xiao Lantern that carried someone's wishes. No one can say where it has flown since, but now there is naught left but its lampshade...

desc_chs: 铁的矿石，需要施以相当强大的力量才会碎裂吧。
desc_en: Iron ore. Looks like it could take quite a strong blow to break it apart.

desc_chs: 未经削切的晶体。普通人即使倾尽全力，也只能在其表面留下轻微的划痕吧。
desc_en: An uncut crystal. Most people could throw everything they have at it and still barely leave a scratch.

desc_chs: 红色的钩钩果。不知道有什么特别的药效…
desc_en: A red Wolfhook berry. One wonders if it might have some unique medicinal properties...

desc_chs: 很新鲜的绝云椒椒，看起来品质很不错…
desc_en: A very fresh Jueyun Chili. It seems to be of very high-quality...

desc_chs: 和诺艾尔一起挑选的礼物。希望它能够成为连接贝雅小姐和昆恩先生的红线…
desc_en: A gift you chose together with Noelle. Hopefully, it will help bring Bea and Quinn together...

desc_chs: 从望雅那里拿到的海灯节礼品。还是赶紧送去给千岩军吧…
desc_en: Lantern Rite Gifts from Wang'ya. Best to pass them on to the Millelith as soon as possible...

desc_chs: 拿在手上的时候还能感觉到明显的热度，这种材料，真的能做颜料吗…
desc_en: You can still feel its heat as you hold it in your hand. Can this really be used to make paint?

desc_chs: 卯师傅为竺子准备的菜品，似乎刚刚做好，隔着密封的包裹也能感受到温度。
desc_en: A meal that Chef Mao has made for Atsuko. It looks like it is freshly made — you can feel its warmth even through the tight wrapping.

desc_chs: 似乎装着什么东西的盒子。到底是谁把它埋在这里的呢…
desc_en: A box with something in it. One wonders who might have buried it here...

desc_chs: 粗看与普通霄灯别无二致，但若仔细观察，会发现灯罩一侧的题字。字迹清峻沉逸，皆是出自伯桓子之手。
desc_en: At first glance, this looks no different from your average Xiao Lantern. However, closer observation reveals that this lantern has inscriptions upon it. The penmanship is most austere, and seems to have been written in Mr. Bohuan's hand.

desc_chs: 一份天衡山的土壤。不知道索拉雅能从里面分析出什么来…
desc_en: A soil sample from Mt. Tianheng. Who knows what discoveries Soraya's analysis will yield...

desc_chs: 只生长在孤高石峰的通透白花。不愿接受平原的温暖与湿润，宁可在清冷的尖峰眺望远方。
desc_en: A translucent white flower that only grows on the highest stone peaks. It eschews the warmth and moisture of the plains to gaze out afar from the solitary mountaintops.

name_chs: 被史莱姆吞下去过的嘟嘟莲
desc_chs: 被史莱姆吞下去过的嘟嘟莲。希望这株嘟嘟莲还可以入药…
desc_en: A Calla Lily that has been swallowed by a Slime. One hopes that this Calla Lily can still be used in making medicine...

desc_chs: 璃月水生的泽芝，花开两株。一株盛放芳香，一株莲蓬清苦。据说能入药。
desc_en: An aquatic plant native to Liyue that grows and blooms in pairs. One is fragrant, and the other bitter. It's said to make a good herbal medicine.

desc_chs: 很平常的木板，泛用性很广。
desc_en: An ordinary wooden plank. It has a great many uses.

desc_chs: 刚从猎物身上取下的新鲜兽肉，肉质紧实鲜嫩。
desc_en: Fresh meat rendered from a fresh hunt. It is both firm and tender.

desc_chs: 出产自雪山的优质冷鲜肉，具有独特的风味。
desc_en: High-quality Chilled Meat from Dragonspine. It has a unique flavor.

desc_chs: 记录了风花节期间蒙德景观的画片。鲜花、神像还有自由的蒙德人，风花节大概就是浪漫的代名词吧。
desc_en: A picture recording the scene in Mondstadt during Windblume Festival. With fresh flowers, the Statue of The Seven, and the free people of Mondstadt, "Windblume" could be deemed synonymous with "romantic."

desc_chs: 记录了风花节期间蒙德景观的画片。鲜花、神像还有自由的蒙德人，风花节大概就是浪漫的代名词吧。
desc_en: A picture recording the scene in Mondstadt during Windblume Festival. With fresh flowers, the Statue of The Seven, and the free people of Mondstadt, this festival could indeed be deemed synonymous with "romance."

desc_chs: 记录了风花节期间蒙德景观的画片。鲜花、神像还有自由的蒙德人，风花节大概就是浪漫的代名词吧。
desc_en: A picture recording the scene in Mondstadt during Windblume Festival. With fresh flowers, the Statue of The Seven, and the free people of Mondstadt, "Windblume" could be deemed synonymous with "romantic."

desc_chs: 以星银矿为主要材料，经炼金术炼制而成的奇异花朵。花瓣大而柔软，泛着银光。
desc_en: A wondrous flower created using alchemy, with Starsilver as its main component. Its petals are large but soft, and it glimmers with a silver light.

desc_chs: 来历不明的恐吓信。内容没头没尾，又似乎意有所指。
desc_en: A threatening letter of unknown origin. You can barely make heads or tails out of it, but yet it seems to also conceal some deeper meaning...

desc_chs: 刚刚采摘下的落落莓，捣碎后很适合用来染色。
desc_en: A freshly picked Valberry. It would make a fine dye once mashed.

desc_chs: 火史莱姆的凝液，有着微弱的火元素痕迹。
desc_en: The condensate of a Pyro Slime. It bears slight traces of Pyro energy.

desc_chs: 从康纳那里取得的水瓶。里面装着解决事件的关键。
desc_en: A bottle you received from Connor. It contains the key to resolving this incident.

desc_chs: 写满笔记的纸条，似乎出自情诗速成班学生之手。仔细阅读的话，也许能学到写情诗的重要技巧。
desc_en: A note filled from margin to margin with text. It seems to have come from a student of the love poem crash course. If you read it carefully, you may yet grasp the gist of how to write a love poem.

desc_chs: 从狐狸造型的雕像中，拿到的神秘物件。
desc_en: A mysterious object retrieved from within a fox-shaped statue.

desc_chs: 在绀田村北面的荒废神社中，从狐狸造型的雕像中，取得的「镇物」。\n根据「花散里」的说法，需要利用这种镇物来实行净化的工作。
desc_en: A ward retrieved from within the kitsune-shaped sculpture within the abandoned shrine north of Konda Village.\nAccording to Hanachirusato, these wards are required to conduct rites of purification.

desc_chs: 妖狸五百藏作为答谢交给你的「镇物」，造型是相当华丽的梳子。\n五百藏曾经盗走了这把梳子，为了引「那个臭狐狸」现身。作为惩罚，五百藏和他的同伴们被「那个混小子」封在石像当中。\n根据「花散里」的说法，需要利用这种镇物来进行「神樱大祓」。
desc_en: A ward given to you by the bake-danuki Ioroi as a sign of thanks. It is shaped like a lovely comb.\nIoroi once stole this comb to lure "that sneaky kitsune" out. As punishment, Ioroi and his companions were sealed into graven stone by "that dratted fellow."\nAccording to Hanachirusato, these wards are needed to conduct the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual.

desc_chs: 古老的神秘物件，外形是密封的卷轴。无论用什么方法，也无法解开。\n根据「花散里」的说法，需要利用这种镇物来进行「神樱大祓」。
desc_en: An ancient and mysterious item shaped like a tightly-sealed scroll. No matter what you do, it won't open at all.\nAccording to Hanachirusato, these wards are needed to conduct the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual.

desc_chs: 古老的神秘物件，外形是古老的钥匙。既然有钥匙，那就有锁。这把钥匙对应的锁，似乎快要被树根吸收的污秽冲破了。\n根据「花散里」的说法，需要利用这种镇物来进行「神樱大祓」。
desc_en: An ancient and mysterious item shaped like an ancient key. Where there's a key, there's a lock — but this key's lock is about to be breached by the defilement absorbed by the tree's roots.\nAccording to Hanachirusato, these wards are needed to conduct the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual.

desc_chs: (test)遗迹石板，上面的图案磨损的看不清了。
根据绀田传助的记录，是用来打开井盖的钥匙。
desc_en: According to Konda Densuke, this is the key to the well's lid.

desc_chs: 刻画着纹路的古老石板，静静诉说着传说中宝藏的秘密…
desc_en: The lines carved into this old stone slate speak silently of the secret of the legendary treasure...

desc_chs: 刻画着纹路的古老石板，静静诉说着传说中宝藏的秘密…
desc_en: The lines carved into this old stone slate speak silently of the secret of the legendary treasure...

desc_chs: 刻画着纹路的古老石板，静静诉说着传说中宝藏的秘密…
desc_en: The lines carved into this old stone slate speak silently of the secret of the legendary treasure...

desc_chs: 刻画着纹路的古老石板，静静诉说着传说中宝藏的秘密…
desc_en: The lines carved into this old stone slate speak silently of the secret of the legendary treasure...

desc_chs: 在摘星崖附近采到的蒲公英籽，据说品质不错。
desc_en: Seeds of a Dandelion plucked from Starsnatch Cliff. Said to be of rather fine quality.

desc_chs: 生长在风起地附近的风车菊，据说品质不错。
desc_en: A Windwheel Aster that grows near Windrise. Said to be of fine quality.

desc_chs: 刚刚调制好的特制饮品。不知道喝起来是什么味道…
desc_en: A special beverage that has just been brewed. Who knows how it will taste...

desc_chs: 刚刚调制好的特制饮品。不知道喝起来是什么味道…
desc_en: A special beverage that has just been brewed. Who knows how it will taste...

desc_chs: 「和煦春日的死亡，是怎样的触感呢？」在清晨温馨的时刻，少女吐露出的是——背离常识的话语…「大概是——毛茸茸的吧？」
desc_en: "What does the death of a warm spring day feel like?" So the young maiden said one morning, in defiance of all common logic. "I suppose it must feel... furry?"

desc_chs: 毕竟在这世界上，没有一个人能活着得到解脱。
desc_en: After all, none can live and still obtain release.

desc_chs: 「吵吵闹闹的狗嘴，让我来堵上好了…」「唔唔——！」那一夜，少女向忠犬托付了重要的东西…
desc_en: "I should just stuff that noisy puppy yapper of yours..." "Woof, woof!" That day, the young maiden gave her loyal dog something precious...

desc_chs: 为了救回心爱之人，青年不顾自身安危，提剑直取虎穴；而另一边，他的心上人也在苦苦支撑…
desc_en: To rescue the one he loves, the young man charges heedlessly into danger, entering the lair of the enemy with his sword drawn: and on the other side, his beloved hangs on desperately...

desc_chs: 深夜的贼窝中伸手不见五指，恶霸、青年、女子，三人在黑暗中摸索着相互找寻，一场危险的误会即将上演…
desc_en: The bandit lair in the dead of night is pitch-dark. The tyrant, the youth, and the lady grope in the dark in search of one another, and there, a perilous misunderstanding is about to play out...

desc_chs: 民俗学家艾拉·马斯克编写的丘丘语实用速查手册，但其可靠度仍需实际验证。
desc_en: A handbook of Hilichurlian written by the folklorist Ella Musk, though its practical use has yet to be tested in the field.

desc_chs: 在不起眼的地方做了标记的竹签。通过鸣神大社的玄冬林檎小姐，可以兑换成阐明运势的「御神签」。
desc_en: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

desc_chs: 在不起眼的地方做了标记的竹签。通过鸣神大社的玄冬林檎小姐，可以兑换成阐明运势的「御神签」。

desc_chs:
昭明今日运势的特制纸签，也被某人称为「纸片儿」。
每天只能求得一次签文，昨日的签也会因为不再具有意义而消失。
据说，「凶」和「大凶」这类不吉祥的签条，可以结在「御签挂」上，以求转运。
但无论如何，「命」与「运」都应该自己掌握、自己开拓吧。
desc_en:
A special slip of paper that can illuminate one's fortune. Also known to a certain someone as "strips of paper."
You can only get one of these per day, which will cause the previous day's fortune slip to lose meaning and disappear.
They say that slips that portend ill luck such as "Misfortune" and "Great Misfortune" can be tied to the Fortune Slip Hanger as a prayer for a turnaround.
Regardless, "fate" and "destiny" are things best grasped and forged in one's own hands.

据说，「凶」和「大凶」这类不吉祥的签条，可以结在「御签挂」上，以求转运。
但无论如何，「命」与「运」都应该自己掌握、自己开拓吧。
desc_en:
A special slip of paper that can illuminate one's fortune. Also known to a certain someone as "strips of paper."
You can only get one of these per day, which will cause the previous day's fortune slip to lose meaning and disappear.
They say that slips that portend ill luck such as "Misfortune" and "Great Misfortune" can be tied to the Fortune Slip Hanger as a prayer for a turnaround.
Regardless, "fate" and "destiny" are things best grasped and forged in one's own hands.

desc_en: A special slip that can only be obtained if you use a certain secret code while exchanging for a Fortune Slip. Indicates a target and the location where they will emerge.

desc_chs: 在兑换「御神签」时，说出某个「暗语」才能领取到的特殊签文。记载着行动的目标与其出没的地点。

desc_chs: 在兑换「御神签」时，说出某个「暗语」才能领取到的特殊签文。记载着行动的目标与其出没的地点。
