desc_chs: 为贝雅拍下的画片，印着从「誓言岬」眺望海滩的风景。
desc_en: A picture taken for Bea. It shows a scenic view of the beach at Cape Oath.

desc_chs: 为贝雅拍下的画片，印着在「摘星崖」仰望夜空的风景。
desc_en: A picture taken for Bea. It shows the night sky above Starsnatch Cliff.

desc_chs: 为贝雅拍下的画片，印着「风起地」水木相辉映的风景。
desc_en: A picture taken for Bea. It shows the picturesque landscape of trees and water at Windrise.

desc_chs: 似乎很长的信，令人好奇塞琉斯在信中都说了些什么，不过偷看别家姐弟之间的信不太好吧？
desc_en: This long letter makes one curious as to what Cyrus has written in it... But it's not very appropriate to peek at the private letters between a brother and sister, now is it?

desc_chs: 为玉霞拍下的画片，描绘了雪山的风景。
desc_en: A picture taken for Iris. It depicts the snowy scenery of Dragonspine.

desc_chs: 由「南十字武斗会」的主办者颁发的奖牌，证明你夺得了这场比武大会的冠军。但比起大会上的「激斗」，可能还是有关神之眼和「理想」的故事更值得纪念吧。
desc_en: A medal awarded by the organizers of The Crux Clash. It is proof that you are the undisputed champion of this tournament. But it is not so much the duels you experienced that you will look back on — rather, it is the story of a Vision and the pursuit of ideals.

desc_chs: 经打包完成的「酱菜煎肉」，从包裹里飘出一种奇妙的味道。\n听说这是只有老食客才会点的隐藏菜品，所以普通人欣赏不来它的滋味，也是可以理解的吧…
desc_en: A serving of Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut that has already been packed. A curious smell wafts from within.\nYou've heard that this is a hidden menu item that only long-time patrons know of and that the hoi polloi cannot appreciate its flavor — fair enough, you think...

name_chs: 莉莉亲手烤制的庄园烤松饼
name_en: Tea Break Pancake Cooked by Lily
desc_chs: 内层的形状压制得并不完美，入口也有些微焦味，但已经是莉莉能烤出的最好的松饼。
desc_en: The inner layers have not quite been pressed together to perfection, and it does taste a little burnt, but these are the best pancakes that Lily can make.

desc_chs: 罕见的装置，似乎有某种特殊用途。试着将它放到与之匹配的环境里吧。
desc_en: A rarely seen device that seems to have some special purpose. Try fitting it into a suitable environment.

desc_chs: 美丽的水晶块，通体呈轻柔如摇摆秋叶般的浅黄色。
desc_en: A crystal chunk that is pale yellow all over, beauteous as the swaying leaves of fall.

desc_chs: 美丽的水晶块，通体呈绚丽如春日新花般的浅红色。
desc_en: A crystal chunk that is pale red all over, lovely as spring blossoms.

desc_chs: 美丽的水晶块，通体呈澄澈如纯净冬雪般的浅蓝色。
desc_en: A crystal chunk that is pale blue all over, fair as the purest winter snow.

desc_chs: 从海中游鱼身上取得的浅黄色鳞片。长时间看着它的话，似乎会联想到与秋天有关的事物。
desc_en: A pale yellow scale obtained from a fish in the sea. Gazing upon it for a long time, you are reminded of autumn.

desc_chs: 从海中游鱼身上取得的浅蓝色鳞片。长时间看着它的话，似乎会联想到与冬天有关的事物。
desc_en: A pale blue scale obtained from a fish in the sea. Gazing upon it for a long time, you are reminded of winter.

desc_chs: 从海中游鱼身上取得的浅红色鳞片。长时间看着它的话，似乎会联想到与春天有关的事物。
desc_en: A pale red scale obtained from a fish in the sea. Gazing upon it for a long time, you are reminded of springtime.

desc_chs: 从莎拉小姐那里拿到的猫饭。不知道尝起来味道如何…
desc_en: Cat food obtained from Sara. You wonder what it might taste like...

desc_chs: 从玛乔丽小姐那里拿到的猫玩具。希望小猫会喜欢。
desc_en: A cat toy obtained from Marjorie. Hopefully, the kittens will enjoy it.

desc_chs: 新鲜的鱼鳞。不知道迪奥娜会用来做什么…
desc_en: The fresh scales of a fish. One wonders what Diona might do with it...

desc_chs: 刚刚调制出来的饮品。看起来，似乎…有些微妙？
desc_en: A newly mixed drink. It seems a little... odd?

desc_chs: 在绀田村的枯井旁找到的钱袋。\n似乎是匆匆落下的东西。上面印了特殊的符号。
desc_en: A purse that you found beside the dry well in Konda Village.\nIt seems to have been left behind in a hurry, and has a special symbol printed on it.

desc_chs:
从偏僻深山开采出的稀有矿石。
这种石头仅存在于极古老的山脉之中。或许是太过罕见的关系，许多商人甚至没听说过它。
矿石本身净度极高，色彩鲜亮。内里如有光源一般，呈现出剔透美丽的蓝紫色。该种色彩犹如日暮时分的天际一般，幽远而艳丽。
少数了解它价值的学者为它起了一个朴素的名字——「老石」。
若想将它当作礼物，最好送给识货的人。
desc_en:
A rare ore mined from a deserted spot deep in the mountains.
This sort of ore can only be found in veins in the oldest mountains. Perhaps it is due to its extreme rarity, but many merchants haven't even so much as heard of this rock.
The ore itself has incredible clarity and its colors are dazzling, almost seeming to glow with an inner light that brings out its blue-violet beauty, which is like the distant and lovely sunset sky.
The few scholars who understand its value gave it a most straightforward name — "Archaic Stone."
If you intend to give it as a gift, it would be best to give it to one who recognizes what they're receiving.

desc_chs: 有些残破的木板。上面似乎刻着一些字…
desc_en: A wooden plank that has taken some damage. Some words seem to be carved on it...

desc_chs: 略有腐坏的木板。上面似乎刻着一些字…
desc_en: A wooden plank that has partially rotted away. There seem to be some words carved on it...

desc_chs: (test)记录了雷樱大祓的事宜已经封印的方法
名为「翠珏岩」的石片，不知道萍姥姥会用来做什么…
desc_en: A stone known as Smaragdus Jadeite. What will Madame Ping use it for?

desc_chs: 据烟绯和芷巧判断，名为「翠含岩」的石片。
desc_en: A stone that Yanfei and Zhiqiao have adjudged to be Smaragdus Nephrite.

desc_chs: 从「解翠行」处得到的证明文书。
desc_en: A written affidavit from The Jade Mystery.

desc_chs: 从「明星斋」处得到的总务司备案文件。
desc_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs' filing documents, obtained from Mingxing Jewelry.

desc_chs: 从「不卜庐」处得到的药理证明。
desc_en: A pharmacological certification from Bubu Pharmacy.

desc_chs: 刚刚取得的史莱姆凝液。不知道迪奥娜会用来做什么…
desc_en: Slime condensate that you just obtained. Who knows what Diona might do with it...

desc_chs: 从「危危岛」的石壁上记录下来的壁画。画中似乎描绘着一场海难…
desc_en: A mural that you found on a stone wall on Minacious Isle. It seems to depict a shipwreck...

desc_chs: 从「破破岛」的石壁上记录下来的壁画。画中描绘着五个奇怪的物体…
desc_en: A mural that you found on a stone wall on Broken Isle. It depicts five strange objects...

desc_chs: 从无名岛屿的石壁上记录下来的壁画。画中似乎描绘着一次营救的场景…
desc_en: A mural that you found on a stone wall on the Nameless Island. It seems to depict a rescue...

desc_chs: 从「双双岛」的石壁上记录下来的壁画。画中的山上有着一处特别的标记…
desc_en: A mural that you found on a stone wall on Twinning Isle. The mountain in the mural bears a special mark...

desc_chs: 笔迹已经模糊的笔记
desc_en: These notes are illegible.

desc_chs: 新鲜的鱼肉。不知道迪奥娜会用来做什么…
desc_en: Fresh fish. What will Diona use it for, you wonder...

desc_chs: (test)潦草的字迹，貌似只有一半。
(test)潦草的字迹，貌似只有一半。
在被破坏的小货车上，找到的清单。\n经过日晒雨淋，大部分内容已经无法辨识了。唯独能看出是幕府的清点货品与款项的单据。
desc_en: A list of goods found on a destroyed transport cart.\nBoth sun and rain have beaten down upon it such that most of its contents are impossible to discern. One thing alone remains clear — that this was once a Shogunate receipt for goods and the payments thereof.

name_en: Cargo Bag Fished Out From Water
desc_chs: 顺着沟渠在水中找到的货物袋。\n似乎是顺着沟渠的流水，被冲走了。
desc_en: A bag of cargo you discovered in the water while following the gully.\nIt seems to have been washed away.

desc_chs: 从无名小岛的石壁上记录下来的壁画。画中似乎描绘着一群准备乘船的人…
desc_en: A mural that you found on a stone wall on the Nameless Islet. It seems to depict a group of people preparing to board a ship...

desc_chs: 记录着「御影炉心」中存储装置情况的画片。不知道泽维尔能不能从中看出什么来…
desc_en: An image showing the state of the storage devices within the Mikage Furnace. Who knows what Xavier can glean from it...

desc_chs: 记录着「御影炉心」底部情况的画片。不知道泽维尔能不能从中看出什么来…
desc_en: An image showing the lowest level of the Mikage Furnace. Who knows what Xavier can glean from it...

desc_chs: 记录着「御影炉心」周边情况的画片。不知道泽维尔能不能从中看出什么来…
desc_en: An image showing the area around the Mikage Furnace. Who knows what Xavier can glean from it...

desc_chs: 一把旧刀，因为长期无人保养，刀身的光泽已经暗淡了。
desc_en: An old blade that has lost its luster due to a long-term lack of maintenance.

desc_chs: 装有酒的旧壶，散发着芳醇的气息。
desc_en: An old jug containing wine. A rich scent emanates from it.

desc_chs: 一把令人眼熟的旧刀，歪歪斜斜插在战场之上。
desc_en: A familiar old blade, stabbed into the battlefield in a skewed fashion.

desc_chs: 装着许多花种的袋子。不知道这些花种要种在哪里…
desc_en: A bag full of flower seeds. Question is, where to plant them?

desc_chs: 感觉有些不同寻常的海螺。不知道能用来做什么…
desc_en: A conch, but there's something strange about it. What could it be for?

desc_chs: 绀田村寻人启事
desc_en: Konda Village Missing Person Notice

name_chs: 将于明日逝去的贤者埃托莉亚
name_en: The Sage Aetolia Will Die Tomorrow
desc_chs: 一本幻想背景的小说。据腰封看，这本小说似乎以各类精巧的设定吸引了众多读者…
desc_en: A fantasy novel. From the packaging, it seems that this book has used various setting intricacies to attract many readers...

desc_chs: 一本悬疑小说。据腰封看，这本小说似乎以各类出乎预料的剧情吸引了众多读者…
desc_en: A suspense novel. The packaging suggests that many readers were attracted by the unexpected twists and turns of the plot.

desc_chs: 一本传统小说。据腰封看，这本小说似乎有着「严谨的剧情和设定」…
desc_en: A traditional novel. The packaging states that this novel has a "rigorous plot and setting"...

desc_chs: 在绀田村的井下，找到的老旧钥匙。\n常言「既然有钥匙，那就有锁」。不知这把钥匙对应的锁，又位于何方呢。
desc_en: An old key found at the bottom of the Konda Village well.\nIt is said that "where there's a key, there's a lock." Who knows where the lock for this key is...

desc_chs: 巫女「花散里」曾经戴着的面具，内侧有着深色的污渍。\n其中承载着一部分记忆。通过这份记忆，可以学会法器「白辰之环」的锻造方法。\n如今面具与花散里分别了，派蒙也不会叫她「面具巫女」了吧。
desc_en: Hanachirusato the shrine maiden used to wear this mask. It is deeply stained on the inside.\nSome memories are contained inside, through which one may learn the art of creating the Catalyst known as "Hakushin Ring."\nNow that Hanachirusato has been separated from this mask, Paimon doesn't get to call her the "Masked Maiden" anymore, right?

desc_chs: 岩藏流破门弟子柳叶岚士曾经使用的爱刀。\n是某一把名刀的影打，断裂后重铸而成的。与冈崎寅卫门的刀是一对。
desc_en: The favored sword of Yanagiha Arashi, an expelled member of the Iwakura School.\nIt is a leftover copy of a certain famous sword, and has been reforged after being broken. It and the weapon of Okazaki Toraemon are a pair.

desc_chs: 岩藏流破门弟子冈崎寅卫门曾经使用的爱刀。\n是某一把名刀的影打，断裂后重铸而成的。与柳叶岚士的刀是一对。
desc_en: The favored sword of Okazaki Toraemon, an expelled member of the Iwakura School.\nIt is a leftover copy of a certain famous sword, and has been reforged after being broken. It and the weapon of Yanagiha Arashi are a pair.

每天只能求得一次签文，昨日的签也会因为不再具有意义而消失。
据说，「凶」和「大凶」这类不吉祥的签条，可以结在「御签挂」上，以求转运。
但无论如何，「命」与「运」都应该自己掌握、自己开拓吧。
desc_en:
A special slip of paper that can illuminate one's fortune. Also known to a certain someone as "strips of paper."
You can only get one of these per day, which will cause the previous day's fortune slip to lose meaning and disappear.
They say that slips that portend ill luck such as "Misfortune" and "Great Misfortune" can be tied to the Fortune Slip Hanger as a prayer for a turnaround.
Regardless, "fate" and "destiny" are things best grasped and forged in one's own hands.

desc_chs: 「八重堂」给常九爷准备的礼物，里面还有一封信件。
desc_en: A gift from the Yae Publishing House to Chang the Ninth. There's even a letter on the inside.

desc_chs: 「八重堂」给「枕玉」准备的礼物，里面还有一封信件。
desc_en: A gift from the Yae Publishing House to "Zhenyu." There's even a letter on the inside.

desc_chs: 似乎是与牢锁适配的钥匙，被某个冒失鬼丢了出来。
desc_en: Seems to be the key to some prison cage. Some reckless person seems to have thrown it out here.

desc_chs: 看起来似乎随处可见的金属钥匙，可以打开大部分普通门锁…大概。
desc_en: A metal key that one can find just about anywhere, and that can unlock a majority of ordinary doors... Well, probably, anyway.

desc_chs: 竺子亲笔写就的家书，字里行间充满了对父母的挂念。希望这封长信能让远方的父母安心。
desc_en: A letter that Atsuko penned herself. It is filled with her yearning to see her parents again — with any luck, this long letter will bring her parents some peace of mind.

desc_chs: 字迹已经很模糊的签。虽然看不清上面的签文，但既然这根签被丢到了这么高的地方，应该也不会昭示着好运吧…
desc_en: A fortune slip on which the wording has become all but illegible. But considering that it was chucked up to such a high spot, it can't have boded particularly well...

desc_chs: 似乎曾被揉成一团的纸条。纸条上潦草地写着心愿，但现在只看得清「平安」两个字了。
desc_en: A paper note that has been crumpled into a ball. A wish has been scribbled on it, but the only legible word now is "peace."

desc_chs: 一匹精美的丝绸。通常，人们会用这种布料来制作高档衣物。
desc_en: A bolt of lovely silk. This is normally used to make high-end clothing.

desc_chs: 一份手抄的烤蘑菇披萨食谱。依照该种方法制作而成的食物或许会有独特风味。
desc_en: A handwritten Mushroom Pizza recipe. Perhaps food prepared using various different methods might result in a unique flavor.

desc_chs: （test）打包好的烤蘑菇披萨
（test）华丽的着物

name_chs: 卯师傅特制香嫩椒椒鸡
name_en: Chef Mao's Special Jueyun Chili Chicken
desc_chs: 由卯师傅特别制作的香嫩椒椒鸡。在制作时特别加入了海草，海葵等食材，不知尝起来味道如何…
desc_en: Jueyun Chili Chicken specially made by Chef Mao. Seagrass and Sea Cucumber were added in the process, and one wonders how the result might taste...

desc_chs: 香菱的手抄笔记。上面记录着香菱在做菜方面的一些…「奇思妙想」。
desc_en: Xiangling's handwritten notes. It records some of her... novel ideas regarding cooking.

desc_chs: 从绀田村的树下挖掘到的信件，似乎寄托了某人的期盼。
desc_en: A letter unearthed from beneath a tree in Konda Village. It seems to convey a certain person's hopes.

desc_chs: 以瓦希德亲手培育出的稻米为材料，捏制出的饭团。卖相上佳，味道也不错。
desc_en: Onigiri made from rice cultivated personally by Vahid. It tastes as good as it looks.

desc_chs: 宵宫交给你的用来记录烟花配方的纸条，听说只要将这张纸条交给宵宫，她就能做出和你记忆中完全一致的烟花。\n哪怕时光荏苒，物是人非，只要好好保管手里的这张纸条，就握住了通往过去的门票。希望在漫天烟火之下，你也能想起专属于你的美好。
desc_en: A note that Yoimiya gave you to record firework formulae with. If you give this note to Yoimiya, she will be able to make fireworks just as you remember them.\nNo matter how time passes, or people and things change, so long as you take care of this note, you will stand guard over a door to the past. Perhaps you too will find happiness that belongs only to you under a firework-filled sky.

desc_chs: 光泽鲜艳的古老珍珠，似乎其中存留着海渊之下的秘密。
desc_en: An ancient, vibrant pearl, within which lies the secret of the ocean depths.

desc_chs: 名字拗口的奇异宝物，传说由海祇大御神之精血铸就。
desc_en: A strange treasure with an awkward name. It is said to have been forged from the blood of Watatsumi Omikami.

desc_chs: 外形特异的容器，看起来脆弱易碎，但实际上材质十分坚韧。
desc_en: A vessel with an odd appearance. It seems fragile, but is actually quite sturdy.

desc_chs: 水中饱含着梦想与愿望，请你把它们送往应去的归宿。
desc_en: This water is filled with hopes and dreams. Please send them to the place where they belong.

desc_chs: 晶莹闪亮的甘甜之水，是滋养「灵草」最理想的水源。
desc_en: Crystal-clear water, the ideal source of hydration for the Spiritherb.

desc_chs: 传说中大海贼林藏留下的亲笔信，纸张皱巴巴的，或许曾被沾湿过。
desc_en: A letter written by the legendary pirate Rinzou. The paper is all crumpled up. It must have been wet at some point.

desc_chs: 大海贼林藏留下的徽记，是宏伟冒险生涯的证明。
desc_en: A signet left behind by the great pirate Rinzou as proof of a glorious life of adventure.

desc_chs: 似乎记录了离岛商户的近期税收情况，持有人为庆次郎。
desc_en: A ledger that seems to contain the recent taxation situations of Ritou's merchants. Its owner is Keijirou.

desc_chs: 持有本邀请函便可获准进入「木漏茶室」，上面印有社奉行的印章。
desc_en: Whomsoever has this invitation letter may enter Komore Teahouse. It has the seal of the Yashiro Commission on it.

desc_chs: 柊千里写给九条镰治的信，私自拆开的话会让千里小姐生气的吧？
desc_en: A letter that Hiiragi Chisato has written for Kujou Kamaji. She would be mad if you opened it up without her permission...

desc_chs: 刚刚被煮熟的肉，也许可以用于烹饪…
desc_en: Meat that has just been cooked. Maybe it can be used in a dish...

desc_chs: 从泽维尔那里拿到的「映影台本」。
desc_en: A "film script" you obtained from Xavier.

desc_chs: (test)带信封的信
某人留下的特殊的「御神签」。其中记载着某个地点。或许与玄冬林檎小姐的消失有关。
desc_en: A special fortune slip that a certain person left behind. A certain location is recorded within. This may have something to do with Gendou Ringo's disappearance.

desc_chs: 在不起眼的地方做了标记的竹签。通过鸣神大社的玄冬林檎小姐，可以兑换成阐明运势的「御神签」。
desc_en: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

desc_chs: 在不起眼的地方做了标记的竹签。通过鸣神大社的玄冬林檎小姐，可以兑换成阐明运势的「御神签」。
desc_en: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

desc_chs: 在不起眼的地方做了标记的竹签。通过鸣神大社的玄冬林檎小姐，可以兑换成阐明运势的「御神签」。
desc_en: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

desc_en: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

desc_en: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

desc_chs: 在不起眼的地方做了标记的竹签。通过鸣神大社的玄冬林檎小姐，可以兑换成阐明运势的「御神签」。
desc_en: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

desc_chs: 在不起眼的地方做了标记的竹签。通过鸣神大社的玄冬林檎小姐，可以兑换成阐明运势的「御神签」。
desc_en: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

desc_chs: (test)废弃营地发现的纸片，上面写了一些不明所以的话，可能跟神社占卜有关？
从勘定奉行的足轻那里拿到的信，据说是由柊家的大小姐亲笔所写。
desc_en: You obtained this from an infantryman at the Kanjou Commission. They say that this was written personally by the young lady of the Hiiragi Clan.

desc_chs: 由天领奉行特批的全稻妻的「通行凭证」。拥有这个凭证后，应该就可以自由出入离岛了…
desc_en: A special Travel Permit that allows travel throughout Inazuma. With this in hand, you can now freely enter and leave Ritou...

desc_chs: 九条镰治拜托你送给柊千里的信件，由他亲笔写就。据他说，这封信是用词最得体的一封。
desc_en: Kujou Kamaji asked you to carry this letter that he personally penned to Hiiragi Chisato. According to him, this one was the best-worded of the lot.

desc_chs: 九条镰治拜托你送给柊千里的点心。里面装得满满当当的…
desc_en: A box of snacks that Kujou Kamaji request you bring to Hiiragi Chisato. It seems very full indeed...

desc_chs: 白夜国的传国之宝。只不过已经失去了自己的力量。这么做的目的是为了防止用旁门左道闯关而来的小贼看穿它的价值。
desc_en: The hereditary national treasure of Byakuyakoku, but it has lost all of its own power. This was done to prevent thieves who have entered through alternative means from seeing its value.

desc_chs: 白夜国的传国之宝。展示着白夜国的大权，给与持有者支配「常夜」、「白夜」的能力。
desc_en: The hereditary national treasure of Byakuyakoku. It represents the highest authority in the land and confers the power to control Evernight and Whitenight upon its wielder.

desc_chs: 苏生之辔的碎片，使用了特殊的材料制成。
desc_en: A fragment of the Reins of Revival. It is made from a special material.

desc_chs: 苏生之辔的碎片，拥有特殊的力量。
desc_en: A fragment of the Reins of Revival. It has some special power.

desc_chs: 苏生之辔的碎片。三块碎片遵循着「三」的法则。
desc_en: A fragment of the Reins of Revival. The three fragments, too, follow "The Rule of Three."

desc_chs: 白夜国的传国之宝。除去执掌日夜之大权外，还能赐予持有者支配幽冥与现世的权力。
desc_en: The hereditary national treasure of Byakuyakoku. Apart from representing the highest authority in the land, it also confers the ability to control souls and this realm.

desc_chs: 供奉于狭间之街的供奉物，承载残魂「阿倍良久」一部分意念。
desc_en: Offerings from The Narrows that contain a fraction of Aberaku's remnant thoughts.

desc_chs: 供奉于灵庙之前的供奉物，承载残魂「阿倍良久」一部分意念。
desc_en: Offerings from the Evernight Temple that contain a fraction of Aberaku's remnant thoughts.

desc_chs: 供奉于蛇心之地的供奉物，承载残魂「阿倍良久」一部分意念。
desc_en: Offerings from the Serpent's Heart that contain a fraction of Aberaku's remnant thoughts.

name_en: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku
desc_chs: 取材自海祇岛民间故事的小说。最早版本乃是蛇神尚在人世之时，有鸣神岛的商人前往海祇岛誊抄转写带回的。如今已是没人看的古典名著，被市面上的轻小说埋没了。本书描写了海祇岛人在接纳鸣神文化之前的独特宇宙观。因为最近传统小说再出版的风潮，得以再次问世。
desc_en: A novel based on Watatsumi Island's folktales. The original edition of this text was transcribed on Watatsumi Island and brought back to Narukami Island by a merchant while the former's serpent god yet lived. No one reads this ancient tome nowadays, its role supplanted by all the light novels on the market. This book describes the unique cosmological outlook of the Watatsumi people before they came to adopt aspects of Narukami culture, and a recent resurgence in traditional novel publishing has allowed it to see the light of day once more.

desc_chs: 深海龙蜥的实验记录。实验中并没有龙蜥死亡。
desc_en: Experimental Records of the Bathysmal Vishaps. No vishaps were killed in the writing of these records.

desc_chs: 禁止一般人接触的编年史，写法混杂了寓言和纪年。从开天辟地写到了大日御舆落成。
desc_en: A chronicle that ordinary folk have been forbidden to read. The writing is a mix of fables and histories from the beginning of the world to the creation of the Dainichi Mikoshi.

desc_chs: 记载了白夜国地理和水文的工具类图书。随着海渊的封门以及海祇民的集体移居，再加上漫长时光的变动，这本书已经没用了。
desc_en: This text records the geography and hydrology of Byakuyakoku. With the sealing of the depths and the emigration of the people of Watatsumi, as well as the passing of long years, this book is now useless.

name_en: In the Light, Beneath the Shadow
desc_chs: 面向九岁到十二岁年龄段的益智类图书。作为特殊过渡时期的版本，下附了古代白夜国姓名的鸣神式改称法。
desc_en: A puzzle book for children of ages nine to twelve. As a book from a transitory period, it uses Narukami-style names with Byakuyakoku subscripts.

desc_chs: 海祇岛与渊下宫流传的键纹。用以解锁的图案，因此称之为「键纹」。
desc_en: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. Such pictures are used in unlocking, and are thus named "Key Sigils."

desc_chs: 海祇岛与渊下宫流传的键纹。是由曾经的白夜国民之纹拆解而成的。
desc_en: A Key Sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. It was made by disassembling the emblems of the once-upon-a-time people of Byakuyakoku.

desc_chs: 海祇岛与渊下宫流传的键纹。五种键纹样式各不相同。
desc_en: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. Each of the five Key Sigils is unique in its structure.

desc_chs: 海祇岛与渊下宫流传的键纹。人们离开海渊之后，将键纹拼合，形成了珊瑚宫家之纹。
desc_en: A Key Sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. When people left the ocean depths, they combined various Key Sigils to create the Sangonomiya house emblem.

desc_chs: 海祇岛与渊下宫流传的键纹。隐藏着一段秘密。
desc_en: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. It conceals some secret.

desc_chs: 海祇大御神生命力凝结的珊瑚。是举行「海祇御灵祭」必不可少的道具。
desc_en: A coral in which the life force of Watatsumi Omikami dwells. It is a vital part of the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri.

desc_chs: 仿造御辔之型所制，为白夜国「太阳之子」权位之象征。本身不具备特殊的力量。
desc_en: A symbol of the Sunchild's authority, made in the shape of a bridle. It does not possess any special power by itself.

desc_chs: 伊达的认可状，做工很精致。
desc_en: A medal that represents Date's recognition. It is very well-made.

desc_chs: 伊达的认可状，做工很精致。看久了会让人情不自禁地去玩上面的迷宫。
desc_en: A medal representing Date's recognition. It is very well-made. If you look at it long enough, the labyrinth-wanderlust might actually overtake you!

desc_chs: 可以用来打开狭间之街某处密室的钥匙。可能是被阿多尼斯他们放弃的另一处藏身之地吧。
desc_en: A key that opens the door to a certain secret room in The Narrows. This might be one of the abandoned safehouses that Adonis and his compatriots once used.

desc_chs: 在常夜灵庙附近的河流中取出的水，会在黑暗中发出微小的光芒。直接饮用它并不会让人遗忘什么，但其催生的龙骨花凝珠却有着近似的作用。
desc_en: Water from a river that flows near the Evernight Temple. It shines with a faint light in the darkness. Directly ingesting this liquid will not cause you to forget anything, but the Dragonbone Orb created through its auspices has this effect.

desc_chs: 经忘川之水浇灌而凝结的龙骨花果实，据说有着扫除忧愁、带来平静的奇异功效。放下目标，舍弃欲望，心怀满足，这就是幸福的真相吧？
desc_en: The fruit of the Dragonbone Flower, created via the use of the Waters of Lethe. It is said to sweep one's worries away and bring peace. Giving up your objectives, forsaking desire, and becoming content and satisfied... Is that not happiness?

desc_chs: 在踏鞴砂内找到的钥匙。\n有钥匙，就有钥匙对应的锁。
desc_en: A key found in Tatarasuna.\nWhere there's a key, there's got to be a lock to match.

desc_chs: 在踏鞴砂内找到的钥匙。\n有钥匙，就有钥匙对应的锁。
desc_en: A key found in Tatarasuna.\nWhere there's a key, there's got to be a lock to match.

desc_chs: 在踏鞴砂内找到的钥匙。\n有钥匙，就有钥匙对应的锁。
desc_en: A key found in Tatarasuna.\nWhere there's a key, there's got to be a lock to match.

desc_chs: 从叶名山薰处获得的干花。这朵甜甜花，也是那片全新的花海中长出的第一朵花。
desc_en: A dried flower from Hanayama Kaoru. It was the first flower to grow in that brand-new floral sea.

desc_chs: 击败踞身天云峠顶端的魔物后，发现的奇异鸟羽。
desc_en: A strange feather you discovered after defeating the monster on the summit of Amakumo Peak.

desc_chs: 墨田委托你寻找的物品。\n在鹤观找到的木簧笛，似乎是这里的传统乐器。\n按理说，鹤观的文明已经消失了数千年之久才对。
desc_en: An item that Sumida tasked you to find.\nYou found this Maushiro on Tsurumi Island, and it seems to be a traditional instrument around these parts.\nThat said, it should have been at least a few thousand years since Tsurumi Island last played host to any civilization at all.

desc_chs: 墨田委托你寻找的物品。\n似乎是某人离开鹤观前，留下的木簧笛。\n依照阿瑠的说法，木簧笛并不是乐器，而是鹤观生活在迷雾中的人们，定位同伴的道具。
desc_en: The item that Sumida sent you to find.\nThis Maushiro appears to have been left behind by someone before they left Tsurumi Island.\nAccording to what Ruu tells you, the Maushiro are not musical instruments. Instead, they were used by the locals as a means of locating one another amidst the fog that shrouded their home.

desc_chs: （test）传说中雷鸟身上所掉落的羽毛，因为破损了貌似少了一些力量。
（test）传说中雷鸟身上所掉落的羽毛，感觉很神秘但是充满了力量。

desc_en: An onikabuto that has fallen under the influence of Tatarigami. Who knows what sort of tests Xavier wants to put it through...

desc_chs: 从「净化装置」上掉下来的零件。
desc_en: A component that fell from the Purification Device.

desc_chs:
击败「愚人众执行官第八席·女士」后，获得的战利品。
愚人众常以面具示人。据说是因为，成为愚人众之后，过去的一切、自己的一切都再无意义。故此，无论是真名抑或是面目，都应当放弃。

——但要割舍构成「我」之所有过去、所有牵绊，是何等艰难之事。
不如说，正是因为近乎于——或是超越了妄念的执着，才愿意加入这种违逆天理的狂人组织，将自己的余命与「邪眼」相连，如天蝎般燃烧吧。
…当然，愚人众当中，痴迷于权益之人，或是纯粹的嗜虐者亦不在少数。而这两者亦不冲突。

真名为「罗莎琳·克鲁兹希卡·洛厄法特」的女人，或许曾经也有过更加天真纯粹的过去吧。
直到此人的视界被烈火填满，纯真的时代被焚毁；又藉由极寒的冰之邪眼，熄灭了永远噬咬她的火舌；又直到守护她的冰之权能被无羁的、意志同样坚决的永恒异乡人粉碎，喷薄而出的炽焰再度燃起…
desc_en:
A trophy obtained from defeating Signora, Eighth of the Fatui Harbingers.
The Fatui often face the world from behind their masks, and it is said that this is because all they once were will mean nothing once they become Fatui, and thus must they forsake their true names and faces alike.

—Yet the act of giving up all that makes up an "I" — one's past and the bonds that come with it — is no mean feat.
Perhaps it is fair to say that only those who possess an obsession close to or even exceeding the level of delusion might be willing to join this group that so rebels against the Heavenly Principles, binding their remaining days to their Delusions and burning as brightly as stars.
...Of course, many within the Fatui are simply consumed by power and are simple sadists — nor are these states necessarily in conflict.

The woman whose real name was Rosalyne-Kruzchka Lohefalter may have once led a more innocent, naive existence.
But that was before her eyes were filled with a raging fire, and her innocent days were burned away. Before the icy Delusion extinguished the flaming tongues that ever gnawed her. Before the frozen might that protected her was shattered by the eternal outlander, unbound yet no less determined than she was, causing the flames to burst forth once more...

desc_chs: 散发着奇异光彩、逸散着雷元素的宝珠，似乎与岛上的磐柱存在某种关联…
desc_en: A precious pearl that emits Electro energy and a strangely-colored light. It seems to have some connection with the rock pillars on the island.

desc_chs: 破破烂烂的信纸上，写有某人的心声。但纸张受到岁月侵蚀，字迹已经模糊不清，如果不是被人挖掘出来，某些往事大概会一直安眠在泥土中。

desc_chs: 保本留下的笔记，散发着浓烈的鸣草气息。
desc_en: Notes left by Yasumoto. They still smell strongly of Naku Weed.

desc_chs: 保本留下的笔记，在精心保护下并没有被雨水沾湿多少。
desc_en: Notes left by Yasumoto. It has been conscientiously protected from rain damage.

desc_chs: 保本留下的笔记，其上有些许污损痕迹。
desc_en: Notes left by Yasumoto. It shows some signs of blotching and water damage.

desc_chs: 看起来崭新的信笺，但已经被打开过了。散发着淡淡的绯樱气息。
desc_en: A letter that seems brand new but that has already been opened. It gives off a light sakura scent.

name_chs: 稻叶藤三郎久藏 绝笔
desc_chs: 一张写满文字的信纸，其作者已不知所踪。
desc_en: A letter filled with words from margin to margin. Its author has gone missing.

desc_chs: 不知是何种物质制成的神秘宝珠。即使放在行囊中，也会像星星一般发出微光闪耀。\n或许是某些「画面」完成的关键吧。
desc_en: A mysterious gem of unknown make. It shines like a star even when placed inside your backpack.\nPerhaps this is the key to completing a certain "image."

desc_chs: 刻画了「石根文字」的石板。\n或许能在鹤观的某些地方派上用场吧…？
desc_en: A stone slate with Ishine Script carved into it.\nPerhaps it may be of some use on Tsurumi Island...?

desc_chs: 记录着踏鞴砂上的「神居岛崩炮」所在位置的地图。
desc_en: A map that records the positions of the Kamuijima Cannons.

desc_chs: 心海写的日记（test）
从布伦处得到的优质稻米，看起来很适合用于烹饪。
desc_en: High-quality rice that you obtained from Brunn. It looks like it'll cook well.

desc_chs: 用「机关烹饪神机」烹饪出的「米饭布丁」，不知道味道如何…
desc_en: Rice Pudding made using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. One wonders how it might taste...

name_chs: 被风史莱姆吞下过的竹笋
desc_chs: 被风史莱姆吞下过的竹笋，不知道会不会带上什么特别的味道…
desc_en: Bamboo Shoots that have been swallowed by Anemo Slimes. Who knows what special flavor they might add...

desc_chs: 用「机关烹饪神机」烹饪出的「文心豆腐」。不知道吃起来味道如何…
desc_en: Oncidium Tofu made using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. One wonders what flavors this is going to have...

desc_chs: 装有疑似「海中月」化石的袋子，把它带给鲸井椛看看吧，不知道她能否接受这个现实。
desc_en: A bag containing the suspected fossil of the Lunar Leviathan. Give it to Kujirai Momiji... though one wonders if she can accept this reality.

desc_chs: 被流寇视若珍宝的钥匙，或许是通往宝藏秘密的关键之一…吧？
desc_en: A key treasured by the bandits. This must be one of the keys to finding the secret treasure... right?

desc_chs: 破旧残缺的书页，不知为何有一股陈腐粮食的气息。
desc_en: A tattered page. For some reason, it gives off the stench of stale grain.

desc_chs: 一张皱皱的字条，其上字迹杂乱难辨。
desc_en: A crumpled note with very messy, illegible handwriting.

desc_chs: 记录着清籁岛某处景致的画片。不知道为什么会被埋在地里…
desc_en: A picture of some place on Seirai Island. Who knows why it would be buried here...

desc_chs: 从太田太郎先生处获得的画片，似乎记录着清籁岛某处的景致…
desc_en: A picture you got from Mr. Oda Tarou, it seems to show some place on Seirai Island...

desc_chs: 从珊瑚那里获得的豆子。据说荒泷一斗对豆子过敏，如果他打算反抗，这袋豆子会成为反制他最有用的道具。\n珊瑚说这豆子是收费的，要价应该不会太过分吧…

从右侧拍摄「寝子」后，得到的画片。

desc_chs: 澄澈明净的晶石，矿芯具备良好的韧性与塑性。
desc_en: A bright and clear crystal with a core that is both tough and malleable.

desc_chs: 映着虹色辉芒的晶石，有着优异的韧性与可塑性，自古以来便被至冬的工匠们视为绝佳的锻造材料。\n传说明月的高车破碎时，沾染神血的车軎殒入月下的尘世，化作虹色的宝玉。从那以后，大地上的人们不再为死去的神明奉上信仰，唯有那些知晓夜的君王们为何而死的幸存者们依然在徒劳地歌唱着那些早已被遗忘的名字。
desc_en: A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.\nIt is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

desc_chs: 生产武器的原材料。通过锻造，可以生产出4星的单手剑。\n哲学中认为大理石蕴藏着成为美丽雕塑的潜能。这些原胚也孕育了无限可能。真让人期待。
desc_en: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords. \nPhilosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.

desc_en: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star catalysts.\nIn terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...

desc_chs: 生产武器的原材料。通过锻造，可以生产出4星的长柄武器。\n原胚所能打造而出的诸多武器的「事态」，其结果的「可能」虽然早已包含在了原物之中，但是最终能被制成怎样的形制，仍是现在无人知晓之事…
desc_en: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star polearms.\nIn terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...

desc_chs: 栖息在雷元素富集区域的奇异甲虫。与甲壳上宛如怒目而视的恶鬼之相相反，鬼兜虫其实非常温顺迟钝。
desc_en: A strange beetle that inhabits areas rich with Electro energy. Its docile and sedentary temperament could not be more different from the fierce, demonic visage displayed on its armored shell.

desc_chs: 从鸣神大社的神樱上飘落的花瓣，怀着稻妻大地的眷顾。
desc_en: Blossoms from the Sacred Sakura at the Grand Narukami Shrine, filled with a fondness for Inazuma.

desc_chs: 蕴含着「祟神」力量的晶体。冶炼时加入这种物质的话，能极大地提高钢铁制品的强度与韧性。
desc_en: A crystal that contains a sliver of Tatarigami power. Adding this material during smelting will greatly increase the strength and toughness of metals.

desc_chs: 在诗文中也被称为「赤蕊」的鲜艳植物，一度在稻妻列岛绝迹，如今在战场上再度重现。传说在血腥的战场上，它们开得格外妖艳。
desc_en: A vibrant plant that has also been named the "lycoris" by the poets. It was once thought extinct in the Inazuman archipelago, only to re-emerge now upon the battlefields. It is said that it blooms most enchantingly where much blood was spilled.

desc_chs: 即使在无风的日子里，亦会随雷鸣之声隐隐振动的植物。看起来像是花瓣的结构其实是叶片的延伸，保护着脆弱的花朵。
desc_en: Even on windless days, this plant will tremble lightly amid the cries of thunder. The parts of it that resemble petals are in fact extensions of the leaves meant to protect the fragile flower.

desc_chs: 在某些特殊的海域中、岛屿上才会生长的特殊物种。虽然外形看起来像菌类，但其实是由软体生物分泌增生而成的。
desc_en: A plant species that only grows in certain regions and islands of the ocean. Though it looks like a fungus of some sort, it actually comes from a substance secreted by certain soft-bodied organisms.

desc_chs: 与海祇的珊瑚相伴而生的宝珠，散发着月光般的丝丝凉意。
desc_en: A precious pearl that grows in the coral of Watatsumi. Gives off a cool sheen like that of the moonlight.

desc_chs: 生长在清籁岛的天云草结成的果实，贴在耳畔能听见微弱的电流声。
desc_en: The fruit of the Amakumo Grass, which grows on Seirai Island. You can hear it crackling with a tiny current if you hold it up to your ear.

desc_chs: 如同夜灯般微微发光的蘑菇，其中蕴含着不可思议的力量。
desc_en: A mushroom that glows like a night-light. Some curious power lies hidden within it.

desc_chs: 生长在浅海中的植物，能为菜肴增添特殊的风味。
desc_en: A plant that grows in shallow seas. It adds a unique flavor to dishes.

desc_chs: 有着色泽艳丽的外皮的果实，其中的果肉可以在烹饪后转化为口感独特的食物。
desc_en: A brightly-colored fruit. The flesh within transforms into food with a unique mouthfeel when cooked.

desc_chs: 伞盖形如五角星星一般的菌类，生命力十分顽强。成熟后，伞盖中央会裂开。
desc_en: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It is quite hardy indeed. Once it matures, the center of the cap will split open.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 如云海般层层叠叠生长的菌类，大多寄生于雨林深处的乔木之上。
desc_en: A fungus that grows in layers upon layers, like a sea of clouds, and which mostly grows on trees deep in the rainforest.

desc_chs: 圣洁而高贵的花卉，对生长环境的要求十分苛刻。花蕊经过加工后可以制成珍贵的香料。
desc_en: A holy and noble plant. The conditions for growth in its environment are very demanding. The flower buds can be processed to make valuable spices.

desc_chs: 生长于林中湿地，散发着同月亮一般皎洁光芒的花卉。只有在夜晚才会绽放。
desc_en: Growing in the forest wetlands, these plants only bloom at night with flowers as bright as the moon.

desc_chs: 生长在炎热潮湿的雨林当中，有着特殊辛香的果实。磨成粉末后可以制成香辛料，是须弥最重要的香料植物。
desc_en: Commonly grown in the hot and humid rainforest, this fruit has a special spicy aroma. When ground to powder, spices can be made from it. It is the most valued spice plant in Sumeru.

desc_chs: 生长在山崖峭壁之上的攀援植物开出的花朵。被称为莲只是因为外形相似，本身和莲花并没有什么关系。
desc_en: Flowers from vines that grow on cliff sides. It is called a lotus only because it has a similar appearance to one. Aside from that, it bears no other similar properties to the lotus.

desc_chs: 林中灌木结出的果实。肉质敦实，味道香甜可口。据说食用后还有宁心安神的功效。
desc_en: The fruit of a forest shrub. Its flesh is firm and sweet. It is said to have a calming effect on the mind.

desc_chs: 明艳而深沉的紫色花卉，散发出使行人驻足的馥郁芬芳。虽然被称作蔷薇但其实严格来说应该算作玫瑰。
desc_en: Bright and beautiful, these pure purple flowers give off a pleasant fragrance that will give any passerby pause. While some like to call this a type of "rambler rose," its relative lack of multiple flowers means that it falls under a different floral classification.

desc_chs: 在恶劣的沙漠环境中也能存活的植物所结的果子，赤红的果实在黄沙映衬下显得格外动人。
desc_en: A fruit that grows even in the most hostile of desert environments. Its vibrant crimson fruits are made even more lovely against a backdrop of yellow sand.

desc_chs: 沙漠绿洲中的常绿乔木结出的果实。坚硬果皮下的果肉肉质绵厚，甘甜可口，对沙海子民而言是重要的食物来源。
desc_en: A fruit that grows on evergreen trees within desert oases. The flesh under the tough skin is thick, sweet, and delicious, making it an important food source amongst the desert peoples.

desc_chs: 在沙漠深处流沙鳗鳗的繁殖地才能找到的枯壳。其坚硬的表壳是为了保护流沙鳗鳗的幼体，直到它们得以适应炎热干燥的沙漠环境而存在的。
desc_en: You can only find such husks deep in the desert where the Quicksand Eels breed. The hardened shell is meant to protect the Quicksand Eels' larval bodies until they finally acclimate to the conditions of the dry desert.

desc_chs: 绽放在古老战场上的鲜红之花，即便在荒漠中也能顽强生长。低垂的花朵似乎是在哀悼曾在此牺牲的英灵。
desc_en: Crimson flowers that bloom on ancient battlefields. They can even flourish in the depths of the desert. Their drooping flowers seem to be in mourning for heroes long past.

desc_chs: 分布在荒原群山的深处，散发着异彩的特殊辉石，似乎是由混化的元素能量凝结而成的。
desc_en: A splendorous stone that can be found in the depths of desolate mountains, seemingly formed from congealed elemental energy.

desc_chs: 栖息在浩瀚沙海之中的顽强甲虫。甲壳上的金色纹路似乎暗示着它们与遍布沙漠的古老遗迹间存在某种渊源。
desc_en: A tenacious beetle that finds repose within the vast ocean of desert sand. The golden pattern on such beetles' shells hints at some deep relationship between them and the ancient ruins that dot the desert.

desc_chs: 伞盖形如五角星星一般的菌类，生命力十分顽强。看上去似乎充满了活力。
desc_en: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It seems to be bursting with vitality.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复800点生命值。

desc_chs: 伞盖形如五角星星一般的菌类，生命力十分顽强。看上去似乎被烤焦了。
desc_en: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It seems to be a little singed.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复1点生命值。

desc_chs: 没有种子的花卉。\n只要大地重新记起，毗波耶就会绽放。
desc_en: A flower without seeds. \nOnce the earth remembers, the Viparyas will bloom.

desc_chs: 生长在水元素富集之处的植物。枫丹漫长的雨季后，随处可见其踪影，因此而得名。
desc_en: A plant that grows in environments rich with Hydro. This plant can be found everywhere in Fontaine after its long rainy seasons. The plant is named "Pluie" — which means "rain" in the local tongue — for that reason.

desc_chs: 生长在温暖、湿润、光照充足之处的果实，圆圆的外表下，偷偷藏着甜甜的甘鲜。
desc_en: A fruit that grows in warm and damp environments with ample sunlight. Inside this round and rotund fruit hides a sweet and refreshing surprise.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 华润而温莹的桃色花朵。拥有不同层次的芬芳，是用来调香的主要原料之一。
desc_en: A pink flower with a pearl-like luster and rich scent profile. It is one of the most important ingredients in a perfumer's arsenal.

desc_chs: 散发着幽光的贝状结构。似乎是纯净的元素能量凝结而成的产物，而非某种生物的甲壳。
desc_en: A conch-like structure that gives off a faint glow. Despite the name, it is not a shell but something condensed from pure elemental energy.

desc_chs: 幽淡而高贵的蓝色花卉。柔软的花蕊具备良好的吸水性和弹性，是诸多日用品的原材料。
desc_en: An ethereal and elegant blue flower. Its tender petals are elastic and water-absorbent, making it the ideal raw material for various daily necessities.

desc_chs: 随波逐流的藻类，依靠其他植物释放出的养分维持自身存在。虽然经常会被误解成浮游动物，但本质上其实是浮游植物。
desc_en: An algae floating with the tides that sustains itself by feeding on substances produced by other plants. Though often mistaken for zooplankton, based on its nature, Tidalga is actually a type of phytoplankton.

desc_chs: 静雅而清美的紫色花卉。其香清淡悠长、细腻柔和，因此常被用来制作名贵的香水。
desc_en: A serene and tranquil violet flower. It has a light, soft, and lasting scent and is often used for making luxurious perfumes.

desc_chs: 纤婉而柔洁的粉色花卉。虽然被称作蔷薇，但本质上更接近百合。
desc_en: A delicate and tender pink flower. Despite their name, Rainbow Roses are essentially more akin to Lilies.

desc_chs: 在水中会发出柔浅微光的软体动物。大多攀附在水边或水下的人造建筑表面。
desc_en: A soft-bodied animal that emits a gentle light. Often found climbing the walls of buildings near the water or underwater.

desc_chs: 明澈而澄净的苍色花卉。生于水脉汇聚之处，其香清冷淡雅，辛凉柔婉。
desc_en: A clear and clean azure flower, it is born where Water Veins come together. It has a simple, cool, and elegant fragrance, pungent and refreshing yet gentle.

desc_chs: 枫丹科学院利用新型奇械构件生产的微型探测单元，原本用以监测各类环境数据。
desc_en: Detection units produced by Fontaine Research Institute using new models of artificed components. Its original purpose was monitoring all kinds of environmental data.

desc_chs: 悬浮于莫尔泰区水体深处的清澈露滴，与常见的纯水造物不同，似乎凝聚着更为原始而纯粹的元素能量。
desc_en: A limpid drop of dew floating amidst the waters of Morte Region. It is different from other pure water bodies, as though it is a conglomeration of even more pure and primordial Elemental Energy.

desc_chs: 出产于沉玉谷的玉石。触感凉如清水，因此而得名。
desc_en: Jade from Chenyu Vale. Named for its cool, refreshing touch, that is much like clear water.

desc_chs: 生长在沉玉谷温暖湿润之处的茶叶。经过数千年的精心筛选培育，如今的茶叶香气浓馥绵长，纵然相隔数条街，依然能够嗅到那沁人心脾的芬芳。
desc_en: Tea grown in warm, moist areas in Chenyu Vale. After millennia of careful cultivation, the tea today emits a rich fragrance that can be savored from several streets away.

desc_chs: 因穗轴上长出巨大颗粒果实而得到此名的作物。
desc_en: This plant is named after the giant grains that grow along the cob.

desc_chs: 生长在崖壁上或是山脚下，如小型座灯一般轻微发亮的菌类，将手靠近时能感受到些微的温暖。
desc_en: A fungus that grows on cliff faces or at the foot of mountains, and which shines like a little lamp. You can feel a hint of warmth when your hand draws close.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 广泛生长于液态燃素环境之中的澄晶果树，在汲取燃素后结出的形如宝石的果实。
desc_en: The crystalline trees that grow widely in areas with Liquid Phlogiston produce these gem-shaped fruits after absorbing phlogiston.

desc_chs: 风味浓郁的作物。果肉本身会有独特的苦涩味，其种子在发酵及烘焙后，可以制成其他的美食。
desc_en: A crop rich in flavor. The fleshy part itself features a unique bitterness and its seeds, after being fermented and baked, can be made into other delicacies.

desc_chs: 生长在海边如羽状的特殊物种，看似是水草般的植物，实际上是形态特殊的水栖软体珊瑚。
desc_en: A special feather-shaped species that grows by the seaside. It looks kind of like a seagrass but is in truth a soft-bodied aquatic coral with a unique shape.

desc_chs: 形如飘然羽翼的花，花瓣的姿态在风中无比悠然。
desc_en: A flower with a shape like floating wings. Its petals sway in an unbelievably relaxed, serene manner as they are caressed by the wind.

desc_chs: 青蓝色的，汁液丰富的莓果。其果树大片生长在「悬木人」部族附近，是形态与火榴果相近的植物。
desc_en: Bluish, juicy berries that grow in large amounts near the Scions of the Canopy. Their shape is similar to that of Flamegranates.

desc_chs: 形如巨大动物爪掌的多肉植物。
desc_en: A succulent shaped like the paw of a great animal.

desc_chs: 散布在平原与高土的奇特花朵。成熟的花苞会在受到冲击后绽放开来。
desc_en: A strange flower that can be found all over the plains and highlands. Mature buds will bloom after being hit.

desc_chs: 在黑暗中微微发出光芒的菌类，因为形似暝视龙的角冠而被称为角菌。
desc_en: A fungus that emits a faint light in the darkness. It is so named because its shape resembles the horny crest of an Iktomisaurus.

desc_chs: 叶片与花瓣呈现枯焦之态的花朵，常常能在流灰弥漫之处看到它。
desc_en: A flower, the leaves and petals of which look scorched and withered, that can often be seen in places where ash abounds.

desc_chs: 花叶的外侧犹如石质的奇特植物，在绽放后，会露出晶石一般的芯。
desc_en: A strange plant whose flower's exterior resembles stone. Only in bloom does it reveal a resplendent, crystal-like core.

desc_chs: 沉积在富含燃素的区域，逐渐形成的红色鳞状晶石，蕴含极高的热量。
desc_en: Formed gradually in areas rich in Phlogiston, these red, scale-like crystals are blazing-hot to the touch.

desc_chs: 看似形态普通，风味却相当特殊的蘑菇，只会生长于瓦雷莎家的果园附近。既然派蒙取下了很可爱的名字，说明味道深得她心。
desc_en: An ordinary-looking mushroom with an extraordinary flavor. Only grows near the orchard at Varesa's house. Since Paimon gave it a cute name, its taste must have been truly memorable for her.

desc_chs: 愚人众进驻挪德卡莱后大量制造的便携轴承单元。损耗过度的单元也会像失去用途的单位一样被抛弃。\n其中偶尔还会残存一些微弱的月矩力。由于难以仿造，有时也会被那夏镇的商人当作等价交换的凭物。\n也正是因为如此，据说曾经有人试图伪造过这些单元。最终似乎是因为伪造的成本高于它们作为一般等价物的价格而破产了。
desc_en: A portable bearing of a type that was mass-produced after the Fatui moved into Nod-Krai. Excessively worn units are discarded like obsolete personnel.\nA few of them have a vestige of kuuvahki left inside. As they are difficult to imitate, they are occasionally used as currency by merchants in Nasha Town.\nIt's said that people tried to forge these bearings for that reason, but went bankrupt in the end because the cost of forging them was higher than their market value.

desc_chs: 常见于挪德卡莱沿海地带的砾石，特征是其上自然形成的空洞，触碰时总能感到一股隐隐的寒意。\n在古老的传说中，寒涌石上的空洞曾是霜月指引妖灵们避难的居所，亦是通向幽域的门扉。而在另一个流行于那夏镇的故事里，大盗雷德·米勒被围困之时，正是靠着霜月的圣女送给他作为定情信物的符石隐去身形，逃脱了追捕。霜月之子的追随者们坚决否认这样的说法，将其斥为胡言乱语，毕竟现在的寒涌石也的确看不出有如此神奇的效果。
desc_en: A pebble commonly found on Nod-Krai's coasts, characterized by a naturally occurring hollow. Touching it sends a faint chill through your finger.\nAccording to ancient legends, the hollows in these pebbles were once shelters revealed to the fae by the Frost Moon — gateways to the ethereal. In another story popular in Nasha Town, the legendary thief, Reed Miller, was surrounded when a runestone given to him by a holy lady of the Frost Moon as a token of her love allowed him to conceal himself and escape his pursuers. Naturally, the Frostmoon Scions vehemently reject this claim, as these pebbles do not display any such magical properties.

desc_chs: 形如烛盏的花卉，多生长在水边，香气寒冽素净，有安神的功效。\n花蕊与花茎彼此相异的色彩被认为是两种不同的月矩力的象征，然而霜盏花却是极为罕有的、不会受到月矩力任何影响的植物，因此有时也会被霜月之子的追随者们视为无信者与叛离者的象征。\n据说五百年前的漆黑灾厄结束时，这种造型奇异的花朵才出现在大地上，但这种说法从未得到过严谨的考证。
desc_en: A flower that resembles a candle lamp, commonly found near water. It emits a cold, simple aroma that has a calming effect.\nThe contrasting colors of its stamen and stem are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, yet despite this symbolism, it is one of the few rare plants that are immune to kuuvahki's influence. As a result, the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as a symbol of faithlessness and apostasy.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared at the end of the dark calamity five hundred years ago, but this claim has never been rigorously verified.

desc_chs: 双色缠络的花卉，有着极强的月矩力亲和性。由于香调淡雅、色泽显明，时常被认为是优质的天然染料。\n彼此相异的色彩被认为是两种不同的月矩力的象征，因此宿影花有时也会被霜月之子的追随者们视为月之少女的祝福。\n据说五百年前的漆黑灾厄结束后数十年，这种造型奇异的花朵才伴着咏月使的故去出现在大地上。霜月之子的诗歌大多采用这种说法，但这种说法从未得到过严谨的考证。
desc_en: A flower in two entwined colors with a strong affinity for kuuvahki. Its light fragrance and conspicuous color have made it an excellent natural dye.\nIts contrasting colors are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, so the followers of the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as the Moon Maiden's blessing.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared decades after the dark calamity ended five hundred years ago, a claim widely reflected in the verses of the Frostmoon Scions, though it has never been rigorously verified.

desc_chs: 如月光一般明净无瑕的银白晶体，具有几乎完美的元素亲和力。\n在霜月之子的传承中，这种晶石于五百年前伴随月之少女一同诞生，被彼时的咏月使认为是从月上落下的馈赠，因此得名「月落银」。然而在至冬的编年者们记述的、更为古老的文献中，黄金国的遗胤自数千年前便在使用霜月纺就的秘银。两者之间的关联早已无从考证，唯一能确定的只有这种晶石如今依然被挪德卡莱的工匠们视为绝佳的元素力导体。
desc_en: A silver crystal as pure and pristine as moonlight. It possesses almost perfect elemental affinity.\nIn the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, these crystals were born five hundred years ago alongside the Moon Maiden, and were believed by the Moonchanter at the time to be a gift from the moon, hence the name "Moonfall Silver". However, in older documents written by Snezhnayan chroniclers, the descendants of the golden realm were already using secret silver woven by the Frostmoon thousands of years in the past. The threads that connect these two tales are unclear — the only certain thing is that these crystals make excellent elemental conductors in the eyes of Nod-Krai's craftspeople.

desc_chs: 如珍珠般澄澈的白色果实，口感清润甘甜。\n在霜月之子的传说中，与月灵一样，白灵果也是月之少女的恩赐，受新月祝福的神圣象征，因此分享并食用美味的白灵果也是对库塔尔的虔敬。\n话虽如此，即便没有与神明相关的故事，如此饱满甜蜜的果实本身便也足以唤起人们的食欲了。
desc_en: A fruit as white as pearl that tastes refreshingly sweet.\nIn the legends of the Frostmoon Scions, these fruits, like kuuhenki, are a gift from the Moon Maiden, a sacred symbol blessed by the new moon. Therefore, sharing and eating delicious Lakkaberries is also a form of worshipping Kuutar.\nEven when not associated with the divine, their plumpness and sweetness alone are enough to awaken one's appetite.

desc_chs: 生长在挪德卡莱温暖地带的果实，深受过冬的动物与嘴馋的孩子们喜爱。\n在霜月之子的传承中，夏槲果被视为「生命」与「丰盈」的象征，因为只有在春夏温暖的日子里，这种果实才会开花生长。\n亦有「冬凌王」与「夏槲王」永恒斗争的逸话。传说两位孪生的君王伴着年轮的转动，交替杀死彼此、又交替从冥府重生，统治属于他们的时节，如此循环往复，直至世界终结。至冬的学者们普遍认为这只是原始信仰中对季节交替的隐喻，至少他们这样说服了自己。
desc_en: A fruit that grows in the warmer parts of Nod-Krai. It is beloved by animals emerging from winter and hungry children alike.\nIn the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, Midsommar Berries are regarded as a symbol of life and abundance, for they only flourish during the warmth of spring and summer.\nThere is a tale that tells of the endless struggle between the King of Winter Icelea and the King of Midsommar Oak — twin monarchs that slay each other as the seasons change, returning from the underworld to rule in turn until the end of time. Most Snezhnayan scholars dismiss this as a primitive religious metaphor for the alternating seasons — or at least that's what they tell themselves.

desc_chs: 生命力极其顽强的花草，即便历经风吹霜打，依旧在苦寒的冬日里迎风摇曳。
desc_en: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.

desc_chs: 古时覆盖挪德卡莱的参天巨木，流淌下的树脂凝结而成的宝石，散发着璀璨的色彩。
desc_en: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.

desc_chs: 清湛而明耀的苍色凝晶，蕴藏着极度纯净的月矩力，对各类元素力的亲和性也堪称完美。
desc_en: A clear, radiant azure crystal that holds an exceptionally pure form of kuuvahki. It possesses a near-perfect affinity with all types of elemental energy.

desc_chs: 瑰秀却不失清润的花朵，主要生长在蒙德北方。\n花香明澈悠长，是用来调香的主要原料之一。
desc_en: An exquisite flower that remains delicate and fresh, found primarily in the northern part of Mondstadt.\nIts fragrance is clear and enduring, making it one of the primary ingredients used in perfumery.

desc_chs: 闪耀着神圣金色光辉的奇异生命，如飞蛾般游曳在同样奇异的隙间。
desc_en: A singular entity bathed in a divine, golden radiance, drifting through uncanny interstices as if a moth in flight.

desc_chs: 不管风雪多么严苛亦会绽放的圣洁花朵，总是散发着微弱的令人向往的光芒。
desc_en: A sacred flower that blooms no matter how harsh the wind and snow. It always radiates a faint, mesmerizing glow that draws the hearts of all who see it.

desc_chs: 一度被怀疑是植物与动物结合后的奇妙植株，但后来被证明只不过是单纯长着类似动物绒毛的植物罢了。
desc_en: A peculiar plant once suspected to be a hybrid of plant and animal, though it was later proven to be nothing more than an ordinary plant covered in a coat of animal-like fuzz.

desc_chs: 边缘微微发出金光的蕨草，据说经过炖煮后，将会拥有非常奇妙的风味。
desc_en: A fern whose edges radiate a faint golden shimmer. It is said to take on a remarkably unique flavor when stewed.

desc_chs: 在寒冷冻土里也能生长的草本植物，为了能在严酷的环境里生存，生长出了肥大的肉质根。
desc_en: A hardy herbaceous plant capable of thriving even in frozen soil. To survive such an unforgiving environment, it develops a thick, succulent root.

desc_chs: 冻土上的臻冰受到特殊影响后结出来的星状果实，将其生长的枝条拆除后，果实即会落于雪上。
desc_en: A star-shaped fruit born from Prime Ice that has undergone a peculiar transformation in the permafrost. Once the branch it grows upon is removed, the fruit falls naturally onto the snow.

desc_chs: 花序接近球形的可爱花朵，雪落在花瓣上时，整朵花便会如同雪球一般。
desc_en: A charming flower with a spherical cluster of petals. When snow settles upon it, the entire bloom looks just like a tiny snowball.

desc_chs: 从霜结的冰枝之上，生长出来的风味丰富的浆果。
desc_en: A richly flavored berry that sprouts from frost-rimed, icy branches.

desc_chs: 受影域的力量影响而产生的奇怪萤石。
desc_en: A strange fluorite formed under the influence of the powers of the Shadow Realm.

desc_chs: 产自「桦树」的木材，易于加工，切面光滑，用这种木材制作的家具器物大多美观而耐用。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber obtained from birches. It is easy to work with and produces smooth cuts. Furniture made using such wood is both beautiful and durable.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「萃华树」的木材，色泽秀美，木质独特，经过适当的加工，能胜任各种用途。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber obtained from Cuihua Trees. With its lovely color and unique make, it will surely be able to take on myriad uses upon undergoing suitable workmanship.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「松树」的木材，色泽与木纹并不亮眼，但以朴实无华、低调素雅著称。且木质坚实，只需老练的木匠处理，就能耐受虫蛀和腐蚀。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber obtained from pines. Its color and grain are nothing to write home about, but its unpretentious nature is elegant in its own right. The wood is very sturdy as well. In able hands, its products should be able to resist moth and rot alike.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「却砂树」的木材，据说有着风雨不侵，百年不朽的卓越木质。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber from the Sandbearer Tree. Said to be an exceptionally hardy plant resistant to wind and rain with a long lifespan.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 翠竹的竹段，轻巧而结实，远比谦逊的外表坚韧，散发着独特的清幽气息。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Segments of bamboo that are light and far stronger than their humble appearance might suggest. It lets off a light fragrance.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: （test）能量木的木材，在拥有相应技能的工匠手中能绽放光采吧。\n可用于制作摆设。
产自「苍柏」的木材，因其富含油脂，香气别致，有着「垂香木」的别称。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood from the Cedar tree. Also known as the "Fragrant Cedar" for the aromatic oils it contains.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 「冷杉」出产的木材，有着不错的木质和纹理，被广泛使用于各种领域。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood from the tree known as "Faber's Fir." Widely used for its fine quality and attractive grain.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「樱树」的木材，质感细腻，富含水分，据说能为人们带来暖春般的美梦。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber obtained from Sakura Trees. Exquisite in quality and full of moisture, people say that it can lull people into dreams as sweet as the warm spring.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「羽扇枫」的木材，硬度适中，品质优异，色泽与纹理上佳。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber from the Amur Maple. Excellent quality wood with a fine color and texture.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 「柳杉」出产的木材，质地柔软，纹理平直，散发着浅淡的清香。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood from the Inazuman Cedar. It is soft, has straight veins, and gives off a light fragrance.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 「御伽树」出产的木材，水分和油脂的含量恰到好处，因此有着各种用途。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood from the Otogi Tree. It has just the right amount of moisture and oil, and as such has a great many uses.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「辉树」的木材，似乎有着与普通木材不同的构造，质地较软，但极为坚韧，易于染色，用途较为特别。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber from the Brightwood Tree. It seems to have different properties from ordinary wood — soft but extremely resilient, easy to dye, and can be used for special purposes. \nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 「业果树」出产的木材，只需简单的处理就能得到光滑的切面，无需精细加工就极为美观。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: The wood of the Karmaphala Tree. One can easily get a nice, smooth surface while working on this material and obtain a rather eye-pleasing result without going through any sophisticated processes.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「证悟树」的木材，几乎随处可见，看似平凡，实则有着轻便耐用的特点。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: The wood of the Adhigama Tree. Can be found everywhere and therefore appears rather ordinary, but the wood is durable and easy to handle.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 「刺葵树」出产的木材，虽然没有优秀的质感和纹理，但锁水能力极强，便于维护。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood of the Mountain Date Tree. Although it neither feels special to touch nor possesses a special texture, it retains water exceedingly well and is thus easy to grow.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「柽树」的木材，质地特别，能够同时抵抗干旱和潮湿，极耐衰损。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood of the Athel Tree. It has a special texture and is resilient to both drought and humidity, making it very durable.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「悬铃树」的木材，芯材坚韧，适合用于搭建房屋的地基和框架。边材也易于加工，制作各类美观的家具时，所需的人力相对较少。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood from the Mallow Tree. With a tough core, it is suitable for building the foundations and frames of houses. It is easy to craft and process, so it takes relatively less manual labor to produce beautiful furniture.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 「心叶椴」出产的木材，质地细腻，色泽较浅，精细处理时的木屑较少，常被用于雕刻精巧的工艺品，或是制作尺寸紧凑的木制机关部件。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood from the Linden Tree. With a smooth texture and light color, few wood chips are produced even during fine processing. Often carved into delicate handicrafts or used to make compact parts for wooden mechanisms.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「白梣树」的木材，强度极高，除了制作高强度的承力部件，还可以组合成坚韧的板材，用于加固墙体，或拼装成货运木箱等需要时常应对冲击的物件。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood from the Ash Tree. With its extremely high strength, it is not only used for making strong load-bearing components, but also for making sheets to be used as wall reinforcements, and for transportation crates subject to frequent shocks.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 「香柏树」出产的木材，有着边材较薄，芯材直径较大的优点。虽不如金属般坚实可靠，但需要制作较大面积的部件时，这种木材有着独特的优势。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood from the Cypress Tree. The core has a relatively large radius, with thinner sapwood. Though not solid or reliable as metal, the wood possesses unique advantages for buildings components with a large surface area.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「炬树」的木材，质地较软，易于切削，保持干燥的能力较强，与许多色泽亮丽的涂料相性极好，因此常被工匠们制作成各种精美的装饰品。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Wood from the Torch Tree. It has a soft texture, can be easily cut, stays dry easily, and the color is compatible with many bright paints. This makes it a common choice for artisans making delicate decorations.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「白栗栎树」的木材，硬度和韧性达成了较好的平衡，便于加工。虽说外观和其他木材并无太大差别，但经过纳塔各部族常用的方法处理后，木质颜色会变得较浅，接近白色，因此有了这一名字。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber obtained from White Chestnut Oak Trees. It strikes a balance between hardness and toughness, making it easy to process. Though it appears no different from most other wood, its color grows lighter once processed using methods common to the tribes of Natlan, becoming nearly white, hence the name.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「灰灰楼林树」的木材，有着较为轻便的优势，其余性能与大部分纳塔木材相差无几，成年的龙伙伴可以轻松搬运，传说也有部族战士将成捆的灰灰楼林木当成健身器材。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber obtained from Ashen Aratiku Trees. Other than being lighter, it isn't all that different from most regional trees in Natlan. Mature Saurian companions can carry it with ease, and some legends even tell of tribal warriors who use bundles of such timber as fitness gear.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「燃爆树」的木材，与名字不同，这种木材经过「沃陆之邦」推荐的方法处理后，不易燃不易爆，相当可靠。\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber obtained from Flammabomb trees. Unlike what their names suggest, such timber is resistant to catching fire or exploding once processed using methods recommended by the Collective of Plenty.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 产自「桃椰子树」的木材，正如其名，树皮有着椰子壳般的质感，打磨后光滑而美观，硬度和防潮性能都极为出色…\n可用于制作摆设。
desc_en: Timber from Peach Palm Trees. As the name suggests, the bark has the feel of coconut palm husks, and is both smooth and aesthetically pleasing once sanded and polished, with exceptional hardness and humidity-resistant qualities...\nCan be used to create furnishings.

desc_chs: 「银冷杉树」出产的木材，被人类运用的历史悠久，可以胜任小到木桶，大到建筑板材的各种需求…
desc_en: Wood harvested from the Silver Fir Tree. Humans have favored this type of wood since ancient times for its wide range of uses, from crafting barrels to constructing frameworks.

desc_chs: 产自「榛树」的木材，虽然来源的树种形态多样，但木材表层大多具有独特的成分，防虫防腐能力可观，极为耐用。
desc_en: Wood sourced from the Hazelnut Tree. Though the subspecies this wood comes from vary wildly in appearance, they mostly share the same unique compounds that offer excellent resistance to insects and decay, making it a remarkably durable material.

desc_chs: 产自「夏栎树」的木材，密度较低，韧性却相当不错，且有着不错的防水性能，因此常被用作水畔建筑…
desc_en: Wood sourced from the Pedunculate Oak Tree. While its density is relatively low, it boasts impressive toughness and water resistance, making it a common choice for buildings near bodies of water.

desc_chs: 「桤树」出产的木材，对于水汽和寒气有着可观的耐受性，亦是不错的家具和乐器原材…
desc_en: Wood from the Alder Tree. It demonstrates considerable resistance to moisture and cold, making it a fine raw material for both furniture and musical instruments.

desc_chs: 「雪杨」产出的木材，表层较为光滑，质地轻盈而柔软，用于制作各种小型木工品，是不错的选择…
desc_en: Wood from Snow Poplars that have smooth surfaces and light, soft textures. A fine choice for making all sorts of small woodworking products...

desc_chs: 「白桦」产出的木材，密度较高，韧性较强，可用于抗弯需求较强的建筑结构…
desc_en: Wood from White Birches that boasts high density and toughness. Used for building structures for which bending resistance is a necessity...

desc_chs: 「青榉」产出的木材，纹理较为均匀，能较好地抵抗磨损，在至冬常被用于制作多重板材，制作长时间使用的器物与建筑…
desc_en: Wood from Bluebeeches with even grain patterns and can better withstand wear and tear. In Snezhnaya, it is often used in layered panels involved in structures and implements for long-term use.

desc_chs: 「落叶松」产出的木材，硬度可观，耐腐蚀的能力也较强，常被至冬人用于建筑立柱和板材…
desc_en: Wood from Larches. They possess considerable hardness and are highly corrosion-proof. Snezhnayans often use it to build pillars and boards.

desc_chs: 蒙德城的大家都喜欢芭芭拉。「偶像」这个词是她从一本杂志里看到的。
desc_en: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.

desc_chs: 优质的布匹。制作摆设时应该能派上用场。
desc_en: Some fabric of fine make. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

desc_chs: 红色的染料。制作摆设时应该能派上用场。
desc_en: Red dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

desc_chs: 黄色的染料。制作摆设时应该能派上用场。
desc_en: Yellow dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

desc_chs: 蓝色的染料。制作摆设时应该能派上用场。
desc_en: Blue dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

desc_chs: 异国面容的剑斗士，西风骑士团的头脑派人物。
desc_en: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.
