desc_chs: 传说在过去，软弱短寿的凡人尚未渡海而来的时代里，稻妻曾是狸猫的国度。而人类的历史，最初亦是醉酒的狸猫趁兴胡诌出来的…鹮巷，历史与狂言交织之巷。
desc_en: They say that in the past, when the fragile and short-lived mortals had yet to cross over the sea unto these lands, Inazuma was once a land that belonged to the tanuki. They say, too, that human history began as drunken tanuki nonsense... Welcome to Toki Alley, a place where history and wild tales intertwine.

desc_chs: 大天狗者，乃凶残暴戾的自大狂也。酒后尤如是。——狸史氏评
desc_en: The great tengu are naught but brutal braggarts, and especially when drunk! — Tanuki Historical Commentary

desc_chs: 家母曾有教谕：美貌的女子多精通骗术。由是举一反三可得：美貌如月光般的女人，其真面目莫非狐妖，要么便是修为不浅化猫婆婆咯。——狸史氏评
desc_en: Mother once warned that a beautiful face can hide deceptive intentions. If she looks as lovely as the moonlight, she must either be a fox spirit, or some old bake-neko hag of significant power — Tanuki Historical Commentary

desc_chs: 俗语有言，招惹雨女哭泣者，必然招致无法解脱的悲哀。——狸史氏评
desc_en: They say that those who make the ameonna cry will bring inescapable sorrow upon themselves. —Tanuki Historical Commentary

desc_chs: 凡人之可悲，正在于其不自知。至于妖怪嘛，总是缺乏此种悲哀的烦恼。——狸史氏评
desc_en: The tragedy of mortals is to lack self-knowledge, and that of the youkai is the lack of any such tragic troubles. —Tanuki Historical Commentary

desc_chs: 遗憾的中场，其后或许接续着更有趣的故事？
desc_en: Will this middle section filled with regret lead to a more interesting story thereafter?

desc_chs: 从八重神子那里取得的通行证明，有此即可不受限制地进入天守阁并面见将军。\n听说此证明是为了应对紧急情况而制，不过八重神子似乎并没有用到它的机会。
desc_en: A pass permit you obtained from Yae Miko. With this, you can enter Tenshukaku without restrictions and meet the Raiden Shogun.\nYou heard that this was made for emergencies, but that Yae Miko seems to have never had a chance to use it.

desc_chs: 将粘稠的团子加入牛奶而制成的创意饮品，滋味甜美，口感绵密，尝过的客人都很喜爱。\n只不过毕竟加入了团子，喝得太多的话可能会影响食欲。
desc_en: A creative snack made by adding sticky dango to milk. It is sweet and has a dense mouthfeel. All the customers who have tried it love it.\nStill, it is dango that's been added in — drink too much and you might lose your appetite.

desc_chs: 从阿圆处得到的「洞天关牒」。似乎可以用来让同伴们在洞天中自由来去…\n获取此物品后，即可前往放置界面，邀请同伴入驻「尘歌壶」。
desc_en: A realm dispatch that you obtained from Tubby. It seems to be able to allow your companions to come and go in your realm as they please...\nAfter acquiring this item, you can invite companions to reside in your Serenitea Pot from the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: （test）旅行者暂借的留影机，用过要还的
似乎有某些特殊之处的绯樱绣球。
desc_en: A seemingly special Sakura Bloom.

name_chs: 生活在雷樱树旁的螃蟹
desc_chs: 生活在雷樱树旁的螃蟹。不知道到底有什么特殊之处…
desc_en: A crab that lives beside the Thunder Sakura. One wonders if it has any unique properties...

desc_chs: 新鲜的海草。看起来很适合用来做菜。
desc_en: Fresh Seagrass. It looks like it would make a good meal.

desc_chs: 新鲜的绯樱绣球。不知道朱莉会怎么用它来做菜…
desc_en: A fresh sakura bloom. One can't be sure how Julie is going to use it in her dish...

desc_chs: 新鲜的金鱼草，应该很适合用来做菜。
desc_en: Fresh snapdragon. It should be most suitable for cooking.

desc_chs: 新鲜的鸟蛋，应该很适合用来做菜。
desc_en: A fresh egg that should be most amenable to cooking.

name_en: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune: Prologue
desc_chs: 有关记忆的故事，总是与得而复失的瞬间相连。本书并非全然新作，而是名作《有乐斋六狐传》之改写
desc_en: Stories about memories are always closely intertwined with transience. This book is not all-new, but is an adaptation of "Urakusai's Chronicles of the Six Kitsune."

name_en: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (I)
desc_chs: 被称为「黑狐」阿达及其故事，本是《有乐斋六狐传》的第三章。由于笔者的特别偏爱，特别被提至第一个故事
desc_en: The story of the "Black Fox" Itaru was actually the third volume in the original "Urakusai's Chronicles of the Six Kitsune." It appears at the front of this edition due to the writer's personal preference.

name_en: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (II)
desc_chs: 本册讲述了「黑狐阿达」与「户隐的双鬼」之间的对决故事。该故事在《有乐斋六狐传》中不幸佚失，今幸而寻回，加以改编而成。
desc_en: This volume recounts the clash between "Black Fox Itaru" and the "Twin Oni of Tokaku." This tale was missing from the original text, but it was fortunately rediscovered at a later date. It is presented here in an edited form.

name_en: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (III)
desc_chs: 在五百年前的《有乐斋六狐传》中，叶山与阿优亦有独立的故事。但在此时，这对母女还要仰赖阿达的搭救。
desc_en: In the 500-year-old "Urakusai's Chronicles of the Six Kitsune," Youzan and Yui went on to have their own tales. But at this time, the mother-daughter pair are still reliant on Itaru to rescue them.

name_en: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (IV)
desc_chs: 《有乐斋六狐传》中最具张力的故事片段，据说乃是有乐斋大人自璃月归来所写。亦被笔者全文收录。
desc_en: This is the tensest tale of the series, said to have been written by Urakusai upon his return from Liyue. It is featured in full in this writer's adaptation.

desc_chs: 由幕府著名历史学者，名列「九条三笔头」的名臣九条道真所著的历史书籍，简要介绍了海祇岛的历史。
desc_en: Historical annals written by the famous Shogunate historian Kujou Michizane, who was known as one of the "The Three Kujou Dignitaries," or "The Great Calligrapher." It chronicles the history of Watatsumi Island in broad strokes.

desc_chs: 新锐轻小说《哈玛瓦兰战记》的前言，由于经营调整而单独成为一册！
desc_en: The prefaces of the new light novel "The Saga of Hamavaran," now combined into their own separate volume due to a business model adjustment!

desc_chs: 「怎会如此…」本是普通的须弥旅行学者，没想到却被分配了冷门课题，前往遥远的雷之国土…海岸之国的冒险，徐徐开启！
desc_en: "How could this happen..." An ordinary scholar from Sumeru is unexpectedly assigned an unpopular specialization and ordered to go forth to the land of thunder and lightning... The curtains slowly rise on an adventure in the nation of many shores!

desc_chs: 「『使鬼』？与家乡的『镇灵』差不多少吧？」怀着这样的疑惑，哈玛瓦兰与新来的旅伴攀谈起来…一场未尝预料的旅程，就此开端。
desc_en: "'Ghost-calling'? Is that the same as 'spirit-warding' back home?" With confusing questions swirling in his mind, Hamavaran begins to speak with his newfound traveling companion. An unexpected journey begins!

desc_chs: 逆转的星海中央，地表之下蔓延数百光年的战场…随着过于庞大的开头展开迅猛而来的新感觉侠客物语！就此开场！
desc_en: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse, light-centuries of war unfold down on the planet's surface... With this grandiose opening comes an all-new tale of gallantry!

desc_chs: 在逆转的星海中央，即便一场神话般的大战，对于「岸上」之人来说也不过沉寂中偶生的一丝涟漪…但对于涉身其中的战士，此即生命之全部！
desc_en: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse, no battle is legendary enough to be any more than a ripple in the silence for those who dwell upon the shore... But for the warriors in the thick of it, the war is all there is.

desc_chs: 逆转的星海中亦有着小小的碎片群岛，隔绝的碎片之上，亦存在着自己的历史、侠客与琐事…骏河幕府侠客谭，就此揭幕！
desc_en: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse lies a small chain of shattered isles, each of which has its own history, featuring tales heroic and trivial alike. This heroic tale is set in the time of the Suruga Shogunate.

desc_chs: 「所谓山贼，乃是战争之子女。」稻妻曾有如此名言…战乱年代，收割米粮亦是战争！《沉秋拾剑录》，第一剑，徐徐而出！
desc_en: There is a saying in Inazuma: "What are bandits but the children of war?" In times of tumult, even the harvest is a battlefield... See how this unfolds in the latest volume of "A Legend of Sword"!

desc_chs: 在逆转的星海中央，碎片之岸的一隅，似乎并不值得一书的小村，落难浪人与农民结成同盟，与山贼的大战一触即发——
desc_en: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse, in nondescript village in a remote corner of the shattered isles, a ronin who has fallen upon hard times forms an alliance with a group of farmers. A great battle with the bandits draws near...

desc_chs: 记载着「神樱大祓」相关信息的残破书卷。某页有看起来像神社留下的朱砂印。
desc_en: A tattered scroll containing information related to the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. Some pages seem to bear the cinnabar seal of some shrine.

desc_chs: 原本并不在此处生长的蘑菇，因为吸收了充足的特殊养分开始疯长。
desc_en: A mushroom that did not originally grow in this area, but began to grow with wild profusion after absorbing sufficient special nutrition.

desc_chs: 从旭东处得到的螃蟹诱饵，据说放下后会将螃蟹吸引过来。
desc_en: Crab bait that you got from Xudong. Laying it should attract crabs.

name_chs: 谁人的日志·其五·刃连岛
desc_chs: 某人遗落在野外的日志，描述了其人在刃连岛的不幸遭遇。
desc_en: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's unfortunate encounters at Jinren Island.

name_chs: 冒险家罗尔德的日志·离岛
name_en: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Ritou
desc_chs: 著名冒险家罗尔德留下的日志，纸张上残留着绯樱花瓣的清香与烟叶的苦涩。
desc_en: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages bear both the refreshing scent of sakura flowers and the bitterness of tobacco leaves.

desc_chs: 由八重神子所赠予的御守。\n「想我的时候也可以拿出来看看哦？」
desc_en: An omamori given to you by Yae Miko.\n"You can take this out and have a look whenever you think of me as well, you know?"

desc_chs: 从九条孝行处取得，据说除了将军和九条孝行本人外，无人可知其内容。上面印有九条家主的印章。
desc_en: Obtained from Kujou Takayuki. None are privy to these contents save him and the Shogun — or so they tell you. It has the seal of the Kujou Clan Head on it.

desc_chs: 从九条孝行处取得，内容有些暧昧晦涩，但不难看出部分内容是在与愚人众交换情报。
desc_en: Obtained from Kujou Takayuki. The contents are a bit ambiguous, but it isn't difficult to see that some of it involves an exchange of intelligence with the Fatui.

desc_chs: 「长野原烟花店」现任店长宵宫的得意之作，但似乎还是试做品…应该不会出事…的吧？
desc_en: Yoimiya's pride and joy as the current owner of Naganohara Fireworks. It still seems to be in an experimental state. Nothing's going to go wrong... right?

desc_chs: 航海日志中提到的特殊魔晶矿，外观与普通的魔晶矿并无二致，应该是某种特殊原因才让它成为吸引「海中月」的重要因素吧。
desc_en: The Special Magical Crystal Ore mentioned in the sailing log. It looks exactly the same as normal magical crystal ore, so there must be some other key factor that allows it to attract the Lunar Leviathan.

desc_chs: 雪山矿堆中遗留的矿渣。珍贵的部分被挑走，余下的部分则为渣，一钱不值，百无一用，这就是世人对渣的看法吧。否则为何不把它们也带走呢?
desc_en: Slag left behind amidst some ore on Dragonspine. The valuable portions have been taken away, and the rest is just worthless, useless dross — or at least, that's how people might be inclined to see it. They would have carried it off as well otherwise, right?

name_en: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (I)
desc_chs: 出生即被预言将要带来毁灭的公主陷入亡国的危机，此时一位不明真相的浮浪武士从天而降。\n战火纷飞的古风时代剧，二人的旅行，就此展开！
desc_en: The princess who was prophesied to bring destruction witnesses the imminent fall of her nation, and it is at this moment when a wandering warrior descends from the skies, ignorant of the truth.\nThe pair's journey amidst the fires of an ancient warring period are about to begin!

name_en: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (II)
desc_chs: 「所谓带来毁灭的公主，说到底不过是战争的借口罢了。」\n为了了解预言的真相，向着世界中心前进吧！\n超人气的浪漫冒险谭，仍在继续！
desc_en: "A princess who brings destruction. Hah. Isn't that just an excuse for making war?"\nThey travel to the center of the world in search of the truth behind the prophecy.\nThe super-popular romantic adventure continues!

name_en: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (III)
desc_chs: 踏入战争之地的二人，终于见识到了真正的阿鼻地狱。席卷世界的百年战火，其真相在此揭开！\n本卷随书附赠超值周边！
desc_en: The two, who have entered the field of battle, finally witness the true Avici. The truth behind the fires of war that have swept across the world will be revealed here!\nThis volume comes with some super value-added extras!

name_en: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (IV)
desc_chs: 「来自过去的亡灵，滚回地狱去吧！」\n激动人心的回忆篇！武士所封印的过去究竟是——\n失去国家的公主与武士，两人的冒险，迎来新章！
desc_en: "Go back to hell, you jumped-up vengeful spirit!"\nThe riveting flashback chapter! What lies within the warrior's buried past?\nHere comes a new chapter in the adventures of the princess who lost her nation and the warrior!

name_en: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (V)
desc_chs: 「需要牺牲你去拯救的世界，还不如毁灭算了。」\n终于抵达世界中心的空之塔，两人的故事，将要迎来终点……了吗？
desc_en: "If this world requires your sacrifice to be saved, then it might as well burn."\nHaving reached the Sky Tower at the heart of the world at last, is this... finally the end of the pair's tale?

name_en: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (VI)
desc_chs: 世界的真相终于揭晓，就像是彻底恶意的讽刺。分开的二人，仍然无法逃离命运的缠绕。\n《亡国的美奈姬》最终卷！但我们的故事并未完结！
desc_en: The truth of the world is revealed — and what a terrible joke it is! Even when separated, the two cannot escape the chains of fate.\nThis may be the final volume of "Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation," but our story isn't over yet!

name_chs: 菲谢尔皇女夜谭·第零卷
desc_chs: 本书系《菲谢尔皇女夜谭》系列的设定集。\n最初为原作紫黑木盒版之限量赠品，但由于内容丰富，印量极少，惹怒了大量跟随连载购书的铁杆书迷群体。\n不得已之下，八重堂将本作命名为「第零卷」单独发售。此后，原作、紫黑木盒收藏版与「第零卷」一同被核心向粉丝奉为圭臬。
desc_en: The preliminary volume of the "Flowers for Princess Fischl" series.\nThis work originally came in a violet and black wooden box as a limited edition gift, but many hardcore fans of the series who wanted to collect the whole saga were enraged by the great amount of content versus the small number of copies printed.\nDue to this, Yae Publishing House would name this book "Volume 0" and sell it separately. Eventually, the original work, the boxed collector's edition, and Volume 0 would all come to be regarded as standard by fans.

name_chs: 提瓦特游览指南·稻妻篇
desc_chs: 冒险家协会主办的旅行杂志，每一期都会介绍提瓦特大陆各地值得游览的景色。这一本登载了旅行家艾莉丝在稻妻的简短行记。
desc_en: A magazine by the Adventurers' Guild. Each issue introduces great sceneries across Teyvat. This issue includes a short traveling diary of Alice the Traveler in Inazuma.

desc_chs: 无意中钓上来的漂流瓶，瓶口的塞子已经出现了破损，内部的信件也染上了霉斑。多谢你及时发现了这个小东西，否则它用不了多久就得坠入时间尽头了。
desc_en: A floating bottle that you fished up accidentally. The cork on this bottle has already been damaged, and the letter within has been mildewed. Thankfully, you discovered it in time, or its contents may have become lost to time altogether.

desc_chs: 由八重堂的作家顺吉所著，是轻小说《鬼武道》的单行本，收录了故事最初的两大篇章。其连载版本质量参差不齐，但在读者中仍有着一定的人气。
desc_en: A standalone volume from the light novel series "Onibudou," written by Junkichi, a writer with Yae Publishing House. This collection contains the first two major arcs in the story. The quality of the serialized version varies quite a bit, but it still enjoys a degree of popularity amongst readers.

desc_chs: 曾在「一心净土」中发挥过至关重要作用的御守。\n按照八重神子的说法，「这可是兼具智慧与美貌的八重神子大人赠予我的」。
desc_en: An omamori that served a critical purpose within the Plane of Euthymia.\nAccording to Yae Miko, "This item was given to you by the lovely, sagacious Lady Yae Miko."

desc_chs: 托马赠给你的御守，据说能带来好运的庇佑。
desc_en: An omamori that Thoma gave you. It is said to be able to bring good luck.

desc_chs: 从盗宝团营地里拿到的一盒钉子，应该可以用于维修。
desc_en: A box of nails obtained from a Treasure Hoarder camp. You can use it for repairs.

desc_chs: 从盗宝团营地里拿到的木板。应该可以用于维修。
desc_en: Wooden planks obtained from a Treasure Hoarder camp. You can use them for repairs.

desc_chs: 从盗宝团营地里拿到的绳子。应该可以用于维修。
desc_en: Rope obtained from a Treasure Hoarder camp. You can use it for repairs.

desc_chs: （test）奶奶给的花
木户与木奈两人的香包。似乎是由两个小香包缝制在一起，被精心收藏在木盒之中。
desc_en: A sachet carried by Kito and Kina. It seems to have been woven from two smaller sachets before being carefully hidden in a wooden box.

desc_chs: 岻伽的哥哥留下的「藏宝图」碎片，由兽皮制成的纸张散发出淡淡的海盐气息。
desc_en: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

desc_chs: 岻伽的哥哥留下的「藏宝图」碎片，由兽皮制成的纸张散发出淡淡的海盐气息。
desc_en: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

desc_chs: 岻伽的哥哥留下的「藏宝图」碎片，由兽皮制成的纸张散发出淡淡的海盐气息。
desc_en: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

desc_chs: 岻伽的哥哥留下的「藏宝图」碎片，由兽皮制成的纸张散发出淡淡的海盐气息。
desc_en: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

name_en: A Treasure Map Left for Shitoki
desc_chs: 由碎片拼成的一整张藏宝图，散发着淡淡的海盐气息。
desc_en: A complete Treasure Map made from several fragments. It gives off a faint sea-salt scent.

desc_chs: 一个朴素结实的布袋，似乎不会被海水浸透。里面满是祖灵沉甸甸的祝福。
desc_en: A sturdy bag that seems seawater-proof. It's full of blessing from the ancestral spirits.

desc_chs: 常见于古代文明所留下的种种造物之中，似乎是保障它们运行的基础元件之一。由于「普尔希娜光钉」所使用的零部件材质与之类似，因此可以用它替换损坏的零部件。竟然要用如此珍贵的物品来维修，「普尔希娜光钉」的使用与维护代价实在高昂。
desc_en: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

desc_chs: 被锈蚀了的钥匙。不知道在这里放了多久…
desc_en: A rusted key. Who knows how long it has been here...

desc_chs: 入手感觉有些沉重的钥匙。不知道能用来开哪一扇门…
desc_en: A key that feels heavy in your hand. What door will it open?

desc_chs: 看上去还算完整的钥匙。不知道是被谁放在这里…
desc_en: A key that at least looks intact. One wonders who might have left it here...

desc_chs: 墨田交给你的信。\n把这封信交给离岛的阿釜。
desc_en: A letter given to you by Sumida.\nGive this letter to Kama in Ritou.

desc_chs: 宵宫研制的新型烟花。不知道放起来会是什么样…
desc_en: Yoimiya's new firework model. Who knows what it will do...

name_en: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (V)
desc_chs: 《新六狐传》中特意新增了对于旧事的评论，如读者读之烦闷，可特别略过本册。但对于笔者而言，不得不谈之事，不得不抒发之感慨，仍是要浪费笔墨言明的。
desc_en: Commentary regarding ancient matters that was specially added to the "New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune." If you find it an insipid, monotonous slog, dear reader, you may skip this volume. But as far as the author is concerned, this is one waste of words and emotion that cannot be avoided.

desc_chs: 一张印有北国银行标识的钱票，是用来兑换摩拉的凭证。
desc_en: A check with the emblem of the Northland Bank printed on it. It can be exchanged for Mora.

desc_chs: 胡乱排着几根线条的图纸，是藏宝图中的歪瓜劣枣。但要是对外宣称是某位意识流画家的大作，说不定能卖上不少摩拉。
desc_en: This is an awful specimen of a treasure map. Its lines are random and its grids scrawled. You could probably sell this for a significant amount of Mora by claiming that it is the work of some stream-of-consciousness artist, though.

desc_chs: 由木南杏奈亲手制作的「活力喵饭」。不知道寝子会不会喜欢…
desc_en: An Invigorating Kitty Meal made personally by Kiminami Anna. You're not certain if Neko will like it or not...

desc_chs: 鹤观文明的「石根文字」的载体。\n应当将其归还至逢岳之野的某处吧。
desc_en: An example of the Ishine Script that was once used on Tsurumi Island.\nIt probably needs to be returned to some place in the Autake Plains.

desc_chs: 常见于古代文明所留下的种种造物之中，似乎是保障它们运行的基础元件之一。由于「普尔希娜光钉」所使用的零部件材质与之类似，因此可以用它替换损坏的零部件。竟然要用如此珍贵的物品来维修，「普尔希娜光钉」的使用与维护代价实在高昂。
desc_en: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

desc_chs: 常见于古代文明所留下的种种造物之中，似乎是保障它们运行的基础元件之一。由于「普尔希娜光钉」所使用的零部件材质与之类似，因此可以用它替换损坏的零部件。竟然要用如此珍贵的物品来维修，「普尔希娜光钉」的使用与维护代价实在高昂。
desc_en: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

desc_chs: 常见于古代文明所留下的种种造物之中，似乎是保障它们运行的基础元件之一。由于「普尔希娜光钉」所使用的零部件材质与之类似，因此可以用它替换损坏的零部件。竟然要用如此珍贵的物品来维修，「普尔希娜光钉」的使用与维护代价实在高昂。
desc_en: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

name_en: A Preliminary Study of Sangonomiya Folk Belief
desc_chs: 须弥近代史家希哈布·普尔比鲁尼的论著，书写于稻妻内战之前两年。简述了海祇岛的珊瑚宫民间信仰，并提出了较新的学术主张
desc_en: This paper was written by Shihab Purbiruni, a scholar of modern history from Sumeru, two years before the civil war in Inazuma. It details the folk beliefs of Watatsumi Island and the Sangonomiya people, and puts forward some relatively new academic propositions.

name_en: The Life of Mouun the Shrine Maiden
desc_chs: 对于海祇之民而言，有关魔神战争的传说必然是苦涩的。在千年传唱的诸多岛歌中，有一位名为「曚云」的巫女，曾乘着庞大的海兽追随大蛇作战，留下了悲壮的名声。
desc_en: For the people of Watatsumi, the legends of the Archon War are always filled with bitterness. Many of these millennia-old folksongs tell of a shrine maiden by the name of Mouun, who once rode upon the back of a sea monster, following the Great Serpent unto a tragic, moving end.

name_en: Debates on the "Viceroy of the East"
desc_chs: 在海民的岛歌中流传的「东王」或「东山王」，在雷电的土地上则以「恶王」之名广泛流传。他是大蛇远吕羽氏册立的第一位藩王，也是最后一位。
desc_en: The "Viceroy of the East," or "Touzannou" sung of in Watatsumi folk tradition is also known as the "Akuou" all across Raiden's domains. He was the first vassal ruler of the Great Serpent Orobashi, and he was also the last.

name_en: Treasured Tales of the Chouken Shinkageuchi (I)
desc_chs: 稻妻传统小说的第一部分，此卷另有别名「真影打」，曾经一度是禁书。本卷讲述了初代雷电将军与其影武者的幻想故事。刻画了初代将军的仁政与影武者的勇武。但是因为通称《转生雷电将军》一书广受欢迎，大众对此类型的故事渴求了起来。这本书也因此阴差阳错得以出版。
desc_en: The first part of a traditional Inazuman novel. This particular volume is also known as "Shinkageuchi," and was once a restricted text. It contains a fantastical tale about the first Raiden Shogun and her kagemusha, depicting the benevolent sagacity of the first Shogun and the great valor of her kagemusha. However, due to the great popularity of another book known colloquially as "Raiden Reincarnation," many people became interested in stories of this kind. This book thus wound up being published in a haphazard manner.

desc_chs: 坐拥蒙德大半酒业的贵公子，财力、人望、能力都令人无法小觑。
desc_en: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

desc_chs: 似乎是鹤观文明的「石根文字」的载体。\n将这种石块归还至合适的地方吧。
desc_en: This object seems to carry the Ishine Script that was once used on Tsurumi Island.\nBring this stone back to its rightful place.

name_chs: 冒险家罗尔德的日志·鹤观
name_en: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Tsurumi Island
desc_chs: 著名冒险家罗尔德留下的日志，书页间残留着迷雾的潮气与菌类的清香。
desc_en: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages bear both the moist smell of the fog and a certain fungal scent.

desc_chs: 托马为流浪狗狗准备的食物，应该会很受欢迎。
desc_en: Food that Thoma has prepared for the stray cats and dogs. This should go like hotcakes.

desc_chs: 托马为流浪猫猫准备的食物，闻起来有淡淡的鱼腥味。
desc_en: Food that Thoma has prepared for the stray cats and dogs. A slightly fishy smell wafts off it.

desc_chs: 在南码头的仓库里找到的一批废弃物品，基本没有什么价值。
desc_en: A batch of abandoned goods that you found at a warehouse at the south wharf. They essentially have no value.

desc_chs: 凝光委托「明星斋」修复的梳子，它属于一位有些特殊的情报人。据说梳子原来的损伤很严重，能复原到现在的程度实属不易。
desc_en: The comb that Ningguang commissioned Mingxing Jewelry to repair. It belongs to a special informant. The damage to the comb was originally quite severe. The fact that it could be repaired to this extent is quite impressive indeed.

desc_chs: 从希娜小姐后援会那里收到的传单，上面的形象好像有些眼熟…
desc_en: A pamphlet you obtained from the Ms. Hina Fan Club. You've got to say that the design looks kind of familiar...

desc_chs: 由你为凝光安排的日程表，各项事务都已罗列在上，清晰易读。
desc_en: A schedule that you created for Ningguang. The various items are all laid out in a clear and easy-to-read manner.

desc_chs: 由你为凝光安排的日程表，简明扼要，毫无冗杂。
desc_en: A schedule that you created for Ningguang. Simple, cogent, and to the point.

desc_chs: 制作「千奇核心」的必要矿石之一，拥有和神之眼共鸣的力量。
desc_en: One of the ores required to create Wonder Cores. It has the power to resonate with Visions.

desc_chs: 制作「千奇核心」的必要矿石之一，多出现于晨昏交界之处。
desc_en: One of the ores required to create Wonder Cores. It can often be found where dawn meets dusk.

desc_chs: 群玉阁机械结构的核心，与仙家符箓结合后，可以用作群玉阁的控制中枢。
desc_en: The core component to the Jade Chamber's mechanisms. When combined with Adepti Sigils, they can be used as the control center of the Jade Chamber.

desc_chs: 申鹤所制仙家符箓，蕴藏着浓厚的仙家力量。
desc_en: Adepti Sigils made by Shenhe. They contain dense adeptal energy.

desc_chs: 通告村民迁居的文书，记录了村庄因为魔神残骸而被迫搬迁的事情。
desc_en: Documents announcing the villagers' migration. It states that the village was forced to relocate due to a god's remains.

desc_chs: 从村庄中找到的残破笔记，记录了一些被岁月掩埋的旧人旧事。
desc_en: A ragged notebook you found in the village. It records the happenings of long ago, now buried by the passage of time.

desc_chs: 记录了天衡山各种奇石传说，其中包含许多稀有的矿石。据说站在天衡山南部的湖中心，在黄昏之时沿着日落方向去寻找，就能找到传说中的秘华石。
desc_en: This text contains all manner of strange legends about Mt. Tianheng's stones, including tales about many rare ores. It is said that if you stand in the middle of the lake south of Mt. Tianheng at dusk, you will find the legendary Subrosium.

desc_chs: 这封信的纸张微微发硬，油墨也有些晕染开，看来它与它的主人遭遇过同样的浪潮袭击。只可惜经历相似，命运却不尽相同。
desc_en: The paper of this letter is slightly brittle and its ink is also a little smudged. It seems that both it and its owner have borne the assault of the waves. Unfortunately, while they encountered the same tribulations, they did not share the same fate.

desc_chs: 塞着小蒙烦恼的漂流瓶，不知道里面到底写着什么内容…
desc_en: A bottle containing Little Meng's various troubles. You wonder what's inside...

desc_chs: 从层岩巨渊的地下开采出的珍奇矿石，据说是具有「触媒」的作用。\n处在幽暗的矿道中时，似乎会发出耀眼的光，但一旦离开了层岩巨渊的地下矿道就会失去作用。\n似乎还有其他的神奇特性尚未被发现。
desc_en: A special stone mined from the depths of The Chasm. It is said that it has catalytic properties.\nIt almost blazes with light in the gloomy mines, but it loses all such effects the moment one leaves The Chasm.\nIt seems to have other unique properties as well that have yet to be discovered.

desc_chs: 从总务司专员沐宁处获得的字条，短短数行字中出现了8次「严禁」这个词。如果向一位名叫志琼的冒险家出示，就会获得帮助。
desc_en: The Ministry representative Muning gave you this note. Despite its short length, the word "prohibited" appears 8 times. If you give this to an adventurer named Zhiqiong, you will receive the aid you need.

desc_chs: 地图的碎块，似乎出自一张完整的藏宝图。\n如果能够寻得另一块的话，大概就能拼成完整的一张吧。
desc_en: A fragment of a larger map that seems to indicate the location of treasure.\nIf you can find the other fragment, that should complete the picture.

desc_chs: 被盗宝团撕成两半分别藏匿的藏宝图，如今合二为一。\n追随其上的标记，或许能发现不得了的宝藏？
desc_en: This treasure map, once torn in two and kept in different hiding spots by the Treasure Hoarders, is now whole again.\nIf you follow the symbol on it, you might discover some special treasure!

desc_chs: 一把库房的钥匙，藏在很显眼的地方，并且没有被找到，盗宝团的业务能力可见一斑。
desc_en: A key to a certain storehouse that was hidden in a very obvious place, yet was never found by the Treasure Hoarders. Guess they're not as good at their job as they think, huh?

desc_chs: 另一把库房的钥匙，藏在非常显眼的地方，并且没有被找到，可见盗宝团的业务能力有待锻炼。
desc_en: A key to a certain storehouse that was hidden in an incredibly obvious place, yet was never found by the Treasure Hoarders. They should probably go back to Hoarder school.

desc_chs: 「开山炮」，或「安全距离爆破机关·贰壹伍陆型」的炮弹，虽然用流明石「触媒」清理了上面的不明污物，但是还散发着令人不悦的气息，捏住鼻子也能闻到。\n真不想碰它！
desc_en: Cannonballs for the Mountainator, also known as the Safe Blasting Mechanism 2156. Although you used the Lumenstone Adjuvant to clear the unknown pollutants away, there is still a stench about them that can be detected even while covering your nose.\nUgh. Do you really have to touch it?

desc_chs: 根据克里托夫的配方制造的危险油膏，由两份磐石精油浓缩精炼制成，含有过量岩元素。\n以其极不稳定的性质而知名，只有疯子和最老练的矿工才会使用它，所以并不是很常见。\n一定要轻拿轻放！
desc_en: A dangerous substance made using the formula that Clitopho provided by compressing two Unmoving Essential Oils into one very dense bottle filled with Geo elemental energy.\nDue to its fame as a highly unstable concoction, only madmen or experienced miners would dare use it, making it an uncommon sight indeed.\nHandle with utmost care!

desc_chs: 经海迪夫的初步鉴定，这枚构装物或许是能够开启某处遗迹大门的「钥匙」。
desc_en: According to Khedive's initial speculations, this construct may be a "key" that could open the door to some ruin somewhere.

desc_chs: 在层岩巨渊拍摄下来的，偶尔可在墙壁上见到的奇怪岩石照片。岩石上的纹路不知道有什么含义，说不定对于那些学者来说有很高的研究价值。
desc_en: You took this picture of a strange rock that can be seen on the walls of The Chasm. You do not know what the patterns on the rock mean, but perhaps it could be of value to some researchers.

desc_chs: 精心写就的信，封蜡上面是「生态学者海迪夫·普尔希纳」的徽记。\n从海迪夫处获得的报酬，据他所说比黄金还宝贵，可以获得普尔比鲁尼一门的帮助。\n海迪夫个人认为用金钱作为报酬是一种侮辱，但愿这并不是须弥人的普遍想法。
desc_en: This letter, carefully crafted, is sealed in the name of "Ecologist Khedive Pursina."\nYou got this as a gift from Khedive. He claims that this is even more precious than gold, and can gain you the help of the House of Purbiruni.\nKhedive himself believes monetary remuneration to be something of an insult... Hopefully, this doesn't prove to be a trend with people from Sumeru.

desc_chs: 来自深渊的敌人留下的奇异宝珠。注视其中，仿佛能望见隐藏雾中的悠久之梦。
desc_en: A strange gem left behind by a foe from the Abyss. If you look into it hard, it is almost as if you are looking into a long-borne dream shrouded by a deep fog.

desc_chs: 一柄铁制的钥匙，千百年的风霜在其上留下了锈蚀痕迹。
desc_en: A key wrought of metal that has been worn down with rust accumulated over many years.

desc_chs: 矿井中常见的钥匙，不知为何会出现在这里。
desc_en: Such keys are commonly found in the mines, but one wonders why it would appear here.

desc_chs: 从赞玛兰处得到的可疑物品，据说可以清除邪气源头的问题。其中似乎凝聚了庞大真菌吸收的养分、团聚而成的孢子…以及浓厚如浆的幽默感。
desc_en: A suspicious object you obtained from Xamaran. It is claimed that this can clear the source of the foul energy. Condensed from the fungus' absorbed nutrients, the agglomeration of spores... and a thick sense of humor.

name_chs: 装有引信的「开山炮」炮弹
desc_chs: 精心安装好引信的炮弹，随时可以击发。
desc_en: A cannonball with a fuse carefully attached. Ready to be fired at any time!

desc_chs: 矿工戚定的女儿的玩具。看上去已经破破烂烂，很难想象会有小孩喜欢。不过从精心缝制的针脚上依旧能够看出，当初购买的时候一定价格不菲。
desc_en: A toy belonging to miner Qi Ding's daughter. It looks pretty tattered and it's hard to imagine that any kid would like it. But the intricate stitch-work shows that this was once quite the pricey item.

desc_chs: 传说中散落在层岩巨渊的六件供物之一？不…好像只是普通的清心，似乎刚刚生长出来，白色的花瓣尚沾着朝露。\n不知曾经有过多少人同样爬至高处，采摘这样新鲜的花朵。不知这些花朵最终见证了离别，还是重聚。
desc_en: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm... possibly? It seems just like an ordinary Qingxin, and one that has newly sprouted as well, seeing as how its white petals have never been touched by dew.\nWho knows how many people have once climbed up to high heights to pick one such fresh flower? Who knows if these flowers eventually bore witness to partings or reunions?

desc_chs: 传说中散落在层岩巨渊的六件供物之一，掠过洞窟顶端的苍鹰落下的飞羽。千岩军似乎很喜欢收集这些坚硬的羽毛作为装饰。\n传说鹰翎最配勇士，因此，这种翎羽总会成为最勇猛的军士的佩饰，再次以不输高天之上的迅捷，长驱敌阵。
desc_en: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm, a feather that fell from an eagle that flew over the top of the cavern. The Millelith seem to enjoy collecting these tough feathers to use as ornaments.\nIt is said that eagle feathers fit valiant warriors best, and so tend to be used to decorate the armor and arms of the bravest, such that they might break the enemy formation with all the swiftness of that great bird of prey.

desc_chs: 传说中散落在层岩巨渊的六件供物之一，已经略显老旧，但刻度依旧清晰，想必现在也能使用。\n虽然巨渊之下难见天日，就连时间的流逝都会被稀释，但是总有一天，日晷会重新开始记录岁月的印痕。
desc_en: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. It seems quite old now, but the etchings are still very clear, and so it can still be used.\nThe sun is a rare sight down in The Chasm, and it is easy to lose track of time. But someday, this sundial will once again track the passage of years.

desc_chs: 传说中散落在层岩巨渊的六件供物之一，非石非玉，不幸成为盗宝团的战利品。\n曾经落入贼人之手的它，盛放过美酒，财宝与鲜血。如今洗去了耻辱，开始承载一段新的记忆。
desc_en: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. Neither stone nor gem, it somehow still became part of the Treasure Hoarders' loot hoard.\nIt has been filled by turns with fine wine, fair treasure, and blood. Now, its previous shame has been washed away, and it is ready to take on new memories.

desc_chs: 传说中散落在层岩巨渊的六件供物之一，藏匿于矿工们的居所之中。如果不仔细分辨的话，很容易被当成常见的矿工用帽。\n周身遍布擦刮痕迹，不知它在过去曾经庇佑过多少矿工的安全。
desc_en: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. It was found hidden in the living quarters of the miners. A slightly less discerning eye might have mistaken it for a miner's hat.\nIt is heavily scarred and pitted, making one wonder how many miners' lives it must have saved.

desc_chs: 传说中散落在层岩巨渊的六件供物之一，散落在五百年前的古战场上。也许因为历时太久，枪尖已经不再锋利，但是仍旧寒气逼人。\n想必它曾经也在勇士手中如银龙出水，横扫层岩，所过之处，一度遍是年轻人们的欢声。
desc_en: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. It was lost amid the ancient battlefield five hundred years ago. The long years have worn the edge of the spear-point away, but it still looks quite ominous nonetheless.\nOne can imagine that it was once wielded by a warrior most brave, earning the cheers of the young wherever it swept, even unto The Chasm itself.

desc_chs: 从「大黄金盗宝鼬」处夺得的一枚戒指，亮闪闪呀，亮闪闪，大概盗宝鼬想用它吸引配偶吧。看上去就价值不菲的戒指！想必它的主人应当非常焦急。
desc_en: A ring that you got off a Golden Weasel Thief. See how it glitters, see how it shines! The Weasel Thief must have planned on using it to attract a mate, and it does indeed look quite valuable. One imagines that its owner must be quite distressed at the moment.

desc_chs: 从层岩巨渊开采出的稀有矿石。\n这种石头仅存在于极古老的山脉之中。或许是太过罕见的关系，许多商人甚至没听说过它。\n但近来由于层岩巨渊地下的异变，质量较为低下的老石多有出现，令辉山厅的矿石商人们颇为头疼。
desc_en: A strange, rare ore that was mined from The Chasm.\nThese rocks can only be found in the ore veins of the oldest mountains. It is so rare that most merchants have probably never heard of it.\nHowever, the changes in The Chasm have led to the emergence of much low-quality Archaic Stone, a fact that has given the merchants of Huishan Hall quite the headache.

desc_chs: 看起来已经干枯的物体，以常识来判断应当是种子，但是似乎蕴含着不可小觑的生命力量。\n所以暂时还是先别吃了吧…
desc_en: A seemingly withered object that seems to, by normal judgment, be a seed. However, it still has a surprising amount of life in it yet.\nBest not to eat it for now...

desc_chs: 流明石的璞矿，稍加雕琢的话似乎可以用来增强手中的流明石「触媒」，不如去找瑾武咨询看看…
desc_en: The raw ore from which Lumenstone may be found. If processed properly, it can be used to strengthen the Lumenstone Adjuvant you have. Why not hit Jinwu up and ask her?

desc_chs: 里面装有岳川回信的漂流瓶。不知道能不能顺利被小蒙捡到…
desc_en: A drifting bottle that contains Yue Chuan's reply to Little Meng. You wonder if it'll reach him...

desc_chs: 十分新鲜的豆乳，如果储存不善，品质很快就会下降。
desc_en: Fresh soy milk. It'll go bad quick if improperly stored.

desc_chs: 从愚人众身上获得的金属钥匙，应该可以打开某扇大门。
desc_en: A metal key that you obtained from the Fatui. It should be able to open some kind of door.

desc_chs: 刚摘下来的嘟嘟莲，很适合做成标本。
desc_en: A freshly-picked Calla Lily. Suitable for being used as a specimen.

desc_chs: 刚摘下来的小灯草，很适合做成标本。
desc_en: A freshly-picked Small Lamp Grass. Suitable for being used as a specimen.

desc_chs: 刚摘下来的塞西莉亚花，还散发着花香。
desc_en: A freshly-picked Cecilia with a pleasant fragrance.

desc_chs: 遗迹守卫的核心部位。古代制式和近代制式不复相同，不能拿去强化其他东西。不过残余的能量应该还是可以启动一台遗迹守卫的。
desc_en: The core section of a Ruin Guard. Old and new versions of this device are incompatible, and it thus cannot be used to empower other objects. However, the leftover energy should be enough to power one Ruin Guard.

desc_chs: 伊达的钥匙。很可惜开不了渊下宫望族家的金库门，只能打开「反本格派」的迷宫之路。
desc_en: Date's key. Unfortunately, this will not open the treasury of a distinguished Enkanomiya family. It will only open the way to the Heterodoxa labyrinth.

desc_chs: 堆放在地上的堇瓜，可能是由某种动物搜集到此处，远处看起来有点像是鬼兜虫。
desc_en: This pile of Lavender Melons may have been collected and placed here by some kind of animal. They look a bit like Onikabuto from a distance.

desc_chs: 从王平安处取得的香。据说品质不错。
desc_en: Incense you got from Wang Ping'an. Looks to be of good quality.

desc_chs: (test)黑夜植物
从层岩巨渊深处获得的不明构装物，看起来仿佛一个精巧的「魔方」。
desc_en: An unknown construct that you discovered in the depths of The Chasm. It resembles an intricately-made cube.

desc_chs: 在稻妻城里行走时，不知道被谁塞在身上的纸片，上面画着两个奇怪的记号。
desc_en: As you were walking down the streets of Inazuma, someone stuffed this note onto your person. Two strange symbols are drawn on it.

desc_chs: 被百代撒上特制元素粉末的竹签，要小心保管，轻拿轻放。毕竟元素粉末有一定毒性，而且毛手毛脚也会遭到无情的呵斥。
desc_en: A Bamboo Slip upon which Momoyo has applied some specially made elemental powder. Store and handle it with care! The powder has some measure of poison in it — and of course, you'll get yelled at for improper handling.

desc_chs: 从柳达希卡手里得到的愚人众行动指令，详细叙述了接下来要在海祇岛上执行的任务。由于事关民众的安危，这张纸上的情报尤为重要。
desc_en: Fatui operational orders that you obtained from Lyudochka. They detail an operation that will take place in the future on Watatsumi Island. This intelligence is very important — peoples' lives are at stake here!

desc_chs: 装着柳达希卡愚人众队服的纸包。考虑到愚人众身份的敏感性，这件衣服还是不要轻易让其他人看到为好。
desc_en: A bag that contains Lyudochka's Fatui uniform. Considering the controversial nature of Fatui uniforms, it is best not to let other people see this.

desc_chs: 昭明今日运势的特制纸签，本质上与其他「御神签」没有区别，不过这一张却是用假的竹签换来的。\n「御神签」上书写的签文，究竟预示着谁的命运呢？
desc_en: A specially made fortune slip that describes how your luck will be like today. There is nothing different about this Fortune Slip, save for the fact that you got it for the fake Bamboo Slip.\nWhose fortune does this Fortune Slip describe?

desc_chs: 从层岩巨渊的地下水域钓上来的奇怪物件，湿漉漉的，看不出是活物还是死物。
desc_en: A strange item that you fished up from the underground waterways in The Chasm. It's wet, and you cannot tell if this is a living or dead thing.

desc_chs: 志琼速写的简略示意图，标示了矿坑地面上几处「磐键」的大体位置。
desc_en: A simple diagram that Zhiqiong drew in haste. It indicates the general locations of several Bedrock Keys.

desc_chs: 从宝箱里找到的摩拉袋。在感受到它重量的瞬间，也同时感受到了失望。
desc_en: A Mora purse you found in a treasure chest. The feeling you had when weighing it was one of immense disappointment.

desc_chs: 从宝箱里找到的摩拉袋。相比起之前找到的摩拉袋，它的重量要令人安心许多。
desc_en: A Mora purse you found in a treasure chest. Compared to the previous purse you found, this one provides a decent amount more comfort.

desc_chs: 刚刚从河中获得的鱼肉，堪称自然的馈赠。如此优秀的食材只需烧烤一番便能美味无比。
desc_en: A fish you just obtained from the river. It might be considered a gift from nature. It is so excellent that it only needs to be grilled a little to be delicious as can be.

desc_chs: 字迹娟秀的留信
desc_en: Beautifully-Written Note

desc_chs: 云堇写给诗筠的亲笔信，似乎是扭转局面的关键？
desc_en: A letter that Yun Jin personally wrote to Shiyun. It seems to hold the key to turning the situation around.

desc_chs: 柳达希卡让八重堂员工转交给你的信，你能从信中找到她不辞而别的理由。不过，是否接受这个理由，就是另一回事了。\n是你发现了她的存在，改变了她的命运…你或许还能做到更多事，比如一个让所有人都幸福的结局？
desc_en: The letter that Lyudochka asked someone from Yae Publishing House to pass on to you. It contains her reasons for leaving without saying why. However, whether you will accept her reasons for departing or not is a different story.\nIt was you who discovered her presence and changed her fate... Might you be able to do still more to change this ending for the better?

desc_chs: 柳达希卡留下的摩拉袋，里面应该装着不少钱，不过就连派蒙都不打算接受它。
desc_en: The Mora purse that Lyudochka left behind. It contains a decent sum of Mora, but even Paimon doesn't want to use it.

desc_chs: 由某位永远睡不醒的终末番成员记录的「愚人众暗语表」。\n阅读它的时候，你除了能得知「愚人众说话真的很奇怪」之外，还能够感受到记录员浓浓的睡意，以口水的形式力透纸背。
desc_en: A certain ever-somnolent member of the Shuumatsuban wrote this Fatui Code Sheet.\nReading it does not merely let you know that "these Fatui speak very oddly indeed" — you can also feel the recorder's intense lethargy penetrating the paper in the form of saliva.

desc_chs: 从莫娜那里拿到的钱袋，里面装着莫娜用来付房租的钱。
desc_en: A purse you got from Mona. It contains the amount she needs to pay her rent.

desc_chs: 从玛乔丽小姐那里拿到的礼物，据说小朋友会很喜欢…
desc_en: A present that you got from Marjorie. You've heard that children will like it...

desc_chs: 从维克多那里拿到的礼物。他似乎还在礼物盒底下放了一封信…
desc_en: A gift you got from Viktor. He seems to have also put a letter under the gift box.

desc_chs: 舒特所采的新鲜钩钩果，所幸没有被魔物弄坏。
desc_en: Fresh Wolfhooks that Schuster picked. Thankfully, they haven't been damaged by monsters yet.

desc_chs: 昭明今日运势的特制纸签，本质上与其他「御神签」没有区别，不过这一张却是让柳达希卡敞开心扉的钥匙。\n签文再次回到了手中时，也包含了她真诚的祝福。如果有时间的话，就去鸣神大社看看她吧。
desc_en: A specially made fortune slip that describes how your luck will be like today. There is nothing different about this Fortune Slip, save for the fact that you used it to open Lyudochka's heart.\nNow, this Fortune Slip has returned to your hands, along with her heartfelt blessings. If you've got the time, why not go to the Grand Narukami Shrine to see her?

name_en: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku
desc_chs: 取材自海祇岛民间故事的小说。最早版本乃是蛇神尚在人世之时，有鸣神岛的商人前往海祇岛誊抄转写带回的。如今已是没人看的古典名著，被市面上的轻小说埋没了。本书描写了海祇岛人在接纳鸣神文化之前的独特宇宙观。因为最近传统小说再出版的风潮，得以再次问世。
desc_en: A novel based on Watatsumi Island's folktales. The original edition of this text was transcribed on Watatsumi Island and brought back to Narukami Island by a merchant while the former's serpent god yet lived. No one reads this ancient tome nowadays, its role supplanted by all the light novels on the market. This book describes the unique cosmological outlook of the Watatsumi people before they came to adopt aspects of Narukami culture, and a recent resurgence in traditional novel publishing has allowed it to see the light of day once more.

desc_chs: 禁止一般人接触的编年史，写法混杂了寓言和纪年。从开天辟地写到了大日御舆落成。
desc_en: A chronicle that ordinary folk have been forbidden to read. The writing is a mix of fables and histories from the beginning of the world to the creation of the Dainichi Mikoshi.

desc_chs: 记载了白夜国地理和水文的工具类图书。随着海渊的封门以及海祇民的集体移居，再加上漫长时光的变动，这本书已经没用了。
desc_en: This text records the geography and hydrology of Byakuyakoku. With the sealing of the depths and the emigration of the people of Watatsumi, as well as the passing of long years, this book is now useless.

desc_chs: 深海龙蜥的实验记录。实验中并没有龙蜥死亡。
desc_en: Experimental Records of the Bathysmal Vishaps. No vishaps were killed in the writing of these records.

name_en: In the Light, Beneath the Shadow
desc_chs: 面向九岁到十二岁年龄段的益智类图书。作为特殊过渡时期的版本，下附了古代白夜国姓名的鸣神式改称法。
desc_en: A puzzle book for children of ages nine to twelve. As a book from a transitory period, it uses Narukami-style names with Byakuyakoku subscripts.

name_en: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
desc_chs: 「十分正统的轻小说故事，是根据提瓦特现实世界做的合理改编。令人意外的是，作者似乎对海祇岛也有着非常广泛的了解，许多描绘都栩栩如生。」——希娜小姐
desc_en: "This is a rather orthodox light novel, with its contents essentially being an edited version of real life in Teyvat. What is surprising, however, is that the author seems to be highly knowledgeable about Watatsumi Island, with many vivid, almost lifelike descriptions." — Ms. Hina

name_en: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
desc_chs: 「以校园生活为主的轻小说，生动描写了各种学园怪咖们的故事，读来十分有趣。」——希娜小姐
desc_en: "This light novel is based on school life and depicts the antics of all manner of schoolyard oddballs. A very entertaining read." — Ms. Hina

name_en: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
desc_chs: 「天马行空的故事，刚刚读的时候有些摸不着头脑，不过越读越觉得新奇，许多地方让人忍俊不禁。我非常喜欢。」——希娜小姐
desc_en: "This story is quite wild and can be almost disorienting to read initially, but its wonderment grows on you, and it contains many a moment of gut-busting laughter. I liked it very much." — Ms. Hina

name_en: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
desc_chs: 「许多种风格交融在一起，感觉能从薄薄的一本书中体验到很多故事，想必书的作者也是一位非常有趣的人吧。碰巧我也认识这样的一个人，所以读的时候感到十分亲切。」——希娜小姐
desc_en: "By blending many styles together, this seemingly thin book transports you into a great many tales. I can only imagine that its author must also be a very interesting person. I happen to know someone like that, in fact — something that lends this book a very familiar touch." — Ms. Hina

desc_chs: （test）渊下宫水晶能量
从总务司专员沐宁处获得的字条，短短数行字中出现了8次「严禁」这个词。如果向一位名叫志琼的冒险家出示，就会获得帮助。
desc_en: The Ministry representative Muning gave you this note. Despite its short length, the word "prohibited" appears 8 times. If you give this to an adventurer named Zhiqiong, you will receive the aid you need.

desc_chs:
产于层岩巨渊深处的琉璃晶块，这枚特殊的琉璃晶砂矿石是在与神秘机械巨虺的鏖战中崩飞的碎块之一。琉璃晶砂矿石在层岩巨渊本为特产凡物，但这一枚却与众不同。
在湛蓝晶石的辐射与深渊力量的双重影响下，其上似乎生出了一圈圈奇特的旋涡纹路，触感冰冷，令人毛骨悚然。
自天穹而下的强力与从地渊盘桓而上的瘴气，将原本温润的晶砂塑成如此形状。恍若对凡人的警告。
既然无心的天地能够将金石扭曲至此，假如那位平凡的勇者确有机会见证漆黑深处的终点，又会如何面对她所发现的一切呢…？
desc_en:
A glaze crystal produced in the depths of The Chasm, this special Glaze Sand Crystal ore was one of many scattered about during the battle against the giant ruin machine. Glaze Sand Crystal ore is a regional specialty of The Chasm, but this one is different from the rest.
Under the radiance of the blue crystal and the power of the Abyss, a strange spiral pattern has emerged within this stone, and it is cold, almost chilling to the touch.
This once smooth crystal has been transformed into this shape by the great might that descended from the heavens and the miasma that arose from the earth's depths — and perhaps the form it has taken is itself a warning unto mortals.
If the interaction of these forces alone could twist stone and metal thus, if that ordinary heroine was truly able to witness the end of the pitch-dark path, how would she have faced the discovery she would make?

desc_chs: 受到渊下宫常世大神的认可，获授的印记。\n用来供奉给御使雕像，提升睦疏之匣的等级。
desc_en: A mark symbolizing the recognition of Enkanomiya's Tokoyo Ookami.\nThey can be offered up to the Statue of the Vassals of Watatsumi, thus upgrading the Bokuso Box.

desc_chs: 在黑雾笼罩的渊下宫调查探索时，找到了奇特石头。\n为了对抗深渊，光界给人类提供了额外的帮助。
desc_en: You discovered this mysterious stone while exploring the darkened realm of Enkanomiya.\nThe Light Realm gave humans additional means to resist the Abyss.

desc_chs: 沾染血迹与污泥的愚人众士官徽记，不知为何遗落在层岩巨渊深处。
desc_en: The bloodied and muddied insignia of a Fatui sergeant. You have no idea how it ended up in the depths of The Chasm.

desc_chs: 尼古拉下士遗留的笔记，内容早已残缺不全。
desc_en: A letter left behind by Kapral Nikolay. Its contents have long ceased to be whole.

desc_chs: 愚人众成员尼古拉下士遗留的日志残片，散发着让人不悦的气息，但总是要好过被污泥掩盖。
desc_en: A fragment of Fatui Kapral Nikolay's diary. It gives off a rather unpleasant smell, but that's at least better than being covered in mud.

desc_chs: 受飞云商会的阿旭所托，需要交付给辉山厅驻层岩巨渊专员沐宁。沉甸甸的，里面应当有不少摩拉。
desc_en: You were asked by Xu from Feiyun Commerce Guild to deliver this to Huishan Hall's representative Muning, who is at The Chasm. It contains a rather sizable sum of Mora.

name_en: A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits
desc_chs: 稻妻最近流行的轻小说，里面详细的讲述了各种古代妖怪们的奇闻轶事。
desc_en: A light novel that has been popular in Inazuma lately. It contains all manner of bizarre tales involving ancient youkai.

desc_chs:
在离开雷电真的意识空间之前，你手中握住的一瓣樱花。
它的存在如谜，虽然模样和普通的樱花瓣别无二致，也像正常物体一样安静地躺在行囊之中，但你已无法再触碰到它，也感受不到它的重量与温度。当物体缺少了令人习以为常的基本属性，又应该怎么证明它确实「存在」呢？
回想在得到它之前目睹的诸多景象，你产生了猜想：维系这瓣樱花在此世留存的力量，是源于谁人的意志。但这个人究竟是谁，是有意还是无心，无法确定；这份意志是怀念，还是信任或感激，亦无法验证。
或许在「谁人的意志」变化的那一刻，这瓣樱花也会跟着消失。
还是偶尔确认一下它是否还在吧。
desc_en:
You held a single sakura petal in your hand before leaving Raiden Makoto's realm of consciousness.
Its existence is a mystery. It appears no different from ordinary sakura petals, and there it silently sits in your storage just like any of the others. But you can no longer touch it, nor can you feel its weight or warmth. When an object loses any of the attributes that one would normally ascribe to it, how can its "existence" be proven for sure?
As you think back on the many sights the petal must have witnessed in the past, a certain guess comes to mind: that which sustains this sakura petal's existence must be someone's will. But as to who this person is, and whether they are intentionally or unintentionally keeping this petal in existence, neither can be known. Nor can you prove whether that willpower is one derived from yearning, trust, or gratitude.
Perhaps, when "that person's will" changes, so too will this sakura petal disappear.
Just to be safe, it might be best to check back from time to time and see if it still exists.

desc_chs: 因为海祇御灵祭而产生的特殊矿藏。因为渊下宫的环境发生了剧变，海祇弥散的回忆和思念也固化为髓质，而后变为矿物。
desc_en: A special ore created due to the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri. As Enkanomiya's environment has undergone extreme changes, the memories and thoughts of Watatsumi Omikami scattered throughout Enkanomiya have coalesced into medullae, which then transformed into ore.

desc_chs: 因为海祇御灵祭而产生的特殊植物。因珊瑚王虫苏醒，渊下宫的元素力变得温和。这种肥田作物自然生长，等待着腐朽在土地里化为壤土。
desc_en: A special plant that was produced via the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri. With the awakening of the Sangacorexes, the elemental energies within Enkanomiya have been pacified. This is a naturally-growing fertilizing crop that will turn into loam within the soil once it decays.

desc_chs: 特殊的黯色空壳被击败后，从崩落的盔甲间拾取到的宝石。可以感受到内部涌动的意志。或许不能说是这种意志驱动着空壳，而是这种意志借助盔甲得以显现。
desc_en: A jewel that fell from the armor of a special Shadowy Husk after you defeated it. You can feel a will surging within it. Perhaps it might be more correct to say that this will manifested itself through the armor rather than manipulated it.

desc_chs: 从心海那里拿到的小饰品，看起来像是什么东西的碎片。据心海说有可能会派上用场。
desc_en: A small accessory you got from Kokomi. It seems to be the fragment of another object. According to her, it might come in handy at some point.

desc_chs: 从「渊上」那里拿到的碎片。归根究底他也是从大日御舆里偷出来的，所以这个应该算是渊下宫的文物。
desc_en: A fragment that you got from "Enjou." He stole this from the Dainichi Mikoshi, so this should be a relic of Enkanomiya.

desc_chs: 阿祇绘制的地图。上面有些标记。
desc_en: A map drawn by Tsumi. There are some markings on it.

desc_chs: 岩藏家代代流传的宝刀。\n虽然匠人的工艺极其出色，也经历了许多年月与真剑厮杀，但刀本身其实并没有任何特别的力量。历代岩藏之胤不曾获得过神之眼，他们傲人的剑术只来自对身、心、技的长年修炼。\n这把刀在水中浸泡了一些日子。如今已经完全锈坏了。
desc_en: The heirloom blade of the Iwakura Clan.\nAlthough the one who forged this blade possessed great skills, and though it is true that this sword has slain many a foe, it does not possess any special powers. Nor has the Iwakura Succession ever obtained a Vision. Their excellent swordsmanship was purely a result of their honing of mind, body, and technique.\nThis blade has been submerged in water for a long time and seems to have completely rusted.

desc_chs: 勘定奉行的役人丢下的钥匙，用这个应该能将新之丞救出来。
desc_en: Someone from the Kanjou Commission left this behind. You should be able to use this to rescue Shinnojou.

desc_chs: 看起来平凡无奇的石板。不知道隐藏着什么秘密。
desc_en: A seemingly ordinary stone slate. Who knows what secrets it might hold...

desc_chs: 最后拿到的一块石板。在秘密之下还有秘密。
desc_en: The final stone slate you obtained. Secrets within secrets, eh?

desc_chs: 还算完整的字条，其上字迹工整，似乎是为老朋友留下的信笺。
desc_en: A somewhat complete note, written in a neat hand. It seems to have been a letter left for an old friend.

desc_chs: 黑蛇骑士遗留下的信，收件人一栏工整地写着「亲爱的姐姐，卡塔琳娜·雪奈茨夫娜」，寄件人署名很潦草，勉强可以辨认出写的是「你的弟弟，尼古拉，雪奈茨维奇」。
desc_en: A letter you found off one of the Black Serpent Knights. The name of the letter's recipient is neatly written: "Katarina Snezhevna, My Dear Elder Sister," while the sender's name is written somewhat haphazardly, though you can make out the words "Your Brother, Nikolay Snezhevich."

desc_chs: （test）层岩巨渊光能球
根据娜扎法琳给的配方，制作出来的调料。带有扑鼻的香气，加入到料理中似乎能激发出更多风味。
desc_en: Seasoning created using the recipe given to you by Nazafarin. It has a tangy aroma and serves to bring out the flavor in any dish it is added to.

desc_chs: 加入了调料的美味料理，散发着诱人的香气。不知道适合谁的喜好呢？快去邀请伙伴们试吃吧！
desc_en: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

name_en: The Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival!
desc_chs: 从款式到内容都很浮夸的邀请函，函中描绘了一场规模庞大、意义深远、堪称举国盛会般的大型活动，而你将作为尊贵的客人，成为盛会中最灿烂醒目的那颗明星。
desc_en: This is a most lavish invitation letter, whether in its construction or its content. The letter describes a large-scale, deep-rooted, nationally-acclaimed event in which you shall be a most important guest, the radiant star of the show.

desc_chs: 原本是账本，现在似乎被当做记录本来使用了。上面记录了黑岩厂最近的日常，不过并没有太多有用的信息。
desc_en: This was originally a ledger, but appears to have been re-purposed as a site log instead. The latest daily happenings at The Chasm have been scribbled into its pages, though not much of this information is of any particular use.

desc_chs: 加入了调料的美味料理，散发着诱人的香气。不知道适合谁的喜好呢？快去邀请伙伴们试吃吧！
desc_en: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

desc_chs: 加入了调料的美味料理，散发着诱人的香气。不知道适合谁的喜好呢？快去邀请伙伴们试吃吧！
desc_en: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

(test)无名冒险家的笔记
(test)无名冒险家的笔记
一位年轻冒险家留下的信，带着一点点苦涩的清心气味。
desc_en: A letter left by a young adventurer. There is a slightly bitter scent of Qingxin on this piece of paper.

desc_chs: 写有容彩祭嘉宾乘坐船只信息的时刻表。\n你的任务就是根据这张表上的信息，到离岛的港口接引嘉宾，并为他们提供帮助。
desc_en: A list of guests and their time of arrival on ships bound for the Irodori Festival.\nYour task is to welcome and lend your aid to guests according to the information presented in this schedule.

desc_chs: 由八重堂编辑长平山整理的五歌仙资料，用以帮助白垩老师完成五歌仙画像。\n虽然内容十分有限，但仍能从中窥见当年五歌仙的风采。
desc_en: A summary of the information concerning the Five Kasen, which you got from Yae Publishing House's Hirayama.\nAlthough the content is quite sparse, you can still get the gist of the Five Kasen and the great flair they had in their heyday.

desc_chs: 温迪在港口仓库的货箱里发现的纸片，上面写有一首名为《五歌仙容彩·翠光篇》的诗。
desc_en: A sheet of paper Venti found in a cargo crate within the wharf warehouse. A poem entitled "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Suikou" is written upon it.

name_en: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Aoi no Okina
desc_chs: 行秋在行李下面发现的纸片，似乎是有人趁着他打瞌睡放在那里的。纸上写有一首名为《五歌仙容彩·葵之翁篇》的诗。
desc_en: A sheet of paper Xingqiu found beneath his luggage. Someone seems to have left it there while he was napping. A poem entitled "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Aoi no Okina" is written upon it.

desc_chs: 某个神秘人留下的纸片。此人应该原本是想把纸片放在万叶身上，却不料气息被万叶察觉，仓皇中只好将它扔在地上后逃走。纸上写有一首名为《五歌仙容彩·赤人篇》的诗。
desc_en: A sheet of paper that some mysterious person left behind. This person must have originally intended to leave it on Kazuha's person, only to be unexpectedly detected by the latter and forced to flee in a hurry, leaving the sheet behind. A poem entitled "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Akahito" is written upon it.

desc_chs: 绫华在容彩祭会场的花架上发现的纸片，但这张纸上只写了一句话。
desc_en: Ayaka found this on a flower stand at the festival venue. This sheet of paper, however, only contains one line of text.

desc_chs: 绫华在容彩祭会场的花架上发现的纸片，在用清水浸泡过之后，纸面上浮现出了完整的《五歌仙容彩·墨染篇》诗作。
desc_en: Ayaka found this on a flower stand at the festival venue. Once submerged in water, this sheet of paper reveals the full poetic text of "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome."

desc_chs: 一卷古老的锻造图谱，将军曾命令枫原家依照它锻造御神刀。\n经过浸泡后，图谱上有一些文字变得模糊了——有人通过篡改它，导致了锻刀失败，并引发了后续的一系列惨剧…
desc_en: An ancient forging blueprint. The Shogun once ordered the Kaedehara Clan to forge a Goshintou according to it.\nAfter being soaked in water, it becomes clear that some of the text has been blurred — someone tampered with the blueprint, dooming the forging to failure and triggering the tragedy that followed...

desc_chs: 藏在古旧花盆夹层中的空白纸张，沾上水后，就会浮现出尘封多年的秘密。\n在将信上记述的真相告诉大家后，万叶说「这封信对你或许还有用」，便将它交给了你。
desc_en: A blank piece of paper that was hidden in an old flower pot. When dipped in water, it reveals a long-sealed secret.\nAfter telling everyone about the truth that was concealed within, Kazuha said that "this letter may still be of use to you," before handing it over to you.

desc_chs: 厚厚的一叠诗稿，内容往好评价质量平平，如实评论则呕哑难读。比起诗歌不如更像枯燥的历史记录。
desc_en: A very thick poetic manuscript. If you were to give it a generous review, it would be "mediocre," while an honest review would see it getting a "hard to read." It resembles bone-dry historical records more than it does poetry.

desc_chs: 原计划用于购置寝具、改善睡眠的资金，但早柚还不想就此长眠。
desc_en: This was originally intended to buy bedding and other materials by which sleep quality might be improved, but on the other hand, Sayu has no wish to sleep forever just yet.

name_chs: 御建鸣神主尊大御所大人像
name_en: Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder
desc_chs: 裟罗心心念念的「御建鸣神主尊大御所大人像」，快带去给她看看吧。
desc_en: The Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder that Sara has been hankering after. Go on, go give it to her.

desc_chs: 心海所列的购书清单，上面用娟秀的字体清晰罗列出了所有要购买书籍的种类、单价与数量。
desc_en: A shopping list of books compiled by Kokomi. All the genres, unit prices, and amounts of the books she desires have been written down here in her elegant script.

desc_chs: 容彩祭上，五郎帮心海购买童话书时获赠的狐狸玩偶。之后，五郎将它作为陪同买书的谢礼送给了你。\n每当看到玩偶，就忍不住想起五郎在听到「狐狸」二字时，尾巴上的毛全部竖起来的景象。
desc_en: The gift that Gorou got when helping Kokomi purchase books during the Irodori Festival. Gorou then gave it to you as thanks for accompanying him.\nEvery time you look at it, you can't help but remember the sight of every hair on Gorou's body standing on end as he heard the word "fox."

desc_chs: 据称贸然打开会有不幸缠身的包裹，重量似乎比预想的要轻一些…？
desc_en: It is said that opening this will bring you bad luck. It seems lighter than you assumed it might be...?

desc_chs: (test)无名冒险家的笔记

name_en: A Complete Chart of Ako's Treasure
desc_chs: 由离开此处的「赤穗百目鬼一众」留下的秘宝，四份线索收集完全之后，即可得到的，秘宝埋藏之处的海图。
desc_en: A complete nautical chart pieced together after all four parts of the clue were collected, leading to the treasure hidden by Ako Domeki and company before they left this place.

name_chs: 《异邦人喧哗旅：吹向金发武士的死亡之风》台本
name_en: "Outlander Brigade: When the Wind of Death Blew Towards the Blond Samurai" Script
desc_chs: 从泽维尔那里拿到的「映影台本」。
desc_en: A "film script" you obtained from Xavier.

desc_chs: 泽维尔连夜写出的新映影台本，比上一部映影台本厚得多。你手上的还只是第一幕的部分。\n人一旦有了目标，真的会爆发出恐怖的意志力。
desc_en: A new film script that Xavier finished overnight, much thicker than his last one. What you have here merely contains Act I.\nThe willpower one can harness to achieve a goal is truly amazing.

desc_chs: 「上演在星海的大战，本质其实与十年前那场贫瘠星球的草民械斗并无二致…」不久后，那个男人的名字，就将和帝国皇帝的名字一样，被整个银河熟知。
desc_en: "In essence, the great battle in space is no different from the armed conflict between commoners which took place ten years ago on that barren planet..." Soon, the name of that man shall be known across the Galaxy, matching that of the Emperor.

name_chs: 转生成为雷电将军，然后天下无敌
name_en: Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power
desc_chs: 流行于稻妻的轻小说，讲述了一个普通人突然变成雷电将军的故事。由于故事新奇有趣，此书深受欢迎，还激发了很多轻小说作者的创作灵感。
desc_en: A popular light novel in Inazuma which tells the story of a mere mortal suddenly turning into the Raiden Shogun. The story is well-received for its novel plot and has inspired many light novelists.

desc_chs: 流行于稻妻的轻小说。讲述了废柴将军大人与万能狐仙宫司的故事，与《转生成为雷电将军，然后天下无敌》是姊妹篇，但是并非同一作者所著，最大共同特征是都很受欢迎。
desc_en: A popular light novel in Inazuma which tells the story of the "good-for-nothing" Shogun and the "good-at-everything" Kitsune Guuji. The novel is in the same collection as "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power," but not by the same author. What they share in common, however, is their popularity.

desc_chs: 编辑寄语：《出发吧！嘟嘟可》是一个大女孩和一个小女孩共同完成的故事，故事中的所有小小片段都包含着她们的温柔与祝福，也是她们送给诸位读者的礼物。希望这本薄薄的小书能让读者们在繁忙的工作之余获得一些简单的快乐。
desc_en: Message From the Editor: "Let's Go, Dodoco!" is the combined work of an older girl and a younger girl. Every chapter brims with their gentleness and good wishes, as the story is intended as a gift to our readers. I hope this book — in spite of its small volume — can bring you some simple joy after a long day of work.

desc_chs: 由离开此处的「赤穗百目鬼一众」留下的秘宝，埋藏秘宝之时，约定众人再聚于群岛时，将之起出。于是将秘宝所藏之处线索一分为四，此为其一。
desc_en: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the first part.

desc_chs: 由离开此处的「赤穗百目鬼一众」留下的秘宝，埋藏秘宝之时，约定众人再聚于群岛时，将之起出。于是将秘宝所藏之处线索一分为四，此为其二。
desc_en: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the second part.

desc_en: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the third part.

desc_en: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the fourth part.

desc_chs: 「耶然草」是灵药「兰赫玛」的原料之一，「耶然」据说是「名为死亡的实现」之含义。
desc_en: One of the ingredients for making the elixir Arahaoma. "Yajna" is said to mean "the realization of death."

desc_chs: 「须罗蕈」是灵药「兰赫玛」的原料之一，「须罗」的含义据说是「迷醉梦中」。
desc_en: One of the ingredients for making the elixir Arahaoma. "Zohrah" is said to mean "lost in a tipsy dream."

desc_chs: 「钵参花」是灵药「兰赫玛」的原料之一，「钵参」据说是消失已久的神木。
desc_en: One of the ingredients for making the elixir Arahaoma. "Barsam" is said to be a sacred tree that has long vanished in history.

desc_chs: （test）封印钥匙其一
（test）封印钥匙其二
兰那罗的灵药「兰赫玛」，仅一滴便足以令森林明晓兰那罗纯真的梦想。
desc_en: An elixir of Aranara. A mere drop of it is all it takes to unveil Aranara's pure and pristine dreams to the forest.

desc_chs: 泽维尔连夜写出的新映影台本，比上一部映影台本厚得多。你手上的还只是第一幕和第二幕的部分。\n人一旦有了目标，真的会爆发出恐怖的意志力。
desc_en: A new film script that Xavier finished overnight, much thicker than his last one. What you have here merely contains Acts I and II.\nThe willpower one can harness to achieve a goal is truly amazing.

desc_chs: 泽维尔连夜写出的新映影台本，比上一部映影台本厚得多。\n人一旦有了目标，真的会爆发出恐怖的意志力。
desc_en: A new film script that Xavier finished overnight, much thicker than his last one.\nThe willpower one can harness to achieve a goal is truly amazing.

desc_chs: 瑾武专门为生病矿工熬制的浓汤，营养丰富，咸香浓重，饮之令人心生暖意。\n这是瑾武的心意，可不要放凉了。
desc_en: A thick soup that Jinwu made for sick miners. It's nutritious, fragrant, and makes you feel warm inside when you drink it.\nDon't let it go cold, now.

desc_chs: （test）神秘的信笺
（test）神秘的信笺
（test）神秘的信笺

自老臭处得来的一包首饰，以作唐无仇的补偿。为在层岩巨渊走私宝石矿材的盗宝团制作，其粗犷淳朴的宝石制作工艺，和勉强算得上有所设计的外观造型，断绝了这批首饰能够在璃月成功卖出的任何可能。唯一能为人称道的，恐怕就只有这批首饰确实是真材实料的这点了…
desc_en: A bag of decorations that Old Chou gave you as compensation for Tang Wuchou's misfortunes. They are very roughly made, owing to having been manufactured by the Treasure Hoarders within The Chasm using smuggled ore, and can barely be considered to possess any aesthetic qualities at all. As such, there is no hope at all of them selling well in Liyue. The only thing good you could say about these ornaments is that they are at least made using the right materials...

desc_chs: 一次遍历苗圃的土地后得到的东西，晶莹剔透仿佛凝结了大地的记忆。
desc_en: An item you obtained after traversing the nursery. It is translucent and seems to contain the memories of the earth.

desc_chs: 编辑寄语：《出发吧！嘟嘟可》是一个大女孩和一个小女孩共同完成的故事，故事中的所有小小片段都包含着她们的温柔与祝福，也是她们送给诸位读者的礼物。希望这本薄薄的小书能让读者们在繁忙的工作之余获得一些简单的快乐。
desc_en: Message From the Editor: "Let's Go, Dodoco!" is the combined work of an older girl and a younger girl. Every chapter brims with their gentleness and good wishes, as the story is intended as a gift to our readers. I hope this book — in spite of its small volume — can bring you some simple joy after a long day of work.

desc_chs: 藏起线索的人留下的，找到线索的方法。说不定按上面的指示进行航行，就能够找到「赤穗百目鬼一众」秘宝的线索。
desc_en: A log indicating how to find the clues, left by the ones who hid them. If you navigate as it directs, you may indeed find a clue regarding the treasure left by Ako Domeki and company.

desc_chs: 藏起线索的人留下的，找到线索的方法。说不定按上面的指示行动，就能够找到「赤穗百目鬼一众」秘宝的线索。
desc_en: A log indicating how to find the clues, left by the ones who hid them. If you proceed as it directs, you may indeed find a clue regarding the treasure left by Ako Domeki and company.

desc_chs: 藏起线索的人留下的，找到线索的方法。说不定按上面的指示行动，就能够找到「赤穗百目鬼一众」秘宝的线索。不过已经是第二张留书了，希望这次能直接找到线索。
desc_en: A log indicating how to find the clues, left by the ones who hid them. If you proceed as it directs, you may indeed find a clue regarding the treasure left by Ako Domeki and company. Still, this is, what, the second log you've found already? Hopefully, it can lead you directly to the clue this time.

desc_chs: 刻印着星空纹路的神秘碎片，似乎可以用来解开某处机关的谜题。
desc_en: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

desc_chs: 充满神秘力量的果实。\n为了帮助拉娜，必须取得惟耶之实。为了取得惟耶之实，必须取得恒素果。
desc_en: A fruit with mysterious powers.\nBija is indispensable for helping Rana, and the Vasoma Fruit is indispensable for obtaining Bija.

desc_chs: (test)小草神殿给的果子

兰罗摩编织成的花冠。
这种花冠象征着整个桓那兰那的祝福。在与「无留陀的化身」战斗时，一度源源不断地涌出力量。但或许是因为过度燃烧，如今耀眼的光芒已经消退了。

每一朵花，都连接着一颗兰那罗小小的心；而将所有的花朵编制成的花冠，即是连接着「玛哈桓那兰那薜那」的门扉。兰那罗会为戴着这种花冠的朋友声援，为朋友分担痛苦，抵挡噩梦，帮助朋友战胜黑暗的时日，填补心中的虚空。
desc_en:
A garland woven by Arama.
Garlands of this kind represent the blessings from all of Vanarana and once channeled endless powers during the fight with Marana's Avatar. But their blazing light has now faded, perhaps because they burned so relentlessly.

Every flower on the garland is connected with the lovely, tiny heart of an Aranara, and all of them together constitute the gate to Mahavanaranapna. Aranara will support those who wear such garlands. As friends, they ease the wearers' pains, ward off their nightmares, aid them through lightless days, and fill the emptiness in their hearts.

desc_chs: 兰罗摩编织成的花冠。\n这种花冠象征着整个桓那兰那的祝福。
desc_en: A garland woven by Arama.\nGarlands of this kind represent the blessings from all of Vanarana.

desc_chs: 兰那罗最宝贵的事物的结晶。虽说是果实，但也是希望之种。
desc_en: The crystallization of what is most precious to Aranara. It is not only a fruit but also a seed of hope.

desc_chs: 兰拉娜赠送的花儿。\n答应了兰拉娜，要惩罚恶人。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Arana.\nYou promised Arana that the evil shall be punished.

desc_chs: 兰拉迦赠送的花儿。\n他似乎失去过重要的记忆。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Araja.\nAraja seems to have lost important memories.

desc_chs: 不知名的兰那罗赠送的花儿。\n这种花是兰那罗友情的象征，而愿意收下这朵花的人，就是许可了兰那罗的这份友情。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by an unknown Aranara.\nA symbol of Aranara friendship. One who receives this flower willingly recognizes this friendship.

desc_chs: 兰般度赠送的花儿。\n会驱动「法留纳神机」，调节大地中的水分，让森林欣欣向荣。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Arapandu.\nCan power the Varuna Contraption and adjust the amount of water contained within the earth, thus breathing new life into the forest.

desc_chs: 兰贡迪赠送的花儿。\n与友人一起的快乐就像水中的月莲。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Arakunti.\nHappy moments spent with friends are like Nilotpala Lotuses in the water.

desc_chs: 兰那库拉赠送的花儿。\n即使害怕，也要深入蕈兽的森林，照看「石头的记忆」。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Aranakula.\nFearful though Aranakula was, this little creature still ventured into the Fungus-infested forest to tend to "the Memory of Stone."

desc_chs: 兰百梨迦赠送的花儿。\n其中似乎充满了能一击消灭遗迹守卫的力量。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Arabalika.\nIt seems to contain the power to destroy a Ruin Guard with one strike.

desc_chs: 兰纳迦赠送的花儿。\n「雨季归来，草木欢畅…石榴歌唱，苹果鼓掌。」
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Aranaga.\n"Season of rain returns, plants rejoice... The pomegranate sings, the apples clap."

desc_chs: 兰纳真赠送的花儿。\n「不返的风，不逆流的水…甜美的梦与苦涩的回味。」
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Aranakin.\n"Wind that doesn't return, water that doesn't flow backwards... Sweet dreams and bitter aftertastes."

desc_chs: 兰迦鲁赠送的花儿。\n「老去的绿叶，胀满的果实…淡去的好梦，谢落的花朵。」
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Aragaru.\n"Old leaves, swollen fruit... Drifted dreams, fallen flowers."

desc_chs: 兰利遮赠送的花儿。\n遗迹巨像的内部没有土地、没有水，对他来说或许很可怕吧。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Ararycan.\nThere is neither soil nor water inside the Ruin Golem. It must be a nightmarish place for Ararycan.

desc_chs: 兰伊舍赠送的花儿。\n恐怕最深的谜团是为何他将谜语形容为「好吃」…是因为都是食材吗？
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Araesha.\nThe biggest mystery is perhaps why Araesha describes the riddles as being "delicious"... Is it because they are all about food?

desc_chs: 兰伽卢赠送的花儿。\n对于培育「毗波耶」的他来说，值得送给朋友的花，应该是十分宝贵的东西。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Arakara.\nFor Arakara, who nurtures Viparyas, flowers given to friends must be most precious indeed.

desc_chs: 兰帕卡提与「哥哥们」赠送的花儿。\n因为向往「兄妹」之间的牵绊，而长久扮演着「兄妹」的兰那罗。对烹饪的痴迷也是来自与亲人分享食物的愿望。\n但无论如何，兰那罗的味蕾实在令人无法信任。
desc_en: Flowers gifted by Arapacati and her brothers.\nLonging to be connected as "siblings" are, these Aranara have each taken on the role of sister or brother. Their obsession with cooking stems from the wish to share food with family.\nThat being said, an Aranara's tastebuds are not to be trusted.

desc_chs: 采歌者们赠送的花儿。\n「不管天空、大地有多么灰暗，只要你的心一直像太阳一样，发出金色的、温暖的光，那就一直都会有希望。」
desc_en: Flowers gifted to you by the Song Gatherers.\n"No matter how dark the sky and land get, as long as your spirit emits warm, golden light like the sun, there will always be hope."

desc_chs: 兰梨娄与兰难世赠送的花儿。\n最强的果然还是自己！
desc_en: Flowers gifted by Aralila and Aranishat.\nWe ourselves are the strongest. Of that, there is no doubt!

desc_chs: 兰犍多赠送的花儿。\n原本似乎很喜欢与长鬓虎一起玩儿。但为了那菈朋友，创造了新的游戏。
desc_en: A flower gifted by Arakanta.\nArakanta used to love hanging out with Rishboland Tigers. But now, he has created a new game for his Nara friend.

desc_chs: (test)兰那罗给主角的小花，羁绊的证明也是具有神奇的能力

name_chs: 关于你与兰那罗的故事
name_en: Stories of You and the Aranara
desc_chs: 与兰那罗一同冒险的过程中，产生了许许多多的奇妙故事。在重视故事的兰那罗世界里，或许有谁愿意进行「交换」吧。
desc_en: So many wonderful things transpired during your adventures with the Aranara. In the world of the Aranara where stories are highly valued, maybe someone is willing to "exchange" these with you.

desc_chs: 名为奥列格的愚人众不慎落下的计划书中所附地图，上面标注了所有营地的位置，以及愚人众进行巡逻的路线。
desc_en: This map was contained within the plans that a Fatuus named Oleg accidentally dropped. All the encampment positions and Fatui patrol routes have been marked out here.

desc_chs: 刻印着星空纹路的神秘碎片，似乎可以用来解开某处机关的谜题。
desc_en: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

desc_chs: 在奇妙的植物附近找到的钥匙，应该可以用来开启辛焱幻境中某扇位于高处的门扉。
desc_en: A key that you found near the mysterious plant. This may be used to open a certain door in a high-up location within Xinyan's Mirage.

desc_chs: 盛满泉水的瓶子。瓶中之物应该就是火炽之心想要的「寒山甘泉」了吧。
desc_en: A bottle of spring water. The Glacial Spring Water that Blazing Heart desires should be stored within.

desc_chs: 不可思议的花瓣。乍看像是把冰块凿成花瓣的形状，触手却很柔软。\n「拿着我的花瓣，把它种在音律交汇的终点，沉入地下的山脉将为这乐声升起。」\n——冰封之心是这么说的。
desc_en: An uncanny petal. At first glance, it seems like ice molded into the shape of a petal, but it is quite soft to the touch.\n"Plant my petal at the ending point of the intersection of melodies, and what had once sunk into the earth will re-emerge with the music."\nThat's what Frozen Soul said.

desc_chs: 一份字迹优美的笔记。
desc_en: An elegantly-written note.

desc_chs: 一封信。
desc_en: A letter.

desc_chs: 山间的石块。各方面来看都很适合作为盆景左侧山石的雕刻用原料。
desc_en: Mountain rocks. They look suited in all ways to be used as base materials from which to carve rocks for the bonsai's left side.

desc_chs: 山间的石块。各方面来看都很适合作为盆景右侧山石的雕刻用原料。
desc_en: Mountain rocks. They look suited in all ways to be used as base materials from which to carve rocks for the bonsai's right side.

desc_chs: 雕刻工具，出现在蒙德风格的山体上。或许可以用它将石料雕刻成假山。
desc_en: Carving tools that you found on the Mondstadt-style mountains. You might be able to use them to carve the base materials you have into a rock garden.

desc_chs: 雕刻工具，出现在稻妻风格的山体上。或许可以用它将石料雕刻成假山。
desc_en: Carving tools that you found on the Inazuma-style mountains. You might be able to use them to carve the base materials you have into a rock garden.

desc_chs: 小型的齿轮。再小的齿轮是有其用处的，也许吧。
desc_en: A small gear. No matter how small a gear is, it can be of use sometime, perhaps?

desc_chs: 中型的齿轮。我们一般将其称之为「中坚力量」。
desc_en: A medium gear. "The pivotal one," as we call it.

desc_chs: 能够提供些许动力的齿轮。动力是重中之重。
desc_en: A gear that can transmit a measure of force. After all, momentum is key.

desc_chs: 大型的齿轮。它的重量和工作声响都让人印象深刻。
desc_en: A large gear. Its weight and the noise it emits will make an impression for sure.

desc_chs: 略小的双层结构齿轮。双层的结构，双层的工时。
desc_en: A rather small duplex gear. Double the flanks, double the labor hours.

desc_chs: 略大的双层结构齿轮。大型结构，大型消耗。
desc_en: A fairly large duplex gear. The bigger the size is, the more it takes to manufacture.

desc_chs: 需要动力驱动的齿轮。它很有用，真的，谁来帮它转起来？
desc_en: A gear that requires power to rotate. It can be very helpful. Really. Can someone help rotate it, please?

desc_chs: 质地较软的盆景山石，似乎能召来悠闲舒适的轻风，可以摆放为盆景左侧的假山。
desc_en: Slightly soft bonsai rocks. They seem to be able to summon a leisurely and comfy breeze. These can be placed on the left side of the bonsai.

desc_chs: 质地较软的盆景山石，似乎能召来悠闲舒适的轻风，可以摆放为盆景右侧的假山。
desc_en: Slightly soft bonsai rocks. They seem to be able to summon a leisurely and comfy breeze. These can be placed on the right side of the bonsai.

desc_chs: 硬度适中的盆景山石，据说在雷雨天气时，岩石表层将有光芒浮烁，可以摆放为盆景左侧的假山。
desc_en: Rocks of moderate hardness. It is said that a glimmer will dance across the surface of these rocks during stormy weather. These can be placed on the left side of the bonsai.

desc_chs: 硬度适中的盆景山石，据说在雷雨天气时，岩石表层将有光芒浮烁，可以摆放为盆景右侧的假山。
desc_en: Bonsai rocks of moderate hardness. It is said that a glimmer will dance across the surface of these rocks during stormy weather. These can be placed on the right side of the bonsai.

desc_chs: 分外坚硬的盆景山石，极为稳固，蕴含着厚重的岩石气息，可以摆放为盆景左侧的假山。
desc_en: Very hard bonsai rocks that have an air of firmness to them. These can be placed on the left side of the bonsai.

desc_chs: 分外坚硬的盆景山石，极为稳固，蕴含着厚重的岩石气息，可以摆放为盆景右侧的假山。
desc_en: Very hard bonsai rocks that have an air of firmness to them. These can be placed on the right side of the bonsai.

desc_chs: 在水天丛林的河流源头收集到的水，按兰阿帕斯所说，用此处的活源水做出的汤，就是「至上珍馐」。但这真的和普通的水有差别吗…
desc_en: Water obtained from the source of the rivers flowing across Apam Woods. According to Arapas, soup made from such spring water is a Supreme Delicacy. But one wonders if it really is any different from ordinary water...

desc_chs: 满满一盒零件。这些零件看起来似乎没有受到什么损伤，也许是因为魔物对它们没有一点兴趣吧…
desc_en: A box full of components. They all look quite intact, perhaps because monsters have no interest in them...

name_chs: 不知来历的纸条 其一
desc_chs: 在迷之空间内找到的纸条。内容疑似日记。
desc_en: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

name_chs: 不知来历的纸条 其二
desc_chs: 在迷之空间内找到的纸条。内容疑似日记。
desc_en: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

name_chs: 不知来历的纸条 其三
desc_chs: 在迷之空间内找到的纸条。内容疑似日记。
desc_en: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

name_chs: 不知来历的纸条 其四
desc_chs: 在迷之空间内找到的纸条。内容疑似日记。
desc_en: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

desc_chs: 写满歪斜笔迹皱巴巴的纸条。
desc_en: A wrinkled note with horrendously slanted handwriting.

desc_chs: 用于兑换【镜水角鸮号·转】的兑换券
desc_en: Used to redeem Mirrorpool Horned Owl: Turning

desc_chs: 用于兑换【镜水角鸮号·舞】的兑换券
desc_en: Used to redeem Mirrorpool Horned Owl: Dancing

desc_chs: 用于兑换【镜水角鸮号·空】的兑换券
desc_en: Used to redeem Mirrorpool Horned Owl: Air Time
