name_chs: 法医室的研究日志内页
desc_chs: 满是折痕的研究日志内页，字迹依旧清晰可见。
desc_en: A research log excerpt with plenty of crinkles. The handwriting is still very much legible.

desc_chs: 在迷之空间内找到的纸条。内容疑似日记。
desc_en: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

desc_chs: (test）用于开启万叶家庭院厅堂的钥匙。
愚人众神秘装置中缺失的晶核。依照佩尔西科夫的手稿来看，寻找三个这样的晶核，将其置入装置，即可完成重启。
desc_en: The crystalline core component that was missing from the curious Fatui machine. According to Persikov's manuscript, the machine can be restarted if three such cores are found and inserted into the device.

desc_chs: 愚人众神秘装置中缺失的晶核。依照佩尔西科夫的手稿来看，寻找三个这样的晶核，将其置入装置，即可完成重启。
desc_en: The crystalline core component that was missing from the curious Fatui machine. According to Persikov's manuscript, the machine can be restarted if three such cores are found and inserted into the device.

desc_chs: 愚人众神秘装置中缺失的晶核。依照佩尔西科夫的手稿来看，寻找三个这样的晶核，将其置入装置，即可完成重启。
desc_en: The crystalline core component that was missing from the curious Fatui machine. According to Persikov's manuscript, the machine can be restarted if three such cores are found and inserted into the device.

desc_chs: 老旧发黄的笔记
desc_en: Old Yellowed Notes

desc_chs: 神秘来信
desc_en: Mysterious Letter

name_chs: 一份似乎能防水的笔记
desc_chs: 一份似乎能防水的笔记
desc_en: A Seemingly Waterproof Note

desc_chs: 与某种奇妙植物有着关联的钥匙，似乎可以用来打开某道门扉…
desc_en: A key related to a certain mysterious plant. It seems to be able to open some door somewhere...

desc_chs: 爱德琳女仆长不久前代收的信件，需要送到酒庄内归档。\n纸张稍显褶皱，也许写信的人有些匆忙，没能找到平坦的书桌。
desc_en: A letter the head housemaid, Adelinde, just received. It needs to be sent to Dawn Winery for archiving.\nThe paper is slightly wrinkled. Maybe the person who wrote the letter was in a hurry and couldn't find a desk.

name_chs: 晨曦酒庄的珍品葡萄汁
desc_chs: 来自迪卢克的赠礼，包装豪华的葡萄汁，是派蒙期待已久的饮品，更是与伙伴共同处理危机的纪念物。\n这种果汁是迪卢克个人最中意的一款，用到了晨曦酒庄品质最好的葡萄。\n「迪卢克老爷最喜欢的葡萄汁」这一项属性，似乎有着难以估量的商业价值？
desc_en: A gift from Diluc. A bottle of grape juice with luxury packaging. It is something Paimon has long been looking forward to, but more so a memento of the time when you and your friends handled the crisis together.\nIt is also Diluc's personal favorite, produced using only Dawn Winery's best quality grapes.\nBeing "Master Diluc's favorite grape juice" seems to have inestimable commercial value...

name_chs: 浸有史莱姆凝液的泥土
desc_chs: 浸有史莱姆凝液的泥土。黏糊糊的，不知道阿金会拿来做什么…
desc_en: Soil soaked with Slime Condensate. What will Akim use this sticky stuff for?

desc_chs: 从骗骗花的根系上采集得到的泥土。不知道阿金会拿来做什么…
desc_en: Soil collected from Whopperflower roots. What will Akim use it for?

desc_chs: 从岩石底部取得的阴湿泥土。不知道阿金会拿来做什么…
desc_en: Moist soil collected from the bottom of rocks. What will Akim use it for?

desc_chs: 像是凝聚着星光的通透晶体，似乎可以用来解开某处机关的谜题。
desc_en: A translucent crystal that seems to hold coalescent starlight within it. This item seems to be key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

desc_chs: 预计作为补给投放的火腿，在低温条件下能保存很长时间。
desc_en: Ham meant to be used for resupply. It will keep longer in low-temperature conditions.

desc_chs: 由断罪之皇女亲手签署和颁发，供使用者开通航行站点权限的契约书信。能够出示此信者，即被视为拥有于昼夜相交之际张开黑羽、以深邃夜色遮蔽天空的资格。
desc_en: A contract penned and signed personally by the Prinzessin der Verurteilung herself. It may be used to authorize the opening of navigational sites. Those who should produce this letter of warrant shall be authorized forthwith to spread their black feathers where dawn meets dusk, and envelop the skies in night's own embrace.

desc_chs: 阿金专门为尼姆制作的特制「凝成泥土」。不知道尼姆会用它做出怎样的「泥罐战士」…
desc_en: Special "Concresoil" Akim made for Nima. What kind of pot warriors will Nima make with it?

desc_chs: (test)材料参照物
从骗骗花的根系上采集得到的泥土。不知道阿金会拿来做什么…
desc_en: Soil collected from Whopperflower roots. What will Akim use it for?

desc_chs: 看不出来肥沃与否的泥土。\n不知道阿金会拿来做什么…
desc_en: You can't tell whether this soil is fertile or not.\nWhat will Akim use this for?

desc_chs: 质量有问题的「凝成泥土」。看起来非常糟糕…
desc_en: "Concresoil" of poor quality. It looks to be in terrible condition...

desc_chs: 一份正式的寻人委托，印有天领奉行所的标志。
desc_en: An official missing person poster with the Tenryou Commission's symbol on it.

desc_chs: 在金苹果群岛找到的钥匙，似乎可以用来打开某处的锁…
desc_en: A key found in the Golden Apple Archipelago, seemingly able to open a lock somewhere...

desc_chs: （test）危危岛遗迹钥匙2
渔师凯万制作特别鱼饵所需的鸟蛋。虽然是从指定的树上搜集到的，但看不出来厉害在什么地方。
desc_en: A bird egg needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. This special egg was collected from a specific tree, but it does not look particularly special.

desc_chs: 渔师凯万制作特别鱼饵所需的蘑菇。不知为何，似乎对魔物有一定的吸引力，居然会被魔物主动采摘…
desc_en: A mushroom needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, mushrooms of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

desc_chs: 渔师凯万制作特别鱼饵所需的薄荷。不知为何，似乎对魔物有一定的吸引力，居然会被魔物主动采摘…
desc_en: Mint needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, mints of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

desc_chs: 渔师凯万制作特别鱼饵所需的香辛果。不知为何，似乎对魔物有一定的吸引力，居然会被魔物主动采摘…
desc_en: Harra Fruit needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, Harra Fruits of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

desc_chs: 渔师凯万制作特别鱼饵所需的甜甜花。不知为何，似乎对魔物有一定的吸引力，居然会被魔物主动采摘…
desc_en: Sweet Flower needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, Sweet Flowers of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

desc_chs: (test)钓鱼委托
提纳里为海芭夏准备的应急便当，派蒙悄悄打开看了一眼，里面装着一些传统的须弥饭菜，似乎很美味的样子。
desc_en: Emergency food that Tighnari prepared for Haypasia. Paimon took a peek into the lunchbox, finding some traditional Sumeru delicacies that looked very tasty inside.

desc_chs: 提纳里写给海芭夏的信，信中简要介绍了旅行者身份与来到须弥后的种种情况，并言明希望她能为旅行者答疑解惑。
desc_en: A letter from Tighnari to Haypasia. In the letter, Tighnari explains your identity and situation after coming to Sumeru and requests that Haypasia help clear up your doubts.

desc_chs: 旅行者亲手制作的便当，里面放入了拿手的甜甜花酿鸡和萝卜时蔬汤，希望海芭夏能够喜欢。
desc_en: Food that you have specifically prepared for Haypasia. The box contains Sweet Madame and Radish Veggie Soup. You hope Haypasia will like it.

desc_chs: 提纳里写给生论派研究员鲁哈维的信，信中请求鲁哈维能发挥自身优势，帮助旅行者打探消息。\n纸上还附有鲁哈维在须弥城的住址。
desc_en: A letter from Tighnari to Rohawi, a researcher from Amurta. In the letter, Tighnari requests that Rohawi use his prowess in collecting information to help you.\nRohawi's address in Sumeru City is also attached therein.

desc_chs: 由艾尔海森提供，用以购买罐装知识的交易资金，放在手上沉甸甸的。
desc_en: A bag of Mora given by Alhaitham for purchasing Canned Knowledge. You can feel the heavy weight of the bag.

desc_chs: 由艾尔海森出资，在多莉摊位上购入的数枚罐装知识，为了掩人耳目被放进了常见的商品包裹中。
desc_en: Canned Knowledge purchased at Dori's booth with the Mora given to you by Alhaitham. Packaged as common commodities to keep it low-key.

name_chs: 罐装知识「单手剑战斗技巧·八」
desc_chs: 名为「单手剑战斗技巧·八」的罐装知识，在派蒙的怂恿下以十万摩拉的价格从多莉摊位上购入。虽然不知道前七个在哪，但「战斗技巧」这种东西总会有用的…大概。
desc_en: Canned Knowledge labeled "Swordfighting Techniques VIII." It was bought from Dori's booth at the price of 100,000 Mora at Paimon's instigation. You have no idea where the first seven in the series are, but things like "Combat Techniques" will always be useful. Well, probably.

desc_chs: 由艾尔海森提供，用以购买「神明罐装知识」去向的资金。
desc_en: A bag of Mora provided by Alhaitham for buying the intel on the whereabouts of the Divine Knowledge Capsule.

desc_chs: 多莉拍摄的「神明罐装知识」交易现场画片。\n从画片中能清晰地看到「阿赫玛尔之眼」的团长密兹里，和他手中那枚散发着耀眼红光的罐装知识。
desc_en: A picture of a scene where the "Divine Knowledge Capsule" is being traded.\nIn the picture, there is Mizri, the leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar, and the Divine Knowledge Capsule giving off a red glow in his hand.

desc_chs: 艾尔海森提供的暗号表，据说找多莉交易「特殊商品」的人，都要先过了这一关才行。\n在去找多莉的线人之前，最好还是确认一下上面的内容吧。
desc_en: A code chart given to you by Alhaitham. Seems like whoever seeks to purchase "special commodities" from Dori has to provide the right code first.\nCheck this code chart before visiting Dori's contact, just in case.

desc_chs: 本应放在某处的影像海螺，却被人遗弃在了此处，播放着位置错位的影像。将它放回本应放回的位置，能看出什么也犹未可知…
desc_en: This Imaging Conch should have been placed somewhere else but was abandoned here by someone, causing it to project images out of their proper order. Return it to its rightful place, and who knows what you might find...

desc_chs: 本应放在某处的影像海螺，却被人遗弃在了此处，播放着位置错位的影像。将它放回本应放回的位置，能看出什么也犹未可知…
desc_en: This Imaging Conch should have been placed somewhere else but was abandoned here by someone, causing it to project images out of their proper order. Return it to its rightful place, and who knows what you might find...

desc_chs: 本应放在某处的影像海螺，却被人遗弃在了此处，播放着位置错位的影像。将它放回本应放回的位置，能看出什么也犹未可知…
desc_en: This Imaging Conch should have been placed somewhere else but was abandoned here by someone, causing it to project images out of their proper order. Return it to its rightful place, and who knows what you might find...

name_chs: 「健康之家」给古尔根的处方药
name_en: Prescription Medication from Bimarstan for Gurgen
desc_chs: 送给古尔根的药剂，需要搭配静养使用。
desc_en: Medication prescribed for Gurgen. It should be taken along with abundant rest.

name_chs: 「健康之家」给阿兹拉的处方药
name_en: Prescription Medication from Bimarstan for Azra
desc_chs: 送给阿兹拉的药剂，味道似乎非常之苦。
desc_en: Medication prescribed for Azra. It smells incredibly bitter.

name_chs: 「健康之家」给阿夫塔的处方药
name_en: Prescription Medication from Bimarstan for Aftab
desc_chs: 送给阿夫塔的药剂，需要搭配清淡饮食。
desc_en: Medication prescribed for Aftab. Taker of this medication needs to practice a bland diet.

desc_chs: 渔师凯万制作特别鱼饵所需的香辛果。不知为何，似乎对魔物有一定的吸引力，让魔物们在附近徘徊…
desc_en: Harra Fruit needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, Harra Fruits of this kind have an appeal to monsters. They would often linger around areas where these Harra Fruits are...

desc_chs: 渔师凯万制作特别鱼饵所需的墩墩桃，看起来和普通的墩墩桃似乎并没有区别…
desc_en: A special Zaytun Peach needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. It seems nothing different than a regular Zaytun Peach.

desc_chs: 桓那兰那的水，相当清冽和冰凉，叶子落入这样的水里，就如同浮在空中一般。可以看得出来是品质非常高的水。
desc_en: Water collected in Vanarana, clear, cold, and refreshing — a leaf falling on top of it would look as if floating in the air. This is transparent water of extraordinary quality.

desc_chs: 看得出来已经有些年头的怀表，但是能从外壳擦拭的痕迹看得出主人的悉心爱护。里面存放着一张至冬国少女在中心的照片。
desc_en: This is certainly not a new pocket watch. But you can tell that it has been carefully polished, evidence of how much the owner really cares about it. Inside is a photograph centering on a young girl from Snezhnaya.

desc_chs: 应该是愚人众的徽记，但是不知道为何，上面布满划痕。
desc_en: This looks like a Fatui insignia, but it's all scratched up somehow.

desc_chs: 看上去十分新鲜的史莱姆凝液。不知道加尔恰到底要怎么使用它…
desc_en: Slime Condensate that looks really fresh. Who knows what Garcia needs it for...

desc_chs: 这次要找的是一只名为「拉勒」的「黑白色」小猫。用「猫语」呼唤它的话，发音应该是「喵，喵喵喵，喵——」。发音时音调要先下后上，最后一声喵要高高扬起。
desc_en: This time, we are looking for a kitten named Lale with black and white fur. If you wish to call for Lale's attention in cat language, you need to say "Meow, meow meow meow, meeeeow!" with the tone going downward then upward, before ending on an even higher note.

desc_chs: 这次要找的是一只名为「纳尔吉斯」的「深灰色」小猫。用「猫语」呼唤它的话，发音应该是「喵！喵喵，喵。」。发音时第一声喵要发重音，后面的喵要快速发音。
desc_en: This time, we are looking for a kitten named Nargis with dark-gray fur. To call for Nargis's attention in cat language, you need to say "Meow! Meow meow, meow." Stress the first meow, and be quick while saying the following meows.

desc_chs: 这次要找的是一只名为「萝赞」的带有「灰黑条纹」的小猫。用「猫语」呼唤它的话，发音应该是「喵喵喵，喵喵喵。」。发音时要快速发音，不能拖长声调。
desc_en: This time, we are looking for a kitten named Rozan with gray and black stripes. To call for its attention in cat language, you should say "Meow meow meow, meow meow meow." Say it quickly with no elongation.

desc_chs: 生长于林中湿地，夜间绽放的花卉，新鲜的花瓣也是治疗魔鳞病的重要药材。
desc_en: Flowers that grow in wetlands in the forest and bloom at night. Their fresh petals are important ingredients for the treatment of Eleazar.

desc_chs: 在「无留陀」退去的死地新生的花朵，幼嫩但顽强不已。
desc_en: A flower sprouting in the faded Withering Zone, tender yet tough.

desc_chs: 被称为「杰万」的年轻勇士，据说坚强的鹰羽就是他们的象征。
desc_en: The brave young ones known as Javans are said to have this tough eagle feather as their symbol.

desc_chs: 只是用稚嫩的手法编织而成的护身符，不知道有什么含义，附着的草元素让其上的花朵长时间保持着被摘下来后的新鲜状态。但除了其上附着的草元素，确实没有其他的特殊之处。
desc_en: A talisman woven with childish skills. Its meaning remains unknown. The Dendro energy in it keeps the flower fresh for a long time. But apart from that, there is nothing special about this talisman.

desc_chs: 在范兵卫的指定地点采集到的蘑菇。这些蘑菇虽然生长在树干上，但看起来也没什么特别之处。这些蘑菇总不会惹出什么麻烦了吧…
desc_en: Mushrooms collected at the location designated by Hanbei. Although these mushrooms grow on tree trunks, they don't look special at all. They aren't going to cause any trouble, are they?

desc_chs: 受地脉影响的须弥蔷薇，和平时相比略微有些不同…？
desc_en: A Sumeru Rose affected by the Ley Lines. It seems a little different from normal...

desc_chs:
「无镜之镜，照见诸戏。」
从上一处谜语所指示的宝箱里拿到的又一条谜语。
到底是谁写下的这些谜语呢…
或许，谜底就在与「戏」有关的场所附近…？
desc_en:
"A mirror not made of glass reflects every drama."
Another riddle you got from the chest indicated by the previous riddle.
Who wrote these riddles...
Maybe the answer is hidden somewhere associated with dramas?

desc_chs: 「通往知识的必经之路。」\n读起来意外直白的谜语。\n但「必经之路」又指的是哪里呢…
desc_en: "The sole path to knowledge."\nA riddle that is surprisingly straightforward to read.\nBut what does "the sole path" mean in this case?

desc_chs: 「池上之花，盛水为珠。」\n从箱子里拿到第三条谜语。\n也许…是在描述某种水上的植物？
desc_en: "The flowers in the pond are blooming, with watery pearls there lingering."\nThe third riddle found from a chest.\nPerhaps this might be some kind of plant?

desc_chs: 「请在正午之时，造访知识殿堂的正门。」\n这道谜语，就像是某种「邀请」…
desc_en: "Please go to the front door of the Temple of Knowledge at noon."\nThis riddle is like some kind of "invitation"...

desc_chs: 拉菲克购置的造船材料。据说花了他不少摩拉…
desc_en: Shipbuilding materials Rafiq bought. You've heard that these have cost him a fortune...

desc_chs: 看起来很普通的风干小花，却是一度珍贵的礼物，一定要好好珍惜它，正如珍惜往昔被遗忘的友谊。
desc_en: It looks like an ordinary little dried flower, but it was once a precious gift. It deserves to be cherished, just like the forgotten friendship of the past.

desc_chs: 名为「单手剑战斗技巧·八」的罐装知识，在派蒙的怂恿下以十万摩拉的价格从多莉摊位上购入。虽然不知道前七个在哪，但「战斗技巧」这种东西总会有用的…大概。
desc_en: Canned Knowledge labeled "Swordfighting Techniques VIII." It was bought from Dori's booth at the price of 100,000 Mora at Paimon's instigation. You have no idea where the first seven in the series are, but things like "Combat Techniques" will always be useful. Well, probably.

desc_chs: 愚人众研究员佩尔西科夫的手稿，手稿中包含着一份地图，根据地图上的指示，似乎能找到「知感拟态」装置所缺失的晶核…
desc_en: Notes penned by the Fatui researcher Persikov. These notes contain a map, and if you follow its instructions, you should be able to find the crystalline cores that the Cognitive Mimicry device is missing...

desc_chs: 维克多订购的木头，据他说会用于制作木雕。
desc_en: Viktor bought this. He claims that he'll use it to do wood carving.

desc_chs: 装有两份「绿汁脆球」的食盒。维克多和弗谢沃洛德应该已经有点饿了…
desc_en: A meal box containing two Panipuri. Viktor and Vsevolod should be a little hungry by now...

desc_chs: 被放在箱底的藏宝图。图上用简单的标记注明了「好东西」的所在。
desc_en: A treasure map placed at the bottom of a box. It indicates the location of the "good stuff" with simple markings.

desc_chs: 阻拦前路的元能构装体的一部分零件，似乎是对附近的机关产生了反应而不断闪烁。
desc_en: A piece of the Primal Construct that barred your path. This component seems to be reacting with nearby devices, constantly gleaming and glinting as it does.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。学者们认为这个文字最初的含义是谷地。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Either way, researchers believe this symbol to have initially stood for "valley."

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。其上铭刻的文字被普遍认为是鸟首的象形。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Most believe the etchings here symbolize a bird's head.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。学者们认为这个文字既是表音符号，可能也还有尊敬、服从的引申含义。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Either way, researchers believe this symbol to have been a phonetic symbol, and that its extended meanings may have included respect or submission.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。文字的形状应当来源于沙漠中的风暴。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The shape of this symbol should be derived from the storms that ravage the desert.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。其上的文字形似耳郭，但是也有学者持不同的意见。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol on this plate looks like an auricle, but a consensus has not been reached on this matter.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。大部分学者都认为这个文字表示树林，这意味着在过去的某个时间段，沙漠并不像现在这般荒芜。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? A majority of researchers believe this to represent the forest, and that this suggests that the modern-day desert was not always a desolate wasteland.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。其上的文字形状的来源应当是在沙漠中很少得见的闪电。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The shape of this symbol should be derived from the lightning that is ever so rare a sight in the desert.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。其上的文字表达的应该是凿锤悬挂在悬崖之上的危险态势，是稍晚时代才出现的文字。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol seems to indicate the hazardous circumstance of hanging a chisel hammer on a cliff, and is thought to have emerged at a later date.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。代表着凿锤的符号是最早出现的几个文字之一。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol for a chisel hammer is one of the earliest words to emerge.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。字形的来源应当是升起的太阳。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The origin of this symbol is the rising sun.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。字形恰似统治者端坐在御座之上。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? This symbol is the spitting image of a ruler seated upon a throne.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，虽然字形的来源不得而知，但是似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。其上铭刻的文字被普遍认为是羊首的象形。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building, though the origin of this writing seems unclear. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Most believe that the etchings here symbolize a sheep's head.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。其上铭刻的文字的来源应当是棘冠鳄的骇人巨口。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The source of this symbol is probably the Spinocrocodile's frighteningly huge maw.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。虽然知论派学者认为这个文字是巨蛇的象形符号，但是生论派学者则提出了不同意见：现在的大赤沙海中并没有蛇的踪迹。所以这个文字的来源至今仍有争议。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Though Haravatat researchers believe this to be a symbol for a giant serpent, Amurta researchers have proposed a different view, arguing that the Great Red Sand is not home to any snakes. As such, the meaning of and inspiration for this word is still being contested.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。其上的文字的最初含义应当是祭品，延伸出了祭祀的含义。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The original meaning of this symbol was most likely "sacrifice," with an extended meaning of "rites" or "ceremonies" emerging later.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。其上的文字与凿锤几乎同时出现，是最早出现的几个文字之一。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol here appeared at the same time as the chisel hammer, and is one of the earliest words to emerge.

desc_chs: 刻有古老文字的石板，似乎原本是某种构筑物的一部分。在沙海中沉睡了不知几许，又不知承载了谁人的祈愿。赤王时代留下的文献对各种形状的沙丘有不同的称呼，这给研究者带来了不小的麻烦。
desc_en: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The civilization from the era of King Deshret had different words for dunes of different shapes, something that has brought researchers no lack of headaches.

desc_chs: (test)废弃
和须弥蔷薇相比，金蔷薇是更适应沙漠环境的独特品种。为了生存，它不得不用泥巴与石头将自己保护起来，但在合适的环境中，就能绽放出自己原本的美丽模样。
desc_en: Compared to Sumeru Roses, Golden Roses are a unique species more suited to the deserts. To survive, it has had to protect itself with a shield of mud and stone, but in the right environment, it may yet recoup its original beauty.

desc_chs: 从赤王陵附近，透明的遗迹中找到的石板。似乎是已经失落的文明留下的记录…
desc_en: A stone slate that you found in the transparent ruins near the Mausoleum of King Deshret. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

desc_chs: 在吞羊岩镀金旅团秘密基地中发现的石板。似乎是已经失落的文明留下的记录…
desc_en: A stone slate that you found in the secret Eremite base within Lamb-Devourer Rock. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

name_en: Record of the Tomb of Carouses
desc_chs: 从饱饮之陵中找到的石板。似乎是已经失落的文明留下的记录…
desc_en: A stone slate that you found in the Tomb of Carouses. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

desc_chs: 教令院学者索赫尔年轻时进入沙漠考古时留下的笔记，看上去很古旧，但并没有皱褶。
desc_en: These are the notes left by Soheil, an Akademiya researcher, who entered the desert to study when he was young. They look very old, but they are not crinkled.

desc_chs: 自赤王陵的最高处获得的石板。似乎是已经失落的文明留下的记录…
desc_en: A stone slate that you found at the highest point of the Mausoleum of King Deshret. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

desc_chs: 《极夜幻想剧·王女执剑记！》的台本。潦草的字迹似乎是团长的批注，部分批注十分激进，想必不会被采纳吧。
desc_en: The script for "Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!" The meandering scribbles appended to the script seem to be annotations from the theater troupe head, some of which contain such radical instructions as to render their adoption unlikely in the extreme.

desc_chs: 刚刚采下的香辛果，很适合用于烹饪。
desc_en: A freshly picked Harra Fruit. Perfect for cooking.

desc_chs: 没有署名的纸条，不知道是何人所留…
desc_en: An unsigned note. No one knows who left it...

desc_chs: 由炼金术士哈贾娜德开发的装置，设计较为精巧，具有能够承受高压与高温的内部腔室，用以承载「重熔效应」的爆炸。特殊的阀门则能在适当的时机自动开启，释放充分混合后的药剂烟雾，为使用者提供战斗的助力。\n不过，从这个装置的部分细节可以判断，它似乎是压缩成本的实验品。哈贾娜德的研发资金好像并不充裕…
desc_en: This device, developed by alchemist Hajanad, is cleverly designed with an internal chamber capable of withstanding high pressure and high temperature to withstand the explosion from the "remelting effect". The special valve can be opened automatically at the right time to release the fully mixed medicament smoke and provide the user with assistance in combat. However, judging from some of its details, this experiment seems to be suffering from a shortage of funds. Hajanad's research doesn't seem to be all that well-funded...

desc_chs: 炼金术士哈贾娜德的倾力之作，极为特殊的固体药剂。理论上，这种炼金药剂能长期存放，便于携带和运输，还有着不错的安全性。不过在使用时，需要将片剂放入「重熔装置」内部，通过微型爆炸将两种固体药剂混合，以获得完整的药效。\n可是，一想到手中的装置内部会发生爆炸，总让人有点不安…
desc_en: A masterpiece of the alchemist Hajanad, a truly special solid potion. Theoretically, this alchemy tablet can be stored for a long time and is quite safe and easy to carry and transport. However, when in use, the tablet needs to be put into the "remelting device," where the two solid agents will be mixed via micro-explosion to obtain complete efficacy.\nAnd it is always a little disturbing to think that the device in hand may explode...

desc_chs: （test）雇主的命令
冒险阅历，用于提升冒险等阶
desc_en: Adventure EXP. Used to improve Adventure Rank.

desc_chs: 住在蒙德地区奔狼领，远离城市与人群，和狼一同生活的少年。直觉锐利，身姿迅捷。
desc_en: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

desc_chs: 从火元素结晶上剥落下来的晶片，吸收后可获得50点火元素能量
desc_en: A shard that broke off a larger Pyro Crystal. Gives 50 Pyro Energy when absorbed.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得50点火元素能量

desc_chs: 从水元素结晶上剥落下来的晶片，吸收后可获得50点水元素能量
desc_en: A shard that broke off a larger Hydro Crystal. Gives 50 Hydro Energy when absorbed.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得50点水元素能量
