desc_chs: (test)显示Cutscene的记忆球
(test)创建Group的记忆球
(test)传送玩家的记忆球
永远充满活力的女孩，骑士团最优秀，同时也是最后的侦察骑士。
desc_en: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.

desc_chs: 蒙德城诸多吟游诗人中的一位，自由自在地穿行在街头巷尾。
desc_en: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

desc_chs: 来自璃月，名声在外的少女厨师，对料理之道极具热情，拿手麻辣菜肴堪称一绝。
desc_en: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

desc_chs: 武装船队「南十字」的首领，豪快的大姐头。
desc_en: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

desc_chs: 经常能在书摊看到的少年人。手执长剑，胸中常怀侠义之心。
desc_en: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

desc_chs: 守护璃月的仙人，「夜叉」。美号「降魔大圣」，妙称「护法夜叉大将」。
desc_en: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

desc_chs: 「璃月七星」中的「天权」，其名下财富之多，全大陆鲜有人能望其项背。
desc_en: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

desc_chs: 西风骑士团禁闭室的常客，蒙德的爆破大师。人称「逃跑的太阳」。
desc_en: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius' confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

desc_chs: 角色小天赋点(包括主角)
desc_en: Small talent points (Including the main character)

desc_chs: 被「往生堂」请来的神秘客人，知识渊博，对各种事物都颇有见地。
desc_en: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

desc_chs: 从火属性的奇卡卡树上采摘的果实，食用后可获得30点火元素能量
desc_en: A fruit taken from a Pyro Jikaka tree. Gives 30 Pyro Energy when eaten.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得30点火元素能量

desc_chs: 从水属性的奇卡卡树上采摘的果实，食用后可获得30点水元素能量
desc_en: A fruit taken from the Hydro Jikaka tree. Gives 30 Hydro Energy when eaten.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得30点水元素能量

desc_chs: 从草属性的奇卡卡树上采摘的果实，食用后可获得30点草元素能量
desc_en: A fruit taken from the Dendro Jikaka tree. Gives 30 Dendro Energy when eaten.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得30点草元素能量

desc_chs: 从电属性的奇卡卡树上采摘的果实，食用后可获得30点电元素能量
desc_en: A fruit taken from the Electro Jikaka tree. Gives 30 Electro Energy when eaten.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得30点电元素能量

desc_chs: 从风属性的奇卡卡树上采摘的果实，食用后可获得30点风元素能量
desc_en: A fruit taken from the Anemo Jikaka tree. Gives 30 Anemo Energy when eaten.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得30点风元素能量

desc_chs: 从冰属性的奇卡卡树上采摘的果实，食用后可获得30点冰元素能量
desc_en: A fruit taken from the Cryo Jikaka tree. Gives 30 Cryo Energy when eaten.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得30点冰元素能量

desc_chs: 从岩属性的奇卡卡树上采摘的果实，食用后可获得30点岩元素能量
desc_en: A fruit taken from the Geo Jikaka tree. Gives 30 Geo Energy when eaten.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得30点岩元素能量

desc_chs: 从无属性的奇卡卡树上采摘的果实，食用后可获得30点无属性能量
desc_en: A fruit taken from a Standard Jikaka tree. Gives 30 Elemental Energy when eaten.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍角色获得30点无属性能量

desc_chs: 自称「断罪之皇女」，与名为奥兹的漆黑夜鸦同行的神秘少女。
desc_en: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

desc_chs: 蒙德的冒险家少年，拥有与他的善良毫不相称的霉运。
desc_en: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

desc_chs: 愚人众执行官第十一位，「公子」，其战绩威名远扬。
desc_en: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

desc_chs: 「西风骑士团」的可靠女仆，梦想有一天能成为正式的骑士。
desc_en: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

desc_chs: 药庐「不卜庐」的采药姑娘兼学徒，面色苍白如纸的不死之人。话很少，也没有什么表情。
desc_en: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

desc_chs: 驱邪世家的年轻方士，为压制自身的「纯阳之体」费尽心机。
desc_en: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

desc_chs: 月海亭的秘书，体内流淌着仙兽「麒麟」的血脉。
desc_en: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

desc_chs: 西风骑士团首席炼金术士兼调查小队队长，被称做「白垩之子」的天才。
desc_en: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

desc_chs: 遗传了稀薄的「非人」血统的少女，「猫尾酒馆」的超人气调酒师。
desc_en: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

desc_chs: 角色大天赋点(包括主角)
desc_en: Large talent points (Including the main character)

desc_chs: 角色经验素材，含有1000点经验值。\n如果不在大陆七国生活，这些经验还是很必要的。
desc_en: Character EXP material. Gives 1,000 EXP.\nThese experiences are still beneficial even if one does not live in Teyvat.

desc_chs: 角色经验素材，含有5000点经验值。\n如果踏上了前人未至的秘境，这些经验还是很重要的。
desc_en: Character EXP material. Gives 5,000 EXP.\nThese experiences are very beneficial for journeys into the unknown.

desc_chs: 角色经验素材，含有20000点经验值。\n如果向往着天空岛而在大陆开始巡礼，这些经验可称得上弥足珍贵。
desc_en: Character EXP material. Gives 20,000 EXP.\nThese experiences are extremely precious for a pilgrim traveling through Teyvat in order to be closer to Celestia.

desc_chs: 武器经验素材，含有400点经验值。\n蕴含着无限可能性的精炼矿锭，可以用来强化武器。
desc_en: Weapon EXP material. Gives 400 EXP.\nA refined ingot with endless possibilities that can be used to enhance weapons.

desc_chs: 武器经验素材，含有2000点经验值。\n出于某种原理，武器可以吸收这种特殊的精矿，来变得更强大。
desc_en: Weapon EXP material. Gives 2,000 EXP.\nFor reasons unknown, this special and refined ore can be absorbed by weapons to greatly increase their strengths.

desc_chs: 武器经验素材，含有10000点经验值。\n传说，精炼的矿锭中凝结了大地上战斗的记忆。而受益于这些记忆的兵器，自然也是有灵魂的了。
desc_en: Weapon EXP material. Gives 10,000 EXP.\nLegend has it that this refined ingot contains the memories of battles that had taken place in the land. The weapons that benefit from these memories naturally become sentient.

desc_chs: 神秘的少女占星术士，声称自己是「伟大的占星术士莫娜」，拥有与名号相符的不俗实力，博学而高傲。
desc_en: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「欢迎来到世界。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"Welcome to this world."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「欢迎来到世界。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"Welcome to this world."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「欢迎来到世界。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"Welcome to this world."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「欢迎来到世界。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"Welcome to this world."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。
desc_en: Character Ascension material.

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「为了愿望而步上巡礼，为了最强之名而云聚争斗…」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"A pilgrimage for a wish; a battle to earn a name..."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「为了愿望而步上巡礼，为了最强之名而云聚争斗…\n「最后为了梦在劫火中燃尽。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"A pilgrimage for a wish; a battle to earn a name...\nBurnt to cinders for a dream."

desc_chs:
角色突破素材。
「为了愿望而步上巡礼，为了最强之名而云聚争斗…
「最后为了梦在劫火中燃尽。
「灰烬中如果留下了最初的心，那他就达成了██的真实。」
desc_en:
Character Ascension material.
"A pilgrimage for a wish; a battle to earn a name...
Burnt to cinders for a dream.
If the intention yet remains, achieved ██'s truth he has."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。
desc_en: Character Ascension material.

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「我的理想之内并没有一丝污浊。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"My ideals have no stains."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「我的理想之内并没有一丝污浊。\n「我要纠正你，在这里，人并不对神背负罪孽…」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"My ideals have no stains.\nI must correct you. People here bear no sins in the eyes of the gods..."

desc_chs:
角色突破素材。
「我的理想之内并没有一丝污浊。
「我要纠正你，在这里，人并不对神背负罪孽，能下达判决的只有法律与裁判庭。
「他们甚至连我也可以裁判。赞美我的崇高与纯洁吧。」
desc_en:
Character Ascension material.
"My ideals have no stains.
I must correct you. People here bear no sins in the eyes of the gods... Only laws and the Tribunal can judge someone.
They can judge even me. So praise my magnificence and purity."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。
desc_en: Character Ascension material.

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「我做了一个很长很长的梦…」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"I had a very, very long dream..."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「我做了一个很长很长的梦…\n「人们手握着手转圈。贤人与愚者，舞女与勇士，人偶与神像…」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"I had a very, very long dream..."\n"In it, people were holding hands, dancing in a circle, be they sages or fools, dancers or warriors, puppets or statues of gods..."

desc_chs:
角色突破素材。
「我做了一个很长很长的梦…
「人们手握着手转圈。贤人与愚者，舞女与勇士，人偶与神像…
「大家的欢舞里蕴藏着宇宙的一切。『生命』一直都是目的，『智慧』才是手段。」
desc_en:
Character Ascension material.
"I had a very, very long dream..."
"In it, people were holding hands, dancing in a circle, be they sages or fools, dancers or warriors, puppets or statues of gods..."
"That dancing circle embodied everything about the universe. Life has always been the end, while it is wisdom that shall be the means."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。
desc_en: Character Ascension material.

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「此身即是尘世最为殊胜尊贵之身。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"This body is the noblest and most eminent of all in this world."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「此身即是尘世最为殊胜尊贵之身。\n「应持天下之大权。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"This body is the noblest and most eminent of all in this world.\nIt should hold absolute control over this world."

desc_chs:
角色突破素材。
「此身即是尘世最为殊胜尊贵之身。
「应持天下之大权。
「此身曾许诺予臣民一梦，即是千世万代不变不移的『永恒』。」
desc_en:
Character Ascension material.
"This body is the noblest and most eminent of all in this world.
"It should hold absolute control over this world.
"It once promised its people a dream: the never-changing 'eternity.'"

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。
desc_en: Character Ascension material.

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「但风向是会转变的。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"Still, the winds change direction."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「但风向是会转变的。\n「终有一天，会吹向更有光亮的方向。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"Still, the winds change direction.\nSomeday, they will blow towards a brighter future..."

desc_chs:
角色突破素材。
「但风向是会转变的。
「终有一天，会吹向更有光亮的方向。
「从今往后，带着我的祝福，活得更加从容一些吧。」
desc_en:
Character Ascension material.
"Still, the winds change direction.
"Someday, they will blow towards a brighter future...
"Take my blessings and live leisurely from this day onward."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。
desc_en: Character Ascension material.

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「…抱歉…」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"Sorry..."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「…抱歉…\n「让你们一起和我背负了整个世界的哀思。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"Sorry..."\n"...to also have you shoulder the grievances of the world."

desc_chs:
角色突破素材。
「…抱歉让你们一起和我背负了整个世界的哀思。
「你们既然能忍受我的苦寒，那心中一定都有炽烈的欲望吧？
「那么，替我燃烧旧世界吧。」
desc_en:
Character Ascension material.
"Sorry... to also have you shoulder the grievances of the world.
"Since you could endure my bitter cold, you must have the desire to burn?
"Then, burn away the old world for me."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。
desc_en: Character Ascension material.

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「大陆所流通的一切银钱皆是我的血肉。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"The currencies that flow through this land are my flesh and blood."

desc_chs: 角色突破素材。\n「大陆所流通的一切银钱皆是我的血肉。\n「我在以这样的方式，为人类一切的汗水、智慧和未来做担保。」
desc_en: Character Ascension material.\n"The currencies that flow through this land are my flesh and blood.\nFor thus did I become the guarantor of the people's hard work, wisdom, and future."

desc_chs:
角色突破素材。
「大陆所流通的一切银钱皆是我的血肉。
「我在以这样的方式，为人类一切的汗水、智慧和未来做担保。
「这是我对众生的信任，辜负了它就是玷污了我的血。」
desc_en:
Character Ascension material.
"The currencies that flow through this land are my flesh and blood.
For thus did I become the guarantor of the people's hard work, wisdom, and future.
This is the trust I have placed in them. Betray it, and you taint my blood."

desc_chs: 璃月七星之一，玉衡星。对「帝君一言而决的璃月」颇有微词——但实际上，神挺欣赏她这样的人。
desc_en: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis' unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

desc_chs: 能够使元素突破材料发生变质，转变其元素属性的道具。\n刨除实用目的的话，炼金术实际上是研讨物质本质与其变化规律的学科，最终通向的是世界运转、地脉流通的规律。\n不知何者出于何种目的，在地上的文明当中散布的这种炼金术的极高成就产物，具有扭转完全惰性化结晶后的元素物质的能力。虽然相当便利实用，但也隐藏着打破平衡的巨大危险性…
desc_en: A device that can transmute elemental Ascension Materials and change their Elemental Type.\nIts practical uses notwithstanding, alchemy is the study of the nature of matter and the rules that underpin its transformations, and ultimately it seeks to comprehend the working principles of the world and the flow of the ley lines.\nIt is not known who would share alchemical achievements of this magnitude with the civilizations of the world and why. But although the power to fundamentally transmute elemental energy in its crystallized and inert form is a highly useful one, this device also conceals the grave danger of disrupting the elemental balance...

desc_chs: 对万物充满好奇的炼金术士，「生物炼金」学派的研究者。
desc_en: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

desc_chs: 上限突破所需的珍贵素材。\n尚未成为既定命运一部分的无主的命星，等待一个声音，将它重新织入世界的歌谣。
desc_en: A precious material required for raising Ascension Limits.\nA Masterless Stella Fortuna, adrift apart from the flow of fate. It awaits a voice to weave it once more into the song of the world.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n风之国土的精神是自由。\n自由其一，是生存的自由，即是能健全、健康地生活，而不必担心朝不保夕的自由。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nFreedom is the spirit of the land of the wind.\nThe freedom to live is one of such. It is the freedom to live freely and healthily without concerns of one's own safety.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n风之国土的精神是自由。\n自由其二，是漫游的自由，即是能在苍翠的土地上自由地通行，而不受阻挠的自由。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nFreedom is the spirit of the land of the wind.\nThe freedom of travel is one of such. It is the freedom to traverse the land freely without being obstructed.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n风之国土的精神是自由。\n自由其三，是歌唱的自由，即是能在风之神塑造的美好土地上歌唱，让自己的心与歌一同随风而去的自由。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nFreedom is the spirit of the land of the wind.\nTo sing is one such freedom. To sing on the land created by the Anemo Archon is to send your heart away with the song on the wind.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n风之国土的脊梁是抗争。\n蒙德的历史即是抗争的历史。抗争是为了蒙德过去的一切抗争不被遗忘，如同草木突破土壤，如同恒风洞穿石墙。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nResistance is the backbone of the land of the wind.\nThe history of Mondstadt is one of resistances. People rose up to prevent past conflicts from ever being forgotten, like sprouts breaking through the soil, like the eternal wind eroding through stone walls.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n风之国土的脊梁是抗争。\n蒙德的历史即是抗争的历史。抗争是为了蒙德现在的人们能够拥有自由，正如风之神吹散冰雪，正如温妮莎奋起抗争。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nResistance is the backbone of the city of Wind.\nThe history of Mondstadt is one of resistances. People rose up to grant the citizens of Mondstadt the freedom they now enjoy, like the Anemo Archon blowing away the snow, or like Vennessa rising up to fight.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n风之国土的脊梁是抗争。\n蒙德的历史即是抗争的历史。抗争是为了蒙德未来的诗文，也能自由地随着眷顾的风，传到远方。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nResistance is the backbone of the land of the wind.\nThe history of Mondstadt is one of resistances. People rose up to allow the future Mondstadt's poetry to freely be that of the wind and be spread across the land.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n风之国土的灵魂是诗文。\n诗文是美好的心意。在美好的日子里，吹拂原野的风中飘扬着田园诗、情诗，如和风拨动草叶般拨动人们的心。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nPoetry is the soul of the land of the wind.\nPoetry is the manifestations of beautiful feelings. On a beautiful day, the breezes carry with them poetry that touches the heart of people like the wind caressing the leaves.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n风之国土的灵魂是诗文。\n诗文是激励的心意。在黯淡的日子里，穿过巷道的风中低语着愤怒的诗文，如同战鼓，如同风暴前的低鸣。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nPoetry is the soul of the land of the wind.\nPoetry is the manifestations of the will to encourage. In the dark days, the gales in the streets and alleyways whisper words of fury, like the battle drums, like the low rumbling before the storm.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n风之国土的灵魂是诗文。\n诗文是传颂的心意。即使一切都将逝去，即使一切都将不再，随风而行的诗歌，仍会将此世间一切美好传遍天空、大地与海洋的一切角落。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nPoetry is the soul of the land of the wind.\nPoetry is the manifestations of the desire to spread the word. Though nothing is eternal, though nothing will be the same, the wind's poetry will still spread beyond the skies, the land, the seas to every corner of the world.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n岩之国土的追求是繁荣。\n繁荣是璃月的恩惠，是璃月的神与人共同建立的伟大城市，是璃月的大地安全和平的源泉。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nProsperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.\nProsperity is the blessing of Liyue, it is the foundation of the great city built by the gods and the people of Liyue, and it is the source of the peace and safety of the land.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n岩之国土的追求是繁荣。\n繁荣是璃月对它的子女的许诺：以繁荣回报勤劳者，以黄金照亮这片土地。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nProsperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.\nProsperity is the promise made by Liyue to its children: To repay the hard-working laborers with enough gold to brighten up this land.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n岩之国土的追求是繁荣。\n繁荣是璃月的过去、现在与未来。在此世间一切国度都无法企及的繁荣，均归于璃月，以及璃月的子女。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nProsperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.\nProsperity is Liyue's past, present, and future. This prosperity is unmatched and unobtainable by any other nations — it all belongs to Liyue and its inhabitants.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n岩之国土的根基是勤劳。\n勤劳即为通过人的努力，克服高山与大海，追求繁荣与黄金的勇气与力量。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nIndustriousness is the foundation of the land of Geo.\nDiligence is having the bravery and the strength to conquer mountains and seas and to pursue gold and prosperity through honest, hard work.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n岩之国土的根基是勤劳。\n勤劳是流传在璃月人血脉中的催化剂，能将岩石化为黄金，是伟大商港之所以为伟大商港的原因。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nIndustriousness is the foundation of the land of Geo.\nIndustriousness is the catalyst that flows in the blood of the people of Liyue, able to turn rocks into gold. It is what lies behind the greatness of its great commercial port.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n岩之国土的根基是勤劳。\n勤劳即为相信自己，即为相信通过汗水、智慧与力量，在诸神的土地上，人人都可以拥有自己的一席之地。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nIndustriousness is the foundation of the land of Geo.\nIndustriousness is believing in one's own ability to earn a place in the land of the gods through sweat, wisdom, and power.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n岩之国土的象征是黄金。\n黄金是流淌在璃月土地深处的血液，是鼓动璃月的心脏有力搏动的肌肉，是让璃月傲然挺立的筋骨。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nGold is the symbol of the land of Geo.\nGold is the blood that flows deep within Liyue's veins, the muscle that makes up Liyue's beating heart, and the bones that make Liyue stand proud.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n岩之国土的象征是黄金。\n黄金意味着转换，这是璃月的岩山、大地、港城与人们的默契。在璃月，勤劳被转换为黄金，而黄金被转换为繁荣。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nGold is the symbol of the land of Geo.\nGold symbolizes conversion. This is the unspoken understanding between Liyue's mountains, land, city, and people. In Liyue, industriousness is converted into gold, and gold into prosperity.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n岩之国土的象征是黄金。\n黄金是璃月的财富。但璃月真正的财富，是璃月的人们那如黄金般闪耀的心灵。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nGold is the symbol of the land of Geo.\nGold is the wealth of Liyue, but Liyue's true wealth is the hearts of its people that shine like gold.

desc_chs: 提升天赋所需的珍贵素材。\n远古时期，承载与传授智识所用的仪式器具。尽管如今，智慧居于言语及典籍中，但「智识之冕」中残存的力量与智慧仍能给如今的人们带来伟大的突破吧。
desc_en: A precious Talent Level-Up material.\nOnce a medium for the storage and transfer of wisdom in ancient times. Now, wisdom is found in ancient texts and in profound speech. Nevertheless, this Crown of Insight must still be able to impart some transcendent power and wisdom to its bearer.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n雷之国土的梦想是浮世。\n浮世之荣华乃是人之美的最高体现。人之在世岂不与疾电相类？如美梦或花火般浮华一瞬，在永恒的夜幕中留下绚烂的印记。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nTransience is the dream of the nation of thunder.\nFleeting glories are the highest expression of mortal beauty, for are we mortals not like the flashing lightning itself? Like a lovely dream or blossoming spark, we shall leave a gorgeous mark on the eternal night sky.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n雷之国土的梦想是浮世。\n浮世之难求乃是人之美的价值所在。人之在世岂不与雷影相似？意欲追逐掇取则遥踞云端，灯火阑珊的静谧之时却不期而来。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nTransience is the dream of the nation of thunder.\nWe find the greatest joys in mortal life in transient dreams, for is life itself not like the shadow of the thunder? Pursue your dreams into the clouds if you wish, and enjoy the unexpected silence of the dim lamp-lit nights.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n雷之国土的梦想是浮世。\n浮世之短暂乃是人之美的本性所在。人之在世岂不与稻光相近？神威显现的刹那恍若隽永，而永恒的威鸣又有谁人能够承受？
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nTransience is the dream of the nation of thunder.\nThe fleeting nature of this mortal world is the essence of beauty, for are our lives in this world not akin to the levin flash? Yet the might of the divine comes suddenly, and before the roar of eternity, who can stand?

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n雷之国土的姿容是风雅。\n风雅是不谄媚。风雅之人永远是高贵的。正似只愿高飞与雷暴争鸣的海鹰；迎合鄙俗则恰如将花冠倒插泥淖，仅让尊严染上了污渍。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nElegance is the form of the nation of thunder.\nElegance brooks no flattery, and the elegant are ever noble. They are like the sea eagles who soar on high to contend with the resounding storms. They will not cater to philistine vulgarity, as one would not cast a flower crown into the mud, staining its dignity.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n雷之国土的姿容是风雅。\n风雅是不倨傲。风雅之人永远是谦虚的。只有消除虚荣与怠慢，才能明亮双眼，从哪怕最不堪入目的表象之下寻求美与雅致的真境。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nElegance is the form of the nation of thunder.\nElegance shuns arrogance. The elegant are ever humble, and only by discarding vanity and sloth may one see clearly — and is there not beauty and loveliness even in the basest of appearances?

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n雷之国土的姿容是风雅。\n风雅是不庸俗。风雅之人永远是独行的。不屈于平庸之恶，不感动于平庸之爱，不逃避于平庸的无知，才可能明辨何为雅致与鄙陋。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nElegance is the form of the nation of thunder.\nElegance abhors vulgarity, and the elegant ever walk alone. Resisting base evils, unmoved by base loves, never taking refuge in base ignorance — that is how one perceives the chasm between the elegant and the contemptuous.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n雷之国土的愿望是天光。\n自认通透一切的大君，永远企图将高天之光彩尽收囊中。然而无从分享的愿景，却反令须臾之人更加炽烈地追求，犹如飞蛾扑火。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nLight is the yearning of the land of thunder.\nThe ruler who claims to have perceived all forever aims to hoard celestial glory. But this vision that cannot be shared only leads people to long for it more fiercely, like moths diving into the flame.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n雷之国土的愿望是天光。\n即使晖光被重重雷云所掩盖，鸣神的国土之上，依旧有志士如云雀般突破雷光与天之怒海，追寻天光之迹，哪怕迎来冷酷的殛灭。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nLight is the yearning of the land of thunder.\nThough the sun rays themselves should be blocked by layers upon layers of clouds, there are still those in the thunder god's land who dream of piercing that wrathful sea of lightning to pursue the glory of the divine, fearing not that they shall be cruelly struck down.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n雷之国土的愿望是天光。\n即使永远生活在地下，人也会不屈地祈求天光。人总是追逐超越，无可止步。静止封闭的永恒亦固然壮丽，但其本质终究是死亡。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nLight is the yearning of the land of thunder.\nThough they must live forever on the earth, humanity will always reach for the light. Mortals will pursue and surpass, and they will never stop. A sealed eternity may, perhaps, look magnificent, but its essence is death.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「诤言」是智慧之国的枝干。\n诤言出于纯净的心智。唯有清醒纯善的言语，方能表达深秘的智慧，令睿智之种突破傲慢的壅阻，生根繁茂。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nAdmonition is the branches of the nation of wisdom.\nAdmonition comes from a pure heart. Only sensible words of goodwill can express profound wisdom and free the sprout of knowledge from the shackles of arrogance.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「诤言」是智慧之国的枝干。\n诤言相伴巧妙的思虑。多思多虑方能出言谦逊明晰，令智者折服，使愚者醒悟，让智慧如川流一般畅通不息。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nAdmonition is the branches of the nation of wisdom.\nAdmonition is paired with wise thinking. Careful deliberation affords humble words a clarity that convinces the wise and enlightens the foolish. Such words allow wisdom to flow like an unobstructed river.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「诤言」是智慧之国的枝干。\n诤言终于至善的操行。行为赋予言语真实含义，言、思、行的协同一致，是令智慧之树结出善果的丰厚养分。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nAdmonition is the branches of the nation of wisdom.\nAdmonition is completed by good deeds. What is done confers real meaning upon what is said. When one's mind, words, and deeds are aligned, their nourishment shall guarantee the fruition of wisdom's tree.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「巧思」是智慧之国的叶脉。\n巧思生自良善的意旨。所谓「毒树不结善果」，良善坚定的意念才能孕育巧妙周到的思谋，方不玷污智慧之名。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nIngenuity is the leaf-veins of the nation of wisdom.\nIngenuity springs forth from benevolent consideration. They say that "a poisonous tree bears no kind fruit." Similarly, ingenious nascent ideas are always born from determined and benign minds, for only they are worthy bearers of wisdom.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「巧思」是智慧之国的叶脉。\n巧思引导正直的言语。巧妙而周密的向善思索，令出口之言不偏离福祉之正道；怠慢与歹意则令言行卑劣不堪。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nIngenuity is the leaf-veins of the nation of wisdom. Ingenuity sets words of integrity on the right path. One who thinks out of goodwill and in a clever and careful fashion never deviates from the path of boons. Yet one who thinks with contempt and malice shall taint their words with despicable colors.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「巧思」是智慧之国的叶脉。\n巧思成于谐和的品行。行为赋予思想完美形态，思、言、行的彼此印证，是令智慧之树绽放出花朵的忠实基干。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nIngenuity is the leaf-veins of the nation of wisdom.\nIngenuity is completed by harmonious conduct. What is done completes what is thought. Wisdom blooms where the mind, words, and practice converge.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「笃行」是智慧之国的根系。\n笃行源于明晰的真性。不懈求索的实践，正是一切智慧最终显现的必经之途。不拘善行，明思与雅言亦无土壤。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nPraxes are the roots of the nation of wisdom.\nPraxes stem from an unwavering will. All wisdom is manifested through the unyielding pursuit of goodness. Where goodness is not practiced, ingenuity and eloquence wither.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「笃行」是智慧之国的根系。\n笃行印证直率的言说。所思所行皆是为善，仍不可称之为智慧。智慧孕育于行动之中，为正直的言语篆下封印。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nPraxes are the roots of the nation of wisdom.\nPraxes validate words of honesty. Though one speaks and acts out of goodwill, one has not yet obtained wisdom. Wisdom, born from action, is a signet pressed upon honest words.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「笃行」是智慧之国的根系。\n笃行促生智慧的果实。行为实证行为本身的意义，行、言、思的联结一体，是令贤智之人得见完美的唯一通途。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nPraxes are the roots of the nation of wisdom.\nPraxes bring forth the fruit of wisdom. Practice grants itself meaning, and it is only by treading a path that unites action, speech, and thought that the wise may reach perfection.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n水之国土的堤岸是公平。\n公平限制了权利的边界。若无公平，律法赋予的权利亦会被滥用，成为损害善良风俗的工具。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shore of the Nation of Water is equity.\nEquity sets boundaries on rights. Without equity, the rights granted by law will be abused, and become a tool to damage our virtuous customs.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n水之国土的堤岸是公平。\n公平是枫丹立国的基础。公平形成了律法的准绳。假若律法失去公平的本质，必沦为敛利的棋盘。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shore of the Nation of Water is equity.\nEquity is the foundation upon which Fontaine was founded. Equity forms the standard of the law. If law loses the essence of equity, it will become a chessboard played for profit.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n水之国土的堤岸是公平。\n公平是枫丹立国的基础。公平总是需要稳固的道德与律法加以支撑，道德与律法亦基于不变的公平准则而流变不息。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shore of the Nation of Water is equity.\nEquity is the foundation upon which Fontaine was founded. Equity requires the continuous and steady support of morality and law, and morality and law constantly change based upon the invariant principle of equity.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n水之国土的利剑是正义。\n枫丹的律法秉正义之剑而行。若无正义的准则，一切律法将沦为无力的空文，任人篡改宰割。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe sword of the Nation of Water is justice.\nThe law of Fontaine walks with the sword of justice in hand. Without the guidance of justice, all law is reduced to meaningless words, to be tampered with and slaughtered at a whim.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n水之国土的利剑是正义。\n枫丹的律法秉正义之剑而行。正义必定是盲目的，以正义为利剑者，不论利益或私情都无法蛊惑。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe sword of the Nation of Water is justice.\nThe law of Fontaine walks with the sword of justice in hand. Justice must be blind, and those who wield the sword of justice must not be led astray by their own interests or affairs.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n水之国土的利剑是正义。\n枫丹的律法秉正义之剑而行。正义意味着裁决与调和，以裁决的剑锋遏止恶行，以调和的手段维护秩序。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe sword of the Nation of Water is justice.\nThe law of Fontaine walks with the sword of justice in hand. Justice means judgment and reconciliation, the blade of judgment arrests the actions of evil, while reconciliation maintains order.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n水之国土的坚盾是秩序。\n枫丹的一切律法终究服务于稳固的秩序。若无秩序的存在，混沌的乱流中自然亦无公平可言。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shield of the Nation of Water is order.\nAll law in Fontaine ultimately serves to maintain a stable order. Without order, there is chaos, and there can be no fairness in chaos.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n水之国土的坚盾是秩序。\n枫丹的一切律法终究服务于稳固的秩序。若无秩序的保证，正义也将沦为无止境的暴力，成为一切人反对一切人的武器。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shield of the Nation of Water is order.\nAll law in Fontaine ultimately serves to maintain a stable order. Without the guarantee provided by order, justice will be reduced to unlimited violence, a weapon used by all against all.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n水之国土的坚盾是秩序。\n枫丹的一切律法终究服务于稳固的秩序。公平与正义源于秩序，亦服务于秩序。正如枫丹恒无风浪的绵延水面那般，秩序构成了枫丹存在的基石。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shield of the Nation of Water is order.\nAll law in Fontaine ultimately serves to maintain a stable order. Equity and justice come from order, and serve order. Like the still, ripple-less surface of the waters of Fontaine, order is the cornerstone of Fontaine's existence.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n火之国土的原则是角逐。\n何为强大者，何为弱小者？唯有胜败彰示着一切，角逐的结果，比任何话语更有说服力。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nContention is the principle by which all is weighed in the Nation of Pyro.\nWhat defines strength, and what weakness? Only victory and defeat. The results of a contest are more convincing than any words.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n火之国土的原则是角逐。\n人无法与有翼的兽比较飞行的速度，无法与史莱姆比较身躯的柔软，但人自有卓然之处。有时，为何要进行角逐，如何进行角逐，正是认清自己的关键。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nContention is the principle by which all is weighed in the Nation of Pyro.\nThough humans cannot fly at the speed of winged beasts, nor match the flexibility of slimes, yet still, they have their own unique strengths. Sometimes, understanding both why and how to compete is the key to knowing oneself.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n火之国土的原则是角逐。\n角逐是为了让自身更加强大，在一场角逐的胜负落定之后，胜利者从中获得确立自己方向的自信，失败者获得如何变得强大的启示。在胜负之外，这是角逐真正的意义。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nContention is the principle by which all is weighed in the Nation of Pyro.\nIts purpose is to make yourself stronger. After the outcome of a competition has been decided, the victor gains the confidence to be sure of their direction, while the loser gains insights on how they must become stronger. Beyond winning or losing, this is the true meaning of contention.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n火之国土的成规是焚燔。\n有所取，即要有所予。想要得到，首先要付出相应的代价，正如应在焚燔中献上的祭品。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nOffering up kindling is the established rule of the Nation of Pyro.\nFor something gained, something must be given. If you wish to obtain something, you must first pay the corresponding price, just like the offerings that should be made as kindling in the process of incineration.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n火之国土的成规是焚燔。\n想要取得多少的东西，就要付出相应量级的代价。有时为了得到而付出太多，有时却付出的不足而无法得到。能够认识如何正确的付出与得到，也是焚燔的意义之一。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nOffering up kindling is the established rule of the Nation of Pyro.\nTo acquire a certain amount of something, one must first pay the corresponding price. Sometimes, you may end up paying too much to obtain something; while other times, you may pay too little, and lose it as a result. Understanding how to strike this balance between giving and receiving is one of the meanings of offering kindling.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n火之国土的成规是焚燔。\n所谓的焚燔，是在得到之前，先献出代价，但往往并非一定会有回应与回报。不求回报地付出代价，才是焚燔的真意，因为取得成果的日子终究会到来。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nOffering up kindling is the established rule of the Nation of Pyro.\nWhat is meant by offering kindling is to offer up a sacrifice before one obtains something, though it does not always guarantee a response or return. Its true meaning lies in paying a price without expecting a reward — for in the end, the day when the fruits will be reaped is sure to come.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n火之国土的事理是纷争。\n不去避让矛盾，而是直面冲突，在纷争的结果彰显后，根据此结果决定将行的道路。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nConflict is considered reason in the Nation of Pyro.\nRather than avoiding conflict, one should face confrontations head-on. Once the outcome has been made manifest, the path forward should be determined accordingly.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n火之国土的事理是纷争。\n纷争永远能够被更高层面的力量介入并解决，而非不可收拾，这让一切都得以进入可控的境地。纷争亦是一种局限，禁止不计成本地推诿下去，而是要求参与方更干净利落地得出结果。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nConflict is considered reason in the Nation of Pyro.\nConflicts can always be resolved by greater powers. This fact means that they can always be managed, as opposed to developing into something uncontrollable. Conflict is also a kind of limitation, preventing people from endless shirking of responsibilities without weighing the costs. It demands that participants settle their scores decisively and efficiently.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n火之国土的事理是纷争。\n纷争的前提是，参与争端的人都会真诚地面对自己的欲望，面对欲望，然后在争辩或战斗之中，才不会忘记自己想要取得的东西，也不会偏离原本的目的。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\nConflict is considered reason in the Nation of Pyro.\nThe premise of conflict is that all parties involved must confront their own desires with the utmost sincerity. Only then, amid the fight or debate, can they remain mindful of what they wish to achieve and stay true to their original objectives.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「月光」是月下之地的祝福。\n物有大小不一，人有贤愚不齐。但在月光之下，一切都是平等的。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Moonlight" is the blessing of the land beneath the moon.\nThings come in all sizes, and people come in all states of wisdom. Yet under the moonlight, all are equal.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「月光」是月下之地的祝福。\n云中之月的光芒，相对于幽暗无垠的荒野是如此微弱，然而在漫漫长夜中，引导人们前行的却总是那一缕微光。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Moonlight" is the blessing of the land beneath the moon.\nThe cloud-veiled moonlight glows but faintly over the boundless dark wilds. Yet its fragile glimmer is a guide through the endless night.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「月光」是月下之地的祝福。\n于新月初升之时向天空之月祈求启示与祝福，是从初民的时代流传至今的仪式。今夜的月光似乎与过去的每一夜并无不同，但人们曾仰望的那轮新月又在何方？
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Moonlight" is the blessing of the land beneath the moon.\nPraying to the new moon for guidance and fortune is a rite passed down from the days of the first people. Tonight's moonlight seems no different from any other night, yet where is the new moon that people once looked to?

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「乐园」是月下之地的狂想。\n有人不择手段地想进来，也有人拼了命地想出去。或许乐园就是你永远无法抵达的地方。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.\nThere are those who are desperate to get in, and those who are desperate to get out. Perhaps Elysium is not a place one can ever truly reach.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「乐园」是月下之地的狂想。\n在满溢着苦涩与悲泣的大地上，创造出没有界限亦没有差别的乐园。虽说这不过是孩子气的妄想，但那同样也是创造未来的基石。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.\nTo create a paradise without borders or distinctions upon a land overflowing with bitterness and sorrow — though it might be but a childish delusion, it may yet be a foundation for the future.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「乐园」是月下之地的狂想。\n乐园的定义因人而异。对那些从不安于现状的人而言，再也没有比挪德卡莱更适合称作乐园的地方了。但对剩下的人来说，情况则恰恰相反。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.\nSeldom do we share the same dreams of paradise. For those who wish not to settle for the present, there is no greater paradise than Nod-Krai. Yet for all the rest, the truth is quite the opposite.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「浪迹」是月下之地的生活。\n安享短暂的休整，于黑夜到来前启程。黎明并非终点，而是另一次旅途的开幕。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Vagrancy" is the living of the land beneath the moon.\nEnjoy a moment's respite, then depart before the sky turns black. Dawn is not the end, but the beginning of another journey.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「浪迹」是月下之地的生活。\n生命与流浪本身并无差别，无人在世间永远驻留，不过是暂作停歇。值得纪念的不是抵达终点的时刻，而是沿途留下的足迹。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Vagrancy" is the living of the land beneath the moon.\nTo live is to wander, for none of us can settle in this world. What is remembered is not the moment of arrival, but the footprints that we leave along the way.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「浪迹」是月下之地的生活。\n穿越雷霆与风暴，跨过山峦和雪原，即便遍体鳞伤，也绝不就此驻足。浪迹之人之所以还没有停下脚步，是因为他们还没有找到可以称之为「家」的地方。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Vagrancy" is the living of the land beneath the moon.\nThrough thunder and storms, across mountains and snowfields, though scarred and weary, the wanderer does not stop — nor will they till they find a place to call home.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「慈爱」是冰之国土的救赎。\n慈爱是凡人之间的爱护与守望。在广袤的土地上，人们凭此抵御霜雪带来的寒冷，抚平铭刻在记忆里的伤痕。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nCharity is the salvation of the frozen realm.\nIt is the love and vigilant care shared among mortals. Across this vast and boundless land, it is the warmth by which the people withstand the biting frost, soothing the deep-seated scars etched into their memories.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「慈爱」是冰之国土的救赎。\n慈爱孕育对他人的怜悯。在风雪的国度里，谁若真心为灵魂的罪责悔过，便能得到以慈爱为名的宽恕。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nCharity is the salvation of the frozen realm.\nIt breeds mercy for others. In the realm of wind and snow, whosoever sincerely repents for the sins of their soul shall find absolution in the name of Charity.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「慈爱」是冰之国土的救赎。\n慈爱是对众生的关照，它消弭高低与贵贱，跨越血脉与国别。慈爱的目光往往注视着所有人，它施与不幸者以护佑，并应许众人以永恒的解放。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nCharity is the salvation of the frozen realm.\nIt is a boundless grace extended to all living things. It collapses the divide between the highborn and the low, transcending both bloodline and nation. Its watchful gaze beholds all of humanity, offering sanctuary to the unfortunate and promising eternal liberation unto all.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「坚忍」是冰之国土的品格。\n坚忍源自对生存的渴望。就算未被播撒在沃土中，羸弱的种子却也能凭借着这样的渴望，在冻原的土地下根系深扎。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nFortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.\nIt stems from a raw yearning for survival. Even if scattered far from fertile soil, a fragile seed can rely on this desperate longing to drive its roots deep beneath the frozen tundra.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「坚忍」是冰之国土的品格。\n坚忍带来生长的意志。即便寒潮摧折，羸弱的种子仍能借这意志破土而出，在风雪覆盖的大地上生出新芽。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nFortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.\nIt brings forth the will to grow. Though shattered by the bitter cold, a fragile seed can still harness this will to break through the frozen earth, pushing forth fresh sprouts to life across a landscape blanketed in wind and snow.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「坚忍」是冰之国土的品格。\n坚忍成就生命的繁荣。人们不曾向严寒屈服，如同羸弱的种子偏要在风雪里开出花朵；文明历经困苦而生生不息，如同霜仙花在寒冬中一年又一年盛放。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nFortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.\nIt breeds the prosperity of life itself. The people here have never bowed to the biting cold, just as a fragile seed defiantly chooses to bloom amidst the blizzards. This civilization has witnessed centuries of bitter winter, yet remains vibrant much like the Frostfairy Flower that flourishes season after season.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「荣光」是冰之国土的信仰。\n荣光是深埋于冻土下的火种，若能描摹出它的形貌，也就获得了面对严寒的勇气。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nGlory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.\nIt is a spark buried deep beneath the frozen soil; if one can but trace its true form, they shall grant themselves the courage to stand against the biting cold.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「荣光」是冰之国土的信仰。\n荣光是长夜中闪烁的火苗，跋涉于雪原上的众人始终注视着它的方向，如同确信风雪将息，黎明将至，他们确信自己仍行在应行的路上。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nGlory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.\nIt is an ember flickering in the deep night, a beacon upon which all who trek across the snowfields fix their gaze. Just as they are certain the blizzards will wane and the dawn will break, they are certain that the path they tread remains the true one.

desc_chs: 天赋培养素材。\n「荣光」是冰之国土的信仰。\n荣光是火炬台上不熄的火焰，如今与风雪的国度共存亡。火焰点燃高尚的激情，为了维系它的永恒燃烧，人们甘愿奉献出自己的一切。
desc_en: Talent Level-Up Material.\nGlory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.\nIt is the undying flame upon the beacon hearth, bound now to live or die with the frozen realm. The flame ignites a noble passion, and to sustain its eternal burn, the people would gladly offer up their all.

desc_chs: 璃月港唯一的摇滚乐手，以音乐和热情歌颂着对「成见」的反抗。
desc_en: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

desc_chs: 除了打扮哪里都不像神职人员的修女。冷淡的言行中透着锐利。总是单独行动。
desc_en: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

desc_chs: 「往生堂」七十七代堂主，年纪轻轻就已主掌璃月的葬仪事务。
desc_en: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

desc_chs: 来自稻妻的浪人武士，如今栖身于璃月船队「南十字」中。性情温和而洒脱，心中埋藏着许多往事。
desc_en: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

desc_chs: 活跃在璃月港的知名律法咨询师，混有仙兽血脉的精明少女。
desc_en: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

desc_chs: 「长野原烟花店」店长，「夏祭的女王」，将人们的愿望寄托于烟花中的能工巧匠。
desc_en: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

desc_chs: 好感经验，用于提升好感等级
desc_en: Companionship EXP. Used to increase Friendship levels.

desc_chs: 神里家的家政官，活跃在稻妻的「地头蛇」。
desc_en: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.

desc_chs: 圣遗物经验素材，含有2500点经验值。\n蕴含着强大能量的精华物质，能让圣遗物获得成长。
desc_en: Artifact EXP material. Gives 2,500 EXP.\nMaterial that contains the distilled essence of great power. It can contribute to the enhancement of artifacts.

desc_chs: 圣遗物经验素材，含有10000点经验值。\n圣遗物本质上是意志与记忆的具现结晶。而将某种的纯粹力量提纯得来的这种精华物质，能让其中的记忆与意志变得更加清晰、强大。
desc_en: Artifact EXP material. Gives 10,000 EXP.\nArtifacts are themselves the physical manifestation of ideals and memories. Materials such as this, which contain the distilled essence of the power thereof, can make these memories and ideals clearer and stronger still.

desc_chs: 通过圣言自明机，进行圣遗物定义时所消耗的素材。\n圣遗物本质上是意志与记忆的具现结晶。此即是炼金术伟业的一种应用：将意志保存于物质世界的精华之中，并使之结晶。只有这样才方便将其按需塑造。
desc_en: A material that is consumed when defining Artifacts with the Artifact Transmuter.\nArtifacts are themselves the crystallized physical manifestation of ideals and memories. This is one of the applications of the noble art of Alchemy — namely, to preserve ideals by crystallizing them inside the essence of material objects. Only in this way can they be molded according to need.

desc_chs: 圣遗物力量的本源来自于故事，因此神圣或渎圣的书写可以尝试重塑圣遗物。\n然而故事本身并无善恶，歌谣与字句既有拯救之力，亦有毁灭之能，正如昔日传谕至圣的启示、统领地上的万国与万国的荣华，却又从高天坠落的使者所相信的那般。时至今日，这些至洁或不洁的翎羽依然能写下虚假的启示，改写注定的故事，然而与世界相抗的结果唯有散落成尘。
desc_en: The power of Artifacts stems from stories. Thus, sacred or profane writings may reshape them.\nThere is no good or evil inherent in stories, while songs and words have the power to save as well as destroy — such was the belief of the emissary who once conveyed revelations on the holiest one's behalf, governing the nations on earth and their glory, and who eventually fell from the high heavens. To this day, whether pure or impure, these feathers can still inscribe false revelations and rewrite fated tales, yet the only outcome of defying the world is to scatter into dust.

desc_chs: 古老家族出身的「浪花骑士」，西风骑士团游击小队队长。身为旧贵族后裔却加入了堪称死对头的西风骑士团，该事件至今仍是蒙德一大谜团。
desc_en: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

desc_chs: 其身为御建鸣神主尊大御所大人，许稻妻人民以亘古不变之「永恒」。
desc_en: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

desc_chs: 隶属于「终末番」的忍者。身形小巧，总像没睡饱一样。
desc_en: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.

desc_chs: 海祇岛的「现人神巫女」，统管海祇岛各项事宜的少女。
desc_en: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

desc_chs: 海祇岛军的大将，深受部下信赖。
desc_en: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

desc_chs: 「天领奉行」的大将，杀伐果断，骁勇善战。
desc_en: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

desc_chs: 活跃在稻妻城花见坂的「荒泷派」初代目头领。什么，从没听说过荒泷派？你是想找茬吗？
desc_en: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

desc_chs: 鸣神大社的宫司大人，兼任「八重堂」总编。艳丽动人的外表下藏着令人意想不到的聪慧与狡黠。
desc_en: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

desc_chs: 天领奉行的天才少年侦探，直觉敏锐，心思玲珑。
desc_en: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

desc_chs: 能激活石化古树、地脉之花，以获得秘宝。其中的能量会随时间恢复。\n传说所有银白的古木与银白的花的根系在大地的极深处隐秘相连，而它们联通的痕迹绘制出了地脉的轨迹…
desc_en: Used to vitalize Petrified Trees and Ley Line Blossoms, allowing access to the treasures they hold. Energy regenerates over time.\nIt is said that the roots of all the Irminsul trees and blossoms in the world are intertwined at the deepest, most hidden place in the earth, and that the pattern the root system makes defines the Ley Lines of the world.

desc_chs: 自称供职于总务司的神秘人士，却又是总务司名录里的「不存在之人」。
desc_en: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

desc_chs: 用于体力成长的测试道具
desc_en: Test item for increasing stamina

name_chs: 测试用体力临时增长道具
desc_chs: 用于一次性增加体力上限的测试道具
desc_en: Test item for increasing max stamina temporarily

desc_chs: 稻妻快递公司「狛荷屋」的送货员，一只热爱自己工作、向往人类社会的「猫又」。
desc_en: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

desc_chs: 曾经是流放者，如今则是无比机敏的猎手。随时准备着为了正当之事而挽弓放箭。
desc_en: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

desc_chs: 气质出尘的仙家子弟。隐修在璃月群山之间，个性也如仙人般淡漠疏离。
desc_en: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

desc_chs: 集剧作与演唱能力于一身的璃月戏曲名角。风格自成一派，雅致柔美，恰如其人。
desc_en: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

desc_chs: 干练可靠的「荒泷派」的副手——特别注明：干练可靠形容的不是「荒泷派」而是副手。
desc_en: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader - Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

desc_chs: 社奉行神里家年轻有为的现任家主，为人温雅有礼，处事颇有手段。
desc_en: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

desc_chs: 活跃于道成林的见习巡林员，热情的言行背后是一颗依旧稍显内向的心。
desc_en: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

desc_chs: 神出鬼没的旅行百货商人，最喜欢亮闪闪的摩拉。
desc_en: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

desc_chs: 精通植物学的少年学者，现于道成林任巡林官一职。直率热忱，擅长教导脑瓜糊涂的人。
desc_en: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

desc_chs: 解锁「传说任务」所需的钥匙。\n能通过完成一定数量的「每日委托」获得。
desc_en: A key used to unlock Story Quests.\nObtained by completing the required number of Daily Commissions.

desc_chs: 祖拜尔剧场的知名舞者，舞姿灵动优美，为人纯真亲善。
desc_en: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

desc_chs: 浓烈的风元素能量积聚成的物质。献给风的神像，能弥补它在漫长岁月中散失的力量。
desc_en: A substance that has accumulated intense Anemo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

desc_chs: 神瞳结晶破碎后的碎片，揭示附近隐藏宝箱
desc_en: Shattered fragments of the Oculus Crystal. Shows hidden treasure nearby.

desc_chs: 浓烈的岩元素能量积聚成的物质。献给岩的神像，能弥补它在漫长岁月中散失的力量。
desc_en: A substance that has accumulated intense Geo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

desc_chs: 日常积分奖励，可以随机获得1个初阶角色突破素材
desc_en: Daily highscore reward. Grants 1 random T1 Character Ascension material.

desc_chs: 进包自动开启，获得一把飞天大御剑
desc_en: This chest opens automatically, granting a Skyrider Greatsword.

desc_chs: 能破除散布在蒙德大地各处的远古地灵龛封印。\n大地上矗立着的远古神龛，随着那个文明的覆灭，也将自己封锁了。在幽深的秘境中寻得的密钥能破除封印，或许只是利用过去的气息，让神龛忘记一切尽毁之事吧。
desc_en: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Mondstadt.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

desc_chs: 能破除散布在璃月大地各处的远古地灵龛封印。\n大地上矗立着的远古神龛，随着那个文明的覆灭，也将自己封锁了。在幽深的秘境中寻得的密钥能破除封印，或许只是利用过去的气息，让神龛忘记一切尽毁之事吧。
desc_en: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Liyue.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

desc_chs: 能破除散布在稻妻大地各处的远古地灵龛封印。\n大地上矗立着的远古神龛，随着那个文明的覆灭，也将自己封锁了。在幽深的秘境中寻得的密钥能破除封印，或许只是利用过去的气息，让神龛忘记一切尽毁之事吧。
desc_en: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Inazuma.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

desc_chs: 可以补充原粹树脂的道具，一个能补充60点。\n蕴含着少许能量的晶体，可以被原粹树脂吸收。\n种种能量的流动构成了这个世界的诸多美好与挑战。这枚晶体中也蕴含着这些能量。
desc_en: An item used to restore Original Resin by 60 points.\nThis crystalline substance pulsates with a little energy that can be absorbed by Original Resin.\nThe flow of energies of all sorts is the source of many wonders and challenges in this world. Those same energies are also contained within this crystal.

desc_chs: 某种浓郁的生命力与龙脊雪山的特殊能量结合产生的结晶。对于渴求生长的忍冬之树，是绝好的「养分」。
desc_en: A type of crystal formed from the combination of concentrated life force with an energy unique to Dragonspine. Makes for an ideal nutrient for growing Frostbearing Trees.

desc_chs: 某种浓郁的生命力与龙脊雪山的特殊能量结合产生的结晶。对于渴求生长的忍冬之树，是绝好的「养分」。
desc_en: A type of crystal formed from the combination of concentrated life force with an energy unique to Dragonspine. Makes for an ideal nutrient for growing Frostbearing Trees.

desc_chs:
可以补充原粹树脂的道具，使用以补充60点原粹树脂。
获取后，将会随时间<color=#FF5E41CC>自动分解消失</color>：
·到期时间从获取后的下一个周一开始计算，由该时间点开始的七天后到期消失。
·在不同的周获得的多个须臾树脂，到期时间分别计算。

会随着时间消散的纯净能量。就此而言，与世间一切美好的事物有着共性。但紧握当下的片刻，让世界稍微变好一点，或许就是生活在「时间」的桎梏中的人们，应当拥有的美好品德吧。
desc_en:
An item that can be used to replenish Original Resin. Once used, it will replenish 60 Original Resin.
Once obtained, it will <color=#FF5E41CC>automatically dissipate</color> after a period of time.
·The expiration time will be calculated from the Monday after this item is obtained, and it will disappear seven days from then.
·Multiple Transient Resins obtained on different weeks will have their expiration dates counted independently.

Pure energy that will dissipate with time. In this, it is similar to all else that is lovely in this world. But seize this opportunity and go make the world a slightly better place, as is fitting for one who dwells within the bounds of "time."

desc_chs: 封存着一股仙力的小瓶。使用后能立即完成一件摆设的制作。
desc_en: A small bottle that seals some adeptal energy within. Will immediately complete a furnishing when used.

desc_chs: 浓烈的雷元素能量积聚成的物质。献给雷的神像，能弥补它在漫长岁月中散失的力量。
desc_en: A substance that has accumulated intense Electro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

desc_chs: 由冒险家协会布设在各地的玉符，以「浮生石片」雕琢而成，光泽温润，晶莹剔透。据说这种玉符凝聚着皓月的精华，寄托着人们对往日佳节的追思，意义非凡。
desc_en: These jade talismans have been placed in various areas by the Adventurers' Guild. They are made from crystal-clear and gently lustrous Plaustrite Shards. It is said that these talismans contain the essence of the bright white moon and store the reminiscences that people have of festivals past.

desc_chs: 湛蓝如天幕的晶石，表面光芒明灭，似乎在呼应着地层深处不可见的高远天空…\n侧耳细听，仿佛能听到其中传来细微的叹息。\n说来奇怪，这块晶石有一种温暖的触感。
desc_en: A sky-blue crystal that glitters so brightly that it brings forth echoes of the heavens above, which cannot be seen from underground...\nIf you hold it up to your ear, you can almost hear a soft sigh coming from within.\nThis might sound strange, but this crystal also gives off a faint warmth.

desc_chs: 浓烈的草元素能量积聚成的物质。献给草的神像，能弥补它在漫长岁月中散失的力量。
desc_en: A substance that has accumulated intense Dendro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

desc_chs: 能破除散布在须弥大地各处的远古地灵龛封印。\n大地上矗立着的远古神龛，随着那个文明的覆灭，也将自己封锁了。在幽深的秘境中寻得的密钥能破除封印，或许只是利用过去的气息，让神龛忘记一切尽毁之事吧。
desc_en: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Sumeru.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

desc_chs: 只有背面纹路的影幻牌，正面则是一片空白。据说在空白的牌面上填写想要得到的影幻牌的名字，就能够在酒馆的协会代理人处，得到那张卡牌的影幻牌面。
desc_en: A blank card with a painted back. It is said that if you put the name of your desired dynamic card on this blank card, you can get the very skin from the Association agent located at the tavern.

desc_chs: 可以阅览猫尾酒馆对局邀请板，选择牌手名录中的一位，即可使用这封对局邀请函，委托猫尾酒馆发出对局邀请。受邀请的牌手将会到猫尾酒馆等待进行对局。
desc_en: You can select a player from the Player List via the invitation board, and then entrust The Cat's Tail to send out an invitation using this Invitation Letter. The invited player will head over to the tavern and wait for a duel with you.

desc_chs: 牌手协会内部认证和使用的货币，可以用于购买「七圣召唤」相关的各式各样的道具。据说当初取名为幸运牌币，是希望拥有它的人能够变得幸运，不过，或许是足够幸运的人才能拥有它们也说不定…
desc_en: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...

desc_chs: 灵光百种所遗留下来的，凝结着过去记忆的断片。
desc_en: Fragment left by Khvarena. Carrier of past memories.

desc_chs: 浓烈的水元素能量积聚成的物质。献给水的神像，能弥补它在漫长岁月中散失的力量。
desc_en: A substance that has accumulated intense Hydro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

desc_chs: 存放着「欢兴礼券」的礼盒，有着花朵般的奇特外形，是「琉形蜃境」中独树一帜的景观，也是游客们赢取奖品所需的重要收集物。使用「流悦晶石」与「酣悦晶石」，似乎能更便捷地确定它们的位置…
desc_en: Box that contains Joyeux Vouchers. They have a unique flower-like shape and can only be found in the Veluriyam Mirage. They are also important collectibles for guests who wish to win rewards. Using the Flowing Joyspar and Felicitous Joyspar seems to allow one to more effectively find them...

desc_chs: 能破除散布在枫丹大地各处的远古地灵龛封印。\n大地上矗立着的远古神龛，随着那个文明的覆灭，也将自己封锁了。在幽深的秘境中寻得的密钥能破除封印，或许只是利用过去的气息，让神龛忘记一切尽毁之事吧。
desc_en: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Fontaine.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

desc_chs: 由逸散的仙力凝集而成，畅游于山野河谷之间的灵鲤。
desc_en: A Spirit Carp formed from the condensed adeptal energy, swimming freely amidst mountains and river valleys.

desc_chs: 能破除散布在纳塔大地各处的远古地灵龛封印。\n大地上矗立着的远古神龛，随着那个文明的覆灭，也将自己封锁了。在幽深的秘境中寻得的密钥能破除封印，或许只是利用过去的气息，让神龛忘记一切尽毁之事吧。
desc_en: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Natlan.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

desc_chs: 浓烈的火元素能量积聚成的物质。献给火的神像，能弥补它在漫长岁月中散失的力量。
desc_en: A substance that has accumulated intense Pyro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

desc_chs: 如同快乐笑声凝结而成的神奇晶体，呈现出两片书页拼接的姿态，或是自由飞旋的羽毛。触碰之后，便能从中获得「悠乐片段」…\n使用「轻愉信笺」与「欢跃信笺」，似乎能更便捷地确定它们的位置…
desc_en: Like a mystical gem crystallized from peals of joyous laughter, it appears as two pages intertwined, or perhaps a feather flying freely. After being touched, "Excerpts of Bliss" can be retrieved from it...\nIt seems that their locations can be quickly ascertained using Jocund or Joyous Letters...

desc_chs: 浓烈的月矩力积聚成的物质。献给新月的神像，能弥补它在漫长岁月中散失的力量。
desc_en: A substance that has accumulated intense kuuvahki energy. Offer it to the Statue of the New Moon and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

desc_chs: 能破除散布在挪德卡莱大地各处的远古地灵龛封印。\n大地上矗立着的远古神龛，随着那个文明的覆灭，也将自己封锁了。在幽深的秘境中寻得的密钥能破除封印，或许只是利用过去的气息，让神龛忘记一切尽毁之事吧。
desc_en: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Nod-Krai.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

desc_chs: 能破除散布在霜月各处的远古月灵龛封印。\n月面上矗立着的远古神龛，随着月之意志的消逝，也失去了旧日寄予信仰的恩主。在幽冷的月壤上寻得的密钥能破除封印，或许只是利用过去的气息，让神龛忘记一切尽毁之事吧。
desc_en: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Kuuhenki Shrines scattered around the Frost Moon.\nThese shrines that were built upon the moon's surface lost the benevolent being in whom faith was vested in ancient days as the will of the moon faded away. These secret keys found upon the frigid lunar soil can be used to break the seals — or perhaps they only use the fading voices of the past to help the shrines forget all that has come to ruin.

desc_chs: test 空之神殿神瞳
构筑「文明」的最小单位。\n任何来自「文明」的造物，从人类的集体记忆中消逝后，皆会裂解为摹忆因子。将其供奉于空之神殿内的摹忆中枢，或许会得到来自隙间记忆的赐福…
desc_en: The fundamental building blocks of "Civilization."\nAny creation of "Civilization" that fades from the collective memory of humanity will eventually disintegrate into Memory Factors. Offer them to the Memory Core within the Temple of Space, and you may receive a blessing from the memories drifting within the interstices...

desc_chs: 浓烈的冰元素能量积聚成的物质。献给冰的神像，能弥补它在漫长岁月中散失的力量。
desc_en: A substance that has accumulated intense Cryo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

desc_chs: 影域中诞生的生物，所化成的奇怪液状物质。
desc_en: A strange, liquefied substance left behind by a creature born within the Shadow Realm.

desc_chs: 能破除散布在至冬大地各处的远古地灵龛封印。\n大地上矗立着的远古神龛，随着那个文明的覆灭，也将自己封锁了。在幽深的秘境中寻得的密钥能破除封印，或许只是利用过去的气息，让神龛忘记一切尽毁之事吧。
desc_en: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Snezhnaya.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

desc_chs: 教令院内负责监管学者们的「大风纪官」。工作时比刹诃伐罗学院制作的「大风机关」更有效率。
desc_en: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

desc_chs: 有着琥珀色左眼的赤王后裔，阿如村的守护者。
desc_en: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

desc_chs: 深居净善宫的笼中之鸟，只能在梦中将世界尽收眼底。
desc_en: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

desc_chs: 专攻理论星相学的梨多梵谛学院学生。时常梦游，长期缺觉，饱受睡眠问题困扰。
desc_en: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

desc_chs: 身份成谜的流浪人士。衣着打扮像是修验者，言行却并不是修验者应有的模样。
desc_en: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

desc_chs: 来自「一百年前」的学者，喜欢以前辈自居，对各类古老文字与古典机关都颇有研究。
desc_en: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

desc_chs: 歌尘浪市真君膝下最年幼的弟子，温柔体贴的「小大人」。
desc_en: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."

desc_chs: 须弥教令院现任书记官，有过人的智慧与才能。生活得自由自在，一般人基本找不到他。
desc_en: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

desc_chs: 横行须弥沙漠的佣兵组织「镀金旅团」的成员，勇敢而又强大的战士，在「镀金旅团」内部声名赫赫。
desc_en: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

desc_chs: (test)熄星三阶段解锁积分
平凡家庭出身的年轻骑士，在小队中担任「前进测绘员」一职。为人低调，谨小慎微。
desc_en: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.

desc_chs: 烹饪系统的产出道具
desc_en: Items created by cooking

desc_chs: 铺满洋葱的吐司。但烤得有些不对劲，即使一边钓鱼一边啃，也能尝出味道的差别。
desc_en: Onion-covered toast. Not quite cooked right. You'll notice its imperfection, even if you eat it while fishing.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高88点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 铺满洋葱的吐司。是渔夫间流行的主食。他们会在包里塞满这种吐司，并在河边蹲上一整天。
desc_en: Onion-covered toast. A favorite amongst fishermen, they will stuff a bag with it and sit by the river all day.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高107点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 铺满洋葱的吐司。散发诱人的香气。很难判别鱼究竟是被鱼饵还是吐司吸引上钩的。
desc_en: Onion-covered toast. Exudes a wonderful aroma. Are the fish biting for the bait, or is it the toast they're after?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高126点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 单面煎熟的禽蛋。入口有些发硬，只能期望营养没有流失。
desc_en: An egg fried on one side. A bit hard in the middle. One can only hope it still has its nutrients.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复50点生命值。

desc_chs: 单面煎熟的禽蛋。蛋黄一戳就可以流出汁，非常适合解馋。
desc_en: An egg fried on one side. The yolk flows out nicely when broken. So satisfying.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复100点生命值。

desc_chs: 单面煎熟的禽蛋。有着阳光般和煦的口感，只一口便涌入了蓬勃生命力。
desc_en: An egg fried on one side. With a taste of the summer sun, it invigorates you from the first bite.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复150点生命值。

desc_chs: 煎烤过的肉排。表面色泽有一丝黯淡，好像在遗憾自己没有物尽其用。
desc_en: A grilled steak. Its color is a little bleak, almost as if it feels sorry for itself for being a sorry excuse for a steak.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复50点生命值。

desc_chs: 煎烤过的肉排。高温将水分紧锁其中，令人期待它切开后流汁的样子。
desc_en: A grilled steak. High heat has locked the juices in, giving one high expectations for when the meat is cut open.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复100点生命值。

desc_chs: 煎烤过的肉排。满溢在口中的肉香，能感到力量在体内迸发。
desc_en: A grilled steak. Juicy, flavorsome, fragrant steak. One bite and you feel yourself come alive.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复150点生命值。

desc_chs: 安柏的特色料理。一面泛着血色，另一面散发着微妙焦香气味的肉排。闭着眼大口吃下去，安柏会很高兴的吧。
desc_en: Amber's specialty. One side is obviously uncooked. The other side gives off a subtle scent of something burnt. Close your eyes and have a big mouthful, just to keep Amber happy if nothing else.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复生命值上限的10%，并额外恢复150点生命值。

desc_chs: 由野菇和禽肉组成的烤串。乍一看有些难以区分两者。
desc_en: A skewer of mushrooms and poultry. At first glance it's hard to tell which is which.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的8%，并额外恢复800点生命值。

desc_chs: 由野菇和禽肉组成的烤串。鲜嫩禽肉佐以鲜香野菇，吃的时候也不要挑食哦。
desc_en: A skewer of mushrooms and poultry. Fresh poultry is complimented by fragrant mushrooms. Don't be picky, chow down!
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的9%，并额外恢复1000点生命值。

desc_chs: 由野菇和禽肉组成的烤串。恰到好处的火候，让一根小木棒串起了整片山野的味道。
desc_en: A skewer of mushrooms and poultry. All the best the wild has to offer are pierced on just one stick.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的10%，并额外恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 凯亚的特色料理。弹牙可口的烤串，隐约带有一丝甘甜浓厚的回味。等等…真的是果香吗？
desc_en: Kaeya's specialty. A chewy skewer with a rich sweet aftertaste. Wait... Is this really the smell of fruit?
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的16%，并额外恢复1350点生命值。

desc_chs: 淋满肉酱的细面。口感有些稠厚，黏在牙齿上的感觉有点不妙。
desc_en: Bolognese covered with a meat sauce. A bit chewy and annoyingly sticks to your teeth.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的18%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 淋满肉酱的细面。细面被番茄酱着上红红火火的色彩，酸甜可口，非常开胃。
desc_en: Bolognese covered with a meat sauce. The meaty, herby aroma really gets your appetite going.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的20%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复390点生命值。

desc_chs: 淋满肉酱的细面。浓郁的酸甜让最后一口都跟第一口一样美妙。
desc_en: Bolognese covered with a meat sauce. The beautiful, authentic flavors take you on a culinary adventure from the first bite to the last.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复470点生命值。

desc_chs: 丽莎的特色料理。颜色有些奇妙的肉酱面，可一旦尝过一口就再也不想停下来。她究竟施了什么魔法？
desc_en: Lisa's specialty. With an inexplicable aura, this bolognese is so exotic that you can never have enough. Did she actually enchant it with some kind of magic?
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的26%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复570点生命值。

desc_chs: 萝卜为主的菜汤。汤里的蔬菜无精打采，如同经历了一场霜寒。
desc_en: Radish-based vegetable soup. The vegetables within appear to have been victims of a frost.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的8%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复210点生命值。

desc_chs: 萝卜为主的菜汤。微酸微甜的汤里藏着脆嫩的白萝卜，营养均衡。
desc_en: Radish-based vegetable soup. Its flavor is delicately between tart and sweet. With luscious radish, it's a well-balanced dish.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的9%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复260点生命值。

desc_chs: 萝卜为主的菜汤。一股清新朴素的田园香气扑面而来，如同重返无忧无虑的午后时光。
desc_en: Radish-based vegetable soup. The clear aromas are perfectly accompanied by a sunny summer afternoon.

desc_en: A main dish with an intense flavor. You can barely tell where the rice noodles end and the fish begins. The soft, floppy mouthfeel is almost unbearable — how could something that looked this simple actually require so much craft?
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的18%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 滋味浓郁的主食。将河粉、半熟的鱼肉和若干配菜猛火快炒而成。充分吸收食材鲜味的河粉，以其柔韧爽滑的独特口感，受到很多食客喜欢。
desc_en: A main dish with an intense flavor. Created by stir-frying rice noodles, par-cooked fish, and various side dishes in a wok on high flame. The noodles, having absorbed the flavors of the various ingredients, are springy and smooth to the taste, making this dish a big hit with diners.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的20%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复390点生命值。

desc_chs: 滋味浓郁的主食。饱满而鲜亮的外形早已引人垂涎欲滴，入口后的香味更是让人欲罢不能。河粉的柔滑更衬鱼肉的鲜弹，虽无名贵食材或特殊烹饪技法，它的美味放在宴席之中也不会逊色。
desc_en: A main dish with an intense flavor. The sumptuous, fresh look is already enough to leave people salivating, and one bite will surely lead to another. The smooth rice noodles and tender fish grant this meal a seat at any gourmet's table, its pedestrian ingredients notwithstanding.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复470点生命值。

desc_chs: 滋味浓郁的素食。过于稠厚的酱汁完全掩盖了食材应有的鲜味，感觉吃进肚子里的是无论喝多少水还嫌口干的调味料。
desc_en: A vegetarian dish with a rich flavor. The overly thick sauce has totally covered the freshness that the ingredients should have had, and the condiment leaves your mouth dry no matter how much you wash it down with water.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复250点生命值。

desc_chs: 滋味浓郁的素食。将松茸切成薄片，煎至焦黄后倒入酱汁。松茸肉质饱满，嚼上去有着鲍鱼般鲜香的滋味，是一道近乎能够以假乱真的菜肴。
desc_en: A vegetarian dish with a rich flavor. The matsutake has been sliced thin and fried till golden before pouring the sauce. The matsutake meat is sumptuous and has flavor to match that of fresh abalone — almost enough to make you think it was the real thing.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复400点生命值。

desc_chs: 滋味浓郁的素食。在酱汁的提点下，松茸呈现出了上等而高级的口感，嫩如鲜贝，鲜如鲍鱼，难以辨别真身。若是先由食客随意猜想，最后再揭晓答案，必然能赢得对方的惊羡。
desc_en: A vegetarian dish with a rich flavor. With the aid of the sauce, the matsutake has achieved an excellent, elegant mouth-feel that so rivals scallop in tenderness and abalone in freshness that you can hardly tell them apart. If you left your customer guessing before revealing the truth later, you would be sure to earn their astonished praise.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复550点生命值。

desc_chs: 宽油炒制的素食。油温的控制不当让食材的口感泛起过重的油味，令人吃一口摇三次头，惋惜这来之不易的琉璃袋。
desc_en: Wok-fried vegetarian food. Improper oil temperature control has caused the ingredients to reek of oil. Those who eat but a single bite will shake their heads and mourn the loss of the rare violetgrass used.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升6%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 宽油炒制的素食。选取璃月当地盛产的三种食材煎炸翻炒。虽然做法朴素，却充分调动了食材本身的浓郁鲜味，丝毫不输玉盘珍馐。
desc_en: Wok-fried vegetarian food. A stir-fried selection of three ingredients hailing from Liyue. Though the methodology is simple, it brings out the intense, innate flavors of the ingredients, and does not fade in brilliance when compared to some high-class delicacy.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升9%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 宽油炒制的素食。泥土的芬芳、树荫的沁凉与岚气的润泽，汇聚成盘中之鲜。配一碗简单的白米饭，就能收获令味蕾和心灵都倍感踏实的满足。
desc_en: Wok-fried vegetarian food. The scents of the earth, the cool shade, and the moistness of the mist have all been enjoined into this plate of freshness. Pair it with simple white rice — both your taste buds and your soul shall experience a down-to-earth satisfaction many times over.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升12%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 清淡润口的菜肴。为了防止糊底，手抖放入了过多的油。经过一番特殊的「油煎」烹调，虾仁弹性尚可，就是吃多了嗓子有些不舒服。
desc_en: A mild and luscious dish. In an overzealous attempt to prevent the food from sticking to the bottom of the pot, too much oil was added. Despite having been subjected to this rather heavy-duty frying process, the shrimp still have a surprisingly pleasant texture — but mind you don't eat too many, or you'll get a sore throat.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 清淡润口的菜肴。将虾仁上浆后快速炒熟勾薄芡。极其简单的调味方式，为的是衬托虾肉本身的鲜美。从家常小菜到宴请宾客，都有它的一席之地。
desc_en: A mild and luscious dish. The shrimp are quickly sautéed and the sauce thickened. This method of cooking is exceedingly simple and brings out the wonderful natural flavor of the shrimp meat, granting it a place in humble home-cooked dinners and lavish banquets alike.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升25%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 清淡润口的菜肴。外形饱满的虾仁将全部鲜味储存在体内，只等齿间轻咬的那一刻迸发而出。如同一颗颗水珠接连滴入原本平静的湖面，荡出无数鲜美的回旋。直到细腻的回甘隐约浮现，心醉神迷的感受才刚刚停止。
desc_en: A mild and luscious dish. The plump shrimp are packed full of flavor just waiting to burst out on the first bite, creating wave after wave of indulgent deliciousness, like drops of water falling one by one onto a still lake, ending just as the sweet aftertaste finally begins to emerge.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升30%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 松软弹牙的主食。揉面完成后似乎并没有发酵到位，蒸制时也没有圆润地膨胀起来。粗糙而扎实的口感，与预想中有着不小差距。
desc_en: Soft and fluffy buns. The dough has not been proofed properly, meaning the buns did not puff up evenly during the steaming process. The resulting coarse, hard texture leaves much to be desired.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的8%，并额外恢复800点生命值。

desc_chs: 松软弹牙的主食。稻米和马尾磨粉后揉成面团，做出造型后上笼屉蒸熟。除了直接食用以外还有夹菜馅的吃法。方便携带的同时又很能填饱肚子，是璃月地区一道备受欢迎的主食。
desc_en: Soft and fluffy buns. The rice and horsetail have been ground into flour and kneaded into dough before being placed into a steaming basket. They can be eaten as-is or with a vegetable filling. Portable and satiating, it is a very popular dish in the Liyue region.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的9%，并额外恢复1000点生命值。

desc_chs: 松软弹牙的主食。粗粮特有的香甜，伴随着咀嚼渗入唇齿之间。再不起眼的食材，在劳动的作用下，也能成为温暖身心的力量。这份属于老百姓的幸福，流汗后品尝才最为美味。
desc_en: Soft and fluffy buns. The unique sweetness of the whole grains passes between your teeth and lips as you chew. The relatively nondescript ingredients have been transformed into a true delicacy by your labors. This is one of the simple pleasures of the common folk and tastes best after some good, honest work.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的10%，并额外恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 药庐「不卜庐」的主人，随身悬着名为「长生」的白蛇。精于药石，深于城府。
desc_en: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

desc_chs: 胡桃的特色料理。圆头幽灵挤作一堆的样子有些滑稽可爱。不过，要是因为好奇抵不住诱惑而吃了其中「一只」的话，可能会为此后悔很久吧…毕竟，盘子里装的是境界极高的、将味蕾轰炸到完全失灵的——「吃不出是什么食材」。
desc_en: Hu Tao's specialty. The round-faced ghouls seem quite cute, squeezed into a pile as they are. But if you were to fall to temptation and try but one of them, you may yet come to regret it for a long while... After all, this plate is full of top-quality, taste-bud-blasting— Actually, what on earth is this stuff, anyway?
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复生命值上限的15%，并额外恢复550点生命值。

desc_chs: 色彩缤纷的主食。制作过程中流失了过多的水分，需要靠些许想象力和额外添加的水，才能还原应有的口感。
desc_en: Colorful staple food. Too much moisture was lost during the cooking process — at this point, it would take some imagination (and some extra water) to recoup the intended taste.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的30%，并额外恢复600点生命值。

desc_chs: 色彩缤纷的主食。香软糯口的稻米间，紧实地码放着各类甜味的食材。比起口味，更重视的是万事兴隆，天下太平的心意。而心意就是最好的调味料，所以口味一定不会差。
desc_en: Colorful staple food. Maintains perfect balance between soft and fragrant rice and all kinds of carefully selected sweet ingredients. This dish is mainly known for its meaning as a symbol of prosperity and peace, and less so for its taste. However, with such noble ideals behind it, its flavor should not disappoint.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的32%，并额外恢复1250点生命值。

desc_chs: 色彩缤纷的主食。酸甜的果干如一缕看不见的丝线，与口感饱满的稻米交织。即使咽下，淡淡的香甜依然萦绕唇齿，令人幸福感倍增。
desc_en: Colorful staple food. The sweet-and-sour preserved fruit is bound to the rich mouthfeel of the rice as if by invisible threads. Even after you swallow, the faint fragrance remains on your lips, increasing your sense of satisfaction by an order of magnitude.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的34%，并额外恢复1900点生命值。

desc_chs: 热乎乎的炖菜。在炖煮的火力选择上出了一些纰漏，让成品的口感僵硬了几分。如果只是胡乱喝下去的话也不算太坏，毕竟驱寒的效果还是有的。
desc_en: A steaming-hot stew. There was some flaw in the flame control during the stewing process, leading to a product with a very stiff mouthfeel. You can ignore those flaws if you scarf it all down — it'll keep the cold away regardless.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色严寒积累速度略微降低，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 热乎乎的炖菜。将冷鲜肉和蔬菜切作小块，加上番茄久煮炖成浓稠的菜肴。汤汁包裹着被煮得暖洋洋的食材下肚，有着驱赶寒冷的效用。
desc_en: Hot stew made from Chilled Meat and vegetables chopped into small pieces. Slow-boiled tomatoes give this dish a rich and thick texture. Filling one's stomach with this comforting mixture has a warming effect.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色严寒积累速度小幅降低，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 热乎乎的炖菜。就算只品尝了一口汤汁，踏实而满足的感觉也会从心底里传来。越嚼越香的肉仿佛带给了人无穷的力量，身处冰天雪地也丝毫不在话下。
desc_en: A steaming-hot stew. Just one spoonful sends a down-to-earth sense of satisfaction welling up from the depths of your heart. The meat's flavor grows with every chew, bringing limitless strength to the eater even in the coldest wintry wastes.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色严寒积累速度降低，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 慢火煎制的鱼料理。鱼肉的烹饪时间过长，已经完全失去了鲜味与弹性，似乎用餐具稍微触动就会碎成小块。
desc_en: Gently fried fish dish. The fish has been fried too long, which has deprived it of all its freshness and springiness. The slightest touch with your utensils might cause it to break into small pieces.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 慢火煎制的鱼料理。火候得当的鱼肉最大程度保持了鲜味，入口细嫩柔软，搭配表面带有黄油香气的微焦，形成了一种层次丰富的口感。
desc_en: Gently fried fish dish. Cooked with the right heat and duration to maintain freshness for a long time. Tender and flaky, it is delicately browned thanks to the layer of aromatic butter on top, which creates a multi-layered and unique flavor.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升25%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 慢火煎制的鱼料理。鱼肉入口即化，海洋与陆地的风味在口中碰撞，令人久久难以忘怀。难怪做法如此简单的一道菜，也能跻身大雅之堂。
desc_en: Gently fried fish dish. The fish melts in your mouth, melding the flavors of land and sea together as it does, making for an unforgettable experience. Little wonder, then, that such a simply-made dish can make it into restaurants of great class.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升30%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 璃月的特色小吃之一。在勉强保留住香味的锅巴上，褐色的绝云椒椒和火腿黏作了一团，只能从口感来分辨两者。
desc_en: One of Liyue's specialty snacks. The browned Jueyun Chilis and ham stick together on top of a crust that has barely retained its flavor, and you can only tell them apart by the mouthfeel.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色物理伤害提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 璃月的特色小吃之一。将切片的火腿与绝云椒椒快炒，浇在稻米和马尾穗混合煎熟的锅巴上制成。混合着精制肉品与辛香的气息，四处可见的寻常稻米在此时也变成了炙手可热的美味菜品。
desc_en: One of Liyue's specialty snacks. Stir-fried ham and Jueyun Chili sprinkled on a crispy crust made from Rice and Horsetail create a refined, meaty snack that transforms humble Rice into a hot delicacy.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色物理伤害提升30%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 璃月的特色小吃之一。掰一片香脆的锅巴，放上冒着热气的火腿片一同嚼下。脆香鲜辣争先恐后般直奔鼻腔，这酣畅过瘾的滋味，让人连哪怕是指尖的碎渣都不想放过。
desc_en: One of Liyue's specialty snacks. Chow down on that lovely, fragrant crust and the steaming ham sitting atop it. The spices and spiciness race neck and neck into your nostrils, creating an addictive flavor that has you licking that last finger rather than let a single scrap go to waste.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色物理伤害提升40%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 甘雨的特色料理。麒麟憩于花丛的画面，光是观赏就能让心情平静下来。甘雨怀揣着对世间的美好祈愿烹制菜肴，再将自己最喜欢的清心花瓣，默不作声地留给了珍视的你。
desc_en: Ganyu's specialty. The image of a resting qilin is by itself enough to calm a person down. Ganyu has put her well-wishes for all that is lovely in this world into this dish — and she's saved some of her favorite Qingxin Flowers just for you, too.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的40%，并额外恢复2350点生命值。

desc_chs: 阿贝多的特色料理。蔬果平铺为草，直立为树。在这盘中世界绕过斑驳城墙，沿着棕色小道，踏入浅橘色的城堡。细嫩而香甜的滋味瞬间如花般绽放。睁开双眼，白发的王子眼里含笑。
desc_en: Albedo's specialty. The fruits and vegetables are laid out like grass, and they stand tall like trees. In this miniature world-in-a-plate, you circle the mottled city wall, follow brown alleys, and enter the light orange castle. A sweet, tender taste then bursts forth like a blooming flower. You open your eyes. There is a smile in the white-haired prince's eyes.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升35%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

name_en: Lantern Rite Special Grilled Tiger Fish
desc_chs: 为庆祝海灯节而制作的传统佳肴。将码头打捞上来的鱼略加腌制后迅速烤熟，香味能吸引街边的猫。而新鲜正是美味的秘诀。
desc_en: Traditional cuisine made to celebrate Lantern Rite. The fish is a fresh catch straight from the harbor, lightly seasoned and swiftly grilled. Its aroma attracts the street cats. Indeed, freshness is the secret of flavor.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的10%，并额外恢复1200点生命值。

name_chs: 海灯节特色炸萝卜丸子
name_en: Lantern Rite Special Fried Radish Balls
desc_chs: 为庆祝海灯节而制作的传统佳肴。有着脆嫩酥香的独特口感，适合趁热吃。
desc_en: Traditional cuisine made to celebrate Lantern Rite. Fragrant and crispy. Make sure to eat them while they're hot!
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高95点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

name_en: Lantern Rite Special Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup
desc_chs: 为庆祝海灯节而制作的传统佳肴。色泽澄澈金黄的禽蛋羹上点缀了几颗莲子。不管是作为早餐还是饭后点心，都能大量补充身体所需的优质营养。
desc_en: Traditional cuisine made to celebrate Lantern Rite. The clear, gold colors of the egg custard have been embellished with several lotus roots. Regardless of whether it is breakfast or a post-meal snack, its superior nutritional value can greatly nourish the body.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 为庆祝海灯节而制作的传统佳肴。热水烧开后，将金鱼草、豆腐和莲子下锅齐煮。因其造型寓意而被戏称为「珍珠翡翠白玉汤」，实质上是一道非常家常的菜品。
desc_en: Traditional cuisine made to celebrate Lantern Rite. Snapdragon, tofu, and lotus seeds are put into boiling water and simmered. Jewelry Soup earned its luxurious name from the look of the ingredients used, but contrary to its name, the soup is commonly prepared and served in ordinary households.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高126点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

name_en: Lantern Rite Special Noodles with Mountain Delicacies
desc_chs: 为庆祝海灯节而制作的传统佳肴。分量十足的配菜拌入卤面之中，酱味敦厚。虽然是普通家常的做法，却能孕育出无比浓郁的回味。
desc_en: Traditional cuisine made to celebrate Lantern Rite. The sauce has a rustic flavor, and there's a generous amount of it mixed in with the noodles. A humble but enduringly popular dish.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复60点体力。

name_en: Lantern Rite Special Come and Get It
desc_chs: 为庆祝海灯节而制作的传统佳肴。配料与做法上并没有特别的讲究，经常在璃月的节庆时分登场。每当这道菜上来以后，为首的人会说「来来，吃」，招呼大家动筷子，因此而得名。
desc_en: Traditional cuisine made to celebrate Lantern Rite. There is no great refinement in the making of this food, and it appears in Liyue often during festival season. Whenever this dish is served up, the person at the head of the table will invite everyone to dig in, saying "Come on, eat, eat," hence the name.
