desc_chs: 须弥流行的甜点。将帕蒂沙兰和须弥蔷薇的花瓣捣出汁液，混合入牛奶、明胶、糖等材料凝固成固状。外表可爱，口味香甜，在须弥的庆典里十分常见。
desc_en: A popular dessert in Sumeru. Juices are squeezed from the petals of Padisarahs and Sumeru Roses before being mixed with milk, gelatin, sugar, and other ingredients, and then left to solidify. Cute appearance and sweet flavor make it a common sight at celebratory events in Sumeru.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低20%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 须弥流行的甜点。刚一入口，弹滑的口感，让人仿佛徜徉于奶香味的云端。细细品味，帕蒂沙兰与须弥蔷薇的交织出的香气芬芳又馥郁。直到吃完最后一口，仍是意犹未尽，忍不住舔舔勺背，想要将美妙的享受再延长片刻。
desc_en: A popular dessert in Sumeru. The moment it enters your mouth, the springy mouthfeel makes you feel like you're wandering atop milk-flavored clouds. As you savor its flavors, the blended fragrance of Padisarah and Sumeru Rose fills the air. When you finally do reach that very last bite, it feels like something has been left unfinished. You cannot help but lick the back of your spoon, as if to savor the final sublime moments of enjoyment.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 量大管饱的主食。由于心急，在食用前并没有搅拌均匀，导致部分米饭上的番茄味过浓，但另一部分的米饭又平淡无味…还是再拌一拌吧。
desc_en: A large serving of filling staple food. In your hurry, you did not mix the various ingredients well before eating, resulting in a ridiculously thick tomato flavor on one side of the rice, and an utter blandness on the other... Best you mix it a bit better next time.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复40点体力。

desc_chs: 量大管饱的主食。集米、面、豆于一体的食物，好吃的秘诀来源于番茄酸甜的味道。因为用料常见，价格低廉，是充饥的好选择，这种做法也渐渐从阿如村传遍了整个须弥。
desc_en: A large serving of filling staple food. In this dish that combines rice, noodles, and beans together, the secret of great taste lies in the sweet and sour flavor imparted by tomatoes. Owing to its common nature and low price, this dish is a great choice for sating one's hunger — which is one of the key reasons why this recipe has spread from Aaru Village to the rest of Sumeru.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复50点体力。

desc_chs: 量大管饱的主食。米饭粒粒分明，被浓郁的酱汁包裹着送入口中，明明没有加入油荤却比肉香更加诱人。如随处可见的沙丘般堆叠着的美味，带来非同寻常的满足感。
desc_en: A large serving of filling staple food. Each grain of rice is distinct and evenly coated in flavorful sauce as you spoon them into your mouth. No oily meats were used to make this dish, and yet its flavor is more alluring still. This dish stacks flavor like the endless dunes themselves, bringing a most unique satisfaction.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复60点体力。

desc_chs: 色彩清丽的无酒精饮品。没能处理好钩钩果的酸涩，导致舌头隐隐发麻。怎、怎么回事…耳边还回荡起了奔狼领的狼嚎声，应该是幻觉吧…
desc_en: A brightly colored non-alcoholic beverage. The sourness of the Wolfhook has not been managed well, leading to a numbing sensation on your tongue. Wait a minute... Is that howling from Wolvendom you hear? That's got to be a hallucination, right? Right?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色治疗加成提升15%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 色彩清丽的无酒精饮品。将日落果和钩钩果分别捣出汁液调味后，再依次倒入杯中。冰爽的口感加上清凉的颜色，能轻易让人想起关于假日的美好回忆。为了顺利制作出渐变效果，千万不能弄错顺序哦！
desc_en: A brightly colored non-alcoholic beverage. Freshly squeezed Sunsettia and Wolfhook juices have been poured into a cup in a specific order. The cool and refreshing flavor and vibrant color remind people of the beautiful holiday times. Do not mess the order up if you want to get the gradient effect right!
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色治疗加成提升17%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 色彩清丽的无酒精饮品。沁人心脾的味道，带来如同虚幻梦境般的曼妙享受。只须浅浅一口，便能置身于莹白沙滩上，波光粼粼的海水打着节拍，在诗歌中谱写出假日的悠闲。
desc_en: A brightly colored non-alcoholic beverage. The sublime enjoyment brought by the refreshing taste is almost like a sweet, illusory dream. One small sip transports you onto a white, sandy beach, where the sparkling seawater beats with the rhythm to which the hymn of your leisurely vacation shall be composed.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色治疗加成提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 妮露的特色料理。晶莹剔透的杯子宛若华美的珠宝盒一般，装着入口即化的香软布丁。这一抹红艳的色泽…恍惚间让人联想到了妮露婆娑起舞之时，那熠熠生辉的身影。不由希望这一舞能永远没有落幕的时刻。
desc_en: Nilou's specialty. The crystal-clear cup that reminds you of an ornate jewel case contains a soft, melt-in-your-mouth pudding. The reddish coloration, like a fleeting trance, reminds you ever so much of Nilou's radiant, dancing form. Ah, would that this dance might last forever.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续1500秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 赛诺的特色料理。金灿灿的米粒被堆叠成了不可思议的丘状，挖开一勺，里面香喷喷的肉块入口后，顿时在心中激起了一种不可言状的冲动——好想现在就拿出「七圣召唤」，进行一场畅快淋漓的决斗！
desc_en: Cyno's specialty. The golden grains of rice have been piled up like a most remarkable hill. As you scoop out a chunk and place the fragrant meat into your mouth, an impulse you cannot name rises within your chest — a desire to whip out your Genius Invokation deck and duel!
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的34%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复980点生命值。

desc_chs: 坎蒂丝的特色料理。在端上来之前先已闻到扑鼻的香气，看来坎蒂丝在守护「胃口」方面也颇有心得…只是这分量比寻常的阿如拌饭还要来得更多一些，该、该如何才能将这一份「备至到过量的关怀」全部吃完呢？
desc_en: Candace's specialty. The aroma of this dish hits your nose long before it can be plated up. It would seem that Candace's adept guardianship also extends to sustaining appetites... But, uh, this really is an extraordinary amount of Aaru Mixed Rice. How are you supposed to deal with this mountain of "overflowing consideration"?
effect_desc_chs: 恢复80点体力。

desc_chs: 全新推出的无酒精饮品。不同成熟度的落落莓为果汁增加了由甜到酸的回味层次，冰凉的气泡水沁人心脾，伴你享受惬意的休闲时光。
desc_en: An all-new non-alcoholic beverage. Valberries of varying ripeness add layers of sour-to-sweet to this juice while the cooling sparkling water refreshes the soul — a fine companion for a pleasant and leisurely time.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复生命值上限的15%，并额外恢复550点生命值。

desc_chs: 由发酵乳制成的甜点。看起来没什么问题，但一入口…牙齿立马被酸得打颤。调味不足尚且可以通过加糖解决，但心中的酸涩余悸却无法轻易平复。
desc_en: A dessert made from fermented milk. It appears to be fine, but as soon as you try some... your teeth will quiver due to the unbearable acidity. The lack of seasoning can still be made up for by adding more sugar. However, that lingering sourness is hardly something that can be easily forgotten.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的18%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 由发酵乳制成的甜点。将牛奶发酵后过滤，制成酸奶后加糖搅匀，缀以蔷薇花干和坚果碎。这种吃法最初仅在四处奔波的冒险者和旅行商人之间流行，但现在已传遍整个须弥，不管是早餐还是午后甜点，都能见到它的身影。
desc_en: A dessert made from fermented milk. Once the milk is fermented and filtered into yogurt, stir sugar in before garnishing with dried roses and chopped nuts. In the beginning, this dish was only popular among adventurers and traveling merchants, but now, it is served as breakfast and a tea-time dessert across Sumeru.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的20%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复390点生命值。

desc_chs: 由发酵乳制成的甜点。绵密的凝乳、清新的花瓣、酥松的坚果，三者交融出芳醇甜蜜的滋味。喉间纵情享受的是此刻滑落的奶香，心头悠悠回荡的是彼时繁盛的花香。
desc_en: A dessert made from fermented milk. When mixed together, the dense curd, fragrant petals, and crisp nuts together create a mellow and sweet taste. As that fragrant milky concoction slips down your throat, it is almost as if you can smell the floral scent from a long time ago.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复470点生命值。

desc_chs: 莱依拉的特色料理。零零散散的坚果粒，宛若星辰点点缀于深邃静谧之夜。浅尝一口，奔波一整天的身心，忽而感受到了安宁。将感受告诉莱依拉之后，她露出了开心而又遗憾的复杂表情——「太、太好了！呜，如果对我也有效就更好了。」
desc_en: Layla's specialty. The scattered nuts are like stars dotted in the deep and quiet night sky. After just one bite, your body and mind after a day's work suddenly felt relaxed and peaceful. When you told Layla about that feeling, she showed a mixed expression of joy and regret — "Th—That's great! Ah, if only it could work for me too."
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的26%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复570点生命值。

desc_chs: 纳西妲的特色料理。据说玛兹在须弥有「智慧」的意思，如此精致玲珑的「智慧」，着实令人无法抗拒。纳西妲的眼里有着温柔的笑意：「海葵帮助并见证了鱼儿成长，鱼儿的小小馈赠也是理所应当的呀。」
desc_en: Nahida's specialty. It is said that "mazd" means "wisdom" in Sumeru, and such delicate "wisdom" is simply irresistible. There is a gentle smile in Nahida's eyes: "The sea anemone has helped the little fish and witnessed its growth, so it's only natural for the little fish to give something back."
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高282点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 油炸而成的小吃。油腻的外皮加上浓重到呛人的内馅，就算是搭配清爽的薄荷酱，也让人没有勇气再尝试第二个了。
desc_en: A deep-fried snack. Its greasy crust and aggressively strong-flavored filling easily stifle one's desire for a second bite, even with the attempt to balance the flavor using Mint — an attempt that has apparently failed.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的20%，并额外恢复900点生命值。

desc_chs: 油炸而成的小吃。薄薄的面皮卷上搅拌均匀的内馅，裹成三角状，放入油锅煎到金黄。肉馅与素馅两种都很常见，因此也成为了素食派与肉食派「交战时的必争之地」。
desc_en: A deep-fried snack. The well-stirred filling is wrapped in a thin crust, shaped into a triangle, then fried in a pan until golden brown. Both meat and vegetarian fillings are common, so the dish has become a point of conflict for those with a strong preference for one over the other.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并额外恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 油炸而成的小吃。金黄酥脆的外皮个头饱满，里面包裹着软糯的内馅。第一个，狼吞虎咽；第二个，细细品味…不知不觉间沉醉于味蕾的享受，恍惚中再次伸手，才发现盘内早已空空如也。
desc_en: A deep-fried snack. Each golden, crispy pocket is stuffed full with a soft, glutinous filling. You can't help but wolf one down immediately, and then reach out for a second one, taking your time to savor it... Piece by piece, you become lost in the dish's enticing aroma, and before you know it, you are only left with an empty plate.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的24%，并额外恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 珐露珊的特色料理。漆黑的甜饼横卧在薄荷般翠绿的酱汁之上，宛若一个玄之又玄的机关。或许是察觉到了你的犹豫，珐露珊前辈立刻挺起胸膛，「自信满满」地表示，这是一百年前须弥传统的做法，保证好吃。可，可是…一百年前须弥人的口味，真是如此吗？
desc_en: Faruzan's specialty. The dark and sweet cake, lying as it does atop a minty-green sauce bed, almost looks like some enigmatic mechanism. Your hesitation must have somehow reached Faruzan, for she then straightened up to assertively reassure you that this was a traditional dish in Sumeru and that its flavor is guaranteed. But you can't help wondering... Is it really a "traditional" dish that catered to the tastes of Sumeru people a hundred years ago?
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复生命值上限的20%，并额外恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 流浪者的特色料理。微苦的茶香与清甜的米饭浑然一体，吃上一口就停不下来。如此高超的厨艺，他是怎么做到的？似乎察觉到了你的内心想法，只见他脸色一沉：「还等什么？吃完了就赶快去洗碗。」
desc_en: Wanderer's specialty. The mildly bitter fragrance of tea and the refreshingly sweet aroma of rice are perfectly blended together, leaving you to wolf it down insatiably. How did he manage to cook something so extraordinary? Ah, your expression must have betrayed this thought to him, for his face suddenly turns grim: "Have you finished yet? Stop gawking and go wash the dishes now."
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色治疗加成提升25%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 颇具风味的炖肉。酸气有些刺鼻，光是闻着味道，就让人有了一些不妙的联想…放置得再久一些，或许里面会长出蕈兽吧？
desc_en: A meat stew with a unique taste. The sourness feels a little too much. The scent itself inspires not-so-appetizing associations... Leave it be for a while longer, and it might just become the perfect breeding ground for Fungi.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的30%，并额外恢复600点生命值。

desc_chs: 颇具风味的炖肉。将多种绿色蔬菜，混合后切碎，与肉块一起放入锅中炖煮。由于加入了柠檬，成品带有温和的酸味。须弥人通常会将其浇在米饭上一同享用。
desc_en: A meat stew with a unique taste. A variety of vegetables are mixed together, then chopped into small pieces and stewed with meat. The addition of lemons gives the final product a mildly sour taste. The people of Sumeru usually enjoy this dish over rice.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的32%，并额外恢复1250点生命值。

desc_chs: 颇具风味的炖肉。香气独特的食材搭配在一起，给味蕾带来了奇妙的享受。大块鲜肉被炖煮得绵软，裹上了深深的幽绿色，仿佛招引着品尝之人信步漫游于苍翠密林。
desc_en: A meat stew with a unique taste. The fragrant ingredients complement each other perfectly. Large pieces of fresh meat are stewed until tender and coated in dark green, as if inviting all who taste it for a leisurely stroll in the forest.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的34%，并额外恢复1900点生命值。

desc_chs: 以肉末为主的菜肴。黯淡的外表，让人无法想象出里面究竟放了什么。稍稍尝上一口…嗯，看来有小麦，嘴唇很明显是被小麦壳刮了一下。
desc_en: A dish with ground meat as its base. One may find it hard to guess what's inside based on its dull appearance. If you try taking a small bite... Yep, there's wheat in there. It'll probably scrape your lips if you're not careful enough.
effect_desc_chs: 以一定概率为选中角色恢复生命值上限的24%/30%/36%，并额外恢复450/600/700点生命值。

desc_chs: 以肉末为主的菜肴。先将小麦碾碎烹煮，混合碎肉制成表皮，再炒制洋葱和肉作为内馅，最后揉成肉团炸至金黄。只要火候掌控得当，轻而易举就能享受到大口吃肉的幸福。
desc_en: A dish with ground meat as its base. After crushing the wheat and cooking it over a fire, ground meat was added to form the outer layer. desc_chs: 随处可见的浓汤。抿了一口，还没下咽，却不禁开始祈祷——舌尖传来的怪味，可千万千万不要是泥土的味道啊…
desc_en: A bisque that can be found everywhere. A small sip, and the weird taste already freezes you. You can't help but pray: "Archons above, please tell me it's not dirt that I'm tasting..."
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复250点生命值。

desc_chs: 随处可见的浓汤。将食材煮熟后打碎成稠液，与奶油一并加热变为浓汤。简简单单就能享受一份热气腾腾的美味，既暖胃又暖心。
desc_en: A bisque that can be found everywhere. Blend cooked ingredients until they are liquefied, and heat the soup with cream until it is thickened up — voila! A simple dish that warms your stomach as well as your heart.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复400点生命值。

desc_chs: 随处可见的浓汤。丝滑温暖的口感，让人感觉仿佛被一条丝绒包裹着，在舞台上旋转跳跃…表演已落幕，无穷的回味却久久不散。
desc_en: A bisque that can be found everywhere. Its creamy texture feels like a silky garment, and you seem to be dancing on the stage in this beautiful attire... The curtain has fallen, but the memory lingers.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复550点生命值。

desc_chs: 长条面包的切片。坚硬的口感，让人忍不住频频看向碟子反复确认——这面包到底是不是石头块伪装出来的？
desc_en: Sliced baguette. It is so hard that one can't help but look at the plate and wonder: Is this baguette a stone in disguise?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高66点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 长条面包的切片。刚出炉的时候，外皮酥脆，里内松软，搭配上黄油和蒜的香气，着实美妙！难怪枫丹人下班的时候都喜欢买上一份。
desc_en: Sliced baguette. Taken freshly out of the oven, the bread has a crispy, crackling crust, and soft, fluffy crumb. The aroma of butter and garlic further adds to the baguette's tastiness! No wonder you often see Fontainians buying a baguette on their way home after work.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高81点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 长条面包的切片。据说枫丹每隔一段时期就举办比赛，选出面包棍做得最好的面包师，去沫芒宫一展身手。如果这份拿去参赛的话，一定能拿下头奖吧！
desc_en: Sliced baguette. It is said that every now and then, the people of Fontaine organize baking competitions. The bakers who make the best baguette get to show off their skills in the Palais Mermonia. This baguette could definitely win first prize in those competitions!
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高95点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 油炸而成的小吃。任何一位枫丹人吃了这份食物，都会忍不住写信给沫芒宫：请立法禁止变软的炸鱼薯条在市面上流通，以防新的受害人出现！
desc_en: A deep-fried appetizer. Any Fontainian unfortunate enough to eat this dish would file a complaint with the Palais Mermonia: Fish and Chips that have gone soft should be banned and made illegal before more people fall victim to them!
effect_desc_chs: 恢复70点体力。

desc_chs: 油炸而成的小吃。将鱼排裹好面糊油炸到金黄酥脆，再放上薯条，不管搭配什么酱汁，都拥有能让人脸上浮现笑容的神奇功效。
desc_en: A deep-fried appetizer. Coat fish fillets with batter and deep-fry until golden and crispy, then add a few chips on the side. This combination is so miraculous that whatever sauce you choose, it will always bring a hearty smile to your face.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复85点体力。

desc_chs: 油炸而成的小吃。鱼排和薯条在油花中兴高采烈地吱吱作响，高温催化出的美妙香气互相交织、融合，最后扑鼻而来…如果要说有什么是比吃薯条更令人快乐的，那一定是同时再吃一大口鱼排！
desc_en: A deep-fried appetizer. As the fish fillets and chips crack up with laughter in the hot, sizzling oil, their aromas meld perfectly before permeating the room... If there is anything that's more pleasurable than eating chips, that must be eating chips while also taking a huge bite of the fish fillet!
effect_desc_chs: 恢复100点体力。

desc_chs: 烤制而成的面食。面和馅料胡乱地混作了一团，口感实在说不上好。有种要被噎住的错觉，比现在这一口更加难以下咽的是——下一口。
desc_en: A baked pasta dish. The pasta and fillings are haphazardly mixed together, and the texture leaves a lot to be desired. You can almost feel the Lasagna becoming lodged in your throat — but don't worry, this isn't the worst part. You still have the next bite, which will be even harder to swallow.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的30%，并额外恢复600点生命值。

desc_chs: 烤制而成的面食。在面皮上铺一层肉酱、奶酪和白酱，叠上下一层面皮，如此重复数次后，烤至奶酪冒泡呈焦黄色。其美味的秘密，在于那精心熬制的肉酱。
desc_en: A baked pasta dish. Spread cheese, meat sauce, and Béchamel sauce on a layer of pasta strips, and place another layer of pasta strips on the top — repeat the process a few times and bake the pasta until the cheese becomes golden and bubbly. The secret of its tastiness lies in the carefully-prepared meat sauce.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的32%，并额外恢复1250点生命值。

desc_chs: 烤制而成的面食。肉酱在锅与火之歌中升华，在面皮和奶酪铸就的王座上摘下桂冠。吃下去的瞬间，无与伦比的美味席卷脑海，真想直接把今日定为「肉酱千层面纪念日」！
desc_en: A baked pasta dish. The Song of Pots and Fire eulogizes the meat sauce's ascension to the Pasta Throne. The moment it enters your mouth, it graces you with bliss so unparalleled that you almost want to make today Lasagna Day!
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的34%，并额外恢复1900点生命值。

desc_chs: 以鱼肉为主的馅饼。鱼头东倒西歪，比起咏唱更像是在哀嚎，尝一口，咸腥的气息在口中横冲直撞，将味蕾吓了个措手不及。耳边怎么隐约传来了鱼儿哭诉的声音…是、是幻听了吗？
desc_en: A fish pie. One can never fathom how each fish head ended up gazing in a different direction, turning their supposed "Chanson" into disorganized cries. A bite is enough to invite the sudden attack of a gamey taste, and your tastebuds are already admitting defeat. You seem to hear the fish wailing... Th—Those must be hallucinations, right?
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复900点生命值。

desc_chs: 以鱼肉为主的馅饼。先将内馅混合，再铺上面皮制作出馅饼的形状，最重要的是将鱼头摆好造型，再进行烤制。出炉后所有的鱼头都向上仰望，宛如咏诗唱曲一般。
desc_en: A fish pie. Mix the fillings and put the dough right on it. The key is to arrange the fish heads properly before baking. This way, when the dish is ready, every fish will gaze upward as if chanting in unison.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 以鱼肉为主的馅饼。在跳跃的火光中，鱼油滋滋滴入馅饼，面皮渐渐变得焦黄酥脆。刚一出炉，迫不及待地吹一口气，尝下一口，鱼儿在舌尖唱起了赞歌，歌声浪漫而又悠长。
desc_en: A fish pie. Fish fat sizzles near the dancing flame and then drips into the dough as the crust becomes golden and crispy. No one can resist the temptation to immediately have a try once the dish is freshly out of the oven. It feels as if the fish were singing a romantic and savory paean on the tip of your tongue.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 散发着浪漫气息的甜点。在烤糊多次蛋白霜之后，好不容易做出了还算是不错的外形。但由于花费的时间过多，泡泡桔片已经哭丧起了脸，变得不再香甜。
desc_en: A dessert with a romantic flair. The meringue has been baked to form a passable shape — albeit after several failed attempts that resulted in suspicious, burnt lumps. Unfortunately though, the cooking took so long that the Bulle Fruit now grimaces with frustration and no longer tastes sweet.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低15%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 散发着浪漫气息的甜点。先备好挞皮，往挞底挤上果酱和泡泡桔制作的凝乳，盖上一层饼皮，再裱好蛋白霜，进炉烘烤。一次性可以享受到三重花果香气，是餐后甜品的优秀备选。
desc_en: A dessert with a romantic flair. Add jam and fillings made from Bulle Fruit into tart shells and spread some meringue over the top before baking in the oven. The dish offers three fruity aromas all in one bite, making it a top choice for post-meal snacks.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低20%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 散发着浪漫气息的甜点。酥松香浓的挞皮和清爽可口的果馅一并融化在口中，最为令人赞叹的是焦黄与莹白均匀交织的蛋白霜，仿佛是被太阳烘烤过的云霞一般，带着味蕾一并升空，留下满口惊艳。
desc_en: A dessert with a romantic flair. The crispy and flaky tart shell and refreshing fruit fillings melt in your mouth. The harmonious coalescence of brown and white colors on the meringue reminds one of a stretch of gilded cloud in the warm sunlight. A pleasant surprise to your tastebuds indeed.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 多种蔬菜组成的大杂烩。多放或者少放一种食材都不会被发现，因为浓重的调料完全盖过了蔬菜原本的味道。
desc_en: A vegetable ragout. Don't worry too much if you are missing an ingredient or have accidentally thrown in something extra: No one will notice, as the excessive amount of seasoning has already overwhelmed the original flavors of the vegetables.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的20%，并额外恢复900点生命值。

desc_chs: 多种蔬菜组成的大杂烩。是枫丹农户为了庆祝蔬菜丰收而制作的随性菜肴，没有明确的食材配比，也没有固定的烹饪方式，不管是炒制还是烘烤都能带来最淳朴的美味。
desc_en: A vegetable ragout. It is an improvised dish created by Fontainian farmers celebrating vegetable harvests. There are no strict rules for the amount of ingredients or the cooking method. Be it stir-fried or baked, this unpretentious dish never fails to delight with its rustic savor.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并额外恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 多种蔬菜组成的大杂烩。据说从前有一位最为挑剔的枫丹美食家，在吃完这份朴实的菜肴后，回想起了自己的童年，热泪盈眶。或许故事有夸大的成分，但眼前的鲜美滋味的确货真价实。
desc_en: A vegetable ragout. It is said that this dish once moved a picky Fontainian gourmet to tears after reminding them of their childhood. The story may be somewhat exaggerated in some respects, but you should have no doubt that it is truly honest with regard to how tasty the dish is.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的24%，并额外恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 新鲜的生肉料理。暗红色的肉碎给人不祥的预感，凑近闻一闻，居然透出隐隐约约的酸味，看来已经不太适合人类食用了。嗯…当然也不该喂给发条警卫？
desc_en: A dish of fresh meat that is served raw. The minced meat, which is rusty red and faintly sour, gives off an ominous aura. This dish doesn't seem suitable for human consumption. Hmm... You probably shouldn't feed it to security meka either, right?
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的30%，并额外恢复600点生命值。

desc_chs: 新鲜的生肉料理。选用最为上等的肉块，剁碎后混合调料，搭配生蛋黄食用。没有人知道是谁第一个创造出了这道菜肴，可能是某位冒险家在走投无路之时的急中生智吧。
desc_en: A dish of fresh meat that is served raw. Choice meat that has been minced and seasoned goes perfectly well with raw egg yolk. It is unknown who came up with the idea. It might be a starving adventurer's desperate attempt at keeping their belly full.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的32%，并额外恢复1250点生命值。

desc_chs: 新鲜的生肉料理。细腻鲜嫩的肉碎，在蛋黄的包裹中变得甘香多汁。醇美的肉香伴随四溢的汁水，调动着整个口腔的味蕾一起狂欢，带给人最为纯粹又原始的美味享受。
desc_en: A fresh dish of raw meat. Tender meat that is minced properly and coated with egg yolk that tastes exceptionally juicy and sweet. The aromatic juice of the meat fills your mouth with euphoria, giving people an exceptionally pure and primitive gourmet delight.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的34%，并额外恢复1900点生命值。

desc_chs: 传统的枫丹名菜。光是把鸡塞进林猪的膀胱里，就费了九牛二虎之力。满怀期待地品尝一口成品…呃，鸡肉带着一丝古怪的味道，让人分不清到底是在吃林猪还是在吃鸡。
desc_en: A famous Fontainian cuisine. After a painstaking process of stuffing the chicken into the boar's bladder, you expectantly sample the dish that's finally ready... Ugh, what's the strange flavor? You begin to wonder if you're eating a boar or a chicken.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色物理伤害提升25%，暴击率提升6%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 传统的枫丹名菜。「韦西」在枫丹是膀胱的意思，顾名思义，这道菜肴就是将仔鸡简单腌制后装入林猪的膀胱中密封，再用高汤将膀胱煮至像生气的飘浮灵一般，圆鼓鼓的。通常仅取里面的鸡肉食用。
desc_en: A famous Fontainian cuisine. "Vessie" means "bladder" in Fontaine. As the name suggests, the seasoned chicken meat is enclosed in a forest boar's bladder when being poached in a meat broth. The bladder will puff out during the process like a rotund Specter. People usually only eat the chicken meat inside.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色物理伤害提升35%，暴击率提升8%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 传统的枫丹名菜。鲜美的汁水被紧紧锁在了肉块中，散发出纷繁的香气，是老饕们心目中最为心心念念的一品。迫不及待吃得一干二净后，仍是忍不住舔舔嘴角，想要好好享受最后一丝余香。如此佳肴美馔，无愧为枫丹美食界的经典明珠。
desc_en: A famous Fontainian cuisine. Delicious juice locked inside the meat gives off a rich and layered aroma. This dish is considered a highly sought-after cuisine by many gourmets. After wolfing down the whole plate, one can't help but lick their lips, savoring the lingering scent. This exquisite cuisine is no doubt the crown jewel of Fontaine's gastronomy.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色物理伤害提升45%，暴击率提升10%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 以洋葱为基础的汤。喝上一两口，感觉没什么大问题。于是大口大口地喝得一干二净，结果被奶酪腻得难以消受…接下来的一周内都不想再见到任何汤品了。
desc_en: An onion soup. The first few sips taste fine, but when you begin to gulp it down, the greasy cheese almost gives you palpitations... You probably don't want to have any soup in your presence the following week.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高88点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 以洋葱为基础的汤。将洋葱炒至焦褐色，加入高汤炖煮。装入汤盅，盖上面包片并撒上奶酪进行烘烤。老练的厨师都有个切洋葱绝对不会流泪的小窍门，那就是——让学徒帮忙切洋葱。
desc_en: An onion soup. Stir-fry the onion until it is slightly charred, and boil it in broth. Transfer the contents to a soup bowl, add a slice of bread, sprinkle some cheese, and bake it in the oven. Well-seasoned chefs never cry when chopping onions, and here's their secret trick: Let the apprentices do the job.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高107点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 以洋葱为基础的汤。金黄拉丝的乳酪，上脆下软的面包片，浓郁的洋葱味夹杂着淡淡的咸香，只需少少喝上一口，全身就能变得暖呼呼的。
desc_en: An onion soup. Stretchy and golden cheese lies on a slice of bread that is crispy on top and soft on the bottom. The rich onion aroma is combined with a slightly salty taste. A small sip is enough to warm one up.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高126点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 蛋清制成的甜点。尽管手都酸了还是没能让蛋清在打发的时候变成固态，勉强放到准备好的酱汁上，结果两者几乎融为了一体…呃，要不当饮料喝一口试试看？
desc_en: A dessert made of egg whites. Despite trying to froth up the egg whites until your hands were sore, and although you tried to save it by spreading the mixture over the sauce you prepared, the two melt into a total mess... Uh, how about thinking of it as a new beverage and having a sip?
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的18%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 蛋清制成的甜点。做法极其简单，只要打发好蛋清就成功了一半，再把加热过的蛋清放酱汁上就成功了另一半。成品造型浪漫，是枫丹贵妇人下午茶时间的首选。
desc_en: A dessert made out of egg whites. The cooking process is simple: Froth up the egg whites properly, and half the battle is won. Place the heated egg whites on the sauce, and you're done. The dessert has an exquisite look and is the first choice of Fontainian ladies for afternoon tea.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的20%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复390点生命值。

desc_chs: 蛋清制成的甜点。轻盈的蛋清露珠漂浮在白霜酱汁上，像是神秘宝藏一般等待着旅人的探索。此般妙不可言的美味享受，就像是打开华丽的宝箱一样让人满足！
desc_en: A dessert made of egg whites. Light egg-white dew that floats on the creamy sauce is like mysterious treasure chests awaiting travelers' exploration. "Enjoyment" would be an understatement, for the dessert brings you the joy of opening a luxurious chest!
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复470点生命值。

desc_chs: 水产组成的汤品。除了腥气以外尝不出其他的味道，如果味觉没出问题的话，一定是这道汤出了问题…啊等等，磕到牙齿的到底是砂砾还是鱼鳞？
desc_en: A seafood soup. The only flavor it has is the stench of fish. If your nose is still functioning properly, there must be something wrong with the soup... Ah wait, is it fish scales or gravel that got stuck in your teeth?
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的26%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复450点生命值。

desc_chs: 水产组成的汤品。发源于渔村白淞，最初是由渔民将卖不出去的杂鱼随意煮作一锅而成。由于鲜味十足而在枫丹流行开来，如今任何渔获都可以被加入其中。

desc_en: A dish of meat and vegetables. Each dully colored tomato seems to be almost trembling, as though it wants to open its mouth and sob at what it has become. Even worse, the ground meat inside tastes like wood chips. There's four of these cup-like tomato abominations, just how should they be dealt with?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高160点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 荤素搭配的菜肴。将圆溜溜的番茄挖空，放入均匀剁碎的肉馅，组装好后烤熟。成品酸甜柔软，是枫丹餐桌上备受欢迎的常驻嘉宾。
desc_en: A dish with a well-balanced proportion of meat and vegetables. Hollow out a round tomato, fill the hollowed tomato with ground meat, then bake this combination. This dish has a sour flavor and a tender texture. It is a very popular choice on Fontainian tables.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高194点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 荤素搭配的菜肴。多汁饱满的番茄让扎扎实实的肉糜带上了一丝灵动俏皮的气息，一口下去，酸香美妙。吃完一整个，心里所有的阴霾都被舌尖传来的美味享受给驱散得一干二净。
desc_en: A dish of meat and vegetables. Juicy mouthwatering tomatoes filled with hearty meat, each one has an agile, charming aroma, which explodes into a splendid savor after biting into it. After eating a single one, all the dark clouds in your heart will have been banished by the rich deliciousness emanating from your tongue.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高228点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 工序繁多的汤品。浑浊不清的液体，一眼看过去就知道是失败之作。能接受这样一份食物的，可能全枫丹只有那些在水边彷徨的浊水幻灵了吧…
desc_en: A soup with a complex recipe. A turbid and muddy looking fluid, a single glance is enough to tell this is a failed creation. Perhaps the only thing in Fontaine that would accept such "food" are the Tainted Hydro Phantasms roaming beside the water...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升10%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 工序繁多的汤品。将食材打成泥后与高汤炖煮，最后过滤出清汤食用。在枫丹街头流传着一条神秘的小道消息，据说没有灵感的作家一口气喝完此汤就能文思泉涌…但如此奇妙的功效，真的不是商家捏造出来的吗？
desc_en: A soup with a recipe involving many steps. Mash ingredients, then stew the mash in broth, and finally serve only the clear soup from the stew. Mysterious gossip on the streets in Fontaine claims that a writer suffering from writer's block had a sudden burst of inspiration after slurping this soup down... But how can one be sure that such stupendous effects are really not false advertising cooked up by some restaurant?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升15%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 工序繁多的汤品。浅浅一汪汤水，集结了辽阔青空与无垠大地的精华，肉与蔬菜的芳香严丝合缝、浑然一体。怪不得曾有一位蒸汽鸟报的专栏作家，在抓耳挠腮也挤不出来一个字的时候，喝了这样一碗汤后马上源泉万斛、下笔如神。
desc_en: A soup with a complex recipe. A clear soup that combines the essence of the boundless blue skies above and the limitless land below, the aromas of meat and vegetables blended seamlessly into a greater whole. No wonder a columnist for The Steambird, once unable to squeeze out a single word onto the blank paper before them, drank a single bowl and immediately became a font of literary genius, every word nearly as exquisite as this dish.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 传统的枫丹菜肴。不小心失手倒入了过多的油，导致煎制出来的成品也油汪汪的。如果能想到好办法把油分顺利沥干的话，还是可以入口的。
desc_en: A traditional Fontainian dish. It seems too much oil was accidentally added, creating an extremely greasy product dripping in the stuff. If you can think of a good way to absorb and remove the excess oil, it might become edible.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色冲刺消耗的体力降低15%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 传统的枫丹菜肴。将苹果块与血肠片分别煎熟后摆盘，可以搭配酱汁食用。常有外国游客看到这道菜的名字误以为是甜点，但黑布丁其实是血肠的别称。
desc_en: A traditional Fontainian dish. Fry the apple slices and blood sausage slices separately and serve them on a plate with sauce. Judging by the name of this dish, tourists from other nations often think it should be a dessert, while Boudin Noir is actually just a name for blood sausage.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色冲刺消耗的体力降低20%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 传统的枫丹菜肴。血肠的油脂感被香甜的苹果完美中和，散发出惹人迷恋的焦香，让人忍不住两眼发光连连赞叹。
desc_en: A traditional Fontainian dish. A perfect combination, with the sweet fragrance of the apples neutralizing the fat of the blood sausage. An enticing, slightly burnt smell wafts upwards from the plate, and the eyes of those who see it light up as they shout with joy and anticipation.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 简朴的乡土炖菜。外形看似没有问题，吃着吃着，闻到了微弱的焦味，这才发现底部的食材已经烧焦黏在砂锅上了。唔，下次煮的时候要记得翻动…
desc_en: A simple rustic stew. Though it looks okay at a glance, as you begin to eat, you notice a slight burned taste, before realizing the bottom layer of ingredients has been so badly burned they've all fused to the casserole. Ugh... next time, stir the ingredients occasionally while cooking...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 简朴的乡土炖菜。只需要在砂锅里混合所有食材再煮熟便可食用。值得一提的是，这道菜的全名为——用卡苏莱砂锅炖煮的秃秃豆焖油封禽肉与熏制香肠佐以茉洁草。实在太长，就简称卡苏莱砂锅了。
desc_en: A simple countryside stew. Simply put all the ingredients in a casserole, mix them up, and cook until they are ready to serve. It is worth noting that the full name of this dish is "Glabrous Beans, Fowl Confit, and Smoked Sausage Stew in Cassoulet Casserole with a Side of Marcotte." The intimidating lengthiness of the name has, understandably, driven people to just call it "Cassoulet."
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升25%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 简朴的乡土炖菜。时间是最能催化美味的神奇武器，长久的炖煮使得肉块吸饱了鲜美的汤汁，变得酥软，与香浓的豆粒一起，造就了最为振奋人心的温暖滋味。
desc_en: A simple rustic stew. Time is the most wondrous of weapons for catalyzing the creation of deliciousness, and time allows the meat in this dish to soak up the ocean of stewed flavor it is bathing in, becoming soft and fragrant. Together with the rich aroma of the beans, it conjures a warm delight in one's mouth that stirs the spirit.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升30%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 梅洛彼得堡的公爵，隐于漆黑海底的领主。
desc_en: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

desc_chs: 带有馅料的薄饼。第一口寡淡得令人担心自己是否失去了味觉，第二口又被甜味齁得宁可味觉立刻消失…如此刺激的体验，宛如在惊涛骇浪中驾驶浪船一般，就算上岸了还是心有余悸。
desc_en: Crepes with fillings. The first bite is so bland you wonder if you've lost your sense of taste. The second bite is so unbearably sweet that you wish you actually had lost it... Such a stimulating culinary experience is like riding a waverider into a storm: Even if you make it to the shore, you'll be traumatized.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色滑翔和冲刺消耗的体力降低15%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 带有馅料的薄饼。先煎好饼皮，再加入果酱、奶油和水果切片。其实做法并不单一，根据加入的食材不同，口味也是五花八门。
desc_en: Crepes with fillings. Fry the crepes first, then serve them with jam, cream, and fruit slices. In fact, the recipe has quite a few variants. The dish's taste differs according to the different ingredients used.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色滑翔和冲刺消耗的体力降低20%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 带有馅料的薄饼。轻盈的奶油与绵密的果酱交织成悠悠乐声，软乎乎的饼皮，仿佛是翩翩荡于其中的裙裾，引得舌尖也忍不住随之起舞。
desc_en: Crepes with fillings. The light cream and delectable jam are composed into a symphony of flavor, folded into a masterfully cooked soft crepe, as though robed in silken perfection, inviting your tongue to join an elegant, endless waltz of culinary delight.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色滑翔和冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 那维莱特的特色料理。据他说选用了最为纯净清冽的高山之水，制作出了精妙绝伦的无双珍品。尝起来确实清醇味美。至于整体味道和一般汤水并无二致这一点，要不还是别说了吧…
desc_en: Neuvillette's specialty. He claims he specifically selected the purest, chilliest waters from the highest mountains to create this exquisite and matchless treasure. Though it does have a refreshing quality, as for how the overall flavor of the soup is no different from ordinary soups... It's probably best not to mention it.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升20%，暴击伤害提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 莱欧斯利的特色料理。听到他以「现在离开，厨区会爆炸」为理由拒绝了部下后，不一会儿，一盘肉肴映入眼帘。丰腴的肉汁与酥松的外皮带来的非同凡响的双重享受，只是这调味尝起来，似乎和最近流行的某种调味品的味道一模一样…
desc_en: Wriothesley's specialty. Soon after kicking out his subordinates with the excuse, "Feel free to leave, but I'm staying! Things are heating up in here, and it could blow!", a meatastic delicacy greets your eyes. A full-bodied sauce slathered over flaky skin brings an extraordinary double blast of deliciousness, though as you taste it, it does seem to be practically identical to a condiment that has become awfully popular recently...
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的30%，并额外恢复1750点生命值。

desc_chs: 长条形的小蛋糕。每一层的味道吃起来都大同小异，甚至偷懒少加了几层。懂行的人在吃下第一口时，就能发现制作方法出了问题。
desc_en: A small cake, shaped into a long rectangle. The flavor of each layer seems more or less the same, and... wait a minute, it's even missing a few layers! Connoisseurs will know the bakery messed up badly after the first bite.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色生命值上限提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 长条形的小蛋糕。据说这是很久很久以前，某位糕点师以枫丹民众对水神大人的热爱为灵感，创作而成。堆叠而起的多重层次、考验厨艺的制作工序，无一不证明着水神大人的影响力。
desc_en: A small cake, shaped into a long rectangle. It is said that long, long ago, a certain patissier used the great love the people of Fontaine held for their Hydro Archon as inspiration to create this confectionary masterpiece. The manifold layers stacked one upon the other are a true test of the chef's skills, and each aspect of this cake is proof of the great Hydro Archon's influence.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色生命值上限提升22%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 长条形的小蛋糕。咖啡与杏仁的绵长气息，推着思绪前进，恍惚间宛若进入了一场反转不断又纷华靡丽的歌剧，令人忍不住沉溺其中，只希望落幕时刻永远不会来临。
desc_en: A small cake, shaped into a long rectangle. The endlessly indulgent aroma of coffee and almonds draws you in and pushes your thoughts forward, as though you absentmindedly stumbled into an extravagant opera without even realizing it. You find yourself drowning in the twists and turns of this luxurious performance, and only hope that the finale never comes.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色生命值上限提升25%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 奶油夹心的甜点。由于完成后放置过久，酥皮已经变软了。和想象中的酥脆口感大相径庭，才尝了一口，就想直接判这道甜点「死刑」了。
desc_en: A cream-filled dessert. It's been sitting out way too long, and the once-flaky crust is now soft and mushy. It is... quite different from the crispy texture you imagined. After trying a single bite, you want to just pass the "death sentence" on this erstwhile dessert.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色物理伤害提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 奶油夹心的甜点。蓬松的酥皮，包裹着饱满的奶油，圆鼓鼓的，就像膨膨兽的肚皮一样可爱。绵密柔软的奶油能抓住每一个人的心。
desc_en: A cream-filled dessert. Fluffy, flaky crust cradles a rich cream within. Round and nearly bursting, it's as cute as a Blubberbeast's belly. Few hearts can escape being ensnared by the thick, soft cream within.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色物理伤害提升30%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 奶油夹心的甜点。咬下一口只觉得意犹未尽，忍不住一连吃完了剩下的所有，即使是嘴角的奶油，都能让幸福感涌上胸口：如果每顿饭的餐后甜点都是它，这冒险生活该有多么美妙！
desc_en: A cream-filled dessert. After the first morsel crosses your lips, you simply cannot help but scarf the rest down! Even the remnants of the cream lingering on the corners of your mouth is enough to flood your heart with contented bliss. If only every meal could be followed by such sweet perfection... Ah! How wondrous would this adventurous life be!
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色物理伤害提升40%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 芙宁娜的特色料理。「普茹斯蒂司」在枫丹意为「敬正义」，她曾在偌大的舞台上，见证了最为崇高之正义的诞生。这颇具层次感的风味，跌宕起伏最后又如释重负，是否出自她本人的某段体验呢？
desc_en: Furina's specialty. "Pour la Justice" means "veneration of justice" in Fontaine, and she who once performed on the greatest of stages bore witness to the birth of sublime justice. Its layered flavors seem to swell and fade like the waves of the sea, before finally relaxing as though laying down a heavy burden. Perhaps it reflects something she personally experienced?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色生命值上限提升30%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 夏洛蒂的特色料理。陪着她追踪独家新闻时，被她塞入手中的小吃。炸鱼排在齿间咔嚓作响，再看向身边，她迈着雀跃的步伐，两者节奏渐渐重叠起来…虽然新闻还未成稿，但心中的快乐和满足在此刻已然到达了顶点。
desc_en: Charlotte's specialty. A snack that she stuffed in your hands while you accompany her on a relentless pursuit of exclusive scoops. You glance at her skipping beside you, and the excited rhythm of her steps slowly overlaps with the crackling of crispy fried fish fillets in your mouth... Though this latest news has yet to be turned into a finished story, the joy and contentment in your heart has already reached its peak.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复130点体力。

desc_chs: 金灿灿的油炸小吃。花了很长时间才沥干了多余的油分，结果品尝时炸物已经变得软软的，不再酥脆。呃…不知道海岸边的渔鸥愿不愿意接受这样一份食物？
desc_en: A golden brown fried snack, from which the excess oil was drained after much arduous labor, only to result in a soggy fried slop stripped of any crispiness. Hmm... Might the gulls by the shore be willing to accept such a meager offering?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色治疗加成提升15%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 金灿灿的油炸小吃。把鸡肉泥捏成中空造型，和洋葱圈一起组成「圈」。鱼肉泥和土豆泥则压成圆饼状，化为「圆」。最后放入油锅，「圈圈圆圆」便在滋啦滋啦的油炸声中诞生了。
desc_en: A golden brown fried snack. Mashed chicken is shaped into a hollow "O" shape by combining them with onion rings. Mashed fish and potatoes are similarly combined into a round form, making up the meat of the "feast." Put them both into a pot of hot oil and presto — your "Feast-O's" are born amidst the crackling oil.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色治疗加成提升17%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 金灿灿的油炸小吃。香喷喷的气息在刚出炉时，便能立即勾起每个人的口腹之欲。左手勾起圈，右手捏着圆；齿间满是轻盈酥脆，舌尖尽享醇香滋味。
desc_en: A golden brown fried snack. Freshly fried and fully fragrant they come, ready to get appetites roaring. With the ring in your left hand and the round in your right, behold, the crest of crispness lies in your grasp. Dig in! Let the flavor flood forth into your mouth.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色治疗加成提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 五颜六色的小小圆饼。拿起第一个，吃起来是空心的；拿起第二个，造型有点歪斜；拿起第三个，表面粗糙不平、颜色不均…不愧是细节繁多的枫丹甜点，看来想要成功驾驭还需要更长时间的练习。
desc_en: Small, multi-colored round pastries. The first one feels empty, the second is slanted, the third uneven, and the fourth's a fickle mix... As expected of a Fontainian dessert dictated by dozens of details, this will take more work to master.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低15%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 五颜六色的小小圆饼。枫丹有句俗语：甜点里若是少了马卡龙，就如同众水少了源泉。作为水之国最具代表性的甜品之一，不用说后厨的枫丹甜点师，就连街头的甜点爱好者都能将其制作方法倒背如流。
desc_en: Small, multi-colored round pastries. There's a saying in Fontaine that a dessert spread without macarons is like having the many waters bereft of their source. Never mind the dessert artists in Fontainian kitchens — even dessert dilettantes on the streets know this adage by heart.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低20%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 五颜六色的小小圆饼。薄脆的外壳包裹着绵密又柔软的夹心，一切都完美得恰到好处。浅尝一个，宛如心间被小猫咪的鼻头轻轻蹭了蹭一般。无论是谁都会为这一口甜蜜浪漫倾倒吧。
desc_en: Small, multi-colored round pastries. The crisp shell wraps a thick, soft filling, and all is right with the world. Try one, and it shall be as if a little kitten's nose is nuzzling against your chest. Surely no one could help but fall for such an experience.
