desc_chs: 水蓝色的冰淇淋。大块的颗粒状海盐偷袭了味蕾，在过度咸味的刺激下不由恍神…等鼓起勇气打算再试一次的时候，冰淇淋已经融化成了奶昔…
desc_en: Aqua-blue ice cream. The large chunks of sea salt ambushed your taste buds, causing you to blank out... By the time you mustered up the valor to try again, the dessert had melted into more of a milkshake...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高215点，治疗效果提升6%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 水蓝色的冰淇淋。炎热时分最美好的消遣莫过于来上一杯解暑的冰淇淋，口感冰爽清凉，堪比纵身一跃扎入海中，烦恼随着齿间热度渐渐消散，心中唯余畅快。
desc_en: Aqua-blue ice cream. The best way to while away a sweltering day is by enjoying some refreshing ice cream. It chills the body and cools the soul, giving one a feeling akin to having leaped into the sea, all worries dissipating as the heat flees your mouth, leaving naught but pure joy.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高261点，治疗效果提升8%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 水蓝色的冰淇淋。杯身上憨厚可爱的膨膨兽模样增添谐趣。奶香编织出了一番闲适，丝丝缕缕的咸味轻柔交织。味觉仿佛被请入了洋流之中，参与一场别开生面的冒险。这样的美味之旅，真希望没有尽头！
desc_en: Aqua-blue ice cream. The likeness of the earnest, adorable Blubberbeast printed on the cup adds a humorous touch, and the buttery creaminess is interwoven with a light, silken saltiness. It is as if your senses, too, have been invited to embark on an unforgettable undersea odyssey — one that you hope shall never end!
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高308点，治疗效果提升10%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 小面包与咖啡的套餐。干硬的面包有着敦实的口感，仿佛已经丢失了水分。苦中带酸的饮品，带来误喝药剂的味觉。值得庆幸的是，这并不是一份正餐…
desc_en: A small pastry-and-coffee combo. The stony bread stands solid against your teeth, having seemingly been robbed of all moisture. The bitter drink stained with sourness is such that you'd be pardoned for thinking it some kind of medicinal concoction. The only saving grace is that this isn't the main course...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低15%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 小面包与咖啡的套餐。卷起面团，刷上蛋液，送入烤箱。最后膨胀开的小巧面包就热气腾腾地出炉了。据说刷蛋液这一工序好比是面包师在签名——看来这次留下的签名十分规整。
desc_en: A small pastry-and-coffee combo. Roll and fold the dough, lather it in egg wash, and place the creation into the oven. Soon, it will have expanded into an exquisite pastry, piping hot as it triumphantly exits the oven. It is said that the act of brushing the egg wash on is like a baker's signature — and it seems this one has fine penmanship indeed.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低20%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 小面包与咖啡的套餐。两头尖尖的面包有着松软的内里与酥脆的外皮，香甜的黄油气息四溢在空气之中，与咖啡浓烈的味道盘互交错，宛若天作之合。无论是在清晨时分还是小憩时刻，要是能吃上这么一份完美套餐，恐怕再疲惫的人也会雀跃不已。
desc_en: A small pastry-and-coffee combo. The two pointy pieces of bread conceal fluffy softness within crispy crusts, and the aromatic butter dances in perfect harmony with the intense coffee aroma, a match made in heaven. Whether by early morning light or brief break hour, to partake of this lovely combo is to salve even the most exhausted soul.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攀爬和冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 奇妙的特色饮品。紧紧封闭着的小小瓶子，看似与寻常饮品无异。或许它被施加的是让饮料变得更加美味的神奇魔术…不过，真有这种魔术吗？
desc_en: A marvelous specialty sealed within a tiny bottle that looks no different from any ordinary drink. Perhaps there is some magic spell on it that makes drinks taste better... But does such magic really exist?

desc_chs: 颇受欢迎的肉肴。起初一切顺利，但意想不到的是在最后切片的关键时刻，卷好的肉块突然散架了。配菜与兽肉混作一盘狼藉，与强风过后的场面颇有几分相似…
desc_en: A rather popular meat dish. At first, things were going well enough, but at the final, crucial moment, the rolled meat suddenly fell apart, causing the meat and side dishes to look like the aftermath of a wild storm...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中任意角色击败敌人后，恢复15点体力，此效果每3秒至多触发一次，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 颇受欢迎的肉肴。往薄薄的肉片上放上培根与其他配菜，卷起后下油锅煎成焦褐色，再放入汤中炖煮。成品切开后，肉片紧紧包裹着馅料，如同旋风一般。
desc_en: A rather popular meat dish. Bacon and other garnishes are placed over thin slices of meat, which are then rolled up and pan-fried until browned, then simmered in a broth. When the finished dish is cut open, the meat slices stay tightly wrapped around the filling, just like a tornado.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中任意角色击败敌人后，恢复20点体力，此效果每3秒至多触发一次，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 颇受欢迎的肉肴。浓浓的肉香之风席卷了身心，简直满足了人们对丰腴肉食的一切想象。难怪每一个乐乐醄醄的欢聚时分，都不难找到这道菜的身影。
desc_en: A rather popular meat dish. The rich meat fragrance sweeps through you, body and soul, satisfying what your imagination envisions for bountiful meat. No wonder, then, that this dish often finds itself a place at any joyous gathering.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中任意角色击败敌人后，恢复25点体力，此效果每3秒至多触发一次，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 以苹果为主的传统甜点。苹果是苹果，面皮是面皮，仿佛两个水火不相容的人在强行寻找共同话题，就算是再香甜的黄油，都无法扭转这一尴尬生硬的局面。
desc_en: A traditional apple dessert. Apples are apples, and dough is dough. To force them into a commonality they do not share is to create an awkward mess that even the most flavorful butter cannot rescue.
effect_desc_chs: 激活石化古树、地脉衍出，或者开启宝箱后，为队伍中所有角色恢复16%生命值，并额外恢复600点生命值，此效果每5秒至多触发一次，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 以苹果为主的传统甜点。酥脆美味的秘密源于薄薄的面皮，据说高级的蒙德甜点师制作出的面皮，就算覆盖在书页上也不会影响阅读。
desc_en: A traditional apple dessert. The secret to its crispy and delicious flavor lies in the thin pastry crust. Apparently, the best pastry chefs in Mondstadt are said to be capable of making pastries so thin that you could carry on reading even if you placed it over the page.
effect_desc_chs: 激活石化古树、地脉衍出，或者开启宝箱后，为队伍中所有角色恢复18%生命值，并额外恢复900点生命值，此效果每5秒至多触发一次，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 以苹果为主的传统甜点。光是闻到苹果甜蜜柔和的香气，就仿佛置身于温暖炉火旁。还未来得及细细回味，握住刀叉的手像是被他人操纵了一般，不受控制地伸向了下一块。
desc_en: A traditional apple dessert. The mere aroma of the apples gives a feeling akin to situating oneself before a warm hearth. Before you can even think to slowly appreciate it, your hands move as if compelled by some other person, knife and fork in tow, reaching out for the next piece.
effect_desc_chs: 激活石化古树、地脉衍出，或者开启宝箱后，为队伍中所有角色恢复20%生命值，并额外恢复1200点生命值，此效果每5秒至多触发一次，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 枫丹的最高审判官，因其无懈可击的「秉公无私」而闻名。
desc_en: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.

desc_chs: 色彩缤纷的饼干。嚼着十分费劲，仿佛牙齿在和真正的宝石硬碰硬…如果收集起来当暗器的话，在出其不意之时迅速扔出，说不定能对敌人造成致命一击？
desc_en: Multicolored biscuits. This is exhausting to chew, almost as if your teeth are grinding against real gemstones... Perhaps you might even cause mortal hurt to your foes with this, were you to throw them from a hidden location in battle and catch them unawares.
effect_desc_chs: 来自回声之子部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 色彩缤纷的饼干。先用面团做出宝石托，再在其中加入颜色与味道各异的果酱。成品看似一个个精致小巧的宝石吊坠，实则是香甜可口的小饼干，小心不要搞混了哦！
desc_en: Multicolored biscuits. First, use dough to create a gemstone fitting, before adding jam of different colors and flavors to the setting. The result resembles nothing so much as an exquisite gemstone pendant, but be careful not to mix them up with the real thing!
effect_desc_chs: 来自回声之子部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 色彩缤纷的饼干。酸酸甜甜的果酱透出了晶莹剔透的光泽，给酥酥脆脆的饼干添上了一抹闪耀。这般灿烂多彩的美味，就算是与高级珠宝相比，也丝毫不逊色！
desc_en: Multicolored biscuits. The sour and sweet jam gives off the clear luster of crystalline form, adding a shine to the crunchy treats. Such radiance! Such tastiness! What could this be but equal even to the most precious jewels?
effect_desc_chs: 来自回声之子部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 颗粒果制成的披萨。甜味的颗粒果和咸味的奶酪这一组合，可能化作浪漫交织的邂逅，也可能成为水火不容的冲撞。很遗憾，从品尝到的味道上来说，这次显然是后者…
desc_en: A pizza made using Grainfruit. The combination of sweet Grainfruit and salty cheese can make for a romantic encounter but also an irreconcilable clash... Unfortunately, the flavor on this one appears to be the latter.
effect_desc_chs: 来自流泉之众部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 颗粒果制成的披萨。在饼皮上铺匀颗粒果，再撒上一层厚厚的奶酪，送入烤箱中，最后画上可爱的鳍游龙图案就大功告成了。趁热吃上一口，暖呼呼的，让人一下子联想到了泡温泉的悠哉时光。
desc_en: A pizza made using Grainfruit. Grainfruit is scattered across the crust before a thick layer of cheese is poured on top, and the whole thing is delivered into the oven. The final touch is to then draw a little Koholasaurus picture on it. Eat it while it's hot — the warmth will remind you of a serene time spent enjoying a soothing soak in a hot spring.
effect_desc_chs: 来自流泉之众部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 颗粒果制成的披萨。奶酪拉出长长的丝，仿佛一道金黄色的瀑布，直直坠入口中，点缀其中的颗粒果饱满多汁，咸甜互相融合，勾引出了肚子里的无数馋虫，吃完整个仍是意犹未尽。
desc_en: A pizza made using Grainfruit. The cheese pull is like a golden waterfall, descending into your mouth bedecked in juicy Grainfruit. The sweetness and saltiness blend on your tongue, luring forth a boundless appetite within you — even when you finish the whole thing, you could go for more.
effect_desc_chs: 来自流泉之众部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 味道各异的小零食。一连吃下好几个，都是难以言表的奇怪味道，胃部甚至隐隐约约有种灼烧的感觉…到底是运气不好，还是这一份里全都如此？
desc_en: A snack with lots of different flavors. To eat several in a row is to experience a myriad of strange flavors that... burn your stomach? Did you just have bad luck with flavors, or are they all like this?
effect_desc_chs: 来自悬木人部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 味道各异的小零食。闭上眼睛就猜不出下一个的味道，吃的时候心跳会咚咚加速，所以很受热爱冒险的「悬木人」欢迎。顺便一提，嘭嘭二字来源于颗粒果在高温下炸开发出的声响。
desc_en: A snack with lots of different flavors. If you close your eyes, you won't be able to guess what flavor you'll get next, and eating them is sure to increase your heart rate — and that's what makes this popular amongst the Scions of the Canopy. By the way, the "pop" part of the name comes from the sound of Grainfruit kernels bursting open under high temperatures.
effect_desc_chs: 来自悬木人部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 味道各异的小零食。「小小炸弹」接连不断地在口中炸开，带来一个个惊喜的味道。左右手一并合作，不停地往嘴里扔，在美妙的咔嚓咔嚓声中，一切压力都烟消云散。
desc_en: A snack with lots of different flavors. These surprising flavors of these "little bombs" explode between your teeth. Your left and right hands work in unison, sending more hurtling headlong into your mouth. Om nom nom — amid the sound of chewing, all your stress melts away.
effect_desc_chs: 来自悬木人部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 小龙造型的饼干。寡淡的味道与精致的外观形成了鲜明的反差，再加上坚硬的口感，谈不上好吃，也不能说难吃…等等，如果把这些饼干当做磨牙棒的话，会有小龙愿意接受吗？
desc_en: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. The bland taste and exquisite appearance make for a horrendous contrast, and when combined with the hard mouthfeel, makes for something that's neither delectable nor inedible... Hmm, would Saurians accept using these as teething sticks?
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的30%，并额外恢复600点生命值。

desc_chs: 小龙造型的饼干。吃起来松松脆脆、香香甜甜，上面的小龙图案非常可爱，能轻而易举地俘获纳塔人的心。据说甚至连龙都会被其吸引，但龙真的会吃饼干吗？
desc_en: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. Light, crispy, sweet, and fragrant, with adorable patterns on top to boot — how could the people of Natlan not be won over by such delectable snacks? Apparently, even the Saurians love 'em... But are crackers really the type of thing Saurians eat?
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的32%，并额外恢复1250点生命值。

desc_chs: 小龙造型的饼干。黄油诱人的味道牵引着味蕾抓住苦种与颗粒果交织出的美妙。可爱造型让人爱不释手，香甜味道让人停不下口，最后就连从指尖偷偷溜走的饼干碎屑也没有放过！
desc_en: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. The enticing aroma of butter draws forth the delightful interplay between the Cacahuatl and Grainfruit, while the cute shapes make them truly hard to put down. In the end, even the crumbs that slipped through your fingers were not to be spared!
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的34%，并额外恢复1900点生命值。

desc_chs: 新鲜果蔬制作的沙拉。吃下的每一口都和直接生啃果蔬没什么区别…仔细回想了一下制作过程，不出所料——忘记加酱汁了。
desc_en: A salad made from fresh fruit and vegetables. Each bite of this is no different from eating raw fruits and vegetables straight up... And once you give it any consideration, you realize that you forgot to add sauce.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复250点生命值。

desc_chs: 新鲜果蔬制作的沙拉。将颗粒果焯水，切碎其他食材，淋上酱汁，一同搅拌均匀。制作方法十分简单，更重要的是，吃再多也不会有任何心理负担！
desc_en: A salad made from fresh fruit and vegetables. Blanch the Grainfruit, chop the other ingredients, drizzle over the sauce, then stir until evenly mixed. Extremely simple to make, but even more importantly, it's so healthy that no matter how much you eat, you won't feel stressed!
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复400点生命值。

desc_chs: 新鲜果蔬制作的沙拉。酸甜多样的味道，就像是漫步于五彩缤纷的森林之中，从味蕾到心间，都被染上了一抹灵动的清新。
desc_en: A salad made from fresh fruit and vegetables. Sweet, sour, and many others constitute a forest of flavor for you to wander through, leaving you with a lasting touch of freshness from your taste buds to your heart.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复550点生命值。

name_en: Suspicious Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
desc_chs: 裹满酱汁的烤鱼。浓郁的酱汁掩盖了鱼本身的味道，满口的薄荷清香让人完全忘记了这其实是一道烤鱼…
desc_en: Grilled Fish doused in a delicious sauce. The thick sauce has all but drowned out the fish's natural flavors, and the strident taste of mint has all but wiped that of Grilled Fish out.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的8%，并额外恢复800点生命值。

desc_chs: 裹满酱汁的烤鱼。鱼身打上花刀，往肚子中塞上香料，烤熟后淋上厚厚的薄荷酱。鱼肉充满清香，让人胃口大开。
desc_en: Grilled Fish doused in delicious sauce. The fish is scored, stuffed with spices, then baked. Once cooked, a thick mint sauce is generously drizzled over the top. The refreshing aroma of the fish is enough to whet anyone's appetite.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的9%，并额外恢复1000点生命值。

name_en: Delicious Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
desc_chs: 裹满酱汁的烤鱼。一口焦脆清香的鱼皮，一口鲜嫩弹牙的鱼肉，普通的烹饪方式，带来了不一般的美味。
desc_en: Grilled Fish doused in a delicious sauce. Crisp, fragrant fish skin, tender fish meat... Ordinary methods, extraordinary flavor.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的10%，并额外恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 带馅的薄饼。饼皮明明看着单薄如织物，但吃起来却冷硬如铁片，不过内馅味道不错，抛开饼皮不谈的话，倒是一份可口的烤虾…
desc_en: Thin tacos with filling. The shell looks like thin fabric, but is in truth as cold and hard as iron. The filling's not bad, though, so laying the shell aside, could make for some decent grilled shrimp...
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复900点生命值。

desc_chs: 带馅的薄饼。先烙出薄饼，再加入蔬菜与烤虾，最后淋上酱汁，这就是制作塔塔可的三部曲。在纳塔，塔塔可就像是燃素一样无处不在。
desc_en: Thin tacos with filling. Making Tatacos is a three-part process — you bake the tacos first, you add vegetables and grilled shrimp second, then finally, you drizzle sauce over the top. In Natlan, it's hard to say which is a more common sight — phlogiston or Tatacos.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 带馅的薄饼。当舌尖触及热腾腾的饼皮和内馅时，怡人的鲜香带着热情溜入口齿之中，让人不禁想起一句纳塔俗语——或许生活会让人失望，但塔塔可永远不会。
desc_en: Thin tacos with filling. When your tongue touches the piping-hot shell and its rich filling, a pleasant fragrance gushes out from within, reminding you of a saying from Natlan — "Life might disappoint, but Tatacos, never!"
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 带果香的生鱼块。腌制的时间过短，鱼块并没有入味。好在食材足够新鲜，味道倒是马马虎虎过得去，但心里总有几分遗憾挥之不去。
desc_en: Raw pieces of fish with a fruity fragrance. Having not been marinated for nearly long enough, the fish lacks flavor. Fortunately, the fresh ingredients allow the dish as a whole to muddle through, albeit leaving a sense of regret behind.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高66点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 带果香的生鱼块。取用新鲜的鱼肉，去皮后切成厚块，用酸汁腌制，直至鱼肉变白，最后加入切碎的配菜调味。集酸辣于一体，是纳塔最经典的美味。
desc_en: Raw pieces of fish with a fruity fragrance. The fish — which must be fresh — is first skinned and cut into thick chunks, then marinated in the sour sauce until the fish turns white, after which shredded vegetables are added for seasoning. A combination of sour and spicy flavors, it is one of Natlan's most classic flavors.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高81点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 带果香的生鱼块。首先扑面而来的是鲜美的冲击，下一波则是酸与辣带来的刺激，小小一块鱼肉有着宛如浪潮般此起彼伏的层次感，仿佛在海上冲浪，浪潮平息后，仍是意犹未尽。
desc_en: Raw pieces of fish with a fruity fragrance. The sheer fragrance bowls you over in the first wave, with sourness and spiciness bringing up the rear, granting this fish layers akin to the tides, with you the surfer on a sea of flavor. Even when the tumult has subsided, your yearning remains.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高95点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 球形的小零食。苦种原本的特殊风味被过量的糖掩盖，失去了层次，空余下单调的甜味。吃起来又腻又粘牙…清理牙齿倒是不难，只是剩下的巧克力该怎么办呢？
desc_en: Small spherical snacks. The Cacahuatl's unique flavor has been destroyed by a deluge of sugar, ruining the layers in the flavor, leaving naught but stale, sickening, sticky sweetness... You can clean your teeth afterward, sure, but what about the remaining Chocolate?
effect_desc_chs: 恢复70点体力。

desc_chs: 球形的小零食。据说苦种生长的地方会赋予巧克力与众不同的特殊味道，粗犷的矿土香气、甜蜜的水果气息…不知道下一口会吃到什么味道呢？
desc_en: Small spherical snacks. It is said that where the Cacahuatl was grown has a decisive influence on the flavor of the Chocolate, bestowing upon it a completely unique flavor — whether that be rough earthy undertones or sweet fruity notes... You never know the flavor you're gonna get with the next bite.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复85点体力。

desc_chs: 球形的小零食。入口如同天鹅绒一般细腻丝滑，稍稍融化后，苦种带来了煦煦暖意，细品之下，甜味绵绵交织其中，最后的回味更是仿佛拥有魔法一般，会让笑容浮现在每一个品尝者的脸上。
desc_en: Small spherical snacks. The texture is smooth as swan-down, and as it gradually melts, the Cacahuatl brings out a certain warmth that blends in time with a feather-light sweetness, with a magical final flourish that leaves smiles on everyone's faces.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复100点体力。

desc_chs: 多彩靓丽的菜肴。色彩分明，造型规整，满怀期待尝下了第一口，却被干巴巴的土豆泥给呛到了，这、这真的是土豆泥而不是蒸蛋黄吗？
desc_en: An exquisitely colorful dish. The colors are distinct, and the shape regular, promoting an anticipation that is choked in the crib by the bone-dry potato. Are you sure this is potato mash and not steamed egg yolks?
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的26%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复450点生命值。

desc_chs: 多彩靓丽的菜肴。将土豆打成泥状，往中间堆入不同的馅料，最后淋上酱汁，更添一抹亮色。成品看似一个精致的小蛋糕，是很多纳塔人的心头好。
desc_en: An exquisitely colorful dish. Mash the potatoes into a fine creamy state, add various fillings in the middle, then finally, drizzle with sauce for a touch of brightness. The end result is not dissimilar from a finely-made cake, and is the favorite dish of many in Natlan.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的28%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复620点生命值。

desc_chs: 多彩靓丽的菜肴。配色赏心悦目，口感绵软细腻，多层次交叠的味道在味蕾上碰撞出令人惊艳的火花。品尝到如此完美的餐前开胃菜，对正餐的期待已经被拔高至巅峰。
desc_en: An exquisitely colorful dish. The eye-catching colors and soft, delicate texture contain overlapping tastes that bump against your tastebuds in a flavor firework show. Such a perfect appetizer leaves you in unsurpassed anticipation for the main dish.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的30%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复790点生命值。

desc_chs: 颗粒果果粒组成的小吃。过长时间的加热导致水分蒸发掉了一大半，只余下了干瘪的果粒，已无法吸引任何馋虫。
desc_en: A snack made from Grainfruit. The overheating has caused most of the moisture to evaporate away. Only the dried, utterly unappetizing kernels remain.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的8%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复210点生命值。

desc_chs: 颗粒果果粒组成的小吃。将颗粒果一粒粒掰下，与烬芯花花蜜一并蒸煮而成。颗颗多汁，粒粒香甜。
desc_en: A snack made from Grainfruit. The kernels are broken off, then steamed together with Embercore Flower nectar. Each and every one of them ends up being juicy, fragrant, and irresistibly sweet.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的9%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复260点生命值。

desc_chs: 颗粒果果粒组成的小吃。新鲜饱满的果粒在舌尖炸开，仿佛开了一场欢闹的聚会，清甜的余味久久不散。
desc_en: A snack made from Grainfruit. The fresh, plump kernels explode on the tip of your tongue, like a lively party that leaves a lingering sweet aftertaste.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的10%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 荤素搭配的汤品。成品颜色看起来灰扑扑的，与原本想要的鲜艳绿色相差甚远…再加多点绿色蔬菜能拯救回来吗？
desc_en: A soup that consists of a mixture of meat and vegetables. The finished product is ashen-grey, a far cry from the bright green you had hoped for... Might this be saved by adding some more vegetables?
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的20%，并额外恢复900点生命值。

desc_chs: 荤素搭配的汤品。在纳塔，粒果肉汤有不同汤底可以选择，配菜也十分多样，唯一固定的规则是必须要加入大量的颗粒果。
desc_en: A soup that consists of a mixture of meat and vegetables. When ordering Grainfruit Meat Soup in Natlan, customers can choose from a variety of different broths as well as a wide range of side dishes. The only fixed rule is this — it must contain lots of Grainfruit.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并额外恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 荤素搭配的汤品。一勺入口，软烂的肉块、脆嫩的蔬菜、刺激的辣意、清爽的汤底，滋味多重且富有变化，就算一碗见底仍觉不够过瘾！
desc_en: A soup that consists of a mixture of meat and vegetables. Any single spoonful includes soft meat, crunchy veggies, and a titillating spiciness... This cornucopia of shifting flavors decrees that you entertain seconds!
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的24%，并额外恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 三角形的脆片。泛着油光的脆片与黏腻的奶酪碰撞出了油腻的口感，才咽下一片就已经吃不下第二片了。
desc_en: Crispy triangular chips. The oily, crunchy pieces collide with sickly sticky cheese to create a greasy texture that can only be stomached once, but never again.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的18%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复300点生命值。

desc_chs: 三角形的脆片。从油锅里捞出炸好的小脆片，淋上酱汁，撒上奶酪，再添点肉丝，一份丰盛的纳塔早餐就诞生了。
desc_en: Crispy triangular chips. After being scooped out of the oil-filled pot, the deep-fried chips are drizzled with sauce, sprinkled with cheese, and finally topped with shredded meat — thus is a hearty Natlan breakfast born.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的20%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复390点生命值。

desc_chs: 三角形的脆片。喀嚓喀嚓作响的脆片、酸甜可口的酱汁、醇香浓郁的奶酪，再加上香喷喷的肉丝，吃得完全停不下来，只能怪这个组合实在太完美了！
desc_en: Crispy triangular chips. Crunch-crunch-crunch go the crispy pieces! You simply cannot stop pairing it with the sweet and sour sauce, the rich, fragrant cheese, the delicious shredded meat... Why does this combination have to. Be. So. Delicious?
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复470点生命值。

desc_chs: 油炸而成的小吃。油锅无情地卷走了虾肉里的水分，缩水的口感或许勉强能包容，但扎嘴的干硬实在是难以忍受，不过好在成品只有两个，处理起来也不算费功夫。
desc_en: A deep-fried snack. The oil in the pot has mercilessly stripped the shrimp of moisture, resulting in a shriveled texture that could have been shown magnanimity if not for the jarring, hard mouthfeel. It's a good thing there are only two products... That makes dealing with them easy enough.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 油炸而成的小吃。先油炸好豆面揉成的球，再往中间塞入配菜、炸虾和酱汁，制作过程略微繁琐，但因为足够美味，所以值得。
desc_en: A deep-fried snack. First, deep fry the bean flour balls, then stuff them with fillings, fried shrimp, and sauce. Though they may be slightly complicated to prepare, the fact that they're so delicious makes it all worth it.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升25%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 油炸而成的小吃。经历过名为油炸的烹饪魔法后，拥有了黄亮的色泽，脆脆的外壳紧紧裹住汁水，在齿间咔哧咔哧的声音更是带来了强烈的满足感，可惜一碟只有两个，真是完全不够吃！
desc_en: A deep-fried snack. After experiencing the culinary magic known as deep-frying, this has gained a golden luster, with a crisp shell that tightly locks the juices in along with a crackling, satisfying toothsomeness. Alas, for there only being two per dish! Alas, for you desire more!
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升30%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 辣味的炖肉。过度的辣味在嘴里熊熊燃烧，努力将肉咽下后，甚至感觉胃里都窜出了火元素…如果手边有一大杯水能浇灭这火辣辣的烈焰就好了。
desc_en: A spicy meat stew. The excessive spiciness sets your mouth ablaze... and your stomach too, once you force the meat down your belabored gullet. Now if only there was a large cup of water to put these flames out...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升10%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 辣味的炖肉。选用常见的兽肉，加入一连串的香料，慢炖至肉块软烂，揭开锅盖，热辣的味道迎面扑来。欢庆时刻不知道吃什么的话，选它一定没错！
desc_en: A spicy meat stew. Raw meat is seasoned with an array of different spices, then slow-cooked until tender. The moment you open the lid, a hot and spicy aroma wafts out to greet you. When you're not sure what to eat when it's time to celebrate, you can't go wrong with this!
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升15%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 辣味的炖肉。各式各样的香料，渲染出了浓厚的肉香。随着齿间的碰撞，合宜的辣味打开了沉睡的味蕾，丰盈的肉汁喷涌而出，满满的幸福感随之翻涌，就连滴落的汤汁都不想放过！
desc_en: A spicy meat stew. All manner of spices bring out the rich aroma of meat. A well-tuned spiciness awakens your slumbering tastebuds with its touch, and as the meat meets your teeth, its rich juices spill forth, filling your heart with sumptuous joy. Not a drop, you declare, shall be spared. Not one drop.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 基尼奇的特色料理。香味极为浓厚的大块炖肉，入口辛辣。阿乔喋喋不休地在一旁对你念叨：「以往这可是我们猎捕到大家伙之后才会犒劳自己的美味，今天你能不费半点力吃到，是你运气好上了天！还不快快为我进贡美味果汁？」对此基尼奇的补充是：「吃你的，别听他废话。」
desc_en: Kinich's specialty. The large, richly flavored chunks of meat come in hot... and spicy to boot. Ajaw keeps mumbling by your side. "Consider yourself lucky to enjoy this for free! Why, in days past, we would only reward ourselves thus for a true big-game hunt. Indeed, you should be offering delicious fruit juice unto me as thanksgiving!" To which Kinich helpfully supplies, "Just eat. Ignore his nonsense."
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升20%，暴击伤害提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 玛拉妮的特色料理。脚踩冲浪板，手端菜肴，她围着你转了三圈后，才把这碟龙虾放到你面前，龙虾大小看着非同寻常。「噔噔噔——走大运啦！这是我刚刚抓到的超级大龙虾！快快，我把好运传给你！」少女欢快动人的话语，仿佛让裹着虾肉的豆球都蒙上了一层金光。
desc_en: Mualani's specialty. Feet planted on her surfboard, dish in hand, she made not one, not two, but three loops around you before placing the sizable lobster before you. "Ta-da! Super huge and freshly caught — a stroke of luck if ever there was one! And now, I pass that luck onto you!" Her cheerful words all but grant the bean balls wrapped around the shrimp a golden glow.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升35%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 卡齐娜的特色料理。排列得整整齐齐的小脆片，油炸的程度也刚刚好，尝起来酥酥脆脆，十分美味，由此可见卡齐娜的认真和用心。如果把感受说出来再稍加夸赞的话，她会不会大受鼓舞呢？
desc_en: Kachina's specialty. The chips are arrayed in neat rows, fried just right. In their crunchy deliciousness, you can see Kachina's earnestness and care. Would it be too much motivation for her if you were to tell her how you felt about the dish, plus some compliments?
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的26%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复570点生命值。

desc_chs: 苹果制成的小甜点。由于放置过久，发软的外皮裹着更软的内馅，和想象中的酥香可口相去甚远…等等，不好，嘴巴似乎要被黏住了…
desc_en: A little dessert made from apples. Having been left be too long, the softened outer skin now hides yet softer innards, with a flavor far removed from your envisaging... Uh oh. Your mouth's getting stuck shut...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高224点，暴击率提升6%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 苹果制成的小甜点。将苹果切成均匀的小块，加入糖与其他香料，煮至粘稠，裹上方形的酥皮烘烤至金黄膨胀。脆脆的酥皮裹着软软的夹心，是老少皆宜的美味。
desc_en: A little dessert made from apples. After being sliced into evenly sized pieces, the apples are mixed with sugar and other spices. The mixture is boiled until it thickens, then wrapped in square puff pastry and baked until it turns golden and puffy. The crispy puff pastry envelops a soft filling within, a delicious treat suitable for anyone.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高272点，暴击率提升8%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 苹果制成的小甜点。满满的甜蜜馅料涌向味蕾，像是一束金灿灿的亮光，穿过树梢叶隙，直达心扉，就连心情也被这一暖意所感染。单单一个可真不够吃！
desc_en: A little dessert made from apples. The honey-sweet filling surges across your taste buds like a thread of golden light passing through the interlaced fingers of tree and leaf and warming your very heart. Ah, how could you ever stop at one of these?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高320点，暴击率提升10%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 根据几位伙伴设计的食谱，还原而成的糕点，其中饱含了大家的心意。造型上没有出什么问题，但是闻到了些许不和谐的微妙味道…有点不太敢品尝，呃，要不留着当纪念品？
desc_en: A dessert box based on the recipes of several different companions, simply overflowing with heartfelt intentions. There's nothing wrong with the structure itself, but you smell a strange disharmony in its scents... You are apprehensive about giving it a go. Hmm, could it work as a memento instead?
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的30%，并额外恢复600点生命值。

desc_chs: 根据几位伙伴设计的食谱，还原而成的糕点，其中饱含了大家的心意。精致玲珑的糕点整齐排列在食匣之中，这份心意尝起来不知道会是什么味道？
desc_en: A dessert box based on the recipes of several different companions, simply overflowing with heartfelt intentions. Neatly arranged rows of delicate pastries line the box — but what will this goodwill gesture taste like?
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的32%，并额外恢复1250点生命值。

desc_chs: 根据几位伙伴设计的食谱，还原而成的糕点，其中饱含了大家的心意。宛若镂月裁云般的高超技艺，制作出了精妙别致的造型，如此弥足珍贵的心意，着实舍不得下口。
desc_en: A dessert box based on the recipes of several different companions, simply overflowing with heartfelt intentions. The artisanry here is akin to the exquisite scene of the moon cutting through the clouds. Indeed, you can barely bear to eat such a precious gift.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的34%，并额外恢复1900点生命值。

desc_chs: 常见的街头烧烤。失控的大火瞬间让外表变得焦黑，但肉块内部还半生不熟。切掉烤焦的部分，放回炭火上再小火烤会儿吧…
desc_en: Commonly seen street-stall barbeque. The fire blazed out of control, burning the outside to charcoal in an instant, while inside, the meat is still half raw. Maybe you can cut off the burnt bits and put the rest back over the charcoal, and try grilling it again, but over a smaller flame this time...
effect_desc_chs: 恢复40点体力。

desc_chs: 常见的街头烧烤。腌制过的牛心，串好后置于木炭上，烤出诱人的色泽与香气，再添上烤过的颗粒果和土豆，就组合出了纳塔小吃界长盛不衰的黄金搭配！
desc_en: Commonly seen street-stall barbeque. Marinated beef heart is threaded onto skewers before being barbequed over charcoal, grilling forth an enticing aroma and captivating luster. Add on a bit of grilled grainfruit and potato, and you've assembled the eternal golden ensemble of Natlan's street food scene!
effect_desc_chs: 恢复50点体力。

desc_chs: 常见的街头烧烤。炭火上滋滋声响起，仿佛吹响了馋虫的号角，迫不及待尝上一口，厚实弹牙的肉质与丰沛四溢的肉汁，相辅相成，堪称畅快淋漓。
desc_en: Commonly seen street-stall barbeque. The crackling flames and sizzling sounds herald an imminent feast, igniting your craving for that first bite. The firmness of the thick hunks of meat and the abundance of savory juices that burst forth with every bite perfectly complement one another in a culinary experience that might be called bathing in BBQ bliss.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复60点体力。

desc_chs: 苦种制成的纳塔饮品。事先猜想会品尝到或甜或苦的味道，却万万没想到舌尖传来的是酸味…难道加错了什么食材吗？
desc_en: A Natlan drink made from Cacahuatl. If you had to guess before you took a swig, you might assume it would taste either sweet or bitter, but never in a million years would you have expected the sourness that sets upon the tip of your tongue... Did someone add the wrong ingredients?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高165点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 苦种制成的纳塔饮品。最初是将苦种磨碎后加入各种香料制成的饮料，也因此得名。几经演变后，在糖的加入下成品已变得香甜可口、广受欢迎，但苦水这名字倒是一直没有变。
desc_en: A Natlan drink made from Cacahuatl. Initially, bitter Cacahuatl was ground up and blended with various spices, creating the eponymous "bitter water." Much evolution later, added sugar would transform the final product into something fragrant, delectable, and broadly popular, though the name indicating "bitter water" has never changed.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高200点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 苦种制成的纳塔饮品。深邃的苦种香气中带着纯粹的奶香，如同柔软顺滑的织物，轻轻划过舌尖，留下一丝丝甜蜜，足以融化心坎。
desc_en: A Natlan drink made from Cacahuatl. The rich, deep fragrance of the Cacahuatl is infused with a pure creaminess, tenderly caressing your tongue with the softness of smooth silk, leaving behind a touch of sweetness that is more than enough to melt your heart.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高235点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 希诺宁的特色料理。并排坐在大树上闲聊时，她递来一个精致的盒子，里面装着的是形状各异的…糖果？「苦种按分类来说是水果。那苦种加入奶与糖做出来的糖果——说是果味奶糖也没问题吧。一起吃吧。」说着，她率先拿出一颗，上抛后咬下。
desc_en: Xilonen's specialty. As you sit side-by-side atop the tree, she passes you an exquisite box filled with... variously shaped candies? "Cacahuatl is actually considered a kind of fruit. So, it should be fine to call candies made out of cacahuatl and milk 'fruit-flavored.' C'mon, let's dig in." So saying, she swiftly snatches one, tossing it into her mouth before biting down.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复130点体力。

desc_chs: 有荤有素的大拼盘。上一口刚刚吃到半生的肉串，下一口就吃到了烧焦的鱼块。在如此强烈反差的冲击下，已经没有胆量尝试第三口了…
desc_en: A large platter with a mix of meat and vegetables. First, you find yourself biting into a half-raw skewer of meat; next, a chunk of charred fish. The contrast is so jarring that you simply can't muster up the courage to take a third bite...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色滑翔和冲刺消耗的体力降低15%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 有荤有素的大拼盘。将来自海陆空的多样食材烤制后进行混合装盘。每一位食客都能轻而易举地在其中找到自己的心头好，所以这道菜肴在纳塔重要宴会不可或缺。
desc_en: A large platter with a mix of meat and vegetables. Various ingredients from the sea, land, and air have been roasted and mixed together. There's something for everyone here, making it a must-have at any important banquet in Natlan.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色滑翔和冲刺消耗的体力降低20%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 有荤有素的大拼盘。厚实的肉块吸饱了香料的精华，与脆生生的果蔬一起在舌尖旋转跳跃，被打动的不仅仅有味蕾，还有胃袋。难怪这道菜肴能拥有大批忠实的拥趸。
desc_en: A large platter with a mix of meat and vegetables. Thick, juicy chunks of meat have soaked up all the spices, mingling delightfully with the crispness of the fruit and vegetables on the tip of your tongue, touching more than just your taste buds, as your stomach is also moved to satisfaction. No wonder this dish has so many loyal fans.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色滑翔和冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 火山形状的蛋糕。「山脉」没能好好裹住里面的「岩浆」，轰然倒塌的成品呈火山喷发之势，眨眼间底下的托盘已经遭殃。看来进行下回尝试之前，必须先清理一下了…
desc_en: A volcano-shaped cake. The "mountain" has failed to fully contain the "lava" within, resulting in a collapse that genuinely resembles a volcanic eruption, bringing calamity to the tray beneath. Looks like some cleanup is in order before the next try...
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复900点生命值。

desc_chs: 火山形状的蛋糕。混合食材，搅拌成浓稠的面糊，放入模具中烘烤。精准的时间控制会使得外皮凝为固态，而内馅仍保持着液态，就好像火山一般。
desc_en: A volcano-shaped cake. The ingredients were mixed together, stirred into a thick paste, then poured into a mold for baking. Timing it to perfection allows the outer layer to solidify while the filling remains soft and gooey, just like a real volcano.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 火山形状的蛋糕。热腾腾的「小火山」，搭配凉冰冰的「火积云」，顺着醇香的「岩浆」一起流入心田的不仅仅有甜蜜的味道，更有餍足的惬意。
desc_en: A volcano-shaped cake. The steaming hot "little volcano" finds its perfect foil in the icy-cool "ash cloud" that rises above. Aside from its irresistible sweetness, the aroma of the flowing "lava" brings you a deep sense of satisfaction and comfort.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 大片叶片包裹着的主食。与直接生啃颗粒果相去无几的味道，让人不禁开始思考起烹饪的意义…
desc_en: A staple food wrapped in big leaves. It basically tastes the same as biting into raw Grainfruit, begging the question of what the purpose of cooking it was...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高88点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 大片叶片包裹着的主食。纳塔有句简单朴素的谚语——「总有叶片为粒果裹裹从天而降。」用以形容命中注定。
desc_en: A staple food wrapped in big leaves. There's a simple saying in Natlan that goes like this: "A leaf to wrap your Grainfruit with will always fall." It's used to express the idea of things being fated to happen.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高107点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 大片叶片包裹着的主食。软绵绵的内馅带着颗粒果的清香。落入口中，甜辣中略带咸香的滋味，可谓是极其丰富的味觉体验。
desc_en: A staple food wrapped in big leaves. The light fragrance of Grainfruit rises up from the soft, velvety filling within. As it melts in your mouth, its sweet and spicy notes combine with a touch of saltiness, resulting in a gustatory experience that is nothing short of sumptuously rich.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高126点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 颗粒果制成的饮品。浅浅喝下一口，所有的味蕾都开始颤抖…某种意义上也算是「回味无穷」——因为过于浓郁的味道始终萦绕在舌尖，喝水也无法冲淡。
desc_en: A drink made from Grainfruit. One sip and all your taste buds begin to tingle. It's almost like an "endless aftertaste," for the flavor is so intense that it lingers on the tip of your tongue, and even drinking water cannot wash it away.
effect_desc_chs: 来自烟谜主部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 颗粒果制成的饮品。由烟谜主部族的某位萨满发明，最初是为了治病，随着时间流逝配方添添减减，如今已经成为了聚会时的常见饮品。
desc_en: A drink made from Grainfruit. Originally invented as a type of medicine by a certain shaman of the Masters of the Night-Wind, the recipe has been altered with the passage of time and is now a common drink at social gatherings.
effect_desc_chs: 来自烟谜主部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 颗粒果制成的饮品。色泽艳丽的液体静静驻留在杯中，仿佛一块带有瑰丽渐变的晶石。淡香与幽甜，引人窥探古老部族的神秘，流连忘返。
desc_en: A drink made from Grainfruit. The cup is full of still, bright liquid, with the magnificent hues of a gemstone with a stunning gradient. Its subtle fragrance and delicate sweetness combine to evoke the mysteries of an ancient tribe, leaving those that partake yearning for more.
effect_desc_chs: 来自烟谜主部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 风味清凉的润喉糖。凉飕飕的味道在口中横冲直撞，牙齿忍不住打颤，连带着心都凉了半截…别说纵声欢唱了，现在连利索地说话都成了挑战。
desc_en: A cool-flavored throat lozenge. Its icy taste rushes through your mouth, setting your teeth chattering involuntarily and nearly half-freezing your heart. Forget about singing your heart out — even just making yourself understood is now a challenge...
effect_desc_chs: 来自花羽会部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 风味清凉的润喉糖。据说是花羽会部族润喉护嗓的秘密武器，吃下它去纵声欢唱吧！不过小心不要贪多哦，否则过量的糖分也可能会让喉咙沙哑。
desc_en: A cool-flavored throat lozenge. Said to be the Flower-Feather Clan's secret weapon for soothing their throats and protecting their vocal cords — so eat one and go sing your heart out! Just make sure you don't go overboard, as too much sugar can leave your throat feeling hoarse.
effect_desc_chs: 来自花羽会部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 风味清凉的润喉糖。玲珑剔透的糖果仿佛给喉咙送进了一阵冷气，涌动的泉眼洗濯了枯竭的嗓子。清脆的声音同新生的飞鸟一般，迫不及待展翅迎向高天。
desc_en: A cool-flavored throat lozenge. These exquisitely crafted candies seem to send a wave of coolness down your throat, relieving hoarseness like bubbling springwater spilling forth and cleansing parched earth. Your voice is left sounding as clear as a newly-fledged hatchling, eager to spread its wings and fly up into the sky.
effect_desc_chs: 来自花羽会部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 欧洛伦的特色料理。「这是孝敬长辈的。」话声刚落，晶莹的鱼块被端了上来。从清甜的口感中不难猜到，料汁里面应该加入了颇费心思才能采集到的蜜…这份孝心真是难能可贵。
desc_en: Ororon's specialty. "This is to honor my elders." And without further ado, the fish slices were served up, glistening with juicy deliciousness. From the sweet, delicate flavor, you can tell that the sauce most likely contains honey of the highest caliber, the gathering of which must have required a great deal of thought and effort. It's not often that you get to witness such displays of filial respect.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高114点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 恰斯卡的特色料理。食材堆得满满的，喷香诱人。就算是处于纠纷中的人们，闻到如此香味，愤怒也会被转变成食欲吧？等等，怎么连远处原本在打闹的龙也看过来了？
desc_en: Chasca's specialty. Piled high with ingredients, few can resist the aroma of this dish. Even someone in the midst of an argument might find their anger turn to hunger at the mere whiff of it. Wait a moment, those Saurians who were rolling around in the distance just now... Why have they suddenly started looking this way too?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色滑翔和冲刺消耗的体力降低25%，持续1800秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 古老的纳塔菜肴。如果说舌尖传来沙子粗粝口感时还抱有一丝希望，那么在味蕾体验到泥土味道的时候，最后的侥幸也消失了。它到底是在什么时候偷偷跑进来的呢？
desc_en: An ancient Natlan dish. If there's still a hint of hope when the coarse, sandy texture touches your tongue, that last shred of optimism vanishes the moment the earthy taste hits your palate. When exactly did it sneak its way in?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升10%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 古老的纳塔菜肴。最为传统的做法是，在土坑中用炙热滚烫的石块闷熟被大片叶子包裹的食材。看见大片蒸汽如烟云一般升腾后，一道可供多人共享的纳塔美食便完成了。
desc_en: An ancient Natlan dish. Traditionally, the ingredients are wrapped in large leaves and steam-baked in a pit using red-hot stones. When billows of steam begin to rise like clouds, this Natlan delicacy, perfect for sharing with larger groups, is ready to serve.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升15%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 古老的纳塔菜肴。精心的火烤使得汁水被牢牢锁在食材之中，细微的烟熏香气如同稀有织物上若隐若现的金线，让风味更上一层楼。任何人吃上一口都会情不自禁地发出欢呼声。
desc_en: An ancient Natlan dish. The meticulous roasting locks the juices tightly within the ingredients, while a subtle smokiness lingers like faint golden threads sewn on rare woven scrolls, elevating the flavor to new heights. A single bite will make anyone uncontrollably cheer in delight.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 花朵制成的糕点。干硬与寡淡的口感，与鲜花本应有的娇嫩毫无关系。让人不禁怀疑这内馅到底是不是碎纸屑做的…
desc_en: A cake made from flowers. The dry, hard texture and bland flavor bear no resemblance to the delicate nature that flowers should possess. One can't help but wonder if the filling is actually made of scraps of paper...
effect_desc_chs: 恢复40点体力。

desc_chs: 花朵制成的糕点。取带有晨露的清心花瓣制成馅，一层层裹上酥与油两种饼皮，烤制而成。刚刚出炉的清心花饼最为美味。
desc_en: A cake made from flowers. Prepared with Qingxin petals still glistening with their morning dew, the filling is wrapped in many layers consisting of two different types of pastry — a flaky crust and a buttery dough. Baked to perfection, Qingxin Flower Cakes are best enjoyed fresh from the oven.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复50点体力。

desc_chs: 花朵制成的糕点。轻轻咬上一口，漫山遍野的花朵都在口中绽放开来，花香仿佛能沁入心中。依依不舍地吃完了最后一口，手上还留有若隐若现的余香…
desc_en: A cake made from flowers. With a gentle bite, the blossoms swaying in the mountains seem to bloom in your mouth, and the fragrance of flowers feels as if it seeps into your very soul. As you reluctantly finish the last bite, a faint, lingering scent remains on your fingers...
effect_desc_chs: 恢复60点体力。

desc_chs: 造型清雅的璃月菜品。成品看似完美，没想到的是精心拆好的蟹肉里不知何时混入了细碎的蟹壳。在享用前，需要战胜一些不安感，因为牙齿随时都有可能被蟹壳磕到…
desc_en: An elegant-looking Liyue dish. The final presentation seems flawless, but hidden within the carefully disassembled crab meat are small, unnoticed fragments of shell. Before indulging, one must overcome a sense of unease, as there's always the risk of your teeth meeting a shard of hard chitin...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高215点，治疗效果提升6%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 造型清雅的璃月菜品。螃蟹蒸熟后，拆好蟹黄与蟹肉，入锅煸炒后，放回到蟹壳内。将蛋清打发成雪衣糊，封住蟹壳，撒上火腿碎增色一分后烤熟。鲜美蟹肉与蓬松蛋白的组合，有让人拍手叫好的实力。
desc_en: An elegant-looking Liyue dish. Once the crab is steamed, its roe and meat are carefully removed, stir-fried, then returned to the shell. Egg whites are whipped into a frothy coating to seal the crab shell, topped with finely chopped ham for a touch of color, then the whole thing is baked. Together, the succulent crab meat and fluffy egg whites make a combination that's sure to impress.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高261点，治疗效果提升8%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 造型清雅的璃月菜品。雪衣糊柔软且蓬松，像是雪花轻盈地落于舌尖。紧接着鲜醇的蟹肉迅速占据味蕾，宛若孤寂清冷的白雪之间，坠入一剪靡丽绝俗的梅花，惹人沉醉。
desc_en: An elegant-looking Liyue dish. The snow-like coating is soft and airy, like snowflakes gently falling onto your tongue. Then, the rich, fresh crab meat quickly envelops your taste buds, like radiant, resplendent plum blossoms blooming amidst the lonesome, serene snowfall, captivating and enchanting.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高308点，治疗效果提升10%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 玛薇卡的特色料理。各式各样的海鲜在火烤中，融汇出淋漓尽致的美味。宛若一曲崇高不朽的赞歌响彻耳畔，不灭的火焰随之燃起，激昂优美的旋律拥有着鼓舞人心的力量。这也是火神大人强大力量的一部分吗？
desc_en: Mavuika's specialty. A variety of seafood, perfectly grilled, harmonizes into an exquisite symphony of flavor. It resembles an eternal, noble anthem ringing in your ears, with the unquenchable flames igniting in tandem. The stirring, beautiful melody carries an inspiring power. Is this perhaps also a part of the Pyro Archon's immense strength?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升20%，暴击伤害提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 蓝砚的特色料理。眼前的少女低着头，认真地编织着什么…不消一刻，你的手中多了个精巧的藤碗，盛着玲珑的银燕与喷香的糕点。少女真挚淳朴的笑容，就像是某种术法，促使你迫不及待尝上一口，齿颊生香。
desc_en: Lan Yan's specialty. Before you, a young girl lowers her head, focused on weaving something with great care... In no time at all, a delicate rattan bowl appears in your hands, holding exquisite silver swallows and fragrant pastries. The girl's sincere, innocent smile seems almost like a spell, urging you to take a bite, and as you do, the flavors linger delightfully on your palate.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复80点体力。

desc_chs: 茜特菈莉的特色料理。新鲜的菜叶脆嫩得出奇，烤虾肉质紧实带有一丝鲜甜，再加上单手就能轻松捏起的完美造型…若是手边再出现一本有趣的小说，搭配如此美味，恐怕能看上一天一夜不停歇吧。这就是黑曜石奶奶博学多识的独门秘法吗？
desc_en: Citlali's specialty. The fresh, tender greens are surprisingly crisp, while the grilled shrimp is firm with a hint of sweetness. The perfectly crafted shape can be easily picked up with just one hand... If only a captivating novel were at hand, paired with such a delicacy, you could easily lose yourself in it for a whole day and night. Is this the unique secret art of Granny Itztli's vast knowledge?
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复生命值上限的20%，并额外恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 带馅的稻妻点心。干硬的外壳包裹着更加干柴的内馅，甜蜜的滋味在这一刻反而成为了难以下咽的负担。如果不想期待的心情骤降为失落，最好不要在泡温泉前吃它…
desc_en: A filled Inazuman dessert. The dry, hard outer casing contains an even drier filling, the cloying sweetness of which makes it difficult to swallow. If you don't wish to drown your anticipation in disappointment, it's probably a good idea not to eat these before enjoying a good soak...
effect_desc_chs: 恢复70点体力。

desc_chs: 带馅的稻妻点心。起初「秋沙钱汤」将其作为特色小点心，分发给前来泡温泉的客人们，吃起来甜滋滋的，能有效地提供能量。如今已经成为了一款送礼时不会出错的手信。
desc_en: A filled Inazuman dessert. These moreish morsels have a pleasant sweetness and are a fantastic source of energy. Originally handed out to bathers at the Aisa Bathhouse, these special snacks have since become a reliably welcome present for all occasions.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复85点体力。

desc_chs: 带馅的稻妻点心。酥松的外壳下是丰润细腻的内馅，当丝丝缕缕的甜蜜融化于舌尖之上时，仿佛将人拉入了一池温泉之中，疲乏消失得无影无踪，留下的只有闲适与松弛。
desc_en: A filled Inazuman dessert. The crispy, flaky outer casing protects a rich and delicate filling, its sweetness dissolving on your tongue like worries melting away in a hot spring. As you eat, your tiredness vanishes without a trace, leaving you relaxed and at ease.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复100点体力。

desc_chs: 梦见月瑞希的特色料理。两只憨态可掬的小食梦貘馒头闭着眼睛依偎在一起，悠悠自得的可爱模样，不知道是在做什么美梦…尝上一口，或许，也能做与它们一样的美梦吗？
desc_en: Yumemizuki Mizuki's specialty. A pair of adorable mini-baku buns nestling together with their eyes tightly closed. Cute and carefree, they leave you wondering what sweet dreams they're lost in... Perhaps, once you take a bite, you might be able to share in their wonderful reveries.
effect_desc_chs: 恢复130点体力。

desc_chs: 金灿灿的砂锅菜肴。焦黑的食材牢牢地黏在砂锅上，使出浑身解数才勉强挖出一勺，可刚刚吃下第一口，就忍不住哆嗦了一下，仿佛被熔岩游像瞄准了一般，让人只想尽快逃离…
desc_en: A glittering, gold-topped feast. The charred ingredients stick stubbornly to the casserole dish, and after you tried your best to dredge up a spoonful, the first bite sent shivers down your spine. It's like you're being targeted by some sort of magma effigy — your senses scream at you to flee...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色生命值上限提升20%，元素充能效率提升14%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 金灿灿的砂锅菜肴。预先炒制好食材，混合铺入砂锅中，烤至金黄奶酪开始冒泡后出炉。不管是在家庭晚餐，还是在节日聚会的场合，端上这么一道经典的奢华菜肴，都足以令每一个在场的人发出赞叹的欢呼。
desc_en: A glittering, gold-topped feast. The ingredients are pre-fried and layered in a casserole dish before being baked until the cheesy topping begins to bubble. Whether for a family dinner or a festive gathering, this luxurious classic is sure to elicit gasps of admiration from everyone present.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色生命值上限提升25%，元素充能效率提升17%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 金灿灿的砂锅菜肴。蟹肉的鲜甜像是最初的一缕晨光穿透云雾而来，绵密的酪香给味觉带来了曙色，如同灿烂的晨曦，让每一寸味蕾都沐浴在暖黄的光辉之中。幸福感从舌尖席卷到胃里，通身感官无一不为其折服。
desc_en: A glittering, gold-topped feast. The sweetness of crab meat is like the first ray of dawn that pierces the clouds. The dense, savory aroma of cheese invites the radiance of the morning sun onto your tastebuds, bathing your mouth in a warm, golden glow. The sensation of bliss sweeps a soul-warming path from your tongue to your stomach, uniting all your senses in adoration.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色生命值上限提升30%，元素充能效率提升20%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 鲜醇的果汁。苦种的酸苦、颗粒果的纤维、青蜜莓的涩，最后加上鸟蛋的粘稠，林林总总都在味蕾上打起了架…已经没有耐心等它们决出胜负了，现在只想灌下清水漱漱口。
desc_en: Curiously flavored fruit juice made from a variety of ingredients. The sour Cacahuatl, the fibrous Grainfruit, the bitter Quenepa Berries, and the gooey eggs... They battle for attention on your taste buds, but you can't drum up the patience to let them finish. You desperately need a glass of water to wash it all down.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的26%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复450点生命值。

desc_chs: 鲜醇的果汁。由多种食材混合制成，有着浓厚的风味。不仅能提神，对健康也颇有益处，因此「沃陆之邦」的许多健身爱好者几乎每天都会来上一两杯。
desc_en: Fresh and flavorful fruit juice made from a variety of ingredients. Its invigorating and healthy properties have made it a firm favorite among the fitness-obsessed tribespeople of the Collective of Plenty, who often recommend drinking two glasses a day.
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的28%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复620点生命值。

desc_chs: 鲜醇的果汁。扑面而来的清新果香，仿佛将人推入了清晨的果园，沾满露珠的蜜果在舌尖上化开，使人精神一振，充满干劲…等等，脚怎么不受控制地跑向了健身俱乐部的方向？
desc_en: Fresh and flavorful fruit juice made from a selection of the finest ingredients. This otherworldly fragrance feels like being plunged into a fruit garden, bathed in gentle dawn-light, where dew-slick fruits melt into honey on the tongue, lifting your spirits and filling you with energy... Wait, why are your legs carrying you towards the gym?
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的30%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复790点生命值。

desc_chs: 充满活力的蒸汽鸟报记者，每时每刻都在为「真相」而奔走。
desc_en: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

desc_chs: 色彩缤纷的零食。口感过于寡淡，仿佛吃了什么，又好像什么都没吃，只有被染色的牙齿能证明刚刚发生了什么。
desc_en: A turgid, technicolor treat that has been cursed with a bland texture. Eating it almost feels like eating nothing at all. The only evidence left behind is the stains on your teeth.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的20%，并额外恢复900点生命值。

desc_chs: 色彩缤纷的零食。吃起来酥脆又香甜。若是摆在小吃摊上，则会拥有不可思议的魔法——能在不知不觉的情况下，吞掉孩子们口袋里的零花钱。
desc_en: A tasty, technicolor treat that is delightfully crisp and sweet. When displayed prominently on snack stands, it possesses an almost magical ability to make children's pocket money disappear.
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并额外恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 色彩缤纷的零食。伴随着悦耳的咔嚓声，颗粒果香甜柔和的味道占据了整个口腔，内心充盈着平实的快乐。不愧是知名的「零花钱杀手」！
desc_en: A tantalizing, technicolor treat. Once you hear that delightful crunch, your mouth will be filled with a sweet and fruity fragrance, and your heart will be filled with joy. This is the power of the fabled "Pocket Money Pilferer"!
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的24%，并额外恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 外壳黑漆漆的蛋。过长时间的加热使得巨大热量在蛋中累积，过度暗黑的外壳仿佛昭示着某种噩兆——吃下去极有可能会发生不妙的怪事！
desc_en: A jet-black egg with a crust that has trapped too much heat from overcooking. The ominous color of the shell makes you feel uneasy, and you can't help but fear that something horrible will happen if you take a bite!
effect_desc_chs: 不吃为妙！

desc_chs: 外壳黑漆漆的蛋。吸收了火焰与矿物的精华而形成的黑蛋。不过味道和普通的煮蛋相比似乎并没有太大差别。除非，故意将它煮得奇怪一点…
desc_en: A jet-black egg, formed by absorbing the essence of flame and rock. Despite its obsidian appearance, it tastes just like a regular boiled egg — unless, of course, one were to go out of their way to cook it in an irregular fashion...
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的9%，并额外恢复1000点生命值。

desc_chs: 外壳黑漆漆的蛋。黝黑中带点白霜的完美的颜色，好似一块温润的黑玉沉寂于袅袅白雾中，难怪有传闻说吃下会有延年益寿的效果。这么说来，如果反其道而行之的话…
desc_en: A jet-black egg, with a beautiful frosty sheen observable in its darkness. Like a chunk of black jade slumbering in the mist, it's no wonder there are rumors about how it can prolong one's lifespan. That said, one can only hope it doesn't have the opposite effect...
effect_desc_chs: 为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的10%，并额外恢复1200点生命值。

desc_chs: 铺满奶酪的烤串。闻到焦味后，低头发现鲜艳的「红果果菇」已经变成了晦暗的「黑炭炭菇」，糟糕的颜色让人不禁开始担心这菌菇真的能吃吗…
desc_en: A skewer covered in burnt cheese. The acrid smell gives notice that the Red Berryshroom has been reduced to a Black Burnedshroom. It looks so awful that you wonder if you might have turned a harmless mushroom into a poisonous one...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升6%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 铺满奶酪的烤串。取下红果果菇的菌盖，撒上厚厚一层奶酪，串起来后进行烤制。扑鼻香气中还有一丝丝灵动的果味，趁热享用尤为美味。
desc_en: A skewer covered in mouth-watering cheese. The caps of Red Berryshrooms are removed, filled with a generous sprinkling of cheese, and then grilled to perfection. The rich aroma carries a faint fruity tang best enjoyed while hot.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升9%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 铺满奶酪的烤串。厚厚的烤菇，并非肉之香，胜似肉之味，一口下去扑簌的汁水飞溅齿间，嘴里瞬间充满着鲜香，幸福感更是随之洋溢而出。
desc_en: A skewer covered in golden-brown, mouth-watering cheese. The mushrooms are almost as thick as steak. Although they don't smell like meat, the taste is far more splendid. A single bite blesses your whole mouth with the fragrant flavors packed within, as juicy joy overflows in abundance.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升12%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 伊安珊的特色料理。出自金牌教练之手的金牌健康餐，新鲜的食材、恰当的分量、均衡的营养…优点简直数不胜数，如果能每天坚持下来的话，说不定金牌也唾手可得哦。
desc_en: Iansan's specialty. A gold-standard meal, prepped by a gold-standard coach. The freshest ingredients are portioned to perfection and packed full of nutrients, with too many benefits to count! If you can bear eating it daily, maybe you too shall become a gold-standard trainee.
effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复生命值上限的15%，并额外恢复550点生命值。

desc_chs: 瓦雷莎的特色料理。如同粉色棉花糖般的少女单手轻轻松松将这座高山般的菜肴端了出来，你的双手被菌香与奶酪交织的味道吸引得不由自主地握上了餐具，呃，只是这分量…吃上一天一夜能吃完吗？
desc_en: Varesa's specialty. The young lady, with all the air of a bright pink marshmallow, effortlessly serves this mountainous dish with one hand. The fragrance of mushrooms, mingling with cheese, has you reaching for your cutlery before you even know it. Hey, umm... Is it even possible to finish eating this much food in a day?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色暴击率提升16%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 以颗粒果为主的菜肴。焦黑的外壳，突显出控制火候重要性。考虑到收集食材用的时间和精力…里面的食材应该还没焦，要不尝一口看看？
desc_en: A strange-looking meal barely held together by the humble Grainfruit. The blackened outer shell reminds you of the importance of heat control. Considering the time and effort you spent gathering the ingredients... Maybe the inside's not as burnt. Perhaps it's still worth a try?
effect_desc_chs: 来自沃陆之邦部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 以颗粒果为主的菜肴。将碎肉馅炒熟，放在烤盘上，添上肉块与蛋，最后铺上搅碎的颗粒果糊糊，送入烤箱，直至颜色变得诱人。这道用料丰厚的菜肴，通常会在庆祝大丰收之时被端上「沃陆之邦」的餐桌。
desc_en: A rich and comforting meal held together by the humble Grainfruit. Minced meat is stir-fried and placed in a baking pan with larger chunks of meat and eggs. The whole thing is then covered with a layer of mashed Grainfruit and baked until a tantalizing golden brown. This hearty dish can often be found on the tables of the Collective of Plenty during harvest festivals.
effect_desc_chs: 来自沃陆之邦部族的小小惊喜。

desc_chs: 以颗粒果为主的菜肴。出炉时的腾腾热气将心中的期待送上了顶峰，入口后，颗粒果的香甜和碎肉的咸鲜在味蕾上跳起了欢快的舞步…等等，怎么连手脚也无意识地跟着这幸福的节奏摆动了起来？
desc_en: A luxurious, flavor-packed meal held together by the humble Grainfruit. Your anticipation soars even as the oven's heat does, and once you taste it, the sweetness of Grainfruit and the savoriness of the minced meat break out into a joyful dance on your taste buds... Huh, your hands and legs are instinctively swaying along to the beat.
effect_desc_chs: 来自沃陆之邦部族的小小惊喜。

name_chs: 奇怪的德波小蛋糕·改良型
name_en: Suspicious Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version
desc_chs: 由德波大蛋糕改良而来的小蛋糕。小小的蛋糕胚仿佛茫茫海面中的浮木，厚厚的巧克力酱如浪涛般汹涌，不仅吞噬了碟子上的蛋糕，还同时赶走了肚子里的馋虫。
desc_en: A petite version of the famous Gateau Debord. The small cake is like a piece of driftwood lost in a vast ocean, while the thick chocolate sauce is like a surging wave, enveloping not just the cake — and much of the plate — but also any tiny lingering foothold that hunger might have held in your stomach.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高224点，暴击率提升6%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 由德波大蛋糕改良而来的小蛋糕。比起每日只限量发售十六片的德波大蛋糕，彼此一起经历过的奇妙冒险更为珍贵，也更值得纪念。或许爱可菲在写下这食谱的那一刻，心中也抱有同样的想法吧…
desc_en: A petite version of the famous Gateau Debord. Even when compared to its namesake, of which only sixteen slices are sold each day, the extraordinary adventures you've experienced together are yet more precious and worthy of remembrance still. Perhaps when Escoffier scribbled down this recipe, she was thinking along these same lines...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高272点，暴击率提升8%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

name_chs: 美味的德波小蛋糕·改良型
name_en: Delicious Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version
desc_chs: 由德波大蛋糕改良而来的小蛋糕。柔滑的酱汁仿佛无法抓住的绸缎，在下午茶时刻宛转悠扬的乐声中，轻轻拂过舌尖，心也随之陶醉…兴许今夜的梦里也会出现这香甜小蛋糕的倩影…
desc_en: A petite version of the famous Gateau Debord. The velvety sauce is like elusive silk, slipping between your fingers and alighting on your tongue, while the gentle melodies of afternoon tea circle in the air, enchanting your heart... Perhaps this little treat will appear before you again in your dreams tonight...
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高320点，暴击率提升10%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 造型多样的糖果。表面的糖霜有着粗粝的口感，仿佛珠蚌中的砂砾，十分扎嘴。可能只有成功战胜这尖锐糖霜的勇士才能享受到最后的胜利果实——甜蜜的糖果。
desc_en: Candies in a variety of different shapes. The powdered sugar coating has a grainy texture, reminiscent of grit trapped in an oyster's shell. Perhaps only those willing to battle through the coarseness of this coating will earn the right to enjoy the spoils within — sweet candy.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升25%，防御力提高165点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 造型多样的糖果。据说在海薇玛映影欢乐城里贩卖的贝壳彩糖中，会有极少部分藏有珍珠，只有最最最幸运的游客才能吃到，你会是那个幸运儿吗？
desc_en: Candies in a variety of different shapes. It is said that a tiny fraction of the Candy Shells sold at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland contain real pearls, and that the pleasure of tasting these is reserved for only the very luckiest of visitors. Might you be one of them?
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升30%，防御力提高200点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 造型多样的糖果。色彩缤纷的糖果好像一颗颗琳琅宝珠静静地躺在精致的珠宝盒中，给人们送去一个个甜蜜惊喜。还有什么比在海薇玛映影欢乐城更令人快乐呢？那一定就是在欢乐城里吃贝壳彩糖！
desc_en: Candies in a variety of different shapes. Their vibrant colors make them resemble gleaming gemstones resting majestically in an exquisite box, waiting to give their finder a sweet surprise. What could make someone happier than a trip to the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland? Why, a trip to the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland and a box of Candy Shells!
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色护盾强效提升35%，防御力提高235点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 爱可菲的特色料理。豪华的造型比之前见过的大蛋糕更加绚丽，拥有着让人一眼就沦陷的魔力，味道更是无可挑剔，绵软的味道好像温暖的被子包裹住每一个味蕾，幸福感油然而生…毋庸置疑，爱可菲的厨艺在不知不觉之中又精进了不少。
desc_en: Escoffier's specialty. Its lavish appearance is even more dazzling than any gateau you've seen before. It has an aura that captivates at first glance and a taste that is impossible not to love, like a soft, warm blanket that envelops every tastebud and suffuses your body with joy... Without a doubt, Escoffier's culinary talents have quietly reached new heights.
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色攻击力提高384点，暴击率提升14%，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 伊法的特色料理。「吃点吧，哥们。」一人一龙的声音先后响起，伊法端来了一碟香甜的饼干，随后咔库库奋力挥动着翅膀，将一杯香浓的苦水送到了你手中。沉浸在这双重香气中，原先莫名的紧张情绪竟一扫而空…太棒了！哥们！
desc_en: Ifa's specialty. "Eat up, bro." The voices of a human and a saurian follow one after the other as Ifa brings you a plate of fragrant cookies and Cacucu follows it up with a cup of rich Xocoatl — barely delivered with an enormous flapping of the wings. Caught between these competing aromas, your unexplained anxiety dissolves away... Awesome work, bro!
effect_desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色防御力提高282点，持续300秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。

desc_chs: 爱可菲的灵感之作。整齐的芦笋沙拉上铺有橙黄的酱汁，交织出一捧绿意盎然的花束，被端上餐桌。爽脆中带有鲜味的口感，让人品味到了嫩苗破土而出之时的勃勃生机…难道爱可菲在后厨掌控的不是火候而是时间？
desc_en: Escoffier's inspired creation. A well-presented asparagus salad presented like a lush, green bouquet and drizzled with yellowy-orange sauce. A fresh, crisp mouthful that captures the vitality of soft, young shoots at the very instant they break the surface of the soil — it's almost as though Escoffier has moved beyond mastering the careful control of heat and flavor and is now cooking with time itself.

desc_chs: 爱可菲的灵感之作。连绵的奶油，仿佛是起起伏伏的雪白浪花，卷着细腻丝滑的浓汤一起涌入口中，软糯浓稠的滋味凝聚着这位主厨高超的烹饪技巧，拥有着温暖一切的神奇力量。

effect_desc_chs: 复苏选中的角色，为其恢复生命值上限的20%，并额外恢复1500点生命值。

desc_chs: 审判舞台上的绝对焦点，直至谢幕的掌声响起。
desc_en: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

desc_chs: 以动物为原型制作的糖雕。怡然自得的模样，是伫立于林间的凛角鹿。
desc_en: A sugar sculpture modeled after an animal. With a peaceful pose, it's a Rimehorn Deer standing serenely in the forest.
effect_desc_chs: 好看又好吃，但是几乎没什么用。

desc_chs: 以动物为原型制作的糖雕。敦实憨厚的模样，是隐蔽于灌木丛的帔髦獾。
desc_en: A sugar sculpture modeled after an animal. With a sturdy and honest appearance, it's a Chic Badger hiding in the bushes.
effect_desc_chs: 好看又好吃，但是几乎没什么用。

desc_chs: 以动物为原型制作的糖雕。展翅高飞的模样，是翱翔于天际的双辉长翎鹮。
desc_en: A sugar sculpture modeled after an animal. With wings spread wide, it's a Dualblaze Longplume Ibis soaring across the sky.
effect_desc_chs: 好看又好吃，但是几乎没什么用。

desc_chs: 以动物为原型制作的糖雕。安静乖巧的模样，是歇息于悬崖峭壁之上的海崖鹦。
desc_en: A sugar sculpture modeled after an animal. With a quiet and gentle demeanor, it's a Puffin resting atop a cliff.
effect_desc_chs: 好看又好吃，但是几乎没什么用。

desc_en: A sugar sculpture modeled after an animal. With a graceful leap, it's a Frostfin Whale playing above the water's surface.
