生长在炎热潮湿的雨林当中，有着特殊辛香的果实。搭配上其他水果，应该能呈现出更加丰富的味觉层次。
desc_en: Commonly grown in the hot and humid rainforest, this fruit has a special spicy aroma. When paired with other fruits, a greater layering of flavors can be achieved.

desc_chs: 林中灌木结出的果实。肉质敦实，味道香甜可口。据说食用后还有宁心安神的功效，很适合现在的莱依拉。
desc_en: The fruit of a forest shrub. Its flesh is firm and sweet. It is said to have a calming effect on the mind, which presently makes it very suited for Layla.

desc_chs: 爽脆可口的酸甜果实，除了生食与酿酒，烤制起来应该也别有一番风味。
desc_en: Crisp and fragrant. Aside from being eaten raw or used to ferment a beverage, roasting apples also brings forth a distinctive flavor.

desc_chs: 随手捡到的木柴，粗细适中，通体干燥，适合用来生火。烤过的食物会留下充满自然气息的木炭风味，希望这能让莱依拉打起一些精神。
desc_en: Firewood collected at one's leisure. The wood is of appropriate size and dryness for campfire. Food cooked using this will have the natural scent of charcoal. Hopefully, they will grant Layla a bit more vigor.

desc_chs: 被揉皱的名单
desc_en: Crumpled Namelist

desc_chs: 仓库物资订单
desc_en: Warehouse Inventory Records

desc_chs: 古绿洲记事·其七
desc_en: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part VII

desc_chs: 雇佣守则石板
desc_en: Employment Code of Conduct Tablet

name_chs: 印有教令院徽记的约契
desc_chs: 印有教令院徽记的约契
desc_en: Akademiya Emblem-Marked Contract

name_chs: 印有教令院徽记的约契
desc_chs: 印有教令院徽记的约契
desc_en: Akademiya Emblem-Marked Contract

desc_chs: 沾有淡淡的酒香，可以想象信件是在什么环境写出的。寄信的先生似乎自己也没指望这封信可以寄到。
desc_en: This letter has a faint whiff of alcohol. One can speculate as to the circumstances under which it was written. The sender seemed to have had little hope that it could be delivered.

desc_chs: 蘑菇…真的可以在田地里种出来吗？
desc_en: Can mushrooms... really grow in a field like this?

name_en: Nameless Taboo Medicine of the Royal Court
desc_chs: 气味有些刺鼻，久久不会散去。根据书中记载，可以借助智慧之神的力量唤醒被湮没的神智，或许能够对抗「诅咒」也说不定。
desc_en: The smell of this stings your nose and will not easily fade. According to the records, this medicine requires the power of the God of Wisdom to awaken the addled mind. Perhaps it might be able to resist the "curse."

desc_chs: 按照埃德的吩咐，午后两点时分取自神像旁的瀑布。
desc_en: You drew this water at two in the afternoon from a waterfall beside a Statue of The Seven, just as Eide instructed.

desc_chs: 部族行商的信件
desc_en: Tribe Merchant's Letter

desc_chs: 婕德的便条
desc_en: Jeht's Note

desc_chs: 用「机关烹饪神机」烹饪出的「腌笃鲜」。被钟离评价为「色泽饱满，气味醇香」。所选食材之一为萌蘖的竹笋，来之不易…如此种种缘由叠加，纪念意义已高过了它作为食物本身的价值。既然是仙家出品，就这么放在包里，应该也不会坏吧？
desc_en: Bamboo Shoot Soup created using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. Zhongli rated this dish as such: "The appearance is exquisite, and the aroma rich and intense." Among its key ingredients are Nascent Bamboo Shoots. They're hard to come by... And due to a multiplicity of reasons, their commemorative value far exceeds their worth as cooking ingredients. Since this meal was created by an adeptus, it shouldn't spoil even if you just leave it in your bag.

desc_chs: 不分国籍，不论身份，以武会友，演武传心。
desc_en: Beyond nation, beyond identity, united only by mettle and might.

name_chs: 散落在地却又保存完好的手记残页·其一
desc_chs: (test)壁画区阅读物·其一

desc_chs: (test)壁画区阅读物·其二

（test）废弃
一幅简易地图和一段咒语般的句子，据温迪所说事关预言的谜底。
desc_en: A paper with a simple map and something like an incantation on it. According to Venti, it contains the secrets to revealing the prophecy.

desc_chs: (test)(废弃)柯莱送的书签
帕蒂沙兰是柯莱心中能够传达感激与祝福的风之花，她将这些种子赠予了你。\n再访蒙德，柯莱隐约向未来踏出了新的一步。愿她的明天如掌中细小的种子一般，蕴藏着光明与希望。
desc_en: To Collei, the only flower that can serve as her Windblume and convey her gratitude and well-wishes is the Padisarah. She now offers their seeds to you.\nIn visiting Mondstadt again, Collei has taken a tentative step toward the future. May her coming days be as a small seed held within her palm, filled deep with the potential for light and hope.

desc_chs: (test)提纳里的来信
(test)阿贝多的来信
(test)砂糖的来信
(test)丽莎的来信
(test)可莉的来信
(test)柯莱的来信
(test)莫娜的来信
(test)班尼特的来信
(test)安柏的来信
(test)米卡的来信
(test)赛诺的来信
(test)罗莎莉亚的来信
(test)雷泽的来信
灵光绝唱蕴藏着强大的灵光之力，但只有受到灵光认可的花灵，通过特定的仪式才能释放其中的力量…
desc_en: The Great Songs of Khvarena contain immense power, but only the Pari can obtain the Khvarena's approval and unleash its potential through a special ritual...

desc_chs: 从神秘的调查笔记中取出的示意图，似乎详细描绘了地下遗迹试验场的结构和「灵光绝唱」所在的位置…
desc_en: The sketches taken from the mysterious investigative notes seem to list the structural layout of the ruined underground proving grounds and the location of the Great Song of Khvarena...

desc_chs: 据说是某位意图「超越凡人」的伟大学者留下的笔记，其中详细记录了他探索地下遗迹的过程以及遗迹中获得的种种知识…
desc_en: Supposedly, these notes were left by a great researcher who yearned to "surpass mortality," and its contents detail his experiences exploring ruins, along with the knowledge he gained in the process...

desc_chs: 似乎是矫论团的成员留下的笔记，记录了佚失俱利鼓及仪式相关的信息。
desc_en: This appears to be notes left by a member of the Order of Skeptics. It has information on the lost Kory Drums and their traditional usage.

desc_chs: 似乎是矫论团世代传承的古老文献，用古奥的文辞写成导致其中记录的内容难以解读。
desc_en: An ancient document passed down from prior generations of Skeptics. The arcane language makes the contents hard to decipher.

desc_chs: 从绽放的忧昙花中采集的花蕊，似乎对于花灵而言有着特殊的意义…
desc_en: A pistil taken from a blooming Udumbara. It seems to bear some special significance to the Pari...

desc_chs: 失落的碑文残片。不知因何而散失的残片。
desc_en: A fragment of a lost monument inscription. It is not known why this piece was lost.

desc_chs: 失落的碑文残片。其微弱的光芒只有灵鸟后嗣能够捕捉。
desc_en: A fragment of a lost monument inscription. Its faint light may only be captured by the divine bird's descendants.

desc_chs: 失落的碑文残片。将所有残片复归原处或许得见碑铭的本来面貌。
desc_en: A fragment of a lost monument inscription. Returning all the fragments to their original positions may restore the inscription's original form.

desc_chs: 失落的碑文残片。据说与花灵一族因缘极深。
desc_en: A fragment of a lost monument inscription. It is said to have a profound bond with the Pari.

desc_chs: 神秘的鼓，上面镌有冰元素的标记。
desc_en: A mysterious drum. This one has a Cryo marking on it.

desc_chs: 佚失的俱利鼓之一。鼓上镌有草元素的标记。
desc_en: One of the missing Kory Drums. This one has a Dendro marking on it.

desc_chs: 佚失的俱利鼓之一。鼓上镌有水元素的标记。
desc_en: One of the missing Kory Drums. This one has a Hydro marking on it.

desc_chs: 佚失的俱利鼓之一。鼓上镌有雷元素的标记。
desc_en: One of the missing Kory Drums. This one has an Electro marking on it.

desc_chs: 佚失的俱利鼓之一。鼓上镌有火元素的标记。
desc_en: One of the missing Kory Drums. This one has a Pyro marking on it.

desc_chs: 由纯粹的元素能量中提取出来的「阿索斯物质」凝练而成的能量块，似乎可以用来为大型能源装置供能。
desc_en: An energy block of refined Azosite formed via the condensation of pure elemental energy. It seems that they can be used as an energy source for large-scale power systems.

desc_chs: (test)密码本
落水的行李，据说被小心打包好了，不知道内容物是否会因为浸水而受损。
desc_en: Waterlogged luggage. Supposedly packed with care. It is uncertain if the contents inside have suffered water damage from being soaked.

desc_chs: 配色奇怪的画稿。
desc_en: A sketch bearing a strange mix of colors.

desc_chs: 于连摹写的副本，与原本别无二致。\n读完之后有种脑袋空空的奇妙感觉，只有时间白白被浪费，却没能获得任何经验…
desc_en: A copy of an Adventurer's Experience made by Julien. It seems no different from the original.\nAfter reading through it, however, only emptiness pervades the mind, with a sense that time was wasted without the requisite experience gained.

name_en: Picture Left by the Wisdom Seelie
desc_chs: 「知慧仙灵」留下的提示，希望这一次的探寻不再是徒劳…
desc_en: Hints left by the Wisdom Seelie. Hopefully this venture isn't as futile as before...

desc_chs: 从目标商队截获的账务记录，上面的情报均与「阿赫玛尔之须」相关。除了大量的数字与赃物流向之外，迪娜泽黛父亲的名字令人非常在意。
desc_en: Accounts obtained from your target caravan. The information on it mostly relates to Dakan Al-Ahmar. Apart from the large amount of data and information on the movement of loot, the fact that Dunyarzad's father was named is quite concerning.

desc_chs: 一封书信
desc_en: A letter.

desc_chs: 一封书信
desc_en: A letter.

desc_chs: (test)风花节食宿安排
装有文物模型的容器，被特意涂成了紫色。
desc_en: A container holding a relic replica. It has been deliberately painted purple.

desc_chs: 装有文物模型的容器，被特意涂成了蓝色。
desc_en: A container holding a relic replica. It has been deliberately painted blue.

desc_chs: 装有文物模型的容器，被特意涂成了红色。
desc_en: A container holding a relic replica. It has been deliberately painted red.

desc_chs: 记录了俱利般地·识对应的鼓谱。
desc_en: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Vijnana.

desc_chs: 记录了俱利般地·想对应的鼓谱。
desc_en: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Samjna.

desc_chs: 记录了俱利般地·色对应的鼓谱。
desc_en: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Rupa.

desc_chs: 记录了俱利般地·行对应的鼓谱。
desc_en: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Sankhara.

desc_chs: 记录了俱利般地·受对应的鼓谱。
desc_en: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Vedana.

name_chs: 千奇澴回的见证物·其一
desc_chs: 从「琉形蜃境」的经典游乐项目「千奇澴回」的藏宝地发掘而出的见证物，收纳这一见证物的宝藏对应着第一段暗语——「甘甜的雾气在弥漫，望着灯盏的光芒，我几乎忘记了呼吸。最后，还是儿时的回忆给了我引导，让我在桌边安心落座…」
desc_en: A memento discovered at a treasure site in the Veluriyam Mirage event, "Returning Curios." The treasure chest that contains it corresponds to the first code — "A sweet mist permeates all, gazing toward the dancing lamplight, I almost forget to breathe. In the end, memories of childhood guide me, and I take my seat beside the table in peace..."

name_chs: 千奇澴回的见证物·其二
desc_chs: 从「琉形蜃境」的经典游乐项目「千奇澴回」的藏宝地发掘而出的见证物，收纳这一见证物的宝藏对应着第二段暗语——「藤蔓的飞星承载着我，在安静的林间穿行，终于进入了无人打扰的清净梦乡…」
desc_en: A memento discovered at a treasure site in the Veluriyam Mirage event, "Returning Curios." The treasure chest that contains it corresponds to the second code — "A shooting star of vines carries me, traversing a forest so quiet and peaceful, to finally arrive in secluded dreamland so pure."

name_chs: 千奇澴回的见证物·其三
desc_chs: 从「琉形蜃境」的经典游乐项目「千奇澴回」的藏宝地发掘而出的见证物，收纳这一见证物的宝藏对应着第三段暗语——「蓝蓝的屋顶没有一点灰尘，地板就像白色的糖果，软软的好朋友们陪伴着我，我也有了翅膀！」
desc_en: A memento discovered at a treasure site in the Veluriyam Mirage event, "Returning Curios." The treasure chest that contains it corresponds to the third code — "A blue, spotless ceiling, a floor of white candy, soft companions surround me, I too have wings!"

desc_chs: 从伊迪娅手中拿到的特制匣子，是容纳「千奇澴回」见证物的关键道具，据说能将其中的物品安然保存相当之长的时间。有了这个匣子，选择好特别的「见证物」与藏宝地，方可在「琉形蜃境」中留下只属于自己的痕迹…
desc_en: A special box you got from Idyia that is used to contain "Returning Curios" mementos. It is said that it can protect the items within for a long time. With this box, you can pick a special memento and treasure site to leave your very own mark on the Veluriyam Mirage...

desc_chs: 在「琉形蜃境」中意外发现的怀表，有着金灿灿的色泽和摩拉式样的外壳纹路，与伊迪娅所说的故事之中，「千奇澴回」项目之初的资深冒险家留下的摩拉怀表极为相仿，不知价值几何。\n不过，伊迪娅也说过，「重点不在于怀表或宝藏的价值，而是宝藏中蕴藏的故事…」，或许用金钱衡量这个年代久远的「见证物」的珍贵程度，并不是最妥当的做法…
desc_en: A Mora-shaped (and Mora-shiny) pocketwatch you accidentally found in the Veluriyam Mirage. This one bears a strong resemblance to a Mora pocketwatch left behind by a seasoned adventurer in the earliest days of "Returning Curios." One wonders how much it is worth.\nHowever, Idyia also says that "it's not about the value of the treasure or the watch, but the stories hidden inside the treasures!" Perhaps using monetary value as the measure of this memento is not the most fitting...

desc_chs: 在神秘洞窟之中发现的「先成图」残片，描绘着「琉形蜃境」中飘悬的云彩。通过正确位置的「聚流映灯」投射至壁画之上，似乎就能修复壁画中缺失的一块区域…
desc_en: A Preprint fragment found within a mysterious cave that depicts the clouds floating in the Veluriyam Mirage. It seems that a projection at the correct angle from the Streaming Projector can restore a missing part of the mural...

desc_chs: 在神秘洞窟之中发现的「先成图」残片，描绘着「琉形蜃境」中央的巨大构造。通过正确位置的「聚流映灯」投射至壁画之上，似乎就能修复壁画中缺失的一块区域…
desc_en: A Preprint fragment found within a mysterious cave that depicts the huge structure at the center of the Veluriyam Mirage. It seems that a projection at the correct angle from the Streaming Projector can restore a missing part of the mural...

desc_chs: 在神秘洞窟之中发现的「先成图」残片，描绘着高悬在天空中的城镇。通过正确位置的「聚流映灯」投射至壁画之上，似乎就能修复壁画中缺失的一块区域…
desc_en: A Preprint fragment found within a mysterious cave that depicts a city floating in the sky. It seems that a projection at the correct angle from the Streaming Projector can restore a missing part of the mural...

name_en: Mural Fragment: Flower of the Valley
desc_chs: 在神秘洞窟之中发现的「先成图」残片，描绘着「呼呼飞车」驶入山谷之时可见的巨大花朵。通过正确位置的「聚流映灯」投射至壁画之上，似乎就能修复壁画中缺失的一块区域…
desc_en: A Preprint fragment found within a mysterious cave that depicts the huge flowers visible from a Choo-Choo Cart entering the valley. It seems that a projection at the correct angle from the Streaming Projector can restore a missing part of the mural...

desc_chs: 有些使用痕迹，但目前未着一笔的画板。
desc_en: A drawing board that shows signs of use but is presently devoid of any brushstrokes.

name_en: In Pursuit of the Lost Inscription
desc_chs: 从索希处获得的笔记。记录了有关散失碑文残片可能所在的线索。
desc_en: A note obtained from Sosi. It might contain clues about the lost monument fragments.

name_chs: 海妮耶的「妙妙琼脂」赠礼
desc_chs: 海妮耶赠送的精巧礼盒，其中装有蕈兽们喜爱的「妙妙琼脂」，琼脂被分成了多种独特的口味，可以根据蕈兽个体的喜好来投喂。\n「妙妙琼脂」基于此前的「花花琼脂」改进而来，保留了晶莹剔透、富有弹性的质感，去除了所有危险的成分，是喂养蕈兽的理想载体。只不过…存放在家中时，还需格外小心，防止它们被贪吃的孩子误食？
desc_en: An exquisite gift offered by Haniyyah. It contains Marvelous Jellies much loved by the Fungi, and the Jellies themselves come in many unique flavors that can be fed to the Fungi based on their individual preferences.\nThe Marvelous Jellies are a refined version of the Floral Jellies that preceded them and retain their crystalline translucence and springy texture, sans the dangerous ingredients, thus making them the ideal feed for Fungi. That said, one should probably take care that the children don't eat it by mistake when storing it at home...

desc_chs: 看上去应该是某个巨大机械的一部分，不过掉落而出的，孤零零的齿轮，恐怕没法起到任何的作用。不过，如果寻找到让这枚齿轮开始转动的方法，或许有些问题也能寻找到答案。
desc_en: It seems to be a part of a huge machine, but this lone gear that fell out may not be of any use. However, if the way to make it turn again is found, then perhaps the answers to some questions may in turn be discovered.

desc_chs: 冒险家们经常使用的登山绳。虽然已经有些老旧，但看得出来经过相当细心的维护，所以直到今日，正常使用也不是问题。这条绳索最后被当作礼物留在了此地。或许，在攀登高处的时候，可靠的不仅有绳索，还有亲友伸向你的手。
desc_en: Mountaineering rope favored by adventurers. It's a bit old but well-maintained, so it can still be used as per normal. This rope was left here as a gift. Perhaps it is not just ropes that a person relies on when scaling great heights, but friendly hands that reach out to you.

desc_chs: 经常会用在须弥的各种庆典中的糖果盒。小的时候，尚未成为学者的女孩曾每日从中取出一粒糖果来吃，那时最大的担忧仅是害怕糖果有吃完的一日。成为学者之后，这个已经空了的糖果盒成为了人生另一种可能的念想。这个糖果盒最后被当作礼物留在了此地。这对于学者来说，也是她从一种苦恼中解脱的象征。
desc_en: A candy box that is often used in various celebrations in Sumeru. When the girl who would become a researcher was still young, she used to take one candy a day from the box. Back in those days, her biggest worry was that the candy would run out. After becoming a researcher, this empty candy box has become a nostalgic reminder of other possibilities in life. This candy box was left here as a gift. To the researcher, this is also a symbol of freedom from misery.

desc_chs: 青年在夜晚读书时经常使用的灯。可以通过一些小机关控制灯中火焰的大小，这对于从未见到这样的灯的孩子来说，或许就像魔法一样神奇。每次看到这盏灯发出的光亮时，他都会忆起从前对着油灯比划手影扮演各种角色与动物的事。这盏灯最后被当作礼物留在了此地。也许对他来说，这也是一种减负前行的方式。
desc_en: A lamp that the boy often used when studying at night. The flame can be adjusted via a mechanism in the lamp, and this was perhaps quite magical to a child who had never seen such a lamp before. Every time he saw the light from this lamp, he will think of the old days when he played various hand shadow characters and animals. This lamp was left here as a gift. Maybe this is a way for him to let go of his burden and move on.

desc_chs: 从巴哈多那里取得的盒子，里面装有一些特殊的药剂。据他说，这些药剂也许有助于探索某处秘境…
desc_en: A box obtained from Bahador. Within it are some special potions. According to what he said, these potions might be of aid to exploring a certain Domain...

desc_chs: 属于废弃生产区中央传动机阀的可拆卸部件。
desc_en: A removable part that belongs to the central drive valve in the abandoned production zone.

desc_en: Someone's Journal

desc_chs: 某人的备忘
desc_en: Someone's Memo

desc_chs: (test）一封书信
妙论派的研究成果，当参赛者携带特殊的「追踪装置」后，提示器可以显示他们的大体方位。此外，如果参赛者顺利完成比赛，提示器也会发出声响。
desc_en: A Kshahrewar invention. When contestants carry these tracking devices, the locator can display their general locations. Additionally, should the contestants successfully complete their tasks, the locator will also sound.

desc_chs: （test)萨齐因相关的资料

浮游风蕈兽·元素生命交给你们的种子，种在田地里就可以长出蕈兽喜爱的食物。但以后还会有蕈兽知道怎么照顾田地吗？
desc_en: The elemental life form known as the Floating Anemo Fungus gave you these seeds. Plant them in a field to grow food that the Fungi enjoy eating. But will there be any Fungi who remember how to till the fields in the future?

desc_chs: 以风靡提瓦特的卡牌游戏「七圣召唤」为题材撰写的轻小说。人物设定独具创意，故事情节精彩曲折，是近期相当热门的作品。
desc_en: A light novel centered around the most popular card game in Teyvat — Genius Invokation TCG. The characters are unique and the story is exciting and full of twists, making it one of the hottest new works around.

desc_chs: 在海沫村附近获得的机械零件，造型似乎与如今常见的机关零件有着微妙的不同。\n虽然不知道为什么会在这种地方找到这样的零件，但这些漂亮的金属制品似乎深受美露莘们喜爱…
desc_en: A strange mechanical part obtained near Merusea Village. It looks subtly different from common mechanical parts.\nYou have no idea why it ended up here, but beautiful metal products like this are loved by Melusines...

name_en: Key to the Castle's Secret Chamber
desc_chs: 「黛依阿的三日遐想」之「瞳孔里的固形魔咒」剧目中的关键道具，能够开启藏有古老药剂的密室。单就外形而言，与普通的钥匙似乎没什么区别。
desc_en: An item that is key to the "Petrifying Gaze" scenario in Daiya's Three-Day Reverie, which can be used to open a secret chamber that conceals an ancient medicine. Its outer appearance is not much different from that of ordinary keys.

desc_chs: 「黛依阿的三日遐想」之「瞳孔里的固形魔咒」剧目中的关键道具。\n据「落单的水形幻灵」所说，这种药剂有着解除幽魂的魔咒，让石化的「水形幻灵」们恢复原状的药效…\n不过，单看药剂的外观，似乎用到了常见炼金药剂的容器，也不知是设定上和炼金术有关，还是剧组在适当节省经费…
desc_en: An item that is key to the "Petrifying Gaze" scenario in Daiya's Three-Day Reverie.\nAccording to the Lone Hydro Eidolon, such remedies have the power to cleanse Wraith-cast hexes and restore petrified Hydro Eidolons to their original states.\nHowever, the outward appearance of the remedy indicates the use of a very common alchemy vessel. Is this narrative setting related to alchemy, or is the theater troupe just cutting costs...?

desc_chs: 一本中间被挖空，藏匿着挖掘道具的道具书。当然了，毕竟是片场用的道具，其他的书页早就被黏在了一起，所以没法读到书的内容。但有的时候，书的「内容」比书的内容更加重要。
desc_en: A prop book that has been hollowed out and had digging tools put into it. Of course, as a stage prop, its other pages have long been stuck together. But then again, the "content" of a book is sometimes more important than its... content.

desc_chs: （test）丰富情景使用
全然无法理解其中内容的古老纸张。\n或许能有什么方法解读其中的内容吧。
desc_en: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

desc_chs: 从纳西妲处获得的，用于联络兰那罗的树叶。如果像哨子一样吹响它，就会有兰那罗应召而来。兰那罗愿意回应这种声音是出于对纳西妲的信任，换言之，平时吹叶子也是不会有效果的。
desc_en: A leaf that you got from Nahida. It can be used to contact the Aranara. If you use it like a whistle, an Aranara will answer the call. The Aranara will only come because they trust Nahida. In other words, you can't just blow on any leaf you find and expect an answer.

desc_chs: 被赛达菲做上了标记的地图。或许，那个箱子就在附近…
desc_en: A map marked by Sadife. Perhaps the case is somewhere close by...

desc_en: Sadife's case. It's stuffed to the brim and quite heavy.

desc_chs: 德拉萝诗开发的新型钓鱼辅助装置，运用了分析气味、模拟高级鱼饵的原理，据说「效果十分强大」。可以看出，德拉萝诗对这种鱼饵相当重视，还用专门的袋子和缓冲材料将它保护了起来，也不知道这么严密的保护会不会影响鱼饵的基本功能，就算有鱼被吸引过来，似乎也无从下口…
desc_en: A new fishing aid developed by Delaroche that applies the principles of odor analysis and advanced bait mimicry. It is said that its effect is "very powerful." You can tell by the appearance that Delaroche thinks the world of this bait, with protective wrapping and a special bag. However, it is unknown whether such meticulous measures will affect the basic function of the bait — even if it attracts fish, the fish themselves may be unable to even find a way to bite down upon it.

desc_chs: （test）机械怪物残骸
沉在水中的箱子。不知道里面装着什么…
desc_en: A sunken box. Details of the contents within are unknown...

desc_chs: 沉在水中的箱子。看起来似乎和其他的箱子…不太一样…？
desc_en: A sunken box. It seems... a bit different from other boxes...?

desc_chs: 能够开启继续深入「十字铃兰学会」遗址的道路。\n尽管在水中浸泡了许多年月，却没有完全朽坏。
desc_en: A key that can unlock the path leading into the ruins of the Liliacruces Forum.\nIt has been submerged in water for a long time, but it hasn't decayed beyond recognition.

name_en: Key to Some Place in the Institute
desc_chs: 似乎能够开启自然哲学学院的某一扇门。
desc_en: It should be able to open a certain door in the Institute of Natural Philosophy.

desc_chs: (test)吊坠壳上的图案似乎来自于一个古老的文明
(test)造型朴素的小盒子，只有简单的机械元件
用精致礼盒包装起来的礼物，据凯亚说，盒内装了一盏精致的壶灯。等到与凯亚共度的假期结束后再把他赠送的壶灯拿出来仔细观赏吧。
desc_en: A gift in a beautiful gift box. According to Kaeya, it contains an exquisite lamp. It might be best to wait till you come back from vacation with Kaeya to open up his gift and admire it.

desc_chs: 你在特纳的指导下小心翼翼摘下的葡萄，假以时日，它们都将被酿成醇厚的美酒。
desc_en: Grapes you picked with utmost care under Tunner's guidance. In time, they can be turned into rich wine.

desc_chs: 极沉的包裹，里面装着大量的颜料。德皮耶里到底会怎么使用这些颜料呢…
desc_en: An overwhelmingly heavy pack, containing large quantities of paint. How will Depierris put these paints to use...

desc_chs: (test)骗骗花的花蜜，也能制作成颜料
从莉诺蕾娅那里拿到的鱼苗。据说这些小鱼经过她的特别选育，很适合在当前水域里生存…
desc_en: Fry that you obtained from Linorea. It is said that these fish have been hand-picked by her, and are perfectly suited to surviving in these waters...

desc_chs: 戏剧中象征着科巴德王子高贵出身的印珠道具，本应被珠链串起，被王子佩戴于胸前，但命中注定的悲剧使得王子将它抛弃。\n血红色的宝石凝结了凯亚向你提出的问题，那个关于命运的古老问题。\n不要急着回话，在未来，用你的眼、你的手、你的心证明此刻你灵魂中的答案吧。
desc_en: An Intaglio that symbolizes the noble origins of Prince Qubad in the play. It should have been strung on a beaded chain and worn on the prince's chest, but a fated tragedy made the prince abandon it.\nThe blood-red jewel is a crystallization of the question Kaeya asked you — that age-old question about destiny.\nThere is no need to rush to answer. In the future, use what you see, touch, and feel to prove the answer within your soul.

desc_chs: (test)两年前的某个雨夜，雅克在宴会中途离场时被枪杀。根据当年的调查结果，卡雷斯是唯一在场的人。在没有出现其他可能的情况下，被定义为本案真凶。
(test)雅克家人提到，在案发当日，雅克离开家时曾说：他别无选择。那似乎是他在收到胁迫的情况下，对家人的道别。
(test)弗洛朗在案发当日也在宴会现场，并目睹了案发之后的情况。他声称自己感恩卡雷斯多年的善待和信任。
(test)蒂埃里是负责联络刺玫会的警备队人员，他提及：警备队中的人虽然能调度机械警卫，却极难抹除它们的编号，或命令它们做维护法律之外的事。
(test)当年那场宴会的承办人。在枫丹，玛塞勒掌握着十分雄厚的财力，也不断为刺玫会提供着经济支持。
(test)嫌疑人中，足够掌握控制机械警卫的实力，并且能控制「乐斯」一类的货物在枫丹流通的，似乎只有财力雄厚的玛塞勒。
(test)被坚实的武装力量守护起来的工厂深处发现的水池，其中是不知来源的「原始胎海」水，是制造饮料的原料，也是失踪的少女被溶解的场所。
(test)曾经一度在白淞镇流通的饮料，其中掺入了原始胎海水。能让人短时间内情绪高涨，却有很强的副作用。
(test)在工厂深处发现的数箱衣物，其中少数能透露身份信息的物品，都能与登记在案的失踪少女对上。
(test)「第十六号实验，旨在对雅各布·英戈德的原始胎海研究结论进行验证与突破…」\n「实验失败，原始胎海之水中并未有人浮现，二十二、二十三、二十四号少女被溶解」…\n诸如此类的记载有厚厚一本，后面的内容派蒙实在看不下去了。

(test)一部分往来的书信，其中写道：
「关于卡雷斯散布给帮派成员的关键情报是什么，暂时还没查到。」
「这条老狗太难对付，就算他真的履行承诺，主动权还是在他手上。」
「他想对付我们了，随时可以行动。解决的办法，就只能把他杀了。」
「有道理，派人杀了他吧，只要不动娜维娅，老狗就不咬人。」
薇涅尔的笔记本
desc_en: Vigneire's Notebook

desc_chs: 仅在梅洛彼得堡使用的通货。
desc_en: A type of currency only used in the Fortress of Meropide.

desc_chs: 「成功学的里程碑，人生中不可错过的大师力作！」 \n下水沟报编辑、商界精英与枫科院学者倾情推荐的绝世好书！\n教你洞悉名为「人性」的深渊， 成就无与伦比的伟业！
desc_en: "A milestone in the science of success, this masterpiece written by a true genius is an absolute must-read!"\nAn exceptional book emphatically recommended by the editor of La Gouttiere, titans of the business world, and researchers at the Fontaine Research Institute!\nIt will impart deep insights and understanding into the abyss of human nature, a truly incomparable contribution to the science and art of success!

desc_chs: (test)排队送信纸条
特许食堂发放的福利餐。因为免费，所以惊喜与风险并存。\n\n使用后能获得一份料理和一张幸运签。
desc_en: A Welfare Meal from the Coupon Cafeteria. As it's free, there's an element of surprise and risk.\n\nUse to obtain a meal and a Fortune Slip.

desc_chs: 据说是在枫丹建城初年，由著名学者普特尼所撰写的关于古代雷穆利亚文明的历史巨著。
desc_en: It is said that the great scholar Pulteney wrote this epic historical work concerning the ancient Remurian civilization in the early years of the founding of Fontaine.

desc_en: A storybook containing various lore and tales authored by Marie Hericart de La Fontaine, most of which were not written by the author but are compiled from ancient poems which have since been lost.

desc_chs: 利魔世王的使者怎样来见伊黎耶，向她索要爱美乐城的水和土，又怎样要求她臣服于颂福纳·卡卑秃令（意思是永恒的和谐旋律）。
desc_en: How the emissary of King Remus came to Erinnyes, asking her for a gift of Aremori Castle's water and earth, and for her to submit to the Sumphonia Capitolii (which means "the eternal harmony").

desc_chs: 各郡的骑士怎样向伊黎耶应允同心合力，以对抗卡卑秃人的侵略企图。
desc_en: How the Knights of every region united to lend their strength to Erinnyes, in opposition to the designs of the Capitoliani to invade.

desc_chs: 伊黎耶怎样向众水的女主人辞别，又怎样三次将她的剑丢在湖里。
desc_en: How Erinnyes bid farewell to the Mistress of Many Waters, and how she threw her sword into the lake three times.

desc_chs: 风靡枫丹的一本小小的童话书。精美的封面曾让许多小孩子误以为这本书真的是由传说中那位慈祥的雪翅雁夫人编写的。
desc_en: A short fairy tale that is quite popular in Fontaine. Many children saw the exquisitely drawn cover and thought it was really written by the kind Madam Snow-Winged Goose of legend.

desc_chs: 风靡枫丹的一本小小的童话书。精美的封面曾让许多小孩子误以为这本书真的是由传说中那位慈祥的雪翅雁夫人编写的。
desc_en: A short fairy tale that is quite popular in Fontaine. Many children saw the exquisitely drawn cover and thought it was really written by the kind Madam Snow-Winged Goose of legend.

desc_chs: 风靡枫丹的一本小小的童话书。精美的封面曾让许多小孩子误以为这本书真的是由传说中那位慈祥的雪翅雁夫人编写的。
desc_en: A short fairy tale that is quite popular in Fontaine. Many children saw the exquisitely drawn cover and thought it was really written by the kind Madam Snow-Winged Goose of legend.

desc_chs: 流行于枫丹的畅销读物，讲述了一场阴谋与复仇、正义与邪恶交织的故事。
desc_en: A series about conspiracy, revenge, justice, and evil that took Fontaine by storm.

desc_chs: 流行于枫丹的畅销读物，讲述了一场阴谋与复仇、正义与邪恶交织的故事。
desc_en: A series about conspiracy, revenge, justice, and evil that took Fontaine by storm.

desc_chs: 流行于枫丹的畅销读物，讲述了一场阴谋与复仇、正义与邪恶交织的故事。
desc_en: A series about conspiracy, revenge, justice, and evil that took Fontaine by storm.

desc_chs: 由蒸汽鸟报出版的枫丹科学幻想小说，讲述了一位工程师利用时间机器旅行的故事。
desc_en: A Fontainian science fiction novel published by The Steambird. It tells the story of an engineer's travels using a time machine.

desc_chs: 由蒸汽鸟报出版的枫丹科学幻想小说，讲述了一位工程师利用时间机器旅行的故事。
desc_en: A Fontainian science fiction novel published by The Steambird. It tells the story of an engineer's travels using a time machine.

desc_chs: 由蒸汽鸟报出版的枫丹科学幻想小说，讲述了一位工程师利用时间机器旅行的故事。
desc_en: A Fontainian science fiction novel published by The Steambird. It tells the story of an engineer's travels using a time machine.

desc_chs: 林尼在魔术表演时赠送的鲜花饰品，象征离别的柔灯铃。
desc_en: A flowery accessory given away by Lyney at his magic shows. It is an arrangement of Lumidouce Bells, which symbolize parting.

desc_chs: 林尼在魔术表演时赠送的鲜花饰品，分别是象征离别的柔灯铃与象征热情的虹彩蔷薇。离别与相遇本是一体两面，重要的是我们拥有的现在。
desc_en: A flowery accessory given away by Lyney at his magic shows. It is an arrangement of Lumidouce Bells, which symbolize parting, and Rainbow Roses that represent passion. Parting and passion are two separate perspectives sharing the same nature. What really matters is the present that we are living in.

desc_chs: （test）像是什么矿石一样的东西
（test）巨神孩子的胚胎，会长成美露莘还是隙境原体呢？
和玛梅赫一起采集到的红色矿石，据说可以用来制作颜料。\n不知为何，虽然是矿石，摸上去却似乎有一丝淡淡的温度…是错觉吗？
desc_en: Red ore that you collected together with Mamere. It is said that the ore can be used to make paint.\nFor some reason, even though it's just an ore, it almost feels warm... Is your hand too cold?

desc_chs: 一枚老旧的怀表。\n里面不再传出摆锤的声响。外壳也无法打开。
desc_en: An old pocket watch.\nIt has ceased to tick and tock, and its cover cannot be opened.

desc_chs: 对某个故事具有意义的圣剑。\n不属于任何人。
desc_en: A holy sword that bears a special meaning in a certain story.\nIt belongs to no one.

name_chs: （test）阅读物 玛丽安和莉利丝的故事
desc_chs: （test）玛丽安和莉莉丝的奇妙故事

在一些时候有加速故事，带来终结的力量。
因为它的出现本身是超出故事的力量的象征。

尽管非常古老，但保存得很好。曾经被不止一人珍视过。
desc_en:
Sometimes, this feather has the power to advance a story forward and bring it to an end.
Its appearance itself represents a power that transcends the story.

Old yet well-preserved, it must have been cherished by many people.

desc_chs: 刚买来的打字机键帽，虽然看起来和其他的键帽不太协调，但总之…先安上去工作吧。
desc_en: A newly purchased keycap. Though it does not quite fit in with its counterparts already on the typewriter... Well, let's just make do for now.

desc_chs: 从德瑟布尔处取得的信件。据他本人说，该信是为了给他的孩子庆生所写。
desc_en: A letter obtained from Decembre. According to him, this is a letter written to celebrate his child's birthday.

desc_chs: 名为「茉洁」的香水。制作原料似乎就是茉洁草，是莉诺蕾娅经常购买的款式。
desc_en: A perfume named Marcotte. The primary ingredient is also Marcotte. Linorea often purchases this perfume.

desc_chs: 名为「湖光」的香水。是瑟米安比较喜欢的款式，不知道这个人会不会在上班的时候抹上一点…
desc_en: A perfume named Lakelight favored by Semaine. Does he wear this at work...?

desc_chs: 名为「汐藻」的香水。有着独特的水藻香气，但…水藻的「香气」究竟是一种怎样的气味呢…
desc_en: A perfume named Tidalga. It has the unique scent of algae. Come to think of it, what exactly is the "scent of algae"...?

desc_chs: 从巴塔索那里拿到的鱼苗。据说这些鱼苗都经过他的特别选育，很适合在那片水域中生存…
desc_en: Fry that you obtained from Batasso. It is said that these fish have been hand-picked by him, and are perfectly suited to surviving in those waters...

desc_chs: 沉重的箱子。里面装满了映影画片。
desc_en: A heavy box that contains many films.

name_chs: 「歌剧院交换魔术」案件记录册
desc_chs: 记载了发生在「欧庇克莱歌剧院」，由林尼与琳妮特的交换魔术引发的凶杀与少女失踪的案件详情。如果在调查中遇到了困难，就通过目前收集到的线索与证据，再整理一下思绪吧。
desc_en: A detailed case record of the murder and the disappearance that occurred during Lyney and Lynette's switcheroo magic show in the Opera Epiclese. If any difficulties are encountered during the investigation, please examine the clues and evidence collected so far to gather and organize your thoughts.

desc_chs: 记载了与娜维娅的父亲卡雷斯有关的杀人案，以及与其关系密切的「少女连环失踪案」的案件详情。如果在调查中遇到了困难，就通过目前收集到的线索与证据，再整理一下思绪吧。
desc_en: A detailed case record of the murder related to Navia's father, Callas, and the serial disappearances of young women case that is thought to be closely linked to the murder. If any difficulties are encountered during the investigation, please examine the clues and evidence collected so far to gather and organize your thoughts.

desc_chs: 比普通松果更大个的松果，一定是因为比普通松果更纯洁吧。
desc_en: Much larger than an ordinary Pinecone. It must be because it is purer than an ordinary Pinecone.

desc_chs: 空瓶的意思，就是装了很多空气的瓶子，所以也可以用来装其他东西。
desc_en: The meaning of an empty bottle is one full of air, which means other things can also be stored in it.

desc_chs: 据说是前往猛烈纯洁世界的「密钥」，其实是液体形态的东西，可能是为了方便流入各种形态的钥孔。
desc_en: Said to be the key to the World of Intense Purity. In reality, it is a fluid, and thus can easily change shape to fit into any keyhole.

desc_chs: (test)纯洁水仙结出的露珠
派蒙从私藏的「伙食小金库」中取出了一部分，用来支付你的委托费。这样想，她是不是还藏着更多？
desc_en: Paimon used part of her personal "Food Fund" to pay for your commission fee. Hmm, now that you think about it, she probably has more squirreled away, doesn't she?

desc_chs: (test)科研用的植物样本，希望它可以茁壮成长
(test)科研用的植物样本，希望它可以茁壮成长
(test)科研用的植物样本，希望它可以茁壮成长
在神秘的水下空间中找到的器件，似乎是某种光学装置的核心器件，将它安装在正确的位置，应该能激活一些特殊的机关…\n结束实验后，将关键器件与主要装置分离存放，的确是相当符合安全守则的做法。
desc_en: A component found in a mysterious underwater space, it seems to be a core component in some kind of optical device. If placed in the correct position, it should be able to activate some kind of special device...\nAfter the experiment, please store critical components separately from the main devices. This is in accordance with standard security procedures.

desc_chs: 保存完好的打孔纸带，其中记录的数据似乎需要专门的仪器才能解读。
desc_en: Well-preserved punched tape. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

desc_chs: 有些磨损痕迹的打孔纸带，其中记录的数据似乎需要专门的仪器才能解读。
desc_en: Punched tape with a bit of wear and tear. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

desc_chs: 应瑟维妮请求回收的打孔纸带，其中记录的数据似乎需要专门的仪器才能解读。
desc_en: Punched tape collected in accordance with Sevigne's request. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

desc_chs: 神秘的黄绿色晶体原矿。\n似乎有着与同类矿石相互吸引的特性。
desc_en: A mysterious green-yellow crystalline ore.\nOre of the same type seems to mutually attract.

desc_chs: 在特殊的规则下自发聚合而成的始基矿胚料。\n经过锻压处理后，或许可以激发出其内蕴含的无穷潜力…
desc_en: The raw form of Arkhium, which can come together naturally under special circumstances.\nIt may be able to unleash limitless potential after being forged...

desc_chs: 经过锻压处理而成的始基矿辉晶，散发着异于寻常的能量与光辉，据说可以用于开启某处的大门…
desc_en: The result of forging Arkhium. It emits an unusual energy and light. They say that such things can be used to open a gate somewhere...

desc_chs: 对某个故事具有意义的圣剑。
desc_en: A holy sword that bears a special meaning in a certain story.

desc_chs: 从「琉形蜃境」中寻找到的一张信纸，折叠整齐，折痕处泛黄，看的出来是很久以前有人遗留在蜃境之中的物件。
desc_en: A letter you found in the Veluriyam Mirage. It is neatly folded and yellowed. It seems to be an object that someone left in the Domain long ago.

desc_chs: 全然无法理解其中内容的古老纸张。\n或许能有什么方法解读其中的内容吧。
desc_en: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

desc_chs: 全然无法理解其中内容的古老纸张。\n或许能有什么方法解读其中的内容吧。
desc_en: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

desc_en: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

desc_chs: 据说记录了传说中古老乐谱的铜板，但因为使用了奇怪的符号而难以解读。
desc_en: A bronze plate said to be a musical score recording an ancient melody, but it is difficult to understand due to the strange notations.

desc_chs: 自称音乐家的托皮娅交给你的「信物」，据说是用来奏响海螺琴的元件。
desc_en: The token of the self-proclaimed musician Topyas. She says it's used to play the Conch Harp.

desc_chs: 散发着奇异光泽的矿石，质地也颇为致密坚韧。
desc_en: An ore that gives off a strange glow. It has a compact and tough texture.

desc_chs: 采用了特殊的材料制作的试作型钟表，有效缓解了钟表机芯因摩擦而导致的磨损。因为采用了蚌式结构似乎在水下也可以使用。
desc_en: A prototype timepiece made using special materials, reducing abrasion and wear on the internal gears. Due to its clamshell-inspired design, it can also be used underwater.

desc_chs: （test）研究元能机关的记录
（test）元能介质到荒光记录
（test）荒光能量实质化记录
（test）机械运动入门
（test）试验助手的笔记
（test）西摩尔制造实录
（test）物资需求单
（test）水幕房间故事集
（test）学院长日记
由阿鲁埃制作而出的材料，可以直接用来调制咖啡。
desc_en: Ingredients made by Arouet. Can be directly used to brew coffee.

desc_chs: 由艾尤恩特别处理过的鱼肉，似乎很受紫金渔鸥的欢迎…
desc_en: Fish meat that Iaune has processed with a special method. Violetgold Angler Gulls seem to like it very much...

desc_chs: 改良配方之后的「真视药剂」，假如喝下的话不知会有什么奇异的药效…
desc_en: The improved version of the "Truesight Potion." If you drink it, who knows what kind of strange effects you'll feel...

desc_chs: 受那维莱特委托前往梅洛彼得堡调查时候所获取的特许券，记得要专款专用哦。
desc_en: Special Credit Coupons you obtained when Neuvillette tasked you with investigating the Fortress of Meropide. Remember to use them for their designated purpose.

desc_chs: 从布希柯那里得到的鱼饵。希望能帮助洛耶茨多钓上一点鱼…
desc_en: Bait obtained from Boucicaut. Hopefully it will help Roialte with fishing...

desc_chs: 「一时的好运只能带来片刻的满足，终身的幸福还得靠勤奋上进。」
desc_en: "Luck only brings fleeting pleasure, lifelong happiness requires hard work."

desc_chs: 「偶尔也会有这种事，别介意！」
desc_en: "Things happen. Don't take it personally!"

desc_chs: 「生活中的不幸是病，贴心的朋友则是良药。」
desc_en: "Misfortune is an illness, and caring friends are the cure."

desc_chs: 「努力工作，就能获得成功！」
desc_en: "Hard work begets success!"

desc_chs: 「笑得最好的不一定笑到最后，但笑的时候一定最爽。」
desc_en: "The one who laughs loudest may not laugh to the last, but they certainly are the happiest when laughing."

desc_chs: 「用左脸抽了别人的手后，一定要乘胜追击，用右脸继续抽别人的手。」
desc_en: "After using your left cheek to strike the other person's hand, you must be sure to press the advantage, and continue attacking their hand with your right cheek."

desc_chs: 「失败时不要气馁，有时，沉船也是一种抵达。」
desc_en: "Don't be depressed when you fail. Sometimes, a ship sinking to the bottom is also a kind of arrival."

desc_chs: 「买了奖券也不一定能抽到奖，但是不买奖券永远都抽不到！」
desc_en: "You won't win a prize just because you bought a ticket, but you'll never win a prize if you never buy a ticket!"

desc_chs: 「别寻找什么捷径了，说不定去捷径的路口现在都已站满了人。」
desc_en: "Don't look for shortcuts, after all, the shortcut might already be clogged with hordes of people who've already found it."

desc_chs: 「不要后悔，也不要后悔后悔，更不能后悔后悔后悔。」
desc_en: "Don't regret, or regret regretting, and definitely don't ever regret regretting regret."

desc_chs: 「生命的意义在于思考，工作的意义在于放弃生命。」
desc_en: "The meaning of life is thinking, and the meaning of working is in giving up on life."

desc_chs: 「能轻易获得的幸运不会带来长久的快乐。」
desc_en: "Luck that is easily obtained will not bring long-term happiness."

desc_chs: 「当你觉得现状够糟时要保持警惕，因为事态往往还能变得更糟。」
desc_en: "Just when you think it can't get any worse, you must be alert, for things can always get worse."

desc_chs: 「要相信怀疑的力量。」
desc_en: "Believe in the power of skepticism."

desc_chs: 「倒霉的日子会结束的。当你习惯了倒霉，它就不存在了。」
desc_en: "Misfortune will always come to an end. Once you are used to it, it ceases to be misfortune."

desc_chs: 「遇到障碍也别退缩，先来一份福利餐。障碍不会因此消失，但至少你填饱了肚子。」
desc_en: "Don't retreat if you encounter obstacles. First, have a Welfare Meal. The obstacle won't disappear, but at least you've got a full stomach now."

desc_chs: 「没自由的人不伤心。」
desc_en: "Those with no freedom cannot be sad."

desc_chs: 「请不要觉得自己一无所有，你还有这份美味的大餐呢！」
desc_en: "You shouldn't feel like you've got nothing. After all, you've got this delicious meal!"

desc_chs: 「就算骗骗花将自己伪装成甜甜花，聪明的狐狸也不会受诈。」
desc_en: "Even if Whopperflowers disguise themselves as Sweet Flowers, the smart fox will not be fooled."

desc_chs: 「保持身体健康的小妙方：不要生病。」
desc_en: "The secret to staying healthy: Don't get sick."

desc_chs: 「甜甜的日落果，也会从高高的枝头掉落。这就是成熟的结果。」
desc_en: "Even the sweetest Sunsettias fall from high branches. This is the result of maturity."

desc_chs: 「不要相信写在小纸条上的格言。」
desc_en: "Don't believe maxims written on slips of paper."

desc_chs: 「有些时候，幸福就像是幽光星星，只有在黑暗中才能看得清。」
desc_en: "Sometimes, happiness is like a Lumitoile. It can only be seen clearly when it is darkest."

desc_chs: 「生活不是游戏。」
desc_en: "Life is not a game."

desc_chs: 「很多时候，两小步胜过一大步。」
desc_en: "Often, two small steps is better than one big step."

desc_chs: 「别担心，一切都会好起来的！至少他们是这样让我写的。」
desc_en: "Don't worry, everything will get better! At least, that's what they asked me to write!"

desc_chs: 「幸运不在这里而在别处。」
desc_en: "Luck is not here, but elsewhere."

desc_chs: 「我只是一张幸运签，不能为你遇到的困难提供解答。你得靠自己振作起来。」
desc_en: "I'm just a Fortune Slip, and cannot provide the answers to the difficulties you encounter. You must rely on yourself to overcome."

desc_chs: 「挫折也许会给人经验，但绝不会给人特许券！」
desc_en: "Setbacks may give you experience, but they won't give you Credit Coupons!"

desc_chs: 「再来一份！（开玩笑的）」
desc_en: "Okay, have another! (Just kidding)"

desc_chs: 从神秘机器中取得的神秘核心。\n虽然看起来是齿轮，但实际上却是齿轮造型的核心，真的很神秘。
desc_en: A mysterious core taken from a mysterious machine.\nAlthough it appears to be a gear, it is in fact a gear-shaped core — very mysterious indeed.

desc_chs: 非常古老的法螺容器，似乎能够追溯到更加古老的文明时期。
desc_en: An ancient conch container, and it can perhaps be traced back to an even older civilization.

desc_chs: 尚未进行加工和锻打的工件。
desc_en: A widget that has neither been processed nor forged.

desc_chs: 已经在生产区加工完成的工件。
desc_en: A widget that has been processed within the production zone.

desc_chs: (test)往期黑拳冠军的教练使用过的器材包，里面有各种各样奇怪的小东西。等等，灯柱也能用作训练吗？
以教练身份参加「拳力斗技」娱乐赛，指导格内薇芙和布瓦列特夺得冠军后赢得的奖杯。以美观的金属制成，在特定的光照条件下，呈现出摩拉般华丽的色泽。\n拥有这座特殊的奖杯，就能在特定的机器上无限兑换清爽的枫达，尽情畅饮，成为世界最满足的饮品享受者…
desc_en: A trophy awarded for taking part in the Pankration recreational tournament as a coach, and guiding Genevieve and Poiret to victory in the championship. Made from classy-looking metal, under the right lighting, it gleams like shining Mora.\nWith this special trophy, you can get unlimited refills of refreshing Fonta at designated machines, drinking to your heart's content, and become the most satisfied enjoyer of fine drinks in the world...

desc_chs: 从水中取得的打孔纸带，其中记录的数据似乎需要专门的仪器才能解读。\n虽说是用特殊的防水材料制成，不至于因为浸水而损毁，但由于泡在水里太久的缘故，即使被捞上岸，摸起来依然湿漉漉的…
desc_en: Punched tape retrieved from the water. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.\nAlthough it was made from a special waterproof material and has thus not yet been destroyed, it has been in there long enough to still feel rather wet even after being hauled out...

desc_chs: 看似普通的正齿轮。原本属于「二号初始能力样机」，似乎由于某种强大的外力而意外与本体分离…
desc_en: A seemingly ordinary spur gear. It originally belonged to "Initial Skill Sample No. 2," but it seems to have been split from the main body by an immense external force...

看起来像摩拉的糖果。糖果本身苦涩又甜蜜，是小孩欣赏不了的大人的味道。但是金色的包装纸在孩童之间很受欢迎。
desc_en: Candy that looks like Mora. The candy itself is bittersweet, an adult flavor that kids have a hard time appreciating. But the golden wrapping paper is incredibly popular with children.

desc_chs: 用途多多的良质木板。放在衣服里可以阻挡一次致命的攻击，平时也可用它练习武术。
desc_en: A high-quality wooden plank with numerous uses. Place it under your clothes to block a potentially fatal attack, or use it for practicing martial arts.

desc_chs: 不朽的名作，幻之第八卷。
desc_en: The eighth part of this timeless classic.

desc_chs: 因故割爱转卖的秘典之盒。限时随赠《七圣召唤：从入门到决斗之巅》。
desc_en: A cherished Casket of Tomes that its owner has been forced to part with for reasons unknown. For a limited time, comes with a copy of "Genius Invokation TCG: From Novice to the Summoners' Summit."

desc_chs: 风靡稻妻的偶像海报，装饰房间的不二选择。与可爱玩偶同时购入享受折扣优惠。
desc_en: An extremely popular Inazuman idol poster, it is one of the best options of decorating a room. Discounts available if purchased together with Cute Dolls.

desc_chs: 罗西莫夫认证！硬汉也爱不释手的可爱玩偶！与偶像海报同时购入享受折扣优惠。
desc_en: Certified by Roussimoff! Even the manliest man can't bear to part with such an adorable doll! Discounts available if purchased together with Idol Posters.

desc_chs: 神秘的捕兽夹。放上特许券，可以用来诱捕贪婪之人。
desc_en: A mysterious trap for beasts. Place Credit Coupons on it, and it can lure in the greedy.

desc_chs: 让人复活的美味！只要吃下它，就能抵消一天的厄运。
desc_en: A delectable taste that could revive the dead! If you eat it, it can counteract an entire day's worth of misfortunes.

desc_chs: 具有激发潜在智慧的功效。独特的风味献给独特的你。
desc_en: They have the mysterious effect of awakening the latent wisdom sleeping within. A unique flavor for a unique you!

desc_chs: 整箱出售的「纯洁之水」。曾有人喝了半箱，拿下了当期「拳力斗技」的冠军。若要喝下整箱，需要超越冠军的勇气，以及强大的肠胃。
desc_en: "Pure Water" sold by the case. Once, someone drank half a case and became the champion of the next Pankration tournament. To drink an entire case, you must have bravery surpassing that of a champion, and an even stronger digestive system.

desc_chs: 特殊口味的枫达，据说以稻妻的「绯樱绣球」为原料制作而出。在制作时，为了突出绯樱的味道而特意压低了糖的用量，但据试饮者反映，所谓的「绯樱味」更接近于刚除过草后的草坪所散发的气味。
desc_en: Specially flavored Fonta, said to use Inazuman Sakura Blooms as an ingredient. During its manufacture, the amount of sugar was reduced in order to avoid overwhelming the sakura flavor, but consumer feedback indicates that the so-called "sakura flavor" is more like the smell of a freshly-mown lawn.

desc_chs: 特殊口味的枫达，据说在制作时采用了许多「赤色水果」作为原料，具有鲜艳诱人的颜色和层次丰富的口感。但不知道出于何种原因，这种枫达对肠胃具有极高刺激性，在弄清其中原因之前，这款枫达是暂时无法全面推广了…
desc_en: Specially flavored Fonta, said to use many different "red-colored fruits" as ingredients. It has a very enticing crimson color and layered flavor profile. But for reasons unknown, this flavor of Fonta is severely irritating to the bowels, and until the underlying reason is discovered, large-scale promotion of this type of Fonta has been suspended...

desc_chs: 风味浓郁的料理。将羊的内脏剁碎与燕麦一同塞入羊胃中，再加上各种调味香料，制成袋装，装盘时往往会去掉胃袋，仅取内容物和萝卜泥、土豆泥一并食用。是一道极具地方特色的佳肴，枫丹人常将其作为招待贵客的菜品。
desc_en: A dish with strong and distinctive flavors. Chop up the sheep offal, mix it with oatmeal, and stuff the mixture into a sheep stomach along with various seasonings and spices. When the dish is served, the stomach-bag is usually removed while the fillings are served with radish paste and mashed potatoes. This is a local specialty that Fontainians often cook as a treat for important guests.

desc_chs: 沁凉的甜点。身为枫丹的代表性甜点，制作方法却十分简单省力，只要食材比例得当几乎不会失败。细腻之余还带有一丝冰凉的口感，能让人瞬间打起精神。
desc_en: A refreshing dessert. Though it is one of Fontaine's trademark desserts, its recipe is very simple and straightforward. As long as the proportion of ingredients is right, hardly anyone could fail at making this dessert. It has an exquisite texture with a touch of refreshing cold taste, and can instantly lift your spirits.

desc_chs: 脆皮包裹的肉料理。先微微煎香肋排的表面，再刷酱裹上调制好的脆皮，最后用低温慢烤。严格的火候控制使得表皮焦脆，同时肉嫩多汁。
desc_en: A crispy meat dish. Lightly fry the surface of the ribs until they exude a faint aroma, then wrap the crispy exterior with sauce, and finally, grill them slowly on low heat. The meticulous temperature control ensures that the exterior is perfectly crisp, while the meat within is kept juicy and tender.

desc_chs: 油煎而成的大块鱼肉。先用黄油将鱼排煎熟，再将杏仁煎脆后一起摆盘。传统的做法是整条鳟鱼处理好后直接下油锅，但近期也流行起了选用鱼排煎制的做法。
desc_en: Fish fillets of a satisfying size, fried with butter before serving with a side of crispy fried almonds. According to the traditional recipe for this dish, a whole readied trout would be placed into the frying pan, but a new, fillet-featuring recipe for this dish has been gaining popularity recently as well.

desc_chs: 不知为何落在路边的禽肉。推测来自某些遭遇意外的飞禽。
desc_en: Fowl found by the side of the road. It might be from some birds who were victims of foul play.

desc_chs: 为了帮助林尼制作魔术口袋而采摘的海露花，据说这一带海露花的植物纤维含量丰富，能制作出很好的魔术口袋。
desc_en: Romaritime Flowers plucked to help Lyney make magic pockets. It is said the Romaritime Flowers growing in this area are rich in fiber, and thus are great for making quality magic pockets.

desc_chs: 其中的元素力似乎出现过不受公子控制的情况。离开主人的它现在显得黯淡无光。
desc_en: It appears as if Childe lost control of the Elemental Power within it before. The Vision has lost its glow now that its owner has left it behind.

desc_chs: 为了应对「预言危机」，多制作一些魔术口袋总归是好事。这满满一袋材料是你和林尼还有菲米尼等人满满的心意。
desc_en: In order to cope with the "prophecy crisis," it can't hurt to make more magic pockets. This bag full of materials is a sincere gesture of goodwill from you, Lyney, Freminet, and everybody else.

desc_chs: 有着林尼风格的魔术道具，不仅能成为魔术表演的助力，还具备极强的收纳能力，帮助枫丹的人们应对「预言危机」。
desc_en: A Lyney-style magic item that can not only be extremely useful for magic shows, but also has powerful storage capabilities to help the people of Fontaine cope with the "prophecy crisis."

desc_chs: 芙佳遗失在矿脉深处的「信物」，快点还给她吧！
desc_en: Puca's token, which she lost in the depths of the mine. Hurry up and return it to her!

desc_chs: 自神秘空间中取得的古老纸张，似乎可证明那并非梦境…
desc_en: An old page obtained in the mysterious space. It should be able to prove that what transpired wasn't a dream...

desc_chs: 托萝莎分享的探案笔记，记录着亚瑟先生失踪案的相关信息。
desc_en: These investigation notes shared by Talochard contain information on the missing Sir Arthur.

desc_chs: 常见的通用手轮，用以控制梅洛彼得堡周遭水域的管道调节阀。
desc_en: A common handwheel, used to adjust regulating valves on the pipes around the Fortress of Meropide.

desc_chs: 常见的通用手轮，用以控制「奎瑟尔的发条工坊」的管道调节阀。
desc_en: A common handwheel, used to adjust regulating valves on the pipes in Kuisel's Clockwork Workshop.

desc_chs: 常见的通用手轮，用以控制「布拉维的锻压工坊」的管道调节阀。
desc_en: A common handwheel, used to adjust regulating valves on the pipes in Bravais' Press Works.

desc_chs: 从水下搜集的彩色小玩意，用来制作特尔克西的武器。
desc_en: A colorful gizmo retrieved from the water. Will be used to make Thelxie's weapon.

desc_chs: 从水下搜集的彩色小玩意，用来制作特尔克西的王冠。
desc_en: A colorful gizmo retrieved from the water. Will be used to make Thelxie's crown.

desc_chs: 用特殊的防水材料制成的打孔纸带，其中记录的数据似乎需要专门的仪器才能解读。
desc_en: Punched tape made out of a special waterproof material. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

desc_chs: 从枫丹科学院附近的高塔中回收的打孔纸带，其中记录的数据似乎需要专门的仪器才能解读。
desc_en: Punched tape retrieved from the tower near the Fontaine Research Institute. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

desc_chs: 原本是常见的发条机芯部件，不知被何人添配了高密度材料制成的储能圈。\n说不定只靠这一枚元件，便能为整台机体提供充足的能源…
desc_en: It was once an ordinary moving clockwork component but someone added an energy storage ring made from high-density materials.\nPerhaps just this single component is capable of powering the entire machine...

desc_en: A record of the exclusive interview that the renowned reporter from the Steambird, Charlotte, had with the golden-haired Traveler. After various reorganizations and revisions of the information within, it is now fully able to take on various functions apart from "being published in the papers."

desc_en: A condenser component once installed on the Arkhium Inhibitor. According to Raimondo, after they are all reinstalled, the inhibitor can be restarted.

desc_chs: 由克洛妮艾私自印制的「特别报告」，据说上面的文章记载了所有枫丹科学院想要隐藏的「真相」…
desc_en: A special report privately printed by Chronie. It is said that the contents record the "truth" that the Fontaine Research Institute wishes to hide...

desc_chs: 记录着你们在梅洛彼得堡调查出的诸多线索。
desc_en: Records the various clues you found during your investigation in the Fortress of Meropide.

desc_en: A tourism guidebook introducing charming scenic spots recommended by locals.
