desc_chs: 透明的小瓶，瓶中装着背面画有古怪图案的纸条，简要记录了某个叫弗里曼的人的事迹。根据纸条的指引你找到了此人留下的宝藏。
desc_en: A clear bottle with a note that contains the writings of someone named Freeman and a strange drawing on the back. You followed the clues on the paper and found the treasure they left behind.

desc_chs: 由八条留言拼合而成的纸张，留言背面的破碎图案原来是一朵完整的虹彩蔷薇。
desc_en: A piece of paper formed by putting the eight notes together. The strange drawing turns out to be a complete Rainbow Rose.

desc_chs: 无情攻击了沙尔梅小姐腰部的卷宗箱。放在进门左边的桌上。用袋子装着的话，也许会方便搬运一些吧…
desc_en: A file box that ruthlessly attacked Ms. Chalmet's back. It was placed on the table on the left-hand side of the entrance. It would probably be easier to move if it was placed inside a bag...

desc_chs: 无情攻击了沙尔梅小姐腰部的卷宗箱。放在进门右边的桌上。用袋子装着的话，也许会方便搬运一些吧…
desc_en: A file box that ruthlessly attacked Ms. Chalmet's back. It was placed on the table on the right-hand side of the entrance. It would probably be easier to move if it was placed inside a bag...

desc_chs: 从热情的互助会成员手上拿到的宣传册，里面记录了互助会的基本理念。封面的互助会标志看着有些眼熟…
desc_en: A pamphlet given out by a very enthusiastic member of the Mutual Aid Network. It contains the basic principles of the Network. The logo on the cover looks a bit familiar...

desc_chs: 刚采摘下的绝云椒椒，色泽鲜红。是迪奥娜想要用来调酒的材料。
desc_en: A freshly-picked Jueyun Chili with a brilliant red coloration. This is what Diona wishes to use in her latest cocktail concoction.

desc_chs: 颜色鲜艳，口感甜美的果实，与其他食物进行搭配的话，能组成一顿不错的野餐。
desc_en: Brightly colored fruit with a sweet texture. An exceptionally fine picnic can be prepared by pairing it with other foods.

name_chs: 满载的「拳力斗技」枫达奖杯
desc_chs: 装满枫达的「拳力斗技」娱乐赛冠军奖杯。\n静置之时，能够听见「滋滋」声，与「铁锅中的肉排迸发出热油与汁水」时的动静有几分相仿，令人一听就食欲大开。\n不过，这个奖杯的尺寸实属不凡，很少有人能一口气把里边的枫达全部喝完。就算硬着头皮做到了，多半也会撑得像只膨膨兽，甚至被送去就医…
desc_en: The trophy for the Pankration recreational tournament, filled completely with Fonta.\nEven after being set down, a bubbling sound can be heard, a bit like the sound of "hot oil and juices in a pot of meat," making anyone who hears it hanker for food.\nHowever, the size of the trophy is in a category all its own, and few could swallow the contents in a single swig. Even if you forced yourself to manage the feat, you'd probably bloat up like a Blubberbeast and might even end up hospitalized...
effect_desc_chs: 清爽枫达，畅饮世界！

desc_chs: 安里制造出来的「实验饮品」。富有很多气泡，入口时带着一丝丝咸味。\n但总体来说，还是保持着枫达的原味…至少你知道自己喝的还是枫达。
desc_en: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. It is filled with fizzy bubbles, and has a slightly salty flavor...\nBut overall, it still maintains a bit of the orginal Fonta flavor... at least you know what you are drinking is still Fonta.

desc_chs: 安里制造出来的「实验饮品」。富有很多气泡，还能品出一丝咸味的茶水？\n喝起来感觉这瓶饮料更像是一瓶「咸味气泡茶」，而不是枫达。
desc_en: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. It is filled with fizzy bubbles, and you can even taste a bit of a slightly salty tea flavor?\nThis drink feels more like a bottle of "Salty Carbonated Tea," and not Fonta.

desc_chs: 安里制造出来的「实验饮品」。没有任何气泡，咸味有些突出的枫达。\n无论如何，它至少还算是枫达。
desc_en: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. This Fonta has no bubbles whatsoever, and the saltiness is quite prominent.\nAt the very least, it still counts as Fonta.

desc_chs: 安里制造出来的「实验饮品」。没有任何气泡，带着些许咸味的茶水。\n好吧，它更像是一瓶单纯的茶水了。
desc_en: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. It has no bubbles whatsoever, and is a bit like slightly salty tea.\nOkay, it's basically like a plain old bottle of tea.

desc_chs: 安里制造出来的「实验饮品」。清爽枫达，畅饮世界！经典的枫达，啊哈！\n呃…但造出一瓶经典枫达，似乎没什么意义。
desc_en: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. Refreshing Fonta, a font of refreshment! Classic Fonta, aha!\nUh... but just making a bottle of classic Fonta is pretty meaningless.

desc_chs: 安里制造出来的「实验饮品」。富有很多气泡的「甜味气泡茶」。喝起来…感觉还不错？
desc_en: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. A "sweet bubbly tea" bursting with bubbles. It tastes... not all that bad?

desc_chs: 安里制造出来的「实验饮品」。清爽…嘿！这瓶枫达没气泡，谁把盖子拧开没喝完？
desc_en: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. Refreshing Fonta, a font of— what!? This bottle's gone flat, who took off the cap and didn't finish drinking it!?

desc_chs: 安里制造出来的「实验饮品」。没有任何气泡的「甜味气泡茶」。我…我能直接去喝一杯茶吗？
desc_en: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. A "sweet bubbly tea" completely bereft of bubbles. Can... Can I just have a cup of tea instead?

desc_chs: 勇猛奋斗日记（一）
desc_en: Diary of a Valiant Struggle (I)

desc_chs: 勇猛奋斗日记（二）
desc_en: Diary of a Valiant Struggle (II)

desc_chs: 勇猛奋斗日记（三）
desc_en: Diary of a Valiant Struggle (III)

desc_chs: 勇猛奋斗日记（四）
desc_en: Diary of a Valiant Struggle (IV)

desc_chs: 记录了一位奋斗者的人生感悟。\n「一刀把那傻鸟捅个对穿，这样总能好好警告一下他们吧？」
desc_en: A record of the life experiences of a striver.\n"Knife those stupid birds straight through! This should be a good enough warning for them, right?"

desc_chs: 在「学术会堂」拍摄的画片。不知道艾尤恩会用在哪里…
desc_en: A photo taken in the Academic Assembly Hall. Who knows how Iaune will use it...

desc_chs: 丽莎以特别游戏「嘟嘟可轰轰奇遇记」为原型所写的童话书，记载了火花骑士、嘟嘟可、特别蹦蹦、荣誉骑士和白色小帮手一同冒险，战胜角角鱼们的故事…
desc_en: A fairy tale that Lisa wrote based on the special game "Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure," featuring the Spark Knight, Dodoco, special Jumpy Dumpties, the Honorary Knight, and their white-colored helper in their victory over the fishies...

desc_chs: 丽莎以特别游戏「嘟嘟可轰轰奇遇记」为原型所写的童话书，记载了火花骑士、嘟嘟可、特别蹦蹦、荣誉骑士和白色小帮手一同冒险，战胜角角鱼们的故事…
desc_en: A fairy tale that Lisa wrote based on the special game "Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure," featuring the Spark Knight, Dodoco, special Jumpy Dumpties, the Honorary Knight, and their white-colored helper in their victory over the fishies...

desc_chs: 在「破烂骨头商店」获得的帽子，虽然并非求助者丢失的那顶帽子，但应该也能应对现在的情况。
desc_en: A hat obtained from the Rag and Bone Shop. Though it isn't the same hat that was lost, it should be sufficient to handle the situation at hand.

desc_chs: 粗细适中，通体干燥的木柴，适合用来生火。
desc_en: Dry firewood of moderate thickness, excellent for firemaking.

desc_chs: 特殊的钥匙，或许能用在某处。
desc_en: A special key, perhaps it can be used in a certain place.

desc_chs: 特殊的钥匙，或许能用在某处。
desc_en: A special key, perhaps it can be used in a certain place.

desc_chs: 特殊的钥匙，或许能用在某处。
desc_en: A special key, perhaps it can be used in a certain place.

desc_chs: 特殊的钥匙，或许能用在某处。
desc_en: A special key, perhaps it can be used in a certain place.

name_chs: 枫丹动能工程科学研究院奖励状
name_en: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Certificate

name_chs: 枫丹动能工程科学研究院奖励状
name_en: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Certificate

desc_chs: 如雨滴般的宝石，又仿佛某人的泪水。
desc_en: A gem like a raindrop, or perhaps like someone's falling tear.

desc_chs: 一封信件，摆放在两个泡泡桔旁边。
desc_en: A letter, placed betwixt two Bulle Fruit.

desc_chs: 一本只有三页的童话书，描绘了一名战胜孤独的王子的幻想故事。\n「给身处困境的人们」——封底上的小字。
desc_en: A children's fantasy book containing only three pages, it tells the story of a prince who overcomes loneliness.\nIt reads "For anyone in a tough spot" in small print on the back cover.

desc_chs: 安里遗落的资料。不知道他能从中得到什么启发…
desc_en: Heinry's lost materials. Who knows what kind of inspiration he'll get from them...

desc_chs: 安里遗落的资料。不知道他能从中得到什么启发…
desc_en: Heinry's lost materials. Who knows what kind of inspiration he'll get from them...

desc_chs: 安里遗落的资料。不知道他能从中得到什么启发…
desc_en: Heinry's lost materials. Who knows what kind of inspiration he'll get from them...

desc_chs: 色泽各异的贝壳与珊瑚，据说是水妖们最为珍视的瑰宝，正是它们搭起了照耀水妖王国的水中彩虹之桥…
desc_en: Shells and corals of all different hues and colors. Said to be the greatest treasure of the Water Imps, and the very reason they built the shining Rainbow Bridge in the Kingdom of Water Imps...

desc_chs: 奥蕾丽的笔记其一
desc_en: Aurelie's Notes (I)

desc_chs: 海妮耶赠送的精巧礼盒，其中装有蕈兽们喜爱的「妙妙琼脂」，琼脂被分成了多种独特的口味，可以根据蕈兽个体的喜好来投喂。\n随着对蕈兽伙伴们的了解，以及制作经验的不断积累，海妮耶对「妙妙琼脂」口味的把握已堪称完美。改良后的妙妙琼脂不仅能为蕈兽伙伴们提供充足的养分，还融入了枫丹食物的特色，有了更新奇的口味，能让蕈兽伙伴们吃得开心，健康生活！
desc_en: An exquisite gift box from Haniyyah, the jellies within are loved by Fungi. There are many unique flavors, so Fungi with different preferences can be fed separately.\nWith a better understanding of the Fungi and her accumulated experience, Haniyyah has mastered the flavors of the Marvelous Jelly. The improved version is not only more nutritious, but also contains special Fontainian flavors. The healthy jellies allow the Fungi to eat well and live well!

name_en: Spina di Rosula Uniform Gift Box
desc_chs: 娜维娅为阿黛尔准备的礼物，装有刺玫会的制服。虽然尺寸对于现在的阿黛尔来说大了不少，但作为承诺的话，正正好好。
desc_en: Navia prepared this gift, which contains a Spina di Rosula uniform, for Adele. The dimensions are a bit large for Adele at present, but it works just fine for a promise.

desc_chs: 从被打倒的罗默夫一派的成员身上搜到的钥匙，似乎这就是用来紧急制动炸药的道具。
desc_en: A key you got from a member of Romeuf's gang. This seems to be the tool required to quickly stop the explosives.

desc_chs: 推荐信
desc_en: Recommendation Letter

desc_chs: 被落在此处的钥匙，它要开启的是哪一把锁呢？
desc_en: Someone must have dropped this here. Just what lock does it open?

desc_chs: 标识着主人身份的徽记。既然被落在这种地方却许久没有被找回，看来主人并不在意它。
desc_en: An insignia that marks the owner's identity. If it's been left here and no one thought to look for it for a long time, perhaps the owner didn't care about it very much.

desc_chs: 铸造水仙十字圣剑必须的架空物质之一，几乎感觉不到任何重量。
desc_en: One of the fabricated materials necessary to forge the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz. It feels almost weightless.

desc_chs: 一枚老旧的怀表。\n时间在某刻停住，美好的回忆也成为永远。
desc_en: An old pocket watch.\nIt seems to have stopped at a certain instant, the beautiful memory of a moment becoming eternal.

desc_chs: 强大的理性与意志凭依的圣剑，足以创造、毁灭一个宇宙或一场梦。
desc_en: A sacred blade indwelt with great enough reason and will to create and destroy a universe, or a dream.

desc_chs: 古茶树上取下的一根枝条，似乎能够感受到微弱的仙力气息…
desc_en: A branch taken from an ancient tea tree. It emits a faint adeptal energy...

desc_chs: 奥蕾丽的笔记其二
desc_en: Aurelie's Notes (II)

desc_chs: 一张由梅洛彼得堡开具的出门证。虽说只是一张纸，却被冠以一个鼓舞人心的名字。
desc_en: An exit card issued by the Fortress of Meropide. It's just a piece of paper, but it has been given a name most heartening.

desc_chs: （test）废弃
水仙十字结社为这座塔设计的钥匙之一。最终拼合会是一个三圈半的奇怪形状，对此有特别的解释。\n最内圈是亥珀波瑞亚之轮，象征世界被冰封的阶段与失去的乐园。
desc_en: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.\nThe innermost circle is the Cycle of Hyperborea, symbolizing the age when the world was frozen and the lost paradise.

desc_chs: 水仙十字结社为这座塔设计的钥匙之一。最终拼合会是一个三圈半的奇怪形状，对此有特别的解释。\n中间一圈是纳塔兰提亚之轮，象征战胜恶龙。这是人类战胜自然与人性战胜自己兽性的隐喻。
desc_en: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.\nThe middle circle is the Cycle of Natlantea, symbolizing the triumph over the evil dragon, a metaphor for humanity's victory over nature as well as the beasts within themselves.

desc_chs: 水仙十字结社为这座塔设计的钥匙之一。最终拼合会是一个三圈半的奇怪形状，对此有特别的解释。\n第三圈与最外半圈是雷穆利亚与克劳雅利亚之轮。象征人和神的关系。
desc_en: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.\nThe third circle and outermost half circle are the Cycles of Remuria and Khraun-Arya, symbolizing the relationship between humans and gods.

desc_chs: 用来开启安装在破碎舰船上铁栅栏的钥匙之一。
desc_en: One of the keys that opens the iron barrier on the shattered vessel.

desc_chs: 用来开启安装在破碎舰船上铁栅栏的钥匙之一。
desc_en: One of the keys that opens the iron barrier on the shattered vessel.

desc_chs: 用来开启安装在破碎舰船上铁栅栏的钥匙之一。
desc_en: One of the keys that opens the iron barrier on the shattered vessel.

desc_chs: (test)机器人NPC头像
(test)欧芙NPC头像
(test)流浪汉NPC头像
(test)小孩NPC头像
(test)枫丹下线NPC头像
(test)流浪汉NPC头像
(test)落落莓NPC头像
(test)成年男子和女子的合影

在「荒泷甲光烈烈斗虫大修行」中，协助「真剑斗虫大鬼王」提升实力，探寻新的斗虫之道后，从久岐忍那里得到的谢礼…\n结实而轻巧的箱体中装有蒸干后的拉面面饼、纸袋密封的调料和格外坚硬的碗筷。按照附带的说明，只需在碗内放入面饼和调料，倒入热水，就能快速冲泡出一碗味道还算不错的拉面，相当便捷。\n不过，根据箱子里久岐忍的留言，她和荒泷一斗乘船来璃月参加聚会的途中并没吃上这种食物——当时他们只携带了一些饼干和腌菜。在璃月游玩期间，久岐忍受到一些璃月面食的启发，尝试制作了这种新工艺的拉面，以便「鬼王的左膀右臂」和「破空白铁小堇瓜」在旅行中用风味不错的料理快速充饥…
desc_en: A gift from Kuki Shinobu after helping the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King power up and find new ways in Beetle Battle in Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp. \nDried ramen blocks are placed in a sturdy yet light box, with sealed condiments, exceptionally rigid utensils, and a bowl. Put the ramen and the condiments in the bowl, then pour in hot water to quickly make a bowl of ramen that doesn't taste too bad at all. Convenient, isn't it? \nBut according to the letter that Kuki Shinobu left in the box, neither she nor Arataki Itto got to eat this during their journey on the water to Liyue, because they only brought cookies and pickles. During their stay in Liyue, Kuki Shinobu was inspired by the wheaten foods there, and created this instant ramen so that Oni King's Right Hand and Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon could fight off their hunger during their travels...

desc_chs: 一截闪烁着幽碧光泽的枝桠，似乎与幽林雾道存在神秘的联系。\n仔细观察，枝桠内部似乎有什么在流动着。
desc_en: A branch that glimmers with a jade-green light. It seems to have some kind of mysterious connection with the Foggy Forest Path.\nUpon closer inspection, it appears as though something is flowing within the branch.

desc_chs: 何人曾珍视的盛放野花。除了它所遗落的地点，并不具有什么特别之处。\n小小的感激与怀念或许是继续前进的关键。
desc_en: Wild flowers in bloom that were once cherished by someone. There is little special about it, unless that be the place where it fell.\nA little gratitude and remembrance may be the key to moving forward.

desc_chs: 尤维尔遗失的三脚架，干燥之后应该还能继续使用。
desc_en: Urville's lost tripod. It should be usable once it is dried.

desc_chs: 一枚小小的齿轮，看起来并没有特殊之处。
desc_en: A small gear. It seems very ordinary indeed.

desc_chs: 美丽的海螺，纳蒂亚对它格外中意。
desc_en: A beautiful conch. Nadia loves it a lot.

desc_chs: 尤维尔遗失的潜水套装，似乎有些损伤。
desc_en: Urville's lost diving equipment. It seems to have been damaged a bit.

desc_chs: 常见的钱袋，里面塞满了摩拉。
desc_en: A commonly-seen coin pouch filled with Mora.

desc_chs: （test）锈舵酒吧菜单
奇怪的留言
desc_en: Strange Message

desc_chs: 从黄三爷那里得到的钥匙，似乎有些生锈了…
desc_en: A rusted key obtained from Huang the Third.

desc_chs: 根据黄三爷所说，昔日古华宗师传授武艺之时，收取的报酬并非是摩拉，而是稻米和咸肉。基于这一点，派蒙将全部心意（以及随身携带的全部食盐）灌注在了这道特制料理中…
desc_en: According to Huang the Third, when Grand Master Guhua passed on his techniques, he would accept rice and salted meat as payment instead of Mora. Based on this anecdote, Paimon put all her heart (and salt) into this super special dish...

desc_chs: 从斡流处拿到的报酬。里面装着一笔能让各方都满意的摩拉。
desc_en: The compensation you received from Woliu. It contains a sum of Mora satisfactory to both parties.

desc_chs: 装有钻探装置的盒子。不知道这个装置究竟能钻探到什么东西…
desc_en: A box that contains a drilling device. Who knows what it'll dig up, exactly...

desc_chs: 白棠珍奇屋出售的音乐玩具，极受儿童欢迎。这一件似乎买了很久，已经不是店内的最新款式了。\n礼物是用来送人的，如果它不能前往原本该去的地方，至少让它停留在懂得珍惜的人身边。
desc_en: A musical toy sold at Bertin's House of Curiosities. It is very popular among children. This one appears to have been bought a long while back and is no longer the latest model available in the store.\nPresents are for sending to people, and if they cannot be sent to their original destination, then let them at least be left with one who will treasure them.

desc_chs: 击败格外强劲的原海异种后，从其体内取得的大颗结晶。\n其中蕴含着比普通异色结晶石更神秘的能量。\n或许有人愿意为它开出合适的价码。
desc_en: A large crystal obtained by defeating extremely powerful Fontemer Aberrants.\nThe power it contains is more mysterious than common Xenochromatic Crystals.\nMaybe someone will be willing to pay the right price for it.

desc_chs: 委托人伯努瓦·勒鲁瓦填写的说明表，地址栏处热心地附上了地图。
desc_en: Instructions filled in by Benoit Leroy. A map has been kindly appended to the address.

desc_chs: 破损的纸片，看起来像是一张地图的右下角，上面还画着奇妙的点和线。
desc_en: A damaged piece of paper that looks like the bottom-right corner of a map. There are strange points and lines drawn on it.

desc_chs: 小小的钥匙，能夹在书中。它为什么没有被查抄没收，以及小小的它为什么能打开这么重要的门？
desc_en: A small key that can even be used as a bookmark. Why was it not confiscated? And why does such a tiny key open such an important door?

desc_chs: 原本镶嵌在金鲤雕像之上的灵珠，蕴含着浓厚的仙力。
desc_en: An orb that was inlaid on the Golden Carp Fish statue. It contains an immense amount of adeptal energy.

desc_chs: 在沉玉谷的遗迹中找到的遗迹守卫供能机关。其中残余的能量似乎还足以启动一台遗迹守卫。
desc_en: A power supply mechanism discovered in the ruins of Chenyu Vale. The residual energy within seems enough to activate one more Ruin Guard.

desc_chs: 萦绕着仙力的玉玦断片。在先民古老的传说中，所有的玉玦原本都来自同一块璞石——若是如此，不同的玉玦碎片或许也能拼合在一处…
desc_en: A jade fragment with adeptal energy lingering around it. In the legends told by the ancestral peoples, all jades originally came from the same stone. If that holds true, it might be possible to join the jade fragments together...

desc_chs: 萦绕着仙力的玉玦断片。在先民古老的传说中，所有的玉玦原本都来自同一块璞石——若是如此，不同的玉玦碎片或许也能拼合在一处…
desc_en: A jade fragment with adeptal energy lingering around it. In the legends told by the ancestral peoples, all jades originally came from the same stone. If that holds true, it might be possible to join the jade fragments together...

desc_chs: 雕刻精美的祭祀用香木，散发着淡淡的清香气味。从形制判断，似乎与另一块香木是配套的存在。
desc_en: An exquisitely carved piece of fragrant wood that is used in ceremonial rites and exudes a light fragrance. Judging from its shape, there seems to be another piece of fragrant wood to complement this one.

desc_chs: 雕刻精美的祭祀用香木，散发着淡淡的烧焦气味。从形制判断，似乎与另一块香木是配套的存在。
desc_en: An exquisitely carved piece of fragrant wood that is used in ceremonial rites and gives off the scent of something burnt. Judging from its shape, there seems to be another piece of fragrant wood to complement this one.

desc_chs: 收录了多张精彩作品的留影纪念册，令人意外的是，其中有一半作品都出自同一人之手。
desc_en: A commemorative photo album containing many marvelous pictures. Shockingly, over half were taken by the same person.

desc_chs: 在「褪色城堡」中拾得的古老音乐盒，似乎蕴藏着神奇的「乐章」力量。\n可以用来读取古代文明遗留下来的乐谱，设法找到更多的乐谱来解开旧日的秘密吧。
desc_en: An ancient music box found in the Faded Castle. It contains the mysterious power of the Symphony.\nUse it to read musical scores left by the ancient civilization. Find more scores to unlock the civilization's secrets.

desc_chs: 一把奇特的钥匙，不知道可以打开哪里的锁…
desc_en: A strange key. Who knows what lock it opens...

desc_chs: 似乎是古代文明使用未知材料所制造的曲谱。\n谱线之间空空如也，并未记录任何音符。
desc_en: This seems to be a musical score created using unknown materials by an ancient civilization.\nIts staves lie empty. No notes have ever been recorded here.

desc_chs: 似乎是古代文明使用未知材料所制造的曲谱。\n其上记录的旋律需要使用特殊的机关才能读取。
desc_en: This seems to be a musical score created using unknown materials by an ancient civilization.\nThe melody recorded within can only be deciphered using a special device.

desc_chs: 神出鬼没的魔导书，在「乐章」旋律的影响下终于安静下来了。\n有机会的话，或许可以把它放回到书柜里。
desc_en: A strange book of magic that has, by the "symphony"'s power, calmed down at last.\nIf you have the chance, you might want to return it to its shelf.

desc_chs: 特巡队员蒂蕾娜提供的光学设备，似乎应用了一般人难以理解的成像原理，配合「千步拦射角分间」的沙盘装置，就能模拟出使用铳枪打击敌人的情景。\n虽说为正式的队员提供训练时，这种装置还有诸多不足，但足以勾起人们对铳枪的兴趣，引导人们发掘自己的潜能，将射击的天赋运用在正义事业上。
desc_en: An optical array provided by Special Security and Surveillance Patrol member Turenna. It appears to use some hard-to-grasp imaging techniques in conjunction with the sand table device from the "Thousand-Pace Interdiction Arcminute Sharpshooting Zone" to simulate using a musket to shoot at one's foes.\nThough this is considered in many ways insufficient for actual Patrol members' training regimens, it is more than enough to drum up interest in muskets and musketry, in developing one's talents for such, and for using such gifts for good.

desc_chs: 本书又称《热恋中的赫雷贝里》，初版作者自称改编自坎瑞亚家喻户晓的传奇故事，但是世上已经没有人可以佐证这点了。现在已经是数代人的集体创作了。
desc_en: This text is also known as "Hleobranto Innamorato." The author of the first edition claims to have based this tale on a legendary story known throughout Khaenri'ah, but there are none left who can verify this. It is an anthological work produced over several generations at this point.

desc_chs: 本书又称《热恋中的赫雷贝里》，初版作者自称改编自坎瑞亚家喻户晓的传奇故事，但是世上已经没有人可以佐证这点了。现在已经是数代人的集体创作了。
desc_en: This text is also known as "Hleobranto Innamorato." The author of the first edition claims to have based this tale on a legendary story known throughout Khaenri'ah, but there are none left who can verify this. It is an anthological work produced over several generations at this point.

desc_chs: 在遗迹中意外发现的古雷穆利亚书卷，所述内容的真实性无从稽考。
desc_en: An ancient Remurian scroll you accidentally discovered in the ruins. There is no way to verify the truth of the words within.

desc_chs: 在遗迹中意外发现的古雷穆利亚书卷，所述内容的真实性无从稽考。
desc_en: An ancient Remurian scroll you accidentally discovered in the ruins. There is no way to verify the truth of the words within.

desc_chs: 在遗迹中意外发现的古雷穆利亚书卷，所述内容的真实性无从稽考。
desc_en: An ancient Remurian scroll you accidentally discovered in the ruins. There is no way to verify the truth of the words within.

desc_chs: 招工说明
desc_en: Recruitment Notice

desc_chs: 纸条阅读物
desc_en: Note, Readable

desc_chs: 布莱卡利杂货店收据
desc_en: Bracari's General Store Receipt

desc_chs: 古老的石碑
desc_en: Ancient Stone Tablet

desc_chs: 白棠珍奇屋出售的音乐玩具，极受儿童欢迎。这一件似乎买了很久，已经不是店内的最新款式了。\n叮咚的音乐声代替了所有没能说出口的话语在你掌中奏响，这件送不出的礼物已经被人放弃，它现在属于你了。
desc_en: A musical toy sold at Bertin's House of Curiosities. It is very popular among children. This one appears to have been bought a long while back and is no longer the latest model available in the store.\nThe chiming tune played in your palm takes the place of all the words that could not be said. This present, which could not be sent, has been forsaken, and is thus now yours.

desc_chs: 送报人皮普把勒鲁瓦一家人这阵子没有取走的报纸统统塞进了这个包裹。
desc_en: The newspaper deliveryperson, Pip, has stuffed the papers that the Leroy family has not collected during this time into this package.

name_chs: 「千织屋」——布料下看不见的黑暗
name_en: Chioriya Boutique - Darkness Disguised Behind a Facade of Fashion
desc_chs: （test）千织线报纸
在海底采集的幽光星星。造型美观，颜色瑰丽，应该可以用来作为衣服的装饰。
desc_en: A Lumitoile collected from the seafloor. The shape is stellar and the color charming. It should be usable as a clothing accessory.

desc_chs: （test）包了浆的核桃，看起来被盘了些许时日
不知何人遗落在沉玉谷野外的钥匙。究竟是用来做什么的呢…
desc_en: A key that seems to have been lost in the wilderness of Chenyu Vale. What could it be used for...?

desc_chs: 不知何人遗落在沉玉谷野外的钥匙。究竟是用来做什么的呢…
desc_en: A key that seems to have been lost in the wilderness of Chenyu Vale. What could it be used for...?

desc_chs: （test）王山厅盗宝团藏匿的宝箱钥匙三
增加一块可用于培育药材的区域。
desc_en: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

desc_chs: 增加一块可用于培育药材的区域。
desc_en: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

desc_chs: 增加一块可用于培育药材的区域。
desc_en: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

desc_chs: 增加一块可用于培育药材的区域。
desc_en: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

desc_chs: 增加一块可用于培育药材的区域。
desc_en: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

desc_chs: 增加一块可用于培育药材的区域。
desc_en: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

desc_chs: 改进炼金釜的性能，扩展炼制药剂时放置药材的区域大小。
desc_en: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

desc_chs: 改进炼金釜的性能，扩展炼制药剂时放置药材的区域大小。
desc_en: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

desc_chs: 改进炼金釜的性能，扩展炼制药剂时放置药材的区域大小。
desc_en: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

desc_chs: 改进炼金釜的性能，扩展炼制药剂时放置药材的区域大小。
desc_en: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

desc_chs: 棱角分明的药剂瓶体，如同方方正正的水滴，对于宝贵的炼金药剂而言，确实每一滴都不能浪费…\n可以略微提升药剂的品质，所有特殊瓶体提供的增益效果相同。
desc_en: A potion bottle with very distinctive angles, like a chiseled drop of water. When it comes to precious alchemical potions, not a single drop may be wasted...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

desc_chs: 高脚设计的药剂瓶体，采用了心形的设计，据说无论装着什么颜色的药剂，都能给顾客带来愉快的观感…\n可以略微提升药剂的品质，所有特殊瓶体提供的增益效果相同。
desc_en: A potion bottle with a tall stem with a heart-shaped design. It is said that customers will find it aesthetically appealing no matter the color of the potion within...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

desc_chs: 设计巧妙的药剂瓶体，采用了长瓶颈的独特设计，据说这种瓶型被设计师比作「宁静的水湾」…\n可以略微提升药剂的品质，所有特殊瓶体提供的增益效果相同。
desc_en: A cleverly crafted bottle with a unique long neck design. They say that the designer of the bottle compared it to a "tranquil bay"...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

desc_chs: 窄口宽体的药剂瓶体，大量直线交织的外观如同一颗大型宝石，可以给顾客格外华丽的观感…\n可以略微提升药剂的品质，所有特殊瓶体提供的增益效果相同。
desc_en: A potion bottle with a narrow mouth and wide body. The interweaving of a multitude of straight lines gives it the outward appearance of a large gemstone, bestowing it with an extra-luxurious look in the eyes of customers...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

desc_chs: 弧线圆润的药剂瓶体，如同胖胖的猫猫头，喜欢可爱事物的顾客很容易被这种瓶体吸引注意力…\n可以略微提升药剂的品质，所有特殊瓶体提供的增益效果相同。
desc_en: A potion bottle with a round, curvy design, like a fat feline's head. The attention of customers who like cuteness is easily drawn to these bottles...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

desc_chs: 风车菊与翠绿树叶相结合的瓶体配饰，似乎能让药剂被和煦之风环绕…
desc_en: A bottle decoration made from the combination of a Windwheel Aster and emerald-green leaves. It seems to be able to envelop the potion in a gentle breeze...

desc_chs: 晶蝶造型的瓶体配饰，尤为亮眼，有时能瞬间吸引顾客的目光…
desc_en: An especially eye-catching bottle decoration fashioned in the shape of a Crystalfly that can sometimes grab the attention of customers in an instant...

desc_chs: 蝴蝶结缎带造型的瓶体配饰，似乎能让药剂充满礼物盒包装般的惊喜感…
desc_en: A bottle ornament that is shaped like a ribbon tied into a bow. It seems to give the potions a feeling similar to that of a gift box, bursting with promises of pleasant surprises...

desc_chs: 有着莓红点缀物的羽毛造型瓶体配饰，据说能让顾客和使用者联想到飞鸟的意象…
desc_en: A feather-shaped bottle ornament sprinkled with berry-red that is said to easily be associated by customers with the image of birds in flight...

desc_chs: 金色框体与青色宝石外形的瓶体配饰，「宝石」由玻璃制成，兼顾了美观与成本…
desc_en: A bottle ornament with a golden frame and the appearance of an emerald gem. The "gemstone" is made of glass, and balances aesthetic appeal with cost...

desc_chs: 骑士团的炼金店铺专用的特别装潢，美观的双层花坛，据说是由某位调查小队的队员捐赠的「士气提升品」。
desc_en: A decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop. A beautiful double-layered flower bed, it is said to have been donated by a certain member of the Investigation Team as a "morale booster."

desc_chs: 骑士团的炼金店铺专用的特别装潢，栽有蓝色与米色的花卉，据说是某位后勤小队队员打造的「氛围营造品」。
desc_en: A decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop. An array of blue and beige colored flowers, it was supposedly created by a certain member of the Logistics Company as an "item to build up the atmosphere."

desc_chs: 骑士团的炼金店铺专用的特别装潢，可被悬挂在店铺的棚体上，画面上的药剂采用了大众印象中的经典造型…
desc_en: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, it can be hung from the shop roof, and the pictured potion uses a classic shape that most people associate with...

desc_chs: 骑士团的炼金店铺专用的特别装潢，也是在蒙德城各处宣传炼金店铺所用的广告牌，画面上的药剂采用了大众印象中的经典造型…
desc_en: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, it is also used to advertise the alchemy shop throughout Mondstadt. The pictured potion uses a classic shape that most people associate with...

desc_chs: 骑士团的炼金店铺专用的特别装潢，悬挂着多种颜色的小彩旗，据说「多彩」也象征着奇妙炼金药剂的多种功效…
desc_en: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, many small multicolored flags are hung from it, and the "prismatic" effect is said to be symbolic of the many myriad effects of the wondrous potions sold...

desc_chs: 额外聘用一位经销商。
desc_en: Engage an additional distributor.

desc_chs: 从悬练山附近取来的所谓「仙水」，若不是因为这个名字，无论如何也感受不到其中的玄妙。反过来，正因为有了「仙水」之名，再瞧它又似乎真的瞧见了仙气袅袅。
desc_en: If not for its name, this so-called "sacred water" sourced from the vicinity of Mt. Xuanlian would never have been regarded as anything special. On the contrary, when looking at it after knowing its name, you feel like you can see some adeptal aura rising from the water.

desc_chs: 不知何人遗落在野外的古老茶杯，似乎能够感受到微弱的仙力气息…
desc_en: An ancient teacup that seems to have been lost in the wilderness. It seems to exude a faint adeptal aura.

desc_chs: 在王山厅中找到的账本，详实记载了每一笔收支。
desc_en: This ledger found in the Wangshan Hall contains detailed records of every last income and expenditure item.

desc_chs: （test）神奇的松果
浮锦仙人昔日投下的最后一枚宝玉。虽说看上去与普通的玉饰并无太大差异，但其中蕴藏的仙力似乎足以在一瞬间改变附近水土的形貌…
desc_en: The final gemstone hurled by the Adeptus Fujin in ancient times. Although it looks pretty much the same as other ordinary jade stones, it contains enough adeptal energy to transform the nearby water and land in an instant...

desc_chs: （test）遗剑拓片·其之一
（test）遗剑拓片·其之二
（test）遗剑拓片·其之三
（test）遗剑拓片·其之四
（test）遗剑拓片·其之五
千岩军留下的地图，似乎记载了仓储的位置。
desc_en: The location of the warehouse seems to be recorded on this map the Millelith left behind.

desc_chs: 似乎录下了某种声音的小型留声机。或许，能够派上用场…？
desc_en: A miniaturized phonograph that appears to have recorded certain sounds. It might perhaps come in handy...?

desc_chs: 如今早已生锈的钥匙，似乎能够用来打开赤璋城垣某处早已被抛弃的仓库。
desc_en: It seems that this long-rusted key can be used to open a long-abandoned warehouse somewhere along the Chizhang Wall.

desc_chs: 在沉玉谷的遗迹中找到的钥匙，尽管锈迹斑斑，但似乎还能使用…
desc_en: Although this key, which you found in Chenyu Vale, is covered in rust, it looks like it can still be used...

desc_chs: 在海底采集的苍晶螺。造型美观，颜色瑰丽，应该可以用来作为衣服的装饰。
desc_en: A Beryl Conch collected from the seafloor. The shape is stellar and the color charming. It should be usable as a clothing accessory.

desc_chs: 在海底采集的海露花。造型美观，颜色瑰丽，应该可以用来作为衣服的装饰。
desc_en: A Romaritime Flower collected from the seafloor. The shape is stellar and the color charming. It should be usable as a clothing accessory.

name_en: Fish Seized From a Pelican's Mouth
desc_chs: 从翘英庄码头的鹈鹕口中夺回的鱼儿，似乎是其他动物颇为重视的珍馐，将它放回某些动物日常用餐的餐具之中，或许能补足特定时期的遗憾吧…
desc_en: A fish you managed to retrieve from the mouth of a pelican at the Qiaoying Village docks. It seems to be an item that other creatures treasure greatly, so you might be able to make amends for a certain loss from a certain time by returning this to the daily feeding vessel of certain animals...

desc_chs: 在探索时偶然得到的，刻画有「回声之子」风格纹饰的黑曜石断片。看上去只要有如是三个就能够组成一个完整的环，但不知道有什么作用。
desc_en: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

desc_chs: 刻画有「回声之子」风格纹饰的黑曜石环，是部族与深沉夜晚建立联系所用的古老媒介，或许可以凭借它的力量跨越某处的边界…
desc_en: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

desc_chs: （test）名单集
从款式到内容都很喧嚣的邀请函，函中描绘了一场热血奔放、狂野盛大、如跨国巡回般的摇滚盛会，而你将作为特别的来宾，一起点燃人们沉睡着的摇滚灵魂。
desc_en: An invitation letter that is loud and colorful in both cast and content. It describes a passionate, freeform, wild, huge, border-crossin' rock 'n' roll festival, in which you shall be a special guest, there to awaken the burning rock 'n' roll soul within all present!

desc_chs: 一份很有年代感的文件，不知道已经放了多久了。
desc_en: A document that seems to be of considerable age. Who knows how long it's been here?

desc_chs: 被用很高规格保存起来的发条。不知道拥有什么神奇的力量值得如此高的待遇。
desc_en: A clockwork device preserved to a very high standard. One can only wonder what mysterious power deserves such fine treatment.

desc_chs: 丽莎特意为你炼制的奇特药剂，呈现出黄金般的美丽色泽。能为使用者带来好运，在药效消失之前将会事事顺心。由于所需原料相当稀有，调配过程极其复杂，只有极少数人能够炼制成功。
desc_en: A peculiar potion Lisa concocted for you that seems to shine with a golden sheen. It is said to bring the user good luck, ensuring all their every endeavor will succeed until the effects wear off. As the ingredients required are exceedingly rare, and the brewing process devilishly complex, only a few have succeeded in concocting it.

desc_chs: 希格雯给出的清单中提到的一种特殊材料，需要从特定的原海异种身上取得。
desc_en: A special ingredient on the list that Sigewinne gave. Must be obtained from specific Fontemer Aberrants.

desc_chs: 希格雯给出的清单中提到的一种特殊材料，需要从特定的浊水幻灵身上取得。
desc_en: A special ingredient on the list that Sigewinne gave. Must be obtained from specific Tainted Hydro Phantasms.

desc_chs: 用于开启古老祭坛大门的石制机关。在悬木人部族，此处的机关被当作试炼机器使用，据说部族内也只有经验老道的讯使才能在很短的时间取得全部三把钥石。
desc_en: A stone mechanism used to unlock the gates of ancient altars. Among the Scions of the Canopy, this mechanism serves as a trial machine, where only the most experienced couriers are said to be able to acquire all three keystones in a short span of time.

desc_chs: (test)演唱会后，鹿野院平藏已经走了，留下了一份。
(test)你在很显眼的地方，发现了一份「小狗商会」的收治明细，好像是平藏落下的。
专属于琳妮特的信封，背面写有她的名字，装着合照与她的剧照，又被塞入了「威胁信」。
desc_en: An envelope that belongs only to Lynette. Her name is penned on the back, and it contains a group photo and a photo of her on stage. The "threatening letter" has been stuffed in there, too.

name_chs: 瓦萨克拉胡巴肯的护符
desc_chs: 「盗火贤者」的护符，据说是很久以前，传说中将燃素从龙爪中盗取的贤者所留下的事物，是与部族人立下契约的证明。
desc_en: The talisman of the Sage of the Stolen Flame. It is said that the sage who once stole phlogiston from a dragon's claws left this behind as proof of a pact made with the tribes.

desc_chs: 一度破损的曲谱如今已修复完好。若是懂得音律的人，一定可以读出上面记录着的古老旋律吧。
desc_en: The once-tattered score has been restored. Someone learned in music will surely be able to read the ancient melody contained within.

desc_chs: 似乎是某个古老曲谱的残片，不过仅靠这一片实在难以释读。
desc_en: A fragment of an ancient musical score. Indecipherable in its current form.

desc_chs: 一根普通的树枝，似乎有人工处理过的痕迹。\n或许是小孩子用来玩耍的道具，反正无论如何也不会是什么蛮族的信物吧…
desc_en: A very ordinary branch that has been processed by human hands in some way.\nIt might have been a prop used by children at play... But whatever it is, it couldn't have been some "barbarian token"...

desc_chs: 增加一块可用于培育药材的区域。
desc_en: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

desc_chs: 骑士团特制的药材研析装置，可以将炼金店铺中用到的药材置入其中，分析其特性，提升相应的「药材等级」，进而从多方面改善使用药材时的效能…
desc_en: A custom Knights of Favonius device used to analyze alchemical ingredients. Place any alchemical shop ingredients within to analyze their special characteristics and increase the corresponding "ingredient level," allowing the efficacy of concocted potions to be increased in various ways...

desc_chs: （test）正式剧本
（test）「原剧本」
（test）手稿

name_chs: 《转生成为鬼兜虫然后撞翻世界》
name_en: "I Got Reincarnated as an Onikabuto... And Flipped the World Upside Down"
desc_chs: 一段轻摇滚歌词，或是一首蹩脚诗。
desc_en: Some light rock 'n' roll lyrics... or perhaps just bad poetry?

desc_chs: 神秘来信
desc_en: Mysterious Letter

desc_chs: 赛诺的信
desc_en: Cyno's Letter

desc_chs: 破损的曲谱
desc_en: Damaged Score

desc_chs: 齿纹豁口在偏前处的运龙车钥匙。在纳塔，一般来说只有龙已经完全无法行动时，本地的居民才会用木车来运送它们。
desc_en: A key to a Saurian Cart with notched patterns that tend toward the key's front. Normally, local residents only transport Saurians in wooden carts when they can no longer move on their own power.

desc_chs: 齿纹豁口在正中间的运龙车钥匙。虽然名为运龙车，但是坐在车上，让龙拉车的情况似乎更为常见。
desc_en: A key to a Saurian Cart with notched patterns that are right smack in the key's center. Although they call these "Saurian carts," what usually happens is that the Saurian will pull the cart while someone sits on it.

desc_chs: 齿纹豁口在偏后侧的运龙车钥匙。或许能打开一扇特殊的运龙车的门吧。
desc_en: A key to a Saurian Cart with notched patterns that tend toward its rear. Perhaps this might open the door of quite a special cart indeed.

desc_chs: （test）一把好像能用来开锁的钥匙
原本挂在叠架村灯塔上的远光灯。取下来后依然能够散发光辉。
desc_en: A lamp that once hung in the Brickstacks Lighthouse. It shines brightly still, despite having been removed.

desc_chs: 看起来如同剑一般的龙角。似乎曾属于某条冒失的巨龙…
desc_en: A dragon horn that resembles a sword. It seems to have once belonged to a reckless dragon...

desc_chs: 散发着不祥力量的鳞片，据说系希穆兰卡的邪龙掉落。
desc_en: A scale from which an ominous power radiates. They say that the fell dragon of Simulanka dropped this.

desc_chs: 莫嘉娜警官整理的犯人口供，记录了今早的审讯结果。
desc_en: Criminal testimonies compiled by Morgane. They record the results of today's interrogation.

desc_chs: 在拉瓦特母亲住处的橱柜里发现的一页笔记，标记了枫丹科学院北面的一处地点。
desc_en: A page of a notebook you found in a cupboard within Rawat's mother's residence. It marks out a location north of the Fontaine Research Institute.

desc_chs: 原本悬挂于星轨王城上空的星星，因某些原因而散落至此…
desc_en: A star that once hung high above Constellation Metropole. For some reason, it has fallen from the sky...

name_en: Group Photo From an Unknown Time
desc_chs: 那是本应不再存在的空间，某人不知用何种手法超脱了规则，为你留下珍贵的合影。
desc_en: A precious group photo that has surpassed the rules somehow, being taken by some unknown person using unknown means in a space that should no longer exist.

desc_chs: 工匠的笔记
desc_en: Artisan's Memo

desc_chs: 圣王的手记·其一
desc_en: Holy Sovereign's Notes (I)

desc_chs: 圣王的手记·其二
desc_en: Holy Sovereign's Notes (II)

desc_chs: 圣王的手记·其三
desc_en: Holy Sovereign's Notes (III)

desc_en: Holy Sovereign's Notes (V)

desc_en: Holy Sovereign's Notes (VI)

修复完好的曲谱
desc_en: Restored Score

desc_chs: 鲁杰罗的地图
desc_en: Ruggiero's Map

desc_chs: 在探索时偶然得到的，刻画有「悬木人」风格纹饰的黑曜石断片。看上去只要有如是三个就能够组成一个完整的环，但不知道有什么作用。
desc_en: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Scions of the Canopy, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

desc_chs: 刻画有「悬木人」风格纹饰的黑曜石环，是部族与深沉夜晚建立联系所用的古老媒介，或许可以凭借它的力量跨越某处的边界…
desc_en: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Scions of the Canopy. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

desc_chs: 在探索时偶然得到的，刻画有「流泉之众」风格纹饰的黑曜石断片。看上去只要有如是三个就能够组成一个完整的环，但不知道有什么作用。
desc_en: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the People of the Springs, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

desc_chs: 刻画有「流泉之众」风格纹饰的黑曜石环，是部族与深沉夜晚建立联系所用的古老媒介，或许可以凭借它的力量跨越某处的边界…
desc_en: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the People of the Springs. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

desc_chs: 几乎没有重量的黑玉，环绕着火舌冰凉的冷焰。根据纳塔的传说，如果在特定的祭台将之献出，说不定能开启通往夜晚所执掌的国度的道路。
desc_en: A nearly weightless black jade, enveloped in chilling flames. According to Natlan's legends, offering it at a specific altar might just open the path to the kingdom ruled by the night.

desc_chs: 似乎是某个古老曲谱的残片，不过仅靠这一片实在难以释读。
desc_en: A fragment of an ancient musical score. Indecipherable in its current form.

desc_chs: 用来在积木矿窟挖掘积木矿的镐子。拥有特殊的力量，可以削去岩层，却不伤积木矿和希穆兰卡住民分毫。
desc_en: A special pickaxe used to excavate toytanium. It has the special power to slice through layers of rock, but will not harm said toytanium or any resident of Simulanka.

desc_chs: 创造世界的女神亲自书写的故事。这个就是希穆兰卡生成的蓝图，也是不容质疑的历史。
desc_en: A story written by the creator of this world. This is the blueprint that birthed Simulanka, a history that brooks no doubt.

desc_chs: 书写童话作者的亲笔手稿。不知道为什么纸上有个破洞，看起来似乎像是…
desc_en: A handwritten manuscript penned by a fairytale writer. For some reason, there is a hole in the paper that resembles...

desc_chs: 只是一个普通人创作的童话。仔细一看，稿纸上都有的破洞，似乎是猫爪印啊…
desc_en: A mere fairytale, penned by most mundane hands. If you look closely, the holes in the paper were made by a cat's paw...

desc_chs: （test）红色家徽
（test）黄色家徽
（test）蓝色家徽
据说是「同理心」家族的秘药，可以让星轨王城的住民体形变大、力量变强。然而这个里面真的是这种药吗？
desc_en: Said to be a secret elixir that belongs to the empathy clan, capable of increasing both the size and strength of residents of Constellation Metropole. Really, though, does this container really contain such a medicine?

desc_chs: 星轨王城卫兵的长矛，重心合理、流线优美。平地上投掷可以击落飞翔的龙。
desc_en: A long spear wielded by Constellation Metropole guards. Well-centered and elegant, you could throw it from ground level and strike down a flying dragon.

desc_chs: 被奥尔科称为星星碎片的奇异碎片。
desc_en: A strange fragment that Orqo termed a Star Shard.

name_en: Group Photo From an Unknown Time
desc_chs: 那是本应不再存在的空间，某人不知用何种手法超脱了规则，为你留下珍贵的合影。
desc_en: A precious group photo that has surpassed the rules somehow, being taken by some unknown person using unknown means in a space that should no longer exist.

desc_chs: 棱角分明，造型奇特的黑曜石像。是从前纳塔人用以与「夜神之国」沟通的媒介。
desc_en: A uniquely sculpted obsidian statue with very distinctive contours. It was once used by the people of Natlan as a medium to communicate with the "Night Kingdom."

desc_chs: 在硫晶支脉中拾取到的钥匙，不知可以打开通往何处的门扉…
desc_en: A key you found in the Sulfurous Veins. Who knows where the door it unlocks may lead...

name_chs: 指示宝库位置的「藏宝图」
desc_chs: 由「看守」弗洛莱恩赠予的藏宝图，据说宝库中埋藏着从前逐影猎人留下的宝藏，蕴含着击败邪恶巫师的力量…
desc_en: A Treasure Map given to you by Florian, the "guard." It is said that within the vault it will lead you to, the Marechaussee Hunters of the past left behind a treasure with the power to defeat the evil sorcerer...

name_chs: 《逐影猎人：审判之时》角色纪念册
desc_chs: 收集了本次《逐影猎人：审判之时》参与冒险的诸位角色以及主持人形象的小册子，装载着与同伴们的冒险回忆。「为此，勿将希望弃扬」——曾经扮演了逐影猎人之人，或许会对这句训誓有更深的理解吧？
desc_en: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

desc_chs: 古老的碑铭
desc_en: Ancient Engravings

desc_chs: 古老的碑铭
desc_en: Ancient Engravings

desc_chs: 调律师的笔记·下
desc_en: Harmost's Notes (II)

desc_chs: 古老的碑铭
desc_en: Ancient Engravings

desc_chs: 古老的碑铭
desc_en: Ancient Engravings

desc_chs: 古老的碑铭
desc_en: Ancient Engravings

desc_chs: 一张边缘用特殊的涂料画着绿色纹路的「通行证」，不知由什么材料做成，摩擦起来沙沙作响。一角写着「意外捡到此证者，请及时将之返还至…」，还画着一张微小的地图。
desc_en: A special "pass" with green patterns drawn along its edges. It is not clear exactly what material this is made of, and it makes a rustling noise when you rub it. On one corner, it reads "If you have picked this up accidentally, please return it promptly to..." A small map has also been drawn on it.

desc_chs: 残破的航海日志
desc_en: Tattered Navigation Log

desc_en: Ruggiero's Notes (I)

desc_en: Someone's Notes

desc_en: Investigation of the Northern Barbarians

desc_chs: 在水中浸泡了许久的钥匙，不知是否仍能打开它应当打开的门扉…
desc_en: A key that soaked in water for a long, long time. Who knows if it can even unlock the door it was made to open anymore...

desc_chs: 在纳塔的古老遗迹中拾得的奇特碎片，难以辨识其材质。\n不知为何，摸上去似乎有些温暖。
desc_en: A strange fragment picked up in the ancient ruins of Natlan. The exact material it is made from is hard to determine.\nFor some reason it feels warm to the touch.

name_en: Perfect Heart of the Sacred Dragon
desc_chs: 完美无瑕的玉石。在文明的篝火尚未被人类点燃之时，统律奇琴乌图的圣龙领主伊·奎库叙·茨博隆·库·雷尔的心脏。\n原本拥有谕令禁城奥奇卡纳塔中一切装置的权能，但如今已经因为能量耗尽而无法使用。\n正如同样追求完美的半人那般，追求完美的龙主最终寻得的也不过是如玉石般冰冷的末路。
desc_en: A flawless piece of jade. Before the fires of human civilization had ever been kindled, it was the heart of the Dragonlord Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon Ch'ule-L, ruler of Chichen Uctokah.\nIt once held the authority to command all devices within Ochkanatlan, the ineffable city, yet can no longer be used due to its energy having been completely exhausted.\nJust as with the half-humans who pursued it so relentlessly, the Dragonlord's quest for perfection was ultimately in vain, leading to naught but an end that was as cold and lifeless as jade.

desc_chs: 生产日志
desc_en: Production Log

desc_chs: 实验日志
desc_en: Experiment Log

desc_chs: 带果香的生鱼块。首先扑面而来的是鲜美的冲击，下一波则是酸与辣带来的刺激，小小一块鱼肉有着宛如浪潮般此起彼伏的层次感，仿佛在海上冲浪，浪潮平息后，仍是意犹未尽。
desc_en: Raw pieces of fish with a fruity fragrance. The sheer fragrance bowls you over in the first wave, with sourness and spiciness bringing up the rear, granting this fish layers akin to the tides, with you the surfer on a sea of flavor. Even when the tumult has subsided, your yearning remains.

name_en: A Gem Meant as a Gift
desc_chs: 晶莹剔透的黄色宝石，是派蒙打算送给龙伙伴的礼物…不过在真正作为礼物送出之前，需要先好好打造一番。
desc_en: A crystal-clear yellow gemstone. Paimon intends to give it to your Saurian companion... but you'll need to process the gem well before it's truly ready to be given away as a gift...

desc_chs: 装有「珠宝大师」库拉霍进行珠宝加工时所有工具的手提箱，里面的工具有些并不昂贵，却十分称手。
desc_en: A suitcase that contains all the tools used by the "Gem Master" Kulahaw when working gems. Some of the tools within are not expensive, but they sure are handy.

desc_chs: 装有「珠宝大师」库拉霍进行珠宝加工时所需零件的手提箱。里面的零件都由宝贵的材料制成。
desc_en: A suitcase containing parts required for jewel processing by "Gem Master" Kulahaw. The components inside are all made of precious materials.

desc_chs: 燃素能量球
desc_en: Phlogiston Energy Orb
effect_desc_chs: (test)增加燃素

desc_chs: 破碎镌光铭印的残片，破碎到了这种程度，已没有任何办法可被修复或利用。虽然被许多人说是痴心妄想，但是仍有人认为可以从中解读出古老文明的讯息。
desc_en: A fragment of a shattered Iridescent Inscription. It is broken beyond repair and can no longer serve its purpose. Though dismissed by many as delusional obsession, some still believe they hold the key to unraveling messages from ancient civilizations.

desc_chs: 自「盗火贤者」的遗迹中所取出的白盘。为前往图兰大火山，去除小嵴锋龙身上的「焰主之祝」，所必须取得的信物之一。金色的铭印纹路镌刻在白盘之上，在触摸白盘时，似乎能感受到其上的纹路如具有生命般微微鼓动。
desc_en: A white disc retrieved from the ruins of the Sage of the Stolen Flame. It is one of the essential tokens required to journey to the Great Volcano of Tollan and remove the "Flamelord's Blessing" from the little Tepetlisaur's back. Golden inscriptions are etched into the surface of the white disc, and when touched, one can sense the intricate patterns pulsating as if imbued with life.

name_chs: 卡兹加的「霍莱专用护理套装」
desc_chs: 由卡兹加亲手制作的一整套嵴锋龙护理用具。每一个工具都针对霍莱的特点进行了专门的改装。
desc_en: A set of specialized Saurian care tools personally crafted by Cazcal. Each one has been specially modified for Hora's particular needs.

desc_chs: 收集了本次《逐影猎人：审判之时》参与冒险的诸位角色以及主持人形象的小册子，装载着与同伴们的冒险回忆。「为此，勿将希望弃扬」——曾经扮演了逐影猎人之人，或许会对这句训誓有更深的理解吧？

"And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

name_chs: 《逐影猎人：审判之时》角色纪念册
desc_chs: 收集了本次《逐影猎人：审判之时》参与冒险的诸位角色以及主持人形象的小册子，装载着与同伴们的冒险回忆。「为此，勿将希望弃扬」——曾经扮演了逐影猎人之人，或许会对这句训誓有更深的理解吧？
desc_en: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

desc_chs: (test)老大终点阅读物1
(test)老大终点阅读物2
(test)老二终点阅读物1

卡齐娜的「古名」，朴实无华的黑曜石中仿佛多出了一些重量。据说可以凭此寻找卡齐娜的大致方位…
desc_en: Kachina's Ancient Name. This plain, unadorned obsidian seems to be a bit heavier than expected. It is said you can use it to find Kachina's approximate location...

desc_chs: （test）卡齐娜送你的小石头
「悬木人」部族使用的特制钩索，具有不错的安全性。在攀岩与速降等项目中很受欢迎。
desc_en: A specialized grappling hook used by the Scions of the Canopy that is exceptionally safe. It's quite popular for both rock climbing and to assist with rapid descents.

desc_chs: 朴实无华的黑曜石，可以作为「古名」的容器。
desc_en: A simple, unadorned piece of obsidian that can become a vessel for an Ancient Name.

name_chs: 小魔女与不熄灭的火·卷一
name_en: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (I)
desc_chs: 虽然装帧精美，但是正文内容全是手写的。看笔迹作者不止一人。「先别管写什么，封面要弄好看一点。这样才有写大作的感觉。」
desc_en: The binding and layout are exquisitely made, but the actual content is all handwritten. Judging from the handwriting, there is more than one author. "Don't fuss about WHAT we're writing, the cover needs to look good! That's the only way it'll give off that 'masterpiece' feeling."

name_chs: 小魔女与不熄灭的火·卷二
name_en: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (II)
desc_chs: 「你这写了一大半了一点情节推进都没有啊，怎么全是设定啊！」「你懂什么！而且这些不是设定，是杂学与博物！」
desc_en: "You're more than halfway through and you haven't even pushed the plot forward one iota! Why is it all about the setting!?" "And what would you know? Besides, this stuff isn't fleshing the setting out. It's elucidating natural science and other miscellaneous disciplines!"

name_chs: 小魔女与不熄灭的火·卷三
name_en: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (III)
desc_chs: 正文开始前有些神秘的笔迹：「难得R她神智正常了一段时间，真的要她用珍贵的清醒时间写这个吗？」「别担心，这是对魔女们来说最重要的事情。」
desc_en: Some mysterious handwriting appears before the main text: "It's so rare for R to be in her right mind for a spell. Should she really be wasting the precious little lucid time she has writing this?" "Don't worry. For a witch, this is the most important thing."

name_chs: 小魔女与不熄灭的火·卷四
name_en: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (IV)
desc_chs: 正文开始前有些神秘的笔迹：「我的女皇陛下啊，这么多伏笔怎么回收啊。可怜可怜我这个老人家吧。」
desc_en: Some mysterious handwriting appears before the main text: "Tsaritsa be good, how are there this many unresolved plot threads? Please, have mercy on these old bones, would you?"

name_chs: 小魔女与不熄灭的火·卷五
name_en: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (V)
desc_chs: 这一本的字迹潦草。或许写作者不怎么提笔，或许发生了什么。
desc_en: The writing here is practically a messy scrawl. Perhaps the author doesn't really write much, or perhaps something happened.

name_chs: 小魔女与不熄灭的火·卷六
name_en: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (VI)
desc_chs: 「现在这个时候，真的还有必要写这个吗？」「请让我写吧，回到这个世界的机会也难得。艾莉丝一定也是这么想的：如果不继续，那么一开始一切就没有意义。」
desc_en: "Is it still necessary to write this, the present moment being what it is?" "Allow me, then. Opportunities to return to this world are few and far between. Alice would think the same: If we don't continue, then everything would have been meaningless from the start."

name_chs: 小魔女与不熄灭的火·卷七
name_en: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (VII)
desc_chs: 虽然装帧精美，但是正文内容全是手写的。看笔迹作者不止一人。「我已找到书写的意义了，那就是告诉你：我多么希望你也在这里。」
desc_en: The binding and layout are exquisitely made, but the actual content is all handwritten. Judging from the handwriting, there is more than one author. "I have already found the meaning of writing — that is to tell you: I do so wish you were here, too."

desc_chs: 神秘的猫咪事务所，有一天向门童佩洛发来了请柬…等待着佩洛的会是怎样的冒险呢？
desc_en: One day, the mysterious Feline Firm sends an invitation to the doorman Perroux... Just what kind of adventures await him?

desc_chs: 破解了猫语魔法的佩洛找到了事务所的入口，就这样「跃入黑影下方」，然后呢？
desc_en: Having deciphered the Felinese spell, Perroux finds the entrance to the firm, and just like that, "jumps into the shadows beneath"... And then?

desc_chs: 花臂猫完成了爱打呼噜的猫老板的委托，其他的猫咪都做了什么呢？佩洛的好奇心还在继续…
desc_en: The cat with the full-sleeve arm tattoo completed the ever-snoring cat boss's commission, but what did the other do? Perroux's curiosity remained unabated...

desc_chs: 百灵百验的猫咪事务所也有困扰的时候，究竟是什么难题，让骄傲的虎斑猫老大要向佩洛求助呢？
desc_en: Even the Feline Firm, which has seen nearly everything, can find itself at a loss from time to time. Just what devilish difficulty has confounded the conceited tabby boss that he must seek succor from Perroux?

desc_chs: 猫的魔法靴子和猫的神奇面具，会用什么手段把长毛猫带到猫咪事务所来呢？
desc_en: A cat's magical boots and a cat's mysterious mask. Just how will they bring the long-furred cat to the Feline Firm?

desc_chs: 累积后可提升信任等阶。
desc_en: Accumulate this to increase your Trust Rank.

desc_chs: 在众猫和老爷的见证下，虎斑猫和长毛猫会顺利地结为猫夫妇，还是…？
desc_en: Witnessed by all the cats and the Master, will the tabby cat and the long-furred cat get hitched without a hitch, becoming cat husband-and-wife... or...?

desc_chs: 「跑！佩洛，跑！」长出了猫耳朵的佩洛，脑海中只剩下这几个字…
desc_en: "Run, Perroux, run!" — For the Perroux that had grown cat ears, these words alone remained ringing in his mind...

desc_chs: 「不过，老爷好像迎来了爱情的第二春？」侍从们偷偷地说着…\n但是，这也是很久之后的事情了。
desc_en: "That said, it seems the Master has come into another springtime of love?" whispered the servants...\nBut this was something that happened much later.

desc_chs: 是某幅绘于壁上的涂鸦的一部分。若能将之复位，或许能看出涂鸦上画的是什么…
desc_en: Part of graffiti art that was once painted onto a wall. Perhaps, if you can put it back in place, you can see what the art was about...

desc_chs: 几乎没有重量的黑玉裂块，环绕着火舌冰凉的冷焰。如果能将之拼凑完整，或许会发生什么了不得的事…
desc_en: A nearly weightless black jade, enveloped in chilling flames. If it could be pieced together, perhaps something extraordinary might happen...

desc_chs: 造型独特的钥匙。通过旋转不同的角度，似乎可以嵌入不同的锁孔…
desc_en: A uniquely shaped key. It seems like rotating it to different angles will enable it to fit into various locks...

desc_chs: 因相互斗争而催生的小小火星，正是这样的力量维系着圣火的久燃不灭。
desc_en: Small sparks born from conflict. They are precisely the forces that eternally sustain the Sacred Flame.

desc_chs: 于希穆兰卡生长的日落果。似乎可以用来制作赐福森林的「魔水」。
desc_en: A Sunsettia that grows within Simulanka. It can seemingly be used to make the Magic Tonic of the Forest of Blessings.

desc_chs: 于希穆兰卡生长的金鱼草。似乎可以用来制作赐福森林的「魔水」。
desc_en: A Snapdragon that grows in Simulanka. It can seemingly be used to make the Magic Tonic of the Forest of Blessings.

name_en: "A Moon That Only Shines At Night"
desc_chs: 于希穆兰卡生长的月莲。似乎可以用来制作赐福森林的「魔水」。
desc_en: A Nilotpala Lotus that grows in Simulanka. It can seemingly be used to make the Magic Tonic of the Forest of Blessings.

desc_chs: 由森林仙子用魔法制作出的神奇墨水，对赐福森林的居民来说十分重要。
desc_en: Mystical ink created by the Forest Fairy using magic. It seems to be very important to those who dwell in the Forest of Blessings.

desc_chs: 记录了奥贡的证言。使用合成台的时间、目的、受害情况等信息一应俱全、清晰明了。
desc_en: A record of Ogun's testimony. It contains clearly-listed information on the time of Crafting Bench usage and purpose, and the victim's condition.

desc_chs: 记录了潘帕的证言。夸张的表达和过多的冗余信息给这份证言记录增加了不少阅读理解的难度。
desc_en: A record of Pampa's testimony. Many exaggerations and redundancies in information make this one much harder to parse.

desc_chs: 在常规采买物资的列表中，唯有鳅鳅宝玉一项的采买理由和数量显得格格不入。
desc_en: Amidst these items, only the reason for and quantity of the Loach Pearl purchase seems out of place.

desc_chs: 记录了阿妮拉的证言。从内容上看，似乎对鹰羽派也不无微词…
desc_en: A record of Anela's testimony. Seems like the content is not short on criticism of the Hawkwings, either...

desc_chs: 看上去是打开某处热气球下营地的笼子所用…真的会有人被关在这样的笼子里吗？
desc_en: It looks like it's for opening a cage from a camp below a hot air balloon somewhere... But would someone really be kept in a cage like that?

desc_chs: 一本关于「希穆兰卡的邪龙」——杜林的绘本。里面绘有他不为人知的故事。
desc_en: A picture book that concerns the "fell dragon of Simulanka" — that is to say, Durin. None know the tales that are recorded in this text.

desc_chs: 书中讲述着一个名为「莉西亚」的少女，在故土被黑龙所毁后，独自踏上旅程的故事。
desc_en: A book about a young woman named Lycia who sets out on a journey alone following the ruination of her homeland at the hands of a black dragon.

desc_chs: 被冒失的讯使弄丢的快件。看起来已经有些破损了，还是快点把它带去给米齐卡吧。
desc_en: An express delivery package misplaced by a careless courier. It appears slightly worn. Better hurry and deliver it to Michica.

desc_chs: 外包装已经破损的快件，隐约可以看见包装上面的字：「…寄出…色盘…雅…」
desc_en: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the packaging: "From... Palette... cat..."

desc_chs: 外包装已经破损的信件，隐约可以看见包装上面的字：「…寄出…安卡…」
desc_en: A letter with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the envelope: "From... anca..."

desc_chs: 外包装已经破损的快件，隐约可以看见包装上面的字：「…宝石铺…伊…」
desc_en: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the packaging: "Gemporium... Im..."

desc_chs: 外包装已经破损的信件，隐约可以看见包装上面的字：「…寄信…尔妲…」
desc_en: A letter with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the envelope: "From... irda..."

desc_chs: 外包装已经破损的快件。据米齐卡的说法，这份快件里包着的信属于圣火竞技场内「弗里达的色盘」的店主爱雅。
desc_en: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, the letter inside belongs to Acat, the owner of "Frida's Palette" located in the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

desc_chs: 外包装已经破损的信件。据米齐卡的说法，这封信属于圣火竞技场内「倦意之屋」的店主夏安卡。
desc_en: A letter with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, the letter belongs to Chanca, the owner of "Weary Inn" located in the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

desc_chs: 外包装已经破损的快件。据米齐卡的说法，这份包着货单的快件属于伊蜜，她经常待在「穆胡鲁宝石铺」。
desc_en: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, this package contains an invoice belonging to Imix, who can often be found at "Muhuru's Gemporium."

desc_chs: 外包装已经破损的信件。据米齐卡的说法，这封信属于蒂尔妲，她经常待在「黄金傍晚」。
desc_en: A letter with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, this letter belongs to Tirda, who is often found at "Golden Dusk."

name_en: Map Left Behind by the First Chief
desc_chs: 流泉之众初代首领留下的地图，据说它指示着前往神秘岛的路线，但只有专业的向导才能进行解读。
desc_en: A map left behind by the first chief of the People of the Springs. It is said to indicate the route to the mysterious island, yet only skilled guides can decipher its secrets.

desc_chs: （test）纪念合照
阿米娜交给你的钱袋，里面是用于应对骗术的资金。
desc_en: A coin pouch that Amina gave you. Inside are funds to deal with scams.

name_chs: 卡乌鲁推荐的探险装备
desc_chs: 卡乌鲁推荐你们购买的探险装备，价格昂贵，但质量似乎并不像他说的那样靠谱。
desc_en: Expedition equipment that Kaulu recommended you purchase. Though very expensive, the quality doesn't seem to be as good as he made it out to be.

desc_chs: 与「鳍游龙长老」阿塔的合照，似乎很受派蒙的喜爱。
desc_en: A photo with Ata, the Koholasaurus elder. Paimon seems to love it.

name_chs: 玛拉妮购置的探险装备
desc_chs: 玛拉妮为此次冒险购置的高档野营装备。
desc_en: High-end camping gear that Mualani has bought for this adventure.

desc_chs: （test）？？？
一份回火夜仪式的图示，行迹有如悬木人的图腾。
desc_en: An illustration of the Turnfire Night ritual. It resembles the Scions of the Canopy's totem.

desc_chs: #{NICKNAME}与派蒙的回忆相册。冒险尚未结束，你们未来一定会创造更多回忆，这本薄薄的留影册大概无法收纳你们过去未来留下的所有画片，拍满这一本之后记得和派蒙一起去买新的留影册！
desc_en: #An album that features many of {NICKNAME} and Paimon's mementos of their adventures. Your adventure is not yet over, and you will certainly create many more memories in the future! This album is probably far too thin to contain all the pictures you've taken and will take, so after it's been filled, don't forget to go buy a new one with Paimon!

desc_chs: 来自「涂鸦联盟」成员「炫彩呆子」的心得笔记，阐述了一部分关于创作「前卫」涂鸦的理念，似乎是她为尚未升起的涂鸦新星所准备的礼物…
desc_en: A notebook written by the Graffiti Alliance member Dopey Dazzler, discussing what she knows of the art of graffiti. It describes some of the ideas behind creating "avant-garde" works and seems to be a gift she prepared for a star of the graffiti scene who has yet to arise...

name_chs: 古寻梦祭司的记录·其之一
name_en: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (I)
desc_chs: 古寻梦祭司的记录·其之一
desc_en: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (I)

name_chs: 古寻梦祭司的记录·其之二
name_en: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (II)
desc_chs: 古寻梦祭司的记录·其之二
desc_en: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (II)

name_chs: 古寻梦祭司的记录·其之三
name_en: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (III)
desc_chs: 古寻梦祭司的记录·其之三
desc_en: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (III)

name_chs: 古寻梦祭司的记录·其之四
name_en: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (IV)
desc_chs: 古寻梦祭司的记录·其之四
desc_en: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (IV)

desc_chs: 刚采摘不久的浪沫羽鳃，据说用它提取的汁液可以欺骗鳍游龙的嗅觉。
desc_en: Sprayfeather Gill that has been freshly picked. They said that its extracted juice can help you deceive a Koholasaurus's sense of smell.

desc_chs: 阿米娜向你支付的报酬，作为帮助给骗子向导定罪的答谢。
desc_en: Remuneration from Amina, as a token of appreciation for helping to convict the scammer "guide."

desc_chs: 看起来随处可见的金属钥匙，正如钥匙必有对应的锁，它也一定能打开某处的门扉吧…
desc_en: A metal key that can be found practically everywhere. Just like every lock has a key, sure there's a door out there somewhere it can open...

name_chs: 玛拉妮购置的探险装备
desc_chs: 玛拉妮为此次冒险购置的高档野营装备和型号特殊的唱片机。
desc_en: High-end camping gear and a special record player model that Mualani has bought for this adventure.

name_chs: 玛拉妮购置的探险装备
desc_chs: 玛拉妮为此次冒险购置的各种物品，野营装备自然是必需品，而唱片机和唱片的组合或许是为了休息时间的娱乐？
desc_en: Various items that Mualani purchased for this adventure. Camping equipment is a necessity, of course, and the record player and records are for... entertainment during rest time, you suppose?

desc_chs: 与「鳍游龙长老」阿塔的合照，似乎很受派蒙的喜爱。
desc_en: A photo with Ata, the Koholasaurus elder. Paimon seems to love it.

name_chs: 你与玛拉妮的纪念合照
name_en: Commemorative Photo of You and Mualani
desc_chs: 这被定格在画片中的一瞬，是玛拉妮和你携手完成神秘岛之旅后，一起留下的纪念。
desc_en: This memento that you took together captures the moment after you and Mualani completed the journey to the mysterious island with each other's help.

name_chs: 你与玛拉妮的纪念合照
name_en: Commemorative Photo of You and Mualani
desc_chs: 这被定格在画片中的一瞬，是玛拉妮和你携手完成神秘岛之旅后，一起留下的纪念。
desc_en: This memento that you took together captures the moment after you and Mualani completed the journey to the mysterious island with each other's help.

desc_chs: 在涌流地偶然得到的，造型有些奇特的贝壳。虽然不知道有什么作用，但派蒙还是很喜欢。
desc_en: A strangely-shaped shell that you chanced upon in Toyac Springs. Whether or not it can be put to any use is unclear, but nevertheless, Paimon still likes it.

desc_chs:
「有时我也会想，如果温泉的水不会干涸，如果聚在一起的朋友不会分别。」
「如果黑暗不再侵蚀这片土地，孩子们可以毫无负担地去享受触手可及的欢乐…」
「如果那样的世界能够真的存在，就算我见不到也没关系。玛薇卡，我的泉友，也是我信任并追随的神明啊——」
「火焰将我们联系在一起，死亡不足以将我们分开。纳塔与你同在，我们不会孤军奋战。」
desc_en:
"Sometimes I wonder — what if the hot springs were never to dry, nor friends to say goodbye..."
"If this land was no longer plagued by darkness, and our children could relish the joys within their reach, free from both care and worry..."
"If a world like that could really exist, just knowing it could would be enough, even if I didn't live to see it... Mavuika, my hot spring buddy and the god I trust and follow..."
"The flames bind us close, and even death cannot part us. Natlan is with you, and no one fights alone."

desc_chs: 全是被撞击痕迹的绵驮兽玩具，颇具分量，似乎需要摆放到有涂鸦标记的地方…
desc_en: An Alpaca model that shows signs of having been hit all over. This heavy object seems to need to be placed at a spot marked with graffiti...

desc_en: A woven scroll that depicts the legend of the hero Traore, a favorite among the children of the Nanatzcayan.

锈迹斑斑的钥匙，或许可以用来打开某处的门…

desc_chs: 从夜神处获得，是打造古名的关键材料。这种材料的本质是「记忆」，因为纳塔的地脉并不会将外来者的冒险事迹记录在内，所以需要一种特殊的「容器」。\n记忆在容器中流动，只要集中精神凝视其表面，它就会展现出你在纳塔留下的重要足迹。\n听上去希诺宁和茜特菈莉获得这种材料的过程很顺利，大概是因为夜神的温柔与慷慨吧。
desc_en: Obtained from the Lord of the Night, this material plays a key role in the creation of Ancient Names. Its essence is "memory," for Natlan's Ley Lines do not record the adventures of outsiders, and so, a special "vessel" is needed here.\nMemory flows within this receptacle, and if you focus on its surface, it will display the vital footprints you have left in Natlan.\nFrom what you've heard, Xilonen and Citlali had a rather easy time obtaining this material. This, you presume, is thanks to the Lord of the Night's gentleness and generosity.

desc_chs: 从夜神处获得，是打造古名的关键材料。这种材料的本质是「记忆」，因为纳塔的地脉并不会将外来者的冒险事迹记录在内，所以需要一种特殊的「容器」。\n记忆在容器中流动，只要集中精神凝视其表面，它就会展现出你在纳塔留下的重要足迹。即便古名的打造已经完成，这些属于你的光辉事迹并不会被消耗掉。\n听上去希诺宁和茜特菈莉获得这种材料的过程很顺利，大概是因为夜神的温柔与慷慨吧。
desc_en: Obtained from the Lord of the Night, this material plays a key role in the creation of Ancient Names. Its essence is "memory," for Natlan's Ley Lines do not record the adventures of outsiders, and so, a special "vessel" is needed here.\nMemory flows within this receptacle, and if you focus on its surface, it will display the vital footprints you have left in Natlan. Though the Ancient Name forging process is complete, these radiant tales of yours will not be erased.\nFrom what you've heard, Xilonen and Citlali had a rather easy time obtaining this material. This, you presume, is thanks to the Lord of the Night's gentleness and generosity.

desc_chs: 未被污染的燃素蜜珠，希诺宁送你的礼物。\n从几近赤红的颜色看，是千里挑一的品级。\n和她的说法不一致，这颗蜜珠的市价恐怕相当高。
desc_en: An unpolluted Phlogiston Honey Pearl, and a gift from Xilonen.\nFrom the nearly-crimson color, you can tell that this is of the absolute highest quality.\nIn contrast to her words, the market value of this is astonishingly high.

desc_chs: test古老的日记描述
一张令人难忘的合影，马尼菲科在背面留下了他的签名：“朋友，小小的树也可以投下大大的影子！”
desc_en: An unforgettable group photo with Magnifico's signature on the back: "Friends, even the smallest of trees can cast the biggest of shadows!"

desc_en: A fragment of a weapon once wielded by Sanhaj Kompore, Border Master of the Masters of the Night-Wind. It was broken into its currents state during the great war five hundred years past. According to Granny Itztli's intuition, it may aid the Traveler in some inexplicable way at some future point in their journey.

desc_chs: 通过暝视得到的织卷地图，指向了一个据称已经消失不见的神秘区域，其名为：烬寂海。
desc_en: A woven scroll map, obtained through a clairvoyant vision, pointing to a mysterious place said to have vanished long ago — namely, the Mare Jivari.

desc_chs: 残缺不全的手记，记录着特帕尔的执念与梦想。
desc_en: An incomplete notebook in which Tepal has recorded his obsessions and dreams.

name_en: Key Found by the "Painted Stone Challenge" Podium
desc_chs: 在「染绘石挑战」的领奖台边发现的钥匙，按照一般的理性思考，这个钥匙对应的门或许就在「染绘石挑战」的台子周围吧…
desc_en: A key you found by the "Painted Stone Challenge" podium. Going by the rules of common sense, you'd probably guess that the door it unlocks must be somewhere nearby said podium...

name_en: Secret Art Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
desc_chs: 裹满酱汁的烤鱼。鱼身打上你和派蒙精心控制的花刀，往肚子中塞上你们特选的香料，烤熟后淋上厚厚的薄荷酱。鱼肉充满清香，让人胃口大开。\n要是能熟练烹制这种烤鱼，说不定，你和派蒙也有一天能获得烤鱼大厨的尊称呢…
desc_en: Grilled Fish doused in delicious sauce. Under your and Paimon's careful hands, the fish has been meticulously scored, stuffed with specially selected spices, then baked. Once cooked, a thick mint sauce is generously drizzled over the top. The refreshing aroma of the fish is enough to whet anyone's appetite.\nIf you can master the art of grilling fish this way, perhaps one day you and Paimon will earn the title of Grilled Fish Master Chefs...

desc_chs: 在探索时偶然得到的，刻画有「烟谜主」风格纹饰的黑曜石断片。看上去只要有如是三个就能够组成一个完整的环，但不知道有什么作用。
desc_en: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Masters of the Night-Wind, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

desc_chs: 刻画有「烟谜主」风格纹饰的黑曜石环，是部族与深沉夜晚建立联系所用的古老媒介，或许可以凭借它的力量跨越某处的边界…
desc_en: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Masters of the Night-Wind. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

desc_chs: (test)龙侦探阅读物2
(test)灰烬城副岛拾取后放在小恐龙营地的恐龙蛋
从愚人众手上得到了一批留影，清楚全面地记录了此处「秘源遗迹」的构造。这张留影上出现了一个特殊的机关，它的形状似乎值得注意。
desc_en: A batch of photos you got from the Fatui that clearly shows the structure of the Remnants of the Secret Source in this place. This picture shows a special mechanism with a very noteworthy shape.

desc_chs: 有着吓人名号的树木，其实不会自燃，也不会爆炸，只是有着醒目如爆炸火球般的树冠，引发了命名者的联想…\n不过，附近没有产出这种木材的树木，却能看见成品木材散落在地，似乎是有人特意将它们运送过来的…
desc_en: This tree has a rather frightening name, but is, in fact, not prone to spontaneous ignition. Its name simply comes from its striking crown, which resembles an exploding fireball...\nYou saw lumps of such processed wood scattered on the ground, yet no trees nearby that could produce it. Someone must have deliberately brought them here...

desc_chs: 可见于纳塔特定区域的树木，数量相对稀少…\n不过，附近没有产出这种木材的树木，却能看见成品木材散落在地，似乎是有人特意将它们运送过来的…
desc_en: A tree that can be found in a specific region in Natlan. Their numbers are few...\nYou saw lumps of such processed wood scattered on the ground, yet no trees nearby that could produce it. Someone must have deliberately brought them here...

desc_chs: 齿纹造型是近似弧线的钥匙，或许能够轻松打开某处的门扉吧…
desc_en: A key with a smoothly curved bit, almost like an arc. Somewhere out there, perhaps there's a door it could easily open...

desc_chs: 齿纹造型十分平直的钥匙，或许能够轻松打开某处的门扉吧…
desc_en: A key with extremely straight bitting. Somewhere out there, perhaps there's a door it could easily open...

desc_chs: 齿纹似乎经过多年使用磨损，所以看上去十分凌乱的钥匙，使用这样的钥匙，或许需要一些「巧劲」吧…
desc_en: A key with worn teeth that look quite messy after many years of action. Perhaps it requires a bit of "technique" to actually use...

desc_chs: 茜特菈莉赠送给你的手帕，她希望将这块手帕的颜色留在你的记忆里，这是一份礼物，也是一个约定。
desc_en: A handkerchief that Citlali gave you as a gift. May its colors ever stay in your memory — as a present, and as a promise.

desc_chs: 茜特菈莉帮助你完成的历史织物，里面记载着那场让你成为纳塔英雄的传奇战斗。
desc_en: A woven scroll that Citlali helped you complete. It chronicles the legendary battle you undertook to become a hero of Natlan.

name_chs: 《转生成为雷电将军，然后天下无敌》第一版
name_en: "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power," First Edition
desc_chs: 《转生成为雷电将军，然后天下无敌》的第一版，因为印数少，所以收藏价值很高。
desc_en: The first edition of "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power." A very costly item to collect on account of its limited print run.

name_chs: 《拜托了我的狐仙宫司》限量精装版
name_en: "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?" Limited Deluxe Edition
desc_chs: 《拜托了我的狐仙宫司》的限量精装版，八重堂为了回馈读者而限量发行的版本，发售之初就被抢购一空，是许多轻小说爱好者求而不得的藏品。
desc_en: The limited deluxe edition of "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?" The Yae Publishing House released this limited print run in response to its readers. Stocks were all but emptied out the instant these came to market, making them a much sought-after collector's item amongst light novel lovers.

name_chs: 茜特菈莉的手帕和钥匙
desc_chs: 因为「不希望在宿醉的时候被敲门声吵醒」，茜特菈莉将她住处的钥匙交给了你。你小心地将它和茜特菈莉送你的手帕放在一起，毕竟你之前收集过的钥匙太多了，这把钥匙必须拥有特别的标识。
desc_en: The key given to you by Citlali so that "you won't wake me up by beating on my door while I'm drunk." You carefully place it alongside the handkerchief she gave you. After all, you've collected so many keys in the past, so this one needs to have a special mark to stand out.

desc_chs: 自奥奇卡纳塔受蚀的烬城之主处取得的白盘。为前往图兰大火山，去除小嵴锋龙身上的「焰主之祝」，所必须取得的信物之一，据说是「焰主」之眼被一分为二后留下的一部分。传说古代执掌一切光芒与智慧的龙主用自己的一只眼眸化作了控制一切火焰的无上权柄，而那也成为了其唯一能够被击破的弱点…
desc_en: A white disc retrieved from the ruler of Cinder City's corroded ruins within Ochkanatlan. It is one of the essential tokens required to journey to the Great Volcano of Tollan and remove the "Flamelord's Blessing" from the little Tepetlisaur's body, and is said to have been one of the fragments left behind when the Flamelord's eye was split in two. According to legend, it is said that the ancient Dragonlord — who once held dominion over all light and wisdom — transformed one of his eyes into a conduit of supreme authority by which all flames might be governed, and that this became his only exploitable weakness...

desc_chs: 在印有海螺纹样的纸张上写就的笔记。\n据说是为制作怪物图鉴而准备的草稿，在记录和说明之外也留下了一些给伙伴的信息，或许是错将原件当作了副本…
desc_en: Notes written on pieces of paper printed with conch patterns.\nThese seem to be drafts made in preparation for composing a monster picture book, and apart from records and descriptions, they also contain some information intended for a companion. Perhaps someone might have switched the copy out for the original by mistake...

desc_chs: 给最好最好最好的伙伴！！！
desc_en: To my best— no, bestest travel companion ever!!!

desc_chs: 协助话事处的战备联络人伊拉德认证考核关卡后获得的纪念品，绘有你与伙伴们的肖像。\n据伊拉德所说，此次由三位大师参与设计，你亲自予以认证的考核关卡，或许是无需迭代的最佳版本，将成为部族战士们挑战自我、锤炼技艺的第一选择…
desc_en: A commemorative portrait of you and your companions, which you obtained after assisting the combat readiness liaison Irade with stage certification.\nAccording to her, after having been crafted by three masters and certified by you, the stages may now have reached such a level of perfection as to require no further iteration. They will surely become the first port of call for warriors looking to challenge themselves and hone their martial prowess...

desc_chs: 协助战备联络人验证考核关卡后得到的纪念品…\n完成魔神任务「炽烈的还魂诗」后可以使用，从而获得「衔勇诚砺之证」的特殊礼物。
desc_en: A souvenir obtained after assisting the combat readiness liaison in testing and certifying various stages...\nComplete the Archon Quest "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection" to use, thereby earning an "Emblem of Steadfast Valor" as a special gift.

desc_chs: 协助话事处的战备联络人伊拉德认证考核关卡后获得的纪念品，绘有你与伙伴们的肖像。\n据伊拉德所说，此次由三位大师参与设计，你亲自予以认证的考核关卡，或许是无需迭代的最佳版本，将成为部族战士们挑战自我、锤炼技艺的第一选择…

They will surely become the first port of call for warriors looking to challenge themselves and hone their martial prowess...

desc_en: Unfinished Musical Score

desc_en: Recordkeeping Secret Source Sentinel

desc_en: Nameless Traveler's Notes (I)

desc_chs: 神子久违地寄来信函，似乎是有要事相商…
desc_en: Miko has sent you a long-awaited letter. It seems she has something important she wants to discuss...

desc_chs: 瑞希赠予的特许券，可以在打烊之后前往「秋沙钱汤」。既不会打扰旁人，也不会被人打扰。
desc_en: A credit coupon given to you by Mizuki which allows you to visit the Aisa Bathhouse after hours. With this, you'll not only not disturb others, but more importantly, others are guaranteed not to disturb you.

desc_chs: 金阁等狸赠予的画册，据说能幻化并定格近段时间的美好回忆。不知为何翻阅起来像是有树叶的味道…
desc_en: An album given to you by Kinkaku and co. that is said to be able to transform and preserve recent wonderful memories. For some reason, when you open its pages, you are greeted by the scent of fresh leaves...

name_en: Place of the Trial of Disembodiment Message
desc_chs: 出魂试炼之所的留言
desc_en: Place of the Trial of Disembodiment Message

desc_chs: 蓝砚为胡桃特制的藤人，内含奇门术法，能通过大阵为胡桃分摊死气。但因为你与地脉的特殊关系，你的藤人无法被链接到阵法中…
desc_en: A rattan figure that Lan Yan made specially for Hu Tao. It contains mysterious spellwork that can be used to distribute Fetor for the latter. However, due to your special relationship with the Ley Lines, your rattan figure cannot be linked up to the array...

desc_chs: 忽然一夜梅香起，散作乾坤万里春。
desc_en: The night was suddenly filled with the fragrance of plum blossoms, spreading across the springtime sky and land.

desc_chs: 一枚刻有特殊岩箓的吉语钱，据说是岩王帝君符号，或能护人平安。
desc_en: A Fortune Coin with a special Guyan Sigil engraved into it. It is said that this is the symbol of Rex Lapis, and can be used as a protective talisman.

desc_chs: 可能是蓝砚遗留的藤编玩具，与街会上的款式略有不同，上面贴有神秘的纸符，似乎别有他用。
desc_en: A rattan toy left behind by someone, perhaps Lan Yan. It is slightly different from the ones at the fair, having a mysterious sigil stuck to it, indicating some other purpose.

desc_chs: 不知是哪个时代的冒险家遗留下来的笔记，上面记载了此人在「奥奇卡纳塔」中的冒险经历。
desc_en: Notes left by an adventurer of an unknown era. In them, they recorded their adventures in Ochkanatlan.

desc_chs: 小龙造型的饼干。黄油诱人的味道牵引着味蕾抓住苦种与颗粒果交织出的美妙。可爱造型让人爱不释手，香甜味道让人停不下口…不过这是在「祝福之路」得到的点心，作为纪念品也不失为一种选择。
desc_en: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. The enticing aroma of butter draws forth the delightful, irresistible interplay between the Cacahuatl and Grainfruit, while the cute shapes make them truly hard to put down... Be that as it may, you received these treats on the parade of blessings and it might be nicer to keep them as an uneaten memento.

desc_chs: (test)在瓦雷莎果园限时采摘的果蔬
已经失去所有的力量，体内空腔只余下回响的小型秘源机械。看得出来曾被很好保养过，以至于流失在外如此之久还能得以重新运转一段时间。
desc_en: A small-scale Secret Source Automaton. Now that it has lost all power, all that is left are echoes in an empty shell. It shows clear signs of careful maintenance, which afforded it brief function once reactivated, even after being lost in the outside world for so long.

desc_chs: 一份做工精致的邀请函，散发着令人心情愉悦的幽香。据说此函是秋沙钱汤专门为贵客准备的，函中标注了店面地址，并介绍了此店主推的三种服务。
desc_en: A beautifully crafted invitation letter that emits a faint yet beguiling scent. It's claimed that such letters are sent to only the most valued of customers. The letter contains the establishment's location and introduces its three primary services.

desc_chs: 游玩「三川花祭」时获得的神秘礼物，似乎是一件精心制作的摆设…
desc_en: A gift gained from playing games at the Mikawa Flower Festival. It appears to be an exquisitely-made furnishing...

desc_chs: 来自枫丹的旅行随笔作家收集整理的稻妻民间故事集，以不同人讲述的各类怪谈与传说为主。
desc_en: A collection of Inazuman folk stories transcribed by a traveling writer from Fontaine. Its pages contain a wealth of myths and strange tales passed down orally by people from all over Inazuma.

desc_chs: 来自枫丹的旅行随笔作家收集整理的稻妻民间故事集，以不同人讲述的各类怪谈与传说为主。
desc_en: A collection of Inazuman folk stories transcribed by a traveling writer from Fontaine. Its pages contain a wealth of myths and strange tales passed down orally by people from all over Inazuma.

desc_chs: 在纳塔的部族间流传的幻想小说，据说翻译自枫丹著名作家昆扬的大热作品。然而根据曾经到访过枫丹廷的纳塔人的说法，他们从未找到过这本小说的原版，当地人也没听说过名为昆扬的作家。
desc_en: A fantasy novel doing the rounds among the tribes of Natlan that is said to be translated from a popular work by the reputedly famous Fontainian author K'n-yan. The Natlanese who have visited the Court of Fontaine, however, claim to have been unable to find the original — nor has anyone managed to find a local who's ever heard of an author named "K'n-yan".

desc_chs: 在纳塔的部族间流传的幻想小说，据说翻译自枫丹著名作家昆扬的大热作品。然而根据曾经到访过枫丹廷的纳塔人的说法，他们从未找到过这本小说的原版，当地人也没听说过名为昆扬的作家。

desc_chs: 看似形态普通，风味却相当特殊的蘑菇，只会生长于瓦雷莎家的果园附近。听说生长能力很强，如果遇见必须马上吃掉。
desc_en: An ordinary-looking mushroom with an extraordinary flavor. Only grows near the orchard at Varesa's house. They're fast growers, so if you see one, eat it quickly.

desc_chs: 自「审议之庭」之中取得空鳞，又由秘源龙仆「阿万尤」进行激活，终于得到的，可以进入「圣山之心」的「许可」。大多数龙的鳞片在离开身体后就会因为失去力量而变成失色的白鳞，而这枚鳞片度过了相当漫长的岁月，仍能在黑暗中发出金色的光亮，可见其中蕴含的伟力。
desc_en: An unadorned scale obtained from the Chamber of Deliberation and activated by the Secret Source Servant, Awanyu. It grants access to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain. Most dragon scales discolor and fade to white once removed from their masters as they lose the power that once ran through them. Yet this one, despite its long history, still glows gold in the darkness, displaying its might for all to see.

desc_chs: 古代生活于此处的居民利用燃素的性质进行打造，可用于替换的单位资源。一切秘源机械的运作都需要「单位燃素」进行驱动，不过所需的「单位燃素」会根据不同秘源机械运作的复杂程度有所变化。
desc_en: A replaceable resource unit created by the ancient inhabitants of this place by harnessing the properties of Phlogiston. All Secret Source Automatons require Phlogiston Units to work, though the exact specifications of the units required depend on the complexity of each automaton's operations.

desc_chs: （test）5.5赠送家具展示 男主未做水神线
（test）5.5赠送家具展示 女主未做水神线
（test）5.5赠送家具展示 男主已做水神线
（test）5.5赠送家具展示 女主已做水神线

name_chs: 关于「燃素状态转换器」的实验报告
《至强融合·控碟乐师重混甄选》
desc_chs: 希诺宁推荐的唱片，收录了若干首她所认可的音乐，极具纳塔本地特色，还附有多位控碟乐师共同出资请人设计的「希诺宁大师特别形象」纪念图。\n不过，这张唱片似乎要在「热舞乐台」一类的专业设备上，才能发挥出最棒的音质，擅用不太匹配的设备，也许会造成碟面损坏…留作独特的收藏品，也颇有纪念意义！
desc_en: A series of songs handpicked by Xilonen that have earned her recognition, a selection truly unique to Natlan. Includes a "Master Xilonen Commemorative Photo" commissioned by several DJs. \nHowever, it seems that this record can only sound its best on professional equipment such as the Dance-Off Stage, and using unsuitable equipment may damage the disc surface... In any case, it makes for a one-of-a-kind collector's item and keepsake!

desc_chs: 在露泽咖啡厅购入的咖啡，光是闻着味道就能令人精神一振。快带给爱可菲吧。
desc_en: Coffee procured exclusively for Café Lutece. The smell alone is enough to sharpen your senses. Make sure to bring it to Escoffier.

desc_chs: 据说是由桑哈杰·康波雷大师亲自编织的挂毯，其内容简短而离奇，通常被认为是从未发生过的虚构故事。
desc_en: Said to be a tapestry personally woven by Master Sanhaj Kompore, its contents are both short and strange. Generally believed to be a work of pure fiction.

desc_chs: 据说是由桑哈杰·康波雷大师亲自编织的挂毯，其内容简短而离奇，通常被认为是从未发生过的虚构故事。

desc_en: Said to be a tapestry personally woven by Master Sanhaj Kompore, its contents are both short and strange. Generally believed to be a work of pure fiction.

desc_chs: 回声之子传承的织卷，述说着五百年前的英杰松伽塔年轻时的传奇。
desc_en: A woven scroll passed down for generations in the Children of Echoes. It tells the legend of a young Sundjatta from 500 years ago.

desc_chs: 回声之子传承的织卷，述说着五百年前的英杰松伽塔年轻时的传奇。

desc_en: A woven scroll passed down for generations in the Children of Echoes. It tells the legend of a young Sundjatta from 500 years ago.

desc_chs: 来自流泉之众的古老歌谣，讲述了传说中的英雄兰吉努伊的故事。
desc_en: An ancient folk song from the People of the Springs. It describes the tale of the legendary hero, Rangi Nui.

desc_chs: 来自烟谜主的织卷，其中述说的故事据说比烟谜主的诞生还要古老，但信息真伪难以考证。
desc_en: A woven scroll from the Masters of the Night-Wind. It is said that the stories within are older than the tribe itself, a claim that remains difficult to verify.

desc_chs: 来自烟谜主的织卷，其中述说的故事据说比烟谜主的诞生还要古老，但信息真伪难以考证。
desc_en: A woven scroll from the Masters of the Night-Wind. It is said that the stories within are older than the tribe itself, a claim that remains difficult to verify.

desc_chs: 与共同旅行的伙伴的合影，是在这片人龙共同生活的国度的纪念。在某个时期同行的伙伴们终究要踏上各自的道路，不过，曾经一同度过的时光并未因此褪去应有的色彩。
desc_en: A photo of you and your travel companions; a memento of a land where humans and saurians coexist. Though our paths may eventually diverge, the memories we create together shall never fade.
