name_chs: 海薇玛乐园全景纪念图
desc_chs: 与伙伴们一同将「海薇玛映影欢乐城」经营得红红火火后收到的纪念品。大家一笔一划画出的这份地图采用了童话绘图的风格，映影乐园的每座游乐设施和特色景观都有着可爱的造型。当然，最为重要的还是来访的诸位重要伙伴。顺着芙宁娜的建议，你为她的头像画上了白色的胡子，令人联想到甜甜的奶油，让这副地图变得「一听就很好吃」…
desc_en: A memento to remind you of the roaring success that you and your companions achieved with the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. You drew this map together in a whimsical, storybook style, ensuring every enchanting attraction and adorable landmark stands out. Of course, the most important features are the friends who came to visit. Following Furina's advice, you added a snowy white beard to her portrait, like a coating of sweet cream, making sure the entire map "sounds delicious"...

You drew this map together in a whimsical, storybook style, ensuring every enchanting attraction and adorable landmark stands out. Of course, the most important features are the friends who came to visit. Following Furina's advice, you added a scarlet beard to her portrait, like a smothering of bolognese sauce, making sure the entire map "sounds delicious"...

desc_chs: 一本装订有悠悠度假村美好记忆的纪念册，绚丽封面上阿夏的姿态如同起舞。\n假日的旋律不曾被遗忘，它像位身居远方的老友，期待着再度向你致以问候。
desc_en: An album filled with precious memories from your time at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. The Asha painted on the vibrant cover looks as though it's dancing.\nThe lilting melody of your holiday still lingers on the breeze, like an old friend from a distant land waiting for the chance to greet you once more.

desc_chs: 阿贝多手稿中的地图。上面标出了三处地点。
desc_en: A map from Albedo's manuscript. There are three locations marked on it.

desc_chs: 阿贝多手稿中的地图。
desc_en: A map from Albedo's manuscript.

desc_chs: 通往「千星奇域」的钥匙之一，装有星形宝石的水晶球，光彩绚烂，是通过魔女会的试炼后得到的赠礼。\n依照转交人的描述，普通人或许无法驾驭这一器物。而被笔名「欧科塔维亚」的魔女关注已久的你与派蒙曾战胜重重险阻，对陌生事物充满求知与探索的热情，在冒险之余，还富有创作的灵感，正是「千星奇域」新主人的最佳选择。「欧科塔维亚」相信，你们一定能将这个奇妙世界的潜能发挥到极致…
desc_en: One of the keys to the Miliastra Wonderland, this glittering crystal ball, adorned with star-shaped gemstones, was bestowed as a reward for passing the Hexenzirkel's trial.\nAccording to the one who presented it, it is not something that an ordinary person can master. Yet, the witch known as "Octavia" has been observing you and Paimon for some time. She has witnessed you overcome countless trials and dangers while displaying natural curiosity and courage, and showing remarkable creativity beyond the realms of mere adventure. For these reasons, she considers you the ideal candidates to become the new masters of the Miliastra Wonderland. Octavia firmly believes that together, the two of you will unlock the full potential of this wondrous world...

desc_chs: 注有月矩力的充能原件，能够在紧急情况下为某些装置提供运转所需的月矩力。
desc_en: A charging component that stores kuuvahki for powering certain devices in case of emergency.

desc_chs: 据说是足以抵挡箭与铳枪的坚固安全帽。
desc_en: It is said to be a sturdy safety helmet strong enough to withstand arrows and firearms.

desc_chs: 在那夏镇码头偶遇月灵后寻得的导览图，上面似乎记录了一些那夏镇有趣的去处。
desc_en: This guide map — found after running into the kuuhenki at Nasha Town's docks — appears to highlight points of interest around town.

desc_chs: 在那艘跨越星海的飞船上，归属于金发的双子旅行者，理论上只存在两把的钥匙。
desc_en: On that ship that traversed the sea of stars, there should be only two keys, belonging to the golden-haired, traveling twins.

desc_chs: 一份神秘的邀请函，内侧有一排歪歪扭扭的小字：归火圣日巡礼。
desc_en: A mysterious invitation letter, with a line of crooked little letters inside: "Tour of the Return of the Sacred Flame."

name_chs: 「保证让人轻轻松松长高超厉害灵药」
name_en: "Ultra-Amazing Miracle Tonic Guaranteed to Make You Taller with Zero Effort!"
desc_chs: 从多莉处拿到的「灵药」。\n总觉得有些可疑，长高…真的有这么简单吗？
desc_en: A "miracle tonic" obtained from Dori.\nIt seems a little suspicious. Could growing taller really be this easy?

desc_chs: 解救绵驮兽警长的「关键」。
desc_en: The "key" to rescuing the Alpaca Sheriff.

desc_chs: 存于「工坊秘藏」的工具箱，但其内并不是工具，而是一件神奇的小饰品。
desc_en: A toolbox stored in the Workshop's Trove. Instead of tools, it contains a mysterious accessory.

desc_chs: 存放爱诺小饰品的工具箱，如今饰品已被取走。
desc_en: A toolbox that once held Aino's accessory — an accessory that has since been taken.

desc_chs: 存于「工坊秘藏」的工具箱，但其内并不是工具，而是一件神奇的小饰品。
desc_en: A toolbox stored in the Workshop's Trove. Instead of tools, it contains a mysterious accessory.

desc_chs: 存放伊涅芙小饰品的工具箱，如今饰品已被取走。
desc_en: A toolbox that once held Ineffa's accessory — an accessory that has since been taken.

name_en: Invitation Letter For a Ball Now Past
desc_chs: 已然落幕的晚宴后，证明众人曾于如梦般的当夜云集的邀请函。一度在舞会中被使用的乔装面具，那空旷的眼廓之后，曾有一双见证过盛大筵宴的眼睛。
desc_en: An invitation that lingers beyond the end of a ball now past — proof of that dreamlike gathering. Behind the now-empty eyes of the mask, a pair of pupils once witnessed the grandeur of that banquet.

desc_chs: 丝柯克赠予的特殊深渊结晶，佩戴后能够与丝柯克在睡眠中「镜像魂梦」。为找寻幕后凶手，丝柯克潜入你的梦中调查，你也望见了她内心深处的记忆。再次使用，能够重现当时的部分场景…
desc_en: An Abyss Crystal, a gift from Skirk to you. When worn, it can be used in your sleep to "dream-mirror" with her. To find the culprit, Skirk infiltrated your dreams, while you witnessed the memories deep within her heart. Use this crystal once more to revisit certain scenes of what happened back then...

desc_chs: 完成丝柯克的特训后，与她一起总结的特训经验，记载了当时的不懈努力与辛苦探索。训练虽已结束，但阅读当初记下的笔记，仍可学到许多经验…
desc_en: After completing Skirk's rigorous training, you and she compiled a summary of your experiences, documenting your relentless efforts and her grueling trials. Though the training has ended, revisiting these records can still yield invaluable insights...

desc_chs: 由鸣神大社宫司八重神子大人亲手书写的「大吉」。\n据说…呃，据八重神子说，这枚「御神签」拥有着特别的力量…？
desc_en: A "Great Fortune" fortune slip written personally by Guuji Yae Miko of the Grand Narukami Shrine.\nIt is said that — or rather, Yae Miko says that — this Fortune Slip has some sort of special power...?

name_chs: 豚兽大王赠与的闪闪礼蛋
name_en: Gift Egg Gifted by Capybara King
desc_chs: 豚兽大王赠与的闪闪礼蛋，摸上去有种潮湿的感觉。\n可以用来试试手气，又或者就这么留在包里也不错。
desc_en: A shiny gift egg given to you by the Capybara King that feels wet to the touch.\nUse it to try your luck or keep it in your luggage as a souvenir, the choice is yours!

desc_chs: 「咔阿夏」赠与的闪闪礼蛋，摸上去格外的光滑。\n可以用来试试手气，又或者就这么留在包里也不错。
desc_en: A shiny gift egg given to you by Cacasha that feels unnaturally smooth.\nUse it to try your luck or keep it in your luggage as a souvenir, the choice is yours!

name_en: Gift Egg: Blood of This Land
desc_chs: 悠悠度假村提供的限定礼蛋，内含纳塔各地的特色甜点和料理。
desc_en: A limited gift egg offered by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, containing dishes and desserts from all over Natlan.

desc_chs: 悠悠度假村提供的限定礼蛋，内含纳塔各地的特色甜点和料理。

desc_en: A limited gift egg offered by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, containing dishes and desserts from all over Natlan.

desc_chs: 一封来自悠悠度假村的邀请函，「夏日」与「度假」这两个词汇总能碰撞出照亮夜幕的明媚色彩。
desc_en: An invitation letter from the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. "Summer" and "Holiday" are words that always seem to be able to light up the night sky in radiant colors.

desc_chs: 从悠悠集市购得的特诺奇兹托克特色供品，散发着多汁水果与柔美鲜花交融的香气。\n听说供奉时，要从中间点燃…
desc_en: A Tenochtzitoc specialty offering purchased from the Easybreeze Market, bursting with the sweet scent of juicy fruit and fresh flowers.\nIt's said that when you offer it, you should light it in the center...

desc_chs: 在悠悠集市购物时获赠的纪念品，质地光洁。\n既然这些蜡烛来自于「太阳」，或许可以被称为迷你「太阳」？
desc_en: A smooth-textured souvenir gifted to you for free at the Easybreeze Market.\nSince these candles came from the "sun," perhaps it's fitting to call them miniature "suns."

desc_chs: 从梅蒂那里得到的欠条。\n根据本人的说法，似乎可以在那夏镇的「斯佩兰扎」餐厅免费吃一顿饭…
desc_en: An IOU note from Maite.\nAccording to her, this can be redeemed for a free meal at the "Speranza" restaurant in Nasha Town...

desc_chs: #记录有{NICKNAME}旅行途中所见的人与事的留影册。一路向前的旅程中，经历了太多事，遇到了太多人，就像每夜都在璀璨星河下入睡的旅人，迟早会对星空之美感到麻木，为了避免这一天的到来，有必要把所见之人与景记录下来。这是旅行之余派蒙提醒你的道理，这么多年了，派蒙也成长了，真是欣慰！
desc_en: #An album filled with memories of people and events that {NICKNAME} has encountered on {M#his}{F#her} travels. On this unending journey forward, too much has happened, and too many faces have come and gone. Like a traveler who sleeps beneath the glittering stars each night, even their beauty may one day fade into numbness. To keep that day from coming, you must record every sight and soul you encounter. This is the wisdom that Paimon shared with you during your journey. It's been so many years, and Paimon has grown too. How heartwarming!

desc_chs: 利落追查并彻底捣毁「黑钱领主」的「摩拉除痕」团队后，与夜兰一同在枫丹享受了短暂的假期。为了纪念这次行动，以「综像勘录仪」完成的留影…
desc_en: After efficiently tracking down and completely dismantling the "Mora-laundering" team of the "Dark Financier," you enjoyed a brief vacation in Fontaine with Yelan. To commemorate this mission, you took a snapshot with the Forensic Imaging Device.

desc_chs: 完成丝柯克的特训后，与她一起总结的特训经验，记载了当时的不懈努力与辛苦探索。训练虽已结束，但阅读当初记下的笔记，仍可学到许多经验…
desc_en: After completing Skirk's rigorous training, you and she compiled a summary of your experiences, documenting your relentless efforts and her grueling trials. Though the training has ended, revisiting these records can still yield invaluable insights...

desc_chs: 破解后的讯息
desc_en: The deciphered message.

desc_chs: 刻着蛋卷工坊标识的螺栓，似乎可以在那里派上用场。
desc_en: A bolt engraved with the Krumkake Craftshop's logo. It may serve some purpose there.

desc_chs: 某人来不及带走的调查报告。
desc_en: An investigative report that someone left behind in a hurry.

desc_chs: 某人来不及带走的调查报告。
desc_en: An investigative report that someone left behind in a hurry.

desc_chs: 某人来不及带走的调查报告。
desc_en: An investigative report that someone left behind in a hurry.

desc_chs: 集齐3个印磐后，可开启希汐岛宝库。\n\n在探索时偶然得到的圆形符印，如能找到纹样相同的3个，似乎就能拼凑出曾经照亮世界的皓月的影迹。
desc_en: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Hiisi Island.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

desc_chs: 集齐3个印磐后，可开启帕哈岛宝库。\n\n在探索时偶然得到的圆形符印，如能找到纹样相同的3个，似乎就能拼凑出曾经照亮世界的皓月的影迹。
desc_en: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Paha Isle.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

desc_chs: 集齐3个印磐后，可开启伦波岛宝库。\n\n在探索时偶然得到的圆形符印，如能找到纹样相同的3个，似乎就能拼凑出曾经照亮世界的皓月的影迹。
desc_en: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Lempo Isle.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

desc_chs: 密码筒内的信件
desc_en: Cryptex Letter

desc_chs: 绘有华丽图案的宣传册，详细记录了大赛的赛制、参与方式和对评审的介绍。
desc_en: A brochure filled with dazzling images introducing the format, entry conditions, and judges for the show.

desc_chs: 夜兰通过先前记录的犯罪团伙暗语信件破译而出的暗语对照表，能够将看似毫无逻辑的废话转换成有效信息，拿着这份对照表，应该就能看懂「黑钱领主」部下们暗中交流的文本…
desc_en: A code cipher compiled by Yelan using cracked codes from a criminal organization's encrypted communications. It can be used to turn seemingly random and nonsensical passages into easily understood messages. With this tool in hand, even the secret missives of the "Dark Financier's" underlings should become as clear as day...

desc_chs: 外表低调的信封，其中装有参与德波大饭店的拍卖会的邀请函。调查「黑钱领主」最关键的一战，便要从这场拍卖会切入正题…
desc_en: A plain-looking envelope, containing an invitation letter for an auction at the Hotel Debord. The most critical showdown in the case of the "Dark Financier" begins with this very event...

desc_chs: 一张画有悠悠度假村各大区域的手绘地图，轻轻载起了客人们对游乐项目的美妙憧憬。
desc_en: A hand-drawn map displaying all of the Easybreeze Holiday Resort's many areas and gently sparking excitement for the fun attractions to come.

desc_chs: (test)5.8-花田阅读物-无实际道具
(test)5.8-冒险区阅读物-无实际道具
豚兽大王赠与的画片，似乎拍摄了悠悠度假村中的某处。在旅行的途中留意一下吧。
desc_en: A picture given to you by the Capybara King that appears to capture a certain place in the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. Keep an eye out during your travels.

desc_chs: 「咔阿夏」赠与的画片，似乎拍摄了悠悠集市的某处。和伙伴们一起去看看吧！
desc_en: A picture given to you by Cacasha that appears to capture a certain place in the Easybreeze Market. Take your companions and have a look!

desc_chs: 从巴窟纳瓦残躯中发现的笔记。
desc_en: Notes discovered in the remains of Bakunawa.

desc_chs: 从巴窟纳瓦残躯中发现的笔记。
desc_en: Notes discovered in the remains of Bakunawa.

desc_chs: 从巴窟纳瓦残躯中发现的笔记，遍布腐蚀痕迹。
desc_en: Notes showing signs of corrosion discovered in the remains of Bakunawa.

desc_chs: 渊上赠予的花。你清晰记得，那是一朵刚刚摘下的鲜嫩花朵。不知何时变成了这般模样。
desc_en: A flower gifted to you by Enjou. Once a delicate bloom, freshly picked — when did it become like this?

desc_chs: (test)流彩的踪迹阅读物
从秘谜书屋处购得的投资券。\n一周一次，可以找书屋老板萨维特结算投资回报。
desc_en: A coupon purchased from Mimisbrunnr Books.\nCan be used to tabulate one's investment returns once a week from Dhabit, the bookstore owner.

desc_chs: 悠悠度假村以阿夏为形象制作的徽章，代表了度假村对你的认可。可用来在悠悠度假村内特定的地方兑换特殊道具。
desc_en: An Asha-inspired badge produced by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort to show their appreciation. It can be exchanged for special items at a certain location within the resort.

desc_chs: 在秘谜书屋处用投资券结算换得的投资回报。虽然投资有风险，盈亏都是常事，但显然，潜在的丰厚回报总是能吸引不少投资人。
desc_en: Returns from one's investment in the portfolio promoted at Mimisbrunnr Books. All investments involve risks, and profit and loss are both common in the industry, but it would seem that generous returns are always an attractive prospect.

desc_chs: 装有糖雕的匣子。为了避免糖雕融化，还请尽快食用。
desc_en: A box containing delicate sugar sculptures. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

name_chs: 松伽塔的燃素锻造记事
desc_chs: 松伽塔的燃素锻造记事
desc_en: Sundjatta's Phlogiston Forge Notes

desc_chs: 司巫的记录·其一
desc_en: Priestess's Records: I

desc_chs: 司巫的记录·其二
desc_en: Priestess's Records: II

desc_chs: 司巫的记录·其三
desc_en: Priestess's Records: III

desc_chs: 漫步黑渊的战士所携带的铜铃，在无光的夜里常常能听到它的哀鸣。
desc_en: A bronze bell that was carried by a warrior who strode the dark abyss. Its peal can be heard on pitch-black nights.

desc_chs: 过去曾用来召集守誓之人的号角，如今早已失去其作用。
desc_en: A horn that was once used to summon those who had sworn oaths. It has long since lost its purpose.

desc_chs: 古老而沉重的头盔，是标识了北方古老战士家系的传承之物。
desc_en: An ancient heavy helmet. It is an heirloom that bears the mark of a venerable lineage of northern warriors.

name_en: Medicine from the Curatorium of Secrets
desc_chs: 用于治疗「月矩力适应性缺陷」的特效药，效果很好，但也难以入手。那夏镇的人往往会借助「秘闻馆」的特殊渠道获得这种药品，当然，通常价格也会再涨一截…
desc_en: A special medication for treating "congenital kuuvahki sensitivity." Highly effective but hard to come by, the locals of Nod-Krai often rely on "special channels" — the Curatorium of Secrets — to get their hands on it. The price usually comes with a significant markup...

desc_chs: 由「执灯人」调查并记录的「狂猎」现象的位置分布图，理论上属于内部资料。
desc_en: A map showing the locations of "Wild Hunt" phenomena, investigated and recorded by the Lightkeepers. In theory, this information is for internal use only.

desc_chs: 沾染锈迹的假花，据说是盗宝团的创立者雷德·米勒留下的信物。
desc_en: An artificial flower stained with rust. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders.

desc_chs: 如夜幕般漆黑的鸦羽，据说是盗宝团的创立者雷德·米勒留下的信物。
desc_en: A feather as dark as night. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders.

desc_chs: 早已停转的时计，据说是盗宝团的创立者雷德·米勒留下的信物。
desc_en: A timepiece long since stopped. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders.

desc_chs: 装饰华美的酒杯，据说是盗宝团的创立者雷德·米勒留下的信物。
desc_en: A goblet lavishly adorned. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders.

desc_chs: 用以遮蔽真容的冰冷假面，据说是盗宝团的创立者雷德·米勒留下的信物。其上没有镶嵌任何装饰，唯有霜色的月光流连于纯银之间。
desc_en: A cold mask that once concealed a true face. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders. No adornments grace the mask but for the frosty moonlight that dances across its pure silver facade.

desc_chs: 装有特制糖雕的匣子。里面装着的糖雕似乎是针对某人定制。无论如何，为了避免糖雕融化，还请尽快食用。
desc_en: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

desc_chs: 装有特制糖雕的匣子。里面装着的糖雕似乎是针对某人定制。无论如何，为了避免糖雕融化，还请尽快食用。
desc_en: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

desc_chs: 装有特制糖雕的匣子。里面装着的糖雕似乎是针对某人定制。无论如何，为了避免糖雕融化，还请尽快食用。
desc_en: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

desc_chs: 装有特制糖雕的匣子。里面装着的糖雕似乎是针对某人定制。无论如何，为了避免糖雕融化，还请尽快食用。
desc_en: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

desc_chs: 用以维修「末日净化系统」的备用手轮。虽然没有生锈，但不知为何依然散发着一股淡淡的、挥之不去的铁锈味。
desc_en: A spare handwheel used for maintaining the Doomsday Purification System. It shows no signs of rust, yet for some reason it still carries a faint, lingering scent of iron.

name_chs: 悬赏证物：欺诈师的红绸
desc_chs: 用以遮盖眼睛的红色绸缎，可以在「旗舰」作为完成悬赏的证物交付。\n「有些人用华美的织物遮蔽住自己的双眼，有些人则用他们想要听到的话语遮蔽住了自己的心。正如须弥古老的悬诗所言——世人甘愿受骗。」
desc_en: A piece of red satin used to cover the eyes. It can be submitted at "The Flagship" as proof of a bounty fulfilled.\n"Some use luxurious fabric to obscure their eyes, while others veil their hearts with words they wish to hear. As they say in Sumeru, 'Everyone has lies they want to believe.'"

desc_chs: 破损的发条机关齿轮，可以在「旗舰」作为完成悬赏的证物交付。\n「『啊，我值得尊敬的先生，那一天，那一天！我目睹了那位淑女的芳容，也正是因为如此，我的心儿依然寝食难安——她不愿让人对她发号施令，若是您要去见她的话，也千万要当心，不要像火前的飞蛾那般，太过接近她的美。』」
desc_en: A broken gear from the clockwork meka. It can be submitted at "The Flagship" as proof of a bounty fulfilled.\n"'Ah, my good sir, I could never forget the day I first laid eyes on that lady's captivating grace. Since that moment, she has never left my thoughts. She's not one to obey the will of others. If you should meet her, tread carefully — don't be drawn in by her dazzling beauty, like a moth to a flame.'"

desc_chs: 装配在稻妻刀剑上的护具，见证过许多战斗，可以在「旗舰」作为完成悬赏的证物交付。\n「浮世此身哀，徒樱散尽不相待，春去难再来。」
desc_en: A protective guard from an Inazuman blade that has witnessed countless battles. It can be submitted at "The Flagship" as proof of a bounty fulfilled.\n"This fleeting world — a body clad in sorrow. Cherry blossoms fall, untended by tomorrow. Spring departs, never to return."

desc_chs: 由「秘闻馆」中的人士所调查且记载下的情报。或许冒险家协会对此会有兴趣…
desc_en: A record of intel procured and documented by an agent of the Curatorium of Secrets. The Adventurers' Guild might find this interesting...

desc_chs: 字迹潦草的手记·其一
desc_en: Messily-Scribbled Notes (I)

desc_chs: 字迹潦草的手记·其二
desc_en: Messily-Scribbled Notes (II)

desc_chs: 字迹潦草的手记·其三
desc_en: Messily-Scribbled Notes (III)

desc_chs: 字迹潦草的手记·其四
desc_en: Messily-Scribbled Notes (IV)

desc_chs: 似乎是愚人众用来储存数据的卡带，不知道其中记录了怎样的内容。
desc_en: A cassette that seems to be used by the Fatui for storing data. Who knows what information this one contains?

desc_chs: 字迹工整的便条
desc_en: Neatly-Written Note

desc_chs: 巡逻记录
desc_en: Patrol Records

desc_chs: 迪玛的检讨书
desc_en: Dima's Reflection

desc_chs: 密密麻麻写满了字，不过难以辨认内容。
desc_en: Densely covered with writing, the meaning of which is difficult to make out.

desc_chs: (test)在黑沙滩上，孩子丢失的书页
(test)在黑沙滩上，孩子丢失的书页

name_chs: 印有海螺纹样的笔记本
desc_chs: 手工制作的笔记本，有明显的使用痕迹。
desc_en: A handmade notebook, visibly worn from frequent use.

desc_chs: 在印有海螺纹样的纸张上写就的笔记。\n记录了谢苗在绯沙盐沼的所见，包括了他对花缨水母的观察，以及他对水母生存状况的担忧。
desc_en: Notes written on pages printed with a conch pattern.\nThe notes are Semyon's observations at Maroon Basin, including his observations on Tassel Jellies, and his concerns about their living conditions.

desc_chs: 坠毁的采集器内保存的打孔纸带，记录了重要的实验数据。
desc_en: A punched tape recovered from the crashed collector, recording important experimental data.

desc_chs: 方格尔为获取高空实验数据而研发的装置。\n虽然已经移除了数据采集的模块，但仍有抵御雷击伤害的功能，不过，似乎仅限挪德卡莱地区特殊的落雷…
desc_en: A device developed by Fanngel for the collection of data from high-altitude experiments.\nIts data collection module has been removed, but it can still block damage from lightning strikes. Although it only seems to be effective against the special lightning strikes in Nod-Krai...

desc_chs: (test）灯塔信号说明
(test)灯内纸条
列兵的手记·其三
desc_en: Private's Notes (III)

desc_chs: 列兵的手记·其一
desc_en: Private's Notes (I)

desc_chs: 列兵的手记·其二
desc_en: Private's Notes (II)

desc_chs: 谁人的研究手记
desc_en: Someone's Research Notes

desc_chs: （test）ID被阅读物占用了
desc_en: (test) ID used by Readable

desc_chs: （test）ID被阅读物占用了
desc_en: (test) ID used by Readable

desc_chs: （test）ID被阅读物占用了
desc_en: (test) ID used by Readable

desc_chs: 试图在集装箱藏身时不小心从某个女孩那儿拿到的鼓鼓囊囊的工具包，不知道里面装了什么工具。\n或许得想个办法还给她…
desc_en: A bulging toolkit accidentally taken from the girl while trying to hide in that container. It's unclear what tools are inside.\nMaybe you should figure out a way to return it to her...

name_chs: 月矩力试验设计局平面图
name_en: Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau Floor Plan

desc_chs: 形似发条钥匙的备用部件，似乎可以用来唤醒「铁鲸上校」。
desc_en: A spare part that looks like a clockwork key. Seems like it can be used to awaken Colonel Iron Whale.

desc_chs: 操作升降梯的拉杆，不知为何被盗宝鼬偷走。
desc_en: A lever for operating a lift. For reasons unknown, it was stolen by a Weasel Thief.

name_chs: 与「铁鲸上校」合影的画片
desc_chs: 找回全部丢失的碎片后，重新拼合的画片。\n画片背面有一行字迹歪歪扭扭的留言：「我是个坏孩子。但是谢谢你，这句不是谎话。」
desc_en: A photo pieced back together from recovered fragments.\nScrawled messily on the back are the words: "I'm a bad kid, but thank you. This time, it's not a lie."

desc_chs: 装有特制糖雕的匣子。里面装着的糖雕似乎是针对某人定制。无论如何，为了避免糖雕融化，还请尽快食用。
desc_en: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

desc_chs: 与「地隐会」交易用的物品。\n按茜斯柯的说法，收集足够多的老旧的便携轴承，就能从「地隐会」那边换回各种好东西，瓦伊诺的靶标也在其中。
desc_en: An item that can be traded with the Hollowhands.\nAccording to Sisko, once you've collected enough Old Portable Bearings, you can trade them with The Hollowhands for a variety of valuable goods, including Vaino's targets.

desc_chs: 在蓝珀湖附近的洵波草内常能发现的形如星星的奇特果实，似乎蕴含着神秘的能量…
desc_en: A strange, star-shaped fruit that can often be found among the Rippleweeds beside Blue Amber Lake. It seems to contain a mysterious power...

desc_chs: 瓦伊诺的训练场所用的靶标，总是会莫名其妙地遗失。
desc_en: A target from Vaino's training ground. It always seems to get lost for some reason.

desc_chs: 在印有海螺纹样的纸张上写就的笔记。\n看起来似乎是奥妮写作的，以在莫雷谷生活的嗅嗅鼹鼠为主角的故事。据说其中也有真实的部分，不过究竟是哪部分呢…
desc_en: Notes written on pages printed with a conch pattern.\nIt seems that this story, set in Moleyvalley and starring Sniffer Moles, was written by Auni. Elements of the story are claimed to be true, but which would they be...

desc_chs: 记载着所有曾获悉情报的册子。或许，这些情报还能在日后派上用场…
desc_en: A booklet comprising all the intelligence that has been obtained so far. The information within may come in handy in the future...

desc_chs: 德兹斯拉沃留下的博比克的操作系统备份模组。\n能快速恢复博比克的底层系统，并允许使用者手动添加或更改系统指令。
desc_en: A backup module left by Drzislav for Bobik's operating system.\nIt can restore Bobik's underlying systems quickly and allow the user to manually add or modify system commands.

desc_chs: 即使缺损了一部分，仍依稀可以辨认出画片上的人物与背景。
desc_en: Despite some damage, you can still just about make out both the people and the background in this image.

desc_chs: 即使缺损了一部分，仍依稀可以辨认出画片上的人物与背景。
desc_en: Despite some damage, you can still just about make out both the people and the background in this image.

desc_chs: 即使缺损了一部分，仍依稀可以辨认出画片上的人物与背景。
desc_en: Despite some damage, you can still just about make out both the people and the background in this image.

desc_chs: 即使缺损了一部分，仍依稀可以辨认出画片上的人物与背景。
desc_en: Despite some damage, you can still just about make out both the people and the background in this image.

desc_chs: 已开启的密信
desc_en: Opened Secret Letter

desc_chs: 由米卡护送，从蒙德远道而来的苹果酿。据说，是某位骑兵队长提前建议，要送给你的礼物…
desc_en: Escorted all the way from Mondstadt by Mika, this Apple Cider is said to be a present prompted by a certain Cavalry Captain's proposal...
effect_desc_chs: 立即为选中的角色恢复生命值上限的26%，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复570点生命值。

desc_chs: 在梅赫拉克的帮助下找到的钥匙。有个话不多还贴心的助手真好。
desc_en: A key discovered with Mehrak's help. It's nice having a quiet yet considerate assistant by your side.

desc_chs: 在遗迹四处搜集到的笔记，纸张脆弱泛黄，似乎经历了漫长的岁月。
desc_en: Notes salvaged from all over the ruins. Based on the state of the fragile, yellowed paper, they appear to have endured the passage of many, many years.

desc_chs: 小心地将字迹相同的笔记按照日期整理好了顺序。似乎记录了某人在此地的「冒险」经历。
desc_en: Notes with matching handwriting that have been painstakingly arranged in chronological order. These appear to chronicle a certain person's "adventures" in this place.

desc_chs: 金闪闪的钥匙，光是钥匙本身就有不菲的价值。
desc_en: A gleaming golden key. The key itself is worth a fortune.

desc_chs: 银灿灿的钥匙，稍逊于金钥匙，但也并非寻常之物。
desc_en: A shining silver key. Not as valuable as the golden one, but it is also far from ordinary.

desc_chs: 普通的铁钥匙，即使在众多钥匙之中，也是最为普通，随处可见的一种。
desc_en: A plain iron key, one of the most ordinary and easy-to-find keys around.

desc_chs: 普通的铁钥匙，即使在众多钥匙之中，也是最为普通，随处可见的一种。
desc_en: A plain iron key, one of the most ordinary and easy-to-find keys around.

desc_chs: 和通常所见的铁钱有几分相似的硬币，或许是铁钱的一种？
desc_en: A coin that resembles a common iron coin, though it may be a different variant.

desc_chs: 将从海螺帮的孩子们那里得到的笔记收纳在一起，由派蒙制作的笔记本。
desc_en: A notebook compiled by Paimon containing a collection of notes obtained from the Conch Gang kids.

desc_chs: 将从海螺帮的孩子们那里得到的笔记收纳在一起，由派蒙制作的笔记本。
desc_en: A notebook compiled by Paimon containing a collection of notes obtained from the Conch Gang kids.

name_chs: 大盗雷德·米勒传奇·卷一
name_en: The Legends of Reed Miller, Thief Extraordinaire (I)
desc_chs: 流行于挪德卡莱的娱乐读物，并非出自同一套书籍，而是由不同作者写成的、诸多关于雷德·米勒的廉价小说，内容的真实程度和纸张印刷的质量相仿。
desc_en: An anthology of pulp fiction stories based on the exploits of Reed Miller that is wildly popular throughout Nod-Krai. Collated from various works and authors, the veracity of the stories within is as dubious as the quality of the paper they are printed on.

name_chs: 大盗雷德·米勒传奇·卷二
name_en: The Legends of Reed Miller, Thief Extraordinaire (II)

desc_chs: 流行于挪德卡莱的娱乐读物，并非出自同一套书籍，而是由不同作者写成的、诸多关于雷德·米勒的廉价小说，内容的真实程度和纸张印刷的质量相仿。
desc_en: An anthology of pulp fiction stories based on the exploits of Reed Miller that is wildly popular throughout Nod-Krai. Collated from various works and authors, the veracity of the stories within is as dubious as the quality of the paper they are printed on.

desc_chs: 霜月之子世代流传的祷歌集，由执祭安洛丝编纂而成，其中的大多数内容与祭礼如今均已被废止。
desc_en: A book of hymns passed down for generations among the Frostmoon Scions, compiled by the priestess Ehrnrooth. Most of its contents, and the rites they serve, have long since fallen into disuse.

desc_chs: 霜月之子世代流传的祷歌集，由执祭安洛丝编纂而成，其中的大多数内容与祭礼如今均已被废止。
desc_en: A book of hymns passed down for generations among the Frostmoon Scions, compiled by the priestess Ehrnrooth. Most of its contents, and the rites they serve, have long since fallen into disuse.

desc_en: A book of hymns passed down for generations among the Frostmoon Scions, compiled by the priestess Ehrnrooth. Most of its contents, and the rites they serve, have long since fallen into disuse.

desc_chs: 始终在此地流传的，手持海螺发言的孩子们在空无一人的边陲荒地发生的故事，事到如今，已经没人知道最初的作者究竟是谁…
desc_en: A tale passed down in this land since the earliest times, telling of children who spoke bearing conch shells in the empty frontier wastelands. The original author has long since been forgotten...

desc_chs: 始终在此地流传的，手持海螺发言的孩子们在空无一人的边陲荒地发生的故事，事到如今，已经没人知道最初的作者究竟是谁…
desc_en: A tale passed down in this land since the earliest times, telling of children who spoke bearing conch shells in the empty frontier wastelands. The original author has long since been forgotten...

desc_chs: 在印有海螺纹样的纸张上写就的笔记。\n梅蒂对尚未被月矩力影响的蟹沙皇的观察记录，其中似乎掺杂了大量未经证实过的、对螃蟹社会形态的主观猜测。
desc_en: Notes written on pages printed with a conch pattern.\nThese are observation notes written by Maite about the Crab Tsar before it became influenced by kuuvahki. They contain a great deal of unverified speculation about brachyuran society.

name_en: The Man Who Became a Mule
desc_chs: 由冒险家协会所搜集来的童话书，里面记载了一则源自于沙漠的童话。
desc_en: A storybook gathered by the Adventurers' Guild. It tells a fairy tale that originated in the desert.

desc_chs: （test）6.1普通情报任务，在火堆边找到的真隐者的日记。
已经不再新鲜的种子，哪怕是不得已的情况，吃下它或许也不是一个好的选择。
desc_en: An old seed that's long past fresh. Even in desperate times, it's probably not a good idea to eat it.

desc_chs: 灰褐色的穗子，隐约可以闻到一丝发霉的气息…
desc_en: Gray-brown grain, carrying a subtle whiff of mold...

desc_chs: 散发着神秘气息的新鲜肉块。不知道吃起来会是什么味道呢？
desc_en: A fresh chunk of meat that seems to be radiating an enigmatic aura. Wonder what it'll taste like?

desc_chs: 从箱子里取出来的一部分「秘闻馆」资金。千金不易得，谨慎使用。
desc_en: A sum of money taken from the chest containing the Curatorium of Secrets's funds. Money doesn't grow on trees, so spend it wisely.

desc_chs: 从箱子里取出来的一部分「秘闻馆」资金。千金不易得，谨慎使用。
desc_en: A sum of money taken from the chest containing the Curatorium of Secrets's funds. Money doesn't grow on trees, so spend it wisely.

desc_chs: 从箱子里取出来的一部分「秘闻馆」资金。千金不易得，谨慎使用。
desc_en: A sum of money taken from the chest containing the Curatorium of Secrets's funds. Money doesn't grow on trees, so spend it wisely.

desc_chs: 搭载了乐平波琳最新研发的「瞬影」镜头的特制留影机。\n其精密的内部结构，足以将飞鸟的振翅与剑士的锋芒都凝固于一瞬。它能捕捉极致的速度，也能留住最珍贵的画面——与友人重逢时，那每一个闪闪发光的、值得被珍藏的瞬间。
desc_en: A custom-built Kamera equipped with Lepine-Pauline's latest "Shutterflash" lens.\nIts intricate inner workings can freeze the flutter of a bird's wings or the flash of a swordsman's strike in an instant. It captures the swiftest motion and preserves the most precious scenes, including every shining moment worth remembering when you reunite with friends.

name_en: The Shiniest and Brightest Beryl Conch
desc_chs: 答应了芙佳，要为她精挑细选，采集最亮最闪的苍晶螺。
desc_en: You promised Puca that you would carefully select and gather the shiniest and brightest Beryl Conches for her.

desc_chs: 如卵状的石头，蕴含着「灰眸」寻回自己身躯所需要的力量。\n一度为名为阿尔维斯的矮灵大公瓜分并取走的力量，不知如何被阿克西妮娅取得并放置在了已然成为遗迹的谧源所的空壳之中。其中或许蕴藏着平俗之人如何通过重新诞生而转变为更完善的生命的秘密。
desc_en: An egg-shaped stone infused with the power required for the Eye of Graeae to reclaim his physical form.\nOnce divided and seized by the Domovoy lord Alvis, its power was acquired by Aksinya through unknown means and placed within the hollow remains of the Alypium. Hidden within it may lie the secret of how, through rebirth, a mere mortal might transcend into a more perfect being.

desc_chs: 形如指针的钥匙。\n可以打开「谧源所」里，雪孃大公的研究室大门。
desc_en: A needle-like key.\nIt unlocks the laboratory doors of the Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka within the Alypium.

desc_chs: 似乎是名为帕芙琳娜的雪孃大公为养在「谧源所」内，名为「拉拉」的猫准备的食粮…闻起来有点香，但毕竟是猫粮，所以大概没什么味道吧。
desc_en: It appears to be food prepared by Pavlina, the Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka, for a cat named Lala who was kept within the Alypium... It smells rather tempting — but at the end of the day, it's just cat food, so it probably tastes like cardboard.

desc_chs: 「黄金」莱茵多特赠给阿贝多的礼物。\n一份新礼物，一份新问题。
desc_en: A gift from "Gold" Rhinedottir to Albedo.\nA new gift, a new quest.

desc_chs: 由伊赫安提所做的「玩偶」，和雅珂达之前所做的某种玩偶有所相似。
desc_en: A doll crafted by Ihanti, bearing a certain resemblance to some dolls previously made by Jahoda.

desc_chs: 由复数「愚人众」分别保管的重要徽记，只有集齐三枚徽记才能启动通向深处房间的装置。至于为什么一定要三枚，魔女的解释是「参与感」。
desc_en: One of a set of important insignia kept in separation by members of the Fatui. Only by gathering all three can the device leading to the inner chamber be activated. As for why there must be three, the mage merely explained that it was to create a "sense of participation."

desc_chs: 来自彻底被深渊污染的特瓦林。从泪滴的状态能判断故事中的特瓦林已无被治愈的可能。
desc_en: From a Dvalin completely consumed by the Abyss. The state of this tear reveals that the Dvalin in the story is beyond hope of healing.

desc_chs: （test）6.2雅珂达情报任务信件阅读物
装有特制糖雕的匣子。里面装着的糖雕似乎是针对某人定制。无论如何，为了避免糖雕融化，还请尽快食用。
desc_en: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

desc_chs: 从箱子里取出来的一部分「秘闻馆」资金。千金不易得，谨慎使用。
desc_en: A sum of money taken from the chest containing the Curatorium of Secrets's funds. Money doesn't grow on trees, so spend it wisely.

desc_chs: 那夏镇「祈月之夜」上发放的导览册，内部展示了许多可供游玩的有趣摊位。足以让参与者留下一晚难忘的回忆。
desc_en: A pamphlet handed out at Nasha Town's Moon-Prayer Night. It highlights a variety of fun booths and activities. With it in hand, guests are sure to enjoy an evening they won't soon forget.

desc_chs: 同伴们为哥伦比娅准备的祈月之夜贺卡，包含着大家对哥伦比娅的祝福。愿她不论身处何处，都能想起今夜朋友们的笑容。
desc_en: A greeting card prepared by Columbina's companions for Moon-Prayer Night. It carries their heartfelt wishes, hoping that wherever she is, she will remember the smiles they shared tonight.

name_chs: 哥伦比娅准备的祈月糖
desc_chs: 哥伦比娅为大家准备的祈月糖。在她的奇思妙想下，糖果呈现出了许许多多奇特的味道，或许也是存在于她记忆中的味道。
desc_en: A Moon-Prayer Candy made by Columbina for everyone to enjoy. Inspired by her boundless imagination, this candy holds a wide variety of surprising flavors, perhaps drawn from the tastes she remembers most fondly.

name_chs: 哥伦比娅准备的祈月糖
desc_chs: 哥伦比娅为大家准备的祈月糖。在她的奇思妙想下，糖果呈现出了许许多多奇特的味道，或许也是存在于她记忆中的味道。
desc_en: A Moon-Prayer Candy made by Columbina for everyone to enjoy. Inspired by her boundless imagination, this candy holds a wide variety of surprising flavors, perhaps drawn from the tastes she remembers most fondly.

desc_chs: 以纳塔本地传说为蓝本的历史幻想系漫画织卷——《炽魂斗士战记》，现已推出典藏版。\n英雄们悉数登场，光芒于风云际会之时交相辉映，在残酷的战斗中用生命为后世开辟道路！
desc_en: The Soulblazer Saga, a historical fantasy comic series based on Natlan's local legends, is now available in a collector's edition!\nHeroes assemble, their brilliance shining brightest when destinies collide, forging a path for future generations with their lives through the crucible of fierce battles.

desc_chs: 魔女M留下的魔法书最终还是要交给杜林，让他继续书写下去。艾莉丝为它制作了一件复制品，并将其送给了你。毕竟你是这个故事的见证者，没有纪念品可不行。当然，这件复制品没有神奇的魔法，但精彩的桥段都不缺。
desc_en: The magic book left by "M" must ultimately be handed over to Durin, allowing him to continue writing the story. Alice created a replica of it and gifted it to you. After all, as a witness to this tale, you deserve a keepsake. Of course, this replica lacks any magical properties, but it for sure preserves all the twists and turns.

name_en: Lantern Rite Gift: Gift of Radiant Night
desc_chs: 总务司所准备的贵重海灯节礼。可以用吉语钱兑换。
desc_en: A precious Lantern Rite gift prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be redeemed with Fortune Coins.

desc_chs: （test)探索完盗宝洞POI的证明
在说书人的故事里，人们将各类美好的心愿寄托在霄灯之上，放飞至高天。但是，这些心愿也曾遭妖魔吞噬，所幸有仙人出手，护得了这些心愿的周全…
desc_en: In the storytellers' tales, people entrusted their wishes to the Xiao Lanterns before releasing them into the sky. Yet there was a time when fiends sought to devour those wishes. Thanks to the intervention of an adeptus, their ascent was safeguarded...

desc_chs: 在说书人的故事里，某些强大的妖魔就连月光也能吞噬。为了救出被吞噬的月光，那位仙人也曾多次出手…
desc_en: In the storytellers' tales, there were once powerful demons that could devour the moonlight. To reclaim the radiance they had consumed, that adeptus stepped forward time and time again...

用于开启下水道控制室大门的三张钥匙卡之一，呈白色。
用于开启下水道控制室大门的三张钥匙卡之一，呈蓝色。
奇妙的请柬，似乎总会经由各种方式送到应当送到的人手中。\n手持这份「请柬」，便可前往至冬冰山上的赫斯珀利德斯之馆，参加雪孃王公帕芙琳娜的婚礼。

name_chs: 被分离的伊科尔的碎片
desc_chs: 被打断「仪式」的阿克西妮娅分离出去的伊科尔力量的碎片。\n不知道为什么化作了散发光芒的人偶的样貌。或许「达成他人愿望」的意志在许久以前就成为了操控他的丝线，而现在的他不过是承载着某种超越之力的傀儡偶人罢了。
集齐3个印磐后，可开启虚海望宝库。\n\n在探索时偶然得到的圆形符印，如能找到纹样相同的3个，似乎就能拼凑出曾经照亮世界的皓月的影迹。
desc_en: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Voidsea Outlook.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

desc_en: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Ashveil Peak.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

desc_chs: 沉甸甸的袋子，里面装满了能够打动「视财如命」之人的筹码，好像叫「诚意」吧？
desc_en: A heavy pouch filled with tokens capable of swaying those who "value wealth above all else." To some, this appears to be what passes for "sincerity"...

desc_en: A photo titled by Paimon, capturing a moment of shared laughter among three friends.

desc_en: An Ancient Poem

desc_chs: 由「仆人」转交给你的，桑多涅的遗物。记录了许多有关桑多涅的内容。\n虽然外表和书页有些陈旧，但不难看出笔记本主人对它的爱惜。
desc_en: A relic from Sandrone, passed to you by The Knave. Its pages record many matters related to Sandrone.\nAlthough its cover and pages are worn with age, it is easy to see how much its owner once treasured it.

name_en: That Which Has Lost Its Power
desc_chs: 一件灵气已散尽的奇物，形制古朴，由美玉和青铜打造，正静待着重新焕发光彩的时刻。
desc_en: A curio whose power has faded away. Crafted from fine jade and bronze, it now waits quietly for the moment it might shine once more.

desc_chs: 刚从地里收割的麦子，散发着温暖的气息。要经过研磨与烘烤，才能化为醇厚的滋味。
desc_en: The freshly harvested rye that carries a warm, comforting scent. Only after grinding and baking does it transform into a rich, full-bodied flavor.

desc_chs: （test)某人的纸条，不知道有什么用

古旧的铁质钱币，其上摹刻着鸦印的形状，据说是很久以前的盗宝团创始人雷德·米勒打造出的第一枚真正的「铁钱」。
在没有界限的世界里，在无人忍受饥寒的乐园里，贵金之神所赐予、所掌控的金钱，不该成为人与人之间互助的定础。
「人」应当是金钱之主，而非其仆役。即使无法成为黄金之心的主人，也该让所有人平等掌控本就属于所有人的财富——

但那也已经是很久以后的故事了。无论是最初的铁钱，还是在其后的数百年间，为不同的人传唱、解读、扭曲的理想，
在那灯光所未及的冬夜，也不过是躲避着大人们的视线、偷偷溜出学院的二人，为扮演侠盗的游戏而刻下的代币罢了。
desc_en:
An aged iron coin engraved with a stylized raven sigil. Legend says it was forged by Reed Miller, founder of the Treasure Hoarders, and was the very first true "Iron Coin."
In a world without borders, in a paradise where no one suffers from hunger or cold, the gold bestowed and governed by the Deus Auri was never meant to serve as the foundation of human cooperation.
Humans should be masters of money, not its servants. Even if one cannot claim the heart of gold for themselves, all should be able to wield the wealth that inherently belongs to everyone.

But that is a story of a much later time. Whether it was the first iron coin or the ideals sung, interpreted, and twisted over the following centuries,
it all began on a winter night beyond the reach of lamplight, when two children slipped out of the academy, hiding from the adults' eyes, and carved a token for playing the Thief Extraordinaire.

desc_en: A photo titled by Paimon, capturing a moment of shared laughter among three friends.

desc_chs: 能够展开结界的神圣灯盏，由于能量耗尽而变得黯淡无光。\n原本是霜月之子的祭器，曾为彷徨在失乐荒土上的古国遗民带去梦与诗歌，因遗落在光阴凝滞的「高塔」中而保存至今。
desc_en: A sacred lamp capable of forming a protective barrier, now dimmed after its energy is depleted.\nOnce a ritual vessel of the Frostmoon Scions, it brought dreams and song to the lost people wandering the desolate lands. It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.

desc_chs: 能够展开结界的神圣灯盏，其中散发着暗弱的光芒。\n原本是霜月之子的祭器，曾为彷徨在失乐荒土上的古国遗民带去梦与诗歌，因遗落在光阴凝滞的「高塔」中而保存至今。

It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.

desc_chs: 能够展开结界的神圣灯盏，其中散发着微亮的光芒。\n原本是霜月之子的祭器，曾为彷徨在失乐荒土上的古国遗民带去梦与诗歌，因遗落在光阴凝滞的「高塔」中而保存至今。
desc_en: A sacred lamp capable of forming a protective barrier, its faint light shimmering quietly.\nOnce a ritual vessel of the Frostmoon Scions, it brought dreams and song to the lost people wandering the desolate lands. It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.

desc_chs: 能够展开结界的神圣灯盏，其中充满了能量，熠熠生辉。\n原本是霜月之子的祭器，曾为彷徨在失乐荒土上的古国遗民带去梦与诗歌，因遗落在光阴凝滞的「高塔」中而保存至今。
desc_en: A sacred lamp capable of forming a protective barrier, brimming with energy and shining brilliantly.\nOnce a ritual vessel of the Frostmoon Scions, it brought dreams and song to the lost people wandering the desolate lands. It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.

desc_chs: 或许可以打开某扇门。
desc_en: This might open a door somewhere.

desc_chs: 从皮拉米达城西侧某个奇怪终端处获得的密钥卡，形制平平无奇。\n据说可以用来开启终端下方的避难所大门。
desc_en: A key card obtained from a peculiar terminal on the west side of Piramida. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.\nFrom what you've been told, it should grant access to the bunker beneath the terminal.

desc_chs: 在实验区域获得的密钥卡，形制平平无奇。\n其上印刷着工整的至冬文字：「高阶维修工阿列克谢·扎卡列维奇·柯泰尼科夫」。
desc_en: A key card obtained from an experiment site. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.\nNeat Snezhnayan text has been printed onto its surface: "Senior Maintenance Technician Aleksey Zakharevich Kotelnikov."

desc_chs: 在实验区域获得的密钥卡，形制平平无奇。\n其上印刷着工整的至冬文字：「主研究员格蕾兹娜·米科卢霍」。
desc_en: A key card obtained from an experiment site. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.\nNeat Snezhnayan text has been printed onto its surface: "Chief Researcher Grazina Myklukho."

name_chs: 古老的日志（卡特·谢尔比乌斯）
古老的日志（阿兰·吉约丹）
古老的日志（雅各布·英戈德）
大师鲁杰罗的研究笔记
name_en: The Research Notes of Master Ruggiero
The History of the Decline and Fall of Remuria

name_chs: 秋分布道听记·关于末日
name_en: Automnequi Sermon Dictation: Concerning the Apocalypse

name_chs: 秋分布道听记·密合的解释
name_en: Automnequi Sermon Dictation: Explications on the Chymical Marriage

name_chs: 大侦探赫尔洛克·炼金士与发条圣人
name_en: Great Detective Hurlock: The Alchemist and the Clockwork Saint

desc_chs: （test)关押霜精的牢笼钥匙
由西风骑士团代理团长琴寄出的邀请函，内容简短，并未提及活动的具体内容。
desc_en: An invitation sent by Jean, Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. The message is brief and makes no mention of the event's details.

desc_chs: 在星落湖寻获的摩拉，虽然看上去和普通的摩拉完全一致，但重量只有正常摩拉的十分之一，导致获得财富的喜悦也变成了十分之一。
desc_en: Mora found at Starfell Lake. Though it looks identical to ordinary Mora, it weighs only one-tenth as much, making the joy of acquiring wealth feel only one-tenth as great.

desc_chs: 在星落湖寻获的鱼肉，虽然看上去和普通的鱼肉完全一致，但具有非常好的弹性，无论怎么用力揉捏，放开之后都会迅速恢复原状。与其说是食材，不如说是某种解压玩具…还是不要尝试烹饪为好。
desc_en: Fish meat found at Starfell Lake. Though it looks like ordinary fish, it is exceptionally elastic — no matter how hard you press it, it quickly returns to its original shape. Rather than a cooking ingredient, it seems more like a method of stress-relief... best not to try eating it.

desc_chs:
协助经营骑士团的调饮小站期间，可莉赠送的纪念品。
「把材料放在炼金台上，许愿一个形状，跟着妈妈念咒语，『嘭~』的一声，嘟嘟可样子的糖果就出现了！」
不愧是艾莉丝女士的作品，即便使用了提瓦特常见的材料，也蕴含着奇妙的复合甜味，浅尝一颗时，脑袋里似乎真的响起了甜美魔法咒语的回响…
可惜数量有限，还是留下一颗当作纪念吧！
desc_en:
A souvenir from Klee during your time helping run the Knights' drinks stand.
"Put everything together on the alchemy table, wish for the shape you want, say Mom's magic words, and... poof! Dodoco-shaped candy!"
As expected of a creation by Ms. Alice. Even using ingredients common across Teyvat, it holds a wonderfully complex sweetness. Take a small bite, and you can almost hear the echo of a sweet magic incantation in your mind...
Unfortunately, the supply is limited. Better keep one as a souvenir!

name_en: A Message From the Legendary Thief Reed Miller

name_chs: 埋放在时间囊中的信笺
name_en: Letter Buried in the Time Capsule
A Brief History of the Pale Starborn
desc_chs: 有关妖精历史的书籍，根据其中的一些细节，世人都认为是妖精中的年长者所作。
desc_en: A book on fae history. Based on certain details within, it's believed to have been written by fae elders.

name_en: Night Murmurs From the Far Border: Varcolac
desc_chs: 流传于至冬的民间故事书，据称讲述了各类不为人知的妖精逸闻。本篇讲述的是名为「鬣兽」的危险妖精。
desc_en: A collection of folktales circulated in Snezhnaya, said to record all kinds of lesser-known fae tales. This volume tells the story of a dangerous fae known as the "Varcolac."

desc_chs: 载有历代执灯长事迹的诗集。大部分内容都在先前的灾厄中佚失，如今能收集的残篇只有原本的一小部分。
desc_en: A poetry collection chronicling the deeds of successive Starshynas. Most of its contents were lost in past calamities. Only a small fraction of the original fragments have been recovered.

desc_chs: 一种利用秘源技艺封装高浓度古月力的人工制品核心。
desc_en: An artificial core that uses Secret Source techniques to encapsulate highly concentrated Archaeolune Energy.

name_en: A Letter Carried by the Wind
desc_chs: 不知何时出现在背包里的信，或许是风吹来的吧。
desc_en: A letter that found its way into your bag at some point. Perhaps it was carried here by the wind.

desc_chs: 法尔伽手绘的请客券，可以在「猎鹿人」餐馆兑换一顿丰盛豪迈的肉食大餐。
desc_en: A hand-drawn invitation ticket from Varka. Can be redeemed at the Good Hunter for a hearty, meat-filled feast.

desc_chs: 法尔伽手绘的请客券，可以在「猎鹿人」餐馆兑换一顿丰盛豪迈的肉食大餐。背面角落里盖了「已使用」的小章。
desc_en: A hand-drawn invitation ticket from Varka. Can be redeemed at the Good Hunter for a hearty, meat-filled feast. A small stamp reading "Used" is marked in the corner on the back.

desc_chs: 法尔伽用来买酒的私房钱，堂而皇之地藏在办公桌的抽屉之内。\n「最危险的地方，就是最安全的地方！」——话是这么说，藏于这里的初衷，大概还是觉得那位代理团长就算发现了也不会拿去花，更不会让其他人发现吧。\n原计划用于购买献予神明的蒲公英酒，但既然现在计划有变，或许可以拿来犒劳救出了法尔伽的荣誉骑士，又或由这位骑士拿去犒劳救出他的每一位朋友。
desc_en: Money Varka has set aside for drinks, brazenly tucked away in a desk drawer.\n"The most dangerous spot is actually the safest spot!" He might claim that, but the truth is he probably keeps the money here because he believes the acting Grand Master will neither spend it nor reveal its hiding place.\nAlthough this money was originally set aside to buy the Dandelion Wine as an offering to the Archon, now that plans have changed, maybe it can be used to reward the Honorary Knight who saved Varka — or given to the knight to reward each friend who helped rescue Varka instead.

desc_chs: 法尔伽用来买酒的私房钱，堂而皇之地藏在办公桌的抽屉之内。\n「最危险的地方，就是最安全的地方！」——话是这么说，藏于这里的初衷，大概还是觉得那位代理团长就算发现了也不会拿去花，更不会让其他人发现吧。\n原计划用于购买献予神明的蒲公英酒，现在已被用于犒劳救出了法尔伽的荣誉骑士，又或可以由这位骑士拿去犒劳救出他的每一位朋友。
desc_en: Money Varka has set aside for drinks, brazenly tucked away in a desk drawer.\n"The most dangerous spot is actually the safest spot!" He might claim that, but the truth is he probably keeps the money here because he believes the acting Grand Master will neither spend it nor reveal its hiding place.\nThis money was originally set aside to buy the Dandelion Wine as an offering to the Archon, and has now been used to reward the Honorary Knight who saved Varka — or perhaps that knight might use it to treat every friend who helped save Varka.

desc_chs: 将各种看不懂的东西记录下来，有朝一日也许能派上用场——机智派蒙的冒险秘诀！
desc_en: Jot down anything Paimon doesn't understand. Who knows? It might come in handy someday! That's a top adventure tip from the clever Paimon!

desc_chs: 没有额外的装饰，美观而不失实用的背包原本的模样。
desc_en: Without any extra ornaments, the backpack is beautiful yet practical in its original form.

desc_chs: 宿影花的徽章，是来自海螺帮的礼物。
desc_en: This Nocturnal Blossom badge is a gift from the Conch Gang.

desc_chs: 虹滴晶的徽章，是来自海螺帮的礼物。
desc_en: This Rainbowdrop Crystal badge is a gift from the Conch Gang.

desc_chs: 银色豚兽的徽章，是来自海螺帮的礼物。
desc_en: This silver Capybara badge is a gift from the Conch Gang.

desc_chs: 独享状态的背包，宽敞舒适。
desc_en: A spacious and comfortable backpack reserved for your exclusive use.

desc_chs: 共享状态的背包，虽然没那么宽敞…但非常热闹。
desc_en: A shared backpack. It's not that spacious... but there's never a dull moment inside!

desc_chs: 与阿瓜拉一起参加「灵使竞冠祭礼」收获的冠军奖牌，看到它就能回忆起阿瓜拉在赛场上的英姿。另外，能够顺利赢下决赛，也离不开莉奈娅和露米的帮助…
desc_en: A champion medal earned alongside Aguara in the "Spirit Envoy Championship." Looking upon it, one can almost see Aguara's heroic figure dominating the arena once more. Of course, this victory in the finals would never have been possible without the help of Linnea and Lumi...

desc_chs: 蒙德香水店「香邂」特制的香氛。\n香调淡雅温柔，仿佛风息山下延袤的花田般，清新而悠长。
desc_en: A special fragrance crafted by Scents and Senses, a perfume shop in Mondstadt.\nThis understated and delicate fragrance, with a sillage that lingers long and fresh in the air, evokes the sweeping flower fields beneath Windrest Peak.

desc_chs: 字迹歪歪斜斜的字条上，写着含混不清的词句。像是喝醉了的人写下的…
desc_en: A note written in a scrawling hand, its muddled words looking like the work of a drunkard...

name_en: Cargo Crate Filled with Heavy Parts
desc_chs: 从魔物手中抢回来的货箱，里边似乎装着金属制品，分量不轻，不知道失主是谁…\n或许在荆夫港里询问骑士们，能找到眉目…
desc_en: A crate reclaimed from monsters. It appears to contain metal goods of considerable weight, though its owner remains a mystery...\nPerhaps inquiring with the knights in Dornman Port might point you toward a lead...

desc_chs: 平平无奇的气球。如同其中蕴藏的风那样，总是渴望着飘向远方。
desc_en: A plain, unremarkable balloon. Like the wind within it, it always longs to drift far, far away...

desc_chs: 一叠纸
desc_en: A Stack of Paper

desc_chs: 如卵状的石头，蕴含着「灰眸」寻回自己身躯所需要的力量。\n一度为名为帕芙琳娜的妖精大公用于弥补妖精本身的残缺。\n其中或许怀抱着平俗之人如何通过重新诞生以企及更高位阶的愿望。
如卵状的石头，蕴含着「灰眸」寻回自己身躯所需要的力量。\n一度被名为卡谢伊的炼金术士用于制造追求永恒的生命。\n其中或许留存着平俗之人如何通过重新诞生以塑造不朽的启示。
经过多洛妲的甄选，用以展出的月落银。仔细观察之下，似乎确实能感受到与普通月落银的不同之处，应该…不只是心理作用吧？
desc_en: Moonfall Silver selected by Dorota for exhibition. A closer look reveals a subtle distinction from common samples... Surely that isn't mere imagination.

desc_chs: 常见于挪德卡莱沿海地带的砾石，特征是其上自然形成的空洞，触碰时总能感到一股隐隐的寒意。\n在古老的传说中，寒涌石上的空洞曾是霜月指引妖灵们避难的居所，亦是通向幽域的门扉。而在另一个流行于那夏镇的故事里，大盗雷德·米勒被围困之时，正是靠着霜月的圣女送给他作为定情信物的符石隐去身形，逃脱了追捕。霜月之子的追随者们坚决否认这样的说法，将其斥为胡言乱语，毕竟现在的寒涌石也的确看不出有如此神奇的效果。
desc_en: A pebble commonly found on Nod-Krai's coasts, characterized by a naturally occurring hollow. Touching it sends a faint chill through your finger.\nAccording to ancient legends, the hollows in these pebbles were once shelters revealed to the fae by the Frost Moon — gateways to the ethereal. In another story popular in Nasha Town, the legendary thief, Reed Miller, was surrounded when a runestone given to him by a holy lady of the Frost Moon as a token of her love allowed him to conceal himself and escape his pursuers. Naturally, the Frostmoon Scions vehemently reject this claim, as these pebbles do not display any such magical properties.

desc_chs: 古时覆盖挪德卡莱的参天巨木，流淌下的树脂凝结而成的宝石，散发着璀璨的色彩。
desc_en: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.

desc_chs: 双色缠络的花卉，有着极强的月矩力亲和性。由于香调淡雅、色泽显明，时常被认为是优质的天然染料。\n彼此相异的色彩被认为是两种不同的月矩力的象征，因此宿影花有时也会被霜月之子的追随者们视为月之少女的祝福。\n据说五百年前的漆黑灾厄结束后数十年，这种造型奇异的花朵才伴着咏月使的故去出现在大地上。霜月之子的诗歌大多采用这种说法，但这种说法从未得到过严谨的考证。
desc_en: A flower in two entwined colors with a strong affinity for kuuvahki. Its light fragrance and conspicuous color have made it an excellent natural dye.\nIts contrasting colors are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, so the followers of the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as the Moon Maiden's blessing.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared decades after the dark calamity ended five hundred years ago, a claim widely reflected in the verses of the Frostmoon Scions, though it has never been rigorously verified.

desc_chs: 形如烛盏的花卉，多生长在水边，香气寒冽素净，有安神的功效。\n花蕊与花茎彼此相异的色彩被认为是两种不同的月矩力的象征，然而霜盏花却是极为罕有的、不会受到月矩力任何影响的植物，因此有时也会被霜月之子的追随者们视为无信者与叛离者的象征。\n据说五百年前的漆黑灾厄结束时，这种造型奇异的花朵才出现在大地上，但这种说法从未得到过严谨的考证。
desc_en: A flower that resembles a candle lamp, commonly found near water. It emits a cold, simple aroma that has a calming effect.\nThe contrasting colors of its stamen and stem are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, yet despite this symbolism, it is one of the few rare plants that are immune to kuuvahki's influence. As a result, the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as a symbol of faithlessness and apostasy.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared at the end of the dark calamity five hundred years ago, but this claim has never been rigorously verified.

desc_chs: 生命力极其顽强的花草，即便历经风吹霜打，依旧在苦寒的冬日里迎风摇曳。
desc_en: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.

desc_chs: 装有特制糖雕的匣子。里面装着的糖雕似乎是针对某人定制。无论如何，为了避免糖雕融化，还请尽快食用。
desc_en: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

desc_chs: （test)神秘的试剂
似乎是名为「屠夫」的帮派成员在搜集资金时获得的线索…也许能找到什么大宝藏。
desc_en: A lead seemingly acquired by a gang member known as "The Butcher" while scraping together funds... Perhaps a massive haul lies waiting to be found.

desc_chs: 由洛恩精心准备的工作报告，需要带给位于西风大教堂的西蒙·佩奇枢机卿。报告准备得相当周全…以至于令人怀疑这是不是出自洛恩的手笔。
desc_en: A comprehensive work report prepared by Lohen for Cardinal Seamus at the Favonius Cathedral. The report is so thorough... It's almost enough to make one doubt if Lohen was the one behind the pen.

desc_chs: （test)霜精戴的帽子，孤独地掉在了井底
（test)霜精村商店修复任务用道具，暂定大雪球
沉甸甸的摩拉袋，袋口闪烁着黄金般闪耀的「友情」。
desc_en: A heavy Mora pouch, its opening shimmering with the golden glow of "friendship."

desc_chs: 已经一空的摩拉袋，袋口曾经闪烁着黄金般闪耀的「友情」。
desc_en: A now-empty Mora pouch, its opening once shimmered with the golden glow of "friendship."

desc_chs: 「棺中的废都·阿卡狄亚」
desc_en: Arcadia, the Entombed Capital

desc_chs: 「瓦力·韦杰的一隅」
desc_en: A Corner of Valivija

name_chs: 少女薇拉的忧郁·最终卷（版本二）
desc_chs: 《少女薇拉的忧郁》系列的最终卷手稿。作者因为对于宇宙某帝国公主的描写引发了原型本人的巨大不满，所以寰宇出版受阻。只有手稿不知为何出现在了这里。\n虞黄衣无法告知究竟哪一卷是女主人姐妹捡来的宇宙漂流物，哪一卷是希尔妲对结局感到愤怒自己写的。因为两份都是手写的手稿。
desc_en: The manuscript for the final volume of the "Vera's Melancholy" series. It was never published, however, because the author's portrayal of a certain princess from a galactic empire incurred enormous resentment from the princess who inspired the character. But somehow, the manuscript has found its way here.\nYu Huangyi cannot tell which volume was a piece of space debris salvaged by the mistress's sisters, and which was written by Hilda out of outrage at the original ending. After all, both are handwritten manuscripts...

name_chs: 少女薇拉的忧郁·最终卷（版本一）
desc_chs: 作者据说创作品德很差。一套故事不停在不同文明星球找出版社出版。严格来说属于一稿多投。可能因此遭到了宇宙某帝国的追杀。\n虞黄衣无法告知究竟哪一卷是女主人姐妹捡来的宇宙漂流物，哪一卷是希尔妲对结局感到愤怒自己写的。因为两份都是手写的手稿。
desc_en: It is said that the author of this work has rather questionable professional ethics — allegedly, the same story has been pitched to publishers as a "new work" again and again on various planets. This is perhaps the reason a kill order has been placed on the writer by a certain galactic empire.\nYu Huangyi cannot tell which volume was a piece of space debris salvaged by the mistress's sisters, and which was written by Hilda out of outrage at the original ending. After all, both are handwritten manuscripts...

desc_chs: 勒诺玫出版社发行的诗集，讲述了主人公通过时间穿梭回到过去，并在纯水骑士的宫廷中与一位侍女坠入爱河的故事。
desc_en: A book of poetry from Lenormand Publishing. It tells the story of a protagonist who travels back in time and falls in love with a maid at the court of the Lochknight.

desc_chs: 装饰着鎏金书底的华贵诗集，传说是在月女城尚未覆灭的年代，由某位深受花神宠眷的镇灵所作。\n根据伐护末那学院的考证，本书早在图莱杜拉毁灭前便已失佚，因此推测其内容应当是后世诗人的伪作。
desc_en: A lavish book of poetry with gilded pages, said to have been composed by a Jinn favored by the Goddess of Flowers in the days before the fall of the City of the Moon Maiden.\nSince according to the Vahumana the book had already been lost before the destruction of Tulaytullah, its contents are believed to be a later forgery.

desc_chs: 据说是古代的西风教会司祭在风神的启示下撰写的诗集，主要是在反省神之爱与人之爱的区别，并在最终得出结论，声称人的仁爱、友爱与恋爱皆是出于对自由的向往，因此天然具备圣洁的特性。
desc_en: A book of poetry said to have been composed by a priest of the ancient Church of Favonius under the guidance of the Anemo Archon. The work reflects on the distinction between the love of the gods and human love, and ultimately concludes that human compassion, friendship, and romantic affection are all inherently imbued with the sacred, for they all arise from the same longing for freedom.

desc_chs: 便签
desc_en: Note

name_chs: 与小魔女和幻想朋友们的合影
name_en: Photo With the Little Witches and Their Imaginary Friends
desc_chs: 「这是送给小魔女会的礼物哦。」艾莉丝这样说道。\n当你仍愿为美丽的幻想留一席之地，童心便永不失效——它润泽孩子们无虑无猜的岁月，也为成年人筑起穿越时光的温柔堡垒。
desc_en: "This is a gift for the Little Hexenzirkel," Alice said.\nAs long as you still leave some room for beautiful fantasies, your innocence will never fade. For children, it nourishes carefree childhood days, and for grown-ups, a gentle refuge against the passage of time.

desc_chs: 一瓶看似普通实则确实普通的团子牛奶，根据布伦妮的说法，这是从魔女手中赢来的战利品，因此她坚信这绝不是普通的团子牛奶！
desc_en: A bottle of dango milk that looks ordinary and, in fact, is ordinary. According to Prune, however, she won it from a witch, so she believes it's anything but your average dango milk!

desc_chs: 艾尔海森与卡维受草神纳西妲与大贤者纳菲斯指派进行一项紧急工程，而工程下一阶段需要大量材料。赤王陵内，最适合用作材料的莫过于元能构装体。它们所拥有的古老技术与优质零部件将被拆解得极小，再在新环境内重组成型。
desc_en: Commissioned by Nahida and Grand Sage Naphis, Alhaitham and Kaveh are undertaking an urgent project. As the next phase requires a vast supply of materials, they have turned to the Primal Constructs within The Mausoleum of King Deshret as the ideal source. Their ancient technology and high-grade components will be dismantled into microscopic parts, then reconfigured for a new environment.

desc_chs: 月之女神曾用她的力量见证了望月者的旅程。现在它也成了你的旅程的见证。
desc_en: The Moon Goddess once used her power to bear witness to the journey of the Moongazers. Now, it has become a witness to your journey as well.

desc_chs: 来自古老年代的花朵标本，外形与一种提瓦特植物很相似。它们之间也许存在几分暧昧的亲缘关系。
desc_en: A preserved flower from a long-lost era, bearing a striking resemblance to a certain plant found in Teyvat. There may be a distant and ambiguous connection between the two.

集齐2个宗室之印后，可开启宗室密藏之地。\n\n在探索时偶然得到的古代符印，如能找到纹样相同的2个，似乎就能打开旧日蒙德宗室留下的藏宝库。
desc_en: Collect 2 Royal Seals to unlock the Noblesse Secret Treasury.\n\nYou found this ancient seal by chance while exploring. If you collect two with the same markings, you may be able to lock the vault left behind by the old aristocracies of Mondstadt.

name_chs: 切片辖域管控模块·零质点
desc_chs: 集齐3个辖域管控模块后，可开启诸界秘展之厅。\n\n在探索时偶然得到的奇怪模块，如能找到纹样相同的3个，似乎就能打开空之神殿中封锁的秘藏展厅。
desc_en: Collect all 3 Domain Control Modules to unlock the Secret Hall of the Realms.\n\nYou found this strange module by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to open the secret hall within the Temple of Space.

desc_chs: 集齐3个印磐后，可开启乌吉恩圈宝库。\n\n在探索时偶然得到的圆形符印，如能找到纹样相同的3个，似乎就能拼凑出曾经照亮世界的皓月的影迹。
desc_en: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault in Ungien's Circle.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

desc_chs: 集齐3个印磐后，可开启月荡海宝库。\n\n在探索时偶然得到的圆形符印，如能找到纹样相同的3个，似乎就能拼凑出曾经照亮世界的皓月的影迹。
desc_en: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault in Moontide Sea.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

desc_chs: 在一次桑多涅举办的茶会上，玛梅赫为「家庭成员」们画的全家福。笔触温馨且富有特色，与她之前的画作有些许不同，看来如她所说，她也在旅行中尝试着各种不一样的画风。
desc_en: A family portrait that Mamere painted for her "family members" at a tea party hosted by Sandrone. Its warm and distinctive brushwork differs somewhat from her previous paintings, suggesting that, as she said, she has been trying her hand at all sorts of different styles during her travels.

name_chs: 首届「冒险家竞技大赛」冠军奖杯
name_en: Champion's Trophy of the First Adventurers' Tournament
desc_chs:
至冬冒险家协会总部颁发的奖杯，是你与派蒙在冒险领域的卓越之证。
因「冒险家协会发展大会」的讨论进展不顺，原本为了促进各国冒险家友好交流的「首届冒险家竞技大赛」成了决定话语权的角斗场…
你和派蒙作为打破僵局的重要人物，中途加入赛事，成绩突飞猛进，最终夺得冠军的宝座，并主导了会议的走向，敲定了多条关键决议…
虽说这些决议不会立刻显现出强大的功效，但相信，它们能让协会与时俱进，并使更多冒险家深度受益…
desc_en:
A trophy awarded by the headquarters of the Adventurers' Guild in Snezhnaya. It stands as proof of the outstanding feats you and Paimon have achieved in the field of adventure.
As discussions at the Adventurers' Guild Development Conference failed to progress smoothly, the First Adventurers' Tournament, originally meant to promote friendly exchange between adventurers of different nations, became an arena for deciding who would have the final say...
As key figures in breaking the deadlock, you and Paimon joined the competition midway. Swiftly climbing the ranks, you claimed the championship, steered the conference's direction, and finalized several key resolutions...
Though these resolutions may not have an immediate impact, they are sure to help the Guild keep pace with the times and bring greater benefits to more adventurers...

desc_en: Gathering three pieces of the Remnant Incense Guide - Snowgrave allows you to unseal the vault of Shadow Realm at the White Birch Snowgrave.\nLegend has it that early squads exploring the Shadow Realm would occasionally find themselves unable to retrieve the treasures they discovered. In such cases, they would leave a specific "scent trail" behind. Only by piecing together the incense trail can one track down the locations of these long-lost relics.

desc_en: Irminsul Fruit fragment data that you have obtained via calculations and analysis performed by the Energy Amplifier. It contains a vast bounty of knowledge that may yet lead to surprising gains if you use it well.

desc_chs: 参与「风行迷踪」，能获得的奖励代币。\n在不同的地区，同一种游戏也会有着不同的「背景设定」。譬如说，同样是追逐捕捉的嬉闹，在蒙德就会将逃逸者称为「游侠」，而追捕者是「猎手」，象征着遥远过去的抗争与压制。\n当然，蒙德的孩子们对这是一场游戏心知肚明，并不会在玩闹中产生真正的对立意识。
desc_en: The currency that is awarded for participating in Windtrace.\nThe "background settings" of this same game will change in different areas. Though it is still a game of chase-and-catch, the fleeing party are named the "Rebels" in Mondstadt, while their pursuer is the "Hunter," symbols both of the ancient resistance and oppression.\nOf course, the children of Mondstadt know well that this is just a game, and no true sense of enmity emerges as they play.

desc_chs: 随海浪漂流而来的贝类壳体，明亮而绚丽，氤氲着大海的气息。\n在「盛夏！海岛？大冒险！」期间，可以换取珍贵的宝物。
desc_en: Shells brought in by the tide that shine gorgeously, filled with the breath of the sea.\nCan be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Midsummer Island Adventure" event.

desc_chs: 封存着光洁的羽毛的弹珠，晶莹通透，正是一种便于收藏的迷你「羽球」。\n在「盛夏！海岛？大冒险！」期间，可以换取珍贵的宝物。
desc_en: These crystal-clear marbles have a bright feather sealed within them, making them miniature harpasta that are easy to collect.\nCan be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Midsummer Island Adventure" event.

desc_chs: 来自「魔球嘟嘟堡」的零件，设计精巧，做工细致，似乎价值不菲，可以用来兑换奖品…
desc_en: Intricately crafted parts from Dodofortresses that look rather valuable. Can be exchanged for rewards.

desc_chs: 凝结着苍紫雷光的碎片，充满奇异的雷元素力量。在「谒索雷痕」期间，可以换取珍贵的宝物。
desc_en: A shard of concentrated violet lightning, fizzing with strange Electro energy. Can be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Thunder Sojourn" event.

desc_chs: 凝结着苍紫雷光的晶体，充满奇异的雷元素力量。在「谒索雷痕」期间，可以换取价值不菲的宝物。
desc_en: A crystal formed from concentrated violet lightning, fizzing with strange Electro energy. Can be exchanged for valuable treasure during the event "Thunder Sojourn" event.

desc_chs: 积累后可提升「弈棋术」等级的资源。提升「弈棋术」等级后，可解锁新的机关与「灵妙签」。
desc_en: Accumulate this to raise your Mastery Level. Raise your Mastery Level to obtain new Mechanici and Wondrous Sticks.

desc_chs:
从觊觎原始的生命之海的巨兽处，取来的一滴水。

若是有生必有灭，自然有灭必有生——在遥远的古老世界中，曾有哲人如此推定。
若非如此，那顷刻的流光终究抵不过永恒的黑暗，在时间的尽头，万象终将凋残。
群星的法则——宇宙的法则，自然应当是守恒。然而宇宙的法则，向来并非守恒。
封闭的匣中，灭却总是会压过新生。千万年的繁盛在亿兆年前不过一瞬，值得夸耀的辉煌总会锈蚀、溃烂、消散，最后被遗忘。
于是，便有星间漂泊之物，曾在无数文明中拥有过无数名讳之物，为注定的寂灭之刻而落泪。
为绝望落泪，也为希望落泪，因为一切绝望与希望，终将伴随着千万颗璀璨的星辰一同熄灭。
为悲泣落泪，也为欢笑落泪，因为一切悲泣与欢笑，终将如漂萍散入那漆黑冰冷的无尽虚空。
一切渺小却美丽的身影，一切值得铭记的时刻，一切都会消逝在时间中，纵是群星亦不例外。
于是，便有那曾被称作「神明」之物，决意存留一切应存留之物，决意吞噬一切应吞噬之物。
直至时间的尽头，直至孤旷星海焚灭成冰冷的余烬，直至那时，全新的「世界」将在鲸腹中胎动。
「不再有罪，不再有悲恸、哀伤与泪水，因为一切都早已逝往万古的群星。」
desc_en:
A drop of water obtained from within the colossal beast who coveted the primordial sea of life.

A philosopher in the faraway ancient world once posited that where there is life, there is death; naturally where there is death, there is life.
If not, then the fleeting light cannot resist the eternal darkness, and all withers into nothingness at the end of time.
The rules among the stars dictate that nature must be conserved, but the laws of the universe have never been conserved.
In a sealed box, destruction always overpowers new life. Millennia upon millennia of prosperity are but an instant in a span of billions of years. The greatest of achievements, the proudest accomplishments, in time all will tarnish, decay, dissipate, and ultimately fade into oblivion.
Thus there are things floating in among the stars, once adorned with countless prestigious titles from innumerable civilizations, shedding tears for their ordained demise.
Their tears stream down, out of desperation, out of hope, because all desperation and hope alike will be utterly extinguished along with the innumerable stars.
Their tears stream down out of sorrow, out of joy, because both will eventually scatter into the cold, dark endless void.
Every tiny yet beautiful silhouette and every moment worth remembering will fade with time, even stars.
And then there are these so-called "gods" that are determined to save everything worth saving, and devour everything that should be devoured.
Until the end of time, until the sea of stars recess into nothing but dying embers, until a newborn "world" moves for the first time in the stomach of the whale.
"There will be no more sins, no more sadness, and no more tears, because everything died with the ancient stars."

desc_chs:
几经周折终于打造完成的全新古名「杜麦尼」，其名意为「希望」。
你是它的第一任主人，它将记录你在纳塔的所有冒险故事，长久地传承下去。
并非拥有生命之物才可获得「智慧」，也并非一切记忆与情感都是「祝福」，它的存在无法名状，也无法以常理去诠释，就像我们对光芒不及之处一无所知，所以无法确认黑暗最深邃之处是否存在无数双聚焦于你的眼睛。它永远居高临下，贪食土地中存储的知识与信息，就连人类永远无法跨越的恐惧与绝望，都只是它完全理解纳塔的一切之后，为你「模拟」出的情感。
仔细聆听库穆库尔的咆哮，那是来自千年前的怨恨，在彼时难逢敌手的至强战士，在伙伴的坟前后悔曾举起了手中的武器——倘若这场战争在最初就无法胜利，那他的身份不再是领袖，而是暴戾的孤王。
仔细观察柯夏尼娜的眼泪，那是来自千年前的绝望，即便她的心智始终坚强，战火与死亡从未停下侵蚀故乡的脚步。最后她跪倒在冰冷的棺椁前，在雨水的倒影中质问自我：若无法拒绝它，为何不拥抱它？
仔细感受恩德盖的怒火，那是来自千年前的疯狂，他为纳塔征战一生，燃尽热血，直至登上王座他才从圣火中得知了战争的真相，他不是万众敬仰的英雄，只是被蒙在鼓里的小丑，因为人类永远无法战胜其真正的主人。
仔细揣摩希巴拉克的言语，那是来自千年前的谎言，极致的智慧才会诞生极致的偏执，他将时间与死亡握于手中，将纳塔的未来纳入了无解的残局，面对注定到来的黑夜，人类本不必将灯点起，除非这盏灯是为了引来更大的怪物。
仔细回味玛薇卡的计划…不。
它可以扭曲历史与记忆，却不能扭曲你的亲身经历。这就是手中之名的意义，也是古名想要传递下去的光辉。
「人类将『奇迹』刻在黑曜石上，后世的继承者，却称之为『力量』。」
desc_en:
An Ancient Name, Tumaini, forged after many twists and turns, whose meaning is "hope."
You are its first bearer, and it shall record all your deeds and adventures in Natlan, to be passed down forevermore.
"Wisdom" is not the sole domain of living things, nor are all memories or emotions a "blessing." It is a nameless, shapeless existence, nor can common sense comprehend it. Just as we know naught about places that no light may touch, we cannot be sure that there are not countless pairs of eyes watching us from the deepest reaches of the dark. It is a condescending thing that lusts after the knowledge and information stored in the land. Even the horror and despair, which humans can never transcend, are mere emotions "simulated" for your benefit once it has understood all that Natlan is.
Lend your ear to Xumucul's roar. Hear the hatred that festered in the heart of the unrivaled warrior a thousand years ago. How he regrets lifting his weapon before the tombs of his companions in days bygone! For if this battle could never have been won, then he was no leader, but a cruel, lonesome king.
Look upon the tears of Cochanina — witness her thousand-year-old despair. Resolute she was to the end, but fire, sword, and death never ceased to ravage her homeland. At the last, she would kneel before the icy coffins, and reflect upon the image the rain-puddles painted of her: If it cannot be rejected, why not embrace it?
Feel Ndenge's fury, and know his thousand-year madness. He fought for Natlan all his life, shed and spent his fiery blood, only to learn the truth of war from the Sacred Flame once he had attained the throne. He was not a hero, beloved by all — he was but a blind, ignorant clown, for humanity can never hope to conquer the true master.
Fathom the words of Xbalanque, perceive his thousand-year-old lie. The utmost wisdom births the utmost paranoia, and as he held time and death in his hands, he doomed Natlan to an endgame without any solution. Humans need not light lamps before the destined darkness to come, lest it be to attract still larger monsters.
Think upon Mavuika's plan... No.
It can warp history and memory, but it cannot twist your personal experiences. This is the meaning of this name you hold, and the light that Ancient Names mean to pass down.
"Our forebears carved 'miracles' into obsidian rock, yet future bearers looked upon them and saw 'strength.'"

name_chs: 哥伦比娅赠予你的祈月之花
desc_chs: 哥伦比娅赠送的祈月之花，散发着纯净与空灵的芬芳，一如你在银月之庭所见的那些。\n它唤起一段故事的记忆，也预示一个崭新的开篇。它已不会再失去自己的色彩了。
desc_en: A Moon-Prayer Blossom gifted to you by Columbina, exuding a fragrance both pure and ethereal, much like those you once saw in the Silvermoon Hall.\nIt stirs the memory of a story, and heralds the opening of a new chapter. This time, it will never lose its colors again.

desc_chs: 游玩「机关棋谭·灵妙之局」后可以获得的奇妙玉符。可以在驹形处以此玉符交换一些东西。
desc_en: A mysterious talisman obtained by playing Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Wonders. Exchange them with Komakata for some precious items.

desc_chs: 就像是在第一次见面，为它的尾巴系上丝巾一般，重撰其「名字」。\n重撰「名字」后，就再也无法更改。
desc_en: Just like when you first met and tied a scarf around his tail, now give him a new "name."\nAfter giving him a new name, it cannot be changed again.
