desc_chs: 凝聚着深奥力量的晶体，如同石珀的碎块，有着纯粹的岩元素色彩。在层岩巨渊下方的这片空间中，似能激发出一定的力量，有助于战胜魔物。\n在「危途疑踪」的「谲域战境」中，可以用来抽取「战策」，或是让倒下的角色重新上阵。
desc_en: A crystal that contains a deep and subtle power. Much like Cor Lapis, it has a pure Geo-gold hue. Its power can be activated to some extent within this space under The Chasm, thus helping to defeat monsters.\nThis can be used in the "Realms of Guile and War" of "Perilous Trails" to draw Stratagems or allow characters who have fallen to take to the field once again.

desc_chs: 在冒险过程中，和伙伴们讨论后，对「兰那罗木刻」如何才能更受欢迎总结出的悉心建议。在「雕琢童心」活动期间，可以用来换取珍贵的宝物。
desc_en: After much discussion with your companions during the adventure, you summed up some thoughtful suggestions on how Aranara Carvings can become more popular. Can be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Graven Innocence" event.

desc_chs: 在冒险过程中，对于「兰那罗木刻」的灵感的快速记录。在「雕琢童心」活动期间，可以用来换取珍贵的宝物。
desc_en: A quick sketch of inspirations for "Aranara Carvings" made during the adventure. Can be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Graven Innocence" event.

desc_chs: 乌尔曼所说能卖大钱的古铁钱。摸起来似乎没什么特别的…
desc_en: Ancient iron currency which, according to Ulman, is worth an awful lot of money. However, it doesn't feel like anything special to the touch...

desc_chs: 通过获胜的「七圣召唤」对局获得。每一次得胜的对局，都将积累获得胜利的手段与方式，所谓的经验就是如此，在无论何种情况下都能知悉如何制胜的方法，就是作为一个牌手的强大之处。
desc_en: Obtained by winning Genius Invokation TCG matches. Every duel you won builds upon the paths to victory, such is the act of earning experience itself. To know how to overcome and subdue the adversary in any situation is the greatest strength that a player can possess.

desc_chs: 归风佳酿节节庆热度
desc_en: Weinlesefest Festive Fever

desc_chs: 数量可观的「佳酿晶冻」，是义卖活动的收入总额。「归风佳酿节」临近尾声时，伯恩哈德会将这些「佳酿晶冻」兑换成摩拉，捐献给有需要的老人和孩子。
desc_en: A sizable amount of Fairbrew Jelly, representing the sum total of your earnings in this charity event. As the Weinlesefest draws to a close, Bernhard will exchange these for Mora to give to old folks and children who need it.

desc_chs: 数额有限的「佳酿晶冻」，是义卖活动中投入店铺经营的基本资金。\n吸引顾客和扩大营收，这两件事是每个店主的目标，为此，有必要精准地规划资金，增强店铺的吸引力
desc_en: A sizable amount of Fairbrew Jelly, representing the base capital used in setting up your shop.\nAttracting customers and increasing earnings — these two are the key goals of all shopkeepers. As such, you must plan out your spending and increase the attractiveness of your shop.

desc_chs: 记录着各种商业理论和经营案例的资料，对于阅历丰富的人而言，每一页文字都能带来大量灵感，启发他们改良经营店铺的策略。
desc_en: Materials that contain various theories and case studies related to mercantile practice. To those with the appropriate experience, every page and every word is filled with possible inspiration for ways to improve.

desc_chs: 做工精致的纪念币，是「月莲杯驯兽师大赛」的「召捕灵蕈」与「潜能焕发」两个环节中，给予表现优异的参赛选手的奖励。\n无论比赛的结果如何，这种纪念币都是选手们与温和的蕈兽们友善交流的见证物。\n在「智巧灵蕈大竞逐」期间，可以用来换取珍贵的宝物。
desc_en: A finely-crafted memorial coin, and the reward given to outstanding participants in the Fungus Capture and Coruscating Potential stages of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament.\nNo matter the results of the competition, these coins are proof of the friendly associations between the participants and the tame Fungi.\nThese coins can be used to exchange for precious items during the "Fabulous Fungus Frenzy" event.

desc_chs: 材质独特的奖章，是「月莲杯驯兽师大赛」的「强化特训」环节中，给予表现突出的参赛选手的奖励。\n与蕈兽伙伴一同战胜特训场地中的强大敌人，是培养默契、共同变强的关键之一。\n在「智巧灵蕈大竞逐」期间，可以用来换取珍贵的宝物。
desc_en: A medal made from unique materials, and the reward given to outstanding participants in the Special Training stage of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament.\nWorking together to defeat powerful enemies in the Special Training grounds is one of the key aspects to nurturing the bond between you and your Fungi friends and growing stronger together.\nThese coins can be used to exchange for precious items during the "Fabulous Fungus Frenzy" event.

desc_chs: 战胜未知秘境中强大的无相元素后，寻获的神秘晶体，绮丽的色彩如同元素之力散去后残留的斑纹。\n在「无相交响诗·离调乐段」活动中，可以用来换取贵重的物资。
desc_en: A mysterious crystalline substance that you obtained after defeating the mighty Hypostases within a heretofore undiscovered Domain. Its lovely colors are like the remnant light of the elements as they are scattered.\nCan be used to exchange for valuable resources in the event "Hypostatic Symphony: Dissonant Verse"

desc_chs: 在社奉行举办的「试胆大会」中，完成某些特别的挑战后获取的票券，似是给胆识过人的参与者的认可。\n在「秋津森夜试胆会」活动中，可以换取珍贵的物资。
desc_en: Ticket earned from a participant's display of courage and insight by completing special challenges in the "Test of Courage" event hosted by the Yashiro Commission.\nYou can exchange these tickets for rewards during the "Akitsu Kimodameshi" event.

desc_chs: 海灯节节庆热度
desc_en: Lantern Rite Festive Fever

desc_chs: 在风花节期间游玩「逐花棋」可以获得的奖励票券。在活动期间，可以用来兑换奖品。
desc_en: You can obtain these reward coupons by playing games of Floral Chess during the Windblume Festival. During the event, you can exchange them for rewards.

desc_chs: 「学院游乐会」游乐热度
desc_en: Wisdom Gala Excitement

desc_chs: 参加风花节期间的各类庆典游艺活动，可以获得的奖励票券。在活动期间，可以用来兑换奖品。
desc_en: You can obtain these reward tickets by taking part in the various festivities during the Windblume Festival. During the event, you can exchange them for rewards.

desc_chs: 在「召唤王大奖赛」会场参加各类活动后奖励的票券。可以在活动期间用来兑换各类奖品。
desc_en: You can obtain these coupons after participating in various events at the King of Invokations Grand Prix. During the event, you can exchange them for rewards.

desc_chs: 从散落在「琉形蜃境」各地的「礼券秘盒」中找到的票券，做工精美，配色明艳，攥在手里时，似乎能感受到赢取奖品般的欢快心情。\n在「清夏！乐园？大秘境！」活动中，可以解锁珍贵的物资奖励。
desc_en: Vouchers found inside Voucher Boxes throughout the Veluriyam Mirage. They are exquisitely made and come in vivid colors. Just gripping them in your hand seems to impart the joy of winning a reward.\nCan be used to unlock valuable rewards during the "Secret Summer Paradise" event.

desc_chs: 闪烁着瑰丽光泽的晶体，长久凝视时，似乎就能回想起参与各种游乐项目所体会到的乐趣。既然在「琉形蜃境」之中，有着诸多奇异的现象，欢快的趣意凝聚成宝石般的实体，似乎也没什么好奇怪的？\n在「清夏！乐园？大秘境！」活动中，可以解锁珍贵的物资奖励。
desc_en: A crystal that radiates a magnificent luster. Looking upon it for a time will bring back fun memories of taking part in various games. With so many interesting sights to be seen within the Veluriyam Mirage, is it strange that such vast quantities of joy would crystallize into a pure gemstone?\nCan be used to unlock valuable rewards during the "Secret Summer Paradise" event.

desc_chs: 泛着奇异金属光彩的机械发条，据说采用了秘密的表层处理工艺，使得原本廉价的金属拥有了相当不错的性能，从而为关键机关提供了优良的性能和低廉的价格。\n同时，在「机枢巧物前哨战」中，可以用来换取物资，解锁奖励。
desc_en: A mainspring with an enigmatic metal luster. Its surface is said to have been processed with a secret technique that grants desirable properties to the inexpensive base metal. The method ensures the mainspring's good performance at a low price when utilized in core meka.\nIt can be used to exchange for supplies and unlock rewards in "Mega Meka Melee."

desc_chs: 「游水酝诗籍」诗歌会热度
desc_en: "Waterborne Poetry" Poetry Gala Fervor

desc_chs: 闪耀着金属光泽的企鹅徽章，似乎能给予佩戴者坚定向前的意志…\n在「特尔克西的奇幻历险」活动中，可以解锁珍贵的物资奖励。
desc_en: A golden penguin badge that shines with a metallic glow. It seems to give the bearer a staunch resolve to move forward...\nA precious reward that can be unlocked in the "Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures" event.

desc_chs: 做工精致的纪念票券，是在「千灵映影节」期间参与庆典的各项活动所获得的纪念品。据说这种票券采用了独特的制作工艺，有着与映影画片相似的质感，映照灯光时晶莹剔透，就如宝石的薄片…\n在「蔷薇与铳枪」期间，可以解锁多种奖励。
desc_en: Exquisitely-made souvenir tickets meant to memorialize participation in the various events related to the Fontinalia Film Festival. These tickets are said to be made to have a similar texture to film slides. Crystal-clear when reflecting light, they resemble nothing so much as thin gem fragments...\nUse these to unlock various rewards during the "Roses and Muskets" event.

desc_chs: 乌尔曼所说能卖大钱的古铁钱。摸起来似乎没什么特别的…
desc_en: Ancient iron currency which, according to Ulman, is worth an awful lot of Mora. However, it doesn't feel like anything special to the touch...

desc_chs: 海灯节节庆热度
desc_en: Lantern Rite Festive Fever

desc_chs: 形如映影画片的纪念币，是在「千灵映影节」期间积极活跃所赢得的纪念品。虽然无法放入专门的设备，播放精彩的映影，但独特的造型让人一看就能联想到节日期间的见闻，心情愉悦…\n在「蔷薇与铳枪」期间，可以换取珍贵的物资。
desc_en: Souvenir coins shaped like film slides. These are mementos that can be accumulated and won through participation in the Fontinalia Film Festival. These cannot be placed within specialized devices to play exciting films, sure, but their unique designs are sure to lift peoples' spirits with reminders of what they saw during that festival...\nThese can be exchanged for valuable rewards during the "Roses and Muskets" event.

desc_chs: 经营炼金店铺获得的资金，可被再次投入到店铺方方面面的事务之中，扩大培育药材、生产药剂和店铺运营的规模…\n合格的店铺管理者总是时刻关注着店铺运营的资金，并时刻保有一笔可观的可用资金，如此一来，才能长久而稳定地保持店铺盈利，逐渐把生意做大…
desc_en: Funds obtained from running the alchemy shop, which can be reinvested into various matters surrounding said shop. Cultivating more ingredients, producing potions, and the scale of your operations...\nA good shopkeeper always keeps an eye on their shop funds and has a considerable sum at hand. That way, you will be able to maintain a profitable, expanding business...

desc_chs: 象征着摇滚精神的神秘票券，似乎能赋予持有者无尽的激情与热血…\n在「荒泷生命摇滚虹色大巡回」活动中，可以换取珍贵的物资，并邀请重要的伙伴…
desc_en: A mysterious ticket that symbolizes the spirit of rock 'n' roll. It appears able to grant its holder hot-blooded passion...\nYou can exchange this for valuable rewards during the "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness," and send an invitation to an important companion...

desc_chs: 通过进行推演，累计战例样本，为各将士们提供有效的参考，从而协助分析各种魔物的战斗力，以及高效对抗它们的方法…
desc_en: By initiating wargames and collecting the combat data therein, we can provide useful points of reference for the various commanders and analyze the abilities of various monsters, as well as how to effectively defeat them...

desc_chs: 在「希穆兰卡」各地游览时发现的书页，记述着各式文字片段，描述着「希穆兰卡」居民的日常生活，饱含悠闲与欢乐之意，能让外来的客人放松心境，在这奇妙的童话国中与伙伴们共享难忘的愉快时光。
desc_en: Pages found while exploring Simulanka. They contain text fragments that describe the daily lives of the realm's inhabitants. Filled as they are with leisure and joy, they set outsiders at ease, that they too may enjoy unforgettable and happy times with their companions in this marvelous wonderland.

desc_chs: 刻有星星徽记的特制硬币，做工精致，似乎饱含着制作者的美好祝福，在使用它时，说不定会有意想不到的好事发生！\n在「欢夏！邪龙？童话国！」活动中，可用于在赠礼箱处摹刻童话巧像。
desc_en: A custom coin with a starry emblem carved into it. Exquisitely crafted, it seems to carry the blessings of the one who made it. And who knows? Perhaps good things will come when you use it!\nYou can use it to obtain fairytale figurines from Fantastical Fabricators in the "Summertide Scales and Tales" event.

desc_chs: 根据「炫彩呆子」的建议，在纳塔各地观光采风后获得的涂鸦灵感。静下心来观察各种事物后，对于它们的形态和色彩，似乎都有了更细致的认知，大大有助于绘制涂鸦…\n在「绮绘的踪绪」活动中，可以用来解锁多种物资奖励。
desc_en: Inspiration for graffiti that, following Dopey Dazzler's suggestion, you've gathered from various sightseeing spots across Natlan. When you calm your mind and focus on the act of observing things, you find that you are able to glean a more thorough understanding of their shapes and colors, which proves greatly beneficial when creating graffiti...\nCan be used to unlock all sorts of material rewards during the "Traces of Artistry" event.

desc_chs: 花神诞祭的庆典热度，可通过参与节日活动不断累积，用以解锁多种奖励。
desc_en: The festive fervor of the Sabzeruz Festival can be continually accumulated by participating in festival events and be used to unlock various rewards.

desc_chs: 通过焚香进入暝视状态后，燃尽的香灰凝结而成的晶体，侧面反映着寻灵所耗的时间。
desc_en: When a person burns incense to enter a state of clairvoyance, the ash leftover from the consumed incense condenses into these crystals. The sides reflect the time that was spent Spiritseeking.

desc_chs: 海灯节节庆热度
desc_en: Lantern Rite Festive Fever

desc_chs: 游玩「三川花祭」的游艺所获的印章，代表了客人对游艺的认可，也凝聚着游艺开发者们的热情…
desc_en: A stamp gained from playing games at the Mikawa Flower Festival. It represents both the festival-goer's appreciation and the creator's passion...

desc_chs: 原料经过重重筛选，由酥软的基底与多种香味物质烹制而成的零食，对于九成九的提瓦特动物绝对安全，异常美味，是吸引动物朋友们入住「悠悠慢庄园」的邀请函…
desc_en: A tasty treat combining a variety of aromatic ingredients with a soft and crumbly base. Ingredients are carefully selected, and the finished result is safe for 99% of Teyvat's animals to eat. This sumptuous snack is a delicious invitation for animal friends from far and wide to visit the Mellow Manor...

desc_chs: 经营「海薇玛映影欢乐城」的总资金池，包含了可以投入至欢乐城各项事务的预算，以及来自各个项目的营收。准确地投入摩拉，绝不浪费任何一枚硬币，才能获得最大的收益…
desc_en: The total funding pool reserved for operating the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. It is the source of investment for all of the park's amusements, and the destination for all of their income. Only by ensuring that every last Mora is invested correctly can profits be maximized...

desc_chs: 等同于娜维娅所说的「工作时间段」，即分配给各项工作所用的单位时间，是基于时间管理学的一种概念，用派蒙都能理解的话，就像是「做出行动花费的点数」。\n随着经营能力和工作效率的提升，相同时间内可以完成的工作也会逐渐变多，这样一来，就可以把同样的时长划分为更多工作时段，完成更多工作，也就是说，干活的速度越快，行动点越多…
desc_en: Equivalent to the "time slots" that Navia told you about. These are the units of time in which all work at the park is allocated, based on the principles of time management. Using words that even Paimon can understand, they are "points required to perform actions."\nAs management skills and working efficiency improve, more work can be completed in the same amount of time, allowing for the day to be subdivided into a larger number of time slots, thereby increasing the amount of work completed...

desc_chs: 通过进行「伙伴冒险大战记」的兵棋推演和树果喂食的长期试验，收集而来的记录。法德瓦会通过这些记录来对「伙伴冒险大作战」中的各种情形和数据进行推演和计算。虽然是先开放给孩子们游玩的游戏，但是数据也一点模糊不得。
desc_en: Records collected through careful observations of the Companion Caper Chronicles' tabletop adventure game and fruit-feeding trials. Fadaweh uses these records to calculate and extrapolate various scenarios and data for the Companion Caper Chronicles. Though initially a game made for children, she will not tolerate even the slightest inaccuracy in the data.

desc_chs: 阿夏形状的小小图案，仿佛在挥洒独属于夏日的美丽色彩。快快提升夏日的热度，尽情享受这段难得的假期吧！
desc_en: A small pattern in the shape of an Asha that exudes the mesmerizing colors of summer. Increase your summer heat and enjoy everything this precious holiday has to offer!

desc_chs: 「叮铃哐啷军团」的士气，影响着爱诺的行动效率，与追查案情也息息相关！
desc_en: The Clink Clank Legion's morale affects Aino's efficiency and is crucial to the investigation!

desc_chs: 为「稳健知行」进行准备工作的进度，达到一定的程度后，这一机构应当就能万无一失地自行运转了…
desc_en: Preparation work progress made on behalf of the Fieldwise Center. Once adequate preparation work has been completed, the Fieldwise Center should be able to operate on its own...

desc_chs: 参与「炽魂斗士的雪界之旅」所获的证明。以信念、勇气与热情为燃料的斗士，终能斩获耀眼的胜果。
desc_en: Proof of participation in the "Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey." A warrior fueled by faith, courage, and passion will ultimately reap brilliant victories.

desc_chs: 由总务司准备的特殊钱币。在海灯节期间，可以用于换取各类奖励。
desc_en: A special coin prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be exchanged for various rewards during the Lantern Rite.

desc_chs: 在欢迎仪式中，以不同以往的角度重新游览蒙德后获得的感悟，可以用来解锁珍贵的奖励。
desc_en: Inspiration gained by exploring Mondstadt from a different perspective during the welcome ceremony. It can be used to unlock valuable rewards.

desc_chs: 总结对各式瑰丽衣装的欣赏经验后，获得的感悟，持续积累的话，总有一天能用于换取珍贵的奖励…
desc_en: Insights gained from appreciating all manner of splendid attire. Once enough have been accumulated, they may one day be exchanged for precious rewards...

desc_chs: 协助主持「挪德卡莱贸易展会」所获得的量化纪念章，可以换取珍贵的物资奖励。
desc_en: A commemorative medal awarded for helping organize the "Nod-Krai Trade Expo." It can be exchanged for valuable rewards.

desc_chs: 与「幻想朋友」们一同游玩所培养的默契，在「幻友绮旅」活动中，可以换取珍贵的奖励。
desc_en: The bond established while playing with your imaginary friends. Can be exchanged for rewards in the "Phantasmal Pals" event.

desc_chs: 在「映夏！归乡？千灵节！」活动期间，完成水族馆的各项事务，提升水族馆的热度以获得的评分，可以用于解锁珍贵的物资奖励。
desc_en: During the "Sunny Summer Fontinalia" event, complete various aquarium tasks to raise your Venue Popularity. This score can be used to unlock valuable supply rewards.

desc_chs: 首届「冒险家竞技大赛」中，根据每场挑战的表现所获取的分值点数。比赛最后，累积胜点最多的冒险家将获得冠军…\n在「险境征者竞锋大赛」中，可以用于解锁各种奖励…
desc_en: Points awarded based on performance in each challenge during the first "Adventurers' Tournament." At the end of the tournament, the adventurer who has accumulated the most Competition Points will be crowned the champion...\nIn the Great Expeditionist Challenge, these points can also be used to unlock a variety of rewards...

desc_chs: 「强化互助会」和冒险家们都在使用的一种票券，可以用来抽取限定款的「凯瑟琳大人」立像部件。或许，凯瑟琳在冒险家与民间人士之中的人气，其实相当夸张？
desc_en: A type of coupon widely circulated among both the adventurers and the Mutual Aid Advancement Network. They can be exchanged to draw for limited-edition "Lady Katheryne" statue parts. Come to think of it... is Katheryne's popularity among adventurers and civilians actually completely off the charts?

desc_chs: 「灰眸」所储存在机身内的臻冰，可以用来凝造蓝图中的各种机关和造物。
desc_en: Stored within the internal reservoir of the Eye of Graeae, it can be utilized to build the various mechanisms and constructs detailed in the blueprints.

desc_chs: 海灯节期间，用以制作「霄灯」的材料。\n随处可见的纤维素。特殊处理后，可以制成霄灯的灯皮，让它承载着良善的愿望飘向远方。
desc_en: Used in Lantern Rite as material with which to construct Xiao Lanterns.\nThis commonly encountered fibrous material can be processed into lantern wrappings so that the lanterns can float away, carrying their beautiful wishes far afield.

desc_chs: 海灯节期间，用以制作「霄灯」的材料。\n随处可见的绒材。特殊处理后，可以制成霄灯的灯芯，让它承载着良善的愿望飘向远方。
desc_en: Used in Lantern Rite as material with which to construct Xiao Lanterns.\nThe commonly encountered velvety material can be processed into lantern wicks so the lanterns can float away, carrying their beautiful wishes far afield.

desc_chs: 海灯节期间，用以制作「霄灯」的材料。\n能自行悬浮的神秘元素石片，是霄灯飞往遥远天际线的秘密，传说也是「群玉阁」漂浮的动力来源。
desc_en: Used in Lantern Rite as material with which to construct Xiao Lanterns.\nA mysterious shard of elemental rock that can float by itself. It is the secret to the flying lanterns. It is also said to be the thing that powers the Jade Chamber's floating mechanism.

desc_chs: 让它承载着良善的愿望飘向远方。
desc_en: It floats away carrying beautiful wishes.

desc_chs: 由总务司特别制作的特殊霄灯。可以装备在道具栏中，在璃月港内使用即可放出对应霄灯。
desc_en: A special Xiao Lantern, specially crafted by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Can be equipped in the item slot and used in Liyue Harbor to release the corresponding Xiao Lantern.

desc_chs: 由总务司特别制作的特殊霄灯，借助此类霄灯，可以将各类礼物赠送给伙伴。可以装备在道具栏中，在璃月港内使用即可放出对应霄灯。
desc_en: A special Xiao Lantern, specially crafted by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. With these Xiao Lanterns, you can send various gifts to your companions. Can be equipped in the item slot and used in Liyue Harbor to release the corresponding Xiao Lantern.

desc_chs: 总务司下发的图谱，上面记载着放飞霄灯的特殊技巧。如果按照图谱上的记载操作，或许能将霄灯放飞为特殊的「霄灯飞阵」。
desc_en: A handbook issued by the Ministry of Civil Affairs, detailing special techniques for releasing Xiao Lanterns. By following its instructions, you may be able to launch the lanterns in a unique Xiao Lantern formation.

name_en: Moon Lights the Sky, Spring Blossoms High
desc_chs: 由总务司制作的「海灯节留念品」。最开始总务司本来只想将霄灯制作为留念品，但在人们的一封又一封建议信的催促下，总务司最终还是决定将更多的摆饰囊括入「留念品」之列。即使海灯节已过，\n 但霄灯与美德亦长留街头巷弄之间。
desc_en: A Lantern Rite keepsake crafted by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. The Ministry had originally intended to offer only Xiao Lanterns as souvenirs, but after receiving waves of heartfelt suggestions, they decided to include many more festive decorations. Though the Lantern Rite is fleeting,\nthe Xiao Lanterns and the virtues they carry continue to illuminate the streets and alleys.

desc_chs: 元素能量球(火)
desc_en: Energy Orb (Pyro)

desc_chs: 从龙脊雪山的魔物处提取出来的小块结晶。\n仅仅会在特殊的时期产生。
desc_en: Small crystals obtained from monster habitats on Dragonspine.\nThey are only generated at special times.

desc_chs: 从龙脊雪山的魔物处提取出来的结晶块。\n仅仅会在特殊的时期产生。
desc_en: Pieces of crystal obtained from monster habitats on Dragonspine.\nThey are only generated at special times.

desc_chs: 「腐殖之剑」专用的精炼道具。\n将散布在龙脊雪山的地脉当中的，「杜林」的腐毒提纯后得到的物质。用在亲和这种物质的「渴血之剑」上的话，可以提升这把剑的力量。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for Festering Desire.\nThis is the product of purifying Durin's vile venom, which has seeped into and spread throughout Dragonspine's ley lines. By using it on a bloodthirsty sword with a strong affinity for such materials, you can increase that sword's power.

desc_chs: 「风花之颂」专用的精炼道具。\n象征着风车与风之花的精致饰物，也是「风花之颂」的弓臂上的装饰品。「风」本身看不见、摸不着，而恒常转动着的风车、绿地上摇摆的花朵则是「看得见的风」，向人们昭示着，轻柔的风无时无刻不眷顾蒙德的大地与众生。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for the Windblume Ode.\nAn intricately-made ornament that symbolizes the windmills and windblumes, and is that which adorns the limbs of the Windblume Ode. The wind is invisible and intangible, but the windmills that keep turning and the swaying flowers in the emerald fields are "the visible winds" that show people that the breeze will always care for all life in Mondstadt.

desc_chs: 「嘟嘟可故事集」专用的精炼道具。\n随风散落的断篇，每一页上都写满童趣之事，而尺寸恰好与《嘟嘟可故事集》完美相合。其间满溢的童心与纯真的爱永不褪色，就像书中永无完结的大冒险一样，热忱的童话永远随着其作者的脚步飞扬。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Dodoco Tales."\nPages scattered on the wind. Each one is filled to the brim with childlike wonder, and their dimensions are an exact match for "Dodoco Tales." The abundant innocence and pure love therein will never fade, and just like the never-ending adventure in the book — this passionate fairy tale shall forever soar in the wake of the author's footsteps.

desc_chs: 「衔珠海皇」专用的精炼道具。\n香气浓郁的膏体，似乎凝结着水中生命的灵气。涂抹在「衔珠海皇」上之后，能将这柄形貌独特的大剑淬炼得更为坚韧。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for the Luxurious Sea-Lord.\nThe intense fragrance of this paste seems to have sealed the spirit of sea life within. Smear it on the Luxurious Sea-Lord to temper this unique claymore and make it harder still.

desc_chs: 「渔获」专用的精炼道具。\n过去称霸清籁地方的赤穗百目鬼一众爱用的酒具。被海水带到了渔师的钓钩上。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "The Catch."\nThis was the favored liquor vessel of Ako Domeki, who once ruled over the Seirai region. The sea has brought it onto an angler's hook.

desc_chs: 「辰砂之纺锤」专用的精炼道具。\n隐隐泛着世外之光的白银液体，对地上之物或许有着蚀骨的猛毒吧。但也具有使物质升华的力量。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for the Cinnabar Spindle.\nA silver substance shining with an otherworldly light that is a deadly corrosive poison to things of this world. And yet it also has the power to sublimate matter...

desc_chs: 「证誓之明瞳」专用的精炼道具。\n由特殊的深海鳗鳗精炼出的鱼油，曾经被拿来保养渊下宫的神器，使其灼目长明。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for the Oathsworn Eye.\nSpecial Deep Sea Unagi oil, which was once used to maintain Enkanomiya's sacred artifacts, has been carefully processed for the purpose of making this shining eye most bright indeed.

desc_chs: 「落霞」专用的精炼道具。\n以层岩巨渊先民的古老工艺精致打磨而成的石珀宝珠。能够微微散发出如同黎明或夕暮的辉光。对于在不见天日的岩窟中，与漆黑之敌战斗的人而言，或许能带来小小的慰藉吧。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for Fading Twilight.\nCor Lapis delicately refined by ancient arts practiced by the early inhabitants of The Chasm. It glimmers slightly with a light that resembles either the radiance of dawn or the dying twilight. Appearing in caverns where none may see either form of light, it must have brought some small comfort to those who fought against the dark enemy.

desc_chs: 「竭泽」专用的精炼道具。\n从北方大湖的渔获中提炼出的油膏，能短暂地让成为良弓的鱼恢复生机。\n据说那个大湖中生活着大陆别处绝对无法见到的水生物种。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "End of the Line."\nOintment refined from a catch from the great lake in the north. It has the effect of temporarily restoring the energy of the fish that could be made into fine bows.\nIt is said that in the lake dwell aquatic creatures that cannot be seen anywhere else in Teyvat.

desc_chs: 「风信之锋」专用的精炼道具。\n由松石雕而成的古旧羽翮，在过去似乎曾被用作饰品或信物。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Missive Windspear."\nAn ancient feather carved from turquoise. It was once used as an ornament or a token of sorts.

desc_chs: 「东花坊时雨」专用的精炼道具。\n用以粘接竹簳与伞面的粉剂。\n纵然时节流转、昔日之雨散落成烟，总会有回忆重接思念，宛若置伞、伴梦同眠。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Toukabou Shigure."\nA powdery substance meant to bind bamboo to an umbrella.\nEven as the seasons change and the past dissolves, memory and thoughts will always remain, slumbering beneath an umbrella to rest in the shroud of a dream.

desc_chs: 「饰铁之花」专用的精炼道具。\n「装饰」能够为任何事物附上一份超出其自身价值与功能的小小心意。即便是战斗的工具，在这样的时日，这种不再枯萎的花朵也能为它赋予些许浪漫的内涵。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Mailed Flower."\nDecorations can always provide a little something beyond an item's value and function. In times like these, an unwithering flower can lend some romantic essence to even a weapon.

desc_chs: 「鹮穿之喙」专用的精炼道具。\n据说后来成为「召唤王」的少年曾在大赤沙海之中受鹮之王的后裔所托，花费数日收集脂蛹熬制护弦之蜡。只是传说中的宝弓随鹮之王消失不复归来，唯有脂蜡的做法代代相传，也许，是为了能够再度使用的某日而作出的准备。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for Ibis Piercer.\nIn the Great Red Sand, the youth who later became the King of Invokations was requested by the descendants of the Ibis King to spend a few days formulating bowstring wax from Sand Grease Pupae. However, the legendary bow disappeared along with the Ibis King, and only the recipe for making pupa wax was passed down from generation to generation. Perhaps it's still waiting for the day when it can be used again.

desc_chs: 「灰河渡手」专用的精炼道具。\n不但能够在特定材质的表面形成隔离层来避免金属氧化和腐蚀，还有润滑、清洁、抛光作用，曾经在枫丹风靡一时。在当时的广告中，灰河的传奇人物就用它来维护那根著名的弯头铜管。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Fleuve Cendre Ferryman."\nNot only can it prevent oxidation and erosion by forming an isolation layer on certain materials, but it also helps lubricate, clean, and polish. It was once all the rage in Fontaine. In the advertisements back then, a legendary figure from the Fleuve Cendre used it to maintain the famous curved copper tube.

desc_chs: 「无垠蔚蓝之歌」专用的精炼道具。\n在许多诗与故事中，蒲公英都是不受拘束、自在、旅行远方的象征。将蒲公英图案的书签夹在书中从某种意义上而言并不是一种禁锢，反而使它能在比现实更广阔、更光明的世界中遨游。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Ballad of the Boundless Blue."\nIn many poems and tales, Dandelions are a symbol of unrestrained freedom, traveling to faraway lands. Placing a bookmark with the image of a Dandelion within the pages of a book is not a form of confinement, but rather allowing it to wander in a world far vaster and brighter than our own.

desc_chs: 「水仙十字之剑」专用的精炼道具。\n古代枫丹文明喜欢用螺贝制作仪式道具，这个被选做圣杯的螺壳内终于涌现出圣油。从象征意义来说，圣杯是太初的言语，圣油是锤炼的意志，圣剑则是破开一切的理性。
desc_en: The specialized refinement material for the Sword of Narzissenkreuz.\nConches were often favored materials in ancient Fontainian civilization for making ritual implements, and the sacred unguents within this conch chosen as a sanctified chalice have finally emerged. Symbolically, this chalice is the primordial word, the oils are the honed will, and the holy sword itself is reason, which breaks through all.

name_en: Super-Duper Invincible Shining Sparkly Magic Crystal
desc_chs: 「究极霸王超级魔剑」专用的精炼道具。\n能够将许多心愿（以及帅气的硬纸板）牢牢地拼合在一起，从而诞生出究极无敌的神奇力量。\n虽说造型差不多（或者说完全一样）的小道具在达莫维百货也买得到，但两者之间其实说不定有着本质上的区别，所以千万不要搞混。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Ultimate Overlord's Mega Magic Sword."\nCan gather many wishes (including super cool cardboard ones) and put them together, forming an ultimate super-duper mysterious power.\nThough you can buy a toy version in Damoville Purveyor that looks similar (okay, basically exactly the same), in reality, there is (probably) a qualitative difference between the two, so definitely don't mix them up!

desc_chs: 「沙中伟贤的对答」专用的精炼道具。\n在炼金术的基础教程中，水银被叫做「大地之王」，因为它甚至可以贪婪地吞吃黄金。因此炼金术也以它代表金属。\n干涸化为粉尘后依然拥有转变的性质。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Dialogues of the Desert Sages."\nIn introductory alchemy studies, mercury is often called "Exalted Earth," for it can even greedily devour gold. As such, it is also used in alchemy to represent metal.\nIt still possesses the potential for transformation even after being dried and turned to dust.

desc_chs: 「筑云」专用的精炼道具。\n由玉衡星委托黑岩厂锻造的新型机件，据工匠所说有着「不逊仙家机关」的传动载荷。安装在对应的实验式兵器上，便可以进一步提升其威力。\n人治之世亦如良弓之弦，唯有定度衡仪，方能使其不至绷断。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Cloudforged."\nA new type of component the Yuheng commissioned the Blackcliff Forge to make. According to the smiths, its dynamic load "wouldn't lose to adeptal mechanisms." By installing it on its counterpart prototype weapon, the latter's power can be considerably increased.\nThe world ruled by humanity is like the taut bowstring of a quality bow: It can only avoid snapping and collapsing with the appropriate quantity of tension.

desc_chs: 「苍纹角杯」专用的精炼道具。\n细密温润的彩砂，质地如傍晚的海风般轻柔。\n在梅兹特利的古老传说中，海是群星的归宿，沉落的星芒终将化作苍色的海砂。静静聆听，瓶中摇晃的，正是星光与海潮的絮语。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for the "Ash-Graven Drinking Horn."\nThe fine and warm colored sand has a texture as gentle as the sea breeze at sunset.\nAccording to an ancient Meztli legend, the sea is the stars' home, and the sinking starlight will eventually turn into pale ocean sand. Listen quietly, then, to the swaying whispers of the stars and the tides within the bottle.

desc_chs:
「厄水之祸」专用的精炼道具。
如棱镜般折射着奇异光泽的玉石坠饰，即便置于焚火上灼烤，那份萦绕的阴冷依然挥之不去。
古老的巫术传承中，「梭」本身便象征着穿刺不同界域的媒介。据说在众人尚不知晓怎样数算自己日子、怎样将故事纺成织物的蛮荒年岁，那些流徙于灵火之原的巨龙早已被忘却的语言中，亦将在漆黑死寂的群星间巡行的造物称作「空梭」，哪怕是将一个世界笼罩在内的厚重面纱，也会被流火的梭镖刺破。
当然，这些说法全部来自狡狯的欺诈师桑哈杰，与他曾经编织出的无数戏言一样，说不定只是用来骗吃骗喝的故事——时至今日，烟谜主一些德高望重的祭司依然抱持着这样的观点。
desc_en:
Specialized refinement material for "Calamity of Eshu."
Refracting an eerie, prism-like light, this jade pendant emits a chilling aura that does not disappear, even were it to be cast within a roaring blaze.
In ancient shamanic traditions, the "shuttle" symbolizes a medium that pierces through different realms. It is said that in the era of barbarism, before humans knew how to count their days or to weave their tales, the mighty dragons who then roamed the Soulfire Plains had a word for a construct that traversed the pitch-black darkness between the stars. In their long-forgotten language, they called such creations "Void Shuttles" — blazing javelins that could pierce anything, even a veil thick enough to enshroud an entire world.
Of course, given that the source of this story was the crafty trickster Sanhaj, it may well be that this was nothing but another of his countless tall tales, told with the sole intention of earning himself a meal and a drink. Today, some of the most respected priests of the Masters of the Night-Wind still hold this view.

desc_chs: 「且住亭御咄」专用的精炼道具。\n昔时以火焰为身奔行稻妻的妖怪，散落于四野的残留磷火。就像每一盏油灯都曾记忆围炉夜谈之人的话语，散落的焰火之中，或许也有对某人而言相当重要的回忆。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Tamayuratei no Ohanashi."\nEmbers of phosphorescent fire scattered by a youkai who once donned the form of flame, traveling the length and breadth of Inazuma. Just as each and every oil lamp remembers the words of those who once gathered beneath its glow, there may well be memories retained within these dispersed embers that are of great import to some.

desc_chs:
「冷寂迸音」专属的精炼道具。
古老的故事中，劫富济贫的逐影猎人、人称「幻戏师」与「行刑人」的沃尔特总是善于利用精密机关的力学效应辅助拉弓射击。据说这种射击方式极度节省体能，从而让沃尔特能够应对可能追至的大量恶人与邪魔。
这一特性在幻想映影中得到强调，以至于发展出「机关技术强化战士」的夸张形象。
而探索极限远射与安静射击性能极限的「复合结构猎弓」同样需要多次校准和调试，才能发挥出最为理想的性能。
desc_en:
Specialized refinement material for the "Sequence of Solitude."
In legends of old, the Marechaussee Hunter who stole from the rich and gave to the poor was Walter, known as both a "Master" of tricks and an "Executioner" who leveraged precision-engineered devices to augment his archery. It is said that this strategy minimized physical strain on the wielder, enabling Walter to strike down hordes of pursuing villains and fiends with ruthless efficiency.
This quality was only further exaggerated in fantastical filmic retellings, birthing the trope of "Mechanically Enhanced Warriors."
Meanwhile, this Composite Hunter's Bow — designed to push the limits of long-range stealth shooting — demands repeated calibration and fine-tuning to achieve peak performance.

desc_chs: 「拾慧铸熔」专用的精炼道具。\n看上去只是普通的矿石，在纳塔各地都有出土。但正因为产地的不同，即使是同样的矿石，其石髓亦有细看才能看出的差别——这也是曾经漫行纳塔的旅人收集矿石的原因，有些东西要真切地触碰或握于手中，才可仔细品会其中的不同。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Flame-Forged Insight."\nAt first glance, it's just like any old mineral you might find throughout Natlan, but due to differences in local geology, even the same type of rock can have slight differences in Stonemarrow that can only be uncovered upon closer inspection. That's why the travelers who once wandered through Natlan collected this mineral — some things need to be held in the palm of the hand before you can appreciate their uniqueness.

desc_chs: 「天光的纺琴」专用的精炼道具。\n在早已失落的古代文明中，曾有人认为主宰世界的命运就像舞台上的唱段，是由高天之上一架巨大的竖琴编制而成。或许是因为他们曾亲眼见过天使从天光中抽出金色的琴弦，在宏伟的乐声中宣告命运的无情。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Etherlight Spindlelute."\nIn a civilization long lost to time, some believed the fate that governs the world was woven like a song upon the stage — birthed from the strings of a colossal harp suspended in the heavens. Perhaps it was because they had witnessed angels pluck golden strings from the very skies above, their divine chords proclaiming the thundering indifference of fate.

desc_chs: 「虹蛇的雨弦」专用的精炼道具。\n被弓手长期佩戴的护指，色彩鲜艳，制作精良。\n箭矢的准头有赖于弓手的经验，其人凝息拨弦的次数越多，弓与箭越能随心而动。搭弦挽弓便是练心，护指有多破损，心就有多锐利。
desc_en: Specialized refinement material for "Rainbow Serpent's Rain Bow."\nA brightly colored, exquisitely crafted finger guard long worn by archers.\nThe accuracy of an arrow hinges on the archer's experience: The more one draws the bowstring with focused breath, the more seamlessly bow and arrow move in unison. To nock and draw is to temper the spirit. The wear on the guard reflects the sharpness of the archer's resolve.

desc_chs: 元素能量球(水)
desc_en: Energy Orb (Hydro)

desc_chs: 角色进行下落攻击时，将释放冲击波，对敌人造成范围伤害。该效果每个角色每8秒至多触发一次。
desc_en: When a character initiates a Plunging Attack, they will unleash a shockwave that deals AoE DMG to opponents. This effect can be triggered once every 8s per character.

desc_chs: 持续滑翔或因跳跃离地时，当前角色每0.3秒会获得一层「铁翼」效果，至多叠加3层。角色进行下落攻击时，每层铁翼将使这次下落攻击造成的伤害提高35%，并移除角色所有的铁翼效果。
desc_en: Continuous gliding or leaving the ground due to jumping will grant the current character a stack of Steelwing every 0.3s, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. When characters initiate Plunging Attacks, each Steelwing stack will increase the DMG of that attack by 35%. This will consume all the stacks of Steelwing that this character possesses.

desc_chs: 角色的下落攻击命中敌人后，将产生能回复6点元素能量的元素微粒与击碎后会产生风场的风琥珀。该效果每8秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character's Plunging Attack hits an opponent, it will generate Elemental Particles that regenerate 6 energy and an Anemo Amber that will generate a wind current. This effect can be triggered once per 8s, and this CD is shared between all characters in the party.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色下落攻击造成的伤害提升40%。
desc_en: All party members' Plunging Attack DMG increased by 40%.

desc_chs: 角色通过重击击败敌人后的60秒内，队伍中所有角色的重击造成的伤害提高35%。该效果至多叠加5层，每0.3秒只能触发一次。
desc_en: After characters use Charged Attacks to defeat opponents, the Charged Attack DMG of all characters in the party will be increased by 35% for 60s. Each of these effects can stack up to 5 times and can be triggered once every 0.3s.

desc_chs: 当前角色若武器类型为弓箭，进行重击并命中弱点时，将获得「刚弓」效果，使普通攻击与重击的暴击率提升50%，持续8秒。
desc_en: If the current character is a bow user, hitting opponents' weak spots with Charged Attacks will grant the Ironbow effect, which will increase the CRIT Rate of Normal and Charged Attacks by 50% for 8s.

desc_chs: 角色通过重击击败敌人时，会产生真空场，牵引周围的敌人，并基于该角色攻击力的500%造成伤害。该效果每2秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: Defeating opponents with a character's Charged Attack will create a Vacuum Field that pulls nearby opponents in and deals DMG based on 500% of the character's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 2s, and this effect's CD is shared between all characters in the party.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的重击造成的伤害提升30%。
desc_en: All party members' Charged Attack DMG increased by 30%.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的重击体力消耗降低50%。
desc_en: Decreases all party members' Charged Attack Stamina consumption by 50%.

desc_chs: 角色拥有5层「剑舞」效果，每层剑舞效果会使角色的普通攻击造成的伤害提高15%。拥有5层效果时，普通攻击速度提高15%。角色受到伤害时，会失去1层剑舞，每秒最多因此失去1层剑舞。角色在场上时，每10秒会获得一层剑舞，直到拥有5层剑舞为止。每个角色单独计算剑舞效果的层数与获得间隔时间。
desc_en: Characters possess 5 stacks of the Blade Dance effect, and each stack increases the Normal Attack DMG dealt by the character by 15%. Possessing 5 stacks will increase Normal ATK SPD by 15%. When a character takes DMG, they will lose 1 stack of Blade Dance. A maximum of 1 stack can be lost every second in this way. A character will gain one stack of Blade Dance for every 10s they are on the field, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each character's CDs, stack counts, and their effects are counted independently.

desc_chs: 角色处于护盾庇护下时，普通攻击命中敌人时，攻击力将提高10%。该效果最多叠加5层，持续8秒。该效果叠加的层数与持续时间对每个角色单独计算。
desc_en: When a character protected by a shield hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, their ATK is increased by 10%. This effect can stack up to 5 times and lasts for 8s. This effect, its stacks, and its duration are independently calculated for every character.

desc_chs: 元素爆发命中后的20秒内，施放该元素爆发的角色普通攻击造成的伤害提高40%。
desc_en: For 20s after an Elemental Burst is used, the character who unleashed that Elemental Burst has their Normal Attack DMG increased by 40%.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色普通攻击造成的伤害提升30%。
desc_en: All party members' Normal Attack DMG increased by 30%.

desc_chs: 队伍中任意角色施放元素爆发后，将产生「元素圆舞」效果，使队伍中所有角色的元素精通提高100点。该效果持续20秒，至多叠加3次。叠加3次后在持续期间内，若再次产生该效果，将释放冲击波，造成范围伤害。
desc_en: When any party member uses an Elemental Burst, the Elemental Roundabout effect is generated, which increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 100 for 20s, stacking up to 3 times. If this effect is triggered again at 3 stacks, a shockwave that deals AoE DMG will be unleashed.

desc_chs: 普通攻击命中后，有50%几率为自己恢复5点元素能量。该效果每个角色每4秒至多触发一次。
desc_en: When Normal Attacks hit opponents, they have a 50% chance to regenerate 5 Energy for themselves. This effect can be triggered once every 4s per character.

desc_chs: 角色施放元素爆发后的8秒内，普通攻击命中时有50%几率产生一个能恢复2点元素能量的元素微粒。通过这种方式，每个角色每1.7秒只能产生一个元素晶球。
desc_en: For 8s after a character uses an Elemental Burst, Normal Attacks that hit opponents have a 50% chance to generate an Elemental Particle that regenerates 2 Energy. Each character can generate this effect once every 1.7s.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色元素爆发造成的伤害提升30%。
desc_en: Elemental Burst DMG dealt by all party members increased by 30%.

desc_chs: 施放元素爆发后，场上所有角色都将各自释放一次冲击波，基于释放冲击波的角色的攻击力的600%，对附近的敌人造成伤害。该效果每2秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: After using an Elemental Burst, all party members on the field will unleash one shockwave that scales on 600% of the ATK of the character that unleashed that shockwave, and which deals DMG to nearby opponents. This effect can occur once every 2s and its CD is shared between all characters in the party.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的元素爆发技能提高1级。\n至多提升至15级。
desc_en: Increases the Elemental Burst Level of all party members by 1.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

desc_chs: 角色施放元素战技后，将会恢复8点元素能量。
desc_en: Elemental Skills will regenerate 8 Energy.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的元素充能效率提升30%。
desc_en: All party members' Energy Recharge increased by 30%.

desc_chs: 角色使敌人感电时，有50%几率引发落雷，基于触发感电效果的角色的攻击力的500%造成伤害，并使敌人的雷元素抗性降低25%。该效果每5秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character causes opponents to be Electro-Charged, there is a 50% chance to trigger a lightning strike that deals 500% of the triggering character's ATK as DMG and decreases the opponent's Electro RES by 25%. This effect can be triggered once every 5s and this CD is shared between all party members.

desc_chs: 角色的元素爆发命中敌人后，将会产生一个击碎后会造成局部降雨的水琥珀。该效果每6秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character hits an opponent with an Elemental Burst, a Hydro Amber that will create falling rain in an AoE when shattered will be generated. This effect can be triggered once every 6s and this CD is shared between all party members.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的元素精通提高100点。
desc_en: All characters in the party have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100.

desc_chs: 角色使敌人超导时，有50%几率降下冰锥，基于触发超导效果的角色的攻击力的500%造成伤害，并使敌人的物理抗性降低25%，持续10秒。该效果每5秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character causes opponents to Superconduct, there is a 50% chance to trigger a falling icicle that deals 500% of the triggering character's ATK as DMG and decreases the opponent's Physical RES by 25% for 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 5s and this CD is shared between all party members.

desc_chs: 角色的普通攻击与重击对受到冰元素影响的敌人造成的伤害提高30%。
desc_en: Character Normal and Charged Attack DMG against opponents affected by Cryo are increased by 30%.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色获得30%物理伤害加成。
desc_en: All party members gain a 30% Physical DMG Bonus.

desc_chs: 角色获得岩元素反应产生的晶片时，会释放小型冲击波，基于该角色的攻击力的500%对周围的敌人造成伤害。此外，触发该效果后的10秒内，队伍中所有角色获得40%岩元素伤害加成。该效果每5秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by a Geo Elemental Reaction, a small shockwave will be unleashed that will deal 500% of that character's ATK as DMG to nearby opponents. Additionally, all characters in the party gain a 40% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s after this effect is triggered. These effects can be triggered once every 5s and this CD is shared between all party members.

desc_chs: 角色获得岩元素反应产生的晶片后的10秒内，获得30%所有元素伤害加成。
desc_en: When a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by a Geo Elemental Reaction, they gain a 30% Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.

desc_chs: 角色获得岩元素反应产生的晶片时，会为队伍中所有角色恢复2点元素能量。该效果每2秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by a Geo Elemental Reaction, they will regenerate 2 Energy for all members of the party. This effect can be triggered once every 2s and this CD is shared between all party members.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的护盾强效提高35%。
desc_en: All party members' Shield Strength increased by 35%.

desc_chs: 角色的攻击命中敌人后，将会释放冲击波，造成范围伤害。角色生命值满时，造成的伤害会进一步提升。该效果每个角色每5秒至多触发一次。
desc_en: When a character hits opponents, a shockwave will be unleashed that deals AoE DMG. When characters are at full HP, the DMG dealt will be increased further. This effect can be triggered once every 5s per character.

desc_chs: 角色处于护盾庇护下时，获得40%受治疗加成。
desc_en: While protected by a shield, characters gain a 40% incoming healing bonus.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的治疗加成提高25%。
desc_en: Increases all party members' incoming healing bonus by 25%.

desc_chs: 角色的重击命中生命值低于30%的敌人时，会降下处刑的剑气，造成大量伤害。该效果每10秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character's Charged Attacks hit an opponent that is under 30% HP, an executioner's blade will descend and deal immense DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 10s and this CD is shared between all party members.

desc_chs: 敌人被击败时，会释放冲击波，对其他敌人造成范围伤害。
desc_en: When an opponent is defeated, it will release a shockwave that deals AoE DMG to other opponents.

desc_chs: 战斗中，角色附近的敌人数量不多于2个时，攻击力提高20%，防御力提高20%。
desc_en: During combat, when there are no more than 2 opponents near a character, ATK is increased by 20% and DEF increased by 20%.

desc_chs: 微小的地脉之果碎片，似乎能感受到断面处漏出的些微能量。
desc_en: A tiny piece of an Irminsul Fruit. You can almost feel a small amount of energy leaking out of its broken face.

desc_chs: 小型的地脉之果碎片，似乎能感受到断面处缓缓流动着能量。
desc_en: A small piece of an Irminsul Fruit. You can somewhat feel the energy that flows gradually from its broken sections.

desc_chs: 大块的地脉之果碎片，似乎能感受到断面处满溢着躁动的能量。
desc_en: A sizable piece of an Irminsul Fruit. You can feel its broken edges brim over with restless power.

desc_chs: 角色的攻击命中敌人后，将会释放冲击波，造成范围真实伤害。角色生命值满时，造成的伤害会进一步提升。该效果每个玩家队伍每5秒至多触发一次。
desc_en: When a character hits opponents, a shockwave will be unleashed that deals AoE True DMG. When characters are at full HP, the DMG dealt will be increased further. This effect can be triggered once every 5s per player's party.

desc_chs: 角色拥有5层「剑舞」效果，每层剑舞效果会使角色的普通攻击造成的伤害提高15%。拥有5层效果时，普通攻击速度提高15%。角色受到伤害时，会失去1层剑舞，每秒最多因此失去1层剑舞。角色在场上时，每10秒会获得一层剑舞，直到拥有5层剑舞为止。每个角色单独计算剑舞效果的层数与获得间隔时间。
desc_en: Characters possess 5 stacks of the Blade Dance effect, and each stack increases the Normal Attack DMG dealt by the character by 15%. Possessing 5 stacks will increase Normal ATK SPD by 15%. When a character takes DMG, they will lose 1 stack of Blade Dance. A maximum of 1 stack can be lost every second in this way. A character will gain one stack of Blade Dance for every 10s they are on the field, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each character's CDs, stack counts, and their effects are counted independently.

desc_chs: 角色获得岩元素反应产生的晶片时，会释放小型冲击波，基于该角色的攻击力的500%对周围的敌人造成伤害。此外，触发该效果后的10秒内，队伍中所有角色获得40%岩元素伤害加成。该效果每5秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by a Geo Elemental Reaction, a small shockwave will be unleashed that will deal 500% of that character's ATK as DMG to nearby opponents. Additionally, all characters in the party gain a 40% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s after this effect is triggered. These effects can be triggered once every 5s and this CD is shared between all party members.

desc_chs: 队伍中任意角色施放元素爆发后，将产生「元素圆舞」效果，使队伍中所有角色的元素精通提高100点。该效果持续20秒，至多叠加3次。叠加3次后在持续期间内，若再次产生该效果，将释放冲击波，造成范围真实伤害。
desc_en: When any party member uses an Elemental Burst, the Elemental Roundabout effect is generated, which increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 100 for 20s, stacking up to 3 times. If this effect is triggered again at 3 stacks, a shockwave that deals AoE True DMG will be unleashed.

desc_chs: 施放元素爆发后，场上所有角色都将各自释放一次冲击波，基于释放冲击波的角色的攻击力的600%，对附近的敌人造成伤害。该效果每2秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: After using an Elemental Burst, all party members on the field will unleash one shockwave that scales on 600% of the ATK of the character that unleashed that shockwave, and which deals DMG to nearby opponents. This effect can occur once every 2s and its CD is shared between all characters in the party.

desc_chs: 角色获得结晶反应产生的晶片后的10秒内，获得30%所有元素伤害加成。
desc_en: When a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by a Crystallize Reaction, they gain a 30% Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.

desc_chs: 元素爆发命中敌人后的20秒内，施放该元素爆发的角色普通攻击造成的伤害提高40%。
desc_en: For 20s after an Elemental Burst hits an opponent, the character who unleashed that Elemental Burst has their Normal Attack DMG increased by 40%.

desc_chs: 角色处于护盾庇护下时，普通攻击命中敌人后，攻击力将提高8%。该效果最多叠加5层，持续8秒。该效果叠加的层数与持续时间对每个角色单独计算。
desc_en: After a character protected by a shield hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, their ATK is increased by 8%. This effect can stack up to 5 times and lasts for 8s. This effect, its stacks, and its duration are independently calculated for every character.

desc_chs: 角色通过重击击败敌人时，会产生真空场，牵引周围的敌人，并基于该角色攻击力的500%造成伤害。该效果每2秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: Defeating opponents with a character's Charged Attack will create a Vacuum Field that pulls nearby opponents in and deals DMG based on 500% of the character's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 2s, and this effect's CD is shared between all characters in the party.

desc_chs: 角色附近的敌人数量不多于2个时，攻击力提高20%，防御力提高20%。
desc_en: When there are no more than 2 opponents near a character, ATK is increased by 20% and DEF is increased by 20%.

desc_chs: 角色的重击命中生命值低于50%的敌人时，会降下处刑的剑气，造成真实伤害。该效果每10秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character's Charged Attacks hit an opponent that is under 50% HP, an executioner's blade will descend and deal True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 10s and this CD is shared between all party members.

desc_chs: 角色获得结晶反应产生的晶片时，会为队伍中所有角色恢复2点元素能量。该效果每2秒至多触发一次，队伍中所有角色共享冷却。
desc_en: When a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by a Crystallize Reaction, they will regenerate 2 Energy for all members of the party. This effect can be triggered once every 2s and this CD is shared between all party members.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的元素爆发技能提高1级。\n至多提升至15级。
desc_en: Increases the Elemental Burst Level of all party members by 1.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

desc_chs: 敌人被击败时，会释放冲击波，对其他敌人造成范围真实伤害。
desc_en: When an opponent is defeated, it will release a shockwave that deals AoE True DMG to other opponents.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色获得30%物理伤害加成。
desc_en: All party members gain a 30% Physical DMG Bonus.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色元素爆发造成的伤害提升30%。
desc_en: Elemental Burst DMG dealt by all party members increased by 30%.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的元素精通提高100点。
desc_en: All characters in the party have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的护盾强效提高40%。
desc_en: All party members' Shield Strength increased by 40%.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色普通攻击造成的伤害提升30%。
desc_en: All party members' Normal Attack DMG increased by 30%.

desc_chs: 队伍中所有角色的重击造成的伤害提升30%。
desc_en: All party members' Charged Attack DMG increased by 30%.

desc_chs: 施放元素爆发后，将产生「元素盈满」效果，使队伍中所有角色元素爆发造成的伤害提升12%，持续15秒。该效果至多叠加5层。拥有5层效果时，普通攻击速度提高15%。
desc_en: After using an Elemental Burst, the Elemental Profusion effect will occur, increasing all party members' Elemental Burst DMG by 12% for 15s. Max 5 stacks. When 5 stacks are possessed, Normal ATK SPD is increased by 15%.

desc_chs: 当前场上角色使敌人触发感电反应后，该玩家队伍中所有角色的元素爆发的冷却时间缩短1秒。该效果每1.5秒至多触发一次。
desc_en: When an active character triggers Electro-Charged, all of that player's party members' Elemental Burst CDs are decreased by 1s. This can occur once every 1.5s.

desc_chs: 元素能量球(草)
desc_en: Energy Orb (Dendro)

desc_chs: 元素能量球(电)
desc_en: Energy Orb (Electro)

desc_chs: 元素能量球(风)
desc_en: Energy Orb (Anemo)

desc_chs: 元素能量球(冰)
desc_en: Energy Orb (Cryo)

desc_chs: 元素能量球(岩)
desc_en: Energy Orb (Geo)

desc_chs: 元素能量球(全)
desc_en: Energy Orb (Any)

desc_chs: 其貌不扬的木质钓竿，除了比较坚韧，可以当作野外防身武器外，再没有什么值得称道的了。但老话说的好——新手一根竿，老手摆地摊。就算是钓鱼之王，最初也是从这根普通的家伙开始的吧。
desc_en: A rather pedestrian-looking wooden fishing rod. Apart from being quite sturdy, even to the point where you could use it for self-defense, it lacks any sort of special features. But the old adage holds true — "the novice's rod shall be the tent-pole of their veterancy." Even the greatest of anglers must surely have started with this simple implement.

desc_chs: 钓鱼过程中，若能使张力处于最佳张力区，使用此竿可稳定缩短鱼儿挣扎时间，提高钓鱼成功率。仅蒙德地区生效。\n\n由一位蒙德诗人创造的长竿，碧荧通透。为了借来风的力量帮助提竿，诗人别出心裁地设计了由风车叶组成的渔轮，也使其蕴含了一丝「与风缠绵」的浪漫意味。但不知是制作工艺还是设计本身的问题，最终的完成品并不能如预想中自由转动，或许这就是所谓的隔行如隔山吧？
desc_en: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Mondstadt.\n\nA long, bright, transparent rod created by a poet from Mondstadt. To help borrow the power of Anemo to help raise the rod, the poet rather ingeniously designed a fishing reel made from the leaves of Windwheel Asters, which also imparts a certain romanticism of "lingering in the wind" to this device. But perhaps there were issues in the handiwork or in the design itself, for the finalized product could not spin as freely as expected. Perhaps this is what they call "the chasm between professions?"

desc_chs: 钓鱼过程中，若能使张力处于最佳张力区，使用此竿可稳定缩短鱼儿挣扎时间，提高钓鱼成功率。仅璃月地区生效。\n\n如竹般高雅挺拔的长竿，据说是一位隐居璃月的高人执藏之竿，最初被发现于一面刻有「负愿者，执竿去」的石碑之上，如传说中的神剑，等待被勇者拔出。当然，如此显赫的来历，尽是从商家口中流出的，所以说不定只是些抬高身价的说辞...但话说回来，凡是知晓这些仍入手者，也都是心甘情愿、自负契约之人吧。
desc_en: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Liyue.\n\nA long rod that stands like elegant bamboo. It is said to have been constructed and kept by a skilled hermit from Liyue, and it was first discovered on a stone tablet with the following words carved upon it: "O you who aspire, take up this rod," like a legendary sword waiting for a hero to pull it out. Of course, you only ever hear this glorious origin story from the mouths of merchants, so it may just be some rhetoric used to increase the item's value... But those who know this and still use this rod can only be those who are ready and willing to accept this pact.

desc_chs: 钓鱼过程中，若能使张力处于最佳张力区，使用此竿可稳定缩短鱼儿挣扎时间，提高钓鱼成功率。仅稻妻地区生效。\n\n为纪念古老的鹈饲捕鱼法而制的长竿，竿尖的红宝石象征着鹈匠的火绒，竿身的鸟饰象征着鹈匠的鸬鹚，它们曾指引辛勤的稻妻先辈度过艰难的灾变年代。如今这种生产力低下的捕鱼法基本已被弃用，但那种顽强的开拓精神却伴随此竿一同传承下来。
desc_en: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Inazuma.\n\nA rod created to commemorate the ancient Ukai, or Cormorant, fishing method. The ruby-red gem at the tip of the rod represents the tinder used by the cormorant fishers, and the bird ornaments along the rod's shaft represent the cormorants themselves, who helped the hard-working Inazumans pass through those cataclysmic years. This low-efficiency fishing method has long become obsolete, but the persevering, pioneering spirit has been passed down together with this rod.

desc_chs: 钓鱼过程中，若能使张力保持在最佳张力区，使用此竿可加速缩短鱼儿挣扎时间，若离开最佳张力区，加速过程会被重置。\n\n因「海中月」而生的特制长竿。为了应对传说中的大鱼，制作者特别在竿身、鱼线中掺入了罕见的功能材料，使其不仅拥有不俗的延展性，更能承千斤而不崩。如此宝具，用来对付普通鱼儿自然也不在话下，但总是这样牛鼎烹鸡的话，它也会感到负尘蒙羞吧？
desc_en: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle at an accelerating rate and increase your chances of success. If you leave the Ideal Tension Zone, the acceleration will reset.\nA special fishing rod created for the sake of the Lunar Leviathan. To tackle this legendary fish, the creator of this rod specially added some material with rare functions onto the rod itself and the fishing line, giving it both great malleability and tensile strength. Of course, such a treasure could easily catch ordinary fish, but that seems like overkill to the point where even the rod might feel ashamed to be used thus.

desc_chs: 钓鱼过程中，若能使张力处于最佳张力区，使用此竿可稳定缩短鱼儿挣扎时间，提高钓鱼成功率。仅须弥地区生效。\n\n形制古朴的须弥鱼竿，竿体如白玉雕琢，黯金色的纹饰盘绕其上，并以苍青的宝石作为点缀。纯美的形貌之下，似是有着与「生命」相关的寓意——据说须弥最古老的鱼竿就是缠绕着藤蔓的树枝，许多钓鱼宗师用这样的鱼竿完成了他们的「奇迹一钓」。如今的鱼师们也相信，这种历史悠久的鱼竿将为他们带来收获的好运。
desc_en: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Sumeru.\n\nThis archaic Sumeru fishing rod is carved like white jade, decorated with dark gold patterns, and embellished with green gems. Under its pure aesthetics, it seems to have some meaning related to "life" — it is said that the oldest fishing rod of Sumeru was a branch wrapped with vines, and many master anglers achieved miraculous catches with such rods. Today's fishermen also believe that such fishing rods with long histories will bring them good luck.

desc_chs:
钓鱼过程中，若能使张力处于最佳张力区，使用此竿可稳定缩短鱼儿挣扎时间，提高钓鱼成功率。仅枫丹地区生效。

有着优美金属光泽的修长鱼竿，应用了枫丹科学院的新式金属材料，轻便而坚韧，在多段结构的连接处，还安装了高强度的金属加强导线环，足以吊起重量惊人的鱼类，类似武器护手状的卷线器轮座则可以保护鱼师，防止他们的手被凶猛而「坚硬」的鱼类伤到。
在一些经验丰富的鱼师口中，这种鱼竿正是与枫丹特色之「铁鱼」进行决斗的理想武器，就如一柄趁手的长枪。
desc_en:
If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Fontaine.

A slender fishing rod with a beautiful metallic glamor. Made of innovative metal materials designed by the Fontaine Research Institute, it combines light weight and resistance. Thanks to the solid metal loops reinforcing the connections between each section, the rod is capable of bearing fish of astonishing weight. Moreover, the reel seat is modeled after the handguards on weapon handles, protecting the angler from being damaged by fierce and "tough" fish. 
According to experienced fishers, this rod is the perfect weapon against "Iron Fish," the specialty of Fontaine, and is comparable to a trusty lance.

desc_chs:
钓鱼过程中，若能使张力处于最佳张力区，使用此竿可稳定缩短鱼儿挣扎时间，提高钓鱼成功率。仅纳塔地区生效。

纳塔钓鱼协会特有的鱼竿，以精雕细琢的长颈角犀和浮流鸟装扮点缀竿体，材质则选用了武器级金属，兼顾趣味与耐用性。
钓鱼佬们时常猜想，有着修长脖子的长颈角犀或许能成为自然界最优秀的鱼师，而看似笨拙的浮流鸟需要捕鱼为生，两者堪称绝妙的搭档，同时出现在鱼竿上，必定能为鱼师带来绝佳的钓鱼运！
desc_en:
If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Natlan.

A specialty rod of the Natlan Fishing Association. Crafted from weapons-grade metal, it has also been carved with a fine design that features Long-Necked Rhinos and Flowcurrent Birds, ensuring both durability and style.
Anglers often speculate that, if only it felt inclined to harness the potential of its exceedingly long neck, the Long-Necked Rhino might become the most gifted fisher in the entire natural world. Meanwhile, the seemingly clumsy Flowcurrent Bird actually has to rely upon catching fish to survive. Together, therefore, they would make the perfect fishing partners — thus, having them both on the same rod is believed to bring anglers exceptional luck!

desc_chs: 钓鱼过程中，若能使张力处于最佳张力区，使用此竿可稳定缩短鱼儿挣扎时间，提高钓鱼成功率。仅挪德卡莱地区生效。\n\n如同凝结的月光般，散发着明净白晖的鱼竿，是挪德卡莱鱼师群体之中，有着至高技法的宗师才有资格持有的杰作。相传，上一位善用这型鱼竿的鱼师仅将钓鱼视作和鱼儿们的「对谈」，会将钓获的鱼儿们就地放生，或是「请回」家中的鱼缸做客几天，就恭送至原本栖息的水域…这等温柔的做法，也在如今的鱼师群体中形成了一个特别的流派…
desc_en: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Nod-Krai.\n\nA fishing rod that shimmers with a pure, silvery glow, like moonlight caught in its frame. It's a masterpiece reserved for true masters among Nod-Krai's anglers, those who have reached the highest levels of the craft. It is said that the last wielder of this rod treated every catch as a quiet exchange rather than a contest. Some fish were released right away, while others were invited home for a short visit in the aquarium — before being gently returned to the waters they came from. This thoughtful, respectful way of fishing gave rise to a unique tradition among local anglers — one that values connection and care over mere skill.

name_en: Scepter of the Snow Angler King
desc_chs: 钓鱼过程中，若能使张力处于最佳张力区，使用此竿可稳定缩短鱼儿挣扎时间，提高钓鱼成功率。仅至冬地区生效。\n\n由不知名工匠打造的臻冰造物鱼竿，被誉为「雪国钓鱼王者的权杖」，如今被寄放在至冬钓鱼协会。据说，唯有技艺最为顶尖，且接受了风雪完全锤炼的鱼师，才有资格使用这一鱼竿…
desc_en: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, using this rod will steadily shorten the time fish struggle and increase your chances of success. Only effective in Snezhnaya.\n\nA fishing rod made from Prime Ice by an unknown artisan, acclaimed as "the scepter of the king of anglers in the land of snow." It is currently entrusted to the Snezhnaya Fishing Association. It is said that only anglers of supreme skill, fully tempered by the howling wind and snow, are worthy of wielding this rod...

desc_chs: 超出世界的原初晶石。黑暗的宇宙中，由无主的梦想与希望凝结而成的辉光。
desc_en: A primordial crystalline gem that's beyond the mundane world. Shines with the condensed hopes and dreams of universes that once were.

desc_en: Atomic Energy Orb (Pyro)

desc_chs: 原子能量球(水)
desc_en: Atomic Energy Orb (Hydro)

desc_en: Atomic Energy Orb (Dendro)

desc_chs: 通行大陆的钱。世界通用的共同语言，谁人都能理解的贵金属。
desc_en: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

desc_en: Atomic Energy Orb (Electro)

desc_en: Atomic Energy Orb (Cryo)

desc_en: Mysterious time shards that increase the time you can stay in the Fog Maze.

desc_en: Mysterious time shards that increase the time you can stay in the Fog Maze.

desc_en: Energy Orb (Any)

desc_chs: 开辟宇宙的能量结晶。虚无的真空中，由足以点亮新星的潜力和希望结晶而成。
desc_en: An energy crystal from the very origin of the universe. Formed from within nothingness out of pure potential and hope, it contains enough energy to create a newborn star.

desc_chs: 燃素能量球
desc_en: Phlogiston Energy Orb

desc_chs: 燃素能量球
desc_en: Phlogiston Energy Orb

desc_chs: 燃素能量球
desc_en: Phlogiston Energy Orb

desc_chs: 磁力能量球
desc_en: Magnetic Energy Orb

desc_chs: 大型磁力能量球
desc_en: Large Magnetic Energy Orb

desc_chs: 至冬电量能量球
desc_en: Snezhnayan Power Energy Orb

desc_chs: 至冬建材能量球
desc_en: Snezhnayan Material Energy Orb

desc_chs: 洞天宝钱。可在壶灵处交换各类物品。
desc_en: Currency of the realm. Used within the Serenitea Pot to exchange for various items.

desc_chs: （test）卡牌货币
亮闪闪的勋章。虽说只是玩具，但也代表了观众们的认可。\n在「幻想真境剧诗」中，可以用来向小狼换取「表演诀窍」。
desc_en: A shiny medal. It is a toy, yes, but it nonetheless represents the acknowledgment of the audience.\nUse it in the "Imaginarium Theater" to obtain "Thespian Tricks" from Wolfy.

desc_chs: 通过「千音雅集」完成乐曲演奏挑战，获得的纪念币，是热爱音律之人获得认可的一种证明，可以在「千音藏品」换取独特的奖励。
desc_en: Currency gained from completing "Repertoire of Myriad Melodies" performances. Proof that you've been acknowledged as one who loves music and rhythm. Can be exchanged at the "Treasure of Myriad Melodies" for unique rewards.

desc_chs: 能使银白古树暂时复苏的透彻晶体，可以通过这种方式获得古代的宝藏。其中的能量会随时间恢复。
desc_en: A crystal that temporarily revitalizes Irminsul to grant you ancient treasures. The energy within regenerates over time.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「欢迎来到提瓦特。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Welcome to Teyvat!"

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n完成了游记写作最困难的部分，就是写个开头。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe most difficult part of writing a travel journal is coming up with the beginning.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「是兔兔伯爵哦！」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"It's Baron Bunny!"

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n可莉的幸运爆弹。仔细观察尾巴，告诉大家，这个是蹦蹦还是嘟嘟可？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nKlee's lucky explosive — can you tell if it's Jumpy Dumpty or Dodoco? (Hint: Look carefully at the tail...)

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n克利普斯老爷生前经常画鹰。但是他未曾预料如此炽烈燃烧的鹰，也出自自己之手。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nMaster Crepus painted many eagles during his lifetime, but he never could've foreseen creating an eagle with such fire.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n雷泽和群狼一起弄晚饭的姿态十分飒爽。但是不能给可莉和旅行者看到。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIt's quite a sight to behold Razor and the wolves prepare their dinner, but they won't let Klee or the Traveler see the slightly gruesome affair.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n天空的青色和「斐林」的音色应该很般配吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe bright blue of a cloudless sky and the melodious tone of Der Frühling complement each other perfectly.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n蒲公英又被叫做「狮子牙」，是对于风的方向感觉最敏锐的花。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe dandelion, also called "lion's fang" by some, is the flower most sensitive to the direction of the wind.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n什么东西会流淌？治愈的清泉和芭芭拉的歌声与旋律。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhen Barbara sings, her melodic voice flows like the tender healing of a clear spring.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n孔雀漂亮尾羽上的花纹很像是永不闭上的眼睛。所以凯亚并非少了一只眼睛，而是…
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe pattern of peacock feathers resembles eyes that never shut. Can we really say that this Pavo Ocellus is missing an eye...?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n什么东西会流逝？时间，和丽莎计算下班时间的沙漏。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAn hourglass marks the end of the work day for Lisa. Its sand moves fast.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n如果在无相之风消逝前仔细观察的话，会发现它们其实也挺方的。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIf you closely examine an Anemo Hypostasis before it disappears, you will discover that they are actually quite square.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n持有遮日挡月之翼的漆黑夜鸦。「许可你拓画它的纹样！」
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA raven dark as midnight with wings that can block out the sun. "I permit thee to conceive his likeness upon such decoration!"

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n诺艾尔比较特殊，诺艾尔不会让你受伤。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nNoelle is quite special. Noelle won't let any harm come to you.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n倒映着漫天的星辰，少女低头看着水中的离合悲欢。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA girl gazes down at the stars' reflection on the water, pondering the joys and sorrows of life.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n班尼冒险团的认可。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA sign of recognition from Benny's Adventure Team.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n快速而且准确地读出下面的话：「出锅锅巴！」、「锅巴出锅！」、「锅巴出击！」、「出击锅巴！」
desc_en: Namecard style.\nTry saying this three times fast: "Guoba sears sea snails by Liyue's sea shore."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n来看宿雨断虹收。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nCome watch the night rain that brings no rainbow.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n有什么需要冷藏？白先生的药材、椰奶…还有胡桃。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhat should be kept in the fridge? Dr. Baizhu's herbs, coconut milk... and Hu Tao.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n其实一开始这个是为了目测土地使用情况，方便登高而发明的。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIt was originally invented to just test out one's surroundings and climb to high places, really...

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n走遍了大陆所有的地方之后，还要记得最初的心哦。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAfter all your wanderings throughout the world, do not forget the reason why you first set out.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n既然掌握了这些技术，或许不需要战斗也能很好地活下去吧。如果没有使命在身的话。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAfter mastering these skills, you may just find that you can get by just fine without engaging in battle. If you are without any commission to complete, that is.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n英雄的旅程在一念之间就开始了。重要的还是旅程中途经历了多少事情。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nYour hero's journey began before you knew it, but it's the experiences that really made it special.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n听蒙德的鸟吟风唱。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nListen to the singing of Mondstadt's birds and winds.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n看璃月的云寂岩静。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWitness the lonely, cloud-covered peaks of Liyue.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n其实白昼之光，可以被色散成为无数种颜色。但是人们懒得数了，就简单分了七种。元素，大概也一样吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nLight can refract into countless colors, but people stop at seven because they're lazy to count. Perhaps the elements are like that, too.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n挽弓当挽强！
desc_en: Namecard style.\nDraw that bowstring taut!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n就算你只是想出门采一朵蒲公英，仍然会有阻碍横在你的面前。你当然欣然接受一切挑战，对吧？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEven if you're just going out to get a single dandelion, there will be obstacles in your path. But you love a challenge, don't you?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n行向地心越深，所知的秘密就越多。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe deeper you delve, the more secrets you shall uncover.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n其实一开始丘丘人会被命名为「山丘的鬼怪」。但是有某个马斯克小女孩坚持称他们为山丘的子民。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe hilichurls were dubbed the "hill devils." But a certain young girl named Musk insists on calling them the "hill dwellers."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n听了很多关于至冬的故事呢。在你想象里它是什么样的地方呢？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nYou've heard many stories about Snezhnaya. What does it look like in your mind's eye?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n说书人合扇说从头——但是你已经听过所有的故事了。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThey say that storytellers love their cliffhangers — but you? You've heard it all before.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n人生何处不相逢。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWe shall meet again someday.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n 常说「麟止凤仪，所患在少」。另一位不论，凝光大人这样的人，一个就够了…
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThey say that "more's the pity that phoenixes are few." But seriously, one Ningguang is more than enough...

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n 「若拔锚入海，惑而不知东西。则须仰天，识认北辰斗极。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Weighing anchor out to sea, one is wont to waver. But look to the skies, and the stars shall light the way."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n 本意只是用冰来制作桃木剑。不过做大了之后比起桃木更好驱魔了。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThis was originally a peachwood sword made of ice. But a big enough ice block makes a better exorcist's tool than peachwood.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n挑战的尽头看到的居然是…
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThat which awaits at the end of the challenges is...

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n只要你的渴望尚未平息，那抬头应该可以看到那无光的闪耀吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nSo long as there is still desire left in your heart, when you hold your head high you will see that which glitters but is not light.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n凯茨莱茵一家都有这种猫一样的特征。是远古时代里谁人的恶趣味吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAll who have Kätzlein blood will have such feline features. An ancient prank played by a certain someone, perhaps?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n天陨岩星，命昭昏暝。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nStars fall, light dims.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n辛焱唱罢之时才有机会仔细观察她的乐器。其实它静时也是一位美人。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nXinyan only has time to examine her instrument carefully after the performance is over. Even in silence, it is a beauty.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n借由万般变化的武炼之技，肆意驰骋大地的他的记号。但这名为「魔王」的武艺并非他的独创，而是师承自踞身宇宙至暗之处的那位孤高少女…
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThis bears all the marks of that fellow who gallivants as he pleases across the continent with his ever-changing combat styles. Yet, his "Foul Legacy" was not originally his. Rather, it was taught to him by that solitary girl who dwelt in the darkest corners of the universe.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n荣誉骑士的好名声早已远扬全城。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe name of the Honorary Knight has spread far and wide among the citizenry.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n喜欢帮助他人的仁心，大家都会相应地予之祝福。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThey who have it in their hearts to bless others shall themselves be blessed.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n坐看日月行，细数千帆过。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nMany boats have been numbered by day and night.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n岩间琉璃云间月。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe peaks adorn the clouded moon.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n终于有一个值得一战的对手了，这场战斗必定载入史诗。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nFinally, a worthy opponent! Our battle will be legendary!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n人问寒山道。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA draconian peak must be scaled.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n不折草，不履虫。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nDo no harm to plant nor insect.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n请让我来当这项奇迹的见证者吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAllow me to bear witness to this miracle.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n踏足雪山，注意保暖。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nRemember to keep warm when setting foot on the mountain.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n我等必将复起，古木已发新枝。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWe shall rise again — the tree of old has sprouted anew.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n今天挑战的对手是什么艺术风格吗？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nMy opponent for today seems to have an artistic temperament.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n他总想着有一天，能戴着这傩面起舞。不为除魔之故，只为伴随那花洲的笛声。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nHe longs for a day to come when he will wear the mask and dance — not to conquer demons, but to the tune of that flute amid a sea of flowers.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n胡桃堂主一点都不可怕。大概。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nDirector Hu Tao isn't scary at all. Probably.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n大家的愿望聚在一起，就能变成点亮长夜的光。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhen everyone's wishes are gathered together, they can light up the long night.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n年年今日，灯明如昼。愿火不灭，愿人依旧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEvery year on this day, the lanterns light up the night. May the fire never die, and may humanity endure.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n你道你见过机关算尽，可你真算到了自己也要下场当棋子吗？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nYou claim to have seen all mechanisms, but have you ever considered playing yourself as a pawn?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n人们无私散出的温暖和善意，在她心里就是必须回报的恩情，因此也是永生伴随她的苦役。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe unselfish warmth and goodwill of the people is, to her, a kindness that she must repay, and so it is an indenture that follows her forever.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n谁也没有见过风，更别说我和你了。谁也没有见过爱情，直到有花束抛向自己。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWho has seen the wind? Neither you nor I. Nor has anyone ever seen love, till a bouquet comes flying by.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n好极了！
desc_en: Namecard style.\nExcellent!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n宇宙里真的有这样一条蛇，闪烁着这样颜色的光辉鳞片。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe universe does play host to just such a snake, whose scales glitter with precisely these colors.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n智慧的果实要是落在大地之中，它会结出许多智慧来。但如果遇到了迪奥娜，那一定会很好喝就是了。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhat knowledge might the fruit of wisdom bring, were it to descend upon the land? Either way, it'll taste good as a drink if left in Diona's hands.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n你看不到我，你看不到我。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nYou can't see me. You can't see me.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n朱漆火印，以证公平。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nJustice, signed in scarlet.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n冷酷的心只是保护自己的外壳。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA cold heart is but a shell to protect oneself.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n前生何年枕石眠。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nHow many nights have you spent with a stone for your pillow?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n壶里日月长。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe days and months pass within the teapot.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「松籁枯波送红叶。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"The pine-song ripples as red leaves billow."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n是大冒险的时间！
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIt's adventure time!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n檐下天地宽。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe world is wide under the eaves.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n试着想象星海的浩瀚无垠。试着想象，一的后面写上一百个零。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nImagine the vast expanse of a sea of stars. Imagine a one followed by a hundred zeros.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「在好远好远的地方，有个叫『大联盟』的王国，住在那里的人能丢出变来变去、又快又厉害的『魔球』。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"In a land far, far away, there was a kingdom known as the Grand Alliance, and the people living there could throw ever-changing, quick, and powerful Kaboomballs."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n吉兆要出现三次，幸运才会降临；谢幕时应当三次鞠躬；而在风来人的剑斗剧中，胜负的对手也有三名。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nGood omens must appear thrice for good fortune to come. One bows thrice at curtain call. The opponents to defeat number three.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n绯樱飘落之处，尽在神木的守护之下。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWherever the sakura petals fall, there the protection of the sacred tree rests.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n鸣神大社的纹样，「影向山樱」。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe sakura of Mt. Yougou symbolizes the Grand Narukami Shrine.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n绫华的配扇当然一直在换。如果想作为赠礼送给她的话，记得不要送成了夏扇或者投扇，舞扇或者茶扇是不错的选择。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAyaka does constantly change out the fans she carries with her, of course. If you're buying her some as gifts, remember not to send summer fans or throwing fans. Dancing fans or tea fans are good choices, though.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n即使只是片刻的火花，也能在仰望黑夜的人心中留下久久不灭的美丽光芒。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEven momentary sparks can leave beautiful, unquenchable flames in the hearts of those who watch the night sky.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n虽然个子比早柚小，但却能帮早柚做早柚不想做的事情。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIt is even smaller than Sayu, sure, but it can help her do the things she doesn't want to do.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n大御所将军的纹样，亦即麾下军势之旗印，「雷之三重巴」。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThis is the emblem of the Ogosho Shogun, and is the banner of her troops, the Electro Mitsudomoe.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n三奉行中，社奉行·神里家的椿纹。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThis Tri-Commission house-crest represents the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n在门扉的对面，会有什么样的相遇呢。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhat encounters lie on the other side of this door?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n旅人将遍历的一万个故事，都将成为旅人灵魂的一部分。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA traveler shall experience ten thousand tales, and each shall form a part of the traveler's soul.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n我们曾经同行于巍岩之间。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nOur journey among the precipices.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n宇宙四方各取土一坯，养育天地万花。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nGather ye then soil from all corners of the universe, and from it may countless flowers grow.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n三奉行中，天领奉行·九条家的钴纹。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThis Tri-Commission house-crest represents the Tenryou Commission's Kujou Clan.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n真正的棋手能算尽千步之后的局面。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA true grandmaster can see the board a thousand steps ahead.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n不仅是影，也不只是将军。留一只雷曜之眼观照自己，方能得始终。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nNot simply Ei, and not merely the Raiden Shogun. Observe yourself also with one stormy eye, and you will someday reach a breakthrough.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n这是海祇之民都知晓的传说：在渊下有着曾经的故乡。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAll Watatsumi islanders know this tale: that deep beneath the waves lies their former home.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n裟罗摒弃了天狗一众傲慢的生存方式，但是对于磨炼剑技和神通却并没有怠慢。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nKujou Sara may have forsaken the arrogant life of the tengu race, but she has never neglected their brilliance with the sword or their supernatural might.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「真想让罗斯特也看看这些。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Everything I do is in the service of life, not death."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n愿逐月华流照君。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nMay the moonlight wash over you, O pursuer!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n海祇民之领袖，珊瑚宫家的家纹。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThis is the emblem of the Sangonomiya Clan, the leaders of Watatsumi's people.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「既然这些鱼都不能吃，何苦敲针做钩呢？」「这你就不懂了吧。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Wait, if these fish can't be eaten, then why are we hammering these nails into fishhooks?" "Oh, you wouldn't understand."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n星海啊，山岩啊，请你们倾耳听我的曲调吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nO stars and mountains above, listen to my song!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「我来问你问题，你只准用剑来回答。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"I will ask you a question, and you shall answer me with your sword."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n真红炽火铠，炎彩大袖甲。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nBlazing armor, flaming guards.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「你的存在意义，可并非恶行罚示哦。至于是什么，小生也不知道。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"You were not created to punish evil. But as to what your purpose is... I fear that I, too, do not know."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n啊啊，美丽的鸟，如神的鹫鸟啊。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nPirka chikappo! Kapatcir kamuy!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n只要相信自己行走的道路，那么这漫长旅途中遇到的一切都将是令人愉快的。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAs long as you believe in the path you are walking, then everything you encounter on your journey will be a source of happiness.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n男子汉，就要把痛苦和愤怒藏在背后，然后露出最爽朗的笑容！
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA real man puts sorrow and anger behind him and smiles brightly for the world to see!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n高峰之上万树凋零，唯有此花。
desc_en: Namecard.\nOnly this flower remains on the heights where all trees have withered.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n早生白发，多缘愁苦。因为「梳」「疏」同音，璃月人认为，以梳栉发，可以疏愁。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe early onset of white hair is often correlated to one's sorrows. Since "comb" and "scatter" are similarly read in Liyue's language, they believe that combing one's hair is the same as scattering one's misfortunes.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n云先生有师二种。一种在外，戏台之上时「说我孬者，是我师也」；一种在内，创作戏文，需要对照韵书。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nMs. Yun has two sorts of teachers. The critics of her onstage performances are one, and the books on rhyme she references while writing are the other.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「啊，伟大的太阳啊！假若你不拥有你照耀的一切，你的光热有何意义？」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"O Mighty Sun! What use are your heat and light if you cannot own all that they survey?"

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n华光流彩万象新。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe luxurious colors flow past — all things are renewed.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n这里有很多很多的故事，但是没有酒精。派蒙也可以喝。
desc_en: Namecard.\nThere's a great many stories here, but no alcohol, so it's safe for Paimon to drink.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n八重神子的狐狸形态在哪里能看到呢？在梦里吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhere can Yae Miko's fox form be found? In your dreams, that's where.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n三界震动，天地醒转。珊瑚王虫也从永眠中恢复了过来。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe three realms quake, heaven and earth awaken. The Sangacorexes, too, rise again from their eternal slumber.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n椿花浮镜，澄水泛波。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe camellia alights upon the mirrored pond, sending ripples throughout the water.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n无名无言的湛蓝晶石，其中流动的是高天的秘辛，或是巨渊的低语…？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhat flows within this nameless, voiceless azure crystal? The secrets of the heavens? Or the whispers of the abyss?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n听啊，丛云间回荡的声响。那是它的嗟怨忿怒，与一个小小的愿望。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nListen to the sound that comes from the clouds. That is its resentful rage, and its tiny wish.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n矿工曾奔忙穿梭的栈道与矿山，如今被寂静笼罩。仅有千年的琉璃晶砂与玉髓闪烁着幽光。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhere once miners industriously delved and tunneled, now all is silent. Only the Glazed Sand Crystal and marrows of stone, both millennia-old, still give off any brilliance.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n同好之人，谓之「同人」。趁着狐狸总编还没想到版权法，大家好好描绘心中的故事吧。——又或者，她想到了，但并不在乎？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThose who share a hobby are known as a group as "fans." Best come up with those stories, everyone, before the kitsune editor-in-chief dreams up copyright law... Or perhaps she has already dreamed it up, but does not altogether mind?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「做骰子本来就难得公平。做工糙一点的骰子，不同点数掏空的重量肯定会不一样。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Dice are always quite hard to make 'fair.' That goes double for dice with shoddier workmanship. The weighting on each numbered side will almost certainly be unbalanced."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「稻妻不是有那种鸣草轮吗？穿过去可以驱邪落秽那种。小忍就想到既然邪物不愿意主动钻圈，把草轮做成主动卷人的样子就好了。妹妹她做巫女的才能，真是可怕啊。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"You know those Naku Weed rings they have in Inazuma? You know, the kind that can drive out evil? Shinobu got the idea that since wicked things won't cross their boundaries willingly, we could make them into items that could be actively used. Ah, her talent for being a shrine maiden truly is frightening..."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「昔有忠魂，似那飞鸿散东西。」「今我引灯，唯愿英灵毋歧迷。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Once upon a time, loyal souls did scatter east and west like swan geese." "Today I light my lantern, that they may not lose their way."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n本是殚精竭虑用彩线周匝而成，却未料在其手中不过是简单抽出丝缕的游戏。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA Temari of entwining strings in various colors. It must have taken someone's great effort to make such an item, yet Heizou only sees it as a simple game to untangle each string.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n就像你多年后，从旧梦中醒来。纪念的螺壳里，仍存在着那年夏天的海。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nYears have gone by, and you wake from an old dream. Inside the keepsake shell, lingers the blue ocean of those summer days.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n提纳里用花露精心调制的精油，用来保养毛茸茸的大尾巴，淡淡的清香有着安神的功效。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nTighnari takes good care of his big, fluffy tail. The essential oil he uses was extracted from flowers and mixed together meticulously. It gives off a faint, calming scent.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「是…是柯里安巴哦！…呜…」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"I—It's Cuilein-Anbar! I, uh..."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n擦一擦递给你的魔灯，再擦一擦递给她的摩拉，无论是什么样的愿望都能实现…大概吧？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIf you wipe the lamp she gave you and then scrub the Mora you gave her, no wish is unattainable... right?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n深林幽谷之间，蔷薇伴月安绽。若得与你相伴，此处便是乐园。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nBeneath the tranquil moon and inside the deep valley grows blooming roses. 'Tis a paradise with your presence.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n每一段旅途、每一段回忆，都是只属于旅人的、独一无二的奇迹。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEvery journey and memory is a unique miracle that only belongs to the traveler.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n总有一天，此刻的相逢，将会成为值得眷恋的思念。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nOne day, our encounter at this moment shall shine like a star of reminiscence in our hearts.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n那些静静沉睡在林中的故事，又寄托着什么样的美梦呢。
