desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhat dreams lie within the rich slumber of the stories deep in the woods?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n遍览世间相，一念彻天光。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nBehold everything the world has to offer; see through all that the sky's light surveys.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n洞悉真谛的智者不受罪恶沾染，如沐濯雨露却依然清净的月莲。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe wise, graced with the thorough knowledge of the truth, will not be sullied by sin. They are like the Nilotpala Lotus, which remains clear and pure even after the rains and winds have passed.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n岁月流转，唯有思念与归风不变。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe years come and go. Only remembrance and the winds that return do not change.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n赛诺看上去幽沉而肃默的时候，未必总是在想着什么沉肃的审判，也有可能只是在思考幽默的笑点。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhenever Cyno falls into a profound silence, he must be considering some weighty judgment... Or perhaps he is simply considering something amusing.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n往昔的炽风撩拂着苍鹭的尾羽，那鸟儿却只是望向初晓的晨星。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe burning winds of the past ruffle the heron's feathers, but the bird has eyes only for the morning star at first light.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n绽于净水的莲华，不过是她足尖下的一刹流光。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe lotus that blooms amidst the pure water is naught but a flash of light beneath her toes.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n无论是谁，都能奏响属于自己的美妙乐章，正如草上的浅露，也能映出天光的七芒。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAnyone can play a tune that belongs just to them, and like the dew upon grass, can reflect the seven lights of heaven.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n砂原埋藏下旅人的足迹，等待来日的尘风卷起饰金的回忆。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe sands subsume the tracks of travelers, and they await the day when a gust of wind will reveal gilded memories once more.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「千年的妄执与悲愿，都已经消逝在了灼夜的风沙中。但她梦里那片永恒的绿洲，应当依旧柔茂如初吧…」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"A millennium of obsession and tragic yearning has long been lost in the sandstorms of those blazing nights. But the eternal verdant oasis of her dreams is, in all likelihood, as tender as it was at the first..."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n初升的新月将日景仰羡，因为她的光芒遍照世间；沉落的暮日却向往月弦，因为她有万千美梦作伴。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe rising moon admires the sun, because her light can shine all over the earth. On the other hand, the setting sun is envious of the moon, for she can be accompanied by the sweetest of dreams.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「梦中的星空会将你的前路照亮，只是你那颗心中的水晶，也要映出澄净的辉光。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"The starry sky in your dreams will illuminate your way forward, on the premise that the crystal in your heart reflects clear lights."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「…旅人啊，不必哀伤，因为那黎明的风儿，定会将载着美梦的蕈孢，吹向你希冀中的原野…」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Traveler, there is no need to grieve, for the wind at dawn will blow the fungal spores carrying beautiful dreams to the fields that contain your hopes..."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n浮世隐昔话，薄雪伴流花。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIn a world most transient does the past hide, and in the whims of flowing flowers does thin snow abide.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「总、总之，下次提问之前，要先叫前辈！真是的…」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"A—Anyway! Next time, remember to refer to me as Madam Faruzan before you ask a question! Seriously..."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「村子里还没人能胜得了我！」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"In this village, no one can defeat me!"

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n旧宴何为名，三川流散烟云中，秋津犹尚浮暮景。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nForgotten is the name of the ancient feast, scattered are the three rivers amongst a plumage of clouds, and across the curve of twilight does autumn yet linger.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「学者应当遵循之物，唯有知论与证辩。只有时刻保持对一切的质疑，才能避免陷入偏见。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"The only things researchers should abide by are debates and dialectics. Only by questioning everything at all times can one avoid falling into prejudice."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「猜猜看，这里哪一个是月桂？没错，大家都是月桂喔！」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Can you guess which one here is Yuegui? That's right, all of them are!"

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n浮云晓向千峰散。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe floating clouds dispersed to the thousand peaks at dawn.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n霞明玉映海灯天，今宵共奏华年。金殿珠帘，月彻银栏，虹歌流彩绣筵。花如烟。瑟彼清弦，鸾笙瑶管，和乐且湛。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWith magnificent sunglow sheds light on the night sky, chimes are orchestrated to celebrate the bygone year. The gilded palaces are adorned with beaded curtains, the railings painted silver by bright moonlight, and the feasts brimmed with jolly singing and dances. Is that flowers or fireworks? A wealth of instruments plays in unison, harmonious and pleasant.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n永不停息的沙暴之内，隐匿着古老的梦想…
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe endless sandstorm conceals ancient dreams...

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n那些该被烧却的将化作飞灰，于是所有应被保留的珍贵之物得以显出形廓。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThose that should be burned will be reduced to fly ash, so that all the precious things that should be preserved can be revealed.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n每次将绘制的地图捧在手中，男孩都觉得自己捧起了一小片世界的拓印。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEvery time he holds the map he illustrated in his hands, the boy feels like he is holding a small piece of rubbing of this world.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n都说真爱如同鬼魅，谈论者众而见者少，但既然在此处鬼魅也偶尔现身，或许真爱也正等在下一个街角。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIt is said that experiencing true love is like seeing a ghost. Most folks speak of both as hearsay, but true witnesses remain few and far between. That said, since even ghosts can manifest here, perhaps true love is also waiting right around the next corner.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「谨道成术，长有摄生。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\nSincerity begets longevity.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「构思建筑之时，不妨设想，我们正在建筑的，是逾越穹天与繁星的永恒。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"When conceptualizing architecture, there is nothing wrong with imagining that the structure we build will surmount the firmament and outlast the stars."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「万种的灵光啊，护佑着永劫的大地。世间流转的枯荣，不过是种子现行的幻象。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Oh, Khvarena in your endless forms, protect this imperiled land. The blights and glories of the earthly realm are naught but the illusion of existing seeds."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「我终将遗忘昔时的繁花、昼光和雨露。愿你为我铭记，在新生的世界中，铭记那不复的梦。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"I will forget the flowers of yesteryear, the daylight, the rain. I ask that you remember in my stead, in this nascent world, and hold to that lost dream."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「新芽萌发的时节尚未到来，请小心将我藏起，在草木亦流连的梦境。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"The time to flourish has yet to come. Hide me with care between the blades of grass and beneath the tallness of trees. Let me linger in that place of dreams."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n遗世的甘露池水虽盛满了属于过去时代的追忆，但其中或许也蕴藏着将要创造未来的力量。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe ancient Amrita Pool is suffused with recollections of times past. Perhaps it also contains the power that will create the future.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「才识是年岁的冠冕，正如思念是我们共度的时间。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Knowledge serves as the crown of time, and reminiscence is bound to the time we shared as one."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「那些收件人满足的笑容，对绮良良来说就是最好的报酬。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"To Kirara, the smiles on her customers' faces are the best rewards possible."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n勿忘那些与友人相伴游戏的岁月，勿忘那些不必忧虑未来的时光。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nNever forget the time you once spent with games and good friends. Never forget what it feels like to have no worries about the future.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n在透明玻璃的另一面才得以存在的幻梦之光，说不定也能稍稍照亮这面的世界。
desc_en: Namecard style\nWho knows? Perhaps the phantasmal light that only exists on the other side of this transparent glass can ever so slightly brighten up the world on this one.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n魔术有一大分类就是「凭空消失」。林尼的戏法有诸多欺瞒。作为共犯的你如果愿意睁只眼闭只眼，那一切问题都可以消失不见。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nOne major type of magic revolves around making things "vanish." Lyney has an arsenal of tricks up his sleeve. As his accomplice, as long as you are willing to turn a blind eye, all your problems may vanish as well.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n魔术有一大分类就是「突然出现」。琳妮特平常虽然都在节约能量，但是认真的一面也会像是魔术帽里的鸽子一样突然出现。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nOne major type of magic revolves around "appearing suddenly." Lynette is usually conserving her energy, but her serious side can "appear" as abruptly as pigeons from a hat.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n明明发条在原地打转，玩偶们却在迈步向前。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAs the clockwork devices do naught but round and round in circles turn, the dolls march forward.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n新任水之神的纹章。不需要法律声明，谅也没谁敢随意使用。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe insignia of the new Hydro Archon. Even without any legal notice, it is understood that none dare use it without permission.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「至高的王上啊，深秘院为你呈上预测的结果：双星早已被大地的引力捕获…经历了漫长的归回周期，如今它们的轨迹将要再度交错。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"O Almighty Sovereign, the Universitas Magistrorum has provided the predictions you requested: The two stars have been captured by the world's gravity... After a lengthy orbital period, today their paths shall intertwine once more."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n旅人曾用手触摸万千条水流，它们从世界的源头淌来，最终也将归于同一之海。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe hands of travelers have touched ten thousand streams. They all flow from the same font of the world's waters, and all return to the same sea.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n枫丹发条机关通用能源模块的标志。关于要不要注册为商标曾经有过大讨论。总之呼吁大家不要随意使用。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe symbol of the energy blocks used by all of Fontaine's clockwork meka. There was once a great debate over whether it should be registered as a trademark, but in the end, the public was simply called upon not to use it too freely.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n蒸汽鸟报的商标。保留一切权利。一旦发现盗用，我们一定通过法律手段维护到底！
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe trademarked logo of The Steambird. If you are discovered using it without first obtaining prior permission, we will uphold our rights and prosecute the offense to the fullest extent of the law!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n时计伴着安谧的岁月流转，鱼儿伴着皎澈的源水游旋。若是说万象终有枯竭之日，我的思念又为何澄浄如初？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nTimepieces accompany the tranquil passing of the years, as fish accompany the swirling of the clear waters of the font. If all that is must one day wither, why is my yearning as clear as ever?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n水面之所以保持着如宝石般无瑕的平静，也许只是在等待泛起涟漪的时机。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe water's surface may seem placid as a pristine gem, but it may yet be lying in wait for an opportune moment to gush forth.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n维持梅洛彼得堡内部的平衡并不是简单的工作，为此，他需要一些灵活的手腕，适量严苛，和少许令人叹息的残酷。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nMaintaining order at the Fortress of Meropide is no simple affair. As such, a deft and sometimes firm hand is needed — along with a small pinch of truly regrettable cruelty.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n在掷出箭矢前轻轻许愿吧，如果能够将之投入壶中，那份心中的期冀也许亦可得以实现。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nMake a wish before you toss the arrow. If you manage to get it into the pot, who knows — your wish just might come true.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n万壑松声山雨过。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe trees sing on the slopes of a thousand mountain valleys, accompanied by the music of the passing rain.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「于螺丝与齿轮中断裂的梦已无人听取，唯有不知疲倦的机关舞者，仍用似轻羽般优雅落下的脚步，日以继夜叩问过往的回音。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"No one hears the dream that shattered between the conches and the gears. Only the tireless mechanical dancer still queries the echoes of the past day and night with its every elegant step."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n梅洛彼得堡的官方标识。希望尊敬秩序且目标是安稳度过余生的各位，不用与此标识背后的机构产生任何关联。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe official logo of the Fortress of Meropide. It is our dearest hope that all who wish to honor order and live out their lives in peace shall not ever be associated with the organization this insignia represents.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n一个人能吃下所有的蛋糕吗？或者每天吃一个，这样差不多可以吃一周？但是蛋糕放不了这么多天啊。唔…不要担心，以后就有很多朋友一起来吃了吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nCan one person eat every cake? If they eat one per day, they should be able to enjoy cake for a week or so, right? But will the cakes stay fresh that long? Hmm... Well, don't worry, because there will be friends coming to eat the cakes together.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「一、写好了独家新闻报道，一定会很有话题度的！二、结果报社说事态逐步升级改发通稿…三、写通稿的那人明天要去欧庇克莱歌剧院坐被告席，又换成我的了！」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"One, I've written an exclusive, and it's going to generate a lot of buzz for sure! Two, the newspaper said the situation is developing too slowly, so they're changing to a press release instead... Three, the person writing the press release will be in the Opera Epiclese as the defendant tomorrow, so they've decided to run my piece after all!"

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「晚云在暮天上散锦，溪水在残日里流金；我孤独的影子飘荡，像涧底寂寞的幽灵。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"The evening clouds scatter in the sky and the creek shines gold under the setting sun. My shadow wanders alone, akin to a lonely apparition at the bottom of a waterfall."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n就算发条不再原地打转，就算玩偶不再迈步向前。回忆成为永恒化作珊瑚，也请不要忘记我们一起的冒险与时间。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEven if the clockwork stops ticking, even if the puppets stop stepping forward. Though our memories be frozen eternally as coral, do not forget our adventures and the time we spent together.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n玫瑰会绽放，娜维娅小姐的伞可以打开。但是要小心，因为玫瑰带刺，娜维娅小姐的伞可以发射强力伞弹。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nRoses shall bloom, and thus does Ms. Navia's umbrella flower. Yet beware, for roses have thorns, and Navia's booming brolly packs a powerful punch.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n特巡队配枪全名叫「特巡队贰型制式铳枪」。夏沃蕾则把自己那把取名叫「贰型」。就像世上有无数的花，但是你珍惜的那一朵就算被命名为朴实无华的「花」，也同样与众不同。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe standard issue weapon of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol is known as the "Special Security and Surveillance Patrol Type II Standard Musket." Yet, though there may be countless flowers in this world, the one you treasure is special, even if it should be known to the world as nothing at all special.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n不知道还需要多久提瓦特的映影艺术才能重新发明「雕刻时光」。不过这幕剧，确实凝固了罪恶的过往。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWho knows how long it shall take before film in Teyvat will advance to the point of reinventing the art of "carving time"? Still, this scene has indeed frozen the sinful past.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n坦白从宽。当留云问你：「难道在你眼中，本仙只是个大一点的鸟？」的时候，你是不是还想着：「对，还会说话，还会摆弄奇怪的机关。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThose who the truth tell, commuted shall their sentence be. Be honest. When Cloud Retainer asked you, "Do you perceive one as merely some larger bird?", did you also append the thoughts, "Yes, and you talk, and fiddle with funny machines"?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「文仔，要相信。有朝一日龙穿凤，不用日日裤穿窿。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Don't stop believing, Man Chai. One day, we'll soar high, with nary a patched hole in our trousers."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n…后来鱼沉入湖底，蛇断为几节，留下的野兽等着山与河与月，等着它们无言的回答。
desc_en: Namecard style.\n...After that, the fish sank to the bottom of the lake, and the snake was split into several pieces. The remaining beasts waited on mountains, rivers, and moon, awaiting their silent answer.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n海晏川河固，星朗珠玉明。山民共鸟兽，率舞感升平。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nStars flicker brightly above the tranquil sea and rivers. The mountain folk dance in harmony with birds and beasts.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n鹞腾鹤驻春来早，借我风筝五丈风。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nHarriers and cranes come early in spring. Let the wind rise and the kites soar.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n我们在一段旋律里暂别，又在另一段旋律重新相遇。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWe parted in one melody and reunited in another.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n被叫做「阿袖」的娃娃是千织最早的作品，也是最省裁剪与布料的模特。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe doll known as "Tamoto-chan" was one of Chiori's earliest works, and is also the model that requires the least fabric and tailoring.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n炼金术是研究物质互相转化的学科，但是用炼金术制作药剂质量却会少一截。可能是变成大家快乐的心情了吧，我不知道。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAlchemy is a discipline that studies the conversion from one substance to another, but using alchemy to make potions reduces the quality by a drop. I don't know, perhaps that missing drop is converted into making everyone's mood a bit lighter.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「父亲」大人为壁炉之家订立了严苛的法度，当中有些条目甚至有些不近人情。熟悉她的人，或许能借由这些规则，隐约勾勒出她从不轻言的理想吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Father" laid down the harsh strictures of the House of the Hearth, and some of these seem almost unreasonable. Those familiar with her can use these rules to trace the outline of the ideals she so rarely speaks of.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n乐章「福波斯」已然狂乱失序，调律师的职责就是使其重回正调。然而「法图纳」无声地行进，因命运知晓，完美的乐章也有演奏结束的一刻。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe symphony known as "Phobos" has gone out of control, and a Harmost must bring it back in harmony. Yet Fortuna's wheels turn on noiselessly, for destiny knows that even the perfect melody must someday end.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n这次达达利亚与它激战了相当长的时间，尽管仍然没能打败它。第三次追捕鲸鱼是不吉利的，可达达利亚不会放弃。不过等它康复可能得花上好久好久。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThis time, Tartaglia fought this entity for a long time, though he remained unable to defeat it. Hunting the same whale thrice is considered unlucky, but he will not give up. That said, it will be a long while before the creature fully recovers.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n不要喝露景泉的水，因为你不知道会喝下谁的泪。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nDon't drink from the Fountain of Lucine. You never know whose tears you're swallowing.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「世界不疼爱他的孩子，不然干嘛赶着他们去另一个世界？」「你懂什么？说不定那边更摇滚呢。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"The world does not love its children. If not, why chase them into the next one?" "What do you know? Maybe that one rocks even harder."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n用心的主持人在「桌上剧团」游戏中会切换帽子来表示身份的切换。那克洛琳德主持游戏是不是——\n想什么呢，她游泳都没摘过这顶帽子。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nDedicated Game Masters at the Tabletop Troupe will sometimes switch hats to indicate their change in role. Hmm, in that case, does Clorinde—\nForget about it! She doesn't even take that hat off when swimming.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n希格雯会好好照顾病患的。注射治疗没有那么痛，药物治疗的话，虽然也不好吃，但味道至少不像是特制奶昔那么荒芜。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nSigewinne will take good care of her patients. Don't worry, her injections aren't that painful — and while the medicines aren't very tasty, you'd take them over the barren wasteland that special blend milkshakes represent.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n跋灵各有象征。看起来像是沙漏，但是这其实象征着赤王统治里上下风蚀赤土的联合。而其中的明灯则是赫曼努比斯的智慧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEach Ba Fragment has its unique symbol. While this one resembles an hourglass, it represents King Deshret's rule over both Upper and Lower Setekh. As for the light within, it stands for the wisdom of Hermanubis.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n谁人所织造的梦幻是虚假的，但是最后指向了真实不虚的东西。在这条路的尽头，一定有着「回忆」化成的永恒吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe dreams someone weaves into being are false, but they nonetheless point toward something real. There must be an eternity forged from "memory" at the end of this path.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「胜利只是游戏者的错觉，沉默方是棋盘上的终结。所以唯一的善行是落子，而唯一的恶行是弃局。」「少玩点『推演』吧！」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Victory is but a mere trick of the player's imagination. Silence is the chessboard's true endgame. As such, the one virtuous deed is to play, and to forfeit is the sole sin." "Hey, why don't you play a few less wargames?"

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「前调甜美，中调浓郁却不会喧宾夺主，后调有种淡淡的檀香味。多么精致的一款香水啊。」\n工作一个接一个，为了避免气味干扰现场，艾梅莉埃很少自己用香水。她什么时候有机会闻到后调呢？
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"The top note is sweet, the middle rich but not distracting, and the base — Ah! Such a faint fragrance! Such an exquisite perfume."\nOrders flow in and out in an endless stream, and to prevent any scents from disturbing her work, Emilie very seldom uses perfume herself. Alas. When will she have the chance to delight in those base notes?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n木头被做成了纸，纸片折叠成为树。纸折成的大家，虚假之中仍有一丝真我。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWood is processed into paper, and paper is folded into trees. All who are of folded paper shelter a true self within a falsehood.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n大餐是由什么做成的？番茄、洋葱，还有所有美味的东西。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhat makes a feast? Tomatoes, onions, and all other delicious things.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n听起来很像是伟大的圣龙库胡勒·阿乔终于让基尼奇小子成为了自己的意志容器。很可惜，这只是因为名片的命名规则如此罢了。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAt first glance, you might think that the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw had finally succeeded in turning the puny Kinich into a vessel of his will. Sadly, though, this is just the way namecards are named.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n海里的鲨鲨其实不喜欢吃人，只喜欢吃海洋生物。玛拉妮的鲨鲨冲浪板原型是淡水温泉鲨，所以只吃温泉生物。骗你的，不吃豚兽的啦。一是因为肉很柴，二是因为冲浪板不吃东西。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nSharks that live in the sea don't actually like eating people — they prefer marine creatures. So as a shark that lives in freshwater hot springs, it's only natural that Mualani's Sharky Surfboard will only eat hot spring creatures. ...Just kidding, those Capybaras can sleep easy. Firstly, because their meat's too tough. And secondly, because... it's a surfboard?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n冲天转转上半部分的搭乘仓稳定性很好。但是如果下半被卡住，那也确实很容易让搭乘者被转晕。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe upper half of the Turbo Twirly is very stable, but if the lower half gets stuck, there's a high chance you'll end up with one very dizzy rider.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「…沐浴于隐秘的太阳之下，希巴拉克的行军势不可挡。他让世间再度充满兵戈，但他的目的绝不仅是如此…」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"...Bathed by a hidden sun, Xbalanque's forces advance with unstoppable momentum. He brings all-out war to the world once more, but his goals don't stop there..."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「…那归来的月光之下，分享了光、热与智慧的龙之王静候着来人。他再度醒转，并不只是为了…」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"...Sharer of light, heat, and wisdom, the dragon king awaits the coming visitor in silence beneath returning moonlight. His reawakening is not simply for..."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n真实的星天在夜空中划出一圈又一圈的轨迹。花海等待着离开的那一朵回归，等待着心与花瓣变得柔软的那一天。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe orbits of the true stars are traced in myriad rings across the night sky. A sea of blossom awaits the return of a single flower, anticipating the day when both hearts and petals shall become soft and tender.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n你问未来？且在此处坐好。让猫猫忍住把水晶球扒落到地下的冲动，为你把命运的秘密偷来。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nYou want to know what the future holds? Then stay here and sit tight. Let this little kitty resist the urge to knock the crystal ball onto the ground, and steal the secrets of fate for you.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n享受角逐本身吧。胜败同等尊荣，皆归于夜中之火。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nGive yourself over to the joy of the contest — for victor and vanquished shall earn honor in equal measure, with both belonging to the flames of the night.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n抚平那些不息意念的办法？在这片土地上，唯有战斗一途！
desc_en: Namecard style.\nHow can restless thoughts be calmed? In this land, the only way is battle!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n为什么是绿色、棕色、紫色呢？一般来说最早遇到的同伴不应该是红、绿、蓝或者赤、青、黄的吗？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nBut why green, brown, and purple? Shouldn't the first companions we meet be red, green, and blue, or... yellow?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n盐糖得位，甜咸交宁，色金质脆，美味生焉。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThis golden array of food is the perfect balance of salty and sweet.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n万山回响着希诺宁锻打的律动。当最后一丝回声渐消，那会儿她早已停下工作，寻找午后的日光去小睡了。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nRight on cue, the mountains echo with the rhythm of Xilonen's forge-hammer. When the final echo fades, she has already long ceased her toil and found a sunlit spot for her afternoon nap.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「十二个月亮又十二个月亮，新的记忆会生长。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Twelve moons and twelve more, new memories will grow."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n放心吧，人家是来调停的，又不是来打架的。问题也就是要不要省几发子弹罢了…对着天空警告射击的那种。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nFear not, she's here to make peace, not to fight. The only question is whether to save a few bullets... Y'know, the type that get fired into the sky as warning shots.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n就像星光无法照亮夜色，烛灯下亦有阴影，心的空洞也同样难以填满。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nJust as starlight cannot overpower the darkness of night, so too do shadows linger beneath the candle's light. Likewise, the heart's emptiness cannot easily be filled.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n欲使人为龙的贤哲，与欲使人为人的君王，奋其私智的规划皆已成梦。但残缺是好的，高于完满。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nBefore one could become a sage among dragons, or a king among men, the ploys of one's ambition would have long since turned to naught but dreams. Yet to be incomplete is good; superior, in fact, to perfection.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n即使已失去肉体，即使已身在冰冷的幽泉之中，持续不断斗争的意志仍然不会消亡。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEven if one was to lose their physical form and find themselves trapped in the cold depths of some ghostly spring, the will to fight on shall never fade away.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n烟谜主的织卷之所以可以记录故事，那是因为万物皆有经纬，曾经之事与纺织的纵横亦然。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe reason that the Masters of the Night-Wind are able to record stories in their scrolls is very simple — that everything in this world has its warp and weft. All that has been is no less than the very fabric of existence.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n任何一代火神都没有与太阳争锋的意思。但是在普通人眼里，这「太阳环」就是如太阳一般闪耀领袖的冠冕。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nNo Pyro Archon has ever intended to contest the sun. But as ordinary people see it, this "solar ring" is the crown of leaders as radiant as the sun.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n黑色的那只像是黑曜石，所以叫做「伊兹帕帕」。白色的这只也和星星一样白，所以被叫做「茜特菈琳」。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe black one is akin to obsidian, and is thus called "Itzpapa." The white one is white as a star, and has thus been named "Citlalin."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n燕子来时挟清雨，能洗旧冬一点愁。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe swallow's arrival shall bring forth cleansing rains, washing the worries of wizened winter away.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n旅人的视线如光注视一切，而事物的印象终会如浓烈的色彩般浮现于脑海之中。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe gaze of a traveler looks upon all like a light, and your impression of things will someday resurface in your mind in vivid, intense color.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n在曾代表一切光热和智慧的火焰亦受幽邃的深色侵蚀之后，唯一属于这受困巨兽的，只有此刻心中无法熄止的战意。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAfter the flame that once represented light, heat, and wisdom became corroded by the tenebrous dark, the only thing that yet belonged to the imprisoned titan was its inextinguishable will to fight.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n或许存在这样的曲子，收集了世上一万种妙音。澎湃的心潮是乐句，忧虑的思绪是短暂的休止，而音符里有一切的一切，欢笑、哭泣、遗忘的梦与跃动的雨滴…
desc_en: Namecard style.\nPerhaps a melody may exist that collects and contains all the wondrous music in the world. Surging heartbeats mark the musical phrase, anxious thoughts form brief rests, and within the notes lie all things — laughter, tears, forgotten dreams, and dancing raindrops...

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n春逐五更来，总将旧符烧去。举杯敬屠苏，才把新桃换取。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe spring comes on sure, and old peach wood charms must be burned. Raise your cups of herbal wine in toast, then exchange those old talismans for new ones.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n食梦的貘会将噩梦食去留下美梦，可万一梦都是反的呢？应对这样的忧虑，她温柔的解释是这样的：全方位的美梦，即使透过现实翻转过来，那也是美好的呀。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe yumekui-baku consume nightmares and leave only pleasant dreams. But what if dreams are to be understood in reverse? Faced with such conjecture, her warm-natured response: A truly beautiful dream, even if turned upside down through reality's lens, would still remain beautiful.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n进行一次强大攻击的诀窍就是，先收起拳头，再满怀一往无前的信念将之打出！
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe secret to unleashing a powerful attack is to pull back your fist and then strike out with unwavering conviction.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n花见游艺远歌去，依稀留梦痕。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAs flowers bloom and distant songs fade, faint traces of dreams remain.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n支撑她身躯里如此之大力量的能量来源是什么呢？也许是一个比整个世界都略大的胃口…吧？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhat could possibly be the secret to her immense strength? D'you think it's got something to do with her nigh-on insatiable appetite...?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「如果需要的话，即使在梦中也应该不懈锻炼…这种事，只要努力一下就能做到！」话是这么说，但是真的能够做到吗？
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"If you really need to, and you push yourself hard enough, you can even train in your dreams!" Sounds great, but... Is it actually possible?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n曾映照整个旧日辉煌的龙瞳之中，如今，复归的光芒又揭示了新世界的预兆。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nHaving once beheld the old world in all its glory, these draconic eyes now shine with fresh vigor, heralding the dawn of a new one.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n若世上有全部的斗争都得以平息之日，就是夜晚的神祇也可以陷入安宁沉睡的时刻了吧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIf ever the day comes when all worldly conflicts can finally be put to rest, then even the gods of night themselves may drift off into peaceful slumber.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n在玩耍和追逐中学会战斗的方式，在伤口和苦痛中取得不被磨灭的勇气，然后将此作为起点，我们开始打探世界的边垒。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWe learn to fight through play and pursuit, to stand firm through wounds and hardship, and with that strength, set forth for the very limits of the world.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n对于爱可菲来说，韵律和味道是有对应关系的。至于她为什么不吃着美味的餐点来作曲，理由也很简单。稳定的味道值得信赖，一直写同一首曲子那就没什么意义了。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nFor Escoffier, a certain relationship exists between rhythm and flavor. Why, then, does she not fuel her compositions with delicious food? The answer is quite simple — consistent flavors are reliable and comforting, but no one wants to hear the same song over and over.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「『和伊法搞好关系有什么好处吗？』有的，哥们，包有的。」「有的，哥们，有的。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"'Is there any point in getting close to Ifa?' Of course there is, bro, absolutely." "Of course there is, bro, of course there is."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n拍摄映影的场记也是一个重要的工作，作用就是记录拍摄场次的各种信息。仔细一想，你就是最好的场记，因为你已经记住了一切。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nScript supervisors perform a vital role. They record every detail of each scene to ensure continuity. Thinking about it, you're the best script supervisor there is — you already remember everything.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n她留下孤独的身影，并非是为了故作神秘。她曾是整片荒野烈火过后最后的一只兔子，她如今则是不能对绵羊开口、伪装了自己的狮子。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nHer solitude is not some show meant to maintain an air of mystery. She was once the last rabbit left standing in the wildfire's wake — now, she's a lion in disguise, unable to speak her truth to the sheep.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n如果说「偶像」这工作的本质就是「被人喜爱」，那塔利雅的天职可能就在此了。芭芭拉尚且需要努力当好偶像，塔利雅只需要管好隐私，别被人发现和某吟游诗人一起喝酒…\n…好像也不那么简单？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIf the essence of being an "idol" is simply "being loved," then Dahlia might've found his sacred calling. Barbara still strives to perfect her image, while Dahlia need only guard his privacy — lest someone spot him sharing drinks with a certain bard...\n...Though that may not be as easy as it seems.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n在「咔嗒」作响的倒计时中，晚宴如约拉开帷幕。乔装舞会的转身之后，两人同时开始了各自的计划…\n也许这份心照不宣，才是更值得珍重的「秘宝」。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAmid the ticking countdown, the gala commences on schedule. After their masked waltz, the two set their separate schemes into motion...\nPerhaps this unspoken understanding is the true "treasure" to be cherished.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n如果棋子某日生出自己的想法，是否也能反过来令执棋人陷入欠行的僵局？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nShould chess pieces ever grow minds of their own, could they too force their players into awkward zugzwang?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n家用机器人等待着您的指令。但是「薇尔琪塔」会指着你，让你好好掂量一下想说什么命令。她可配备了激光模块哦。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe household robot awaits your command, but Birgitta will keep her aim on you, silently urging you to choose your next words carefully. She does come equipped with a laser module, after all.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n令镌刻图腾的石轮转动的，不止有岁月，还有一切炽热的灵魂。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe stone wheel of the totem turns. Not just with the passage of time, but with the blazing of all souls.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n就算风不再吹拂那破碎之地，依旧有巡风者腾起在灰烬里。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEven when the winds no longer sweep these broken plains, those who chase the breeze through the ashes will still remain.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n时间悠悠地走哟，你悠悠地停。没想过要抵达什么地方，拣首诗儿悠悠地吟。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nTime floats easy, light and free. You sway so breezy, just let it be. No rush to go, no need to know — just pick a poem and go with the flow.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n回转是为了把所有好吃的在你面前展示。美味则是为了用幸福感填满你的心。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe rotation is meant to display all the delicious food before you. The deliciousness, on the other hand, is meant to fill your heart with happiness.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n异地有过对鹿角者的传说。角是大脑容纳不下的灵性破开头颅，像是树的枝杈一样向上成长而成的。不知道菈乌玛的角曾经是不是软软的茸。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIn a distant land, there are legends of those who bear antlers. Antlers are said to be the outgrowth of wisdom too vast for the mind to contain, branching upward like the limbs of a tree. One can't help but wonder if Lauma's antlers were once soft and covered in velvet.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n俗言道：「鬼火像是爱情，在荒芜的沼泽里最为显眼，却总是在最危险的地方上引诱。」当然，说的是作为自然现象的鬼火。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAs the saying goes, "Will-o'-the-wisps are like love — most visible in the barren swamp, and just as likely to lead you into danger." Of course, the saying only relates to the natural phenomenon.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「冷静一下鸭」过热的时候究竟是有另一个「冷静一下鸭」给它降温，还是只能听到爱诺一声「哎呀」呢？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhen a "Cool Your Jets Ducky" is overheating, does Aino throw out another Ducky to cool its jets, or does she just say "Whoopsie Ducksie" and leave it at that?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n与你一起见到的第一轮新月，是过去一千个夜里最美的那轮。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nOf the thousand nights before, none held a new moon as beautiful as the one we saw.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n月下的人们追逐着潮汐，因为那是初升的新月行过的痕迹。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nUnder the moonlight, people chase the tides, for they are the traces left behind by the rising new moon.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n一万个冬天以后是一万个春天，一万次离别后是一万次相见，或许过往已无可溯洄，但好在还有可以与你相遇的明天。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAfter ten thousand winters come ten thousand springs anew. After ten thousand partings, ten thousand reunions, too. The past has slipped away. Yet tomorrow holds the promise of you.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n月影是一片如冰之海，而我们将之横渡。在破碎的岛屿上，迷失的人曾那样渴望一位…新的世主。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe moon's shadow stretches like a sea of ice, across which we journey. Amid shattered isles, the lost once longed deeply for a... new savior.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n有人说餐点的出品亦是厨师与食客的对决，而前者获胜的报酬，就是后者满足的笑意。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nSome say cooking a dish is a duel between a chef and a customer, and that the reward for the former's victory is the latter's satisfied smile.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n即便是狼狈不堪的胜利，也好过体面的认输。在血与沙的幕布下，没有出尘不染的余裕，因为这就是沙漠人的生存方式。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEven the ugliest victory is preferable to noble defeat. Unbesmirched innocence has no place amid the blood and sand. This is simply how the desert folk survive.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n避匿于时光之后，避匿于永恒的阴霾，用谜语环抱幽梦趵泉之人，在流星的影子中期待世界的答案。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nHidden beyond time and veiled in eternal shadow, the one who embraces the silent spring of dreams with riddles awaits the world's answer in the wake of a falling star.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n胸腔中，这颗心不休的鼓动如此提醒他：「你承接来自遥远过往的期望，你拥有瑰丽而崭新的灵魂，如是，你怀抱冰雪再无法掩埋的炽热。」
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe ceaseless drumming in his chest reminds him thus: "You carry the hopes of a distant past. Your soul is resplendent and nascent, and within you burns a fervor no winter blizzard can quench."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「太忙的时候，都想要借雅珂达的手了。」——这大概说明出借手的主人既敏捷又可靠，一定是这样的吧！
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Whenever things get too busy, I wish I could borrow Jahoda's hand!" — Surely that means the owner of said "lendable hand" is both agile and reliable, right?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n在冰风雪雨中勇往直前，最重要的并非满腔的孤勇，而是能辨别前路方向的细心。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhen braving wind, snow, and rain, what truly matters isn't sheer bravery alone, but the careful discernment to find the right path forward.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n所谓日有所思，夜有所梦，也许所读书籍的内容，在梦里也会变成另外的形式浮现…呃，应该不至于是噩梦吧？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThey say that one's dreams at night reflect one's thoughts by day. Perhaps the same goes for the books one reads... Though that probably doesn't count as a nightmare. Probably.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n在清溪浅滩中起舞，在苍白山影下入梦。在时间的涟漪中漂流，与月灵玩耍躲藏。\n在万物的花园里小憩，对所有生灵哼唱。夜央未旦，她等待着，几时的相见。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nShe dances in the shallows of clear streams and drifts with the current, falling asleep beneath the pale shadows of the mountains. She wanders through the ripples of time, playing hide-and-seek with the kuuhenki.\nShe rests in the garden of all things, humming softly to every living creature. In the quiet hours before dawn, she waits for the day of their reunion.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nHeaven and earth are but a wayfarer's lodge, and time a wanderer passing through the ages.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n挺过了黑夜的莺鸟，会用热情报答白日世界的一切，也会用愤怒去燎尽梦魇。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nHaving braved the darkness of night, the nightingale pours its ardor into the bright world of day, and sears the nightmares with fierce fury.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n旅人曾站在市镇的高处向远处眺望，自信那些目及处尚且遥远的景色，终将变成未来旅途记录中的节点。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe traveler once stood atop the town, gazing toward the distant horizon, confident that the far-off sights within view would one day become milestones in the journey ahead.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n总会有灯在天幕最漆黑时亮起，如是一夜，如是千百夜。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIn the blackest of nights, a lamp shall rise, tonight, and for a thousand nights beyond.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n祈我明月，祝我良朝，袭我春帔，共我奔霄。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nPray for me a bright moon, wish me a fair day. Clad in my spring cloak, I follow moonbeams' sway.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n群狼追逐自北而来的风——但唯有群狼的首领知道，早在开始奔跑之时，风就已环绕在大家的脚边了。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe pack of wolves chased the northern wind, but only the leader knew that the wind had already begun swirling at their paws the moment they started running.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n那是风能从北方带来的东西：些微的寒冷、花朵离枝前最后的幽香和远方游子将归的消息。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nIt was something the wind could bring from the north: a hint of cold, the last faint scent of the flowers before they would fall from their perches, and the news that a traveler from afar would soon return.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n莉奈娅一直以为霜精走路时会发出的响声是因为身上的冰雪在互相挤压，直到后来的某一天…露米从身后取出了沙锤。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nLinnea had long assumed the rhythmic clatter coming from Lumi was merely the compression of frozen snow. But then came the day Lumi reached behind her back and produced — a pair of maracas.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n在被塞了一些奇奇怪怪的东西后，「切片辖域·陶」更加不像是个保存库了。而在她离开之后，它从神殿，彻底变成了盼着主人归来的望楼。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nAfter being stuffed with all sorts of oddities, Segment-Domain Tau looked less like a vault than ever. Ever since her departure, it had been transformed from a temple into a watchtower, yearning for its mistress to come home.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n摹忆因子是「文明」的最小组成单位。就算如此，满满的摹忆仍然不能复现古董的高价。因为缺少做旧。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nMemory Factors are the building blocks of civilization. Even so, an archive brimming with them cannot replicate the high price of an antique — simply because it lacks the "weathering."

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n世上所有东西都有自己的过去与秘密，你呢，能否在这些器物上看到曾流连其上的故人的目光？
desc_en: Namecard style.\nEverything in this world holds its own past and its own secrets. Tell me, can you see the lingering gaze of those who once cherished these artifacts?

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n曾经的尼可保持着近似人类的形体，一步一步走下这天梯。比起陨落、坠下，看起来还是体面不少。她只是沉默不语，走入这苍穹之下，走入不再属于天使的城市之中。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nOnce, Nicole still bore a form close to that of a human, making her way down the stairway step by step. Whatever else it was, it seemed far more dignified than falling or being cast down. Silent all the while, she passed beneath the sky and into a city that no longer belonged to angels.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n看起来「仁蔼」是全世界所有形容词里距离洛恩最远的那一个。但是最锐利的棘刺，也是从温润的土壤生长出来的嘛。
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"Benevolence" may be the last word anyone would use to describe Lohen. Then again, even the sharpest thorns grow from gentle soil.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n「我迄今为止、波澜壮阔的半生，如果写成回忆录，名字就叫《给邪恶的魔女制裁的铁锤》！」尽管，这个波澜壮阔的半生其实也没几年就是了。
desc_en: Namecard style.\n"If I ever write my memoirs, the title will obviously be The Iron Hammer That Punished the Wicked Witch! It's only fitting for a life as grand and eventful as mine!" Though in fairness, that "grand and eventful life" has only spanned a few short years.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n一般来说，礼盒的作用是提供「期待」。但小小的她们不会让打开礼盒的人失望，所以里面装着的是「超出期待」！
desc_en: Namecard style.\nA gift box is meant to stir up anticipation. But these little ones were never going to stop there — what's inside is nothing less than a beyond-expectations surprise!

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n桑多涅喜欢茶会这一点，或许是从阿兰那里学来的。只有两个人的茶歇在当时还不觉得无聊。可是自从人多到能开茶会，随后又一个个离开之后，她似乎追上了一点当年阿兰的孤独。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nSandrone may have learned to enjoy tea parties from Alain. In those days, even a tea break for two never felt dull. But later, when there were finally enough people for a proper tea party, they left one after another. And in their absence, she seemed to come a little closer to the loneliness Alain had known.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n眼前月是天上月，月上人是心中人。抬头应是我见月，却念心中人见我。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nThe moon before my eyes is the moon above, and the figure upon it is the one I hold dear. I look up, as if to meet the moon, only to wonder whether my beloved sees me there.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n有时也该随波逐流，放下所有疲惫与烦恼，顺其自然吧。就像一场长梦，醒来时，会有世界替我们拥抱你。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nSometimes, it's okay to go with the flow. Let go of your exhaustion and worries, and allow things to unfold as they will. Like waking from a long dream, you may find the world there, ready to embrace you in our place.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n每当想起旅途开始时对方伸向自己的手，因提瓦特便落满了湖面。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWhenever I recall that outstretched hand at the start of our journey, the lake becomes adrift with falling Inteyvats.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n人们用双手建造出抵御寒冷的堡垒——为了穿过无尽的长夜，为了听见未被传唱的和弦，为了今后的我和你，还能同看一年又一年的新雪。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nWith our own hands, we raise fortresses against the frost — all to cross the endless night, to catch the chords of songs yet unsung, and to ensure that you and I might still watch the fresh snow fall, winter after winter.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n霜雪落在旅人的手心，转瞬融化不见，正如有的故事已然过去，而记忆永久地铭刻在旅人心间。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nSnowflakes alight in the Traveler's palm, only to melt away moments later. Whilst some stories have already concluded, their memories remain forever etched in the Traveler's heart.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n有无数人正在没有开始也没有终末的叙事中徘徊，越过他们吧，因为你想要看到结局的意愿比任何人都强烈。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nCountless people wander through narratives without beginning or end. Surpass them, for your will to see the ending is stronger than that of anyone else.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n苦难的先兆总如气泡般浮现。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nOmens of suffering always appear like bubbles rising to the surface.

desc_chs: 名片纹饰。\n穿过漫长的风雪以后，便是晴天了。
desc_en: Namecard style.\nOnce the long snowstorm has passed, the skies will clear.

desc_chs: 能使银白古树暂时复苏的透彻晶体，可以通过这种方式获得丰厚的宝藏。其中的能量会随时间恢复。
desc_en: A crystal that temporarily revitalizes Irminsul to grant you great treasures. The energy within regenerates over time.

desc_chs: 琴的绘想游迹，如乘风飘摇的蒲公英，旋绕在琴的身侧，伴她坚定前行。
desc_en: Jean's Envisaged Echo flutters like dandelions in the wind, swirling about her, accompanying her on her resolute journey.

desc_chs: 七七的绘想游迹。寒病鬼差的同伴们时常前来拜访，随七七一同练习柔软体操。
desc_en: Qiqi's Envisaged Echo. The Heralds of Frost often come to visit and do calisthenic exercises together with her.

desc_chs: 凝光的绘想游迹，形若鎏金的银杏叶，尊贵古雅。
desc_en: Ningguang's Envisaged Echo is shaped like gilded ginkgo leaves, noble and elegant.

desc_chs: 绮良良的绘想游迹。猫爪轻踏之处，会有生机盎然的花朵绽放。
desc_en: Kirara's Envisaged Echo. Wherever cat claws nimbly tread, blooming flowers there shall spread.

desc_chs: 迪卢克的绘想游迹。点燃夜枭的翎羽，照亮暗夜的一角。
desc_en: Diluc's Envisaged Echo. The night owl's pinions ignite, that a corner of the darkness may have light.

desc_chs: 钟离的绘想游迹。「随山不辜春，闲游本无程。」
desc_en: Zhongli's Envisaged Echo. "Waste not the mountain spring, for no order governs wandering for leisure."

desc_chs: 刻晴的绘想游迹。「疾霆昨夜问新梢，晴霓今晨劝云销。」
desc_en: Keqing's Envisaged Echo. "Swift thunder questioned new boughs last night, this morn the rainbow drove clouds to flight."

desc_chs: 甘雨的绘想游迹。「循循如仪，不罹罗网。」
desc_en: Ganyu's Envisaged Echo. "Proceed with elegance, avoid certain peril."

name_en: Echo: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
desc_chs: 枫原万叶的绘想游迹。「拾花鸟之一趣，照月风之长路。」
desc_en: Kaedehara Kazuha's Envisaged Echo. "Flowers and birds are a dear pleasure to one winding under the moonlight."

desc_chs: 温迪的绘想游迹。「如风般自由，歌颂美好的万物万象。」
desc_en: Venti's Envisaged Echo. "As free as the wind, I shall sing now the praises of things beauteous and true."

desc_chs: 迪希雅的绘想游迹。「鹫鸟的眼睛，狮子的灵魂，沙漠自由的女儿。」
desc_en: Dehya's Envisaged Echo. "The eyes of a vulture, the spirit of a lion, an unbridled daughter of the desert."

desc_chs: 雷电将军的绘想游迹。「弓张如弦月，刃研似璧澄。玉真信已远，月影徒伴身。」
desc_en: Raiden Shogun's Envisaged Echo. "The drawn bow is like the quartered moon, and studying the blade is like a circle of transparent jade. Now, the truth of jade lies beyond reach, my only companion the moonlit shades."

desc_chs: 申鹤的绘想游迹。「曲高未必人不识，自有知音和清词。」
desc_en: Shenhe's Envisaged Echo. "From the world she seems apart, but there are those who know her heart."

desc_chs: 夜兰的绘想游迹。「天星每念之处，恰有幽客巡游。」
desc_en: Yelan's Envisaged Echo. "Stealthily she roams the night, stars shining upon her in the skies."

desc_chs: 纳西妲的绘想游迹。「知识，与你分享。」
desc_en: Nahida's Envisaged Echo. "Share in my knowledge."

desc_chs: 阿贝多的绘想游迹。「炽白黑土，耀灼阳华。」
desc_en: Albedo's Envisaged Echo. "From blazing nigredo, the Solar Isotoma blossoms."

desc_chs: 可莉的绘想游迹。「哒哒哒~火花骑士，冒险开始！」
desc_en: Klee's Envisaged Echo. "Da-da-da~ The Spark Knight's off on an adventure!"

desc_chs: 神里绫华的绘想游迹。「勿说冬无彩，雪时满关扉。」
desc_en: Kamisato Ayaka's Envisaged Echo. "Do not speak of winter as void of color, the white snow falls and fills every corner."

desc_chs: 神里绫人的绘想游迹。「谁言秋水冷，终有落花随。」
desc_en: Kamisato Ayato's Envisaged Echo. "Who says the autumn streams run cold, fallen blooms still drift and fold."

desc_chs: 流浪者的绘想游迹。「如清风一般，活在世间，行在世间。」
desc_en: Wanderer's Envisaged Echo. "Like the breeze, he lives in this world, and he walks its length and breadth."

name_en: Echo: Helm of the Radiant Rose
desc_chs: 娜维娅的绘想游迹。「盲目乐观可不行，幸福的生活要靠自己的双手去争取！」
desc_en: Navia's Envisaged Echo. "Blind optimism isn't the answer — if you want a bright future, you have to go out and seize it with your own two hands!"

desc_chs: 达达利亚的绘想游迹。「破绽，稍纵即逝。」
desc_en: Tartaglia's Envisaged Echo. "A flaw — here one moment, gone the next."

desc_chs: 魈的绘想游迹。「灭诸苦厄，如是经年。」
desc_en: Xiao's Envisaged Echo. "Purge evil through battle — to this we dedicate our lives."

desc_chs: 星体自天空的一角初升时，颜色如暗色般浅淡。
desc_en: When stars first ascend from a corner of the sky, their colors are as subtle as a whisper of darkness.

desc_chs: 开始的光芒总是微弱的，但蕴光的种子已在心间种下，只需静待生长的时机。
desc_en: The first light is always faint, but the seed of its glow is already sown within, awaiting only the moment to flourish.

desc_chs: 在无明的残夜之中，昭示自身吧，唤醒向光者们眼眸中的希冀，遍照日光无法触及的幽明。
desc_en: Rise in the dying night where no light remains, ignite hope in those who chase the dawn, and blaze through the darkness that the sun cannot reach.

desc_chs: 那是自天彻照的光，亦是自柔和的心底溢盛的明亮，迷失的孩子追寻玉华如缕的梦境，在无情的日夜轮转之中，此处是岁月里唯一的乐园。
desc_en: It is light shining from above, and a gentle glow flowing from the heart. Lost children chase dreams of delicate moonlight. Amid the endless cycle of day and night, this place remains the only Elysium left in time.

desc_chs: 历经百千苦战，仍像全新锻造的利剑，锋锐不减。
desc_en: Even after hundreds of hard-fought battles, it remains as keen as a freshly forged blade, its edge undiminished.

desc_chs: 如沉重的弹头，侵彻防线，击碎对手严防死守的战垒。
desc_en: Like a heavy bullet, it punches through defenses and shatters the enemy's lines.

desc_chs: 以绝境为熔炉，铸炼粉碎强敌的意志，与无坚不摧的战技。
desc_en: Make adversity your crucible, forging the will to crush mighty foes and honing battle skills that none can withstand.

desc_chs: 与晨曦的光芒一同洒落的漫天雪花，是天穹崩解时飘零的碎屑。
desc_en: The endless snow falling with the light of dawn is nothing but drifting debris as the firmament breaks apart.

desc_chs: 北风吹来始冻的气息，那是冬凌王的侍女们永恒的歌唱。让世间停驻于此刻吧！唯有这样的愿望得到了应允。
desc_en: The north wind carries the breath of the first freeze, the eternal singing of the King of Winter Icelea's maidens. Let the world be held still in this moment forever! Only that wish was ever granted.

desc_chs: 冷寂的街巷与庙宇，层叠的回廊与宫室，掩埋于不受融化的冰封之下。永冻的大地在冬凌王的统治下，静谧地迎接着永无止境的终局。
desc_en: Cold, silent streets and temples, layered corridors and palace halls, lie buried beneath a seal of ice that never melts. Under the reign of the King of Winter Icelea, the ever-frozen land quietly welcomes its end without end.

desc_chs: 曾经宏伟与肃穆的古都，化作了霜精们游乐的戏场。世间万物都被封存在皑皑白雪之下，仿若永恒。唯有狡黠的霜精们知道，在冬日的终点，大地仍会再度迎来春生。
desc_en: The once grand and solemn ancient capital became a playground for the Jack Frost. All things lay sealed beneath the vast snow, as if for eternity. Only the sly Jack Frost knew that, when winter reaches its end, spring will return to the earth once more.

desc_chs: 在蒙德使用时，能寻找附近的「散失的风神瞳」。\n与风之七天神像有着某种近似特性的人造石盘，能与风神瞳产生共鸣。\n神瞳共鸣石是对古代建立在大地各处的七天神像的拙劣仿造。正因拙劣，才会渴求神瞳的力量，为虔信者与冒险者提供收集神瞳的机会。
desc_en: A stone that can be used in Mondstadt to search for nearby Anemoculi.\nThis man-made stone plate possesses a certain characteristic similar to that of the Anemo Statues of The Seven, giving it the power to resonate with Anemoculi.\nOculus Resonance Stones are crude imitations of the Statues of The Seven constructed by the ancients. But it is precisely this crudeness that makes them crave the power of elemental oculi, thus providing devout worshippers and adventurers alike a prime opportunity to collect oculi.

desc_chs: 在璃月使用时，能寻找附近的「散失的岩神瞳」。\n在某种神秘性质上拟似岩之七天神像的精巧石盘，会将人引向岩神瞳所在之处。\n神瞳代表着神像佚失的力量。将其供奉归还的话，对神眷顾着的土地或许也有重要的意义。
desc_en: A stone that can be used in Liyue to search for nearby Geoculi.\nThis exquisite stone plate imitates a certain mysterious quality of the Geo Statues of The Seven, causing it to lead people to the location of Geoculi.\nElemental Oculi represent the lost power of the Statues of The Seven — perhaps offering this power back to the statues also has significance for the lands that the gods watch over.

desc_chs: 在璃月使用时，能寻找附近的宝藏和宝藏相关的线索。\n岩之国土上物产丰富，山间与原野各处都藏着财宝。
desc_en: A compass that can be used in Liyue to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nThe land of Geo is rich with valuable resources, with treasures hidden throughout the mountains and wilderness just waiting to be found.

desc_chs: 能够容纳风种子，并利用风种子的能量产生风场的实用道具。\n西风骑士团的学者设计了这种能善加利用风神恩惠的道具，让骑士团成员的侦察与旅行更加便利。\n但正统地使用风之翼需要「飞行执照」，所以反而从法规的层面上减少了它的使用率。
desc_en: A bottle that is able to hold Anemograna and use their energy to generate wind currents.\nThis item was designed by Knights of Favonius scholars to help the Knights on their scouting expeditions and travels by affording them the ability to better use the blessings of the Anemo God.\nIn order to take advantage of its wind currents with a wind glider, you technically need a gliding license — this has prevented it from becoming widely used, at least legally anyway.

desc_chs: 使用后会在当前大世界设置虚拟的「传送锚点」。同时只能设置一个。\n模仿传送锚点创造的道具，一定程度上能与地脉相连，实现传送的功能。\n对神之眼持有者而言，应当是非常便利的小物件。虽然传送锚点的运作原理还没有完全解明，使用时说不定会产生未知的负面影响…？
desc_en: Use this to create a temporary Teleport Waypoint at your current location. Only one can exist at a time.\nA pocket-sized item that creates a temporary Teleport Waypoint. It is capable of connecting with the ley lines, at least to the extent necessary to bring about teleportation.\nAlthough it offers an incredible convenience to Vision bearers, the actual principles behind Teleport Waypoints are not yet fully understood. We can only hope that using them does not cause any undesirable side effects...

desc_chs: 能在场景中快速架设烹饪的锅炉。在附近进入战斗状态时，该道具会被破坏。\n璃月的土地广袤、地形错综复杂；璃月人爱好美食。能同时体现这些特点的，恐怕就是这种便携烹饪用锅。利用这种装置，即使身处绝云间的高峰，或是在孤云阁的礁岛上，都能随时做出新鲜的菜肴。
desc_en: A portable stove that can be quickly set up for cooking in the environment. If you enter into combat nearby, it will be destroyed.\nLiyue's terrain is vast, varied, and at times even inhospitable — and yet all its inhabitants share a love of good food. These two phenomena would not be able to coexist were it not for portable cooking equipment like this. Whether you are scaling the heights of Jueyun Karst or exploring the islets of Guyun Stone Forest, bringing a portable stove means that a delicious and freshly cooked hot meal is always available at a moment's notice.

desc_chs:
同时最多持有5个。
能在激活石化古树与地脉之花时替代原粹树脂，以获得更丰厚的宝藏的树脂浓缩产物。
蕴含着充沛能量的晶体。
银白的古树与花连接着地脉，而树脂蕴含的能量能疏通地脉的管道，提炼淤滞其中的物质。
desc_en:
You can hold no more than 5 at a time.
Condensed tree resin that can be used instead of Original Resin to revitalize Petrified Trees and Ley Line Blossoms to receive greater rewards.
Crystal filled with immense energy.
The silver-white Irminsul trees and blossoms are connected to ley lines that have become blocked over time. The energy contained in tree resin can purify the obstructing substance.

desc_chs: 能将大部分美食转化为能瞬间摄入的「营养物质」。尽管能大大提高营养补充的效率，但愿意使用它的骑士似乎不多…
desc_en: A handy meal-in-a-pouch that can transform most foods into instantly absorbable nutritional matter. Despite the fact that it can greatly increase the efficiency of nutritional intake, most knights aren't too keen to put their food in it...

desc_chs: 在蒙德使用时，能寻找附近的宝藏和宝藏相关的线索。\n寻宝罗盘的指针并不遵循大地的磁场转动，而是沿着地脉，寻找附近的财宝。
desc_en: A compass that can be used in Mondstadt to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nThe needle of the Treasure Compass doesn't spin according to the world's magnetic field, but rather follows the energy of ley lines to lead the user to treasure.

desc_chs: 对「铁钱」的气息很敏感的，特殊的小仙灵。\n乌尔曼托付给你的「伙伴」。仙灵向来有引导人的习性，只是这一个仙灵似乎格外孱弱，又对「铁钱」有着奇妙的执着…
desc_en: A small and special Seelie, particularly sensitive to the presence of Iron Coins.\nA companion entrusted to you by Ulman. Seelie are naturally inclined to guide people, though this Seelie seems weaker than usual, and possesses a remarkable obsession with Iron Coins...

desc_chs: 「秘宝迷踪」活动的纪念，装备后可以获得迷你仙灵的陪伴。\n水色的迷你仙灵。和其他的仙灵不同，似乎不想引导人，而是随着人去看看这个世界。
desc_en: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature sea-blue Seelie. Unlike other Seelie, it does not serve to guide others, but to follow them to see the world.

desc_chs: 「秘宝迷踪」活动的纪念，装备后可以获得迷你仙灵的陪伴。\n粉色的迷你仙灵。虽然不能说话，但会默默随着自己钟情的旅人走遍世界。
desc_en: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature powder-pink Seelie. Though it cannot say a word, it will silently follow a traveler that strikes its fancy around the world.

desc_chs: 「秘宝迷踪」活动的纪念，装备后可以获得迷你仙灵的陪伴。\n金色的迷你仙灵。散发着与摩拉近似的气息，传说这种颜色的仙灵象征着幸运。
desc_en: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature golden Seelie. It gives off a feeling very similar to that of Mora. They say that Seelie of this color represent good fortune.

desc_chs: 使用后，会在短时间内小范围中释放热量，削减积累的严寒。\n「温暖仙灵」是依据气候剧变而进化的形态，能为渴求温暖的人提供慰藉。而这种便利道具，则是曾在雪山挣扎求生的人，依据仙灵的变化创造出的模拟道具。
desc_en: Upon use, emits heat for a short period over a small area, diminishing the effect of Sheer Cold.\nWarming Seelie have evolved in response to the extreme change in temperature to give the comfort of warmth to those who seek it. This convenient gadget was originally crafted by those who struggled to survive in the snowy mountains in imitation of such evolved Seelie.

desc_chs: 使用时，会记录储存当前景象的便利道具。\n来自枫丹的奇特道具，能将景象牢牢记录下来。对巡游世界的旅行者而言，值得纪念的景象、值得铭记于心的人物应当相当多吧。
desc_en: A convenient tool that records and saves images upon use.\nA special item from Fontaine that can record images. People and places to remember must come aplenty for a Traveler roaming the world.

desc_chs: 在「福至五彩」活动期间使用时，能储存当前具有特定色彩的事物的影像。\n季同从枫丹引进的新式留影机，似乎不能如他所愿地发挥应有的效果…？
desc_en: Use this during the "Five Flushes of Fortune" event to store images of objects with a specific color.\nJi Tong imported this new-fangled Kamera model from Fontaine, but it doesn't seem to work quite as he'd hoped...

desc_chs: 使用时，会记录储存当前景象，并附带特殊色调的便利道具。\n来自枫丹的奇特道具。与普通的留影机不同，将景象牢牢记录下来之余，还能在印出的画像上附带特殊的色彩。这种设计，是针对枫丹的通讯社「蒸汽鸟」希望留影机除了反映景象，也能反映拍摄者的情绪而做的。但最终产品没能实现「蒸汽鸟」的需求。
desc_en: When used, this useful gadget can save and store the scenery before it and add a special color tone to it.\nA strange device from Fontaine that will not only record sceneries but will also add special colors to the printed images. This design was made in response to "The Steambird"'s request for a Kamera that could not only reflect the environment, but also the emotions of the one taking the picture. Unfortunately, the final product could not quite match their specifications.

desc_chs:
可以使填入的物质发生质变，转化成其他物质的道具。
·质变过程中，需要进行<color=#3399CCFF>元素攻击</color>使其能量达到发生质变的临界值。
·获取经过质变的物质后，需要经过七天才能再次使用。

从遗迹中发现的古代神秘仪器，具有加速循环，使物质发生「质变」的力量。普遍而言，地上地下的一切都在循环，记忆与元素在地脉中恒常奔涌，腐烂的日落果会回归尘泥，而泥土中生长出来的树木终有一天也会结出晶莹的果实吧…
desc_en:
A device that can transmute materials placed within and convert them into some other materials.
·During the transmutation process, you must use <color=#3399CCFF>Elemental Attacks</color> to generate enough energy for the transmutation to take place.
·After obtaining the transmuted materials, you must wait seven days to use the Parametric Transformer once again.

This mysterious device, discovered within the ruins, has the power to accelerate cycles and "transmute" material objects. Generally speaking, everything is undergoing a cycle. Memories and elements surge within the ley lines, rotten fallen fruits return to the soil, and the trees born from the soil will one day bear their crystalline fruit...

desc_chs: 奇怪的幼体纯水精灵，对于世间一切充满好奇。\n纯水精灵擅长幻化水型，也能通过融合其他水体，同步情感与知识。嫣朵拉还小，嫣朵拉很好奇。嫣朵拉会吐出水泡来融合其他的纯水之形，学习一切。
desc_en: A strange Lochfolk larva, filled with curiosity about the world at large.\nLochfolk specialize in shifting into watery shapes and can meld with other water bodies to synchronize emotions and knowledge alike. Endora is still small, and Endora is very curious. Endora can spit out bubbles to meld with other beings of water, through which she shall learn everything.

desc_chs: 只是一个仍然好奇的纯水精灵，只想要看看世界。说不定和「迷你仙灵·露草」很合得来。不可以把它融合掉哦。
desc_en: Just a very curious Lochfolk who only wishes to see the world. Might actually get along very well with Mini Seelie: Dayflower, but please do not meld them together, thank you.

desc_chs: 使用后，会释放可以被打破的气球。\n气球在风之国土有着特殊的意义，因为它的意象代表着随风而行的无拘无束。当然实际上气球上升至一定的高度之后就会因为气压破裂。
desc_en: Use this to release a balloon that can be popped.\nBalloons have special significance in the land of the wind, for they represent the freedom to drift with the wind. Of course, air pressure will destroy balloons once they've reached a certain height.

desc_chs: 使用后，可以进行演奏的蒙德传统乐器。\n做工极为精致的乐器，在善于演奏的人手中，能奏响清澈动人的乐曲。\n蒙德有着诗与歌的传统，所以在此类乐器的研究上也有着悠久的历史。吟游诗人以自己的音乐、诗为傲，而乐器也会以自己的主人及诗歌的传统为豪吧。
desc_en: Use this traditional instrument from Mondstadt to play songs.\nAn instrument of incredible workmanship, it will surely produce moving music when played by able hands.\nMondstadt has a long-standing tradition of poetry and song, and thus also boasts a long history of constructing instruments to that effect. Bards are most proud of their songs and poems, and perhaps the instruments, too, would be proud of their owners and their musical tradition.

desc_chs: 从萍姥姥那里得到的茶壶。里面似乎别有洞天…
desc_en: A teapot obtained from Madame Ping. There seems to be a whole new realm within it...

desc_chs: 以纯净的鸟羽和坚韧的布料所制作的羽球，或许拥有某种奇妙的力量…
desc_en: A harpastum made from pure bird feathers and strong fabric. Perhaps it contains some strange power...

desc_chs: 装有各式器具的工具箱，可以修理「浪船」所受的损伤。\n·能够为浪船回复50%完好度；\n·具有90秒冷却时间。
desc_en: A toolbox filled with all manner of items that can be used to repair the damage done to a Waverider.\n·Restores 50% of a Waverider's structural integrity.\n·Has a 90s cooldown.

desc_chs: 重量适中的羽球爆弹，易于控制，便于准确投掷，能对单个敌人造成大量火元素伤害。
desc_en: A Harpastum Bomb with a comfortable weight that makes it easy to control and throw accurately. It can deal a large amount of Pyro DMG to a single opponent.

desc_chs: 设计巧妙的羽球爆弹，爆炸时碎片四处飘散，能在可观的范围内造成一定的火元素伤害。
desc_en: A Harpastum Bomb of cunning design that sends fragments flying every which way when it explodes, dealing a certain amount of Pyro DMG over a wide AoE.

desc_chs: 充满了火元素力量的羽球爆弹。「绽放」时会猛烈燃烧，并在小范围内造成少量火元素伤害，对抗冰元素的防护时更为有效。
desc_en: A Harpastum Bomb brimming with Pyro energy. When unleashed, it will burst into violent flame, dealing a small amount of Pyro DMG over a small AoE. It is extraordinarily effective against Cryo shields.

desc_chs: 在稻妻使用时，能寻找附近的「散失的雷神瞳」。\n能够与雷之七天神像共鸣的奇特石盘。因为这种性质，也能感知神瞳的存在。\n在无边无际的漫长的岁月中，宏伟的城池与造像也会被风雨侵蚀，七天神像的力量也会慢慢逸散。但逸散的力量会结成「神瞳」的形象，无声呼唤着只属于它的神像。
desc_en: A stone that can be used in Inazuma to search for nearby Electroculi.\nThis strange device can resonate with Electro Statues of The Seven. Due to this trait, it can detect the presence of Electroculi.\nAcross the span of endless years, even the most majestic cities and sculptures would be worn down by wind and rain, and even the power of Statues of The Seven would gradually dissipate. But this faded strength would coalesce once more into the Oculi, which call out wordlessly to their Statues.

desc_chs: 从萍姥姥处获得的神奇匣子。据萍姥姥说，这匣子具有「化种」之能…依据原有植物的特性，可以将「化种」所得的种子种植在「尘歌壶」的对应田亩中。\n可供种植的植物：霓裳花、甜甜花、塞西莉亚花、琉璃百合、风车菊、清心、琉璃袋、落落莓、小灯草、绝云椒椒、胡萝卜、白萝卜、薄荷、蘑菇、鸣草、马尾、金鱼草、莲蓬、嘟嘟莲、海草、海灵芝、香辛果、墩墩桃、须弥蔷薇、久雨莲、茉洁草、柔灯铃、虹彩蔷薇、颗粒果、苦种、肉龙掌、青蜜莓、灼灼彩菊、浪沫羽鳃、微光角菌、云岩裂叶、霜盏花、夏槲果、白灵果、松珀香、冬凌草、霜仙花、植绒草、金蕨、红甜菜、冰醋栗、雪球花。
desc_en: A special container obtained from Madame Ping. According to her, this dispensary has the power to "generate seeds"... That is to say, it can create the seeds of various plants according to their special traits, which can then be planted within the appropriate fields within your Serenitea Pot.\nPlants available for planting: Silk Flower, Sweet Flower, Cecilia, Glaze Lily, Windwheel Aster, Qingxin, Violetgrass, Valberry, Small Lamp Grass, Jueyun Chili, Carrot, Radish, Mint, Mushroom, Naku Weed, Horsetail, Snapdragon, Lotus Head, Calla Lily, Seagrass, Sea Ganoderma, Harra Fruit, Zaytun Peach, Sumeru Rose, Pluie Lotus, Marcotte, Lumidouce Bell, Rainbow Rose, Grainfruit, Cacahuatl, Saurian Claw Succulent, Quenepa Berry, Brilliant Chrysanthemum, Sprayfeather Gill, Glowing Hornshroom, Skysplit Gembloom, Frostlamp Flower, Midsommar Berry, Lakkaberry, Pine Amber, Winter Icelea, Frostfairy Flower, Flockingweed, Golden Fern, Red Beet, Rimecurrant, Snowball Flower.

desc_chs: 在稻妻使用时，能寻找附近的宝藏和宝藏相关的线索。\n雷之列岛的土地曾经受过诸多伤害。伴随着创伤与恢复而来的是遍布各岛的诸多宝藏。
desc_en: A handy tool used to locate nearby treasure in Inazuma and relevant clues.\nThe land of the thundering archipelago has suffered a great many past hurts. The many treasure chests that dot the islands are a symbol of its revival from these wounds.

desc_chs: 使用后的30秒内，滑翔时的移动速度提高30%。\n\n具有某种神奇力量的道具。在「天狗」的手中，可以发挥各种各样的力量；而在一般人的手里，也能在空游时发挥「让身体稍微变得轻盈一点」程度的能力。
desc_en: Use this to increase Gliding Movement SPD by 30% for 30s.\n\nThis item possesses some sort of mysterious power. In the hands of the tengu warriors, it can have various effects, but in the hands of an ordinary person, it can still have enough power to "make one's body lighter" while in mid-air.

desc_chs: 神秘的「透镜」。透过它观测特殊的小狐狸雕像，可以找到原本不存在的东西。\n据说在很久以前，传说中的「狐斋宫大人」曾经将一件法器作为退邪之物赠与彼时柊家家主弘嗣。\n柊以其为透镜部件的材料，后来从异国定做了特殊的「留影机」，并将其作为情谊的象征，回赠鸣神大社。
desc_en: A mysterious lens. If you view small fox statues with this lens, you can find things that were not there before.\nThey say that in the distant past, the legendary Kitsune Saiguu left a catalyst for the then-Hiiragi Clan head, Hiroshi, as a tool to be used in exorcisms.\nThe Hiiragis would have a special Kamera made to order from overseas with that catalyst mounted on its lens assembly, before giving it back to the Grand Narukami Shrine as a symbol of their friendship.

desc_chs: 对「铁钱」的气息很敏感的，特殊的小仙灵。\n乌尔曼托付给你的「伙伴」。仙灵向来有引导人的习性，只是这一个仙灵似乎格外孱弱，又对「铁钱」有着奇妙的执着…
desc_en: A small and special Seelie, particularly sensitive to the presence of Iron Coins.\nA companion entrusted to you by Ulman. Seelie are naturally inclined to guide people, though this Seelie seems weaker than usual, and possesses a remarkable obsession with Iron Coins...

desc_chs: 「秘宝迷踪」活动的纪念，装备后可以获得迷你仙灵的陪伴。\n紫色的迷你仙灵。色泽和雷元素有几分相似的迷你仙灵，如果触碰的话，不知道会不会有酥酥麻麻的感觉。
desc_en: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature purple Seelie. Its color is very similar to that of Electro-infused items. Who knows if you might get a little tingle from poking it...

desc_chs:
奇特的羽毛。
在鹤观的土地上，有时似乎能发挥神奇的作用。
带着这枚羽毛，走遍世界吧。

毕竟，已经和他说好了。
desc_en:
A strange feather.
It may be able to trigger some wondrous effects if used on Tsurumi Island.
Take this feather with you into the world.

You did promise him that you would, after all.

desc_chs: 击败踞身天云峠顶端的魔物后，发现的奇异鸟羽。\n是曾经栖息在鹤观的「雷鸟」的翎羽，也即是「木簧笛」的原型。\n在鹤观的土地上，似乎能发挥神奇的作用。
desc_en: After defeating the monster that made the apex of Amakumo Peak its home, you discovered this strange feather.\nIt fell from the Thunderbird that once inhabited Tsurumi Island, and is the original form of the Maushiro.\nIt may have some special properties on Tsurumi Island.

desc_chs: 学者阿叶夏研究古代造物时随手制作的简便道具，可用于勘测深埋于地下的古代造物。不过由于制作仓促，准确性依然有待提高。使用者需要特别留心，说不定会有意外情况出现…
desc_en: A handy tool that the researcher Ayesha created on the side while researching ancient relics. It can be used to detect such ancient relics buried underground. Due to its hasty production, however, its accuracy could stand to be improved. Users should beware that some unexpected things may occur while using this gadget...

desc_chs: 若紫用阴阳术式再次改造过的网子。据说可以拘出小动物的神形，并且以网子为媒介，再次化出小动物的形体。
desc_en: A net that has been modified once again by Wakamurasaki using onmyoudou. She claims that it can detain the essence of small creatures before using the net itself as a medium to recreate their forms.

desc_chs: 使用后，可以进行演奏的乐器。\n材质特异，工艺与市面流行之物大为不同。空灵的弦音中似乎蕴含着一股不可捉摸的力量，甚至能勾出乐者心中潜藏的幻想。\n璃月有古诫：镜花迷眼，泥形溺心则陷。如此看，只有意志坚定者才能驾驭此物吧。
desc_en: A musical instrument that can be used in performances.\nIt is made of rather unique materials, and its craftsmanship is quite different from the designs that are currently in vogue. An unpredictable strength has been woven into the ethereal strings that can even allow it to cause the illusions within the heart of its player to surface.\nThere is an old adage in Liyue: "the longer one's eye of the flower drinks, the deeper one's heart into the mire sinks." It seems that only the strong-willed may use this instrument.

desc_chs: 「式大将」所赠的礼物，极具灵性的拓本。虽然「式小将」无法使用符法，但无论位于何地，它都能与「式大将」保持联系，分享所见所闻，就像将「式大将」带在身边一同旅行。
desc_en: A gift from Shiki Taishou: a replica armed with spiritual power. Though Shiki Koshou is incapable of charm magic, it is in contact with Shiki Taishou at all times and can share all that it has seen and heard with him, so it's almost like you've still got Shiki Taishou with you on your journey.

desc_chs: 珊瑚的友人受到启发后，借鉴了「惟神阴阳术」，制作出的方便道具。虽然力量不足以降伏犯罪，但只要认真瞄准的话，捕捉小动物不在话下。
desc_en: A friend of Sango's used Kamuna Onmyoudou in a fit of inspiration to create this convenient little gadget. It is not powerful enough to capture criminals, but with a little aim, capturing little animals should be a cinch.

desc_chs: 由工匠朋义开发的奇妙机关，同时具备熔炼烟花和自动燃放烟花的功能。在富有才思与灵感之人手中，想必能发挥无穷的作用，创造一场无比绚烂的烟花演出。
desc_en: A special device created by the artisan Pengyi. It comes with functions that allow for the creation and automated launch of fireworks. In the hands of someone creative, it will surely see great use in the creation of unique and radiant fireworks shows.

desc_chs:
「层岩巨渊·地下矿区」中装备时，能够提供光照的珍贵晶体。

在成分上与仅在层岩巨渊出产的琉璃晶砂有相当的共同之处，但其中含有更加浓烈的力量。
但愿它能如同掌心的小太阳一样，为黑暗中的跋涉带来些许光亮、些许慰藉。
desc_en:
When equipped in The Chasm's Underground Mines, this precious crystal can provide illumination.

It has many similarities to the Glazed Sand Crystal that may only be found within The Chasm, but it stores even greater power within it.
May it be as a sun in your palm, lighting the way through the lightless tunnels and bringing comfort where all is dark.

desc_chs: 使用后，可以清除一定范围内，渊下宫黑雾的影响。\n「亲近美好之物」谓之「睦」，「远离污秽之物」谓之「疏」。此即「睦疏」之意。
desc_en: Use this to clear a certain area in Enkanomiya of the darkness' influence.\nThe name "Bokuso" is formed from "boku," meaning "to draw near to what is good," and "so," meaning "to shun that which is tainted."

desc_chs: (test)CD测试道具

使用后，可以进行演奏的乐器。
一斗赠予的小鼓，是在一个异国商人那里买到的，虽然外观看起来普普通通，但据说是古代大阴阳师留下的宝具，有驱灾祈福的妙用。
普通人若想要据为己有，代价将十分高昂，但如果与此鼓有缘，价格便可以再商量。
真实惠呀，原价八百万摩拉的贵重物品，最后只要八万摩拉就可以买到，感觉让一斗占了大便宜。
desc_en:
A musical instrument that can be used in performances.
A small drum that Itto gave you. He bought it from an outlander merchant, and while it does look quite normal, it is said to be a relic left behind by an ancient and powerful onmyouji who used it to drive out calamity and pray for blessings.
It would cost an ordinary person a large sum if they were to wish to possess this, but the price may be negotiated if one has some connection to the drum.
And wouldn't you know it? An 8,000,000 Mora treasure was eventually purchased for 80,000. What a steal for Itto, eh?

desc_chs: 由机械制造商伯特兰制造的收集器，可以分阶段收集不同的制造所需素材。可以连接「大工机」，将素材作为原材料倒入后，进行机器人摆设的制造。
desc_en: A collection device created by Bertrand, a manufacturer of machines. It can sequentially collect materials required for creating other products. When hooked up to the Great Machine, it will pour the source materials into the latter and start the process of creating robotic furnishings.

desc_chs: 装备后，可以在特定的场合下施展兰那罗的力量。\n「既是胖胖的种子，亦是苦涩的果子。」\n是兰那罗记忆的暂居所，也是兰那罗力量的暂存处。
desc_en: Equip it to utilize the power of Aranara.\n"Fatty fruit, bitter fruit."\nA temporary home for Aranara memories. Kusava makes Aranara strong.

desc_chs: （test）仇恨测试道具
兰罗摩交给你的书。\n看起来经历了很多年月。原本似乎有人在上面记录过什么，但那些内容已经失落了。\n用来记载与兰那罗一同冒险的故事吧。
desc_en: Arama handed this book over to you.\nIt seems to have witnessed the passage of many years. By the look of things, someone used to keep records in it, but none of that can be retrieved now.\nUse it to document your shared adventure with Arama.

desc_chs: 由「七圣召唤」的牌手协会发行的牌盒道具，只有学习完基础规则，得到认可的新人牌手能够领取。\n据说是由须弥教令院的学者制作，牌盒中有一个特殊设置的机关，可以借此来感应周围的秘典之盒持有者。\n利用这个功能，多与身边的牌手进行对局吧！
desc_en: A box for cards released by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Only beginners who have learned the basic rules and are verified as players can collect one.\nThey say that these boxes were made by researchers from the Sumeru Akademiya, and that they feature a special mechanism that can be used to detect nearby people who also possess Caskets of Tomes.\nUse this function to engage in more matches against nearby players!

desc_chs: 在须弥使用时，能寻找附近的「散失的草神瞳」。\n具有与草之七天神像相似性质的奇特护符。因此，也会被草元素的神瞳所吸引。\n芳草与树木、藤蔓与花，仰赖草元素的生命具有诸多形态。尽管有着形态的差别，尽管生命与生命是具有隔阂的，但来自同一片大地的，最终也会回归同一片大地。
desc_en: A stone that can be used in Sumeru to search for nearby Dendroculi.\nA curious amulet of a similar nature to the Dendro Statues of The Seven. By the same token, it is drawn to Dendroculi.\nIn the world, there are grass and trees, vines and flowers — living beings of Dendro Element that abound in diverse shapes and forms. Though differing in appearance and various other aspects, they were born from the same land and will return to the same land.

desc_chs: 在须弥使用时，能寻找附近的宝藏和宝藏相关的线索。\n对一些人而言，生命的意义在于探索与开拓吧。而在探索与开拓的终点，往往有着丰厚的宝藏等着他们。
desc_en: A compass that can be used in Sumeru to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nFor some people, the significance of life lies in exploration and discovery. Upon reaching each destination, there is always bountiful treasure awaiting.

desc_chs: 使用时，能获得附近树木的木材。\n在须弥的林野中有时能够见到的神秘护符，具有召集草木力量的能力。\n为了防止沙漠入侵森林，以及在更黑暗的岁月中，为了抵御恶兽的入侵，树木藤蔓会结成严密的藩篱。持有这种护符的人便被森林认作朋友，能不受阻碍地穿行在树篱的迷宫中，得到溪流与月光的指引。不过那是古代传说中的事情了。
desc_en: A talisman that can help collect wood.\nTalismans of this kind are often seen in the forests in Sumeru. They possess the ability to gather the power of grass and trees.\nTo prevent the erosion of the forest and, in darker times, to resist the invasion of vicious monsters, trees and vines would form impregnable shelters together. Those who held "the Boon of the Elder Tree" were recognized by the forest as its friends and thus gained unfettered access to walk amidst the forest under the guidance of streams and moonlight. But that is archaic lore from a long, long time ago.

desc_chs: 能够通过消耗矿物，提高食材加工效率的小装置。\n教令院的年轻学者有着利用实验器材进行烹饪的习惯。为了提高效率，节约时间，有人发明了「超燃灯」这种能将矿物中的能量提取出来，增加功率的装置。\n手中的是这种超燃灯的民用试验型，限制了出力功率，消除了明火，以降低火灾风险。不过，就算如此，还是能够熬制果酱、烘干香肠，十分方便。
desc_en: A gadget that improves the efficiency of food processing by consuming minerals.\nYoung Akademiya researchers are accustomed to cooking with their experimental instruments. Someone invented an "Ultra-Hot Burner Lamp" that utilizes the energy of minerals to juice up the heat, all the better to save time and increase cooking efficiency.\nThe one you have is a test model for civilian use with power constraints and a dimmer flame, which should reduce its fire hazard rating. Even so, this convenient gadget is still perfectly capable of cooking jam and drying sausages with ease.

desc_chs: 从乌尔曼处获得的「寻宝仙灵」。看上去似乎没什么活力…
desc_en: The "Treasure-Seeking Seelie" you got from Ulman. It doesn't look that energetic...

desc_chs: 「秘宝迷踪」活动的纪念，装备后可以获得迷你仙灵的陪伴。\n绿色的迷你仙灵。每次靠近树木时，它都会格外高兴。
desc_en: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature green Seelie. It becomes most happy indeed when it gets close to a tree.

desc_chs: 小朋友拉齐从桑歌玛哈巴依老爷店里借的留影机，是拍摄风景、野外取材、节庆留念时的好帮手！\n比起一般的留影机多了一些金属装饰，看起来要昂贵不少，可千万不要弄坏了！\n另外，根据租借条款规定，这台留影机只能在须弥境内使用。
desc_en: A Kamera that Razi borrowed from Lord Sangemah Bay. It will come in handy when you take photos of beautiful scenery, look for inspiration in the wilderness, or wish to keep festive memories!\nThis Kamera is adorned with metal decorations and thus looks a lot more expensive than regular Kameras. Be careful with it!\nAccording to the leasing agreement, it can only be used within Sumeru's borders.

desc_chs: 某个设定中被灌注了神奇力量的法杖。能与未来星的存在共鸣，从而指引出未来星的方位。\n当然，在其他的设定中，它也可能是一个名叫教令院的组织的库藏物品，而它登记在册的名字是「阿叶夏混沌勘探器」。因为长期无人使用而落上了薄薄一层灰。
desc_en: In some cosmological settings, this is a staff filled with mystical power. It can resonate with the Future Stars and show the way to them.\nOf course, in some other settings, it might be an object kept in storage by an organization known as the Akademiya, and perhaps its recorded name might even be Ayesha's Chaos Prospector. There is a thin layer of dust over this object due to a long period of disuse.

desc_chs:
一种具有自适应能力的张力稳定器，安装在鱼竿上后，可以平缓鱼线的张力波动，帮助人们更轻松地钓鱼。稳定器可以自动测录不同鱼类的挣扎力度，测录的数据越丰富，稳定效果越出色。

原型是一位枫丹发明家的无用小发明，长时间处于无人问津的状态。直到被枫丹钓鱼协会发现，几经改造才有了如今的鱼线稳定器。成品一经问世，就受到了大多成员的认可，渐渐推广到了其他地区。
在至冬国的推广尤为顺利，据说是因为受到了某位执行官大人的喜爱。
desc_en:
A self-adaptive tension stabilizer that can be installed on a fishing rod to facilitate fishing. The device can automatically detect and record how hard different fish struggle. The more data it collects, the better the stabilizer works.

The device's prototype was the pointless invention of a Fontaine inventor that drew little interest for the longest time until the Fontaine Fishing Association discovered it and modified the product into the fishing line stabilizer used today. When the device first came out, it was most warmly received by the Association members, and now it has gradually been promoted in other regions.
It is an exceptionally hot commodity in the Snezhnayan market. Word has it that one of the Lord Harbingers is particularly fond of the product, which explains the hype.

desc_chs: 使用后，可以进行演奏的蒙德传统乐器。在须弥的森林中，有时似乎能发挥神奇的效果。\n从维摩庄的阿玛兹亚处借来的老旧诗琴。\n蒙德有诗与歌的传统。吟游诗人会将自己乐器称为自己的「挚友」、「伴侣」，因此将乐器作为信物托付给阿玛兹亚无疑是十分亲密、充满信赖的行为。
desc_en: Use this traditional instrument from Mondstadt to play songs. It may work wonders when played in the forests of Sumeru.\nA vintage lyre borrowed from Amadhiah in Vimara Village.\nMondstadt has a long-standing tradition of poetry and song. Bards from there tend to address their instruments as "Friend" or "Partner." Thus, one of them trusting Amadhiah with the instrument was nothing less than a gesture of intimacy and trust.

desc_chs: 使用后，会释放出彩带和亮片的拉炮。\n「蹦蹦是可莉的好朋友，也是一起炸鱼的好帮手，但庆典上把蹦蹦拿出来会被琴团长凶的…不过你别担心，在阿贝多哥哥的完美改良下，蹦蹦已经有了全新的本领！你看，只要拉一下它的小尾巴，就能放出好多漂亮的彩带！」
desc_en: A party popper that, when used, unleashes streamers and confetti.\n"Jumpy Dumpty is Klee's good friend and fish blasting companion! But if Klee brings Jumpy Dumpty to the festival, Master Jean will be angry... Don't you worry, though! Jumpy Dumpty has gained a new ability with Albedo's help! Just pull on its tail, and beautiful colored strips will come flying out!"

desc_chs: (test)赤王石板-未激活-剧情调整废弃
教令院学者提尔扎德多年来的研究对象，从纹样与工艺来看是赤王文明的造物。似乎隐藏着催动赤王遗迹机关的权能…
desc_en: This object has long been the subject of Akademiya Researcher Tirzad's research. Its etchings and craftsmanship indicate that it is a relic of King Deshret's civilization. It seems to have the power to command devices within ruins associated with King Deshret...

desc_chs: 使用时，会记录储存当前景象，并附带特殊色调的便利道具。\n来历不明的奇特道具，成像效果尤为别致，机器内部明明没有多余的水分，拍摄出的画片周围却有着缤纷的泡沫，使得画面具备了一种梦幻的观感。\n因此，某位骑兵队长形容这台机器「捕捉到了人们对清凉的期待」。
desc_en: When used, this useful gadget can save and store the scenery before it and add a special color tone to it.\nA strange device of unknown origin. The photos it takes have a peculiar effect. Who would've thought that a machine with no water inside could produce photos with jovial bubbles in them that lend them a sense of fantasy?\nA certain Cavalry Captain once described this machine as being able to "capture people's desire for cool and refreshing days."

desc_chs:
装备后，可以在特定的场合下施展兰那罗的力量。
「既是胖胖的种子，亦是苦涩的果子。」
是兰那罗记忆的暂居所，也是兰那罗力量的暂存处。
如今其中积蓄了兰纳真、兰迦鲁与兰纳迦的宝贵记忆，时刻准备着为珍视的朋友而释放其力量。
desc_en:
Equip it to utilize the power of Aranara.
"Fatty fruit, bitter fruit."
A temporary home for Aranara memories. Kusava makes Aranara strong.
Now inside it are stored the cherished memories of Aranakin, Aragaru, and Aranaga. The power within is ready to be unleashed at any minute for the sake of beloved friends.

name_en: Jinni in the Magic Bottle — Liloupar
desc_chs:
自睡莲而生的大镇灵利露帕尔，因遭受古老的绝罚而神魂分裂，被封印在透明的魔瓶之中…
如今，似乎她又寻得了新的主人…

如今只拥有过往伟大力量的一万万分之一。会利用这些力量，帮助她的「主人」通行于千壑沙地的热砂与古城。
desc_en:
Born from water lilies, Liloupar, the great Jinni, whose soul had been shattered due to an ancient punishment, was sealed in a transparent magic bottle.
Now, it seems that she has found a new master...

Although she only possesses a-hundred-millionth of her previous great power, she will use what is left of her to help her master pass through the hot sand and ancient ruins of the Desert of Hadramaveth.

desc_chs: 「月莲杯」驯兽师大赛官方提供的关键道具，能够捕捉、容纳与指挥富有灵性的蕈兽，据称是学者考特里亚的发明。唯有娴熟地使用这种道具，才能获准参加「月莲杯」驯兽师大赛。不过，这种道具的部分表现令人倍感熟悉，似乎在某些地方见过…
desc_en: A crucial item provided by the organizer of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. Use it to capture, accommodate, and command intelligent Fungi. Word has it that it was invented by a researcher named Kautilya. Only those who can wield this item skillfully are qualified to participate in the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. That said, you cannot help but feel that some of this item's functions create a strong sense of déjà vu...

desc_chs: 由纸叠成，外型如鸟的轻盈机关，由留云借风真君所赠。\n虽然说是「机关」，但从外部几乎看不到任何传统的机关结构。 \n那位仙人的「机关术」，似乎又向前进了一步…
desc_en: Made from stacked paper, this lightweight device has the appearance of a bird, and fittingly, was given to you by Cloud Retainer.\nWhile it may be called a "device," you cannot see any traditional mechanical components here — well, not from the outside, anyway.\nIt seems that this adeptus' skills as a mechanist have improved even further...

desc_chs: 从冒险家协会处所获的特别罗盘，据说会带给人好运…？
desc_en: A special compass obtained from the Adventurers' Guild. According to certain rumors, it might just offer you a sprinkle of extra luck...

desc_chs: 作为守护大地的花灵一族，斯露莎立志要成为平息灾厄的勇者。\n在与信赖之人建立连结后，斯露莎将会同她的「谒颂主」一起穿行于满布污秽的大地…
desc_en: As one of the Pari, the defenders of the land, Sorush aspires to become a Bloomguard who shall quell calamity.\nHaving formed a connection with one whom she trusts, Sorush now traverses the defiled land alongside her Yasnapati...

desc_chs: 从法斯宾处借用的留影机。用的时候要小心谨慎，可别弄坏了…
desc_en: The Kamera you borrowed from Fassben. Be careful when using it. You don't want to break it, now...

desc_chs: 使用后，可以进行演奏的乐器。\n构造独特，音色清脆的小鼓。外形雅致，做工精细，采用了上佳的材料，兼顾了演奏时的音质、音准与长期使用的耐损度。\n相传，这种小鼓结合了稻妻传统乐器与异国之鼓的特点，演奏某些乐曲之时，还能为人们带来好运的护佑…
desc_en: A musical instrument that can be used in performances.\nA drum with a clear sound and unique design. It has an exquisite exterior and features intricate craftsmanship. High-quality materials have been used in its construction, with a view toward sound quality during performances, intonation and long-term wear and tear.\nIt is said that this small drum combines an Inazuman traditional instrument with some quirks of drums from other nations. When it plays certain tunes, it can even bring people good luck...

desc_chs: 作为诞生于花海的花灵的一员，斯露莎乃是为灵光所认可的勇者。\n在与信赖之人建立连结后，斯露莎将会同她的「谒颂主」一起穿行于灵光护佑的大地…
desc_en: A Pari born in the Vourukasha Oasis, Sorush is a Bloomguard acknowledged by the Khvarena.\nHaving formed a connection with one whom she trusts, Sorush now traverses the land blessed by Khvarena alongside her Yasnapati...

desc_chs: 用于寻找文物模型的「寻物锚针」。因为是基于探测元素的装置改造而来，所以在探测文物模型的所在地时，似乎还是会被特定的元素所影响…
desc_en: A "Search Compass" made to find relic replicas. As this device was adapted from one used to survey elemental energies, the localized elements present might disrupt its attempts to scan for those replicas...

desc_chs: （test）光酒WQ小道具
闪烁着点点荧光的奇妙晶体，似乎能够感知到一定范围内的欢乐情绪，并指引人们前往相应的方位…\n使用后，可以探测到附近一定范围内的「欢兴礼券」。
desc_en: A marvelous crystal with spots of radiance that seems to be able to sense joyous emotions in a certain radius around it and lead people in the corresponding direction.\nUse this to find Joyeux Vouchers in a set AoE.

desc_chs: 流漫着明丽光彩的奇妙晶体，似乎能够感知到广阔区域内的欢乐情绪，并指引人们前往相应的方位…\n使用后，可以探测到「琉形蜃境」中的所有「欢兴礼券」。
desc_en: A marvelous crystal within which radiance flows like a river. It seems to be able to sense joyous emotions in a vast area and lead people in the corresponding direction.\nUse this to find all Joyeux Vouchers within the Veluriyam Mirage.

desc_chs: 本应是生活在海洋深处的小小章鱼。\n或许是出于其旺盛的好奇心，还有对旅行的向往，在尚处于幼体态时，它就已然在海中四处游弋。如果遇见了中意的生物，它也愿意跟随其四处旅行。\n不过，它长大后究竟会变成什么样呢…
