desc_en: A type of tiny octopus that normally lives in the depths of the ocean.\nPerhaps out of an overabundance of curiosity, or a desire to travel, it begins to cruise throughout the seas while still extremely young. If it sees a creature it likes, it will follow it everywhere.\nBut who knows what it will be like when it grows up...

desc_chs: 生论派学者拉米雅制作的镜型道具，可以与实验用动物身上的装置进行链接，取得动物视角内的事物并于镜面显现。
desc_en: A mirror-type gadget made by the Amurta researcher Lamiya. It can be linked to the animals' devices, which will reflect the animals' points of view in the mirror.

desc_chs: 在枫丹使用时，能寻找附近的「散失的水神瞳」。\n在制造时尽力拟似了水之七天神像性质的奇异护符，似乎能够感知到水元素神瞳的元素流动。\n神瞳本就是七天神像佚失在外的力量，将其归还至神像之处，是合情合理亦合法之事。
desc_en: A talisman that can be used in Fontaine to search for nearby Hydroculi.\nA curious talisman that possesses similar properties to the Hydro Statues of The Seven. It seems to be able to detect the Elemental Flow of Hydroculi.\nOculi are by nature scattered pieces of power belonging to the Statues of The Seven. Returning them to the Statues is therefore the reasonable, right, and lawful thing to do.

desc_chs: 在枫丹使用时，能寻找附近的宝藏和宝藏相关的线索。\n这些宝藏散落在枫丹诸处，并无人宣告自己对其的所有权。大多数情况下，将其收入囊中不会触犯律法刑责。
desc_en: A compass that can be used in Fontaine to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nThese chests scattered across Fontaine are not the lawful property of any individual or organization. In most circumstances, it is legal to claim the contents found within.

desc_chs:
由枫丹动能工程科学研究院高级研究员法维茨基所开发的「晶蝶诱捕装置」。
布置完成，并向其内部投入特定材料后，此装置便会开始运转，将晶蝶诱捕入装置内。
法维茨基曾领导研究的「低温光照装置」项目需要大量的晶核作为研究材料，本装置也是因此而被研究开发。
但因为诸多原因，该项目已暂停研究。
「我们在此缅怀勤恳的法维茨基先生，并衷心期望有人能接过他的衣钵，本院将在各个合适的方面予其以大限度的支持。」
desc_en:
A Crystalfly Trap, developed by a senior researcher named Fawitzki from Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering.
After being properly deployed and inserting the required materials, this device will start working and lure Crystalflies inside.
Fawitzki once led research on "Low-Temperature Lighting Devices," which required a large amount of Crystal Cores as research materials, which led to the development of the Crystalfly Trap.
However, the project was suspended for various reasons.
"We are here to commemorate the diligent Mr. Fawitzki. We sincerely hope that there are those who will carry on his research. The Institute will provide maximum support in any areas deemed appropriate."

desc_chs:
由枫丹动能工程科学研究院高级研究员勒费所开发的「鼓风装置」。
启动后，可以为正在使用风之翼飞行之人提供一段强大的升力。
但限于设计，此装置启动时需要强风辅助。所需风力的强度，大约与使用风之翼飞行时所产生气流的风力强度相等。
「呃…所以你的意思是，我只能在使用风之翼飞行的时候，启动这个装置」
「但我启动这个装置，不就是为了获得一阵强风推动风之翼吗？！」
desc_en:
A wind generating device developed by Refait, senior researcher from Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering.
After being activated, this device can provide a strong lifting force for the Wind Glider user.
However, due to design limitations, the device requires utilizing significant wind power to activate. The wind energy required is approximately equal to that produced by the working Wind Glider.
"Umm... So you mean I can only activate this device when I'm already using the Wind Glider."
"But the only reason I even want to activate it is to give my Wind Glider a push!"

desc_chs: 由布列松特别改造过的「留影机」，据说制造时采用了最好的材料，有着出色的性能。
desc_en: A Kamera specially modified by Bresson. It was manufactured with the best materials available, and has excellent performance.

name_chs: 便携式空气动力胶质泡生发器
desc_chs:
使用后能够生发出大量胶质泡泡的机关造物。

由枫丹科学院研究员吉瓦鲁瓦所开发的机关造物原型机。
项目的开发本意，是制造一种大型的胶质泡泡生发器。在项目预期中，生发出的胶质泡可以在内部承载一定量的水体，并且能在空中稳定地漂浮和移动。从而达到快速运输水源的目的。
不过，因为始终未能找到能够制造此种胶质泡的材料，该项目一直停留在原型机实验阶段。
但据说吉瓦鲁瓦研究员的孩子很喜欢这台会吐泡泡的原型机，或许就将其作为一种玩具推出，也未尝不可？

「这台机器呢，是爸爸的研究成果，叫做空气动力胶质泡生发器…」
「泡泡！好好看！爸爸！好厉害！」
desc_en:
A mechanism that can be used to create large amounts of colloid bubbles.

Givalois, a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute, developed this prototype.
The original purpose was to create a large generator of gelatinous bubbles. Just as the project aimed to do, the bubbles so produced could carry some amount of water within them, and move or hover stably in the air, potentially achieving the aim of being able to quickly transport water resources.
However, as they were never able to find a material to make gelatinous bubbles of this type, the project stalled at the prototype stage.
But it is said the researcher Givalois's children loved this prototype bubble machine, so perhaps it would be possible to sell it as a toy?

"This machine is a product of Daddy's research, and it's called the Portable Aerodynamic Gelatinous Bubble Generator..."
"Bubbles! So pretty! Daddy, you're amazing!"

desc_chs: 为了增强「图形识别」能力而开发的新型留影机镜头组件。\n配备这种镜头组件后，普通的留影机将获得更为迅速的变焦与对焦性能，以便使用者在旅途中进行快速高效的抓拍，记录珍贵的瞬间。
desc_en: A new type of Kamera accessory developed to enhance image recognition capabilities.\nAfter equipping this accessory, a normal Kamera can quickly adjust its focus, allowing it to capture images of your travels so you can record precious memories at a moment's notice.

desc_chs: 乐平波琳为了「图形对抗」这一深奥学问所改造的留影机，不知内部装载了什么复杂而昂贵的元件，似乎能捕捉到留影对象的特定结构、轮廓与色彩特征…
desc_en: A Kamera specially modified by Lepine-Pauline for the profound discipline of "Graph Adversarial Technology." It is unknown just what kind of complex and expensive components are installed inside, but it seems to be able to capture the photograph subject's particular structure, profile, and coloration...

desc_chs: 从乌尔曼处获得的「寻宝仙灵」，据说其在水下环境中依然可以活动自如。但是，现在看上去似乎没什么活力…
desc_en: A Treasure-Seeking Seelie obtained from Ulman. It is said that it can move freely underwater, even though it doesn't look very energetic right now...

desc_chs: 「秘宝迷踪」活动的纪念，装备后可以获得迷你仙灵的陪伴。\n拥有着璀璨色彩的迷你仙灵，在水下环境中依然可以活动自如。
desc_en: A memento from Lost Riches. Equip the Seelie to gain its company.\nA mini Seelie with brilliant colors, it can move freely underwater.

desc_chs: 使用后可以进行演奏的枫丹乐器，由德沃沙克亲手赠予旅行者。\n据说，因为圆号的音色醇厚而柔和，宛如穿梭在密林之间的轻柔晚风，所以枫丹的作曲家们，常使用圆号来塑造猎人、森林等不羁且生机勃勃的意象。毫无疑问，这样的乐器对「生命」为主题的音乐盛会而言，最为合适。
desc_en: This exquisite horn is a Fontainian instrument that can be used in performances, and was a gift from Dvorak to you.\nThey say the tones of the horn are both rich and mellow as well as gentle, like a gentle evening breeze blowing among a thicket of trees. So, Fontainian composers often use horns to vividly bring the imagery of hunters and forests to life. Without a doubt, this instrument is eminently suited to a musical gala celebrating "life."

desc_chs: 看似浮夸，实则功能简单的牌匣。从中抽出的数字似乎昭示着某种命运的走向，或是某项选择的成败…\n「只要相信自己跟牌组的『牵绊』，命运就会预示于数字。」——既然林尼这么说过，姑且就先信个一半吧。
desc_en: A deceptively grandiose-looking card box that is actually quite simple. The number drawn seems to indicate a certain direction of fate, or perhaps the success or failure of a certain choice...\n"As long as you believe in your bond with the cards, the numbers shown will show your fate." — Since Lyney said that, let's just tentatively take his word with a shaker of salt.

desc_chs: 隐隐泛着魔法荧光的信纸，与做工精巧的羽毛笔。手持这支羽毛笔时，就能自动在信纸上写下字体优雅、用词欢快的文字，详细描述某些事物的方位，似乎暗示着宝物的所在地…\n使用后，可以探测到附近一定范围内的「悠乐片段」。
desc_en: Letter paper emanating a faint magical glow, and a finely crafted quill. With this in hand, elegant, ebullient words shall flow across the page of their own accord, writing detailed descriptions of certain objects' locations, and seemingly hinting at the location of treasure...\nAfter using this item, you can detect "Excerpts of Bliss" within a certain AoE inside Simulanka.

desc_chs: 闪烁着亮丽魔法荧光的信纸，与做工雅致的羽毛笔。手持这支羽毛笔时，就能自动在信纸上写下字体优雅、用词欢快的文字，详细描述某些事物的方位，似乎暗示着宝物的所在地…\n使用后，可以探测到「希穆兰卡」中的所有「悠乐片段」。
desc_en: Letter paper that radiates a magical glow, and a masterfully crafted quill. With this in hand, elegant, ebullient words shall flow across the page of their own accord, writing detailed descriptions of certain objects' locations, and seemingly hinting at the location of treasure...\nAfter using this item, you can detect all "Excerpts of Bliss" within Simulanka.

desc_chs: 艾梅莉埃亲手制作的香水试用装，参考枫丹历史上的传奇香水「奥古斯都」调制。\n对着阳光倾斜瓶身，可以看到一行娟秀的小字：「忘记过往，坚强地活下去。」
desc_en: A sample of the perfume Emilie made herself. It is based on the legendary "Auguste" fragrance chronicled in Fontaine's histories.\nTilt the bottle toward the sunlight and you will see this flowing line of graceful text: "Forget the past, and keep on living."

name_chs: 朝雾的枫丹专用留影机
desc_chs: 从朝雾手中获得的留影机，用于协助朝雾完成枫丹之行的取材工作…\n留影机保养得相当不错，可见画家对关键道具的关注不亚于颜料和画笔…
desc_en: A Kamera you obtained from Asagiri. Use it to help her complete her work of gathering inspiration on her trip to Fontaine.\nThe Kamera is well-maintained, clearly showing that this artist paid as much attention to this key tool as she does her paints and brushes...

desc_chs: 在纳塔使用时，能寻找附近的「散失的火神瞳」。\n在打造时经过调整，具备了和火之七天神像近似的特性，似乎能够凭此感受到火神瞳炽热的力量。\n消耗自身，即可令神瞳归还于神像，使散失的众火得以归一，对神瞳共鸣石而言或许也是一种值得的牺牲。
desc_en: A stone that can be used in Natlan to search for nearby Pyroculi.\nDuring its crafting, adjustments were made to imbue it with characteristics resembling those of the Pyro Statues of The Seven, allowing one to sense the blazing power of the Pyroculi through it.\nBy sacrificing oneself, the Pyroculi can be returned to the statue, reuniting the scattered flames. Perhaps the Resonance Stone deems this sacrifice to be worth it.

desc_chs: 在纳塔使用时，能寻找附近的宝藏和宝藏相关的线索。\n火之国土的大地之上遍布纷争，有许多因此失去了线索与踪迹的宝藏。
desc_en: A compass that can be used in Natlan to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nAmidst the turmoil and strife that wrack the land, many treasures throughout the vast Nation of Pyro have gone unaccounted for, all trace of their whereabouts lost.

desc_chs: 自壳中火焰诞生的小小生命。\n过度依赖意识诞生时包裹自己的壳这点也非常可爱，或许封闭的世界令它感到安心吧。毕竟在蛋壳完全合上时，它就是在壳中宇宙的王者。\n据说在太古之时，源火的燃烧就拥有着类似的生命形态。
desc_en: A tiny lifeform that emerged from a flame within a shell.\nThere is something quite endearing about its over-reliance on the shell it found protecting it at the moment it gained its sentience — perhaps it feels secure in this closed-up world. After all, when its eggshell is completely enclosed, it reigns supreme in its own little universe.\nIt is said that in ancient times, the Primal Fire burned with a similar life force.

desc_chs: 会将受到的力不断吸收入体内的机关。\n据说体内的力量积攒到了极限之后就会爆发而出，化作出绚丽的礼花。不过，到底多大的力才能让它爆发呢，似乎每一次都有点不太一样…因此和好友轮流攻击试试吧，据说，最后让它爆发礼花的人，在一天之内都会有了不得的好运。
desc_en: A mechanism that continually absorbs the force it receives.\nApparently, when the power within reaches bursting point, it will explode in a dazzling display of fireworks. But the amount of force needed to trigger this explosion seems to vary each time... So why not take turns attacking it with your friends? They say that whoever makes it go "kaboom" will have extraordinarily good luck for the rest of the day.

desc_chs: 「炫彩呆子」提供的「涂鸦联盟」留影机，功能上与普通留影机没有太大的差异，不过据说能记录特定的景色和物体，为涂鸦提供素材和灵感…
desc_en: A "Graffiti Alliance" Kamera provided by "Dopey Dazzler." Functionally, it isn't much different from a standard Kamera. However, it's said that it can capture and record specific scenes and objects, serving as a repository for inspiration and source material for graffiti artists...

desc_chs: 使用时，会记录储存当前景象的便利道具，这一台属于派蒙。 当初和商家拉扯了半天才以优惠价格买到的定制机型，被派蒙小心保存着。记得购买时商家附赠了一本厚厚的留影册，但你几乎没见她掏出来过，她的留影册里到底有些什么样的画片？
desc_en: A convenient gadget that records and saves images when used, this one belongs to Paimon. Back when you bought it, you haggled with the seller for ages before finally scoring a bargain on this custom Kamera, which Paimon keeps with great care. You recall that the seller included a thick photo album along with the Kamera too, but you've barely seen her take it out. Just what kind of photos has she taken with that Kamera of hers?

desc_chs:
·消耗祝圣之霜通过定义产生圣遗物，或是将圣遗物萃取为祝圣之霜的道具。
·每个周期内，能通过萃取产生的祝圣之霜数量有限；各圣遗物套装定义的次数也有限制。

圣遗物力量的本源来自于故事，因此神圣的书写可以尝试制造圣遗物。传说曾有七十个贤者各自独立翻译出了一模一样的译文，因此神圣的原文可以称圣。只要把手放在这台机器上，圣遗物背后的故事会自然流出。
desc_en:
·Consume Sanctifying Elixir to generate Artifacts through the process of Definition, or consume Artifacts to obtain Sanctifying Elixir through the process of Extraction.
·During each cycle, there is a limit on both the amount of Sanctifying Elixir that can be extracted and the number of times that Artifacts of each Set can be defined.

Artifacts draw their power from stories. This explains how it is possible to attempt to create Artifacts through sacred writings. Legend tells of an instance where seventy sages independently produced identical translations of the same source text; and thus, the original text was considered to be sacred. A person has only to place their hand on this machine and the story behind the Artifact will naturally flow out of it.

desc_chs: 吟游诗人莎莎赠予的曲谱集，记录了各地音乐的乐谱与演奏的心得体会，详实程度堪比音乐界的百科全书…\n运用这本曲谱集，便能演奏诸多动人的旋律…
desc_en: A collection of sheet music given to you by Sansa the bard. It contains musical scores and performance insights gathered from various nations, penned in such detail as to rival a musical encyclopedia.\nWith such a collection at their disposal, a musician could play many enchanting melodies indeed...

desc_chs: 使用后，可以进行演奏的纳塔传统乐器。\n徒手演奏的打击乐器，有着皮制的鼓面，以绳索调音，音色独特，在熟练的乐手手中，能为乐曲带来丰富的律动。
desc_en: A traditional instrument from Natlan that can be used in performances.\nA percussion instrument with a skin drumhead that can be played with one's bare hands. Tuned using ropes, it has a unique sound that, in skilled hands, can add a rich rhythm to any song.

desc_chs: 使用后，可以进行演奏的纳塔传统乐器。\n小巧的四弦琴，形制与演奏手法与吉他相近，品格数量、标准调弦的音高则有所不同。得益于琴弦的材质，音色清澈明亮而不失柔和，常令听众心情舒畅。
desc_en: A traditional instrument from Natlan that can be used in performances.\nA small, four-stringed lute shaped similarly to — and which plays like — a guitar, though its fret count and tuning differ. Thanks to the material the strings are made of, it sounds clear and bright, yet soft, soothing the hearts of those who hear it.

desc_chs: 生论派学者拉米雅制作的镜型道具，可以与被认养动物身上的装置进行链接，取得动物视角内的事物并于镜面显现。
desc_en: A mirror-type gadget made by the Amurta researcher Lamiya. It can be linked to the adopted animals' devices, which will reflect the animals' points of view in the mirror.

desc_chs: 有着特殊功能的留影设备，能够对比过往的资料，协助探查区域内的异常迹象，记录探案的重要线索。\n同时，借助成像机关的多种光学通道，可以发现肉眼难以观察到的痕迹。妥善利用这一功能，必定能高效地获取情报。
desc_en: A special Kamera that can be used to compare past and present data to investigate anomalies in an area and gather important clues.\nAt the same time, thanks to its various optical channels, this device can allow you to pick up on traces that may be difficult to observe with the naked eye. If you make good use of this function, you'll be able to gather information with ease.

desc_chs: 不知以什么样的生物为原型，由执掌一切智慧的神祇制造而出的新式虚空终端机关。\n制造它的人巧妙地为它设定了自动跟随的模式，是希望它能随时为跟随的对象提供小小的佑助。\n此外，似乎是为了提醒跟随者进行每日的规划，还具备最新装配的报时功能…
desc_en: A Neo Akasha Terminal mechanism based on an unknown creature, created by a deity who commands all wisdom.\nIts creator ingeniously programmed an auto-follow protocol, intending for it to provide aid to its master anywhere, anytime.\nIn addition, it also comes with the latest timekeeping function, as if to remind its master of their daily agenda.

desc_chs: 丝柯克制作的吉他之一，据说参考了她故乡的乐器。\n吉他响起的时候会带有一种特殊的韵味，古老的旋律似乎在低声诉说着那段无人铭记的历史。
desc_en: A guitar that Skirk made based on the instruments of her homeland.\nThe guitar has a unique charm when played. Its ancient melody seems to hum of a history that nobody recalls.

desc_chs: 使用后，可以进行演奏的纳塔风格乐器。\n曲线独特的机关钢琴，外观上有着和传统钢琴类似的黑白键，但其发出的声音却更有反常规的特色。在一些热闹的场合中，乐手们常常用它演奏律动十足的乐曲，使之成为派对气氛的助燃剂。
desc_en: Use to play a Natlanese-style instrument.\nA uniquely curved mechanical piano, its black and white keys resemble a traditional model, but the sound it produces is unconventional indeed. On certain lively occasions, musicians play it such that its rhythm becomes the fuel for a fiery atmosphere.

desc_chs: 使用时，会记录储存当前景象的便利道具，这一台属于派蒙。除了美食和你，派蒙还有众多三分钟爱好，留影是其中之一。据她说，自己拍下的画片已经足够办展览的了。未来有一天，说不定可以给派蒙办一次影展！
desc_en: A convenient gadget that can record and store pictures of scenery. This one belongs to Paimon. Aside from food and spending time with you, Paimon has many other hobbies, and photography is one of them. According to her, the pictures she has taken are enough for an exhibition. Perhaps one day, you can hold a photography exhibition for Paimon!

desc_chs: 如猫一般充满谜团的机械体。\n由伏尼契商会赠予。发掘自某处开拓时代的古老遗迹。据某不知姓名的人士透露，发掘现场的碑文曾印有「尤约拉」一词，不过甫一出土便风化了。这个名字究竟是什么意思，至今说法不一。\n或许它是只名叫「尤约拉」的小猫，或曾被某个名叫「尤约拉」的人所拥有，现存的教令院记录中就有这个名字，属于许多年前一位来自挪德卡莱的学生。真相可能并不复杂，毕竟只是名字加上小猫的组合，还能存在什么其他深奥的意思呢？
desc_en: A mysterious mechanical being, much like a cat.\nIt is a gift from the Voynich Guild that was unearthed from an ancient ruin dating back to the pioneering age. According to an anonymous informant, the inscription at the excavation site once bore the word "Ujola," but it weathered away shortly after being uncovered. To this day, the meaning of the name remains uncertain.\nPerhaps it was simply a cat named "Ujola," or it once belonged to someone by that name. Records from the Akademiya show that this name once belonged to a student from Nod-Krai many years ago. The truth is probably simple — after all, it's just a name paired with a cat. What more profound meaning could there possibly be?

desc_chs:
伏尼契商会利用开拓时代的发掘物研制的浮空坐榻。
开启之后，坐榻会稍稍浮空。这下能在野外随时随地休息一下了，真是了不起的造物！
尽管伏尼契商会竭力逆向分析已出土的坐榻，也未能复现其稳定的悬浮效果。开拓时代的先驱们，技术实力的确深不可测。
据说，最早发现的浮空坐榻是跟一只机械猫一起出土的，故此也有人称之为大号猫窝。
「不！这绝不是猫窝，因为猫是不会睡在猫窝里的！」
desc_en:
The Voynich Guild developed this hovering daybed using artifacts unearthed from the pioneering age.
Once activated, it hovers slightly above ground, allowing you to rest on it anywhere in the wild. A remarkable creation indeed!
Despite the Voynich Guild's best efforts at reverse-engineering, the daybed remains somewhat unstable — the technology of the pioneering age remains unfathomable to this day.
It is said that when the earliest hovering daybed was discovered, it was buried alongside a mechanical cat, leading some to call it the "King Size Cat Bed."
"No! It couldn't possibly be a cat bed. Everyone knows cats don't sleep in their own beds!"

desc_chs: 一台造型典雅的古董留影机。它曾是枫丹某位传奇摄影师的爱物，见证过许多载入史册的瞬间。\n如今，它的使命是将旅途中那些转瞬即逝的美好片刻定格为永恒。\n每一次快门，都是对回忆的温柔捕捉。
desc_en: An antique Kamera with an elegant design. It once belonged to a legendary Fontainian photographer and witnessed countless historic moments.\nNow, it serves the purpose of capturing the fleeting beauty along its journey and preserving it forever.\nEvery press of the shutter is a gentle act of capturing a memory.

desc_chs: 在挪德卡莱和霜月使用时，能寻找附近的宝藏和宝藏相关的线索。\n月下世界亦有许多无主的宝藏，只待富于勇气或是智慧的冒险者探寻。
desc_en: A compass that can be used in Nod-Krai and the Frost Moon to search for nearby treasures and relevant clues.\nThis sublunary sphere holds countless unknown treasures, waiting to be discovered by adventurers with courage or wit.

desc_chs: 记录着各类趣事逸闻的笔记本。\n打开后，可以查看已记录在内的逸闻内容。借由夹在笔记本里的「纸签」，或许也可以进行简洁的「相缘绘愿」许愿。
desc_en: A notebook filled with various anecdotes and amusing tales.\nOpen it to browse the stories recorded within. With the fortune slip tucked inside, you can also make a simple wish via Destiny Drawn.

desc_chs: 从某位擅长占卜的魔女那里获赠的牌盒。可以用来收纳在演出中寻找到的「月谕圣牌」，也可以在多人模式下与好友交换已有的牌。\n在不同的世界中，所谓「占术」有着诸多不同的定义，唯一的共通之处，便是借助「此刻」与「此地」的已知之物，推演未知的事理。正是因为如此，匣中收藏的圣牌越多，解明事象的可能性也会越高吧…
desc_en: A card box given to you by a certain witch proficient in divination. It can be used to store the Lunar Arcana you find during your performances, cards which may also be exchanged with friends in Co-Op Mode.\nEach world defines divination differently, but one thing remains constant — the use of "here" and "now" as anchors to unravel the unknown. Thus, the more Arcana one hoards within this box, the brighter the lantern of understanding burns...

desc_chs: 从艾莉丝那里得到的，由魔女们共同撰写的辞典。虽说名义上是为了一本名为《小魔女与不熄灭的火》的寓言书所作的注释，但实际内容却是魔女会为大家量身定制的「课题」。\n正所谓「流溢的逆行即是课业」，与伙伴们一同踏上取得擢升之冠冕的旅途吧！
desc_en: Received from Alice, this dictionary was created by the witches. Though it claims to explain a storybook of fables titled The Little Witch and the Undying Fire, it is actually filled with homework tailored by the Hexenzirkel for each reader.\nAs they say, "To defy the current is to learn." Embark on your journey with your companions and seek the crown of elevation!

desc_chs: 经由地脉洗礼，补充了灵气的「青玄乘阳华盖」，能够唤出青玉高辇，帮助使用者快速前往某地。
desc_en: Bathed in the energy of the Ley Lines, the Jadelight Canopy has been replenished with spiritual power. It can now summon a jade carriage, helping its user travel quickly to distant locations.

desc_chs: 派蒙随身携带的记录用留影机，这次就用来记录那些值得注意的不同之处吧。
desc_en: The Kamera that Paimon carries with her. Use it to record the noteworthy differences you find this time!

desc_chs: 使用后可以进行演奏的精妙乐器。\n在旧日文明的智辩家眼中，尘世奏响的音律不过是对普世乐章的粗糙描摹。然而，不朽者之王却从乐者的演奏中捕获了异调的乐想。在他的指示下，调律师将永恒的乐声固定在每一个琴键上，任何人都能通过弹奏它加入到最宏大的合奏中。
desc_en: A delicate instrument that can be used in performances.\nIn the eyes of the ancient philosopher-debaters, the melodies of the mortal world are but a rough imitation of the universe's symphony. However, the King of the Immortals captured the unusual motifs within the musician's performance, then instructed the harmonist to fix the eternal music onto every key, allowing anyone who plays it to join in the grandest of symphonies.

desc_chs: 在空之神殿使用时，能寻找附近的宝藏和宝藏相关的线索。\n在千风不及的秘藏之所，依然会有不可见的丝线引向最为珍贵的藏品——与藏品后隐藏的意义。
desc_en: When used within the Temple of Space, this device detects nearby treasures and the related clues.\n Even within the hidden vaults where the thousand winds cannot reach, there are still invisible threads that guide the way toward the most precious of collections — as well as the hidden meanings behind them.

desc_chs: 莉奈娅亲手制作的博物图鉴，记录了她的观察发现。
desc_en: A naturalist archive crafted by Linnea herself. It records her observations and discoveries.

desc_chs: 桑多涅赠予你的便携式茶桌。方便携带、易于收纳，甚至还加装了悬浮装置。几乎能在任何地方享受闲暇的茶会时光。
desc_en: A portable tea table gifted to you by Sandrone. Easy to carry and store, and even fitted with a levitation device. With this, you can enjoy a leisurely tea party almost anywhere.

desc_chs: 在废弃的车站中遇到的奇怪机关，经常以单片眼镜的形式出现。\n似乎拥有许多便捷的功能…
desc_en: A strange mechanism you encountered in an abandoned station. It often appears in the form of a monocle.\nIt offers many convenient functions, such as recording blueprints for Prime Ice constructs, creating Prime Ice, calling trains...\nPerhaps it was built for the very purpose of providing all these conveniences.

desc_chs: 曾被芭比洛斯持有的匣子，现在已归你所有。所有尚未揭晓和已揭晓的谕示都装在匣内，至于这些谕示会不会对命运造成影响…芭比洛斯的回答则是：「呵呵呵…命运的底色可不能轻易示人啊，而且，给未来留个悬念也不错，对不对？」
desc_en: The case Barbeloth once carried has found its way into your possession. Within it sleep all the oracles, both those already revealed and those yet to open their eyes. Whether their words may one day steer the course of fate... Barbeloth would only say this: "Hehehe... The true colors of fate are never meant to be revealed lightly. Besides, a future with secrets yet to unfold is far more delightful, would you not agree?"

desc_chs: 琪琪科娃提供的特殊留影机，是「强化互助会」的特别装备之一。按照「探索计划」的要求拍摄指定目标后，其中的图像就会成为专门的情报，为以后的新人提供帮助…
desc_en: A specialized Kamera provided by Chichikova, serving as a special equipment for the Mutual Aid Advancement Network. Once a designated target is captured in accordance with the exploration plan, the captured image is processed into vital intelligence, lighting the way for the rookies who follow in their footsteps...

desc_chs: 在至冬使用时，能寻找附近的宝藏和宝藏相关的线索。\n冰之国的土地上有许多冰封于隐秘之处的宝藏，谁有能力令其上的封锁消融，谁就能获得这些冰中的遗馈。
desc_en: A compass that can be used in Snezhnaya to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nMany treasures lie frozen in hidden places across the land of snow. Those who can undo the seals may claim the gifts left within the ice.

desc_chs: 可以在商城兑换珍稀资源的货币。\n过剩的命运星之光辉。或许可以点亮宇宙其他角落。
desc_en: Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.\nSurplus Starglitter of destiny. Perhaps it can light up other corners of the universe.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的说明，记载着「风神瞳共鸣石」的制作方法。掌握后，可以制作寻找「散失的风神瞳」的道具。
desc_en: Detailed step-by-step instructions for making an Anemoculus Resonance Stone. Master them and you will be able to create a tool to guide you to Anemoculi.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的说明，记载着「岩神瞳共鸣石」的制作方法。掌握后，可以制作寻找「散失的岩神瞳」的道具。
desc_en: Detailed step-by-step instructions for making a Geoculus Resonance Stone. Master them and you will be able to create a tool to guide you to Geoculi.

desc_en: Detailed step-by-step instructions for making a Portable Waypoint. With a Portable Waypoint, you can create a teleport waypoint wherever in the world you want.

desc_en: A detailed step-by-step diagram for making an Adepti Seeker's Stove. Learn it and you can create a portable stove to bring with you on your travels.

desc_chs: 巫女「花散里」曾经戴着的面具，内侧有着深色的污渍。\n其中承载着一部分记忆。通过这份记忆，可以学会法器「白辰之环」的锻造方法。\n如今面具与花散里分别了，派蒙也不会叫她「面具巫女」了吧。
desc_en: Hanachirusato the shrine maiden used to wear this mask. It is deeply stained on the inside.\nSome memories are contained inside, through which one may learn the art of creating the Catalyst known as "Hakushin Ring."\nNow that Hanachirusato has been separated from this mask, Paimon doesn't get to call her the "Masked Maiden" anymore, right?

desc_chs:
通过这个故事，能掌握双手剑「森林王器」的制造方法。

这个故事与森林王有关。
「很多、很多个月亮以前，森林是一座巨大的迷宫…」
desc_en:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the claymore "Forest Regalia."

This tale is about the Forest King.
"The forest used to be a giant maze many, many moons ago..."

desc_chs:
通过这个故事，能掌握单手剑「原木刀」的制造方法。

这个故事与失落在沙海中的友人有关。
「这是来自巴螺迦的故事…」
desc_en:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the sword "Sapwood Blade."

This tale is about a friend lost in the desert.
"This is a story from Valuka..."

desc_chs:

这个故事与迷失在森林的迷宫中的少女有关。
「很久很久以前，有一名公主…」
desc_en:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the bow "King's Squire."

This tale is about a girl lost in the forest maze.
"Once upon a time, there was a princess..."

desc_chs:
通过这个故事，能掌握长柄武器「贯月矢」的制造方法。

这个故事与月光的魔力有关。
「这个故事，与所有为月光所迷的孩子们有关…」
desc_en:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the polearm "Moonpiercer."

This tale is about moonlight and magic.
"This story is about all the children who are fascinated by the moonlight..."

desc_chs:

这个故事与异兆、灾祸有关。
「其实，月亮并不总是如同珍珠一样圆…」
desc_en:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the catalyst "Fruit of Fulfillment."

This tale is about portents and disasters.
"In truth, the moon did not always look like a pearl..."

desc_chs: 可以在商城兑换珍稀资源的货币。\n过剩的命运星之晶尘。累积起来，或许可以创造新的命运。
desc_en: Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.\nSurplus Stardust of destiny. Perhaps it can create new destinies when in large enough quantities.

desc_chs: 饰有彩画的绘马，由品质上佳的梦见木精雕细刻而成，描绘着明丽的稻妻风光。\n借由「外景之能」，方可将彩画上的风雅景致呈现在「尘歌壶」之中…
desc_en: A prayer plaque that displays lovely Inazuman scenery, carved upon exquisite Yumemiru Wood in full color.\nYou can use Sub-Space Creation to imprint this elegant scene upon your Serenitea Pot...

desc_chs: 蕴含着奇妙香气的果实，是周游壶灵阿嘟从须弥带回的纪念品。\n轻嗅这种果实的香气，脑海中似乎就有某种意象浮现而出。借由「外景之能」，方可在壶中洞天构筑奇妙的须弥景致…
desc_en: This fruit, brought as a memento from Sumeru by the Teapot Traveling Salesman Chubby, gives off a truly marvelous fragrance.\nEven a whiff of this fruit brings certain images to mind, which you can manipulate via the power of Sub-Space Creation to recreate the wondrous sights of Sumeru in your Realm Within...

desc_chs: 内部景观优美的生态瓶，是周游壶灵阿嘟从枫丹带回的纪念品。\n凝望瓶内的景致，脑海中似乎就有某种意象浮现而出。借由「外景之能」，方可在壶中洞天构筑奇妙的枫丹景致…
desc_en: This lovely terrarium filled with beautiful landscapes was brought from Fontaine by the Teapot Traveling Salesman Chubby.\nThe scenes contained within bring certain images to mind, which you can manipulate via the power of Sub-Space Creation to recreate the wondrous sights of Fontaine in your Realm Within...

desc_chs: 绘有独特风光，隐含着独特力量的纳塔织卷，是周游壶灵阿嘟从纳塔带回的纪念品。\n注视绘卷上的图案，脑海中似乎就有某种意象浮现而出。借由「外景之能」，方可将绘卷上的纳塔景致呈现在「尘歌壶」之中…
desc_en: This Natlan woven scroll, depicting unique landscapes and containing hidden powers, is a souvenir brought back from Natlan by the Teapot Traveling Salesman, Chubby.\nThe patterns on the scroll bring certain images to mind, which you can manipulate via the power of Sub-Space Creation to recreate the wondrous sights of Natlan in your Realm Within...

desc_chs: 具有播放音乐与制造炫丽光效功能的挪德卡莱月矩力机关球，是周游壶灵阿嘟从挪德卡莱带回的纪念品。\n注视机关球上放出的光影，脑海中似乎就有某种意象浮现而出。借由「外景之能」，方可在壶中洞天构筑奇妙的挪德卡莱景致…
desc_en: A Nod-Krai kuuvahki sphere mechanism, capable of playing music and producing dazzling light effects. It is a souvenir brought back from Nod-Krai by the Teapot Traveling Salesman, Chubby.\nEven a glimpse of the shifting lights cast by the sphere brings faint images to mind, which you can manipulate through the power of Sub-Space Creation to recreate the wondrous landscapes of Nod-Krai in your Realm Within...

desc_chs: 连结梦想的命运之种。\n缘石辉光能让本无交集的命运交错，让彼此的梦想相连，正如这种光辉将群星连成心之所向的图形。
desc_en: A fateful stone that connects dreams.\nIts glimmers can entwine fates and connect dreams, just as how its glimmers link stars into the shapes of a heart's desires.

name_en: The Mountain Clouds Let Down Golden Rain
desc_chs: 「云山蓝」色的经典烟花，升空爆炸后，呈现出内外双层的结构，形如盛开的繁花。
desc_en: A classic "cloud blue" firework that will display its inner-and-outer-segmented design after exploding in mid-air like a profusely-blooming flower.

name_en: The Silver Night Is Full of Stars
desc_chs: 「满天星」色的经典烟花，瑰丽的色彩令人过目难忘。
desc_en: A classic "starry-night"-colored firework. Sure to be a magnificent, unforgettable sight.

name_en: The Gloom Paints the Cold Blooms
desc_chs: 「霁青」色的经典烟花，绽放时的火光流漫，呈现出别致的花瓣形貌。
desc_en: A classic firework the color of the azure skies just after rain. Its flaming flower glows when released, displaying unique petal morphologies.

name_en: Fireworks Dance Amidst a Snowy Sky
desc_chs: 绚烂金色的经典烟花，升空后将以格外轻盈的动态迸发，相对安静，却又不失华丽。
desc_en: These gorgeous golden fireworks follow a particularly graceful trajectory after they ascend and are quite silent, though no less lovely for it.

desc_chs: 「金盏」色的经典烟花，绽放之时如风车般旋转，尤为美观。
desc_en: These calendula-colored classics will spin like windmills after being released and are most beauteous indeed.

name_en: Kindled Trees by the Moonlit Window
desc_chs: 绽放后如柳树枝叶般下落的经典烟花，据说焰光的末梢能触及高楼的窗棂，带给人们非同寻常的观赏体验。
desc_en: After being released, these fireworks rain down flames like willow leaves and branches. It is said that the very edges of these flames can touch the window frames of the tallest buildings, granting a most unique viewing experience.

desc_chs: 风史莱姆造型的创意烟花。由于风史莱姆念起来不太顺口，烟花的创作者便用了一种色彩相同的民间食品「梧枝团」来代为比喻。
desc_en: An Anemo Slime-shaped creation. However, its creator considered calling it an "Anemo Slime-something" just a little odd, thus using the name of a similarly-colored local snack, "Villosa Balls," instead.

desc_chs: 某位璃月的烟花工匠在造访邻国后，遭遇了热情好客的「火花骑士」，并参考「火花骑士」的好伙伴「嘟嘟可」，开发了这种创意烟花。
desc_en: After visiting a neighboring state, a certain firework artisan from Liyue met a friendly and hospitable Spark Knight, and thus created this firework based on her bestest friend, Dodoco.

name_en: Fame and Fortune For a Season
desc_chs: 摩拉造型的创意烟花。传说从最端正的角度欣赏到这种烟花后，今后一整年都会得到财运的保佑。
desc_en: A firework that explodes in the shape of Mora. Some say that if you view this from just the right angle, your fortunes for the year shall be assured.

desc_chs: 某位璃月的烟花工匠在造访邻国后，与一位冒险团团长共同经历了难忘的旅程，并参考那位冒险团长常用的手势，开发了这种创意烟花。
desc_en: After visiting a neighboring state, a certain firework artisan from Liyue went on an unforgettable journey with a certain adventure team leader, thus basing this explosion's design off his favored gesture.

desc_chs: 心型的创意烟花。传说从最端正的角度欣赏到这种烟花后，很快就会迎来最美妙的爱情运势。
desc_en: A firework that explodes in the shape of heart. Some say that if you view this from just the right angle, your love life for the year shall be blessed.

desc_chs: 以某位万民堂名厨的小帮手为参考制作的创意烟花。一看到这位名厨的小帮手，璃月居民们就会回想起格外美味的菜肴。丰盛的家宴对于佳节而言必不可少。
desc_en: A firework based on the little helper for the Wanmin Restaurant's famous chef. When anyone from Liyue sees this little helper, their thoughts will immediately turn to good food. And where there's a festival, there must be good food!

name_en: Between the Exquisite Throws of Her Enigmatic Dice
desc_chs: 骰子造型的烟花，每次燃放时，都有可能绽放出不同的点数，据说是烟花工匠为表对「岩上茶室」新老板的敬重所制的产物。自从新的老板接管了那间茶室，嗜赌之徒几乎全数销声匿迹，牌戏与摩拉再无关联，回归了最初最纯粹的形态——闲暇时的普通游戏。
desc_en: A dice-shaped firework that displays a different number each time it is set off. It is said to be a gift from a firework artisan intending to show their respect for the Yanshang Teahouse's new owner. Since she took over the place, almost all the problem gamblers have disappeared. The game of cards no longer has anything to do with Mora, instead returning to its original and purest form — ordinary leisure-time amusement.

desc_chs: 某位四处云游的作家访问海祇岛期间，曾被一位「尖耳大将」盛情招待，对他的小小助手印象深刻。因此，作家为工匠提供了灵感，制作了这款烟花。
desc_en: A traveling novelist was once warmly welcomed by a pointy-eared General during their stay in Watatsumi Island. The General's little canine companion left a deep impression on them, and so they commissioned an artisan to craft this firework.

name_en: Cliffbreaker's Banner Flutters in Drum Rolls
desc_chs: 热爱戏曲的烟花工匠精心设计的烟花，绽放后的形貌宛如戏曲中出现的旌旗。听戏是许多璃月人最为喜爱的活动，只要观赏到这种烟花，耳畔似乎就响起了某位名角精妙绝伦的唱段…
desc_en: A firework meticulously designed by an opera-loving firework artisan. It explodes in the shape of the banners often seen in opera performances. Watching operas is a favorite pastime among many Liyue locals, and when fireworks with this pattern bloom in the sky, an unforgettable melody sung by a certain famed performer is sure to come to mind...

desc_chs: 曾在璃月与蒙德之间频繁来往的商人委托工匠制作的烟花，据说是为了对某位特别的酒保表示感谢——被那位酒保的话语震撼后，商人不再贪杯，并因此斩获了大量业绩。
desc_en: A firework commissioned by a merchant who often traveled between Liyue and Mondstadt. This firework is said to be a token of gratitude for a certain bartender, for it was after being deeply struck by her words that the merchant stopped their excessive drinking and made a great fortune.

desc_chs: 「浮游水蕈兽」造型的创意烟花。\n据称，一位曾出差至须弥的总务司文员为烟花工匠提供了建议，共同设计了这种圆滚滚的烟花，希望它的可爱造型能让人们心情愉快。
desc_en: A firework that explodes in the shape of a Floating Hydro Fungus.\nThey say that a Ministry of Civil Affairs clerk offered the inspiration for this rotund firework pattern after returning from a business trip in Sumeru, hoping that its adorable appearance would brighten everyone's heart.

desc_chs: 以某位热心小姑娘的搭档为灵感所作的烟花。\n璃月港曾有不少人得到一位小姑娘的帮助，但无从得知她的名字，只听她呼唤自己的搭档为「月桂」，于是便请工匠打造了这种烟花，以表感谢和祝福。
desc_en: A firework inspired by a warmhearted little girl.\nMany people have received a helping hand from the girl, yet none know her name — all they know is that she called her companion "Yuegui." This firework was commissioned as an expression of their gratitude and well wishes.

desc_chs: 枪械的配件蓝图，可用来在「灰眸」展开的视界中消耗材料以制作蓝图中记录的武器配件。
desc_en: Blueprint for a firearm accessory that can be used to create said inscribed weapon accessory by consuming materials in the Eye of Graeae's HUD.

desc_chs: 「臻冰造物·立方」的外观。\n霜精似乎非常痴迷于用自己的形象制造各种奇怪的臻冰造物。即使是最简单的立方，它们也很努力地尝试加入了霜精形象的要素。
desc_en: An appearance variant for the "Prime Ice Construct: Cube."\nJack Frost appears utterly obsessed with fashioning bizarre icy creations in their own image. Even with a structure as simple as a cube, they have poured immense effort into incorporating their own distinct features.

desc_chs: 「臻冰造物·寄物装置」的外观。\n猎人之间似乎有句谚语，是这么说的：「能被熊抱在怀里的一定是好东西。」\n虽然从真正的极地熊手中夺走东西总觉得还是有点可怕，不过如果只是寄物装置的话应该没什么所谓吧…
desc_en: Appearance of the Prime Ice Construct: Storage Device.\nThere is an old saying among hunters that goes: "If a bear holds it close, you know it's a treasure."\nWhile the idea of wresting anything away from a real Polyarbear sounds terrifying, a mere storage unit modeled after one shouldn't pose much of a threat... right?

desc_chs: 「臻冰造物·氛围桩」的外观。\n在观看演出时，心情总是随着芭蕾舞者的每一次舞姿的变化起伏，每次观看，都能从她们的舞姿中获得许多力量。\n似乎是出于这样的心情，设计了如是的臻冰造物外观。
desc_en: An appearance variant for the "Prime Ice Construct: Ambient Bollard."\nWhen watching a performance, one's emotions naturally ebb and flow with every graceful movement of the ballet dancer. Each viewing instills a profound sense of inner strength.\nPerhaps it was born from this very sentiment that this particular Prime Ice Construct appearance was designed.

desc_chs: 「臻冰造物·氛围桩」的外观。\n源源不断提供增益的不只有氛围桩，还有陪伴在身边的伙伴。有的时候，伙伴的陪伴也能带来远超增益的力量…话虽如此，氛围桩要是也能和伙伴一样跟在身边就好了。
desc_en: An appearance variant for the "Prime Ice Construct: Ambient Bollard."\nContinuous buffs come not only from ambient bollards, but from the companions by our side. Sometimes, their mere presence provides a strength that far surpasses any magical enhancement... That being said, it would be wonderful if these bollards could follow us around just like a real companion.

desc_chs: 「臻冰造物·氛围桩」的外观。\n听说在这样设计的氛围桩周围，有时能够听到隐约的潮汐的声音。但氛围桩其实不会发出声音，发出声音的其实是你的内心与想象。就像你在某日夜晚突然想起心底的某首歌一样。
desc_en: An appearance variant for the "Prime Ice Construct: Ambient Bollard."\nThey say that if you stand near a bollard crafted in this likeness, you can sometimes hear the faint murmur of the tides. Yet, the structure itself makes no sound; the melody belongs entirely to your mind and imagination, just like a song that suddenly echoes in your heart on a quiet night.

desc_chs: 点亮星空的希望之种。\n无论相隔多远，命定相遇的人都会受缘石辉光的指引，在星空下相会。
desc_en: A seed that lights up the night.\nNo matter the distance apart, guided by the stone's glimmer, the fated will meet under the stars.

desc_chs: 蕴含着诸多事象概念的晶体。瞬变的诸界中，由珍贵的见闻和铭记的执念聚结而成。
desc_en: A crystal containing phenomenological concepts formed from the coalescence of precious memories and obsessions within ever-shifting realms.

desc_chs: 刻录绮彩的奇迹之楔。\n瑰丽而深邃的奇域之中，封存着魔女羁旅多年的万千见闻，借助这一奇妙之物的力量，便可让这些珍藏再现于世间…
desc_en: A curious keystone that serves as a repository of brilliant hues.\nIn a wondrous domain filled with beauty and mystery, myriad stories from a witch's long sojourns in foreign lands are sealed. By harnessing the power of this wondrous item, you can reveal these brilliant treasures to the world once more...

desc_chs: 再现华美的记录晶簇。\n万物皆可构筑成形的奇域之中，融入了魔女对衣装真谛的见解。借助这一奇妙之物的力量，便可重现诸多精妙的装扮…
desc_en: A crystal geode that serves as a template to reproduce splendor.\nIn a mystical realm where anything can take shape, it is imbued with a witch's insights into the true essence of clothing. By harnessing the power of this wondrous item, you can re-create many a marvelous cosmetic...

desc_chs: 可以在商城兑换珍贵物品的货币。\n过剩的事象具现之形体。累积起来，也许可以再现瑰丽的珍藏。
desc_en: Currency used to purchase precious items from the Shop.\nThe materialized form of surplus phenomena. Perhaps it can recreate splendorous treasures when in large enough quantities.

desc_chs: 启用大厅所需的奇妙钥匙，是开办热闹聚会的必要道具。\n随着时间流逝，每12小时都将有一柄「盛会之匙」凝聚成形。
desc_en: A wondrous key that allows you to open a lobby. Absolutely essential for anyone seeking to host a lively gathering.\nA new Festive Key takes shape every 12 hours.

desc_chs: 通透明亮的纪录之楔，可为自己进行活动颂愿。\n点染着明亮光彩的奇域之中，处处都是魔女巧妙搭配而成的形貌，借助这一奇妙之物的力量，便可重现诸多精妙的装扮…
desc_en: A bright, translucent keystone that can be used to perform Event Odes.\nIn a wondrous domain replete with luminous splendor, every corner is filled with exquisite forms arranged by a witch. By harnessing the power of this wondrous item, you can re-create many a marvelous cosmetic...

desc_chs: 在「千星奇域」中遨游时，增长的热情、阅历与知识，正是一种特别而宝贵的「经验」。
desc_en: When exploring the "Miliastra Wonderland," the enthusiasm, encounters, and knowledge gained serve as a particularly precious form of "experience."

desc_chs: 魔女封存于奇域中的万千收藏，皆是你们新奇的见闻，构成全新画卷的灵感。
desc_en: A witch's boundless collection, sealed within a Wonderland. Each treasure is a spark of inspiration leading toward a brand-new creation.

desc_chs: 使用后可以获得当期的诸界纪游使用资格。
desc_en: Use this item to unlock Chronicles of the Realms for a single period.

desc_chs: 「千星奇域」中的珍贵道具，蕴含奇异光彩的晶体，可用于换取各种奇域中的礼盒。
desc_en: A precious item in "Miliastra Wonderland." This crystal shimmers with a mysterious light and can be exchanged for various gift boxes in the Wonderlands.

desc_chs: 「千星奇域」中的珍贵道具，蕴含奇异光彩的晶体，可用于换取各种奇域中的礼盒。具有使用的<color=#FF5E41>限制时间</color>，在有效时间过后，会失去形体与功效…
desc_en: A precious item in "Miliastra Wonderland." This crystal shimmers with a mysterious light and can be exchanged for various gift boxes in the Wonderlands. It has a <color=#FF5E41>time limit</color>. Once this period ends, it will vanish and lose all its effects...

desc_chs: 「千星奇域」中的珍贵道具，蕴含奇异光彩的晶体，可用于换取各种奇域中的礼盒。
desc_en: A precious item in "Miliastra Wonderland." This crystal shimmers with a mysterious light and can be exchanged for various gift boxes in the Wonderlands.

desc_chs: 异国面容的剑斗士，西风骑士团的头脑派人物。
desc_en: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

desc_chs: 慵懒而博学的图书管理员，须弥教令院「两百年一见」的天才毕业生。
desc_en: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

desc_chs: 受到须弥的草木认可，获授的印记。\n可以贡献给森林深处的「梦之树」，以此获得森林的嘉许。
desc_en: A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the trees, grass, and flowers in Sumeru.\nOffer it to the Tree of Dreams deep in the woods to receive the rewards from the forest.

desc_chs: 受到稻妻群岛的鸣雷认可，获授的印记。\n可以缴纳给鸣神大社的神樱，提高「神樱眷顾」的等级。
desc_en: A sigil that serves as a sign of the acknowledgment given by the thundering islands of Inazuma.\nOffer them to the Sacred Sakura of the Grand Narukami Shrine to raise your Sacred Sakura's Favor level.

desc_chs: 「七圣召唤」进行对局所用的小台桌，平时看上去更像是一个有点高度的箱子，也有牌手会将自己的秘典之盒放在其中携带，在打开后，能够看到风格各异，制作精美的台面，可以在其中进行「七圣召唤」的牌局。
desc_en: A small table used as an arena in Genius Invokation TCG matches. It normally resembles an elevated box a bit more. Some players will place their Casket of Tomes inside to better carry both around, and once opened up, the various exquisitely built arenas of differing types and styles are then revealed as stages for the duels to come.

desc_chs: 听说只要是刚刚开始七圣召唤的牌手，都能够领取到的牌手徽章。\n每个了不起的牌手，都是从领到这枚徽章开始，逐渐成就自己的传奇的。\n敬请期待，一切都将从这里开始。
desc_en: They say that anyone who starts out with Genius Invokation TCG can obtain this particular Player Badge.\nEven the mightiest player starts from this point, building their personal legends as they go along.\nStay tuned, player — your saga begins here!

desc_chs: 经常进行对局的七圣召唤牌手，在通过高级牌手的试炼对局后就能够领取到的牌手徽章。\n成为牌手的人有很多，但大多数只是将七圣召唤视为一种消遣，能成为高级牌手的只是其中少数。\n即使是游戏，认真对待的人也将获得独属自己的回馈。
desc_en: Those who play Genius Invokation TCG often and complete the Advanced Player Trial match will obtain this Player Badge.\nMany are those who become players, but the vast majority treat the game as a sort of pastime, and so those who become Advanced Players are few and far between.\nEven games do provide the dedicated with unique rewards.

desc_chs: 对七圣召唤有所钻研的牌手，在通过专家牌手的试炼对局后就能够领取到的牌手徽章。\n或许此时的心态与一开始接触七圣召唤时已不太一样，却依然能从中寻找新的有趣之处。\n因为有趣所以愿意为之投入时间，因为喜爱所以能够享受其中的一切。
desc_en: Those who study the art of playing Genius Invokation TCG and clear the Expert Player Trial match will obtain this Player Badge.\nPerhaps your attitude at this point is markedly different from when you first began, but you still find new joy in playing—\nIn willingly putting time into something you find interesting, and in enjoying all that comprises that which you love.

desc_chs: 七圣召唤的水平达到相当水准的牌手，在通过大师牌手的试炼对局后就能够领取到的牌手徽章。\n听说领取到这枚徽章的牌手并不多见，每一位都有自己对于七圣召唤的独到理解。\n胜利或许早已不是唯一的追求之物。
desc_en: Those who reach the level at which they may complete the Master player Trial shall receive this Player Badge.\nThey say that few are the players who can obtain this badge, and each of them has their own unique take on the game.\nVictory, it seems, may no longer be the sole object here.

desc_chs: 在通过传说牌手的试炼对局后能够领取到的牌手徽章。\n这枚徽章证明你已经踏上了缔造属于自己传说的牌手之路。\n继续探寻所能抵达的更高的境界吧。
desc_en: Those who clear the Legend Player Trial will obtain this Player Badge.\nThis badge proves that you are well on your way to carving out your own unique mythos as a player.\nGo forth, go beyond, and reach new heights!

desc_chs: 芭芭拉的海滩装扮。洋溢着夏日活力的俏丽短裙，似乎散发着海洋的清爽气息。
desc_en: Barbara's beach attire. This pretty skirt brims with summer vitality and carries with it a cool ocean breeze.

desc_chs: 琴的夏日装束。清凉而不失优雅，是海滨之游的绝佳搭配。
desc_en: Jean's summer wear. Light and cool, but no less elegant for it. The perfect choice for a trip to the seaside.

desc_chs: 凝光的礼服装扮。绀蓝长裙勾勒出丽人优雅的曲线，脚踝上的蝶翼又为她平添了几分轻盈。
desc_en: Ningguang's formal wear. The long cyan skirt traces her elegant curves, and the butterfly wings at her ankles lend the outfit a touch of light grace.

desc_chs: 刻晴的礼服装扮。于海灯节之良辰美景中，往日辛劳浓墨所绘的线条，交织成今夜轻盈而瑰丽的容姿。
desc_en: Keqing's formal wear. Amidst the beautiful dawn of the Lantern Rite, the threads weaved by days of hard work intertwine into a light yet magnificent appearance.

desc_chs: 迪卢克隐秘行动时所穿的衣装之一，如阴影之中翻腾的火焰。敌人视野尽头所留下的殷红残痕，即是他们余生挥之不去的梦魇。
desc_en: One of the outfits Diluc wears during covert actions, it resembles a flame dancing in the shadows. The crimson red traces it leaves behind at the edges of the enemy's vision will scar their nightmares forever.

desc_chs: 皇女菲谢尔的祭礼着装。愿高贵的人永远葆有勇气、诚挚与善心，如此，邪恶必无法挫败她。
desc_en: A ceremonial outfit for the Prinzessin. May she who is noble retain her courage, sincerity, and kindness forever, such that no evil shall ever overcome her.

desc_chs: 琴的装扮款式。典雅干练的骑士礼服，适用于多种场合。
desc_en: Jean's outfit. This classic knight's ceremonial outfit is suited to all manner of occasions.

desc_chs: 安柏的装扮款式。这一次出现的，是更为正式也更为英气的侦察骑士哦！
desc_en: Amber's outfit. This is a more formal — but no less cool — version of the Outrider's uniform!

desc_chs: 莫娜的装扮款式。为迎接占星术概念中的「命定之刻」而特别购置的衣装，感谢星象仪补款七折优惠券。
desc_en: Mona's outfit. A costume made specifically to encompass the astrological concept of "the destined moment," thanks to the 30% discount ticket she got from the planetarium refund.

desc_chs: 罗莎莉亚的装扮款式。这套衣服似乎是教会为她专门定制的礼物。
desc_en: Rosaria's outfit. This seems to have been custom-made for her by the Church.

desc_chs: 神里绫华的出游装扮。比照轻小说插画中的枫丹女性装束而制作的洋装，似乎能借其一窥枫丹淑女的生活风貌。
desc_en: Ayaka's travel outfit. Its design is based on the Fontaine dresses depicted in light novel illustrations and seems to reflect the lifestyle of proper ladies who live in that nation.

desc_chs: 丽莎重游须弥时请人订做的服饰。裙装干练而不失优雅，与她学生时代的制服有几分相似之处。
desc_en: An outfit Lisa had someone commission for her when she revisited Sumeru. A perfect balance between practicality and elegance, the dress bears a resemblance to Lisa's old uniform from the Akademiya days.

desc_chs: 可莉出演关键剧目时所穿的精致服装，色彩明丽，如同点缀着奶油花朵和明红蜡烛的蛋糕，能将快乐与笑容带往冒险所至的每个角落。
desc_en: An exquisite outfit Klee wears only for the most important performances. The colors are brilliant, like a cake adorned with cream flowers and crowned with scarlet candles. With it comes happiness and smiles that will fill your adventures.

desc_chs: 凯亚在舞台上饰演「短刀大盗」时的装扮，以「吸睛」为设计原则的华丽服装。不过衣服穿起来并不麻烦，最花时间打理的是饰品与短刀。
desc_en: Kaeya's outfit from his role as the "Dagger Bandit" in the play. Though flamboyant and designed to be as eye-catching as possible, it isn't difficult to put on, though it does take some time to get all the accessories and daggers sorted.

desc_chs: 申鹤收到的海灯节贺礼。由其师留云借风真君请人缝制的优雅礼服，双臂上红绳依旧，但申鹤心中的苦寒之意已淡。
desc_en: This Lantern Rite gift that Shenhe received is a set of elegant formal attire that her master, Cloud Retainer had commissioned for her. Red ropes still adorn her arms, but the bitter cold in Shenhe's heart has faded.

desc_chs: 轻盈优雅的佳节服饰，以龙葵紫黑和玉鈫蓝为主调，发饰则如清心般明丽，正是甘雨最喜爱的搭配。
desc_en: A light and graceful festive outfit accented mainly in black nightshade and cerulean blue. Its hair accessory is as radiant as the Qingxin — a pairing that Ganyu is most fond of.

desc_chs: 飞云商会为行秋准备的宴会衣装。竹纹清雅、剪裁服帖，但最令行秋满意的还是其内层的口袋，足够塞下一册较薄的小说了。
desc_en: Formal wear prepared by the Feiyun Commerce Guild for Xingqiu. The bamboo prints are refined and the cut is most flattering, but Xingqiu's favorite aspect of the outfit is its inner pockets, into which a thinner novel might be stuffed.

desc_chs: 妮露的典雅服饰，千花编织般的轻盈裙装，如有黎明时的东风捎来淡香，承载着童话世界的美好祝福。
desc_en: An elegant outfit for Nilou, this featherweight dress is seemingly woven of countless flowers, and with it drifts a light fragrance like the east wind at dawn, carrying beauteous blessings from a fairytale land.

desc_chs: 绮良良的装扮款式。童话中行侠仗义的猫猫剑客，传递愿望的狡黠少女，向您致意。
desc_en: Kirara's outfit. The swashbuckling feline of fairytale fame, the crafty courier of dearly-held dreams... is pleased to make your acquaintance!

desc_chs: 胡桃的装扮款式。有别于往生堂深色仪服的素色连衣裙，是好友香菱为胡桃特别准备的礼物，墨镜则是她自己的收藏。
desc_en: Hu Tao's outfit. Styled in a palette lighter than the dark ceremonial wear favored by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, the dress is a special gift from her good friend Xiangling. The sunglasses, for their part, are from Hu Tao's personal collection.

desc_chs: 香菱的装扮款式。冷风中的一抹红色灶火，帽子在胡桃提议下根据锅巴的形象特别设计而成，很受香菱喜爱。
desc_en: Xiangling's outfit. The red coat glows like a stove amidst cold winds, topped with a hat that, at Hu Tao's suggestion, took inspiration from Guoba's appearance — a design that's right up Xiangling's alley.

desc_chs: 夜兰为假日时光所搭配的装束，典雅而不失利落，捎来悠暇的心境之余，也不失为一种「充满攻势」的伪装…
desc_en: The outfit Yelan has prepared for her holiday. Elegant yet neat, it conveys a sense of leisure while somehow still carrying a hint of concealed aggression...

desc_chs: 班尼特的纳塔游历装束，主色调是幸运的湖蓝，以及炽热的黄橙，如同这片土地一般洋溢着勃勃生机。
desc_en: Bennett's traveling attire for his journeys in Natlan. Dyed lucky lakewater blue with hints of blazing orange, these clothes emanate an overflowing vitality that matches the land in which they are worn.

name_en: As Heaven and Earth Are Made Anew
desc_chs: 旅行者的装扮款式。无数相伴的日夜浸入宁谧甘美的沉眠前，为双星中的另一颗所选择的实用衣装。
desc_en: The Traveler's outfit. A practical attire chosen for the other twin before the countless days and nights they spent together drift into serene, gentle slumber.

name_en: As Heaven and Earth Are Made Anew
desc_chs: 旅行者的装扮款式。无数相伴的日夜浸入宁谧甘美的沉眠前，为双星中的另一颗所选择的实用衣装。
desc_en: The Traveler's outfit. A practical attire chosen for the other twin before the countless days and nights they spent together drift into serene, gentle slumber.

desc_chs: 杜林的装扮款式。接过母亲的笔之后，杜林原本的衣装也拥有了新的形态——他最终还是要告别母亲笔下的那段过往。胸前那道心锁消失之后，他的心愿所指向的远方，就是这个故事继续延伸的方向。
desc_en: Durin's outfit. Durin's original outfit has received a new lease of life now that he's taken up his mother's pen. Ultimately, he bid farewell to the past once painted by its previous owner. When the lock on his heart faded away, the distant horizon his wish now points to became the direction in which his story continues to unfold.

desc_chs: 那维莱特收到的惊喜礼物。惊喜不仅源于礼物本身，更来自于参与礼物制作的每一双小小援手。就像河流汇于大海，露水也凝聚成闪耀着七色光芒的奇迹。
desc_en: A surprise gift for Neuvillette. The delight comes not just from the gift itself, but from every little hand that helped make it. As rivers merge into the boundless sea, so too shall dewdrops congregate to create a shimmering, iridescent miracle.

desc_chs: 瑶瑶的装扮款式。新梢清影叩书案，有时客来不是风。
desc_en: Yaoyao's outfit. New shoots cast shifting shadows on the desk in disarray; at times the guest who enters is not the wind at play.

desc_chs: 茜特菈莉的装扮款式。闲居在家的茜特菈莉偶尔会换上一身少女感十足的衣装，届时任何以公务为由上前叨扰的人都会遭到重击。于是那身衣装成为了传闻中的凶煞之物，见到了就得尽快绕路。
desc_en: Citlali's outfit. When at home, Citlali will sometimes change into attire brimming with girlish charm. At such times, anyone troubling her with official duties has promptly come under heavy attack. Thus, this outfit has become a baleful thing, a subject of fearful rumor that all give a wide berth.

desc_chs: 夏洛蒂的装扮款式。本来是《大侦探赫尔洛克》的拍摄用服饰，在拍摄结束后，剧组将它作为纪念品赠予了夏洛蒂。
desc_en: Charlotte's outfit. Once used as a filming costume for Great Detective Hurlock, this outfit was presented to Charlotte by the production crew as a keepsake after the shoot concluded.

desc_chs: 攻破万般凶险的地脉紊乱点最终防线后，获取的特殊战利品，似是与纯粹「信息」凝结而成的实体，承载着失落武器的形貌。\n这些尚未被书籍和歌谣记述的兵器，必定同它们的主人一起，在提瓦特遥远过去的某地经历过无比惨烈的鏖战…\n只是，随着纯粹的信息被从地脉中剥离而出，它们也开始逐渐消散，一段时间后，似乎就无法再维持基本的形貌…
desc_en: A special treasure obtained from breaking through the most perilous layer of the Ley Line disturbance. It is made of "information" in its purest form, coalesced into the shape of a lost weapon.\nThese weapons, forgotten by script and song alike, experienced a tragic battle alongside their original wielders in Teyvat's distant past...\nAnd, as the pure information was stripped from the Ley Lines, they began to dissipate, until, after a time, they could scarcely maintain even their basic form...

desc_chs: 以至为强劲、锐不可当的态势攻破万般凶险的地脉紊乱点最终防线后，获取的特殊战利品，似是与纯粹「信息」凝结而成的实体，承载着失落武器的形貌。\n这些尚未被书籍和歌谣记述的兵器，必定同它们的主人一起，在提瓦特遥远过去的某地经历过无比惨烈的鏖战…\n只是，随着纯粹的信息被从地脉中剥离而出，它们也开始逐渐消散，一段时间后，似乎就无法再维持基本的形貌…
desc_en: A special treasure obtained from breaking through the most perilous layer of the Ley Line disturbance with unstoppable strength and force. It is made of "information" in its purest form, coalesced into the shape of a lost weapon.\nThese weapons, forgotten by script and song alike, experienced a tragic battle alongside their original wielders in Teyvat's distant past...\nAnd, as the pure information was stripped from the Ley Lines, they began to dissipate, until, after a time, they could scarcely maintain even their basic form...

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「洛格瑟姆」的名讳为黄金的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory sword that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. Legend has it that this sword once held the name "Logseims" when it was wielded by a golden sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的、闪映着「生」之力的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「洛格瑟姆」的名讳为超越的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory sword glimmering with the power of "Life" that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. Legend has it that this sword once held the name "Logseims" when it was wielded by a transcendent sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「索达古瑟」的名讳为称贤的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory claymore that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. Legend has it that this claymore once held the name "Starkuthr" when it was wielded by an wise sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的、闪映着「理」之力的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「索达古瑟」的名讳为超越的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory claymore glimmering with the power of "Reason" that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. Legend has it that this claymore once held the name "Starkuthr" when it was wielded by a transcendent sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「瓦恩斯图格」的名讳为猎月的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory polearm that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. Legend has it that this polearm once held the name "Barnstokkr" when it was wielded by a moon-hunting sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的、闪映着「死」之力的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「瓦恩斯图格」的名讳为超越的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory polearm glimmering with the power of "Death" that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. Legend has it that this polearm once held the name "Barnstokkr" when it was wielded by a transcendent sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「格莱普尼尔」的名讳为告谕的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory catalyst that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its user. Legend has it that this catalyst once held the name "Gleipnir" when it was used by an oracle-issuing sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的、闪映着「时」之力的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「格莱普尼尔」的名讳为超越的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory catalyst glimmering with the power of "Time" that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its user. Legend has it that this catalyst once held the name "Gleipnir" when it was used by a transcendent sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「居瑟诺德」的名讳为极恶的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory bow that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. Legend has it that this bow once held the name "Gusisnautar" when it was wielded by a foul sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的、闪映着「空」之力的辉耀兵刃幻形，能依据持有者的元素类型变化自身。据说在古老的国度曾以「居瑟诺德」的名讳为超越的罪人持有。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory bow glimmering with the power of "Void" that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. Legend has it that this bow once held the name "Gusisnautar" when it was wielded by a transcendent sinner in an ancient land.

desc_chs: 「从原理上来说，此世的诸多事象均可被称作『像』。因此，你在水晶球中瞥见的『像』在某种意义上也算是物质实在的外延。总之，就算艾莉丝和尼可都不承认，水占的正统性也是实在的！」
desc_en: "In principle, many phenomena in this world can be called 'images.' Therefore, the image you glimpsed in the crystal ball can, in a sense, be considered an extension of physical reality. In short, even if Alice and Nicole don't acknowledge it, Hydromancy is still very much a real thing!"

desc_chs: 「小魔女会」送给好朋友的礼物。由于材料不足的缘故，形制参考了枫丹的《雪翅雁童话集》中的神奇道具。\n虽然不能真的像童话里那样随意打开通往不同空间的门扉，但依然有着可以陪伴重要的朋友走过无数空间的坚韧。
desc_en: A gift from the Little Hexenzirkel to a good friend. Due to insufficient available materials, the design has been based on a magical item from the Fontainian text, "Tales of a Snow-Winged Goose."\nYou won't be able to open doors to different realms as one can in fairy tales, but this item is more than durable enough to accompany friends through countless such realms.

name_en: A Touch of Frost in Scorching Summer!
desc_chs: 霜精们送给好朋友的小小礼物！虽然看上去很美味，好像还是莓莓果酱味的，咬一口下去，沁人心脾的凉意与美妙的甜蜜一定会在舌尖携手起舞，但其实并不能真的食用…虽然看上去真的很美味。
desc_en: A small gift from the Jack Frosts to their good friends! It looks wildly tasty and seems berry jam-flavored. One bite, and a refreshing chill and delightful sweetness would surely dance together across your tongue... if only this were actually edible. It looks super delicious, though.

desc_chs: 自地脉至深之处显现的兵刃幻形，据说在过去曾以「督兰嘉德」之名为纯白的骑士所持有。\n其名在古语中意为「永无损毁的锋刃」。与他所佩戴的刀剑一样，骑士所坚信的道途也从未弯折——无论那原本纯白的钢铁如今已被如何染作漆黑。
desc_en: A glorious, illusory sword that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines. It is said that in the past, it was wielded by the white knight under the name Durandarte.\nIts name, in ancient tongues, means "the blade that is never destroyed." Just like the sword he bore, the path the knight believed in has never wavered — no matter how the once-pure steel has since been darkened.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「冒险家的临时营地」的放置方法。
深入荒野的冒险家临时建立的营地。
冒险家们准备宿营时，需要设置围栏，以防走兽袭扰。可附近的木材往往不足以建立起完整的屏护，只能用轮流值班放哨来确保万无一失。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up an Adventurer Camp.
A campsite hastily made by adventurers deep in the wilds.
When adventurers make camp, they must be sure to place a fence down to fend wild beasts off. But since the area rarely has enough wood to create complete protection, they must often keep watch on shifts and sound the alarm to avoid any slip-ups and mishaps.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「远驻前哨的生活」的放置方法。\n西风骑士团的前任团长曾建议，人数较少的队伍在野外执行任务时，应尽量建立牢固的住所，以防遭遇突然袭击。「袖珍松木小屋」便是绝佳的选择。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up "Frontier Life."\nThe previous Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius once suggested that knight companies attending to duties in the wild should attempt to set up as secure a dwelling as possible to guard against any sudden attacks. The Pocket-Sized Pine Cabin proved to be the best choice in that regard.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「自在的岩石与草木」的放置方法。\n杳无人烟的荒野中，草木自由生长。岩石也堆积在一处，似乎是某些走兽的杰作。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up "Rocks & Plants."\nThe grass and trees grow free in the wilds where human feet do not tread. Rocks are also piled up in a corner, seemingly the work of some beast.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「简朴的璃月睡房」的放置方法。
即便最为富贵的璃月人家，卧室中也少不了这些必备品。
在七星的高效管理下，璃月居民的收入稳步提高，却砂木的家具也不再是奢侈品。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Plain Liyue Bedroom.
Even the richest of Liyue's households simply won't do without some of these bedroom essentials.
Under the efficient direction of the Liyue Qixing, the income of the average resident of Liyue has steadily climbed, ensuring that these Sandbearer household furnishings are no longer a rarity.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「茶馆一隅」的放置方法。\n与亲友细品清茗，静听说书人的连珠妙语，便是茶馆中最为淳朴的乐趣。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a "Corner of the Teahouse."\nEnjoying some tea with friends and relatives while listening to the witty words of the storytellers is the simplest joy of the teahouse.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「郊野的灯影」的放置方法。\n伫立在树下的路灯与围栏。「退邪灯」的光芒能将夜行之人的不安彻底驱散。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up "Suburbia Lighting."\nStreet lights and fences that stand under the trees. These Evil-Repelling Lanterns will allow those who walk about at night some peace of mind.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「万用的桌椅」的放置方法。\n结实的松木桌椅，桌面宽阔，摆上纸笔即可工作，撤下书本就能用餐，一套家具即可满足众多需求。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up "Table & Chairs."\nA sturdy and wide pine table that comes with pen and paper for work. The papers and books can be cleared aside should you need to eat — truly, this is one furniture set to rule them all.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「忙碌的厨房」的放置方法。\n高耸的货架满备食材，大小炉灶的火力全开。熟练的厨师利用这间厨房，足以制作出招待百人的大餐。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Busy Kitchen.\nThe towering shelves are stocked with ingredients and the large and small stoves are both in full flame. A skilled chef would be able to use such a kitchen to cook a feast fit for a hundred stomachs.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「闲时茶话」的放置方法。\n璃月居民常请朋友到家中坐坐，品茶聊天。只需这样的一张茶桌与两张茶椅，就能度过愉快的闲暇时光。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up "Tea Talk."\nThe people of Liyue often invite friends over to their places to sit and have a chat over some tea. A good time can be had with just this tea table and two chairs.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「万卷书斋」的放置方法。
卷藏颇丰的璃月书房，平心静气在此待上半天，就能得到不少收获。
据说如今常见的书房陈设，大多效仿自飞云商会的宅邸，由飞云商会的二少爷所改进，显著提升了学习与写作的效率。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Book Lover's Study.
A Liyue-style study chock-full of books. One may gain much by spending half a day here in peace and quiet.
They say that the commonly-seen style of study designs nowadays is largely derived from the Feiyun Commerce Guild manor, which was improved by its second young master to greatly increase the efficiency with which one may study and write.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「家具完备的蒙德卧室」的放置方法。
标准陈设的蒙德卧室，家具摆放的位置参考了骑士团的宿舍。
在祈礼牧师对衣柜祈福驱邪的同时，骑士们也以身作则，将床尾正对衣柜门，声称如果有鬼怪出没，西风骑士会给它们迎头痛击，震慑鬼怪的同类。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Fully Furnished Mondstadt Bedroom.
This is a standard-issue Mondstadt bedroom, with the furniture placement taking reference from that of the Knights of Favonius quarters.
As the Deaconess was praying over the wardrobe to ward off evil, the Knights also set an example by facing the wardrobe with the foot of their beds, claiming that they would give any ghostly rapscallions that should show up a hard knock on the head as a form of intimidation.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「『关键六人』会议室」的放置方法。
参照骑士团议事厅布置的会议室。根据椅子的数目，民间推测出了「骑士团的重大决策都由关键六人决出」的传闻。
真相是喜欢坐着开会的骑士团高层只有六人，参会人数从来不是个固定的数字。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a "Meeting Room of the 'Strategic Six'."
A meeting room that was based on the one in the Knights of Favonius Headquarters. A rumor spread among the citizenry, judging from the number of chairs present, that "six shall be present at any key decision the Knights make."
The truth is that only six members of the Knights' leadership enjoy sitting down for meetings. The number of attendees has never been fixed.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「聚会与痛饮之时」的放置方法。\n举办聚会时常用的桌椅，摆放烛台是为了改善光照，让食物的色泽更诱人。不过兴致高涨时，还请留意防火。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up "Wine O'Clock."\nA table and chair set often used during gatherings. The candle stand is used to adjust the lighting and make the food look more enticing. Nonetheless, do watch out for the fire hazard, especially when spirits get high around the table.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「店员们的午间工作餐」的放置方法。\n商铺的店员需要面对随时可能到来的顾客，常常使用简易炉灶自行料理午饭，防止离开店面用餐时错过生意。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a "Merchant's Working Lunch."\nPeople manning a merchant store must be ready to receive customers at any time. As such, they often use simple stoves to make lunch for themselves to avoid missing any business due to not manning the store constantly.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「会客室的温暖防线」的放置方法。\n点燃会客室的壁炉，暖意便会在房间中弥漫开来，让人身心放松。要是再加几杯招待宾客的烈酒，应付咄咄逼人的至冬国商人都不在话下。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting "Parlor Cordiality" up.\nThe sconces that light up this reception area suffuse the area with warmth that relaxes the body and soul. Add on a few cups of strong wine, and you've got everything you need to talk down even some aggressive Snezhnayan businesspeople.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「设施完备的书房」的放置方法。\n书盈一壁的蒙德书房。考虑到书本繁多，但使用书房的人较少，对书籍分类摆放尤为重要。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Well-Equipped Study.\nBooks line the wall in this Mondstadt-style study. Considering that the books are many but the users are few, splitting the books into proper categories is of particular importance.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「山间独居之屋」的放置方法。
璃月各地寻常可见的房屋。门外设置路灯，可为过客提供便捷。
璃月人大多热情好客，即便隐居山野，也不介意迷途之人暂住一晚，还会以最好的餐食与茶水待客。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Hermit's Hut.
A house that can found in many places around Liyue. A street light is set up outside the door for the convenience of passers-by.
The people of Liyue are a friendly sort for the most part. Even those who live apart from others in the mountains don't mind receiving a guest for the night. Indeed, you can expect a fine meal and some tea should you drop by.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「村镇院落」的放置方法。\n蒙德乡野的住宅。围栏和房屋之间留出了大块空地，以便种植各种作物，供日常食用。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Hamlet House.\nA common dwelling found in Mondstadt's countryside. There is a rather large space between the fence and the house, all the better to plant some produce with which to provide some food self-sufficiency.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「收获时节的小镇摊位」的放置方法。\n每到收获时节，镇民们会在要道附近设置摊位，出售各种货物。不止刚刚收成的果蔬和小麦，还有成色不错的旧货和干草卷。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Harvest Season Stall.\nEvery time the harvest season arrives, the people of the town will set stalls up to sell all manner of wares. Such things contain not only the harvested fruits, vegetables, and wheat, but also secondhand goods of good quality and hay rolls.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「应有尽有的果蔬市场」的放置方法。\n设有多个摊位的果蔬市场，普通人家经常购买的果蔬，大多能在这种市场找到。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a "Fruit & Veg Market."\nThis market comes with quite a few stores. The fruits that people often buy can be found at this sort of place.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「练兵场的一角」的放置方法。
新兵训练的过程中，由于使用方法不当，很容易对武器造成不必要的损毁。因此练兵场旁时常摆放着大量武器，以便随时取用。
对于千岩军而言，训练造成的武器损耗不值一提，但要是放在盗宝团那边，可能就要扣除新兵的薪水了…
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Training Ground.
New recruits tend to cause unnecessary damage to their own weapons due to improper use during their training. As such, training grounds tend to come with a large number of weapons for them to use.
For the Millelith, the weapon wear and tear caused by training is no big deal, but leaving them in the Treasure Hoarder's hands is cause for salary docking for sure...
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「备战的兵器工坊」的放置方法。\n稳定运转的兵器工坊。技艺熟练的铁匠也有可能被矿石的质量束缚，打造出质量一般的武器。因此铁匠们设置了多个武器架，将不同品质的武器分组摆放出售。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up an Arms Factory.\nA stable weapon-making operation. Even seasoned smiths may be restricted by the quality of the ore they have to work with, which makes for weapons of so-so quality. Thus, they will place a number of weapon racks to divide the weaponry up by quality and sell them as such.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「货运中转地」的放置方法。
运输货物的中转地，堆叠的货箱和木桶旁，摆放着为工人准备的饮品。
虽说如今流通的陶制瓶罐都很结实，但被重物碾压磕碰，还是很容易破碎，因此工人们一直希望管理者准备一个橱柜，而不是将瓶罐放在地上。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Cargo Transfer Station.
A transit point for moving goods from place to place. Beside the piled-high cargo crates and wooden barrels are drinks prepared for the workers.
Though common bottles and jugs are quite sturdy nowadays, they will still break easily if squashed under a very heavy object. Thus, the workers have always hoped that their foreman might get a cupboard of some sort, rather than leave the bottles on the ground.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「节庆的市井」的放置方法。\n热闹的市集，待售的玩具、花伞和礼品琳琅满目，物美价廉。对孩子们有着无可比拟的吸引力，也不会过度伤害父母的钱袋。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Festival Market.\nThe sight of a bustling city, toys on sale, colorful parasols, and all manner of affordable but lovely gifts, is a dazzling one indeed — a feast for the eyes of children, and not too grievous a blow to the parents' wallets.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「要道正门-『妖邪退散』」的放置方法。\n布置着仙牌和石狮子像的入城要道，这些标志性的陈设，足以震慑魔物，但千岩军也从未疏于防范。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Thoroughfare Entrance: Evil Banisher.\nAdepti plates and stone lions guard this main thoroughfare. Such symbolic gestures are enough to deter monsters, but the Millelith have never slackened their vigilance nonetheless.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「生意红火的食肆」的放置方法。\n一些璃月餐馆的菜品风味上佳，有口皆碑，每到饭点，都有大批客人惠顾。因此店家往往在室外摆放餐位，力求能留住所有来客。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up an Ever-Popular Eatery.\nSome Liyue restaurants boast top-quality dishes that will feed any hungry mouth, and patrons visit them in droves every night. These eateries often set up outdoor tables in an effort to retain every customer possible.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「乡野的水源」的放置方法。
紧靠树木的水井。
树木枝叶茂盛，证明此地水源洁净，来往之人可以放心取用。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a Rural Water Source.
A well that sticks close to a tree.
The tree grows lushly, showing that the water is clean and that those who come hither may draw and drink without fear.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「孤独而谨慎的冒险家」的放置方法。\n独自远游的冒险家大多相当谨慎，会在路标附近宿营，因为路标代表此地曾有前人探索，并将附近的魔物驱离。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a "Lone and Cautious Adventurer."\nAdventurers who travel solo tend to be rather conscientious, setting up camp near to road signs as these are places where others tend to have traveled before, chasing the nearby monsters off.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs: 步骤详实的图纸，记载着「气候相交之地」的放置方法。\n多种气候相交的奇妙地带，生长着不同特点的植株。最初有学者认为这可能是地脉异常导致的结果，但随后的调查证明，这只是提瓦特大陆各种奇妙的自然现象之一。\n使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en: A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up a "Climate Crossover."\nA strange area where different weather conditions interweave, and where plants with different specialties grow. At first, some scholars believed that this might be a result of abnormalities in the ley lines, but later investigations would reveal that this is simply one of Teyvat's many wondrous natural phenomena.\nAfter using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

name_en: Dialogue Twixt Ancient Tree and Rock
desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「朽木与磐石的对谈」的放置方法。
并无特殊之处的青叶盘伏树和山石。
某位小巷诗人一时兴起，声称天地万物皆有灵气，此树和山石正在无声交谈。众人被她影响，越看越觉得，这句描述相当贴切。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for setting up "Dialogue Twixt Ancient Tree and Rock."
This green-leafed tree and mountain rock aren't anything special.
A certain alley poet once claimed that everything in this world has an aura and that this tree and the rock were having a wordless conversation. Many others, influenced by her words, came to believe more and more that these words were quite fitting indeed.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「诗歌沉思间」的放置方法。
布置精妙的书房，深度参考了骑士团的办公室。据说书房中的每件陈设都有着严格的摆放位置，能将烛光与阴影完美融汇，营造独一无二的光照效果。偏爱文艺书籍的读者与写手能在这里找到泉涌般的灵感；忙碌之人亦能快速静心，进入高效工作的状态。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
偏好这套摆设的同伴：琴、丽莎、菲谢尔、莫娜、优菈、塔利雅、杜林
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for making "Amidst Poetic Pondering."
A subtly-decorated study based heavily upon the Knights of Favonius office. It's been said that each part of this study has followed careful placement rules, allowing the candle lights and shadows to blend perfectly to create a unique lighting effect. Literature-loving readers and writers will find a wellspring of inspiration here, while the busy can get in the zone with minimal fuss and chance of interruption.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.
This Furnishing Set is favored by the following companions: Jean, Lisa, Fischl, Mona, Eula, Dahlia, Durin

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「柔风低语间」的放置方法。
随处可见「关怀之心」的卧室。对于匆忙度日的人而言，卧室或许只是容纳床铺，闭眼过夜的房间，凑合凑合就好。可在细心之人眼中，住所的每个角落，都值得倾注心意。
无论向往自由的风，还是执着抗争的风，在吹拂之初，皆为轻柔的微风。给予自己必要的呵护，才能深行至远方。倘若一室之内的生活被温柔环抱，那么疲惫也会在不经意间悄然溜走吧。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
偏好这套摆设的同伴：芭芭拉、优菈、诺艾尔
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for making "Amidst Whispering Winds."
A bedroom that embodies the idea of a "caring heart." For busy folk, a bedroom may just be a place that contains a bed, a place where one gets a little shut-eye, and which does not require too much care. But for those with an eye for detail, every part of one's living space is worth time and care.
Whether they be the winds of freedom or resistance, they all began as the tiniest of gentle breezes. One who travels far must take good care of themselves, and surely fatigue will slip away unnoticed if one lives surrounded by warmth and comfort.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.
This Furnishing Set is favored by the following companions: Barbara, Eula, Noelle

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「绯云文斋」的放置方法。
璃月的书斋有着诸多门道，但「奢华」实为可有可无的选项，文人们更重视「气韵」与「清雅」。摆上一株葱郁的盆栽，平衡屋内的湿度，桌案与书柜的木材就能散发出清幽的淡香，配合有意留白的布局，与立灯如炽的光晕，使人神采奕然，笔走龙蛇。
据传多年前，旅居绯云坡的某位墨客无心插柳，布置了这式书房，并被「万文集舍」的前代掌柜推广。此后它便以「绯云文斋」之名，为璃月的千家万户所熟知。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
偏好这套摆设的同伴：行秋、钟离、凝光、云堇、白术、蓝砚、兹白
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for making a "Feiyun Study Room."
There are many ways to fashion a study in Liyue, but luxury is optional, for the learned prefer "spirit" and "elegance." A potted plant here balances out the moisture in the room, and the table and shelves exude a light woody fragrance that combines with the plain layout and the sunset glow of the lamps to inspire genius and elevate writing.
They say that many years ago, a certain guest at Feiyun Slope laid just such a study out, and this design was taken up by the previous boss of Wanwen Bookhouse. Thus, it was ever after known as the Feiyun Study Room and became recognized throughout Liyue.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.
This Furnishing Set is favored by the following companions: Xingqiu, Zhongli, Ningguang, Yun Jin, Baizhu, Lan Yan, Zibai

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「烟霞入梦阁」的放置方法。
「昨日烟霞，蔼然入梦」
质朴无华的睡房，各式陈设的风格与望舒客栈相仿。这间睡房的玄奇之处难以言喻，如有时光的云雾缭绕，勾起游人的追思，却将其中的哀戚卸下，独留往事的刻痕。
尘世的生活正如一场漂泊，牢记「本我」才能稳住身形，行桨前溯。半梦半醒之时的思绪，往往极为深切。难怪不少旅人在望舒客栈留宿一夜后，都能找到百倍的干劲，容光焕发地启程。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
偏好这套摆设的同伴：胡桃、烟绯、甘雨、刻晴、重云、嘉明
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for making a "Cloudy Haze Dream-Court."
"Of cloud-haze faintly dreaming."
A humble and unassuming bedroom alike in many ways to one you might find in Wangshu Inn. This bedroom's mystery is hard to explain in words. Sometimes it will evoke remembrance in those who pass through, like the sunlight poking through the swirling clouds. Yet it will remove the sorrows therein and leave only the marks of happenings past.
We are all adrift in this mortal life, and only by remembering who "we" are can we remain steady along our course. Our thoughts are clearest in the interstice between dreaming and waking. No wonder those who visit Wangshu Inn for a night find themselves re-energized a hundred times over, radiant and ready to embark on their journey once more.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.
This Furnishing Set is favored by the following companions: Hu Tao, Yanfei, Ganyu, Keqing, Chongyun, Gaming

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「秘术研究所」的放置方法。
平平无奇的炼金工坊，除去个别精巧的器件，看似与普通书房并无差异，但书架上的典籍，容器中的试剂，还有保存在柜子中标注着「严禁拆封」的实验样本，普通人大多闻所未闻，只能凭借自己的印象对它们的用途和内容加以揣测。倘若有好奇之人违背禁令，安全事故就在所难免了。
误入工坊的猫猫引发两次雷声大雨点小的「炼金药剂危机」后，西风骑士团的调查小队就对城内的炼金工坊实施了严格的出入管制。大量关于炼金术的奇怪传说就是在那时诞生的，让潜心研究的学者们头疼不已。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
偏好这套摆设的同伴：可莉、砂糖、阿贝多、丽莎、布伦妮
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for making a "Secret Research Lab."
A plain old alchemy workshop. Take out the specialized, intricate apparatus and it would look just like any other study, but for the collection of books on the shelves, the reagents in their containers, and the various experimental samples marked "Do Not Open," the uses of which can only be wildly guessed at by the uninitiated. An incident is probably unavoidable should some curious cat fail to heed this instruction.
After actual cats that mistakenly entered the workshop caused two such alchemical potion accidents, the Knights of Favonius Investigation Team would place strict entry-exit regulations on alchemy workshops within the city. A great number of the strange rumors concerning alchemy were also born around this time, causing no small number of headaches for researchers just trying to concentrate on their work.
After using this item, you can view it in the Placement Screen.
This Furnishing Set is favored by the following companions: Klee, Sucrose, Albedo, Lisa, Prune

desc_chs:
步骤详实的图纸，记载着「柴烟庖屋」的放置方法。
烹饪器具完备的厨房，橱柜中存放着精心制备的调味品。
追求卓越的厨师会从市场购买当日的新鲜食材，而技艺出神入化的厨师，连用于炉灶的干柴都会仔细考量。万民堂的年轻大厨就曾向同行们分享经验——想要烹调出轻策庄的传统菜肴，须在炉中加入干燥的竹片，细心控制火候；如果找来钩钩果附近的灌木，处理成细长的木柴，更是能还原出邻国蒙德的风味。
各种干柴燃烧时的特性截然不同，大多厨师无法掌握要领，因此，万民堂一直独占着这门技艺。
使用后可进入放置界面查看。
偏好这套摆设的同伴：达达利亚、莫娜、魈、香菱、雷泽、瑶瑶、米卡、白术
desc_en:
A detailed step-by-step blueprint for making a "Cottage Kitchen."
A fully equipped kitchen with a cabinet full of carefully prepared seasonings.
Chefs seeking excellence will buy fresh ingredients from the market daily, and true culinary artists will even pay close attention to the firewood used in their stoves. The young head chef of Wanmin Restaurant once shared that to make the traditional dishes of Qingce Village, one must first place dry bamboo chips into the stove and carefully control the flame. If one can process the shrubbery near Wolfhooks into thin firewood, one can even add a little Mondstadt flair in.
